games.summary: Step into the shoes of a station manager and take over an abandoned roadside gas station. From rusty pumps and empty shelves to a bustling hub of activity, every decision is yours. Refuel cars, clean vehicles, manage the store, and maintain the area — success depends on your skill, speed, and strategy. Experience the challenge of running a full-service station, where every role matters and every customer counts.

games.name: Golfing Over It with Alva Majo
games.summary: Golfing Over It with Alva Majo is a discouraging game about climbing a surreal mountain with a golf ball, a different take on 2017's hit Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy. Experience the challenge of climbing an unyielding mountain without infuriating controls being part of that challenge.

games.name: GOT3D
games.summary: A faithful 3D action-adventure remake of the classic 1994 DOS shareware title 'God of Thunder' built in the Godot engine. Players traverse the land of Midgard as Thor, solving puzzles, talking to wacky townspeople, and using the mythical hammer Mjolnir to defeat the evil serpent Jormangund.

games.name: Guilds of Greybrook
games.summary: Guilds of Greybrook is a roguelike management simulator where you don't play the hero, you pay the heroes! Operate the choppy waters of business ownership, hire adventurers, take contracts, and choose sides in the dangerous power struggles of the frontier.

games.name: Haunted Manager
games.summary: “If your fear is half-hearted, I will shut you down―――”My father, the head of the haunted mansion, said this to me on the first day of opening.

games.name: Heavy Hearts
games.summary: If humans are near extinction - and have become a rarity. In many cases, denizens would love to get their hands on one. Luccia's quest is to stop the decline of human civilization in this action RPG, where love and lust get in the way of the mission.

games.name: Hentai Sora
games.summary: Hentai Sora is a sensual puzzle game about a cold yet dangerously attractive girl. Solve levels, unlock explicit scenes, and slowly reveal her desires as the tension rises with every move.

games.name: Hired Stars
games.summary: HIRED STARS is an isometric single player RTS game in an open, randomly generated sandbox universe. You take control of a small mercenary force. Plunder trade routes, attack pirates, fight the Empire or follow the story. Conquer or buy new ships and equipment. Recruit new captains and level them.

games.name: Ho Ho & Move
games.summary: Collect gifts, and plan the perfect path.

games.name: Kasso Gaiden: Escape from the Skaterverse
Last Dolls
games.summary: Last Dolls is a roguelite horror game set in a dark fairytale world. Do you have what it takes to survive in a shattered world of dolls, scavenging supplies while evading monsters?

games.name: Loan Shark
games.summary: The loan shark is coming for you. Catch enough fish to repay your debt before it is too late. Go fish.

games.name: Love and Legends
games.summary: In a heartbeat, the ordinary becomes legendary. In a world of fantasy, where will your destiny and love lead?

games.name: Magic Sheep
games.summary: Get ready to fluff your brain and relax your heart, because this little sheep in a top hat is about to turn puzzle-solving into the cutest ritual of calm you’ve ever seen. Magic Sheep is a charming, slow-paced puzzle adventure where you push wooden barrels across peaceful gardens until each one rests perfectly on a marble pedestal. No pressure, no timer, only soft music, gentle thinking, and plenty of “oh, that was clever” moments.

games.name: Maid Cafe on Electric Street
games.summary: Maid Cafe on Electric Street is a leisurely maid cafe adventure set in the otaku haven of Nipponbashi, Osaka.

games.name: Manairons
games.summary: Manairons is a 3D action platformer game inspired by the legends of little creatures living in the Pyrenees. Help Nai face off against the landowner who has taken control of a charming village using the power of the "canut," with magic, flute, and plenty of chaos.

games.name: Mitnal
games.summary: Play as Emily, drawn to a remote Mayan ruin after her brother insists it’s safe, amazing and beautiful. Explore an ancient Mayan site spanning jungle, temple, and catacombs as it becomes clear that he didn’t understand what he uncovered.

games.name: Mole Cart Mining
games.summary: Get ready for an underground adventure full of charm and strategy! In Mole Cart Mining, you guide a determined little mole riding a mine cart while rotating tracks on a hexagonal grid to create the perfect route. The goal is simple and satisfying: collect every mineral and reach the exit in style.

games.name: Monkaru Fanta: Yuusha to Suishou no Shoujo
games.summary: Monkaru is an orthodox, retro-inspired turn-based fantasy RPG where you travel to defeat The Demon Lord with the help of a girl who was sealed in a crystal. The game is by Experience with character designs by Yuji Himukai and monster designs by Akifumi Yamamoto.

games.name: Monkey in the Zoo
games.summary: Step inside the cage. Banana drama guaranteed.

games.name: NemoSphere
games.summary:
This is the easy-play shooter

NemoSphere is the easy-play shooter

Left and right operation and shoot

Shoot to the sphere coming from the left and right

The ejected block is speedy

The key point is timing

Leave your best time

games.name: New Heights
games.summary: New Heights is a physics-based climbing and bouldering game.

games.name: No Sleep for Kaname Date: From AI - The Somnium Files
games.summary:
Kaname Date and the AI-Ball, Aiba tackle a mysterious case and rescue Iris, an internet idol who has been forced to take part in a dangerous escape game.
Examine crime scenes and listen to testimonies in "Investigation". Enter the dream worlds of suspects and key witnesses in "Somnium". Solve puzzles to break out of locked rooms in the new "Escape" sections.
By moving between these three sections, obtain the necessary clues to solve the case.

games.name: Oldest Golden Treasure
games.summary: Investigate the mysterious disappearance of your colleague in this thrilling VR escape room adventure. Every decision you make brings you closer to the truth... or further from it. Do you have what it takes to crack the case?

games.name: Path of Mystery: A Brush with Death
games.summary:
A completely new title from Imagineer and Toybox Inc., Mystery Walk is the first in a three-part serial drama series!

The game is set in Narumisawa, a charming, fictional summer getaway town that feels familiar, as though you have seen it somewhere before…

The story alternates between the present and the past to uncover the truth behind an unsolved case from 30 years ago.

Told through a prologue, 10 episodes, and a mysterious “?” episode, the mysteries deepen with each chapter.

The fully voiced dialogue, brought to life by a talented cast, will make you eager to continue to the next episode. And there are some unexpected names among the voice actors…

Please immerse yourself in the world of Mystery Walk to the fullest!

games.name: PC Building Simulator 2
games.summary: Grow your empire as you learn to repair, build and customize PCs at the next level. Experience deeper simulation, an upgraded career mode, and powerful new customisation features. Use realistic parts from 40+ hardware brands to bring your ultimate PC to life.

games.name: Peaceful Fishing Story
games.summary:
Relax and unwind.
Enjoy a slow life all your own, spent fishing at your own pace.

games.name: Picronix 2
games.summary: Take a breather and challenge your brain with these calming logic puzzles

games.name: Pocket Archery Master
games.summary: Test your agility and archery skills. Use bow to shoot targets, survive enemy waves.

games.name: Pools
games.summary: Liminal space game with focus on eerie exploration and immersion instead of typical horror. Navigate through endless alike rooms. Explore, orient, get out.

games.name: Questi Quest
games.summary: An endless runner with shoot-em-up mechanic.

games.name: Rain Debt
games.summary: A game about a kid who's forced to pay back his debt.

games.name: Ready, Set, Block!
games.summary: "Ready, Set, Block!" is a fast-paced PvP board game where players race to reach the opposite side first. Place blocks to slow opponents, use character abilities and items to outwit rivals, and plan your moves carefully in this turn-based, tactical race. Play locally, online, or vs AI.

games.name: Rebooted Fate
games.summary: Qin Nian, who had just graduated when the financial crisis hit and found himself unemployed at home, accidentally obtained a secret manual from an old beggar. Little did he realize that this manual would not only alter the course of his life but also lift a veil on the reality of the world.

games.name: Renegade X
games.summary:
Renegade X is a free Tactical Shooter that brings the Command and Conquer FPS experience to Unreal Engine 3. Renegade X is developed by Totem Arts, an independent group of Command & Conquer fans from around the world dedicated to bringing the world of C&C to you, up close and personal.

Two factions, the Global Defense Initiative (GDI) and the Brotherhood of Nod (Nod), are locked into a conflict over the green and mysterious resource Tiberium.
The primary game mode is Command & Conquer (C&C/CnC), where your objective is to destroy your enemy's base using any and all means necessary.

games.name: Rite of Eris
games.summary: Rite of Eris is a survival roguelike inspired by the likes of Vampire Survivors, Hades, and more. Unlock new characters, each with their own unique abilities, then jump into battle, unlocking powerful abilities along the way to aid your conquest against hordes of enemies.

games.name: Rolling Macho: Tumbling to Earth
games.summary: Rolling Macho: Tumbling to Earth is a rolling action game where you roll and squat your way back to Earth after being stranded in space.

games.name: Rusty Vein
games.summary: Rusty Vein is a 2.5D action-adventure game. Wearing a metal gauntlet, Rain sets out on a journey to defeat the mysterious doll legion that has occupied the town’s castle.

games.name: Saga & Seeker
games.summary: From a consumer of stories to a creator of them. Saga & Seeker is a "storycrafting game" where you can generate endless tales with your favorite characters. The words you write become a part of the story itself in this immersive entertainment experience powered by your imagination.

games.name: Sands of Aura
games.summary: Sands of Aura is an open-world action adventure with a fantasy setting of a realm in its twilight--a world buried beneath a sea of sand. Sail across the sandseas to return life to a dying world in an unforgettable experience that is equal parts engaging story and unrelenting, souls-like combat.

games.name: Shadow Corridor 2: Ame no Yohira
games.summary: Lost forever in the pitch black! But that's what makes it fun! The vast corridors covered in darkness change with each play. All you can do is run or hide from the frightening Apparitions. Use unique items and Karuta cards with special powers in your desperate search for an escape from the darkness!

games.name: Snapshot Oddities! Find What's Wrong
games.summary:
Can you spot something “off”?
A spot-the-oddity game where you hunt for strange details in images!

games.name: Snägäri Pinball
games.summary:
Snägäri Pinball is a classic 2D pinball game set in the late-night afterparty world of Finnish snack kiosks. Players control a single hand-drawn table designed around ramps, lanes, gates, ball locks, events, and score-chasing challenges.

The game features multiple visual and rule variations, including Finnish Mode, Over-The-Top Mode, and an Analog Horror Mode with CRT-style effects. Optional seasonal table themes add holiday and national celebration variants throughout the year.

A dedicated Kids Mode replaces adult humour and nightlife references with family-friendly art, music, and separate leaderboards. High scores, achievements, multiball events, and hidden secrets support replayability across different modes.

games.name: Sociable Soccer Champions
games.summary: Sociable Soccer Champions is an all-action carnival of fast-paced arcade football action.

games.name: Solnest
games.summary:
Solnest is a relaxing cat-finding adventure set in peaceful, sunlit, solarpunk-themed rooms. Explore all cozy levels to discover hidden cats in a beautifully drawn world.
500+ hidden cats to find across detailed scenes. 11 cozy rooms to explore, each bursting with solarpunk personality.

games.name: Spellcasters Chronicles
games.summary: CAST. FLY. FIGHT. COOPERATE. In intense 3V3 action-strategy battles, summon hundreds of creatures, cast devastating spells, and call upon the might of Titans to rise as the most powerful member of the community of Spellcasters – and shape the fate of the world. Together.

games.name: Subway Surfers City
games.summary:
Jump into the world of Subway City and play the newest endless running game. Conquer the new obstacles, reach new heights, and collect new characters! Jake, Tricky, Fresh and Yutani will take you on new adventures in Subway Surfers City.

Subway Surfers City brings an arcade runner quest with super-charged visuals, new characters, thrilling missions and more. Play now and run like never before!

games.name: Sushi Bar: Moebius
games.summary: A physics puzzle game. When you put sushi on top of sushi, the sushi you make will flow down the lane. Feed the customers and keep them full! When they are full, the next customer will come. The game is over when the sushi is out of the box! Aim for a high score!

games.name: Sweet Elf
games.summary: Sweet Elf - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game featuring five pretty and adorable elves. Enjoy the daily lives of these elves with relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

games.name: Tales of Berseria Remastered
games.summary:
Tales of Berseria returns with enhanced graphics and optimized gameplay!

Engage in the ultimate quest for self-discovery, remastered for the first time. The sacred kingdom awaits the arrival of its savior, and a lone woman named Velvet is marked by traumatic deceit. Join Velvet on her journey for vengeance, along with her cast of eccentric companions, as they sail through the archipelago which comprises the kingdom of Midgand

games.name: The Demon Queen's Dire Dilemma
games.summary: A cute and comedic yuri visual novel about a demon queen who just can't catch a break.

games.name: The Fox's Way Home
games.summary: Before you know it, you find yourself in the realm between the hidden world and the real world. Rely on the guidance of the Fox shrine Maiden who lives there, and escape from the otherworld!

games.name: The Pancake Paradox
games.summary: The story of two women, who make pancakes in the middle of a sandstorm, even though the planet is dying. is a bit short, right? ...then a story that has a little more than that.

games.name: Tiny Garden
games.summary:
Tiny Garden, build your own magical garden inside a 90s toy
Plant your vegetables and trade them for furniture to customize tiny gardens in this delightful mix of farming, puzzle and strategy

games.name: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
games.summary:
Countless souls wander the ring road at night.
The title of “fastest” never fades, no matter how times change.

The stage of battle is a sealed future Tokyo.
Race through the night highways weaving through the city in your customized machine.
Defeat the countless rivals and aim to become the fastest on the Shuto Expressway.

games.name: Towerborne
games.summary: The Belfry stands as a beacon of hope and safety amongst the ruins of humanity and the City of Numbers, with monsters lurking right outside the tower’s walls. You are an Ace, born anew from the spirit realm with the skills, the grit, and the determination to protect the people of the Belfry.

games.name: Trials of Olympus
games.summary: Endure the Trials of the Gods in a fluid platforming adventure.

games.name: Vortex 9
games.summary: An online shooter with stylish brawlers, insane weapons, explosive shooting battles and cute pets! Supporting cross play with VR, mobile and desktop versions.

games.name: Warlock Survivors
games.summary: Warlock Survivors is the battleground where you will face hundreds of thousands of enemies in a single frantic run. Upgrade your build and grab all resources you can to reach enough power to survive.

games.name: Waterpark Simulator 2025
games.summary: Life’s Better Soaked.

games.name: WEGO World War II: Overlord
games.summary: WEGO World War II: Overlord is an operational-level, ground-centric WEGOWW2 game system. This hex-based wargame recreates the Allied invasion of Western Europe. Includes 14 historical scenarios, from the landing at Omaha beach to a huge 135-turn campaign that covers the entire Normandy campaign.

games.name: WorldNeverland: Daily Life in the Elnea Kingdom
games.summary: How would you like to live of life of freedom in the Elnea Kingdom? Find solace in the company of unique residents, exploring, battling, collecting, farming, romancing, marrying, raising children, etc. Kick back, relax and enjoy yourself inside the life simulation game, WorldNeverland-Elnea Kingdom.

games.name: Yoshiko, Go to Your Relatives' House!
games.summary: Visiting a relative's house—it is a grand adventure. Presented by Satoru Gobunme, a creator with over 500,000 YouTube subscribers! Control the tragic heroine "Yoshiko Obune," overcome attacking strangers, traps, and exploding pandas to safely

games.name: Z Route: Redemption
games.summary: Post apocalyptic zombie action game that throws you into a relentless road war, where survival hinges on speed, precision, and split second decisions. Behind the wheel, you smash through barricades, mow down swarms, and pick between branching gates that hide supply caches or deadly ambushes. Each run pushes you forward toward redemption as you tune weapons, react to hazards, and keep momentum alive to outpace the horde.

games.name: Amazon Animals
games.summary: Amazonia Animals is a jigsaw puzzle featuring animals from the Amazon rainforest. Embark on a journey to the world's largest forest and meet endangered animals in beautiful hand-drawn 2D artwork

games.name: Apogee
games.summary: Apogee is a retro-style, physics-based arcade game where players navigate alone through an increasingly dense asteroid field.

games.name: Aquamarine: Explorer's Edition
games.summary:
Aquamarine is a turn-based playable comic book about surviving in an alien ocean.

Inspired by the psychedelic sci-fi of the '70s & '80s, Aquamarine combines the mystery of old-school adventure games and challenging roguelikes with elements of survival, exploration, and puzzle solving.

Journey across a water world reclaimed by nature. Overcome survival and navigational challenges as you discover the planet's lost history. Master your pod's controls, study the ocean wildlife, and solve environmental puzzles to help you find your way home.

Cultivate a variety of alien plants with unique attributes. Forage the depths for food and salvage tools to help you survive. Collect and craft powerful upgrades for your humble escape pod, and customize your loadout to fit the needs of every plunge into the water.

You play as a lone space traveler known only as The Seeker. While orbiting an uncharted aquaplanet, your starcraft is disrupted by a strange signal and you're forced to eject. You crash land on a tiny island surrounded by an endless alien ocean, with nothing to help you but an amphibious survival pod. Throughout your underwater journey to reach your crashed ship, you'll uncover the planet's lost history and discover the true nature of why The Seeker ended up here.

games.name: Arrow World
games.summary: Guide the ever-moving cardboard "Hakoby" to the goal! Use infinitely placeable conveyor belts to create diverse solutions. A fresh puzzle experience that responds to Hakoby in real-time!

games.name: AutoBlobber
games.summary: AutoBlobber is a Roguelike Autobattler where you customize your Blob to survive endless waves of enemies. Strategically place upgrades, forge powerful synergies, and adapt your build between waves to push your run as far as possible.

games.name: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings
games.summary:
You are a young adult adrift in life, suffocating under the yoke of your oppressive parents. Feeling out of sync with the rest of the world, you yearn for freedom and life beyond the bounds of your prison.

You find it in the form of a ravishing stranger and a long lost city, calling out to you across space and time. Something is beckoning underneath the ancient city's glimmering white tiles, something old and powerful. Someone.

Will you resist the call beyond the veil and the promise of belonging it brings, or will you let yourself go and embrace the path destiny has set before you?

The choice is yours. Magnustor is waiting for you.

games.name: Buy the Game, I Have a Gun: Sheesh-Man
games.summary: This game is an interactive movie telling the story of how I went on earth and became a super-hero or whatever, it's pretty sick if you ask me! Not sick in the sense that you will throw up, but in the sense that it's cool. This my friend was a word play, you can expect this level of humour in the game, may I say it even gets better than this, not a lot, but at least a little bit.

games.name: Candy Brain
games.summary:
Candy Brain is a small crafting/shooting game set on a colorful world infected by zombies.
Play as an employee of the Candy Knights company whose job is to test the latest prototype in the field, the Candy Truck!

games.name: Cards and Castles Ultimate
games.summary: Collectible cards meets tactical strategy! Build decks, uncover crazy combos, and battle friends and rivals in TACTICAL CARD-BOARD COMBAT. Bring your cards to life and dominate the grid!

games.name: Cat Cursor by Travellin Cats
games.summary: Desktop cat cursor for Windows: turn your boring cursor into an adorable cat paw. Boop!

games.name: Catx11
games.summary: Catx11 is a short incremental game. Harvest crops, buy upgrades, hire cats, fight bosses, and level up your gear! Many different strategies and ways to play.

games.name: Cozy Holes
games.summary: Play as Digby, a magical shovel left behind during an ancient calamity. Tunnel through layered biomes and uncover a heartfelt story through ancient carvings - etched by your lost shovel tribe in a whimsical tropical world.

games.name: Dracu-Riot!
games.summary: Welcome to the Special Administrative Region "Aqua Eden", an artificial island off the coast of Japan where casinos and more are legal.

games.name: Elf Clash
games.summary: Lead your team to delve into the Three Realms, rescue the abducted detective, retrieve the Energy Spirit Stone, and punish the nefarious forces hiding in the shadows. Each realm presents unique challenges and secrets, and your decisions will sway the course of the battle.

games.name: Exodus
games.summary: Defend Earth from the waves of alien invaders in this action-packed top-down shooter!

games.name: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix
games.summary:
Return to 2048 Hong Kong in the groundbreaking prequel that defined style and mature storytelling for a generation.

Set two years before the events of Fear Effect, dive into a sprawling adventure that takes you from futuristic cityscapes to the lost tomb of China's first emperor, and discover the origins of mercenaries Hana Tsu-Vachel, Royce Glas, Deke Decourt, and the enigmatic Rain Qin, in a story that blends high-tech espionage with ancient Chinese mythology and the supernatural.

games.name: Fishing Pro Simulator
games.summary: From quiet waters to rare trophies.

games.name: Furry Superstar
games.summary: Once a famous model, now a depressed middle-aged woman - there is no chance she's gonna get back to the top... Unless a young model agent-boy helps her to feel loved again!

games.name: Gas Ratio
games.summary: Are you ready to test your driving skills and your luck? Gas Ratio brings back the nostalgia of classic top-down arcade racers with a chaotic twist. In this game, speed isn't the only thing that matters—survival does.

games.name: Go Up Frog
games.summary: Falling isn’t the end. In this 2D precision platformer, you must keep climbing upward. Small mistakes lead to big falls, but every challenge can be faced again. How far can the frog go?

games.name: Green Light
games.summary: A forgotten mining town. Peaceful by day, mysterious by night. Enter the dream and unravel the town's secrets.

games.name: Gum Squad
games.summary: Gum Squad is a co-op PvE shooter set in a quiet world gone sticky. Start with a peashooter, explore together, and gear up to survive the gum epidemic with up to 8 players!

games.name: Hamachi the Psychotic Killer
games.summary: Welcome to Hamachi the Psychotic Killer! In this platformer, you control Hamachi, a once-ordinary person now possessed by a demon with a craving for souls. Will you choose to spare the innocent or succumb to the urge to kill them all?

games.name: Hello, Runa!
games.summary: Wake up "Runa," an AI girl trapped in an old game console for 7 years. Experience a deep connection through dynamic animations and full voice acting for every line. Repair the system and discover the truth in this unique visual novel.

games.name: Imperial Command
games.summary: Imperial Command is a turn-based strategy board game inspired by classics like Risk. Conquer a hex-based map, build your economy, and battle friends or AI in multiplayer—fully playable on Steam Deck.

games.name: Jigsaw Realms: Oasis
games.summary: Welcome to the Oasis.

games.name: John Fury’s First Fury
games.summary: John Fury’s First Fury is a 2d adventure game. Your adventure will bring you across the landscapes of Russia to make it to a secret communist lab where they're conducting dangerous experiments. You'll have use what you find to help you along your journey against many different enemies and bosses.

games.name: John's Quest
games.summary: You are John Appleby, video game historian. Your evil twin, "Evil John," is plotting dark schemes and causing a collision between genres! Only you have the power to restore peace and save gaming...

games.name: Just Dismantle
games.summary: Relax and unwind as you dismantle entire maps, piece by piece. Gather valuable resources to upgrade your tools and skills while unlocking new areas in this satisfying deconstruction simulator. No rush, no pressure – just pure dismantling.

games.name: Laysara: Summit Kingdom
games.summary: Build and expand your very own settlements in high mountains! Carefully plan production chains and satisfy various needs of your three-caste society while dealing with mountain hazards such as weather breakdowns and avalanches. Are you skilled enough to make your town thrive?

games.name: Liar's Dice
games.summary: Liar's Dice is an online realtime casual multiplayer bluffing dice game. Easy to learn, easy to master, always entertaining. Play with other players around the globe or invite and play with family or friends. Liar's Dice, also known as Dudo, Cachito, Perudo, Deception Dice, and Pirate Dice.

games.name: Lone Survivors
games.summary: Cut through hundreds of monsters and survive against all odds in this fantasy survivors-like top-down action game! Level up, unlock abilities, and defeat bosses with a wide arsenal of weapons and magic.

games.name: LumenKnight
games.summary: LumenKnight is a roguelike survival game with souls-like combat. Fight through challenging enemy waves and epic bosses. Test your reflexes, timing, and strategy in every fight. One life per run. Step in, embrace the challenge, and prove your skill.

games.name: Malpraxis
games.summary: Assist Chief Medical Officer Samuel Edwards in performing TRIAGE, DIAGNOSIS, SURGERY on the crew aboard the TRH Rusanov.

games.name: Meowgic Mix
games.summary:
Welcome to Meowgic Mix, an adorable pixel art puzzle where a floating cat on a living book must mix potions and deliver them to the correct cauldrons. There are 30 stages inside a magical academy, with challenges that require strategy, logic, and a good dose of feline cleverness.

Observe the classroom where each cauldron awaits its perfect potion. Push bottles, plan your route, and avoid getting stuck while solving each enchanted mini-puzzle. And if something goes wrong, no worries — undo or restart is always just a paw away.

Meowgic Mix combines charming pixel visuals, relaxing music, and mechanics made for players who love calm puzzles, cute animals, and a touch of fantasy. Get ready for a cozy, clever, purr-magical experience where every completed level is a tiny victory in feline alchemy.

games.name: Metal Goose
games.summary: Play as the MG-1 super soldier in this gritty and wacky first-person boomer shooter, and mow down hordes of robotic birds in an endless global war between the Chickens and Geese.

games.name: Meteor World Actor: Gaslight Bullet
games.summary: The third and final part of the Meteor World Actor series.

games.name: Muv-Luv Alternative Remastered
games.summary: Playtime's over. Time for despair. Experience a masterpiece in the Muv-Luv saga's thrilling conclusion.

games.name: Muv-Luv Remastered
games.summary: One of the most highly-acclaimed visual novel series ever, now available on Nintendo Switch!

games.name: Night Clerk
games.summary: Night Clerk is a first-person psychological horror experience set in a quiet roadside motel. Monitor CCTV cameras, answer late-night calls, and uncover subtle anomalies as long stretches of silence slowly give way to unsettling patterns.

games.name: Peace Island
games.summary: On a remote island community, nine cats wake up to find their humans gone. Ultimately, it is up to them to decide: "Are the humans worth bringing back?"

games.name: Pepper Grinder
games.summary: Pepper Grinder is an action-packed pirate adventure starring the titular Pepper, a seafaring soul with a passion for prospecting, and Grinder, her super-powered drilling device.

games.name: Pokémon FireRed Version
games.summary:
Pokémon FireRed Version and Pokémon LeafGreen Version are a pair of core series Generation III games that are set in the Kanto region. They were released in Japan on January 29, 2004, in North America on September 9, 2004, in Australia on September 23, 2004 and in Europe on October 1, 2004.

As the first remakes in the Pokémon franchise, the games revisit the original pair of Pokémon games, Pokémon Red and Green Versions, and so feature all of the characters, plot elements, and challenges of them, but with several important upgrades to bring them up to speed with other Generation III games.

The Game Boy Advance Wireless Adapter was initially included with the games when they were first released, eliminating the need for Game Link Cables when trading between the two games (and later Pokémon Emerald Version). In later copies, it was sold separately.

FireRed and LeafGreen went on to become the second best-selling games of the Game Boy Advance, only behind Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire Versions. They also received Nintendo's Player's Choice awards.

games.name: Pokémon LeafGreen Version
games.summary:
Pokémon LeafGreen Version and Pokémon FireRed Version are a pair of core series Generation III games that are set in the Kanto region. They were released in Japan on January 29, 2004, in North America on September 9, 2004, in Australia on September 23, 2004 and in Europe on October 1, 2004.

As the first remakes in the Pokémon franchise, the games revisit the original pair of Pokémon games, Pokémon Red and Green Versions, and so feature all of the characters, plot elements, and challenges of them, but with several important upgrades to bring them up to speed with other Generation III games.

The Game Boy Advance Wireless Adapter was initially included with the games when they were first released, eliminating the need for Game Link Cables when trading between the two games (and later Pokémon Emerald Version). In later copies, it was sold separately.

FireRed and LeafGreen went on to become the second best-selling games of the Game Boy Advance, only behind Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire Versions. They also received Nintendo's Player's Choice awards.

games.name: Prison Escape Simulator
games.summary: Too long in this prison, time to get out of here. Pull the carpet and start digging with a teaspoon. Watch out for the guard, sell him the junk you find. Trade toilet paper with the prisoners. Get better items and improve your stats.

games.name: Rayadillo
games.summary: History-inspired game set during the Philippine-American War. Pick up your rifle and defend your country from both external and internal threats. The current version revolves around the Aswang storyline.

games.name: React Wars
games.summary: A stage-based turn-based strategy game where you read enemy moves and counter them under time pressure, then grow through item-driven builds with 89+ item synergies. Think fast, react faster!

games.name: Resident Evil 7: Biohazard
games.summary: Resident Evil 7: Biohazard is the first game of the Resident Evil series to switch from 3rd-person to fully 1st-person perspective. A complete refresh of gameplay systems simultaneously propels the survival horror experience to another level. It is as much horror as it is survival, boosting up scare elements and minimizing downright shooting action. The game allows use of Sony's PSVR Headset to play in VR mode.

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.summary: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: Resident Evil Village
games.summary: Resident Evil Village is a first-person survival horror game and the sequel to Resident Evil 7: Biohazard. The game maintains elements from previous Resident Evil games, with players having to scavenge environments for items and manage their resources. However, it adds more action-oriented gameplay, with higher enemy counts and a greater emphasis on combat.

games.name: Rina-sama Musou: The Chosen One and the Reign of Madness
games.summary: Perfect girl × Mad rule = No turning back from school life!?

games.name: Robo Rangers
games.summary:
Robo Rangers is a fast-paced top-down twin-stick shooter where you take control of an elite combat robot. Fight your way through vibrant, handcrafted biomes, survive relentless enemy waves, and take down powerful bosses using a wide range of weapons and special abilities.

Every mission delivers intense, arcade-style combat that rewards quick reflexes, smart positioning, and tactical decision-making. Collect crystals, upgrade your gear, and evolve into an unstoppable Robo Ranger.

games.name: Ruins Of Fear
games.summary: Lucian wakes up on an ordinary school day to find himself in a deserted world. Together with Elora, he must solve puzzles, evade creatures in dark corridors, and uncover the mysteries around him.

games.name: Rusty Seas
games.summary: A game about furry girls fighting over junk on the beach.

games.name: Slime Wars
games.summary: In Slime Wars, take command in fast-paced RTS matches where you gather resources, build up your base, train a gooey army, and crush your enemies. Whether you're defending your own slime stronghold or launching an all-out assault, every decision counts.

games.name: Solar Machina
games.summary: Solar Machina is a vibrant 2D pixel art platformer where you control a robot on a colorful journey through tropical landscapes filled with traps and enemies. As you progress, your robotic suit evolves, granting new movement abilities that transform how you play. With smooth controls, distinct biomes, and a nostalgic chiptune soundtrack, Solar Machina offers a satisfying blend of challenge, rhythm, and exploration that keeps engagement from start to finish.

games.name: Soulshard
games.summary: In a realm between life and death, a confused soul, haunted by a life filled with misguided choices, seeks redemption and freedom.

games.name: Space Shooter
games.summary: A 2D arcade style Space Shooter where you traverse the galaxy hunting down the aliens who attacked your planet.

games.name: Sparrow Country
games.summary: Embark on a mystical journey as a Sparrow, exploring enchanted worlds and meeting new characters. Complete challenges to enhance your skills and progress through the game. Level up your character to increase size and capability. Earn XP by collecting stars, completing races and challenges.

games.name: Specter Hideout
games.summary: Specter Hideout is a top-down, asymmetrical multiplayer experience for 2 to 5 players. It pits a team of Hunters against one invisible Specter. Whether you are hunting the specter or "haunting the living", every match is a game of cat-and-mouse where one wrong move means the end.

games.name: Stick Out!
games.summary: Stick Out! is a precision platformer where you must use a spear to overcome obstacles by sticking yourself to walls and surfaces. Collect coins, buy skins, earn stars, and break time records! Can you complete every level?

games.name: Thaw
games.summary: Mine for ore, trace your memories, and mine again. When you reach the Snow Crystal at the lowest level, the long winter will come to the end. This gentle and quiet mining visual novel offers a small sense of accomplishment, perfect for sleepless nights.

games.name: The AI Bubble
games.summary: Survive the corporate hell where AI tries to replace you... literally. Play as a Junior Dev, collect absurd upgrades (like 'Paid in Exposure' or '144p Tutorial'), and destroy hordes of buggy robots in this satirical Action Roguelite / Bullet Heaven.

games.name: The Final Shift
games.summary: The Final Shift is a slow-burn psychological horror game where a janitor’s lonely night in an empty office building turns into a nightmare of looping floors, distorted realities, and haunting memories that refuse to stay buried.

games.name: The NewZealand Story: Untold Adventure
games.summary: The NewZealand Story comes back to life with Bitobit: experience the adventure of Tiki, the little Kiwi created by Taito in 1988, in a colorful 2D platformer full of challenges and nostalgia!

games.name: The Spooky Island
games.summary: A dark horror game in which the protagonist, Liam, embarks on an expedition to an island to find treasure and earn money. But the island holds secrets and horrors. Over time, the expedition turns into a nightmare from which he must escape...

games.name: Thekku Island
games.summary: A chilling psychological horror set in 1980s Kerala. After weeks of silence, you arrive on a remote island to search for your missing wife. Explore an abandoned house, uncover local folklore, survive haunting encounters, and unravel the island’s buried secrets.

games.name: Totenkampf: Anime Waifus vs WW2 Zombies
games.summary: Fight waves of WW2 zombies as an interdimensional magical anime girl, alone, or with a team of up to 6! Customize your waifu's appearance and outfit, and wield a wide array of weapons and powers as you struggle to survive the undead horde.

games.name: Trials of Randoom
games.summary: Trials Of Randoom is a unique puzzle game with immense challenges and great mysteries. Each level is unique and your experience will be unforgettable as you solve the puzzles to advance through the different levels.

games.name: Twisted Chance Online
games.summary: It's a multiplayer survival horror game where a team of workers must repair, heal, and fight their way through a ruined research lab, while one player controls the Stalker, an evolving monster that hunts them down. Use tools, weapons, and environmental traps to survive… or embrace the terror.

games.name: Vikings: Sex and Blood
games.summary: Meet gorgeous women! Raid and defend your village, explore the islands of the north and build your own harem in Vikings: Sex and Blood!

games.name: Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight
games.summary: Grab the control yoke of a warplane and jump into the battlefields of World War 2 in this thrilling combat flight action game. In each of the campaigns for Great Britain, USSR and Germany you will assume the role of a pilot and squadron leader of an elite air force unit.

games.name: What We Carry
games.summary: What We Carry is a dark, gothic strategy RPG where you can only see yourself. Walk a brave path through an unseen world, face random event cards, and survive the weight of every choice you make—if you can carry it.

games.name: Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist
games.summary: Step into the gritty streets of Chicago in Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist, a story-driven crime adventure. Play as a determined detective navigating a city full of gangsters, corrupt cops, and hidden dangers. Investigate crimes, follow leads, interrogate witnesses, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious Russian crime syndicate. Explore diverse locations from bustling markets and shady bars to the dangerous docks. Experience immersive dialogues, thrilling chases, and tense confrontations in a detailed, atmospheric city. Can you survive the criminal underworld and bring justice to the streets of Chicago?

games.name: A Place Where Summer Rain Falls
games.summary:
️ “Everyone hides something.”
But when the silence ties to survival, the truth begins to shake.

'A Place Where Summer Rain Falls' is a story-driven visual novel set in a rainy school, where hidden memories and quiet emotions unfold.

The truth isn't always loud — sometimes, it's silent.

games.name: Castle of No Escape 2
games.summary: Explore 216 rooms of randomly generated hazards and enemies while collecting necessary artifacts in Castle of No Escape 2, a fantasy themed strategy RPG. Hundreds of monsters are roaming inside, guarding the sword shards - the last known thing to be capable of defeating the demonic castle owner.

games.name: Chronosmith's Saga
games.summary: Travel across the time-bending world of Tempora, master and plan routes through a branching static map, manage energy, grind and hunt exclusive drops as you face Vexar in a rougelike RPG designed for strategy and replayability.

games.name: ClickTown
games.summary: ClickTown is a minimalist pixel city builder. Place buildings, produce resources, and reinvest your output to steadily grow your city. Unlock new buildings and systems as your town expands over time.

games.name: CliveWareGold
games.summary: A standalone lore drop from the world of Clive is a Good Guy - free, weird, and packed with unstable secrets.

games.name: Cooking Misha
games.summary: It's latke night at Misha's!

games.name: Deep Russian Depression
games.summary: “Deep Russian Depression” is a visual novel about people whose fate is a miserable, dreary and hopeless existence somewhere in post-Soviet Russia.

games.name: Dimensional Animals
games.summary: Five animal friends unite for one glorious purpose: recover the dog's... play ball? Explore beautiful dimensions in this metroidvania action platformer adventure!

games.name: Dog's Walts
games.summary:
This is a pop and lighthearted 3D action game starring a slightly clumsy but lovable dog.
Use your hammer to smash enemies and obstacles and send them flying off the stage.
The more things you knock away, the higher your score climbs.
With simple controls and playful physics-based action,
this game is all about fun, chaos, and satisfying hits.

games.name: Dopamine Overdrive
games.summary: 【Survivor × Rhythm × Action】 Step onto the Cyber-POP stage of a virtual future, move to the beat, wipe out waves of data noise enemies, and ignite the crowd’s dopamine with sound, light, and rhythm to create your own C-POP live performance.

games.name: Dragon's Delightful Day
games.summary: Today is a delightful day for dragon. What adventures await her?

games.name: Dreadful River
games.summary: The realm is under attack. The king and his most loyal guards are trying to save the Eternal Crown. Floating down a vast river on a simple raft, you have to fight enemies, improve your gear, find allies and explore mysteries along the shores. Can you turn the tide?

games.name: Firefighters Simulator 2026
games.summary: Every fire is a new challenge, every second a life saved.

games.name: Follow Nightmare
games.summary: Dive into Follow Nightmare, a psychological horror adventure where gore and macabre tales intertwine. Face a terrifying enemy and its nightmarish creatures. Survive through combat and parameters that customize your adventure. Dare you face the horror?

games.name: Frog in the Fog
games.summary: Croak from the Fog

games.name: Frost Survival: Winter
games.summary: The wind howls across the frozen mountains. Snow stretches endlessly to the horizon, and the cold cuts deeper with every step. In Frost Survival – Winter, you are alone in a merciless wilderness where nature shows no mercy and survival is never guaranteed.

games.name: Glowfall Vale
games.summary: A World of Gentle Magic

games.name: Last Asylum
games.summary:
One sanctuary. One doctor. One last chance.
A mysterious plague has swept across the world, leaving chaos in its wake. As a plague doctor, you become the town's final beacon of hope. Build and manage a sanctuary, heal those you can, and guide your people through the darkest days of the pandemic.
Your strategy will shape their future.

games.name: Little Witch Inuko
games.summary: Join Inuko in this card battle rogue-lite RPG as she tries to conquer the mysterious ruins to earn the rank of a full-fledged witch! Collect and combine a wide variety of cards and equipment to build and personalise your battle deck and blast your way through the ruins!

games.name: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Spring
games.summary: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Spring is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming Spring-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a beautiful world.

games.name: Mega Turrican Director's Cut
games.summary: The special Director's Cut edition provides previously cut content and new visuals, compared to the original console release. Released as cartridge initially for the SEGA Mega Drive/Genesis in 2022, it has since appeared on cartridge for the Evercade, Nintendo Switch & PlayStation 4 (via Turrican Anthology Vol. 2) and as a streamable game on Antstream.

games.name: Morning Glories
games.summary: A short Twine game about vampires.

games.name: Ms. Terry's Pleasure Mansion
games.summary:
Ms. Terry is an eccentric fellow, with a decent collection of interesting toys and materials. Of course, there are plenty of people interested in their wares, and your job as manager is to make sure they are all happy. Listen to their requests, and figure out a way to fit them all into the pleasure mansion!

Or alternatively, just bring your friends over and watch them dance.

games.name: NECR: Chain Reaction Physics
games.summary:
NECR: Chain Reaction Physics is a 2D physics-based skill game focused on one-shot mechanics and chain reactions.

The player launches a single core to interact with enemies and environmental objects. Collisions, explosions, and physics interactions create chain reactions that determine the final score.

The game emphasizes precision, timing, and player skill. There are no upgrades or pay-to-win mechanics.

Features include multiple enemy types, interactive elements such as bombs and teleports, and a global leaderboard for score competition.

games.name: Neo Pussy Masters
games.summary: Put a golf ball in your vagina and kegel it out! Neo Pussy Masters is a golfing game about transfemininity. Only on the PICO-8!

games.name: Peter's Apostles
games.summary: Peter's Apostles is a strategy game of the Tower Defense genre set in a Cyberpunk world where you place a large arsenal of Towers, or here called Arms, capable of stopping and destroying the Malwares and Malicious programs and messages that threaten the security of the server you protect.

games.name: Projekt Godhand
games.summary: An extremely high-speed "keyboard destruction rhythm game" in which any key on the same half of the keyboard can be used to input notes.

games.name: Purgatory X: Amalia
games.summary: During the afternoon events of Purgatory 2, Amalia and an ANT unit are deployed to neutralize the demons escaping from the Lobelia facility, with orders to capture D-007.

games.name: Snoot Runner
games.summary: Chase the burgers to unlock new friends. Experience the world of Puppolonia as a canine running through the capital city of Puppolonia collecting burgers. The player will collect letters to learn to spell various words related to canines. The player will jump and dodge obstacles in the course on the city streets while collecting power ups, letters, and burgers.

games.name: Splash of Color
games.summary: Fill the world with color one puzzle at time!

games.name: StarMoon Forest
games.summary: Build your dream forest farm and apartment community! Plant all kinds of crops, make all kinds of delicious food and sell it in stores. Build apartments to attract residents from to live and maybe even find love.

games.name: Stellifier: The Comeback
games.summary: Stellifier: The Comeback - an otome TYPING game inspired by older idols, sequel to the original Stellifier An idol drama game about an older group making a comeback from retirement, featuring a GxB/BxB/non-binary romance!

games.name: Sunbreak War
games.summary: Sunbreak War is a light Rogue strategy game that focuses on construction and defense. Players need to build territories, recruit soldiers and survive enemy attacks.

games.name: The Raid of Brunswick
games.summary: A first-person simulation where players take on the roles of a Lancaster bomber crew during a single World War II bombing raid over Brunswick.

games.name: Tiny Vikings
games.summary: TINY VIKINGS: JOURNEY TO ASGARD is an action adventure game revolving around a gang of Viking children who embark on an adventurous journey to seek the favor of the gods and save their home village from an evil curse.

games.name: Top Cop: Police Training
games.summary: Top Cop - Police Training is a spiritual successor to Mad Bullets with new and improved tracking and centering.

games.name: Untamed Kingdom
games.summary: Shadow Stalk Studios is an indie company creating Untamed Kingdom. We want to create a space for everyone to enjoy and explore with friends. Come join us as we adventure through the wilderness!

games.name: Xmas Surprise
games.summary: Xmas Surprise is a cute Mini Visual Novel about a homeless guy named Richard finding an unexpected surprise on Christmas.

games.name: Yume Fabricated Yume
games.summary: 夢fabricated夢 (Yume Fabricated Yume) is a game where you explore rooms based on the things the developer aug81074 loves, admires, imagines, and more.

games.name: Anseion
games.summary: Get ready for a journey to the world of Anseion, an immersive 2D MMORPG. Choose your fraction: good or evil. Fight against players and monsters, explore the fascinating world, collect items and create your own. Make a unique character. Participate in events and fraction battles, increase your rank.

games.name: As If Through Glass
games.summary: High school freshman Anise enters her spring semester during an unseasonable, unceasing rain. Girls’* relationships float through the waves of time as it passes with or without them.

games.name: Asantria
games.summary: An intriguing top-down game with a cartoonish pixel art style! Move around the map in all directions while viewing your character from above! Use various types of magic to shoot and fight monsters! Also use different outfits that will give you additional advantages in the game world!

games.name: Astrolite
games.summary: Obliterate ever-growing asteroids in a race against time. Level up your starship to stay on top of the looming threat. Spend well earned Luna Coins on permanent power-ups to skyrocket through the levels. Each mission has unique enemies, challenging bosses, and unlimited variety in gameplay.

games.name: Aurora Hills: Chapter 2
games.summary: Aurora Hills: Chapter 2 is the second part in series of point and click puzzle adventure games. Follow the journey of Ethan Hill, a park ranger tasked with investigating strange disappearances from a national park to uncover the mystery of Aurora Hills!

games.name: Axima
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Axima, a Monster Taming RPG! Befriend and battle alongside over a hundred different Axi, while you explore the fully open world by yourself - or with your friends in multiplayer!

games.name: Battle Narf
games.summary: An extremely late entry for the Vextro Unplugged jam, strongly inspired by Battle Kid, Fortress of Peril.

games.name: BattleSail
games.summary: BattleSail is an action tactical strategy game where you command a fleet in turn-based naval battles. Manage resources, upgrade and outfit your ships, and navigate a richly designed single-player Campaign or jump into fast Arena encounters, or test pure thinking in one-turn Puzzle challenges.

games.name: BaulaQuest
games.summary: Local middle school teacher fights angry orange bald man army with marbles and furry creatures. Baula. Quest. BaulaQuest.

games.name: Birdseed VR
games.summary: Snap pics of the chunkiest, cutest birds in VR! Relax in lush forests, complete quirky daily quests, and fill your Journal. Whether you’re birding alone or together with friends, get cozy and escape to nature.

games.name: Blood Night
games.summary: (Multiplayer | COOP) THE FOREST IS DEAD. YOU ARE NOT. Survive. Build. Kill everyone. A world where zombies are smarter than they look. Inventory, crafting, and building are your tools in the war for tomorrow.

games.name: Card TD
games.summary: CardTD is a hybrid tower defense and a deck-building game. Packaged with a ton of user freedom in playstyles with a progression system that lets you play at your own pace. Defend your base from waves of toybox like enemies by playing cards to gain resources and towers to defend yourself!

games.name: Cleaning Raccrew
games.summary: Cleaning Raccrew is a 4 player party game inspired by sumo, japanese game shows, and silly raccoon images!

games.name: Covenant Cards
games.summary: The timeline of history has been corrupted by a massive digital anomaly. Within a sprawling cybernetic simulation, the source code of the ancient, biblical past is fracturing. As a specialized Tactician, you are tasked with entering this shattered system to debug the anomalies. By commanding the echoes of historical heroes and wielding futuristic technology, you must battle through corrupted sectors, uncover the cause of the glitch, and restore the true timeline before the simulation collapses entirely.

games.name: Dark Farts: Parody Smell Edition
games.summary: The most absurd Souls-like parody ever! You’re a blacksmith with bean-powered dragon abilities, taking on evil corporations with maximum gasitude! Fart-dash, demolish bosses, and break the fourth wall in this hilarious action RPG. Smell the legend!

games.name: Die Fighter
games.summary: A sci-fi dice-driven roguelike where your dice fuel both your abilities and your enemies’. You'll need strategy and luck to outwit dynamic foes, harness synergistic upgrades, and escape creeping galactic doom before Fate catches up.

games.name: Doppleganger
games.summary:
A mannequin lies disassembled on the bed.

A window is blocked with steel bars.

You must find a way out of the room.

This is a point and click escape room game, around 30-60 minutes long

games.name: Dreams Stories Online
games.summary: Dreams Stories Online is an indie MMORPG where you return from death ️ not as someone who has already triumphed, but as someone who still dreams. Walk through a persistent, wounded, and hostile world, guided by the hope of a great restoration.

games.name: Emoji Marble Dash
games.summary:
emoji Marble Dash represents a new generation of Web3 gaming, where blockchain enhances rather than complicates the player experience. Officially licensed by the emoji company and built on Immutable zkEVM, the game demonstrates how true digital ownership can seamlessly integrate into competitive arcade racing.

The game features physics-driven marble racing, where players control emoji characters riding on top of rolling marbles. Unlike traditional racers, this momentum-based system creates skill-based gameplay where physics mastery determines victory across 6-player multiplayer competitions.

All Web3 features are completely optional. Traditional players enjoy the full racing experience without ever touching crypto, while Web3 enthusiasts unlock ownership features through simple Immutable Passport integration (email, Google, Apple ID login – no wallet setup required).

Items earned through gameplay can be minted as NFTs or SFTs and traded on the dedicated emoji marketplace. Immutable zkEVM's gasless transaction technology means players never pay blockchain fees.

Quick Race: Barrier-free entertainment with no blockchain requirements Ranked Mode: Competitive play with $EMJ token entry fees and cryptocurrency prize pools distributed to top performers.

emoji Marble Dash follows full MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets) compliance, ensuring regulatory adherence for the European market. The $EMJ token (ERC-20, 10 billion fixed supply) powers the ecosystem with a Token Generation Event scheduled for Q1 2026.

Developed by El Dorado Studio and published by Euronext-listed Crypto Blockchain Industries (ALCBI), emoji Marble Dash launches in early 2026, demonstrating that accessible Web3 gaming is achievable when player experience comes first.

games.name: Enter the Nemesis: Blood Portal
games.summary: In this 2.5D hack and slash shooter platformer enemy bodies will become your platform. Kill enemies to activate the portals, and build a platform of bodies to reach the exits. Stomp the bodies, crush the heads, collect blood, and snatch their weapons. Find and free the girl, then defeat the nemesis

games.name: Entrance No.9
games.summary: A drunk man returns home, but the familiar stairwell turns into an endless, distorted maze. Floors repeat themselves, doors disappear, and every wrong step takes you back to the beginning. Can you make it to your apartment?

games.name: Eurekas
games.summary: Eurekas is a real-time strategy colony sim where settlers battle a hostile, mystical island. Build, survive, use magic, and appease your gods—or risk losing everything to the wild forces that resist your claim.

games.name: Farmare: Ultimate Animal Survive
games.summary: A survival roguelite RPG where you fight endless waves of enemies, gather upgrades on the fly, and grow your farm base stronger with every run.

games.name: Finnie's Bimbo Fishing
games.summary: Finnie's Bimbo Fishing is a short, chill fishing game where the titular Finnie catches fishies in order to pay back her crippling BimboDebt! Catch a total of ten (10!) fish and carry them around on your bits to sell and the shop and purchase various unlocks to aid Finnie.

games.name: Forthold
games.summary: Hold the fort as a lone archer in this short incremental defense game. Shoot waves of enemies, collect magic and soulshards, upgrade your power, and ascend to push further toward the source of the relentless darkness.

games.name: Future Weapon
games.summary: Future Weapon 2D is a top down space shooter where you can relive the couch co-op glory days with up to 8 players across 2 screens. Grab a gun, grab a spaceship, upgrade everything, mine rocks, explore, and recruit the local townsfolk to conquer this demo.

games.name: Garden and a Goat
games.summary: Garden and a Goat is a single-player animal collecting and ecosystem recovery game! You play as a friendly robot, eager to help a series of ecosystems in need. Clean up the environment, revive plants, and entice the local wildlife to return, unlocking ever more animals and decorations along the way!

games.name: Gloop
games.summary: Warp through the space in Gloop, a fast paced arcade game where you'll control your ship with just one button as the hyperspace glitches out!

games.name: Gnomed
games.summary: Gnomed is a roguelite clicker base defence game where your humble home is the last line of defense. Hold out against 20 chaotic waves of enemies, unlock new abilities, and grow stronger each run!

games.name: Grotto Escape
games.summary: You play as a SF character facing Heroic Fantasy creatures in this Dungeon Crawler with Platformer gameplay.

games.name: Harmonic Drive
games.summary: Harmonic Drive is an arcade-style rhythm game built around player reactive background effects and AI generated music.

games.name: Hive Commando
games.summary: Psychic Firepower and Bug Breeding! Experimental combo between a top down shooty game and a real-time strategy (with pause available to do orders on the in-game map)

games.name: Honor Mice
games.summary: Dash, slash, and shoot through handcrafted levels across vibrant worlds in a fast-paced action platformer! Stop the forces of evil from stealing your mysterious lunch and uncover the destiny that awaits you!

games.name: Humanity's Fall
games.summary: Explore the world of Humanity's Fall, a fantasy farming sim. Interact and build a community with the world's next apex lifeform. Build your farm and rediscover lost flora as you discover the world's lore.

games.name: I Got Turned Into a Girl and This Yuri Death Angel Will Only Turn Me Back if I Can Find All the Hidden Props
games.summary: A silly prop hunt game about becoming a girl.

games.name: Ironforged
games.summary: Slow-paced, tactical VR shooter where every mistake is punished. You fight with a minimal arsenal - your pistol, composure, timing, and precision. Wake up as CM-42 and fight your way out of a relentless combat training facility designed to break the weak and forge perfect soldiers.

games.name: King of Santa
games.summary: King of Santa is a competitive party action game for up to four players, where players take on the role of Santa, collect presents scattered across the stage, and deliver them to chimneys to earn points and win the match.

games.name: Landlord
games.summary: "Landlord Chess" turns the ever-changing strategies in card games into visual scenarios, makes it more like playing chess or Sudoku. It includes a single-player mode and a multiplayer online mode, while also integrating a leaderboard and an achievement system.

games.name: Lost & Found
games.summary: LOST & FOUND is a free to play dynamic sorting game. Match forms to the right items and build your own warehouse, or compete with your friends in multiplayer mode after your shift is over.

games.name: Lost Children of the Mansion
games.summary: Explore a dark mansion that constantly shifts like a maze. Rescue the trapped children hidden behind locked doors. Avoid the roaming enemies and find your way out.

games.name: Lumina's Brew
games.summary: Explore enchanted biomes, gather rare ingredients, and brew potions to sell in this cozy 2D metroidvania. Discover secrets, meet curious creatures, and master the art of potion-making as a young witch on a mystical journey.

games.name: Magic Tower: Legion
games.summary: "Magic Tower: Legion" is a roguelike Magic Tower-like game. You will play as a legion commander and lead your team into the magic tower. Use each character's strengths to defeat powerful enemies. Remember to plan every step carefully, for all resources in the magic tower are non-renewable.

games.name: Monster Ops 16
games.summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

games.name: Noelle's Ark
games.summary: Explore ruin puzzles, talk to new people, explore the island and unravel the secrets both hidden on this island, and about yourself in this semi-open-world puzzle based rpg!

games.name: NolyRhythm
games.summary: Get into the rhythm of the music! If you keep getting into the groove, you'll clear the game before you know it! This is the casual rhythm game "NolyRhythm"!

games.name: Nonsense Defense
games.summary: Roguelite tower defense with moveable chaos. Build towers and troops, drag them mid battle, dash through danger, and defend your crystal solo or with up to three friends in online co op.

games.name: NoWay
games.summary: You wake up in a dark underground labyrinth. Zombies roam, hunters wait. Stay silent, run, fight, or survive by acting like one of them. You’re not even sure there’s a way out.

games.name: Pack and Ship: Warehouse Simulator
games.summary: Build your logistics empire from the ground up. Choose the most profitable contracts, optimize your warehouse layout for maximum efficiency, and upgrade your equipment. Balance risk and reward as you adapt your strategy to a shifting market. Every lift, every pallet, and every decision counts.

games.name: Parcel Peaks
games.summary: A difficult fully physics based ski simulator where you deliver items down insane slopes. The controls are few, but difficult to master.

games.name: PhantomZone SemiDeus
games.summary: "A dragon survivor, a rarity in these times." That's what she called herself. Mysterious, bizarre biographical tales unfold in a retro-futuristic world.

games.name: PolyDestroyer
games.summary: Engage in cosmic battles with PolyDestroyer, a riveting 2D shooter. Navigate space, customize your ship, and thwart alien foes to save the galaxy. Your spacecraft, your adventure!

games.name: Primland The Magus
games.summary: A dark fantasy 2D action game about a solitary island that has turned into hell and a girl named Magus. Collect "relics" sleeping on the island and acquire skills. Take on mysteries and powerful enemies using a variety of actions!

games.name: Propaganda vs. Zombies 2
games.summary: Fight through Hordes of Zombies while rescuing other survivors but every shot you make creates noise that attracts more Zombies towards you, your subordinates, and your Camp. Build your camp and make your decisions to assure the safety of your People!

games.name: RC: Car Maniacs
games.summary: RC:CM is a fascinating arcade simulator of radio-controlled cars that will allow you to plunge into the world of children's fantasies by driving radio-controlled cars: rally, drift, high-speed and other types of cars! Race with your friends! Speed, adrenaline and excitement await you!

games.name: Remnant Protocol
games.summary: The assassination of the Blessed Mother has plunged the galaxy in darkness. Usurpers rule with absolute authority, and blood flows in rivers of red across the stars. Only the Protocol can restore Her light.

games.name: Rocket Wrestling Entertainment
games.summary: Throw it down in the newest sport league of 2073: Rocket Wrestling Entertainment. Pelt your foes with a barrage of rockets and powerful takedowns to stand on top!

games.name: Rollbound
games.summary: Rollbound is a short, experimental clicker set at a lonely tavern table, where a single die decides everything. Earn points and gold to upgrade Attack, Defense, Luck, and Gold gain as the stakes climb.

games.name: Rotato
games.summary: Spin. Shoot. Survive.

games.name: Safe House
games.summary: Survive the plague. Manage a Safe House. Decide who to trust. A cinematic, story-driven psychological horror with multiple endings.

games.name: Sculptor
games.summary: Create and paint statues of beautiful women, improve your skills and follow the kinetic novel of a sculptor who fell in love with his creation. The game is inspired by the Greek myth of Pygmalion.

games.name: Secrets of Suburbia
games.summary: Investigate a disappearance in a quiet American suburb in 1997—or ignore it entirely. Spend the night browsing the internet, playing video games, and chatting with your friends in this first-person mystery-horror experience.

games.name: Secrets of Temple Isle
games.summary: Explore ancient ruins and diverse biomes, fight in third-person combat while collecting gear and powers. Design your space and decorate with items gathered in the world. Become the legend in this exciting single player adventure.

games.name: Seed of God
games.summary: Seed of God is a epic scale turnbased Battle 2D/3d JRPG with a characterdriven story that will take you on a unforgettable journey in the style of FinalFantasy. Face choices that define your morale (Good/Bad) and change events as you explore a fantasy world and unfold this epic saga

games.name: Sheol no Mori: Tasogare no Majuuzukai
games.summary: Inspired by “Kodoku Poison,” an ancient Chinese sorcery, this game combines “Kodoku Poison, Beast Alchemy, and Match-3 Puzzles.” Select a few beasts from the herd to turn into familiars, pit your familiars against the beasts, and fuse familiars together to create giant beasts.

games.name: Snatch Squad
games.summary: Imagine Payday in an open world like GTA — built entirely of blocks. Snatch Squad is a co‑op crime sim in a voxel city. Plan and execute heists, launder money through legit businesses, and outsmart the police.

games.name: Stained Blade
games.summary: Stained Blade is a multiplayer VR melee game built around something most VR sword games fake: real, server-driven physics.

games.name: Streamers Cleaning Simulator
games.summary: Restore order and cleanliness to the rooms of famous Gaming Streamers after their epic gaming sessions. Find artefacts, explore streamers life. Play co-op with your friends.

games.name: Tales of Fear: Episode Zero
games.summary: Can you tell the difference between reality and tale? Experience three short horror stories and gather clues as to which are true and which are just part of our imagination. Immerse yourself in the protagonist's perspective and discover eerie tales from around the world.

games.name: The Skyland Chronicles
games.summary: You are a bloody pirate. Will you make the most of it in the new world and fulfill your destiny? This is your battle, where you'll come face to face with dark creatures from Slavic mythology. Take on the role of a legendary warrior and decide if the world is worth saving.

games.name: Three Jokers
games.summary: A card roguelike inspired by Balatro and Cuphead. Fight duels, play insane mini-games, build Joker City and rise to greatness — in Three Jokers!

games.name: Type To Kill
games.summary: An arcade shooting game where you have to type challenges to finish off enemies with your EMP. In between stages, watch live-action full-motion video cutscenes with a full cast of memorable characters and not necessarily the best acting.

games.name: Táng Chuánqí: Shàng Yuáncháng Gān Xíng
games.summary: A three-thousand-mile journey of exile, a mystery of untold evil, when strange legends are decoded into reports of social pathology, when the joy of wuxia revenge collides with the ironclad fortress of power, from bandits slaughtering villages to the powerful committing cannibalism, who is not a lamb to be slaughtered in troubled times? This game focuses on the historical backdrop of the An-Shi Rebellion during the Tang Dynasty, and every choice the player makes will mark their character's fate.

games.name: Vapinupituru
games.summary: Submission for the Cookie Cutter RM2k3 Jam.

games.name: Void Breach
games.summary: Twin-stick space combat roguelite with 12 abilities, 5 reality-warping ultimates, and 20+ enemy factions that each fight differently. Permanent upgrades that stack across hundreds of hours. Quick missions, deep progression, zero runs wasted.

games.name: What’s in the Box?
games.summary: A first-person incremental game where you buy and open containers filled with random items, repair and upgrade the things you find, and sell them for profit. In a dark industrial environment, upgrade your character, tools, and machines, earn money, and step by step work your way toward freedom.

games.name: When It Rains
games.summary: Explore a conservatory on a dark, rainy day to help a (sorta) grandpa (sorta) vampire (sorta) find his stolen memory!

games.name: Win Over That Delinquent Guy!
games.summary:
“Go! Win over that delinquent!”

A violent delinquent has transferred into your class. And your childhood friend encourages you to grow closer to him. Yeah, right! Is a sweet, lovey-dovey school rom-com really gonna happen to you?!

games.name: Wrong Elevator
games.summary: Wrong Elevator is a horror game where you explore abandoned facilities and scavenging resources to maintain and upgrade your elevator.

games.name: 100 Candy Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

games.name: Alex the Rabbit
games.summary: Alex the Rabbit is a classic, fun, and challenging 2D platformer. Join Alex, a brave rabbit, on an action-packed adventure through colorful and dangerous worlds. Your goal is to collect all the carrots scattered across the map, overcome obstacles and enemies, and find the Golden Carrot, located at the end of each level.

games.name: Alstan
games.summary: Alstan is a 3rd-person action-adventure game set in the merciless deserts of Idnan, inspired by Amazigh and Tuareg cultures. You play as Alstan, a warrior cursed by the Mark of the Desert, a power that allows him to control sand but slowly turns him into one of the very Djinns he hunts.

games.name: BlackSands
games.summary: Trapped in a relentless time loop, fight your way through a mysterious arena. Explore, adapt, and use what you’ve learned throughout each reset to uncover its secrets and reach your freedom.

games.name: Breeze of Ashes
games.summary: Command airships in a tactical RTS where choices shape your story. Manage resources, upgrade your fleet, and battle rival factions in a non-linear campaign. With rogue-lite replayability, multiplayer co-op, and skirmish modes, your journey evolves with every playthrough.

games.name: Can I Not Fall for Idols?
games.summary: You’ve become the manager of a brand-new idol group—only to find yourself drowning in romance flags from the start! Love with idols is strictly forbidden. Can you survive this chaotic, no-love-allowed romcom—the first of its kind in the otome world!?

games.name: Cat Quest II
games.summary: Cat Quest II, a fantasy action-adventure RPG, returns to the world of Felingard to expand on the original with more explosive spells, expanded weapon options, an exciting new character switch mechanic, and local co-op! Play as both a cat and dog as you explore their kingdoms solo or with a friend! Quest in a world filled with magic, curious monsters, and go on a catventure like never before!

games.name: Cat Quest III
games.summary: In Cat Quest III you play as a purrivateer in a freely explorable 2.5D open-world swarming with Pi-rats. You can sail the seas in your ship for treasures galore! But prepare for peril, as the Pirate King aims to hunt you down...

games.name: Chromatic Battles
games.summary: Chromatic Battles is a 2D action/strategy game with tower defense mechanics and color-based combat. The player defends a rotating ship against enemy waves, damaging them only with bullets that match their color. It features planet-based progression, an inter-level upgrade system, and a cartoonie visual style.

games.name: Cult of Flies
games.summary: After the death of your grandmother, you start to uncover the reason behind the strange nature of her passing as well as her plans of resurrection.

games.name: Cursed Ghost
games.summary: Once a ghost, now trapped in flesh—avoid every obstacle, evade human eyes, and use brief moments of spectral freedom to find your way out.

games.name: Cut Corner Renovations USSR
games.summary: Step into the gritty world of Cut Corner Renovations USSR, where every crumbling wall and leaking pipe tests your creativity.

games.name: Dice x Deck
games.summary: Based on backgammon, players gain buffs that amplify the effects of the squares. Deck-building roguelike-like play experience.

games.name: Don't Feed the Cat
games.summary: You’re stuck in a time loop from 10 PM to 6 AM inside a dark apartment. Survive the nights, uncover the truth, and whatever you do… don’t feed the cat.

games.name: Dungeon Apollonios
games.summary: This RPG tasks you with forming a party of up to seven members to search for and defeat the Demon King Bargon within a vast dungeon, ultimately reclaiming the Ring of Galtea. Movement occurs in real time, while combat shifts to a turn-based system.

games.name: Encode Encore!
games.summary: Nenena wants to buy her boyfriend an expensive wallet, but to do that, she needs money... You can be her sugar daddy and give her the money she needs. She'll thank you for every bit of money you give her!

games.name: European Logistics Tycoon
games.summary:
European Logistics Tycoon is a business simulation where you build and expand your own logistics company. Start small, secure your first contracts, and grow step by step into a company operating across Europe.

Plan deliveries between real European cities, calculate costs, optimize routes and decide when expansion makes sense. Vehicles, staff and locations must be managed efficiently. Every decision impacts profit, reputation and long-term success.

games.name: Idle Desktop Marbles
games.summary: Marble Desktop redefines the casual form of marble games with three core experiences: "physical excitement + idle development + relaxing decompression!"

games.name: Inselnova
games.summary: The year is 1247. A vast frontier of scattered islands lies unclaimed — connected only by open sea and the ambitions of those bold enough to sail it. In Inselnova, you are a governor. You start with a single island and a handful of resources, then build farms, mines, and barracks, research technologies, and raise armies and fleets. Raid your neighbours, spy on their defences, trade on a player-driven marketplace, or forge alliances and dominate the rankings. Rule through council affairs that shape your realm’s identity, sail on branching story expeditions, and discover gods whose blessings and curses can turn a war. Builds and research run on real-time timers that keep going while you are offline — a slow-burn game made for short sessions and long progression. No downloads, no pay-to-win. A modern reimagining of the classic German island-warfare game Inselkampf, built for mobile and desktop alike.

games.name: Jin
games.summary: JIN is a traditional inspired strategy board game built on simple rules but layered with deep tactical decision making. Players move pieces across the board, stack them to increase value, and capture opponents by landing with equal or lower strength, turning every move into a calculated risk. The neutral zone mechanics add tension in the center of the board, forcing smart positioning and long term planning. With clean visuals, fast turn based gameplay, and a strong focus on skill over luck, JIN rewards players who think ahead, set traps, and control the board with precision.

games.name: Kevin's Playing In Berlin
games.summary: Release the author, who is nothing but the player. Release the player, and restore the freedom once taken away. A three-game experiment in what it means to play.

games.name: Kila: Hourbound
games.summary: Journey through the fantastical world of Aion as Kila, a Keeper of Time. In this single-player action-adventure platformer, you explore floating islands and combat savages who are stealing time.
