A roguelike deckbuilder where you fight with your fingers, spill some blood, and try to make it to your niece’s birthday on time.

You’re a wizard. A not-so-heroic wizard imprisoned for wizard crime, awoken from your wizard slumber by an invitation from your niece. Escape from jail and traverse a hostile world crawling with danger. Every turn is a frenzy of spell sigils, cracking bones, and desperate gestures as you shred through monstrosities with raw elemental power.

You’re not the chosen one, you’re just trying to be a good uncle.

games.name: Project Starblade
games.summary: Project Starblade is a first-person action psychological platformer that follows YOU - a participant for a new series of tests that promise to push your body and mind to their limits. But not everything is at as it seems at "Fathom Laboratories"...

games.name: Puppy Park
games.summary: Run your very own Puppy Park — a tiny dog hotel for pups of every breed and personality! Feed them yummy snacks, pamper them with grooming, and embark on adventures. Earn their love, grow your reputation, and fill your hotel with wagging tails and happy barks! Play daily in bite-sized chunks!

games.name: Quest
games.summary: This is a grotesque game where you can do whatever you want. Challenge the Crescent Moon as a weakling, or explore the Cave System to find power. There is no saving feature, however it's a short game.

games.name: Ritualist
games.summary: Ritualist is a dynamic isometric action-roguelike set in a unique dark fantasy world. Choose your weapons, master combat style, and face death as you uncover ancient rituals to seal away the Primordial Ones. Will you survive the descent, or will the Abyss claim you?

games.name: Sanctale
games.summary: You'll open a potion shop in Sacred Heart City and learn about the reasons for the decline of Sacred Heart City by meeting a wide variety of customers. This is a story-based business simulation game, the main gameplay is that the customer asks you to make the right potion according to the request.

games.name: Shíqǔ Bǎoshí Hòu Yìwài Juéxǐngle Fùzhì Mówáng Lìliàng de Nì Tiān Jìnéng
games.summary: A "Tower of Magic"-like Roguelite game that blends strategy with randomness. Players take control of the "Demon Fox," a character capable of beguiling and shapeshifting into various NPCs- and utilize a unique skill to replicate enemies' attack power, alongside other special abilities, to defeat formidable foes and challenge the Demon King.

games.name: Slime Attack: Survivor
games.summary: Fast-paced arena roguelike bullet heaven! Battle relentless waves, tackle mid-run challenges, unlock unique heroes with their own combat pets, equip powerful gear, weapons, and spells, and take on mighty Yonian bosses.

games.name: Space Tower Defense
games.summary: A strategic space tower-defense game. Enemies detect, warn, and try to bypass defenses, forcing you to adapt. Combine diverse towers and face unique maps for varied battles. With tense sci-fi atmosphere, it delivers a fresh experience beyond traditional tower defense.

games.name: Spacefleet: Heat Death
games.summary: In the 23rd century, Earth orbit is flooded with debris from constant warfare. Countries, megacorporations, and mercenaries are fighting for control. Take contracts, build your warfleets, and dominate the Earth-Luna system in this realism-focused strategy RPG!

games.name: Starweave
games.summary: Starweave is a narrative game that uses tactical RPG mechanics to tell an allegorical story about constricting roles within a cycle of oppression. Dramatic and bittersweet, you endeavor to make the world just a little bit kinder through your actions.

games.name: Steel Force: Top Down Shooter
games.summary: STEEL FORCE is a top-down shooter. Attack robots, use your shield, and push your skills to the limit. Run, dash, and break through waves of armed machines.

games.name: Stellarcraft
games.summary: Stellarcraft is a captivating sci-fi tower defense game that delves deep into the vast expanses of the universe, offering players the opportunity to explore planets, gather resources, and defend against numerous threats.

games.name: Sushi Simulator
games.summary: Manage your own sushi restaurant. Take orders, prepare fresh sushi, purchase ingredients, manage stock, and keep your customers happy. No distractions, just a focused single-player sushi simulation.

games.name: Sys//Purge
games.summary: >SYS//PURGE_ is a free, fast-paced FPS inspired by 90's classics, with roguelike elements. Collect items, stay alive and descend deeper into the facility. You take control of an LN-X unit, a glitch breaks you out of the Overseer's control. Make it burn.

games.name: Tangy TD
games.summary: Strategic tower defense where you play a witch, place class-based towers, equip them with items that grant powerful abilities, combine them, create unique builds & deal ridiculous amounts of damage! Customize your builds with a deep stat system and giant skill tree!

games.name: Temporal Titans
games.summary: Temporal Titans is a Tower-Defense game with Time Travel. Send mechs back to previous waves to prevent your defeat, and protect your salvage team from the monstrous Krell as you scavenge the ruins of a lost earth. Rewind, rethink, and reclaim the future!

games.name: Thysiastery
games.summary: Thysiastery is a dungeon crawler RPG featuring traditional roguelike and turn-based gameplay. Command a party of bearers of the Brand, drawn into a vast Labyrinth. Recruit while exploring the Labyrinth in hope of finding a way out, and its secrets will be revealed as you delve deeper.

games.name: Tree of Knowledge
games.summary: Tree of Knowledge is a roguelite where you beat trivia questions instead of monsters. By using a combination of powerful artifacts, flexible skills and your own general knowledge; try your hand at climbing to the top!

games.name: Vellum: Raid Night Study Hall
games.summary: Brush up on your fighting mechanics with Raid Night Study Hall - your worry-free guide to boss fights! Learn, practice, and don't stand in the fire! You will be prepared!

games.name: Wagon 00
games.summary: Observation game about anomalies in a train car: spot changes, choose back or forward, advance by a streak of correct choices. No HUD; focus on attention and memory.

games.name: Walker
games.summary: An online co-op horror game where you and your crew hunt monsters inside a massive Walker. Use your environment, items, or anything at your disposal to protect your Walker.

games.name: War Flavor
games.summary: War Flavor is a side-scrolling platform game, which is part of a rather arcade gameplay style comparable to the Contra series.

games.name: Wireworks
games.summary: Wireworks is a base-defense roguelike auto-battler where your defenses are built and controlled using a module board.

games.name: Womb of Worms
games.summary: Womb of Worms is a short horror game where a terrifying ancient god manifests itself through worms and maggots, looking to be reborn through someone's body.

games.name: 1 CatLine
games.summary: Master puzzling stages with the help of your 2D feline companion!

games.name: A Color Theory
games.summary: A Trippy Puzzle-Platformer That Literally Plays with Color

games.name: All Me Action Game
games.summary:
Welcome to the ultra-hard 2D action "Madness World"
Players, enemies, blocks—all made from editing my own selfies.
Instant-death trap-filled die-and-retry game. It'll haunt your dreams.

games.name: Art-Therapy: Jigsaw Puzzle
games.summary: A Cozy Jigsaw Puzzle Game for Everyone! If you like puzzles, this one’s for you. It has over 100 beautiful pictures in different styles—some colorful and fun, others peaceful and calming. There’s no rush, no timers, just a simple and relaxing way to spend your time.

games.name: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Claws of Awaji
games.summary:
The first expansion for Assassin's Creed Shadows.
Add over 10 hours of additional content with a new location, quests, enemies and gears.

games.name: BallotGuessr
games.summary: A street view guessing game where players aim to determine how a particular county voted in a recent election based only on their surroundings.

games.name: Battle Hanafuda
games.summary: A strategic two-player card battle based on the traditional Japanese game Hanafuda. Learn as you play and enjoy thrilling “Koi-Koi” duels filled with risk and reward.

games.name: Coco Block
games.summary: Coconuts drop from above – click to block them before they bonk your monkeys. Bananas fall too – let the monkeys eat them for points and combos. The longer you keep the monkeys safe and feed them bananas, the faster the coconuts fall. How high can you score?

games.name: Corgi Race
games.summary: Be a part of the greatest sport in the world, Corgi Racing! Run your own stable; raise and train your corgi from a promising puppy to a legendary champion with all the twists and turns that come on the track to success.

games.name: Crabmeat
games.summary: A short first-person-point-and-click-survival-horror game set in a future Antarctic fisheries region where you are a prisoner tasked with crabbing for the priceless southern King Crab.

games.name: Crabwave
games.summary: Catch the wave of tranquility in Crabwave, a relaxing puzzle where a stylish crab surfs across islands, bringing life wherever he goes. Connect water streams, plan the perfect route, and plant coconuts to transform beaches, reefs, and mangroves into vibrant paradises.

games.name: Dashpunch
games.summary: After the Tyrant Hand is stolen by a mysterious figure, an ancient being awakens to return it to its rightful place before it's too late. Dash and Punch your way through corrupted dungeons that fall apart at the seams, meet colorful characters, battle powerful bosses and carve your legacy!

games.name: Dawn of Heroes
games.summary: By day, you're just another citizen. By night, you defend the city. But don’t quit your day job, hero. A text-based superhero novel, 450,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

games.name: Dead Beyond
games.summary: Dead Beyond is an action packed survival game where you are trapped in a house full of zombies and challenging traps to overcome.

games.name: Delta Manager
games.summary:
Delta Manager is a hardcore management simulation. Forget arcade driving and 3D graphics: here, the action unfolds through a real-time command interface. Like a true Team Principal on the pit wall, you face a ruthless AI where only your ability to analyze telemetry determines the winner.

Experience the race from the pit wall. In this hardcore management simulation driven by a comprehensive tactical interface, every decision is vital. From R&D to real-time strategy under dynamic weather: analyze the data and lead your team to victory.

games.name: Desperate 1: After Sunset
games.summary: The first work of the "Desperate" series - After Sunset, it’s a horizontal 2D action game with hand-painted, and using a new keyboard operation, you can feel a more intuitive combat experience in this game. Fight for the thing you loved in your life in every street you pass by！

games.name: Dicement
games.summary: Dicement is a minimalistic logic puzzle game where your move, modify and manipulate dices to fit them in corresponding slots with different conditions.

games.name: DreamWorld
games.summary: The Infinite Sandbox MMO. For Builders, By Builders. Explore an infinite world with all your friends on one server. Build unbelievable structures using advanced building tools like volumetric selection and copy/paste. Battle bosses and mobs, farm, craft and more in DreamWorld.

games.name: Escape From Duck
games.summary: Master the battlefield or fall in the chaos.

games.name: Exit: Echoes of Insanity
games.summary: Exit: Echoes of Insanity es un juego indie de survival horror en el que estás atrapado en un misterioso edificio lleno de secretos. Explora oscuras estancias, resuelve puzles y esquiva una presencia desconocida que siempre te acecha. Con una atmósfera opresiva y una narrativa intrigante, el juego combina exploración, tensión y supervivencia en una experiencia intensa.

games.name: Floral Fury Online
games.summary: Unleash nature's wrath in Floral Fury Online, an Indie Action MMORPG. Master a unique Fusion system, conquer procedural dungeons, and battle epic bosses with dynamic combat. Forge your legacy, join guilds, and dominate the economy in a world where weather dictates the tide of battle.

games.name: Forest Curse
games.summary: Forest Curse is an adventure game with RPG elements. A gripping adventure awaits you in a mysterious and dangerous world. Your goal is to survive and escape this cursed place at any cost.

games.name: Furnace God
games.summary:
The world has been destroyed.

Anyways, follow Moku's journey to prove that the Sun is the ultimate furnace!

games.name: Galactic Vault
games.summary: Build your weapon to its full potential in Galactic Vault, a fast-paced FPS roguelite. Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Get ready to infiltrate high-security vaults and recover lost tech.

games.name: Gods of Angling
games.summary: Gods of Angling is a "Tamagotchi-like" Idle Fishing RPG! Create your hero from one of 180 unique options and see if they can ascend from a reel rookie to a God.

games.name: Granblue Fantasy
games.summary: Granblue Fantasy is a Japanese role-playing video game. The game plays as a traditional Japanese role-playing video game with turn-based battles. The game also contains summons and a class system that alters the main character's move-set and growth. Characters gain levels and abilities by accruing experience; summons and weapons equipped also confer characters with bonuses on attack power and HP. The characters themselves are gained either via quests (the main story quests or special event quests) or by using in-game currency to receive random crystal fragments, which may contain special weapons that add specific characters to the party. Characters, summons, and weapons are ranked (from best to worst) as SSR, SR, R, or N; each is also of type wind, water, fire, earth, light, or darkness. Voice actors provide voices for all of the characters in battle, and for much of the main and event storylines.

games.name: GreedFall: The Dying World
games.summary:
The story starts three years before the events of the first game and the adventures of De Sardet.

This time you play as a native of Teer Fradee, uprooted by force from your island and taken to the continent of Gacane, where the colonists are from. In this old world ravaged by war and scarred by the Malichor plague and the political scheming of the different factions, you need to regain your freedom and control of your own destiny. Using diplomacy, cunning or combat, as well as help from allies you make, it's up to you to end one man's ambitions of conquest, which could spell the end for the continent and your island.

Experience the unique world of GreedFall again by exploring the old continent! Travel across new landscapes, from Olima – the city of stars of the Bridge Alliance – to the shores of Uxantis, and uncover the secrets of these ancient lands. Meet all the factions that share control over these nations and navigate the treacherous waters of their schemes and conspiracies.

Create your own character and find allies to join your team. Help them with their quests, uncover their secrets and make them your friends, rivals or even lovers. As well as equipping them the way you want, you can also take control of them in combat.

Immerse yourself in an ever deeper RPG experience where every choice has an impact on your adventure and where diplomacy, manipulation, infiltration and combat are all viable paths for you to achieve your aims.

games.name: Haunted Lands
games.summary: An homage to classic DOS games such as Dangerous Dave and Doom. Blast your way through the hordes of ghouls and demons, leaving nothing behind but their rotting corpses.

games.name: Haunting of Mageburrow
games.summary: A cozy lovecraftian horror retro RPG. Become a paranormal investigator & explore an open world. Solve a criminal conspiracy of the occult. Investigate & battle monsters.

games.name: Hunter's Seal
games.summary: Manage the front desk of a fantasy hunters guild. Identify monsters, verify hunters, and authorize them! The guild's reputation is in your hands.

games.name: Kritter: Defend Together
games.summary: Kritter is NOT a tower defense. It’s NOT an action roguelite either. It’s somewhere in between. All we know is you can become absurdly powerful, blow stuff up with your friends, up to 4 players, online or local and follow a surprisingly cool story.

games.name: Little Fiefdom: Medieval
games.summary: A medieval sandbox build/war game. Start as a peasant, become a lord, manage your fiefdom. Gather resources, construct buildings, train people & an army to defend or attack.

games.name: Misery Nights
games.summary: Co-op horror for 1–6 players. Complete high-risk tasks in a vast shopping mall while evading relentless monsters. Hold the security room - or push out and make it back alive.

games.name: Mochiko the Samurai
games.summary: This sword was forged to sever the past. As Mochiko, a lone female samurai, battle demons and powerful bosses across many worlds. Behind their rage lies a sorrowful truth. Handcrafted by a solo developer, this small indie game carries the weight of every slash—and a story that stays with you.

games.name: Monster Girl Therapy
games.summary: Save the monster girls! Talk through their issues and face their challenges. Convince them to leave their crumbling fantasy game before it all falls apart! You may yet come to understand them—or even yourself!—in this wholesome mix of playful conversation and minigames.

games.name: Mr. Sleepy Man
games.summary: In Mr. Sleepy Man, you play as a sleepy guy who's up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!

games.name: Nightmarena
games.summary: Nightmarena is a 2D rogue lite turn based fighting game. Carefully analyze enemy attack pattern to figure out the best time and direction to dodge and then fight back with your own skills. After every arena attempt, improve your character and keep fighting until you conquer all the floors.

games.name: Nitro Turtles
games.summary: Nitro Turtles is a racing game about super fast turtles! Reach insane speeds with awesome shell-attached gadgets, compete in crazy races with friends, and sprint across the finish line to claim ultimate turtle victory! To be the fastest turtle around, you'll need to master shell gadget usage, learn every shortcut imaginable, and maybe even consider using performance-enhancing seaweed!

games.name: Nova Drift
games.summary: Nova Drift distills the mechanical depth of an action RPG into classic arcade space combat. Control an endlessly evolving bio-mechanical ship, face legions of strange and deadly foes, and ride the wake of a dying star across the void.

games.name: Nullis
games.summary: Logic puzzle game where you must destroy paths of 0-s from the board. Use logic to complete levels with optimal solutions.

games.name: Oeuf
games.summary: 3D physics-platformer where you are an egg! Roll, hop and slide your way back home.

games.name: Orbloom
games.summary: Take deckbuilding and replace the cards with ball physics so you can combine abilities in creative ways!

games.name: Out of the Park Baseball 27
games.summary: 27 years of sports gaming excellence! Out of the Park Baseball 27 is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO! This year's brand new version puts you firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise or country. Your team, your way, your rules.

games.name: Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit
games.summary: Get ready for thrilling chases and intense moments in Police Pursuit Highway Cop Patrol Interceptor— a game where law and order clash with crime! Become part of an elite police unit and dive into a world filled with adrenaline, speed, and mind-blowing maneuvers.

games.name: Quest-Top
games.summary: Step into the role of a Guild Master! Recruit adventurers, send them on quests to collect resources, upgrade your hideout, and enhance their gear — all while you work, watch videos, or play other games.

games.name: Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary: Begin your park ranger journey in Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator. Maintain trails, assist visitors, check permits and respond to emergencies. Explore diverse biomes and observe varied animal behaviors across a wide range of species.

games.name: Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble
games.summary:
The iconic characters from the Ratchet & Clank franchise are back in a stunning, fast-paced arena shooter packed with explosive weapons and larger-than-life action!
Experience the humor, action, and energy of the iconic universe in a bold new real-time multiplayer format. Play as a Legendary Hero from the past, now with unique abilities. Go solo or team up with other Rangers online in thrilling multiplayer games built for every kind of player. Free to download soon!

games.name: Renxia
games.summary: This is a challenging action duel game, you will play as an unknown origin of chivalrous expert travel around the ancient Chinese land, to find the former legend of the sword, and gradually solve the mystery of their own origins.

games.name: Retina Rush
games.summary: Retina Rush is a fast-paced arcade dodger where you play as a demon’s runaway eyeball, blazing across the sky in a desperate escape from hell and humanity alike. Glide through pixel-art mountain vistas while weaving between relentless missiles and cursed projectiles that fill the screen. Simple controls and tight, responsive movement make it easy to pick up, but ruthless enemy patterns and score targets test your focus, reflexes, and nerve. Chase higher scores, master risky near-misses, and prove you’ve got the vision to survive the rush.

games.name: Runeborn
games.summary: Runeborn is a dark fantasy roguelike that merges deckbuilding with a slot-machine-like mechanic. Forge your runebook, crush enemies, and combine trinkets of boundless power to destroy the forces of Despair!

games.name: Screaming in the Basement
games.summary: The main character is mike, an experienced journalist who always strives to uncover the truth, According to locals, restless souls inhabit this place, but this needs to be confirmed., the game takes place in 1991.

games.name: Servo
games.summary: Take control of Servo — a high-speed drone. Chain boosts & switch gravity. Ricochet with precision and use momentum to survive in a chaotic world.

games.name: Silent Harmony
games.summary:
Silent Harmony is an emotional rhythm game where you tribute your late sister's death and try not to let people down, falling into her place in the band upon her death.

Silent Harmony is an emotional rhythm game where you play a virtual clarinet and control your breathing. You pick up your late sister's clarinet and continue her legacy in her old band as Noah Harper, a young depressed teenage boy. While pressure builds up, you struggle not to make Noah feel like he has let his sister down.

games.name: Small Town Filled With Cats
games.summary: Small Town Filled With Cats is a cozy hidden object game where every corner of a charming, hand-drawn town is hiding cats. Explore five whimsical illustrated scenes, spot playful animations, and uncover all the sneaky felines tucked away in this delightful small town.

games.name: Smashometry
games.summary: Smashometry is a neon-soaked, three-button reflex score-attack game. Hit matching shapes, survive escalating speed, stack insane combos, and climb global leaderboards as the screen erupts with colour and an electrifying original soundtrack.

games.name: Snack Escort
games.summary: Who would’ve thought that a roguelike, card game, and tower defence could come together over a basket of food? Travel through magical lands filled with hungry creatures, collect cards and artifacts that shape your strategy with every run. Escort your food through this whimsical fantasy world.

games.name: Snake: Secret Treasure
games.summary:
Snake: Secret Treasure reimagines the classic snake game as a modern puzzle-adventure experience.
Across 120 challenging levels, your logic, reflexes, and strategy will be pushed to the limit as you search for hidden treasures.

Features:
120-Level Campaign – Divided into 8 themed worlds (Desert, Ice, Fire, and more).

Progressive Challenges – Each section introduces new mechanics: a fire-breathing snake, Sokoban-style box pushing, invisible tail segments, speed changes, and more.

Treasure Hunt – Collect every gold piece without dying and reach the exit gate.

Classic Meets Modern – Nostalgia of the original snake combined with fresh puzzle and challenge mechanics.

games.name: Sophie: Starlight Whispers
games.summary: Sophie: Starlight Whispers is an adventure game with metroidvania elements, featuring pixelated graphics, a deep narrative, and fully dubbed in Portuguese. Explore a vast map and put an end to the dark creatures that terrorize the kingdom of Sharan.

games.name: SoulWander
games.summary: Soul Wander is a moving journey to restore lost colors and light to a dark world. Can you find the light in this darkness? Each region has its own story. Grow stronger with weapons and soul powers. Your choices shape the world’s fate. Begin your quest to reclaim lost colors now!

games.name: Space Reign
games.summary: An indie space-sim and strategy game featuring ship and fleet combat mixed with management of a private space corporation. Claim sectors for your faction and raise its influence in the near-future, where resource exploiting corporations are in a state of constant conflict over territory control.

games.name: Suitcase Stories
games.summary: Suitcase Stories is a short, cozy puzzle game about packing life’s memories. Organize objects into suitcases across 7 chapters, from childhood to adulthood. No timers, no scores just the calm joy of finding the perfect fit for every cherished memento.

games.name: Switch Blasters
games.summary: In a world overrun by a rogue AI powered by unstable energy cores. To stop it, three heroes were created—each with unique abilities and combat styles. Alone they are strong, but only by switching between them and combining their powers can they overcome the challenges imposed by the machines.

games.name: The Artifactory
games.summary: The Artifactory is a chaotic couch co-op party game set in a whimsical fantasy lootbox factory! Craft potions, forge weapons, and experiment with recipes to fulfill unpredictable orders. Fix broken machines, survive moving platforms, lava, and more! Play solo or with up to 4 players!

games.name: The Paradogx Incident
games.summary:
Step into "The Paradogx Incident," where puzzle-platforming meets rhythmic precision. Guide Dox the dog through mind-twisting, recursive puzzles in a dynamic, beat-driven world and rhythm levels.

Enjoy full controller support and an adaptive soundtrack that changes with every dimension.

Experience a unique blend of genres in this innovative adventure!

games.name: The Subject: Protocol Zero
games.summary: Turn on your camera. The Kessler Foundation is paying for your pain. The game uses your webcam and microphone, turning the room into a lab. Complete four stages: from the blink ban to the "Green Light, Red Light" game. Money or sanity? Be the first to complete Protocol Zero. If you dare.

games.name: Thelma Fantastic
games.summary: Thelma Fantastic is a hidden object mystery game where every level and every hidden object is randomized. It is a game of finding objects, earning clues, and eliminating suspects to solve the case. An endless supply of randomly generated hidden object scenes for you to enjoy.

games.name: Unsealed: The Mare
games.summary:
Unsealed: The Mare is a first-person psychological horror game set in a nightmare rooted in memory and trauma.

Players explore dark, oppressive environments while uncovering fragmented messages and hidden memories that subtly alter the world around them.

The experience emphasizes tension, sound awareness, and atmosphere, encouraging players to move carefully, listen closely, and piece together meaning through environmental storytelling.

games.name: Villa Nocturne
games.summary: In a mansion shrouded in mist, face the ghosts of the past. With puzzles, exploration, and moments of sheer terror, Villa Nocturne awaits.

games.name: Void Reforest
games.summary: A 2.5D puzzle-platformer where almost all technology has gained consciousness and taken control. You play as a robot in a post-apocalyptic future, exploring neo-fictional environments in search of the last hope for survival.

games.name: Wild Tower
games.summary: "Wild Tower" is a Three Kingdoms-themed top-down combat game with Souls-like and light Rogue elements. Enter the tower to explore the unknown, face challenges, and experience combat.

games.name: Words from Pluto...
games.summary: An experimental platformer where words are tied to movement. Guide Pluto up the strange mountain and figure out what secrets are held within.

games.name: Wrack: Reclamation
games.summary: Inspired by classics like DOOM and Quake, Wrack is an arcade-style FPS. Mow down enemies one after another, and become more powerful the more you kill. Amass a deadly arsenal, discover secret powers... and save your world!

games.name: 8:00 AM: Still Morning
games.summary: 8:00 AM – Still Morning is a short narrative exploration game about an ordinary morning and the emotions hidden beneath routine — an atmospheric experience where a familiar day slowly begins to feel different, repeating again and again even when not everyone is ready to wake up.

games.name: All in One
games.summary: ALL IN ONE is a co-op physics game where five players share one body or sometimes, a single object. Control balance, jump, and climb together through our custom physics system. Even simple moves can be a huge challenge so communicate, encourage, and move as one.

games.name: And Yet, We Dream
games.summary: a psychological visual novel where you investigate the souls of the dead. spend time with them, analyze their past, file reports to decide their eternal fate.

games.name: Another Game About Automation
games.summary: Another Game About Automation is a casual factory-building where you have to generate numbers and combine them with mathematical operations. Upgrade and unlock new mathematical operations.

games.name: BitHero Survivors
games.summary: BitHero Survivors is a survivors-like pixel-art action RPG. Pick your hero, wield evolving weapons, harness powerful relics. Explore colorful stages, survive relentless enemy waves — and become a true hero!

games.name: Blade Blitz
games.summary: Blade Blitz is a casual, yet competitive, local multiplayer game to play with your friends. Simply spin, slice, and poke your way through the opponents in a tug-of-war push to score the points for your team. Power ups provide tense matches, evening the odds as each team closes in on victory.

games.name: Bomb's Lair
games.summary: Throw angry bombs and solve puzzles in this 2D puzzle game. Discover four worlds with 48 handcrafted levels. Will you succeed and claim the treasure at the bottom of The Bomb's Lair? (Description from Steam Store Page)

games.name: Breve Bug: Champions of Destiny
games.summary: Breve Bug: Champions of Destiny is a unique RPG in which you play as a roly poly who lives in a tin can. You have a job as a barista, and your goal is to expand your business across the cosmos. Buy upgrades like lavender syrup and high quality espresso, use dialogue choices to get higher tips.

games.name: Bubblegum Galaxy
games.summary: Bubblegum Galaxy is a cute building strategy game about rebuilding the galaxy tile by tile. Discover and design new planets, complete missions, explore your office and befriend your co-workers... all while trying to find out who deleted the galaxy!

games.name: Cats vs Trolls
games.summary: Cats VS Trolls is a humorous and relaxing hidden object game with hand-drawn graphics.

games.name: Chemistower
games.summary: Learn about Chemistry in this science based Tower Defense game! Purchase atoms to create compounds with properties like explosions, acid, and freezing in an effort to destroy antimatter enemies.

games.name: Chop Shop
games.summary: Feel the flow as you hunt, butcher, and cook at a blisteringly fast pace in this action shop-keeping game. Hunt adorable monsters, chop colossal carcasses, and power-slice through huge chunks of flesh to serve your customers even faster. Move fast and stay sharp if you want your shop to survive.

games.name: Chopped Up
games.summary: A cozy horror cooking game with a deadly twist. Serve bizarre fantasy creatures and secretly eliminate targets as an assassin hiding in plain sight. Just keep an eye out for those out to get you.

games.name: Cirno! Lifts a Boulder

games.name: Virivì e l'ombra della pioggia
games.summary:
Overview

Virivì e l'ombra della pioggia is an adventure for children and young adults centered on safety culture and climate change.

Playing as Donatella — a curious and determined young girl on the trail of a mysterious sprite rumored to bring bad luck — you will explore an imaginary village in Basilicata and delve into the theme of flood risk mitigation. With the help of Virivì, a sprite from Southern Italian folklore reimagined here as a metaphor for environmental awareness, Donatella and her friend Antonio uncover various hazardous situations. Through their research, they play an active role in making the village safer.

From the initial investigations and the mysterious "alternative photos" to the critical moment of a weather alert where acquired knowledge becomes vital, Virivì e l'ombra della pioggia guides young people through a process of empowerment. It encourages them not to be paralyzed by eco-anxiety, but rather to contribute actively to the resilience of their own communities.

games.summary: From the creators of Apex Legends and Titanfall, comes Highguard: a PvP raid shooter where players will ride, fight, and raid as Wardens, arcane gunslingers sent to fight for control of a mythical continent.

games.name: Hollowreach: Alone
games.summary: A third-person psychological horror focused on exploration and puzzle-solving. Trapped between the dead and his own thoughts, fight to maintain your sanity in a forgotten world. Each day echoes voices from the past — and the line between reality and delusion begins to fade.

games.name: Island of Ruin
games.summary: "Island of Ruin" is a puzzle novel game where you collect memory cores hidden across the island and uncover the truth behind a tragedy of the past. When the horrors that befell the boys and girls and the island’s strange phenomena are revealed, what final choice will you make?

games.name: John Carpenter's Toxic Commando
games.summary: Take control of one of the commandos, team up with your friends and send the Sludge God and its horde of things-that-should-never-be back to the underworld. Choose the class that matches your playstyle, pile into your favorite ride, and unload an array of gunfire, grenades, special abilities, and freaking katanas as you save the planet.

games.name: Jukai Maze
games.summary: Jukai Maze is a sci-fi suspense visual novel where every choice sends the story down a completely different path. Branching routes twist and diverge with each decision you make. Explore multiple endings, piece together scattered clues, and uncover the deeper truth that lies beneath them all.

games.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Daedunsan
games.summary: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

games.name: Labyrinthesis
games.summary: Navigate your way through floors of enemies and descend deeper into an underground laboratory. Hack your gun to unlock new weapons, and defeat the machine guarding the elevator.

games.name: LasTar
games.summary: Survive endless waves, stack powerful upgrades, and create broken builds in this fast-paced 2D spaceship roguelike. Unlock permanent progression, experiment with different weapons and amulets, and push your limits against escalating enemy threats

games.name: Let Deco Desktop
games.summary: A cute idle-crafting game nestled in the corner of your screen. Visit various regions to gather diverse materials and decorate your home with furniture you've crafted yourself!

games.name: Light Fairytale: Episode 3
games.summary: A turn-based JRPG series featuring a modern presentation with a classic core. Episode 3 carries over with Haru as he gathers a party of new and old friends on a journey to the lost 'Sky'.

games.name: Living Dead Outbreak
games.summary: Battle your way through the dense zombie crowds as you struggle to survive! Inspired by classic zombie movies and FPS games from the 90s, the overwhelming combat will keep you on your toes!

games.name: Magical Massage
games.summary: In a world where magic reigns, you're a rare mundane masseur, easing stressed magicians to prevent disaster. Flaming nostrils, flowers sprouting from backs, floods on the bed—nothing too fancy that you can't handle. However, if your skills fall short, these powerful, unclothed threats may kill you.

games.name: Mark's Power
games.summary: Mark's Power is an adventure game that combines elements of many genres. You will have to interact with the locals of an unknown planet in order to repair your ship and fly home.

games.name: MeowSon
games.summary: MeowSon is a fun arcade adventure with simple controls and nice graphics. Jump in four directions, collect coins and find all three crystals in each intricate level. Interesting puzzles, obstacles and enemies await you, which will allow you to always keep your reaction in good shape.

games.name: Metrocity
games.summary: Play Metrocity, a challenging and innovative city builder game. prove your ability to organize and create the best city in the world. develop your city from 0 to thousands of people only in this game.

games.name: Mewseum: Film Festival
games.summary: Mewseum: Film Festival is a puzzle game featuring famous movie posters in a charming feline universe. Get the museum ready for the big gala night in a relaxing and fun experience! Lights, camera... meow!

games.name: Minigolf Family Party
games.summary: Family-friendly golf party game Tricky holes and fun obstacles Local multiplayer action

games.name: MLB The Show 26
games.summary:
Step up and take control of how you leave your mark in the most immersive MLB The Show yet.

Discover improved Road To The Show mechanics, deeper Franchise experiences, thrilling Diamond Dynasty modes, enhanced customization options, and true-to-life on-field action.

games.name: Mnemosyne's Cube
games.summary: My name is left behind these white walls. In its place, I am left with dozens of questions. I wander aimlessly, though she seems to guide me. I do not feel safe. Twenty-four hours... and everything will fall into place.

games.name: Modavuj: Forest Camp
games.summary: While exploring the remnants of a forgotten civilization, you realize the forest is far from alone. You must confront the guardians of this dark past and survive.

games.name: Monster Mine Clash
games.summary: Survive waves of monsters from every direction! Aim with your mouse, defeat enemies, upgrade your weapons, and mine ores to grow stronger. Faster reflexes and smarter upgrades mean longer survival!

games.name: Munchy Cat
games.summary: Cat + Food + Color Matching! A feel-good, yummy puzzle that lifts your mood

games.name: Neon Runner
games.summary: Test yourself on the neon lit tracks of Neon Runner. A fast paced runner style game that requires speed and precision to complete all levels as quickly as possible and set a high score.

games.name: Net.Attack(): Code or Die!
games.summary: CODE OR DIE! Hack enemy systems & survive the security response by engineering lethal bullet-heaven algorithms. Your brain power determines your firepower across 150+ programming nodes. Debug your failures. Optimize your code. Complete the heist. HACK THE PLANET!

games.name: No Nap November
games.summary: No Nap November is a short psychological horror game set in a kindergarten during an endless nap time. Observe each loop carefully, spot anomalies, and survive an entire month without sleep to save yourself and the children from a strange presence.

games.name: Nyanjet
games.summary: "nyanjet" is a precision platformer where the only way is up. Be cautious, be bold, and never fear the fall. Master the simple yet challenging controls of a cat-piloted jetpack.

games.name: Office Brawl: Room Smash
games.summary: Challenge the office routine! Turn an ordinary workday into a playful office uprising — outsmart obstacles, stir up fun chaos, and face the best boss!

games.name: Ollie and the Merchant of Dreams
games.summary: Ollie and the Merchant of Dreams is a 2D Metroidvania where you traverse a lore-rich world, summon monsters to your aid, ride a winged unicorn into battle, and unravel a story of duty and betrayal to free all of creation from chaos.

games.name: On Constant Delay
games.summary: In this game, you step into the shoes of Leonard, a man whose life is deeply shaped by intrusive thoughts and compulsive behaviors that hinder even the simplest everyday tasks. As you navigate Leonard’s world, you’ll encounter scenarios that trigger his symptoms, illustrating how overwhelming and paralyzing these moments can be.

games.name: One-Dot Enemies
games.summary: An early iPhone game designed by the late Kenji Eno ("D", "Real Sound"), this simple title present hordes of microscopic "one-dot" enemies to squish as long as you can.

games.name: Only Tung Tung Sahur Up
games.summary: Up, up, and never give up!

games.name: Overcat
games.summary: OVERCAT is a 1v1 twin-stick fighting game, where competitive and casual players can finally have a fair fight!

games.name: Parkour Labs
games.summary: Are you good at parkour video games? Are you number 1 in surfing mode? This is your game, welcome to Parkour Labs, an experience that will test your skills.

games.name: Picture Hunt
games.summary: Picture Hunt delivers quick, satisfying hidden-object fun across 10 colorful levels—5 classic hunts where you search scenes using a simple list of items, and 5 shape hunts where you match outline silhouettes to objects hidden in the picture; easy to pick up, great on a TV, and perfect for players who love scanning busy scenes, spotting details, and chasing faster clears.

games.name: Pirates of Gravitae
games.summary:
Pirates of Gravitae is an action roguelike game with fast-paced aerial dogfights, set in a fictional version of the Golden Age of Piracy.

The player commands a rocket propelled pirate ship that they can equip with various weapons and abilities, as they fight against a variety of enemies. They can choose from a selection of different bonuses at the end of every battle, to customize their ship as they go. These bonuses expire at the end of a run. They can also unlock new abilities or upgrade crew members, for perks that persist between runs.

games.name: Plane vs. Blocks
games.summary: "Plane vs. Squares" is a vampire survivor-like game in which you shoot squares, gain experience and upgrade your weapons. It includes 7 playable levels and 10+ upgradeable, selectable weapons. Choose your Plane, defeat the Squares, and achieve victory!

games.name: Pocket Flight
games.summary: Fly your own way in Pocket Flight - a cozy endless flight adventure! Explore dynamic biomes, face shifting weather, customize your plane, and take on daily challenges. Relaxing skies, infinite horizons. Ready for takeoff?

games.name: Prison Run
games.summary: Dig your way to freedom!

games.name: Protect the Grimoire
games.summary: Survive, protect, and strike back in Protect the Grimoire! A fast-paced roguelite bullet hell shoot ’em up. Face relentless Dark Wizards and fight your way toward the most powerful grimoires in existence.

games.name: Province Simulator
games.summary: Province Simulator is a survival-driven quest game set in a harsh Russian provincial city. Fight cold, hunger, and illness, earn little money, endure unpredictable weather, and try to escape to a better life.

games.name: Psyhonds
games.summary: A satirical mental hospital survival simulator: control four unstable characters, craft from junk, forge dubious alliances, communicate with patients and staff, and choose between a quiet life in a ward, a riot, or a risky escape to freedom.

games.name: Put One In for Johnny Minn
games.summary:
Stylized physics-soccer arcade puzzle game. Players score using diving headers, volleys, side volleys, and free kicks. Beat levels by discovering the optimal way to solve the level. Timing and precision are needed to make good contact with the ball in order to achieve high contact quality and goal placement scores.

Includes local PvP multiplayer modes: 1v1 (striker vs. keeper) and pass-and-play shot-for-shot party mode for 2-8 local players.

games.name: Quick Brain Letter Hunt
games.summary: Find the ONE specified character! Search across Hiragana, English letters, Hangul, and Traditional Chinese!

games.name: Quick Deduction Short Mysteries
games.summary: One-minute spark, satisfying payoff! A collection of bite-sized mysteries you can solve in no time.

games.name: Rhell: Warped Worlds & Troubled Times
games.summary: Create unique spells by combining magical runes to solve puzzles your way. Transform objects, manipulate time, and discover the mysteries of a world where everyone has vanished, leaving only 12 people behind. Every puzzle has multiple solutions - if you can imagine it, you can probably do it.

games.name: Rio Rise
games.summary:
Enter RioRise, the ultimate open-world city simulation where urban life, street action, police chases, mafia missions, crime progression, survival elements and dynamic city behavior merge into a single immersive experience. Discover a vibrant environment shaped by realistic streets, dangerous alleys, chaotic traffic, gangs, rooftops, markets and unpredictable events.

RioRise delivers deep simulation of real city life: explore dense districts, escape high-risk situations, unlock vehicles, customize your character, build reputation and face evolving threats. Every mission mixes action, adventure, exploration, driving challenges, stealth routes, rooftop traversal and dynamic encounters.

This open-world simulator offers complete freedom: fight, run, infiltrate, discover hidden paths, dominate territories, avoid police traps, survive gang ambushes and transform your role in the city. Feel the tension of a living world where noise, chaos, danger and movement never stop.

games.name: Rolling Ball Game DX: Director's Cut
games.summary: Rolling Ball Game returns with Rolling Ball Game DX: Director's Cut! Traverse through obstacles and avoid the capsule-bots trying to knock you off the stage. Featuring all new and remastered levels, alongside extra content.

games.name: Räv Kafé
games.summary: Räv Kafé is a 2D action platformer where you wander around in the world and in order to survive you need to find materials and food. Explore the open world.

games.name: Salvage Shop Simulator
games.summary: Enter the world of shopkeepers trading in reclaimed goods! Bid for the best items at auction, prepare and clean the bought items, and then sell them in your shop. Test your skills and watch your business grow!

games.name: Sealed Bite: Extended
games.summary: Emilia's life turns into chaos as her family members disappear, one by one. Forced to put her trust in a wolf spirit, Emilia sets off to search the land while pressured into feeding a monstrous power. Will the enigmatic figure she encounters offer guidance, or is Emilia diving head-first into peril?

games.name: Seen Before
games.summary: Seen Before is a psychological horror game where you are trapped in a looping environment, trying to detect inconsistencies and escape the cycle.

games.name: Shalnor: Silverwind Saga 2
games.summary: An RPG/Action Adventure game. With focus on gauntlet-style combat, traps, boss fights, and beautiful pixel-art scenery. Rynna has arrived on an island plagued by monsters and undead fiends raised by an evil Necromancer. The souls of those who remain cannot be free, until the Necromancer is slain!

games.name: Shrapnel
games.summary: Shrapnel is a 4v4 objective FPS. Operators clash in a storm-ravaged impact zone to control Sigma—a volatile resource capable of reshaping humanity’s future.

games.name: Six Seven Nights
games.summary: You have six nights. The seventh day changes everything.

games.name: SkyRunner
games.summary: A fast-paced first-person platformer with combat and style. Wall-run, jump, slide, and grapple through the skies with mind-melting speed and a set of powerful abilities.Master your movement and destroy anything in your path.

games.name: Solasta II
games.summary: In a Mana-infused land, a dark force led by the enigmatic Shadwyn threatens Neokos. Bring your party of adventurers together across perilous realms in this Turn-Based Tactical RPG based on the SRD 5e ruleset. You make the choices, dice decide your destiny.

games.name: Solateria
games.summary: In a world where the Litt have perished, a small pyron warrior embarks on a journey to find the King, the Primordial Flame, the last hope to save the world. Defeat mighty foes, unleash fiery attacks, and master parrying. Explore a beautifully hand-drawn world and uncover its secrets.

games.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 6
games.summary: Mask of Justice

games.name: Spa Massage Boys: Love & Relax
games.summary: Strong hands. Playful tension. Total relaxation.

games.name: Space Supermarket Simulator
games.summary: Run your own supermarket in outer space. Keep shelves stocked and nicely organized. Supply your store with drone delivery.

games.name: Speed Boom: Last Delivery
games.summary: FULL SPEED. BEAT THE CLOCK. DELIVER OR LOSE.

games.name: Stellar Wanderer DX
games.summary: Stellar Wanderer DX is an old-school space combat sim set in a vast open-world universe. Follow the story or choose your favorite side missions as a mercenary fighter pilot. Explore the galaxy, upgrade your ship and weapons, trade resources and fight outlaws.

games.name: Street Soccer
games.summary: Jump into casual street soccer and relive the joy of playing on the neighborhood playground.

games.name: Suika Game Planet
games.summary:
A new Suika Game is here from a new setting in space! Turn, target, and aim for the watermelon!

Drop the fruits freely from any direction as "Poppy" flies 360° around the planet. Make fruits of the same type collide to make them "evolve" and aim to create watermelons for a high score!
Make a lot of fruits "evolve" to enter the new "Super Evolution Time" mode! Special background music, dramatic effects, and a bonus score bring the excitement to a peak!

The "Suika Game Planet" has evolved in many ways, including with a customization function that allows you to freely decorate the game screen (skin), and a collection function that allows you to collect stickers for completing missions and use them to create your original name tag. Try playing it now!

games.name: Super Waifu Tsunami
games.summary: The anime waifu platform-fighter you never knew you needed!

games.name: Tank Battle Arena Combat
games.summary: Drive powerful tanks into battle. Destroy enemies and conquer missions. Fast, explosive tank action awaits!

games.name: Taxi Hyperdrive
games.summary: Drive at full speed, pick up passengers and compete for the top spot in this fast-paced futuristic taxi arcade.

games.name: The Buried Pillars
games.summary: Explore the world, fight fierce and alluring monster girls to uncover the secrets hidden within! A Metroidvania 2D platformer with combats that push you to the edge!

games.name: The Dark Path to the Black Tower
games.summary: Anomaly horror with a dark fantasy theme. Traverse a cursed forest on a stormy night. If you see signs of witchcraft, turn back... Else you remain trapped on the path for eternity...

games.name: The Tower of Shadows
games.summary: Tower of Shadows is a turn-based strategy game where every decision counts. Climb the levels one by one, face formidable opponents, and perfect your tactics to reach the top. Your ultimate challenge? The Master of Shadows himself.

games.name: Three Misses Confectionery
games.summary: On a rainy afternoon, a young man takes shelter in a cute and quiet confectionery. Three sweet chefs welcome him enthusiastically and offer irresistible cakes.

games.name: Timberborn
games.summary: Humans are long gone. In a world struck by droughts and toxic waste, will your lumberpunk beavers do any better? Timberborn is a sandbox city-building game featuring ingenious animals, vertical architecture, water physics, and terraforming. Contains high amounts of wood.

games.name: Titanic Survival Simulator
games.summary: April, 1912. A calm night in the Atlantic. Laughter echoes through grand halls, chandeliers glow warmly, and the world’s most luxurious ocean liner glides confidently through the water. Then — impact.

games.name: Trailmarks
games.summary: Inspired by Carmen Sandiego, Trailmarks is a globe-spanning strategy adventure where you circumnavigate the planet as a travel guide fact-checker. Plan routes across 1,200 cities, answer 120,000+ trivia questions, trade souvenirs, and prove your expertise to unlock new countries.

games.name: Transport Tycoon Deluxe
games.summary: Transport Tycoon Deluxe was released in 1995, and featured new varieties of landscape and weather, new scenarios, more vehicles and allowed the player to run their company all the way from the year 1950 up to the year 2050.

games.name: Ultra Bonk Survivors
games.summary:
Step into the chaotic world of Ultra Bonk Survivors, where every swing, spell, and explosion decides your fate!

Choose your hero, dive into monster-filled arenas, and unleash devastating attacks in this fast-paced survivor-style action roguelite designed for quick, addictive sessions of pure fun.

games.name: Ultra Maze
games.summary: This is the ultimate Maze Game. The mazes are procedurally generated, and so are always unique. There are plenty of options to create an experience to your likings.

games.name: Unity-Chan: Desktop Companion
games.summary: An AI desktop companion with her own personality and a virtual room to play various mini games with her. "Hi! My name is Kohaku Otori, but everyone calls me Unity-chan! I just found a way to visit you on your desktop, may I come? 🧡"

games.name: Veggie Warfare: Feast of Fury
games.summary: Enter the warzone against furious killer vegetables!

games.name: Versus One
games.summary: Chaotic Party Action with Dark Witch Characters! Jump into a party game for up to 4 players, starring characters from The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4! Play locally or online and compete in 6 fast-paced mini-games, where magic isn’t just for winning — it’s for messing with your friends.

games.name: Wandfall
games.summary: Master tactical combat and collect powerful Sigils in this challenging roguelike. Navigate procedural maps through three acts of escalating difficulty, where every encounter shapes your build and every decision determines your survival.

games.name: Withered Haven
games.summary: Withered Haven is a first-person psychological horror game. After the tragic loss of his wife and daughter, a broken man struggles to endure a collapsing reality. Familiar apparitions drift closer, echoing memories that mask a darkness beyond comprehension.

games.name: Wriggle Apple 2
games.summary: A winter puzzle adventure where a hungry worm collects apples. Plan your path carefully as it grows longer and fragile icy blocks break beneath it.

games.name: Writer's Block
games.summary: Writer's Block is a falling block word game mashup where you write one block at a time. Put your vocabulary to the test, set up combos, and try not to let the letters pile up!

games.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
games.summary: Another chapter of the atmospheric horror series has emerged from the shadows! Eerie sound design and shadowy environments set the stage for gruesome and terrifying ghosts never seen before in the series.

games.name: Zelene Lux: Spirit Notes
games.summary: Free the trapped souls of your friends from a haunted manor. Solve cryptic riddles, find hidden objects, and restore a sanctuary to banish the cult of Magister Vane!

games.name: Zumba: Galactic Marble Blast
games.summary: Leap across the cosmos—match, blast, and save the galaxy in marble style!

games.name: 4Spicchi
games.summary: The 4Spicchi pizzeria is under attack by terrifying food-monsters, and only Margherita can stop them. How? Using their ingredients... and a little bit of science!

games.name: Adventurous Slime
games.summary: Adventurous Slime is a mini metroidvania about a small but very courageous slime going on an adventure. Featuring a magical world full of dangerous creatures and powerful ancient items to find, colorful pixelated visuals and chiptune songs.

games.name: Adversator
games.summary: Adversator is a fast-paced MOBA with short and intense matches. Fight your way up the highly competitive ranked ladder or play for fun in casual matches with no waiting time. Made by a solo indie developer with an old-school graphical touch and unique features you’ll find nowhere else.

games.name: Akunin-Akka
games.summary: An interrogation game where you play as the detective in charge of a case and interrogate suspects to uncover the truth behind the bombing. Uncover the weaknesses of the unique suspects and get to the bottom of the case!

games.name: Ash & Rust
games.summary: The next generation of ARPG is finally here! Fight your way through mysterious places, face mighty foes, and construct the perfect build. Enemies are strong and smart, but you'll have a massive arsenal of tools and abilities to master in order to vanquish them. Dive in!

games.name: Beyond the Eyes
games.summary: A 2d game with a view from above, where you are in the shoes of a blind protagonist and have to find a way to escape from a mansion by collecting various items scattered around it at random while being chased by a monster.

games.name: Bird Watching Simulator
games.summary: An avid bird watching simulator with realistic watching mechanics. Grab your binoculars and build your attention span, Bird Watching Simulator is an unbelievably relaxing and interactive game that draws you so close to nature, it feels like you're apart of it.

games.name: Black Box: Hacker Day One
games.summary: A hacking sim that runs inside a fake desktop OS, with no menus laid over the top. You get a terminal, 72 hours, and one job: get into North Korea's missile network and send its rockets to the Moon instead of Seoul. Do it quietly and nobody ever finds out you were there.

games.name: Blades of Vharan
games.summary: In a world consumed by darkness, a lone warrior rises against the forces of evil. Face monstrous creatures, survive brutal battles, and forge your legend in a retro-flavored action fantasy.

games.name: Caribbean Legend: Age of Pirates
games.summary: You are the captain and owner of your own ship—the finest fate one could hope for in the 17th century Caribbean. Unlimited sandbox experience. A unique genre blending naval combat, land exploration, and global map. Think Sid Meier's Pirates! meets Bannerlord.

games.name: Carrot Overload
games.summary:
our young rabbit hero travel without goal to the green area.the middle land of the rabbit territory is known for being at peace. But it is no longer the fact today.

it is time adorable hero to explore and give a good pawn in the slimes.

trials are stacking, hopes are increasing !

become the hope they deeply need.

games.name: Cat Familiar Center
games.summary: Cat Familiar Center is a relaxing cat-raising game. Players will play as a witch and, with the help of fellow witches, train different cat familiars and find suitable new homes for them.

games.name: Channel 64
games.summary: A short psychological VHS horror about routine tape digitizing, where reality starts to feel more and more strange with each new recording.

games.name: Cyber Saber Pro
games.summary: Become HKKMR-U, the legendary Cyborg Samurai, and test your reflexes in a fast-paced arcade hack-and-slash survival game. Stand your ground, unleash your sword skills, and face wave after wave of mechanical enemies inspired by Japanese folklore.

games.name: Deckline
games.summary: Deckline is an atmospheric war-horror card game. Out of ammo and encircled, you play one last game of Durak to distract from the inevitable. Experience the grit and dread of modern combat through the lens of a board game.

games.name: Desktop Aquarium
games.summary: A relaxing mini aquarium that stays on your desktop corner while you do other stuff — collect fish, upgrade tanks, and enjoy a cozy idle experience.

games.name: Digital Market Simulator
games.summary: Run a marketplace where you can sell games and everything related, take care of customers and shape it however you want.

games.name: Don't Crack!
games.summary: A chaotic co-op or solo rage platformer about a fragile egg’s dangerous journey back to its nest.

games.name: Don't Mess With Bober
games.summary: First-person game with a touch of 80s horror movies, where you face the Beaver, who’s out for revenge.

games.name: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 26
games.summary: Build your college basketball dynasty in Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 26. Recruit elite talent, manage NIL strategy, dominate the transfer portal, and guide your team through March. The deepest and most realistic college basketball simulation yet.

games.name: Drill and Delve
games.summary: You've been trapped in a mine. You'll need to use your tools to dig your way to the exit in a fully destructible 3D voxel terrain. Manage your oxygen and equipment, and uncover the dark mystery buried deep within the mine.

games.name: Duck the Miner
games.summary: Duck the Miner is a 2D mining game, where you control a little duck, that unfortunately has a huge debt. To pay it off, you were contracted by a greedy company to embark on missions across space, collecting resources to help restore Earth from its devastating past.

games.name: Dyping Escape
games.summary: Escape from a dying-typing game where the words you type become reality and turn against you.

games.name: Echo Factory
games.summary: The world has gone silent. Tap into the void, generate echoes, and automate the restoration of sound in this neon-soaked, sci-fi idle game. Build powerful machines, unlock complex frequencies, and rebuild the cosmic core to bring harmony back to the universe.

games.name: End of Garbage
games.summary: A darkened sky. A blazing fire. A wretched tombstone. And you, here at the end of everything. End of Garbage is a short, first-person puzzle game exploring the dark surreality of endings.

games.name: Everfall 2: Idle Dungeon RPG
games.summary: Unique Bosses, Loot Filters, Combat Pets, & Pick Your Team of 4 to Customize with Skill trees, Keystones, Abilities, and Runes in a MASSIVE ENDGAME!

games.name: Exercise Your Demons
games.summary: Step into the world of Exercise your Demons, a 2d narrative adventure inspired by Irish fairies and folklore. Meet and befriend 5 locals while you work towards settling into the small fictional town called Inishsióg in County Galway, Ireland.

games.name: Faye's Garden
games.summary: Here, in this verdant embassy, Faye opens her arms, and legs, to you. So, don't forget take a deep breath, savor the magic in the air, and get ready to experience the beautiful land of Ithonia!

games.name: Ferret Quest
games.summary: Ferret Quest is a charming hand-drawn action game where a brave little ferret hurls acorns at masked woodland foes. Battle through challenging levels, uncover the mystery behind the masks, and take on a climactic boss fight in this adorable forest adventure!

games.name: Find 100 Ducks and Blast Them...in Space!!!
games.summary: Yes! In this game you must blast 100 toy ducks...IN SPACE! Relax, take aim, and let the feathers fly! With light-hearted gameplay and cute ducks to hunt, it's a casual first-person experience full of wholesome, family-friendly fun!

games.name: Five Nights at Frickbear's 3
games.summary:
Five Nights at Frickbear's 3 is a FNaF fangame with a big focus on player choice and replayability, featuring a uniquely goofy art style, a metric buttload of unique animatronic enemies, 3D free-roam minigames, and multiple story routes!

Can YOU survive Five Nights at Frickbear's? ...3?

games.name: Flash Knight Nymphelia
games.summary: A selfie-obsessed-girl-turned-transforming-heroine fights against an evil organization in a powered suit fueled with her stress from hiding her true self from public!

games.name: Forever-Happy-Town
games.summary: A PvE multiplayer shooter where a prophecy of eight endless nights is rapidly approaching, are you good enough to keep the town forever happy? You'd better be, else a herd of lovely rabbits will require rapid relocation.

games.name: Funi Raccoon Game
games.summary: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)

games.name: Gensokyo: Presumption of Guilt - Pansies Before Dawn
games.summary: An ancient village, once sealed by yokais for a millennium, is now plagued by a series of bizarre yokai murders. Follow the protagonist as they delve into the investigation, unravelling the mysteries submerged in the history.

games.name: Ghost Cam
games.summary: Ghost Cam is a spooky exploratory VR and PC game where you search for ghosts – at your own risk… Discover how good you are at finding ghosts, figuring out clues and uncovering the story - if you can survive the multiple endings.

games.name: Grand Containment Sector 4
games.summary:
Grand Containment : Sector 4,

"They said it was just a server farm. They lied."

For years, Grand Gaming Technologies Private Limited (GGTPL) has been a leader in virtual entertainment. But rumors have started to circulate on the dark web—rumors of people going missing near their remote "Logistics Center" hidden deep in the forest. They call it Sector 4.

You are a whistleblower who has received a cryptic coordinate. Armed with only a flashlight and a camera, you must infiltrate the decaying industrial complex to find out what GGTPL is really building.

But the factory isn't abandoned. The machinery is still humming, the security protocols are active, and something horrifying is stalking the assembly lines.

Investigate. Survive. Expose

games.name: Grand Cru: The Wine Maker
games.summary: Grand Cru: The Wine Maker is a turn-based wine-making tycoon set in Bordeaux. Score your terroir, age vintages in oak, and balance the four pillars of quality — then out-negotiate 25 unique buyers with your own pricing strategy while volatile weather RNG threatens every harvest. From terroir scoring to Michelin-star contracts, every vintage is a high-stakes economic calculation where critics and the public pull in different directions.

games.name: Guerilla Cinema // Guerilla Theater
games.summary: A comedy horror indie visual novel about an experimented on silverback gorilla that escapes from a research facility and breaks into a movie theater. The player has to choose between three different items to stop the gorilla and whatever item they choose determines what ending they get.

games.name: Happy Bones: Welcome Home
games.summary: After receiving a frantic message from her father, Laura heads out to her parents house located inside a cult compound to search for the truth, in this complete remake of the classic horror themed JRPG!

games.name: Happy Harvest
games.summary: A cozy themed, idle incremental farming game.

games.name: Hentai Desire
games.summary: Embark on a relaxing and sensual puzzle journey with Hentai Desire, where each calming level and every completed image gently soothes your mind.

games.name: Homeshift
games.summary: Guide a young boy through fears and dark caverns, in hopes of reaching a happy home. Homeshift sees you platforming in diverse environments, utilising your wits and tools to overcome challenges in creative ways.

games.name: Hua-Z
games.summary: You need to survive wave after wave of zombie hordes with your teammates. There are characters with various abilities to choose from. Cooperate with each other and upgrade equipment to try to survive longer.

games.name: I am Slime
games.summary: Memory backtracking, as one puzzle after another is solved, the memories of the blue slime are also turned over page by page ..

games.name: Idle Realms: The Eternal Spire
games.summary: Train 18 skills, craft legendary gear, fight monsters across 6 realms, and conquer The Eternal Spire. A deep single-player idle RPG with true offline progression.

games.name: Jigsaw Puzzle Passport: Spain
games.summary: Your Virtual Vacation Awaits

games.name: Jumpscare Storey Loop
games.summary: Discover jump scare phenomena and escape the loops of eerie buildings. Observe carefully to uncover the paranormal and cut down those who attack you.

games.name: Kicking Upwards
games.summary: Kicking Upwards is an experimental, skill-based physics game where you kick a red ball up a mountain.

games.name: Killer Island
games.summary: A first-person social deduction survival horror game. Stranded with your friends on a foggy island—but one of you is a killer. Chop wood to stay warm, hunt animals for food, retrieve artifacts for sacrifice, and expose the killer before it’s too late. 3–8 players. Proximity voice chat.

games.name: Labyrinth of Anxiety
games.summary: You are trapped in a labyrinth of identical rooms that repeat endlessly. The goal is to find the right door and move forward before anxiety consumes you. Every decision matters... the labyrinth doesn't forgive mistakes.

games.name: Landoria
games.summary: Landoria is a cartoon fantasy strategy game where you begin your campaign in a procedurally generated world as one of the faction leaders to capture strategic locations and defend against the opponents' siege together with your heroes to expand your territory.

games.name: Lucid Blocks
games.summary: Explore, build, and survive in a liminal voxel expanse oozing with surreal landscapes and esoteric critters.

games.name: M.A.D. Cows
games.summary: M.A.D. Cows is an exciting, retro, action platform game. Mow down aliens. Buy better guns. Rescue cows, dogs, raccoons, and more.

games.name: Mazy
games.summary: MAZY is a first-person PS1-style horror game where you explore procedurally generated mazes, solve a variety of minigames and survive while hostile clowns hunt you down. Collect coins to buy power-ups and assistance to help you escape.

games.name: Minima
games.summary:
Minima is a short narrative exploration game about an 11-year-old boy named Ian, whose imagination brings his bedroom to life. The story is told without dialogue, using light, sound, and environmental interaction.
Players explore small, intimate scenes inspired by childhood memories, with a focus on observation rather than challenges. The game features minimalist visuals and a calm soundtrack, creating a reflective, atmospheric experience.

games.name: Monari Station
games.summary: An ordinary commute becomes a moral crucible in Monar Station, a short psychological horror visual novel. Navigate an extreme situation, make value-defining choices... Discover what lingers after the train moves on...

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
games.summary: Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate. Two centuries after a conflict that divided neighboring kingdoms, the drums of war are reignited as twin Rathalos—long thought extinct—hatch from a single egg: an omen of destruction. Is there hope beyond the northern border?

games.name: Mythmatch
games.summary: A Greek mythology community sim about bringing people together by putting things together.

games.name: Night of Nightmare
games.summary: Every night, the nightmare comes. Your room is no longer safe... The moment you lie down on a strange bed and close your eyes, you are no longer alone. Is this reality? Or are you inside someone else’s nightmare?

games.name: Nordic Ashes: The Complete Saga
games.summary: Nordic Ashes is a challenging Norse inspired roguelite-survivor game, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way.

games.name: Omoide Cafe
games.summary: Omoide Cafe is a calm café/pastry shop simulation where you develop your own café step by step, unlocking new recipes, equipment, and features with the guidance of Bebii.

games.name: OpenFront
games.summary: Free RTS Point and Click

games.name: Orbita
games.summary: Discover elements, feed the blackhole, automate with physics, complete missions, get better tools and build megafarms!

games.name: Panic Floor!!
games.summary: An extremely unforgiving and constrained precision oriented platformer with fast paced flow!!

games.name: Penguin
games.summary: Fish, sell, upgrade, and dive ever deeper into an ocean full of secrets. Collect the entire ARTICDEX!

games.name: Pest'Off
games.summary: Pest'Off is a student made First-Person Shooter. Mutants are infesting the city and you’re the one paid to clean it up. Play as a Pest’Off employee, take extermination contracts, wipe out aggressive mutants, earn cash, and upgrade your gear. Clock in, exterminate, get paid.

games.name: Phantom the Huntress
games.summary: Not sword-clanging trash. Not glitter-magic garbage. Bow only. The rest is for peasants. I’m Phantom, elite huntress, eternally exhausted. You’ll track, gather, goblin-slay, babysit dumb NPCs and rank up at snail pace. Wishlist now. I get bonus wine money. Do it or vanish. My patience is dead.

games.name: Piece by Piece
games.summary: Piece by Piece is a jigsaw puzzle platformer where each level is fragmented into jigsaw pieces. Clear each puzzle by connecting and disconnecting each piece to make your way through each of our 100 handcrafted levels. Discover new themes and mechanics along the way!

games.name: Pizza Slice
games.summary: More than just a simulator, Pizza Slice is a true Italian adventure! Take on the role of Tonio, manage your family pizzeria, bake authentic Italian pizzas, fight the competition and grow your business. See if you can win the title of the best pizzeria in the area!

games.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
games.summary: Seal the border. Stop the outbreak. Survive the chaos.

games.name: Raanaa: The Shaman Girl
games.summary:
Raanaa is a third person adventure 3D platformer.
Raanaa, a courageous shaman girl, helps the spirit worlds that are in danger. With the help of her shaman abilities and her magical dress, she can defy gravity.

Raanaa travels through wondrous spirit realms and collaborates with different Gods and Goddesses to fight evil spirits and deities in order to obtain balance in the universe and save humanity.
Raanaa travels through spirit worlds that are all inspired by old Saami and Norse stories and mythology. In every episode the player gets to visit in a new spirit world. Become the savior of the spirit worlds!

games.name: Reap: We Reap What Crawls
games.summary: Co-op horror dungeon crawling X creature collection & farming! Descend into shifting dungeons, throw physics objects, and trap terrifying monsters! Imprison them in your decaying basement lair, farm and feed them cursed crops, then sell them to crazy buyers. R.E.P.O. meets Slime Rancher!

games.name: Recursive
games.summary: Incrementals layered inside of an incremental. Click your way through waves of enemies to grow and defend your kingdom. Unlock a bunch of minigames with different mechanics and bonuses along the way! Can you defeat the final boss and reclaim the throne?!

games.name: Reflections of the Void
games.summary: A sci-fi drama about love, control, and the price of human emotion. Care for your wards, follow every order — or break the rules to discover who you truly are.

games.name: Rubble Rampage
games.summary: Embark on a thrilling space adventure on a mysterious planet where you'll become a master marksman with a powerful space cannon!

games.name: Rustil: Eternal Labyrinth Castle
games.summary: In a randomly changing labyrinth castle, Rustil aims for the top floor. An exhilarating roguelike action game in which players aim to reach the top floor while efficiently strengthening the main character by acquiring abilities from the souls of heroes.

games.name: Sato Killing Time Chat.exe
games.summary: It was supposed to be just a harmless chat to kill time with a stranger named Mina. But from the other side of the browser, the boundary between your reality and the internet is slowly being eroded. This is a desktop-invasion chat horror.

games.name: Scission
games.summary: Scission is a dark and gruesome action game where you control two characters at once. Fight grotesque representations of the subconscious, master new skills and explore the depth of the human mind in this singleplayer game.

games.name: Shadows Of Wyrmwood
games.summary: Shadows of Wyrmwood is a roguelike adventure RPG. Use spells, swords, and strategy to defeat every corrupted foe. Travel across four procedurally generated maps that grow harder with every encounter. With each victory, you obtain new armor, weapons, and spells from defeated enemies.

games.name: Shifting To The Backrooms
games.summary: "Shifting To The Backrooms" is a mix of psychological horror and drama game where the protagonist, Will, grappling with family tragedies, discovers the method of "shifting" enabling him to escape to the dream liminal worlds. However, the dream turns into a nightmare from which Will cannot wake up.

games.name: Shuffles 'n Scuffles
games.summary: Enter a papercraft world in this single-player, deck-building, card-battling, roguelike strategy game. Use your wits to battle your way through waves of enemies, while rewriting the very definitions of the cards you hold.

games.name: Sidyq
games.summary: Sidyq combines monster collection with dynamic turn-based battles. Unleash your tactical creativity and face formidable bosses in a strategic RPG where every decision can change the outcome of the fight.

games.name: SketchCode
games.summary: SketchCode is an online multiplayer party game where players draw and guess words in team-based matches. Players can create private rooms, customize teams and rounds, add custom words, and compete under time limits by explaining terms through drawings while following the game rules.

games.name: Sleep Demon
games.summary: Ever wondered what it is like to experience Sleep Paralysis? A Single player Phycological Horror Walking Simulator exploring the horrors of Sleep Paralysis, Lucid dreaming and Liminal Spaces, all based on my own personal experiences.

games.name: Smile More
games.summary: A short medical simulation horror game with multiple endings where the imperfect are made HAPPY. Perform tasks and operations on sedated patients to fix their defects before submitting your files to the Ministry of Happiness & Peace!
