games.name: Sovereign Brain Empire
games.summary: “Who isn’t a baby anyway?”~You travelled to a parallel world governed by the Sovereign Brain AI. In SB Empire, you’re an adopted “one-year-old”, recognized as a "Monarch-level" prodigy! There will be beauties giving you a sheltered babyhood. Your brilliance and privileges will change their fates!

games.name: Space Tales
games.summary: Space Tales is a real-time strategy game set in a retro-futuristic environment. Take on the role of a commander in the Intergalactic Planetary Expansion (I.P.E.) and immerse yourself in a thrilling mission to explore and conquer new planets, pushing the boundaries of the Human Empire.

games.name: Spoopcore 3D
games.summary: Spoopcore 3D is a low-poly 3D platformer/FPS hybrid where you play as a slime named Reggie on a mission to save ducks from across the multiverse and kill a god. Zoom through levels, find secrets, and dispatch enemies using weapon combos.

games.name: Subsequence
games.summary: Subsequence is a linear single player story driven 3D adventure game about overcoming obstacles, solving logical puzzles and exploration of the world.

games.name: Summer Delicous Simulator
games.summary: Start your career on the bustling city streets as an ice cream or hotdog vendor! Upgrade your cart, outsmart your rivals, and compete with friends to become the most popular seller in town!

games.name: Super Dungeon Scoundrel
games.summary: A super-casual, single-player card battler inspired by the tabletop game Scoundrel, where you fight your way through a dungeon using a deck of cards—equipping weapons, battling monsters, fleeing when necessary, and managing your health as you progress. With simple mechanics and quick decision-making at its core, the goal is to strategically survive each room and make it to the end of the dungeon to claim your reward.

games.name: Super Holo Wars
games.summary:
Super Holo Wars is about one simple concept: Take the members of Hololive, put them into giant robots and give them a world to play around in.

Super Holo Wars offers a full-length SRPG experience covering the first part of a two-chapter story. Join the members of Hololive as they embark on their quest to protect two worlds from an Alien invasion and the Noise

games.name: Teko
games.summary: Enter the casino in TEKO, an addictive Roguelike Deckbuilder! Hit the score goal by playing 3 poker hands simultaneously. Modify your Chips, collect Cards, and take risks to maximize your profits. An indie progressive scoring game inspired by Balatro.

games.name: The Black Whale
games.summary: The factory chip began to malfunction. Your horrible headaches don’t bother anyone in this dystopian world. “Black Whale”, the attractive white powder, is the only thing that can stop the pain. And show you the life without the horrors of harsh reality.

games.name: The Dead Roam Free
games.summary:
Play Snake as you’ve never played it before.

In The Dead Roam Free, you slither, shoot, and snack your way through a twisted military experiment gone wrong. Blood, betrayal, and bad jokes are all part of the package.

You are Bob Segatti, private eye and fixer for those who can pay. When a mysterious dame walks into his office, Bob bites off more than he can chew — literally. One betrayal and a concrete floor later, he wakes up undead and hungry for answers.

Crawl through labs, streets, and sewers in a top-down action-puzzle adventure where every meal makes you longer, stronger, and dumber. Uncover the truth behind the army’s secret zombie program, rescue the girl, and get revenge — one bite at a time.

games.name: The Glitcher 2D
games.summary:
The Glitcher is a top-down 2D survival game where you must withstand endless waves of corrupted entities as the system itself begins to collapse.

Inspired by games like Vampire Survivors, NEOHELL, and classic retro arcade titles, it combines fast-paced action and steady progression with a digital aesthetic drawn from system glitches, VHS tapes, and corrupted technology.

As you survive, the system will spawn increasingly dangerous threats.

games.name: The Last Screening
games.summary: You find yourself inside a cinema hallway, ready to watch your film. The venue, however, has other plans for you.

games.name: The Narrator Says We're Meant to Be!
games.summary:
A sweet and comedic love story where you romance Julian, the most popular guy around, while also dealing with an opinionated and tsundere Narrator trying to give you advice on how to reach your happy ending.

Will you succeed, comically mess up, or... fall for someone who wasn't supposed to be a character in the first place?

games.name: The Shame of a Daydreamer
games.summary: Shame & choices = possible apocalypse. You need to figure out what’s causing the apocalypse to happen, so that you can prevent it. 2 playable characters with different relations to shame → 2 unique perspectives of the same story. Complicated families, branching choices and unforgiving consequences.

games.name: Tilde and the 9 Mystical Glorbos
games.summary: You follow Tilde, an average 20-year-old guy living a humdrum life on his own. When one day word spreads of a cluster of so-called "meteorites" that came from the sky in the middle of the night. With nothing better to do he decides to check it out. If only he knew what he would set in motion...

games.name: Tiny Biomes: Cozy Idle
games.summary: Tiny Biomes is a relaxing idle game where animals peacefully produce resources and you gather wood in a tranquil harvesting area. Build small biomes, earn gold, and enjoy steady progress without pressure, timers, or stress. Play at your own pace and unwind.

games.name: Today's Menu
games.summary: Mix cards with restaurant management in this sim game. Build, gather ingredients, and learn recipes. Use your deck to serve customers, earn profits and fame, then upgrade and expand to craft your ideal restaurant.

games.name: Topobeam
games.summary: Topobeam is a puzzle game about redirecting lasers in different two-dimensional manifolds. The levels operate on a grid system, but pay attention to how the sides of the grid are glued together as players, objects, and lasers can cross over these gluings to different parts of the level.

games.name: Toy Zombies
games.summary: Escape the abandoned mall by hiding from the creatures, learn their behaviors and explore the place to find the way out.

games.name: Trashcan Man
games.summary: Recoil-driven platformer where shooting is the only way to move

games.name: Tricky Monkey Zoo
games.summary: Put yourself in the paws of the cheekiest monkey in the zoo! In this hilarious first-person animal adventure, you can cause chaos, play pranks on visitors, and turn an ordinary zoo into a playground of pure monkey madness.

games.name: Turbo Dismount 2
games.summary: Turbo Dismount 2 is a comedy physics racing sandbox with Mr. Dismount and his friends. It is the officially ambitious sequel to the wildly popular, immensely successful, world-renowned entertainment juggernaut - Turbo Dismount.

games.name: UltiMage
games.summary: Rogue-lite, magic based combat system. A lighter dark fantasy about a person "iseaki" 'ed to another world.

games.name: URLIRL
games.summary: URLIRL is a SOUP-Like that uses art from old websites that are preserved in the Internet Archive, to try and replicate that feeling of the old internet.

games.name: Usurper Reborn
games.summary: Wake with no memory. Descend 100 dungeon floors. Build relationships, start a family, lose companions forever. A text-based RPG remake of the 1993 BBS classic—with a living world and multiple endings shaped by your choices.

games.name: Vesperia Bononia
games.summary: Fight the nightmares of the city! Master a blend of third-person shooting, magic, and bullet hell to survive the fast-paced, ever-changing chaos that grips the streets. Change classes during combat, enter Bononia, and face your destiny.

games.name: Viral Hunters
games.summary: You are trapped in the same facility, aiming to find a way out through the scattered "Vaccine Injectors". The game's core revolves around the crucial vaccines.

games.name: Völund
games.summary: The forge remembers every strike. In VÖLUND, a blacksmithing roguelike, you shape raw ore into weapons of legend. Unearth cursed metals, master the ancient craft, and forge your path to immortality.

games.name: Weeb Store Simulator: Supermarket Together
games.summary: Welcome to Weeb Store Simulator: Supermarket Together, the ultimate management simulator where you and your friends run a nerdy supermarket filled with games, manga, and collectibles!

games.name: Wild West Legacy
games.summary: Conquer the Wild West. Explore the open world of a fictitious American Midwest and survive the harsh environment. Convince other settlers to join you and manage your ever-growing settlements. Build a home, take care of your farm and become a legend in Wild West Legacy.

games.name: Yellow Trouble
games.summary: 8-way water gun blasting horizontal 2D arcade co-op shoot ‘em up, with ducks?!

games.name: B-Day-25
games.summary:
B-Day-25 is an Another World story set in the WithoutEyes series.

It tells the story of someone who wanted to save another person,
and someone who relied too deeply on that kindness.

A destructive brotherhood drama shaped by guilt, blame, and emotional dependence.

games.name: Buying Tomato
games.summary: This is a short visual novel about going to buy a tomato.

games.name: Buzzsaw+
games.summary:
Falling-block puzzle game. Crates and creatures fall into the play area in random sets of three in an L-shape. The player can rotate and stack the shapes in an on-screen hopper. Complete rows of crates are eliminated. Creatures can only be eliminated by the titular 'Buzzsaws' - circular saw blades which occasionally appear among the L-shaped pieces and which run left, right and down, cutting through any lines of creatures. Ton-Weights and Star-Bombs also appear as rare extras and these eliminate creatures in different ways.

Points are awarded for rows of crates completed and creatures eliminated. Score multipliers apply the more rows or creatures are eliminated in chain-reactions from placing a single piece.

games.name: Coin Pit
games.summary: One chamber. One machine. Endless damnation.

games.name: Deckbuilder Fantasy
games.summary: Embark on a thrilling deckbuilding adventure! Craft your strategy as you explore treacherous lands and face challenging foes. Discover a vast array of powerful cards and unique treasures, fighting your way to the final boss on a journey that's different every time.

games.name: Do You Like Italian Food?
games.summary:
Do You Like Italian Food? is a short, slice-of-life, romantic visual novel about a shy college student, a coffee shop crush, and finding the nerve to ask for a date.

Jared is only supposed to be stopping by for caffeine. Instead, he keeps finding himself drawn back by a smile, a little conversation, and the hope that maybe this could become more than part of his routine.

games.name: Dyrocraft 2: Reborn
games.summary:
Dyrocraft is a multiplayer sandbox survival game in which players can explore an open world with friends, gather resources, and build their own base. The focus is on freedom and cooperation: players can establish farms, shape their surroundings, and develop their own playstyle.

In addition to building, survival also plays a central role. In the world of Dyrocraft, zombies appear that drop valuable equipment but at the same time pose a constant threat. They can attack and kill players, bringing tension and risk to every gaming session.

The combination of building, farming, combat, and cooperative gameplay creates a dynamic gaming experience that evolves with every decision and progress.

games.name: Escape from Vacov
games.summary: A deceptive 2D platformer where the system wants you banned. Fake floors, vanishing platforms, and traps that wait for one wrong jump. Run. Jump. Trust nothing. Escape Vacov before it locks you out.

games.name: Guinea Pig Temple
games.summary: You are the hero, and it's time to save your guinea pig friends! Eat food! Squeak! Popcorn! Gather all types of food and friends for a fun temple party. When you've gathered enough friends and resources, the temple's final portal opens for you to join the grand celebration!

games.name: Hentai Age Scientist
games.summary: Enjoy a relaxing puzzle journey where each solved level reveals beautiful girl artwork, offering calm visuals, gentle gameplay, no timers, no pressure, and a peaceful experience playable anytime for everyone.

games.name: I Traveled Back to 5 Days Before the Apocalypse
games.summary: "I Traveled Back to 5 Days Before the Apocalypse" is a real-time text adventure. After freezing and starving in the apocalypse, you revive five days prior. Now you must stockpile supplies, manage neighbor relations, and survive the impending catastrophe—your choices determine everything.

games.name: Kawaii Survivors
games.summary: Fight endless enemy hordes in a glitched cyberpunk world as Lucy the cosplayer. This bullet heaven roguelite blends kawaii anime aesthetics with intense top-down survivors-like action. Use cosplay powers to battle waves of corrupted enemies. Pure bullet hell chaos with a touch of 90s anime.

games.name: Knights End
games.summary: Work together to survive the knight shift in this co-op PvE horror game. Serve your villagers’ as a disgraced knight by completing their commands in a cursed kingdom. Reclaim your lost honor to earn items and a chance at your freedom.

games.name: Lab47
games.summary: Enter mysterious worlds through a laboratory portal and explore the unknown with friends. Discover eerie, magical, and fantastical dimensions, collect items, and trade equipment in Lab47.

games.name: Leaves 3
games.summary: Dive into the enchanting world of Leaves 3, a handcrafted adventure full of mysteries and wonders. Explore a world crafted with love and imagination, solve puzzles and free the Treefruities.

games.name: Mr. Stackman
games.summary: Stay alive. Keep stacking.

games.name: OverTask
games.summary:
Hello! Are you the new intern?
You're trapped in a chaotic office where every superior tries to dump their work on you. Tasks keep piling up nonstop, the boss interrupts to demand that you deal with their whims, and your stress level rises with every second. You’ll need to move fast, manage the chaos, and find moments to rest while struggling to survive the avalanche of work. Hold out as long as you can... before the stress overwhelms you.

games.name: Popup.exe
games.summary: A chill idle game in the corner of your screen. Popups spawn. Close them. Earn money. Buy upgrades. Repeat.

games.name: RTM: The Last Days
games.summary: As the only survivor of a military plane crash, you find yourself in a mysterious island battling to stay alive and discover the dark secret that lies beneath the ground.

games.name: Sand Seeker
games.summary: Walk the ancient paths. Seek what was lost.

games.name: SCP-3008: Infinite Store
games.summary: An observation-driven psychological horror set inside an endless furniture superstore. Spot anomalies, choose the correct path, complete your shopping list — and escape the loop.

games.name: Sherman Commander
games.summary: Command a platoon of Sherman tanks over the most famous theatres of WW2. Take the commander’s seat and give specific orders to your crew, or open the tactical map to coordinate your actions with accompanying units.

games.name: Sinker Sound
games.summary: a Fishing game with Musical Rhythm gimmick! Explore a Strange Fantastical lake and find many strange fishes with its own unique original music!

games.name: Sled Riders
games.summary: Discover incredible winter sled races on exciting tracks against other racers!

games.name: Sore
games.summary: You're just here to observe, they'll fix their problems without you. They will grow and change, maybe more will join the rooms.

games.name: Suction Bot
games.summary: Suction Bot is unique, mouse only platformer that has you climbing from a sewer to space. As you climb, you'll encounter challenges, such as swinging pendulums, flying pigeons, wrecking balls and more.

games.name: The Box
games.summary:
We are a small, recently founded independent studio, Cibeles Games. This is our first video game: a horror experience based on Catholic theology.

The game offers an unusual approach to the genre, exploring the concept of the devil and the struggle against evil from a perspective consistent with Catholic doctrine. To ensure this approach, the project consulted with priests and also features the participation of a real priest who collaborated by explaining, in one part of the game, what the devil is from the standpoint of Catholic theology.

Step into a chilling first-person point-and-click adventure where the line between faith and madness blurs. As a man of the cloth visiting an old friend in distress, you must unravel the mystery behind her condition. Explore a heavy psychological atmosphere within the walls of a decaying home, where you’ll question every shadow in this homage to 90s cult horror classics. To save a soul, you must first survive the truth.

Through its narrative and gameplay mechanics, the title aims to offer a different kind of horror experience, using the interactive medium to address spiritual and theological questions from a playful perspective.

Not recommended for children under 12.

games.name: Uknon Jones: Portal
games.summary: In this platform and puzzle game, Elsa LOVELUST is equipped with a gate gun. You must destroy objects or teleport her through the portals to help her cross inaccessible places and reach the flag of the different levels of the game.

games.name: Aviarium
games.summary: Aviarium is a relaxing sky sanctuary simulation filled with cute birds. Manage your floating aviary with click and idle mechanics, collect resources, and enjoy a pleasant experience in a colorful and peaceful world above the clouds.

games.name: Cheated
games.summary:
Hack your friends to make them fall.
You are tiny. Reach the attic. It's easy.
2-8 players, or streamer mode.

games.name: Death is Sunhaired
games.summary: You’re living in a 19th century village where no-one understands you, suddenly all your fellow men start dying and you are sent on a one-way quest to the lord’s castle.

games.name: Dice of Fate 2
games.summary: Dice of Fate 2 - A sequel to the 3D logic puzzle. You find yourself locked in an ancient sanctuary once again, and this time you're determined to leave this place forever. Your key to salvation lies in the dice, which hold ancient magic.

games.name: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi
games.summary: A unique Reversi game set in the world of El Shaddai. Stones have HP that decreases when flipped, adding deep strategy to the classic board game. Unlock 40+ stories, characters, and special rules as you climb the ranks.

games.name: Emoji Wars
games.summary: Emoji Wars is an exciting game inspired by the classic naval battle, where bright and funny emojis are used instead of ships.

games.name: Giant’s Heart
games.summary: Giant`s Heart — roguelike dungeon crawler with gardening elements. Discover powerful artifacts, make critical path choices - time is your most precious currency. A Giant marches toward the castle... You have just 5 minutes to descend into the dungeons, find and destroy its heart!

games.name: Hotshots
games.summary: HOTSHOTS — is a dynamic, 2D adventure where the price of error is the complete loss of progress. There is no place for saving here: every run is an intense, separate battle. Your only reward for victory is taking valuable weapons with you to start the next, even more dangerous run...

games.name: Kenny vs. Spenny: The Handheld Game
games.summary: Since the beginning of time mankind has been forced to compete for survival. This spirit of competition has reached a pinnacle in the relationship of two best friends who battle against each other. Why? ... Glory for the winner, humiliation for the loser. This is KENNY v.s. SPENNY, The Handheld Game.

games.name: Keplerian Space Discovery
games.summary: Travel through the solar system in your own spaceship! The motion of each celestial body is accurately reproduced by the Kepler equation.

games.name: Mighty Morpho
games.summary:
Mighty Morpho is an isometric puzzle-platformer inspired by classic games such as Adventures of Lolo. Players control Morpho as they navigate compact puzzle stages filled with enemies, obstacles, and hidden solutions.

Each level challenges players to think strategically, solve environmental puzzles, and defeat enemies while exploring different paths through the stage. The goal is to break the evil QUBO's magic spell and free Flowery Flora and the Florans.

The game features bite-sized levels designed for short play sessions, blending puzzle solving, light action, and exploration.

games.name: Minesweeper Arena
games.summary: Find all the mines quicker than your friends in the classic puzzle game.

games.name: Move That Box!
games.summary: Move that Box is a retro, arcade, top-down style action-puzzle game based on logical thinking, but also requiring reflexes. Move, push, throw, melt and even blow up items to reach the goal.

games.name: Pickleball
games.summary: Experience cutting dinks, outrageous rallies and pickup games with AI Bots and friends. State-of-the-art configurable custom physics, makes VR Pickleball feel like the real thing. Use your real-life forehand, backhand, volleys and dinks - analyze shots in Instant Replay.

games.name: Rescue the Hostages: Cryptic Countdown
games.summary: Rescue the Hostages: Cryptic Countdown is a dark horror FMV game centered on a high-tension hostage crisis. The narrative centers around a bomber who has trapped several hostages in a deadly scenario. The player must solve a series of word scramble puzzles connected to a timed explosive device. Gameplay emphasizes psychological tension and problem-solving under pressure, as players attempt to decipher clues and prevent the bomb from detonating before time runs out.

games.name: Ririka von Lustveil
games.summary: Why study when you can rule? Play as Ririka, a bratty archmage on a quest for total campus domination. Corrupt the faculty, tame the student body, and turn the prestigious Aetherial Academy into your personal kingdom in this comedic villainess visual novel.

games.name: Scarred Steel
games.summary: A brutal medieval roguelite where every scar tells your story. Permanent injuries, hard choices, and bloody duels shape your path in a dying world.

games.name: Shard Legends: Clan Wars
games.summary: A hardcore sandbox MMORPG with an economy entirely controlled by players. No NPC merchants: every sword is forged by a real person, and the 18 Great Cities are ruled by real players. Build monopolies, raid caravans, and make your mark on the Empire’s history.

games.name: Shattered Frames
games.summary: A gallery of animal photography has been fractured into scattered shards. It is up to you to mend the broken edges and bring these stunning portraits back into focus.

games.name: SkyLeap
games.summary: SkyLeap is a non-stop VR parkour action game where your only goal is to climb higher and higher. Use jumps, a grappling hook, and telekinesis to flow through a vertical world built for speed and movement.

games.name: Space Kitten
games.summary: In Space Kitten, time is your greatest enemy. Take control of an adorable space feline and navigate the interconnected rooms of your spaceship with one simple, unforgiving rule: you have exactly 10 seconds to survive each challenge.

games.name: The Hero of Destiny Was Killed by the Final Boss
games.summary: How many NPCs equal 1 Hero? In the land of Alta, The Hero of Destiny was fated to defeat a terrible Dark Wizard... but the Hero of Destiny was killed by the final boss. What now? Next to the final dungeon, in a sleepy village, 50 NPCs decide to take matters into their own hands.

games.name: The Town of Nowhere: End Of The Line
games.summary: This is the first downloadable entry in the Town of Nowhere series. This game was made with the intention of being playable and enjoyable regardless of if you know the back story of the larger surrealist horror series. Largely inspired by CGA DOS adventure games TTON:EotL is in full first person 3D.

games.name: The Underdog
games.summary: A top-down soulslike action game. Play as a medieval mercenary, use 4 weapon types (sword & shield, two-handed sword, mace, spear) to tackle BOSS warrant levels, explore diverse scenes, strengthen through failure, and unlock surprises.

games.name: Troll Chess Sekai
games.summary: One day, you gain the power to cast a troll spell in a chess game. Eager to try it out, you head to the chess club—where rivals range from novice Mirai to the mysterious owner who surpasses human skill. The rules of chess are no longer safe. Will you seize victory, or be swallowed by chaos?

games.name: Vault of The Vanquished
games.summary:
Vault of the Vanquished is a rogue-like adventure where you have been sent to the afterlife, after you were killed by the kings orders. You have now been resurrected and now you can collect and unlock hundreds of cards, to vanquish as many enemies as possible and bring peace to your Kingdom.

This game is built on the idea of RNG, bringing you through countless items to collect, and enemies to Vanquish! Push to Vanquish enough enemies to fight the boss of each zone, cleansing them one by one, and bringing peace to the Kingdom.

games.name: Wizard Punks!!!
games.summary: WIZARD PUNKS!!! is a fast-paced, spell-slinging 4-player local party game. Create spells by combining the four elements of Air, Earth, Fire and Water, and defeat your fellow wizards with a variety of bombastic magics.

games.name: 100 Blacksmith Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all?

games.name: A Ragdoll Rage Game
games.summary: A Ragdoll Rage Game is a physics-based rage platformer where you grab, aim, and fling a ragdoll through challenging obstacles. The game also features secret badges, unlockable cosmetics, a built-in level editor, global leaderboards, and more.

games.name: Age of Barbarians Chronicles
games.summary: Chronicles is a crude and violent action RPG game in pure Sword & Sorcery style. Get ready to live the heroic and bloody adventures of barbarians, amazons, and sorcerers against the insane and omnipotent Sorcerer Gods, absolute masters of the prehistoric world of Atlan.

games.name: Age of Enchantment
games.summary: Tower defense deckbuilder where your towers are classes from D&D. Enchant towers with powerful buffs, sacrifice cards to forge new synergies, and select artifacts to customize your build.

games.name: Another Day As President
games.summary: You are the president. Stay awake, work, survive... Complete your term one day at a time whilst fending off disobedient staff. Juggle tasks, stay alert, and don't miss a shot.

games.name: Attack From Izar 2250
games.summary: Alien attackers from the Izar system are invading Earth! Battle the extraterrestrial menace in endless waves in this tribute to classic alien 'invader' shooters from the late '70s and early '80s. Aim for the high score by destroying the evil alien monsters!

games.name: Blunt Blade and a Hundred Halls
games.summary: Kill. Kill. Die. Repeat. Blunt Blade and a Hundred Halls is a game about slaying monsters in a dungeon to grind their meat as an offering to the devil who lives in your basement walls. A retro-styled, fast-paced, rogue-lite slash 'em up with lots of blood and gore.

games.name: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime
games.summary: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime is a frog-obsessed comedy adventure featuring tactical frog battles, bizarre quests, and the mother of all frogs: the motherfrogger.

games.name: Burning Snow
games.summary: BURNING SNOW is a short atmospheric experience about staying warm in a cold forest and eventually launching a firework. Seek matches and make fire while a mysterious cat companion guides you through the forest.

games.name: Capper
games.summary: Lower your expectations. Now lower them further. This is a game about flipping bottle caps. The goal is simple: pay off your bar tab by flipping bottle caps face up.

games.name: Catmorphosis
games.summary: A supernatural adult visual novel with weird romantic elements, a unique vibrant retro art style, and an abnormal storyline. You're Johann, and one night, you decided to order a cat from shady website. However, when the cat arrives a few days later, it's definitely NOT a normal cat.

games.name: Crazy Bike
games.summary: Race through the chaotic streets of New York in Crazy Bike, a modern reimagining of the arcade classic Crazy Courier. Deliver packages at breakneck speed, dodge traffic, pull off insane stunts, and master the art of urban biking in a fast-paced open city playground.

games.name: Creature Creation Station
games.summary: Create characters, watch them play together, and easily share your creations with friends!

games.name: Crucifier
games.summary: Crucifier is the worlds most Christian racing game ever developed! Play as a Roman soldier as he completes his day! Compete in 3 races to get on the top score boards! Farm your local fields for crops to obtain enough money to rest comfortably! Talk to lovely locals and battle a crazy time traveler!

games.name: DDOL
games.summary: Don't Destroy On Load" — Souls engraved on the board. DDOL is a strategy game of "Succession" and "Sealing." Channel souls to expand territory. If the flow is severed, the chains of Lock emerge. Outsmart "Breakthrough" cards. Lock the board, deprive options, and reach a rock-solid Checkmate.

games.name: Dead Z Meat
games.summary: Grab a gun and get blasting - these zombies are as vicious as they are silly. It's the apocalypse again! You may very well be the last person on Earth! Grab your gun and get blasting - these zombies are as vicious as they are silly. Survive day to day, upgrade your arsenal and supercharge your powerups to wreak havoc on the horde of dead meat shambling in your neighbourhood. KEY FEATURES - Action packed shooting gallery - Impressive, upgradeable arsenal, including sci-fi weapons, modern guns and explosives - Powerups included for your pleasure - Stylized, cartoony visuals - And an endless supply of zombies

games.name: Deadline Delivery
games.summary: Strap in, floor it, and deliver the goods... before the bomb goes off. Play as Carl, a monkey driving a wildly unstable mail truck that's rigged with explosives on a tight deadline.

games.name: Deadline Escape
games.summary: Deadline Escape is a Low Poly Extraction Looter Shooter that throws you into a Post-Apocalyptic World. Scavenge for valuable resources, face deadly enemies and fight for your survival as the clock ticks down toward the deadline.

games.name: Dependium
games.summary: A fast-paced 4-player cooperative puzzle game where your success helps your teammate, not yourself. Solve memory challenges, pattern recognition tasks, and coordination puzzles under time pressure—but the points you earn go to the player next to you. Trust your team or watch everyone fail.

games.name: Dice With Death
games.summary: Dice With Death is a Dicebuilding Roguelike – Unfortunately you have already died. Fortunately, Death is up for some friendly competition. Collect new dice and their paired relics, create damage stacking combos, and even cheat Death himself to emerge victorious.

games.name: Doomstacker
games.summary: A compact power-fantasy strategy experience wrapped in an auto-battler. Choose a castle, build it up, collect artifacts, and craft wild synergies between artifacts and (massive) armies.

games.name: Dragonkin: The Banished
games.summary: The draconic threat is once again upon us. Legendary heroes rise up to face the legions from the depths. Tame your wyrmlings, create unique power builds with the Ancestral Grid, expand your city and destroy the Dragons!

games.name: Dream of YukiHana
games.summary: A fan-made bullet hell shooting game featuring "Hololive 5th Generation" as the main characters, with "Yukihana Lamy" at the center of the story.

games.name: Duck and the Land of Flightless Birds
games.summary: Duck and the Land of Flightless Birds - A charming platforming adventure where you play as a fat duck that can't fly.

games.name: Dumpster Dive Live
games.summary: An interactive and cozy raccoon fueled trash digging game for your Twitch viewers. Viewers can dig through your garbage with commands, subs, gift subs, and bit donations. Ideal for keeping chat engaged during content that requires extra attention, or while on long breaks.

games.name: Evil Cat Simulator vs. Granny
games.summary: Sneak through every room, outsmart Granny, and unleash true feline mischief.

games.name: Find Matt's Cats
games.summary: A scavenger-hunt adventure that spans 80 hand-crafted levels, including beautiful holiday destinations and fantasy themes. Look in buildings, detonate bombs, unlock treasure chests, dig for secrets, and more! Every item is clickable as you search for Hidden Cats & Dogs!

games.name: Fly2k
games.summary: A Y2K, cyberspace, butterfly flight sim. Flap using 2 button controls, avoid malware obstacles, boost your speed and break free from the web!

games.name: Gnosia
games.summary:
Gnosia is a Sci-Fi Social Deduction RPG in which you will engage in discussion with a variety of unique characters, with the aim of identifying the Gnosia among the group. Players will have to use what information they can gather during the discussions to ascertain whom they think is Gnosia and then vote to put them into cold sleep. As you progress, your abilities will improve - but so will those of the crew.

As the numbers of crew members, Gnosia, and various “roles” increase, it will become increasingly difficult to determine who is telling the truth. Work in collaboration with or against other crew members to ensure your survival until the end.

games.name: Golemworks
games.summary: Assemble a factory, manufacture golems, and defend yourself from ruin.

games.name: Greenfield Valley
games.summary: Build your peaceful farm in a quiet mountain valley. Grow crops, care for animals, complete quests, level up, and upgrade your home. A cozy farming experience with dynamic weather, no timers, and no pressure. Just relax and enjoy farm life.

games.name: Grind Survivors
games.summary: Grind Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike where demon hunters face endless hellspawn. Dodge, loot, and blast through brutal bullet-hell combat with dynamic builds and ever-changing weapons in a scorched, demon-ridden world.

games.name: Hell Runner
games.summary:
Survive the ultimate endless runner challenge set in a Horror brutal underworld filled with deadly traps, swinging blades, fire pits, and dark magic.

Only the strongest survive.

games.name: House Tidy 2
games.summary: House Tidy 2 is a sequel to the meditative game that will help you relax and unwind from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

games.name: Idle Library
games.summary: Turn a small reading room into a legendary archive of knowledge in this relaxing idle incremental game featuring research upgrades, prestige progression, and offline growth

games.name: Idlemon
games.summary: Idlemon is an idle desktop monster tamer. Played on the side of your screen, your monster will gain experience and collect monster eggs. Upgrade your stats, purchase and collect cards, used to decorate your island.

games.name: Incandescent X
games.summary: Protect your ship against wave after wave of brightly coloured enemies in this fast paced arcade inspired shooter. Use your abilities to survive as long as you can!

games.name: Line of Taste: Pizza Crust
games.summary: Line of Taste – Pizza Crust is a pizzeria simulation where you run the restaurant on your own. Place conveyor belts to solve puzzles in your charming kitchen!

games.name: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking
games.summary: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking is a physics-based cooking game full of discovery and playful chaos. Experiment with everything in the kitchen and unlock around 300 recipes on your way to becoming a master chef!

games.name: Love in the Time of Spellphage
games.summary: A one-hour spellpunk narrative adventure about pandemic, wizards, and first love.

games.name: Maestro
games.summary: Make your way to the top of the mysterious Casino by shooting Cards, Gambling, Upgrading your cards and create your optimal build in this Fast Paced First Person Roguelite.

games.name: Mine Mine
games.summary: Mine Mine is an incremental game about mining ores, upgrading your equipment, and unlocking better and better quarries!

games.name: MingJiangSha
games.summary: "MingJiangSha" is a multiplayer identity deduction and strategy card game. Players can transform into legendary generals throughout history, play cards, deduce identities, coordinate skills, formulate strategies in ever-changing battlefields, and engage in a thrilling strategic showdown!

games.name: Motto Immortal
games.summary: In an age where myths dim and faith falters, you emerge as the prophesied Wayfarer destined to unite with legendary goddesses from myriad traditions. Together, you will purge the blight known as Shadow‑Blight and restore light to a world veiled in despair.

games.name: Movierooms: Cinema Management
games.summary: Become the manager of your own Cinema in this thrilling new Tycoon! Through space and time, explore the various aspects of handling a thriving business. Manage movie choices and screenings, staff, rooms, and more!

games.name: Murder at the Birch Tree Theater
games.summary: Use deductive and abductive reasoning to uncover the truth behind a series of several unsettling deaths at a smalltown community theater. Uncover a narrative that spans decades by revealing the lies, petty grievances, and power struggles of people who came together to make art.

games.name: Notebook Battlegrounds
games.summary: A multiplayer game where your voice is the weapon. Play as a random letter and use proximity voice chat to hear nearby players. Say the funny words on your screen to shoot opponents, find secret words for special powers, and battle in Timed Deathmatch or Battle Royale!

games.name: Orbital Overdrive
games.summary: Orbital Overdrive is a high-octane roguelite twin-stick arena shooter where you are pitted against hordes of relentless enemies on an orbit of a planet. Choose from hundreds of different abilities and weapons to create the deadliest build and smash the resistance!

games.name: Passion Bay
games.summary: Become the ruler of your own paradise where a tropical island is filled with irresistible girls. Experience a captivating idle clicker as you restore and develop your island, grow your business, earn resources, and unlock new areas while deepening relationships with the beauties around you.

games.name: Pit Pioneers
games.summary: A Lemmings-inspired puzzle game where you guide pioneers through treacherous underground caverns by strategically assigning abilities like digging, building, and blocking to overcome obstacles.

games.name: Propaganda vs. Zombies
games.summary: Build your deck of Propaganda, Bullets, and Spells to defend your Leader in this Bullet Heaven where you can't move! Use Propaganda to turn Zombies into your Comrades and make them fight for You! Make choices about your people but be careful, they might overthrow you if you choose wrong!

games.name: Qelochia
games.summary: On a secret arctic research base, a scientist, soldier, AI, and eldritch beast struggle for happiness. A short visual novel about love and pain set in an alternate history where humanity is ruled by eldritch gods.

games.name: Quantum Coffee Conundrum: Director's Cut
games.summary: Quantum Coffee Conundrum is a kinetic visual novel focused on immersive sound and atmosphere, set up like a stage play, offering a dark comedy and reverent pastiche to the Golden Age of Philosophical Science Fiction, in an attempt to blend the industrial cynicism of Harlan Ellison to the Absurdist conflict of Albert Camus and the reality-warping paranoia of Philip K. Dick.

games.name: Rain & Sacrifice
games.summary:
Build a functioning society of Aztec Jaguars by sacrificing people to the Gods in order to gain Favor and keep your people alive by summoning Rain and Thunder from the skies. Expand your domain while always being set back by the very forces that will assist you.

Protect your city from evil heretical Aligators, farm the land and provide an equivalent exchange of Death into Life before all falls apart once the Feathered Serpent arrives at the dawn of the 15th day.

games.name: Retro Otrop
games.summary: A struggling writer receives an unexpected call, and his destiny leads him to the small town of Otrop. Now, he must face mysteries that defy life and death in an adventure filled with supernatural fun.

games.name: Ritus Exorcismus
games.summary: Become the exorcist that the world needs! Use Holy Relics and the knowledge from your book to fight demonic possessions. Investigate unholy events and take part in church rituals in this medieval pixel horror game.

games.name: Royal Revolt Survivors
games.summary: Thrilling 1-4 players co-op survivor gameplay combined with stunning graphics, where powerful Warriors battle through hordes of vicious enemies using a blend of melee and ranged weapons.

games.name: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War!
games.summary: Lock and load into the Starship Troopers universe and join the Mobile Infantry in the most realistic depiction of war ever made ! Experience an original story in this action-packed, first-person retro shooter. Would you like to know more?

games.name: Stitched Together
games.summary: Stitched Together is an RPG adventure with a deep story, unique battle mechanics, world-defying stakes, and a whole extra dimension!

games.name: Super Ant Art Tycoon
games.summary: You're an art dealer with nothing but ants. They paint. You set the prices. Sometimes it sells, sometimes it doesn't. Grow your colony, design galleries, and become absurdly wealthy in this fully remastered 3D idle tycoon game where the artists are tiny and the ambition is enormous

games.name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin
games.summary: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin is an open-world action RPG set in the universe of The Seven Deadly Sins. Step into the role of Prince Tristan of Liones and explore an open-world Britannia, as you embark on a journey to restore order to a world thrown into chaos by the collision of time and space.

games.name: Thunder and Line-ing
games.summary: Move lightning through the air to form lines. When everything aligns a boom echoes blasting your score up to a higher strata!

games.name: Unseen Diplomacy 2
games.summary: You're a Secret Agent during a dangerous time, Evil-doers are plotting to destroy the world. Complete missions, manage your agents & use Intel to narrow down the plot & save the Earth. Play a real-life VR obstacle course using every inch of your room - you will run, roll, sneak & hack to victory!

games.name: Us Five Forever
games.summary:
Olivia Herrera's closest friend Kyle went missing at a frat house two years ago. A party at that frat house is her chance to investigate what happened to him, and get to the bottom of a strange connection she shares with her former group of friends.

Us Five Forever is the first episode of a narrative mystery game that follows a group of former friends who share a strange connection with each other. Find your missing friend while at a party in the frat mansion he disappeared in, and solve the mystery of your entanglement before the sun rises.

games.name: Vipunk: Shield of Valhalla
games.summary: Take the role of the Vipunk, also known as the shield of Valhalla. It is your job to destroy and fight back against the invading robots sent from the future. Vipunk is a bullet-hell survivor game with a focus on deflecting enemies' attacks. Adapt, evolve, and overcome to drive back the robots!

games.name: Wriggle Apple 3
games.summary: Help the worm navigate the scorching desert, avoid traps, and grow longer with each apple. Solve puzzles, climb obstacles, and overcome new dangers in this thrilling desert adventure!

games.name: YEKO
games.summary: Ever said, “Let me finish this hand, then I can die”? We did and took our gaming addiction to the afterlife. Yeko tells the absurd tale of skeletons who couldn't get enough of Okey in life and now set up the table beyond the grave low on calcium, but never on competitive spirit.

games.name: Yes, My Warlord
games.summary: Rule as a hobgoblin warlord in this kingdom management RPG. Balance resources and manage the shifting opinions of commoners, goblinoids, and elites. Face difficult decisions, and choose whether to rule with fairness… or with brutality.

games.name: A Stupid Game About Pouring Drinks for the P.T.A.
games.summary: The P.T.A. (Parent Teacher's Association) is planning the Summer Fete but they need money to hire everything. Selflessly serve drinks and upsell the heck out of them to gain funds. Dig deep! It's for a good cause, after all.

games.name: After the Stream Went Dark
games.summary: Step into the world of Nyx, a VTuber whose online persona begins to blur with something far more unsettling. After the Stream Went Dark is a short psychological horror visual novel exploring identity, self-perception, and the fragile boundary between performance and reality.

games.name: Amphibarium
games.summary: Relax and collect hundreds of unique frogs and salamanders in this cozy idle game. Watch tadpoles undergo metamorphosis in real-time, customize lush terrariums, and discover rare species. Let your vivarium thrive in the background while you work or study. Start your collection today!

games.name: Bearly Flying
games.summary: A difficult game about flying a bear-powered helicopter. Ascend through the floors of a deadly factory. Solo or local co-op. Watch out for emotional turbulence. Careful with those propellers.

games.name: Beautiful Sakura: Volleyball Club 2
games.summary: After walking away from volleyball, Kaito returns to the court with a burning desire to chase his dream once more. This time, he is serious about becoming a professional player.

games.name: BoobyRogue: Tumor Takedown
games.summary: BoobyRogue: Tumor Takedown is a fast-paced 2D roguelike where you choose your hero and fight through waves of enemies in a symbolic battle against breast cancer. Collect weapons and items, create unique builds, and survive until the final Tumor.

games.name: Coinfields
games.summary: A vibrant retro platformer set in autumn-tinted fields where you sprint across earthy platforms while scooping up gleaming coins; five brisk handcrafted levels all wrapped in punchy pixel art and crisp controls. A game developed by CraePlay and ported by GGmuks.

games.name: College Basketball Manager
games.summary: Take charge as head coach in College Basketball Manager. Recruit your dream team, whether that be through All-Americans or hidden gems. Strategize gameplay, schedule games, run practices, and manage your staff, because you are in control. The court is your canvas – create a powerhouse.

games.name: Color Splash: Fruits
games.summary: Color Splash: Fruits is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable fruits and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful birds paintings.

games.name: Comet Tycoon
games.summary: Build and automate your way to cosmic riches in this satirical tycoon sim. Harvest comets, entertain space tourists, recycle the broke ones, and let COMTEC help you replace humanity… one drone at a time.

games.name: Cozy Cats Fit
games.summary: A fun cat puzzle game, with music and adorable cats keeping you company.

games.name: Crack Mountain
games.summary: You can wish for anything, all you need to do is climb this mountain... By throwing a ball that teleports you... Maybe try climbing too, I don't know I'm not the expert here.

games.name: Crimson Night
games.summary: Crimson Night is a challenging turn-based combat game that blends unforgiving battles with world exploration and character progression/building. You'll learn through trial and error, die often, adapt your tactics, and keep pushing forward!

games.name: Cypher Dungeon
games.summary: Identifier = ZERO. Localization = unknown system. Objectives = survive, decrypt, escape. Codes are key. Death is protocol. The sequence begins now.

games.name: Deadzone: Rogue
games.summary: Deadzone: Rogue is a roguelite first-person shooter set in deep space. Slay hordes of enemies, loot powerful gear, and customize your loadout during each unique run. Uncover fragments of your past as you piece together the truth behind your mission. Fight. Die. Revive. Repeat.

games.name: Deck of Treads
games.summary: Deck of Treads is a chaotic 2–6 player tank brawler with a deckbuilding twist. Stack upgrades that transform how your tank looks — and how it fights. Each match spirals into unpredictable mayhem, packed with ridiculous, over-the-top tank builds!

games.name: Dread Delusion
games.summary: Dread Delusion is an open world RPG brimming with strange places and dark perils. Carve your own path through the flying continents of a shattered land. Discover curious towns, unearth occult secrets, master powerful magic - and change the world through your choices.

games.name: Dungeon Crawl Tower Run
games.summary: Single player 3D action roguelike extraction game. Create unique builds out of various combinations of skills and equipments to reach the 6th floor of the Tower!

games.name: Eggconsole Zanac EX MSX2
games.summary: The Zanac battle, which was supposed to have ended, was not over. To suppress the reactivated organic intelligence, Zanac takes flight once again!

games.name: Elemental: Reforged
games.summary: Create a character and lead your civilization in this epic, turn-based fantasy strategy game. Design units, research technology, learn magical spells, send adventurers on quests, craft magical items, trade or battle other civilizations for dominion of worlds of your imagination.

games.name: Emotionless: The Last Ticket
games.summary: Liminal cosmic horror - you'll wander in an abandoned amusement park, walk along empty tunnels and crawl through narrow corridors. Join a ride and step into the dark. Explore eerie remains of a world that shouldn't exist. Find clues and discover the truth, but beware, some things should stay buried.

games.name: Everwind
games.summary: Everwind is a novel take on RPG and Sandbox Survival genre in First-Person-Perspective. Embark on the adventure with your friends - Build a base on a flying island-ship, gather resources, craft, loot, and fight while you rise above the clouds to uncover the mysteries of this world!

games.name: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
games.summary: Fallen Tear: The Ascension is an epic adventure set in a vast magical world where you’ll fight dangerous beasts, defy corrupt gods, and face many challenges, all in an attempt to bring balance back to your world.​Embark on this journey with Hira, a mysterious young boy who seeks the truth about his forgotten past. Along the way, bond with many fully-voiced characters to unlock new skills and abilities that will aid you in your battle through environments that constantly change and react to your choices - all in classic, hand-drawn animation.

games.name: Feed
games.summary: "Feed" is a bite-sized retro point-and-click puzzle game. It features multiple puzzles and a touch of cult horror.

games.name: Flying Aces: Legend of the Red Baron
games.summary: FLYING ACES: LEGEND OF THE RED BARON lets you take to the skies and experience joining the newly formed air forces during World War I.

games.name: Gallipoli Trenches: The Forgotten Front WW1
games.summary: Amidst the chaos of Gallipoli, a battle-hardened officer vows to protect a lost child. Navigate trenches, solve environmental puzzles, and witness the human cost of war. In this atmospheric 2D platformer, survival isn't just about staying alive—it's about keeping your humanity.

games.name: Gamepull.io
games.summary:
GamePull is a browser-based pack-opening and collection game where each card represents a real video game.
Players open packs to collect titles of varying rarity based on popularity, complete franchise sets, and trade cards through a server-synced marketplace.

The game features a central currency used to acquire packs, trade with other players, and buy listed cards.

Rare shard drops can appear from high-demand games, with each title split into four collectible parts. Collecting all four shards allows a player to craft a unique Relic, with only one Relic ever existing per game.

games.name: GearDude
games.summary: GearDude is an ordinary plumber, working day in and day out just to make ends meet. When he gets a routine call to fix a pipe deep in the city sewers, it sounds like just another dirty job.

games.name: Going Medieval
games.summary: Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse.

games.name: GravBot
games.summary: GravBot is a physics-based puzzle platformer, where you decide which way is "up" as a little robot falls and pivots through each level. Collect all the batteries to win, but watch out. A wrong move could be deadly!

games.name: Hearthstone: Cataclysm
games.summary: Cataclysm is Hearthstone's 32nd expansion, featuring 135 new collectible cards released on March 17, 2026. This expansion continues the story of Across the Timeways, where Murozond refused to accept the defeat from Chromie, smashing the Hourglass of Time and opening a portal to a nightmare timeline where Deathwing never fell.

games.name: Heroes of Science and Fiction
games.summary: A turn-based sci-fi strategy that combines exploration and exciting clashes on the battlefield. Take control over several different species, raise powerful armies for your heroes and destroy your opponents! This HoMM-like is set in a scifi universe, with new mechanics on top of the classic formula.

games.name: I Shouldn’t Have Drawn That!
games.summary: Decks are dungeons. Each turn reveals four cards and you must face three: fight monsters, swap weapons, or manage your health in this single player rougelike dungeon crawler. Build custom dungeons and share runs with your friends using the same shuffled decks, so everyone faces the same challenges!

games.name: In Tow
games.summary:
In Tow is a fast-paced one-button game.

You score points by collecting chickens. The more chickens you have, the more points you get. To collect chickens, you run forward and jump between platforms. Hold a button to jump higher, press a button while mid-air to jump multiple times. The number of times you can jump depends on the number of chickens you have and you lose one chicken with each additional jump. You lose all your chickens when you hit a bullet.

The game is over when you fall or hit a bullet when you don't have any chicken.

games.name: Jaxx Blorgin's UFO Jam
games.summary: Legendary space-baller Jaxx Blorgin is comin' at you with the only UFO sports title licensed to use his name! Master physics and your UFO to shoot, dunk and defend in this arcade basketball game.

games.name: Jimmy Jumps
games.summary: Jimmy Jumps is a throwback platformer that combines the simplicity of classic platformers with the mechanical depth of speedrunning. Compete for high scores in over 90 hand-crafted levels!

games.name: Jiǔměizǐ zhī Sǐ: Zhāohé Shàonǚ Xuèsè Gàobái
games.summary: In 1988, on the eve of the bursting of Japan's bubble economy, he transformed himself into a detective who was wrongly accused of a crime. He investigated the strange suicide case of Qingmei, which led to the secret of a 20-year-long serial murder case. He shuttled through the streets of Showa, which were filled with cigarettes, alcohol and neon lights. Amidst the choices between human hearts and life and death, he searched for clues and found the truth of the bloody case.

games.name: KeyBreach
games.summary: Your keyboard is your weapon. In this high-speed typing roguelike, speed isn't enough. Stack items to break the game economy, exploit glitches for profit, and battle unique bosses. Reach Root Access before the timer hits zero. Try not to break your spacebar in panic.

games.name: Kimi to Koishite, Soshite Sotsugyou Suru
Linsips
games.summary: Divide chaos into order! In Linsips, place two lines to split bouncing balls into four quadrants with the exact same number of balls in each. 20 levels of pure arcade precision with authentic OPL3 FM synth music, MS-DOS aesthetics, all under 600 KB on SteamOS.

games.name: Maid of Sker VR
games.summary: Maid of Sker VR is a first-person survival horror, set in a remote hotel with a gory and macabre history from Welsh folklore. Brave the nightmares of the Quiet Ones. Do not panic…don’t even breathe!

games.name: Medieval Life Simulator
games.summary: Rise from nothing to wealth! Mine ore, harvest crops, cut trees, gather livestock products, sell resources, hire workers, buy rentable houses, gamble with card games, bet on fights, and expand into an empire.

games.name: Midnight Scenes: Among Graves
games.summary: When the graves stop whispering in your ear, it’s time for you to surrender to eternal silence. So says the Agreement, and so it must be fulfilled. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

games.name: Monster Tavern
games.summary: A Roguelite Deckbuilder where drinks are your weapons and monsters are your guests. Serve smart, upgrade your drinks and hold the bar together for another night.

games.name: Never Forget
games.summary: You're trapped in a repeating basement corridor. Watch closely: objects shift, signs change, and something is always slightly wrong. Detect anomalies, choose wisely, and survive the darkness miss a detail and the loop pulls you back.

games.name: Opus Magnum: De Re Metallica
games.summary: An independent story set before the events of Opus Magnum, De Re Metallica follows a maverick alchemical researcher named Saverio Daas, who believes he can unlock heretofore unknown metallurgical secrets. Includes new puzzles, glyphs, story, music, and even a new Sigmar's Garden variant!

games.name: Out of Range
games.summary: Play as a dissident robot who tries to flee a spaceship as other robots thinks you're a menace. Gather new weapons and power-ups to travel through enemy-filled arenas in this 15 minutes action-packed twin-stick shooter adventure

games.name: Pawafuru Puroyakyu: Eikan Nine Crossroad
games.summary:
Eikan Nine is a mode in which you become a high school baseball coach, train your team, and lead them to the Koshien Japan National High School Baseball Tournament.

Powerful Pro Baseball Eikan Nine Crossroad retains the traditional Eikan Nine setup, but adds new elements for even deeper team building, including “Scholarship Students,” “Growth Board,” and “Rival Schools.”

games.name: Petal by Petal
games.summary: Petal by Petal is a relaxing incremental gardening game where mindful movements are rewarded. Water seeds, grow flowers, sell your harvest, and unlock permanent upgrades across a sprawling skill tree.

games.name: Pirate Ghost Ship
games.summary: "Step into the boots of Jack, trapped on a cursed pirate galleon. Solve dark mysteries, hide from the undead, and survive the wrath of a ghostly captain. Every decision you make determines if you'll find the treasure or become part of the ship's crew forever."

games.name: Planetary Inc.
games.summary: A short incremental game about building a career by destroying planets, meeting corporate goals, and investing in profitable — and maybe not so ethical — ventures.

games.name: Pretend Cars Racing 2
games.summary: An old school top-down racer with split-screen multiplayer, track editor and night and day transitions.

games.name: Primarch
games.summary: Primarch is a roguelike auto-battler centered on a single hero. After being exiled to a foreign planet, you are challenged by a fallen God and pitted against your comrades to determine who is most worthy of the title ‘Primarch’.

games.name: Project Castaway
games.summary: Project Castaway is a survival crafting title set in the Pacific Ocean. Live the life of a stranded castaway, with only yourself - and the island's inhabitants - for company! Sail the ocean, hunt, explore unique islands and gather resources as you fight for survival.

games.name: Rags to Riches
games.summary: Rags to Riches is a financial market simulation where you build wealth through investments, business tactics, and ruthless decision-making. Start from humble beginnings and climb the Wall Street ladder by hiring employees, making risky trades, and accumulating luxury assets. Choose from historically accurate eras like the Great Market Crash of 1929 or the 1980s, each with unique scenarios. Decide whether to use lawyers and spies against competitors, engage in insider trading, or enjoy your success. Watch your office grow as your client base expands across three difficulty levels.

games.name: Retro Rewind: Video Store Simulator
games.summary: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

games.name: Rikua
games.summary: Rikua is a 2.5D action platformer ninja cyberpunk game surrounded in beautiful, realistic and futuristic 3D aesthetics, and introduces a unique hack-and-slash/third-person-shooting mechanics that will keep you constantly on the edge!

games.name: Saccharine Echo
games.summary: Saccharine Echo is a story that walks the line between psychological drama and dark paranormal romance. Your choices will shape the fate of a young woman haunted by an obsessive entity from another world.

games.name: Sculplings
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Sculplings! Here, trainers collect and battle a random assortment of hand-sculpted monsters in order to become the #1 Sculpling Champion! Sculplings is a mashup of roguelikes with traditional monster fighter games!

games.name: Shapes of Memory: Jigsaw Puzzle
games.summary: Shapes of Memory brings the tranquility of Suitcase Stories to the traditional jigsaw puzzle format. Choose an illustration from the original game and lose yourself in the calm flow of putting pieces together. A Zen experience to organize your mind and complete beautiful images without rushing.

games.name: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online
games.summary: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online is a clicker game where progression is replaced with gambling, where the goal is simply to collect the rarest silly linguine cats.

games.name: Skeleseller
games.summary: Skeleseller is a laid-back idle game set in a vibrant fantasy world. You're a skeleton shopkeep who hires adventurers to collect loot for you after your untimely demise. Send adventurers into battle, sell what they find, and build up your town!

games.name: Sludgineers
games.summary: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, and unlock new areas and perks.

games.name: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club
games.summary: Join Snoopy and the gang in an all-new mystery adventure packed with charm, clever puzzles, and heartwarming friendships! Step into Snoopy’s paws and detective hat as you explore the town, solve challenging cases, and uncover hidden secrets—with help from the lovable Peanuts gang.

games.name: Sphere Shootout
games.summary: "Blue Warrior 4" is a 2D cover tactical shooting game. The key to win in the game is not the shooting technique but the tactical walking.

games.name: Sub Optimal Co.
games.summary: It's simple. Maneuver your submarine to collect the target and return back to base while not scratching the cave-walls. Invite your friends to take control. Navigate carefully and consider every move while exploring unique cave systems in this slow pace, athmospheric, multiplayer diving experience.

games.name: Tales of Klodan
games.summary: Prince Fescillia's mission in Klodan was meant to bring peace, but the cold hides something far more sinister. Alongside his friend Leonar, he becomes entangled in shadows of the past and meet a mysterious warrior in a beastly mask. Five paths, one fateful choice… Will the prince find the right one?

games.name: Tekken: Dark Resurrection
games.summary: A port of Tekken: Dark Resurrection, originally released on the PSP (PlayStation Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: The Abyssal Maze
games.summary: Trapped in a nightmarish labyrinth, you have only two goals, find the ancient book and escape. But the walls are alive with echoes, and the monsters that stalk the corridors never sleep.

games.name: The Artisan of Glimmith
games.summary: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

games.name: The Cube, Save Us
games.summary: A post-apocalyptic extraction action game built around brutal, close-quarters combat. Step through the Cube Gate and discover ever-shifting worlds filled with strange landscapes and terrifying enemies. Escape the Cube by fighting your way through twisted mutants and Raiders you once called allies.

games.name: The Demon's Apple: Otome Game
games.summary: The Demon's Apple is a Dark Fantasy otome game with mature content. Pomme, a herbalist as to make an alliance with a bloodthirsty demon she saved to survive in a world hostile to both. Play as Pomme who has to learn to live under the same roof as the demon who wants her blood and more.

games.name: The Ratline
games.summary: A murdered priest. A secret list. Hunt Nazi fugitives across the globe in this gritty 1971 detective thriller. Analyze evidence, follow leads, and make sharp deductions before the trail goes cold. From the creators of Family, Rivals, Conspiracy, Echo Beach and Riley & Rochelle.

games.name: Thelos
games.summary: Your main ability is to place two crystals on a viable surface and pull towards them. You can use dashing, jumping, running, and perform a special jump which is available after collecting rewards. Your opposition will be two types of sentries, dragons, mines, and traps who all want to keep you down.

games.name: Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor
games.summary: Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor! Hop into the cabs of North Western Railway’s classic steam team to enjoy nostalgic stories and all-new narratives right from the drivers’ seats. Explore the Wonders of Sodor – fun and magic await!

games.name: Till and Hat
games.summary:
Till & Hat is an upcoming fast-paced 2D action game for the SNES.

Take control of Till, a whip-wielding thief in pursuit of treasure, and Hat, a mysterious sentient artifact she recovers from the Imperial vault who lends her his powers.

Use your whip and newly-found shooting abilities to their fullest to fend off the incoming legions of imperial soldiers and machines sent to hunt you down.

Along the way, you will come across a wide variety of environments and unique gameplay segments which aim to show off the various strengths of the hardware.

The game has been fully made in assembly targeting actual SNES hardware, and should work on any compatible system, clone or emulator.

games.name: Timber Rush
games.summary: Timber Rush is a fast-paced incremental roguelite where every swing explodes into upgrades, chaos, and massive numbers.

games.name: Trinket Bag Maker
games.summary: Trinket Bag Maker is a retro sandbox game inspired by the 2000's girl games, where you can create your own trinket bag! Choose between many adorable charms and bags to create the trinket bag of your dreams!

games.name: Twisted Fate
games.summary: A turn-based roguelike with a deep ability-modification system. Lead a party of three heroes, adapt their skills using modifiers, collect artifacts, and craft unique builds to destroy the source of corruption… or die trying.

games.name: Valkyrie Destruction
games.summary: Explore a classic JRPG world together with a cute battle maiden! Upon being rescued from a monster by a passing battle maiden, the protagonist Batz begins journeying together with her. But taking advantage of her weakness, the scoundrel Batz has other plans for his beautiful savior.

games.name: Victorian Debutante
games.summary: Simple visual novel in which you play as a young upperclass woman preparing for her debut before the Queen and her royal relatives. All of your decisions lead to one of four very different endings. Who will you become? The jewel of the season or the outcast, never again mentioned by your family?

games.name: Whispers of the Eyeless
games.summary: Guide your Cult. Oversee your Sanctum. Stay in the Shadows. Serve the Dead Gods.

games.name: Wild Wizard War
games.summary: You are an all powerful Wizard. Craft spells from elemental cards. Battle against friends and other Wizards in this turn based party game. Learn deep elemental synergies or lean into wild magic for over the top destruction. Fast paced duels and the luck of the draw ensure no two battles are alike.

games.name: A Game About Achieving Stuff
games.summary: Cut out the annoying "gameplay" and get straight to what matters: making numbers go up. Walk down identical corridors, hoard useless loot, and perform 200 highly specific, stupid tasks just to make a little notification pop up on your screen. Pure achievement satisfaction.

games.name: Abandoned Stories: Inherited Silence
games.summary: Adopted into a new family, Maria soon realizes she was never meant to feel safe there. Trapped inside a quiet home with something watching you, Maria must uncover the truth behind a growing nightmare.

games.name: AI.VI
games.summary: A mercenary robot is forced out of retirement as the P.A.S.C.A.L. Gigacorporation conquers his planet to squeeze it dry. Combine your FPS and tower defense skills, then send the corporate invaders to the scrapheap, seize the means of production, and take the planet back for the worker bots!

games.name: ArvusForge
games.summary: Craft your own weapons and carve your path in this fast-paced 3D roguelike action game. Defeat enemies, collect materials, and build powerful gear as you progress through a node-based world. Every run is a new challenge with randomized skills and endless crafting possibilities.

games.name: Awakeroots
games.summary: Awakeroots is a passion project—crafted by two brothers who combine creativity with a deep love for Slavic culture and storytelling. It’s not just a game—it’s a journey into a world that could have been… and now awakens again.

games.name: Back to the Village
games.summary:
Back to the Village — build your dream farm and enjoy a peaceful life in this cozy indie game!
Have you ever dreamed of escaping the noisy and polluted metropolis? The hero of Back to the Village takes this step and starts a new life among fields, gardens, and cozy buildings.
Create a farm from scratch that you can truly be proud of: grow crops, care for animals, develop production, and step by step turn a small household into a thriving business. And who knows — maybe this story will inspire your own farm

games.name: Big Theft Valkeala 3: Revenge
games.summary: Terentius Duval is dead and his Wife Mary Duval is coming to Valkeala to rob money and finish missions in this third part of third person open world action game

games.name: BK Simulator
games.summary: A simple Idle game, designed specifically for use with the Archipelago Randomizer program. Walk to 'BK' to get lunch, and find random items; either for yourself (ex. to help you walk faster), or for others in your randomizer room (to help them with whatever game they are playing).

games.name: Cloudwalkers
games.summary: Cloudwalkers is a hilarious third-person shooter-platformer where you defend the cloud world from quirky alien invaders.

games.name: Crawling Angels
games.summary: Smash and thrash the mysterious Forever Chicken, a living ragdoll central to a frightful midnight carnival. Your Uncle Tontine assures "you can leave as soon as you desire" but despite their efforts no child has ever gone home... Will you be the first?

games.name: Curse of the Mirror
games.summary: Curse of the Mirror is a 2D platformer that features a unique set of mechanics and ideas in each and every level inspired by similar games in its genre, a simple moveset that's easy to learn but difficult to master, and a rich story with fun and quirky characters!

games.name: Defender of the Kingdom
games.summary: "Indie wave-based defense game with exploration and resource management. Protect the castle, face hordes, and complete missions as the weather and day/night cycle change with each challenge."

games.name: Defending Camelot
games.summary: Defending Camelot is a tower defense video game, similar to Plants vs. Zombies, developed for PCs and consoles. The game involves Arthur who use a variety of different warriors to prevent an army of monsters from entering Camelot.

games.name: DigDigDrill
games.summary: DigDigDrill is an underground mining and resource collecting game. Dig freely for minerals and treasures. Use the items you collect to forge your original drills in a hack-and-slash style equipment system.

games.name: Everything Will Be Fine!
games.summary: A dark conversation with a girl during a nightly car trip. A short multi-ending novel game where you try to understand this girl and her pain.

games.name: Fireside Fables
games.summary:
Fireside Fables is a narrative driven 3D platformer, which follows a group of children telling stories around a campfire. These stories then come to life, and you play through them as your favourite plushie!

You will be transported across worlds! From a pirate island, to a lush forest, even to outer space - Anywhere that the children's imaginations can take you!

games.name: Flourish
games.summary: Find your rhythm in the cycle of the garden: prune to gather, water to renew, and trade your clippings for deep-rooted progression.

games.name: Foodslingers
games.summary: Cook, run, jump, and throw— all in the name of FoodCorp. This chaotic, physics-based spin on the classic cooking formula demands speed, strategy, and just the right amount of panic! Play with up to 4 friends and try to run the restaurant smoothly... or let it all go up in flames.

games.name: Foolish Earthlings!
games.summary: A side scrolling side-on shooter from the depths of a long-lost arcade cabinet where you take the role of a UFO on the hunt for human prey! Capture them alive with your tractor beam and pull them into your saucer while unleashing your heat ray upon tanks, planes, and all manner of military might!

games.name: Goritaire
games.summary:
Goritaire is a solo card-based survival game centered on building a troop of seven or more gorillas. The deck consists only of Gorillas and Bananas, demanding strategic balance.

Bananas are essential for survival; if the supply fails, the troop scatters, resulting in defeat.

Strategically master diverse actions unique to each stage, expand the troop, and secure the necessary resources to reign as the master of the jungle!

games.name: Gun Store Simulator
games.summary: Take control of a gun store in Gun Store Simulator and manage every aspect of the arms trading business. Buy licenses, select products, hire staff, and ensure safety to grow your store and build a successful chain. Can you dominate the market?

games.name: Gunja Tteokbokki
games.summary: Orders pouring in, broth bubbling over, and the daily pressure of balancing the books! Manage your ingredients, cook tteokbokki to perfection, and run your very own shop in this culinary tycoon simulation game.

games.name: HeadHunters
games.summary: HeadHunters is a chaotic couch/online party game where you don’t pick a character… you are the head. Attach to different bodies to gain new weapons and abilities, and adapt on the fly. Improvise. Adapt. Overcome. Up to 4 players. Fully cross-platform. Don’t lose your head.

games.name: HSNU Academy 79th Anniversary
games.summary: "HSNU Academy 79th Anniversary" is a dark, narrative puzzle game set at HSNU. Explore the campus via chat to uncover secrets and reach multiple endings. This 1-hour experience unlocks Free Mode upon completion. Stay tuned for new games in future celebrations!

games.name: Idle Hacking: An Inaction RPG
games.summary: A persistent idle MMORPG, with a text-based hacking theme. Enjoy the "Inaction RPG" design philosophy by crafting equpiment using ARPG influenced prefix/suffix systems, build or join player managed syndicates, trade on the marketplace, and compete in community events.

games.name: Immortal Clan: Grandmastery
games.summary: Immortal Clan: Grandmastery is an Eastern fantasy xianxia sim-management game. As founding master, build a sect from scratch. Recruit disciples with unique quirks and personalities. Assign daily tasks, guide cultivation, and lead them from mortal to ascension.

games.name: In Their Shoes
games.summary: From the first day of spring, to the last day of winter, wear seven shoes of seven characters and live their most intimate moments. Explore their thoughts, choose their steps and shape their paths in a mumblecore narrative game where the most extraordinary setting is ordinary life itself.

games.name: Jump into the New Year
games.summary: Jump into the New Year! But if you don't keep jumping for three seconds straight, you'll get swallowed up by another world!?

games.name: Last War 2044
games.summary: Last War 2044 will allow you to feel the atmosphere of the world that survived a nuclear war. And with the remnants of mankind, you must be saved from mutated creatures by the help of improvised means of protection.

games.name: Let's Freeze Some Penguins
games.summary: Walnut the Walrus sets out to save his friends, and all of Northern Bear, from the dreaded Emperor Penguin. Luckily, his chilly Walrus Wind is ice cold. Now let's freeze some penguins!

games.name: Letters to Arralla
games.summary: Deliver letters, parcels, and packages to the residents of Arralla, a small fictional island off the coast of Australia populated by big booty cutie fruits! In this relaxing RPG, you play as a mail delivery turnip covering the holiday of the previous mailman. It’s your job to get the mail where it needs to go by solving visual puzzles and exploring.

games.name: M.B.E 3: Horror Escape
games.summary: A first‑person psychological horror, focused on atmosphere, sound, and constant tension rather than cheap scares.

games.name: Manor Dynasty Strategy
games.summary: Begin your journey in the Early Stone Age, when your ancestors lived in simple huts and survived through hunting and gathering. In Manor Dynasty Strategy, every resource you collect and every decision you make lays the foundation for generations to come.

games.name: Mimikaki Collect
