games.summary: A minimalistic city builder where you can rack up tons of points for your island by strategically placing buildings on blocks around each other.

games.name: Balls
games.summary: A chain-reaction deck-building game in which you build the perfect combo machine to achieve the highest-scoring explosion chains.

games.name: Banana Chaos Clicker
games.summary: Banana Chaos Clicker — An epic idle sim with resource management, crafting, and creature evolution. Build your empire from monkey to dragon!

games.name: Belle Citique
games.summary: Belle Citique is a cozy city builder and design game. Use the joyfully simple building system to make riverside hamlets, alpine castles, bustling cities, and everything in between. No major objectives or obstacles, just sit back and create something beautiful.

games.name: Bend2
games.summary: BATIM's second chapter, de-made in bitsy3D.

games.name: Bone Fire Effigy
games.summary: The horror of relationships passed. Collect old discarded things from the woods and burn them. Avoid the Effigy's fiery embrace.

games.name: Can I Go Home Yet?
games.summary: Ever sat in class watching the clock, wondering if it's time to leave? Can I Go Home Yet? answers that question — then lets you kill time with a built-in arcade. Check your countdown, then dive into Pong, Snake, Flappy Clock, Brick Breaker, Whack-a-Clock, and an Idle Clicker while you wait. Features live countdowns based on NSW school schedules, public holidays, and seasonal themes.

games.name: Card Coder
games.summary: Card Coder is a card-building roguelike: A novel mix of tactical card battles, inventory management and roguelike deckbuilding, where YOU create custom cards during play. Loot, shop & collect modular ability components to make truly unique cards out of 10 billion possibilities.

games.name: Colorium
games.summary: Master the Spectrum: A Minimalist Challenge of Pure Color and Memory

games.name: Dead Patrol
games.summary:
Prepare for the collapse of civilization in Dead Patrol, an intense and visceral action shooter where every shot counts. In a city consumed by chaos, you take on the role of an elite patrol officer sent into the most dangerous zones to face relentless hordes of the undead and reclaim overrun sectors.
With fast-paced, tactical combat, extremely responsive controls, and a powerful arsenal, Dead Patrol delivers a brutal and straightforward survival experience. Strategic movement, fluid weapon switching, and smart use of the environment are essential to stay alive amid the urban chaos.

games.name: Depleted
games.summary: DEPLETED is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where sacrifices must escape a ritualist who hunts them down for blood in order to complete the ritual. Use stealth, teamwork, and strategy to survive.

games.name: Dragon Snack: From Ice to Ember
games.summary: Get ready for an adorably epic adventure in Dragon Snack: From Ice to Ember. Here, a hungry and lovable dragon needs your help to find the safe path back to its nest. It sounds simple, but every trail matters.

games.name: Echo Tower
games.summary:
Climb a tower plunged into darkness using the power of echo location.

Echo Tower is an audio action adventure game where your ears replace your eyes. Navigate through the floors, solve puzzles and reach the top to bring back the light to the planet.

games.name: Echoes of Isovios: A Legacy Undone
games.summary: You are Orion, a tyrant who drove humanity to extinction using the mythical life-stealing sword, Isovios. Travel through history, gaining ghostly allies along the way, and undo your legacy in this story-rich, action-packed roguelite.

games.name: Eco City Planner
games.summary: Eco City Planner is a card-based city-building and strategy game focusing on sustainability, urban planning, and resource management.

games.name: Evocreo II
games.summary:
Join millions of players in this pocket monster game sequel
Embark on an epic adventure in EvoCreo 2, the ultimate monster-catching RPG set in the captivating world of Shoru. Immerse yourself in a land teeming with mythical creatures called Creo. For thousands of years, these collectible monsters have roamed the lands, their origins and evolution shrouded in mystery. Do you have what it takes to unravel the secrets of the Creo and become a legendary Evoking Master Trainer?

games.name: Fortune Seller
games.summary: A gothic roguelike shopkeeping game where you sell antiques, read the tarot, and manage your inventory to survive crushing rent increases. Match strange customers with the relics they crave, unlock powerful cards, and gamble your way out of debt, one deal at a time.

games.name: Glenwich Idle MMO
games.summary: Welcome to the land of Glenwich, where adventurers gather resources, forge weapons, and battle through dungeons while AFK. Train 14 skills, discover hundreds of recipes, and trade on the player-driven exchange. Form parties with up to 5 players to conquer brutal dungeons and claim legendary loot.

games.name: Hearth Bound
games.summary: Multiplayer Cozy Home Building - Build and decorate a cozy fantasy home together. Place furniture, discover new decor, and expand your shared hearth as you design rooms side-by-side with friends in a relaxing co-op building experience.

games.name: Hidden Around the World
games.summary: Travel the world in this cozy hidden-object adventure with decoration and discover the charm of cities like Tokyo, Paris, New York, and many more!

games.name: Hushed
games.summary: HUSHED is a 1-4 player co-op horror game where silence is survival. Find and collect ritual items, and complete the ritual while avoiding an entity that hears everything. The more you progress, the more dangerous it becomes.

games.name: Idle Muscle Up
games.summary: Ignite your inner beast and lift the heaviest weights in the universe. Grow BIGGER and face rivals who keep getting stronger. Start with a relaxing idle clicker experience to build muscles, then push yourself in challenging arcade-style mini-games.

games.name: Jump4
games.summary: Jump. This is not a suggestion.

games.name: Kart Soccer Party
games.summary: Drive your kart and smash the ball into the opponent's goal! Packed with fun and fully playable online!

games.name: Kinap
games.summary: A pixel art action roguelite where you defeat enemies to transform into them, gaining their abilities in fast-paced, strategic, and intense combat.

games.name: Learn Katakana!!
games.summary:
Learn Katakana!! is an educational game that helps you memorize the advanced Japanese syllabary typically used for the transcription of the foreign words, Katakana.

Learn Katakana by playing a game! Select the correct spelling of each Katakana character from the 4 options and score points. Attain the highest possible score with 3 lives!

The game features 46 Katakana characters and you can always remind yourself how to read them by using the table in the game.

games.name: Legend of Ymir
games.summary:
Legend of YMIR is a free-to-play, MMORPG inspired by Norse mythology, available on PC and mobile platforms.

Experience the awe-inspiring details of Norse mythology brought to life with Unreal Engine 5. Step into a vivid and immersive world where ancient legends come alive.

Each season introduces new battlefields, stories, enemies, and events. Escape the monotony of fixed systems and embrace the ever-evolving combat that changes moment by moment.

Feel the thrill at your fingertips with intricate controls and convenient automatic systems, redefining the excitement of combat through an immersive hit-confirmation system and evade controls.

Your adventures, your choices. Every action and decision shapes your path, carving out your own unique journey. Start an adventure that begins with you and create a story that only you can tell.

games.name: Link Penguins
games.summary: 【max 8P】The title is A life-threatening bridge-building begins.Due to the effects of global warming, Antarctica has been shattered into pieces. Your mission is to LINK the fragmented continents by building bridges between them! Play solo or team up in multiplayer to unite Antarctica once again!

games.name: Linkies
games.summary: You find yourself all alone in the vastness of outer space! Being alone makes you slow and weak. Take your Linky with you and confront the challenges head-on! Linkies is a co-op game that creates unbreakable bonds and makes you faster and stronger! Can you make it to the end of space?

games.name: LootSlime
games.summary: LootSlime is a small, platforming-focused metroidvania for PICO-8

games.name: Majo Kuruibana: Daria + Lito-hen
games.summary:
Kuro, the protagonist, had lost her mother to a witch at a young age.
Driven by a thirst for revenge, Kuro enrolls in the "Witch Academy", an institution where that very same witch reigns supreme as Headmistress.

A light-hearted "Revenge Yuri Visual Novel" in which you strive to reach the top of the academy alongside a cast of adorable witches.

games.name: Miracle Brave
games.summary: Miracle Brave blends inventory management, deck-building, tower defense, and shooter combat! Strategize your gear, forge your unique build from countless progression paths, take control of your hero, and hold back endless waves of beasts. Carve out your path to victory and forge your own legend!

games.name: MyMemory
games.summary: MYMEMORY is an RPGMaker horror game set in the SCP Foundation universe. Play through Camille's memories as she is contained and classified as SCP-9831. Play through her life and explore her story. Is the Foundation hiding something? Does Camille know about... you?

games.name: Night Shippers
games.summary: You signed up to deliver food in the underworld, alone or with up to 8 friends. Take orders, dodge monsters, and survive the night - or be trapped in hell forever.

games.name: Nullpoint Protocol
games.summary: The feeling of high-level MMO raids, without the grind. Nullpoint Protocol is a 1-4 player co-op action roguelite where you face harbingers of the apocalypse. Craft your own class from randomized loot, master each boss fight, and save your species from extinction!

games.name: Orbitmine
games.summary: Orbit a planet, fire your laser, and mine it to the core. Upgrade your ship and conquer seasonal hazards across four unique zones. A satisfying incremental mining game set in space.

games.name: Perfect City
games.summary: Welcome to a city where life is a breeze

games.name: Pop Optics
games.summary: Pop Optics is a trippy throwback bullet-hell where you will run around avoiding teardrops, explosions, and lasers that you are controlling! The laser-firing eyeballs focus on your cursor while you navigate the game board.

games.name: QuizTreff
games.summary: QuizTreff is a browser-based quiz platform focused on real-time multiplayer competition. It features multiple modes such as ranked duels, battle royale, arcade-inspired events, and casual trivia matches. Players answer live questions, score points, unlock rewards, and compete in different formats with varying pacing and rulesets.

games.name: Rizuhuritan! Rhythmic Flip (Re)Turn
games.summary: It is a journey that guides lost beings home "Rizufuritan!" is a Memory-based Flip-and-Rhythm Game where you memorize living things and press your favorite key to the Rhythm

games.name: Snoot Booper
games.summary: Meet the Snoots behind the Snoot franchise. You can Boop the Snoot to get points.

games.name: Spinny Dungeon
games.summary: The slot machine roguelike. Each time you hit the SPIN button monsters creep closer to you. KILL 'em! LOOT 'em! EAT 'em! Focus on spells or synergies between symbols. Spin to DIE... or spin to SURVIVE!

games.name: Tamagorudo: Floor O
games.summary: TAMAGORUDO - Floor 0 - is an atmospheric psychological horror game. You will find yourself stuck in a parallel floor of the Backrooms, trying to break out of the loop of a chicken-or-the-egg paradox. Will you find the answer to this endless question ?

games.name: Terminal Mass
games.summary: The “Domain” exists as a mass of cold concrete, twisted monsters, and chaotic anomalies. You are an “Agent” sent to ensure it does not reach “Terminal Mass”. Complete missions. Upgrade your weaponry. Access deeper and darker sectors of the Domain. Will you defeat the horrors that lie at its core?

games.name: The Social Grip: Llama Drama
games.summary: The Social Grip: Llama Drama offers an immersive, second-person experience where strategy and quick-thinking are critical. Will you be able to guide Dan the Llama safely through Trig's offices?

games.name: The Witch and the Lost Babies
games.summary: As a journalist, you travel to an abandoned village to investigate a dark event that occurred years ago. As you progress through missing babies, hidden diaries, and forbidden rituals, you will be forced to perform a dangerous ritual yourself to uncover the truth.

games.name: Torara no Mahjong Kyoushitsu
games.summary: An experiential learning game to learn Mahjong from scratch! Perfect for those who know nothing about mahjong! Learn Mahjong rules step by step with Torara!

games.name: A Ghost and a Snail
games.summary: It all started with a stupid bet from Michael. An abandoned building from the 60s, boarded-up windows, and the pungent smell of damp and oblivion. Will you explore the darkness emanating from the closed doors? Will you run for your life from the unknown? Or will you decide that a red-eyed specter is the ideal candidate for an unexpected romance?

games.name: AFL 26
games.summary: Get ready for the future of footy with AFL 26. Feel every hit, hear every roar, and live every moment with unmatched authenticity and intensity. From the first bounce to the final siren, the action is fast, fierce, and true to the game. With lifelike gameplay, roaring crowds, expert commentary, and all the drama of real AFL, you’re not just watching the game — you’re in it. This is footy, redefined.

games.name: Archimedes II: Some Like It Hot
games.summary: Join Hercules to save Syracuse from erupting volcano fire in time management adventure! Gather resources, build and upgrade structures, complete strategic tasks, and banish mischievous ghosts to restore balance to the world

games.name: Behind the Masks
games.summary: Behind the Masks is a unique free-for-all social deduction game where your identity is your life. Use logic and strategy to discover your opponents' roles and eliminate them, while avoiding detection yourself.

games.name: Black Hole Fishing
games.summary: Black hole fishing is a completely normal incremental game about fishing. Don't expect to stock the pond with genetically modified fish, discover an infinite cavern full of ponds to consume, or destroy the entire planet by feeding infinite fish to a singularity. Honestly, it's just a fishing game.

games.name: Clockwork Blackout
games.summary: A megacorporation dominates the city with steam-powered factories and intricate machinery. Rumors suggest the company is secretly developing mutant creatures. The player takes on the role of a lone hacker who must infiltrate the corporation’s headquarters, steal digital evidence, and escape unharmed to expose the truth to the world.

games.name: Convento
games.summary: A story about growing up online and dealing with IRL updates.A look back at the past 2 decades of gaming that will make you think about the good, the bad, and the ones left behind.

games.name: Darkest Messia
games.summary: Darkest Messia is a dark fantasy RPG with survival and cult-building. Serve one of three ancient gods, build a settlement in a dying world, expose traitors among your people, and decide whether light, darkness, or blood will shape the final fate of humanity.

games.name: Desktop Purrfect
games.summary: Your purr-fect desktop companion is here! Get adorable cats that chill at the bottom of your screen, keeping you company while you work, study, play, or relax. Collect toys & furniture to build them a cozy home. Pet, feed, play, or simply enjoy their presence.

games.name: DisGo
games.summary: DisGo is a parkour chase party game where you play as one of four musical animals known as bandimals. Compete to steal the spotlight from one another to prove who’s really the star of the show. Hold the spotlight to become the soloist, and groove along to the sounds of your solo. Literally grab the light from your opponents, and do your best to not let them take it back. Use various Powerups and Parkour Elements to get the drop on your opponents, as whoever plays their solo the longest wins.

games.name: EchoChamber: Not Welcome
games.summary: Platform to dodge enemies and reach the end. If only the end didn't echo.

games.name: Eko And The Bewitched Lands
games.summary: "Eko and the Bewitched Lands" is a roguelite action RPG game. Help Eko on his mission to save the bewitched lands filled with enemies. Acquire and upgrade weapons of all kinds to combat and discover all the secrets that awaits for you.

games.name: Elton Manor: Requiem of the Cursed Roses
games.summary: At the beginning of the 20th century, a “maid”, Anna, worked diligently every day in a quiet manor. However, in an accident, the gaps in his memory swept over him. Abnormal colleagues, confused gender, vague dreams...While Anna was at a loss, a group of strangers visited the manor, and a long-hidden mystery quietly unfolded.

games.name: Evitania Online
games.summary: Similar to games such as IdleOn and Maple Story Idle, Evitania Online is a fun little IdleRPG in the making with plenty on content to come!

games.name: Eyehold Blocks
games.summary: Defeat the dungeon of Eyehold with the help of the blocks within in a brand new puzzle roguelike. Drop pieces to clear away the damage from the attacks of the monsters within and fight back.

games.name: Frostveil: The Last Winter
games.summary: Winter 1920. As a village leader during the War of Independence, you must manage resources to survive the frost. At the breaking point, will you be a savior or a tyrant? Every choice writes a story in the snow. In pursuit of the story.

games.name: I Can Only Speak Doner
games.summary: Slice, grill, and serve Doner in a foreign land where you don't speak a word of the local language. Use rhythmic keyboard controls to keep up with the lunch rush, puzzle out cryptic orders from impatient customers, and survive the chaos of running your uncle's doner shop.

games.name: In Another World with My Smartphone: Fantasia Connect
games.summary: In Another World with My Smartphone: Fantasia Connect is a free-to-play idle role-playing browser game published by CTW, Inc. on the G123 platform. Based on the second season of the In Another World with My Smartphone anime — itself adapted from the light novel series by Patora Fuyuhara published by Hobby Japan — the title casts players as Touya Mochizuki, undertaking guild requests with heroines such as Yumina and Linze across kingdoms including Belfast. Battles resolve automatically, and progression draws on an idle resource system with party composition built from companions and summoned beasts.

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.summary: Run a meatball restaurant in this high energy comedic cooking game. Meet quirky locals and cook their wild orders, upgrade and customize your restaurant, win thrilling cooking battles, and become the town’s top eatery!

games.name: Last Shift: Gas Station
games.summary: A PSX Horror where the bizarre is routine. Survive 5 nights managing a gas station infested by 10 entities with unique death animations. Unravel the mystery buried beneath the fuel pumps before your shift ends in one of 3 endings.

games.name: Machine Child
games.summary: Machine Child - a nurturing simulation lovingly crafted by renowned illustrator Ooyari Ashito! "Raise a daughter in a charming town! Nurture her through heartwarming moments & adventures. Her future is in your hands – will you guide her to happiness?

games.name: Monster Tamer
games.summary: Monster Tamer is a 2D turn-based adventure where you capture, train, and battle with unique creatures. Explore a vibrant world, build your team, and become the ultimate tamer.

games.name: Narin: The Orange Room
games.summary: Narin: The Orange Room is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Narin, a young girl with sixth-sense whose sister mysteriously disappeared. Narin accidentally got involved in the mystical dimension during the twilight time. Find her sister, solve the mystery, and uncover the truth.

games.name: Neon Rush 3D Endless Speed Challenge
games.summary: Neon Rush 3D Endless Speed Challenge is a fast-paced, high-speed 3D endless runner game. Players navigate through vibrant neon-lit tracks, dodging obstacles and testing their reflexes at intense speeds. The game focuses on high-score challenges and quick, responsive mobile gameplay.

games.name: Nippets
games.summary: Nippets is a hidden objects game. It is inspired by the joy of people watching and telling small stories. Set in a hand-drawn, interactive city, you must open windows, pull blinds and shake treets to find items and return them to their rightful owners.

games.name: NumWorlds
games.summary: A cozy, brain-teasing puzzle adventure. Chain numbers through the sunken city of Atlantis and the age of dinosaurs. 200+ handcrafted levels and an endless mode to get lost in, all at your own pace.

games.name: Observation Daruma Log
games.summary: Observation Daruma Log is a roguelite observation sim where you breed darumas, harvest mysterious energy, and escape a collapsing facility ravaged by disasters to unlock permanent upgrades. Zero comfort, zero cuteness—just nonstop tension and brutal choices.

games.name: Origament: A Paper Adventure
games.summary: Tiny paper - Big adventure! Soar, sail, and roll to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and travel through time and imagination

games.name: Paint Ball
games.summary: It's time for paint wars! In this one-button controlled arcade, you'll be fighting with the evil blue team, and your weapon of choice? A paint ball!

games.name: Parcel Game
games.summary:
Parcel Game is a systems-driven browser game about running a warehouse operation and turning simple routing decisions into a much larger automation exercise.

What starts as a simple parcel-routing challenge quickly becomes a larger automation game about expanding capacity, handling new parcel types, and scaling the business across more of the supply chain.

games.name: Pegs X Stickers
games.summary: Pegs X Stickers is a pachinko-roguelite that combines Balatro with the cult-classic Peggle. Build your own boards and purchase stickers to create high-scoring synergies.

games.name: People of Note
games.summary: In this turn-based RPG musical, join Cadence as she recruits an ensemble of musicians on her quest for stardom. Experience turn-based combat like never before, where each battle is a musical performance with evolving combat conditions and genre-bending mashup attacks!

games.name: Peppered: An Existential Platformer
games.summary:
A light hearted 2D platformer about the meaningless of existence. Dark humour. Big focus on narrative-driven gameplay. Regret. Currently being developed for PC and Mac.
You play as a nameless civilian of an immortal world an hour before a return of the God of death. Life presents you with an opportunity to take this matter into your own hands. And then presents you with countless ways to fail spectacularly.

games.name: Pupple Pop
games.summary: Pupple Pop is an incremental game where you pop bubbles to earn money. Buy bigger and better bubbles, unlock upgrades and hire fish helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy popping work for you. Simple. Satisfying.

games.name: Quack & Hatch
games.summary: Breed, hatch, and level up ducks of all rarities on your incremental duck farm! Make your ducks work for food to level them up to unlock rarer breeds with unique traits. Can you hatch the rarest ducks? Start farming now!

games.name: Roach Royale
games.summary: Roach Royale is a cooperative first-person horror shooter for 2 to 44 players, featuring asymmetrical gameplay that fuses horror, strategy, and battle royale elements. Band together to survive - or embrace the terror and become the nightmare that others must escape.

games.name: Road to Vostok
games.summary: Road to Vostok is a hardcore single-player survival game set in a post-apocalyptic border zone between Finland and Russia. Survive, loot, plan and prepare your way across the Border Zone and enter the Vostok.

games.name: Rosa Inferna
games.summary: Rosa Inferna is a hard-boiled noir action game where you must break through waves of relentless enemies with overwhelming reflexes.

games.name: Sad Virus Asia
games.summary: Sad virus back again in this third person platformer simulation game where mission to find beer bottles in Asia place

games.name: Scary Shadow Spot: All In
games.summary: Escape the nightmare by observing what shouldn’t exist. Lisa is trapped in ten floors that shift each loop: find the anomaly, survive, and uncover the truth behind the endless office.

games.name: Scene No.0
games.summary: Pulled from a theater into the screen, survive cinematic horrors in this 1-4 player co-op. Beyond running, gather clues and exorcise unique spirits across diverse film genres to escape back to reality. Can you solve the mystery before the final credits roll?

games.name: Scorpion Champions: Island Warfare
games.summary: Conquer every island. Destroy every enemy. Become unstoppable.

games.name: Sea of Stars
games.summary: Sea of Stars is a turn-based RPG inspired by the classics. Promising the Sabotage touch in every system, Sea of Stars aims to modernize the classic RPG in terms of turn-based combat, storytelling, exploration and interactions with the environment, while still offering a hearty slice of nostalgia and good old, simple fun.

games.name: Shiba Boop!
games.summary: Boop your shiba all the way to the stars! Customise his look to your liking and set a new high score!

games.name: Sigma Star Saga DX
games.summary:
The classic shooter/RPG is back and better than ever! Featuring a unique mix of side-scrolling shoot-'em-up space battles and top-down planetary exploration, Sigma Star Saga DX is an explosive genre mashup that lets you take control of Allied Earth Federation pilot Ian Recker and infiltrate the alien Krill Empire as a double agent in a last-ditch effort to save mankind.

With loyalties divided between humans and Krill, you must investigate six planets using an ever-expanding set of tools and abilities, and jump into the cockpit to engage enemy forces in intense shmup-style combat using more than 70 different Gun Data items. Gorgeous pixel-art graphics, epic boss battles, and a twist-filled story with multiple endings await.

The new DX version adds numerous refinements over the original 2005 release, including an improved map, decreased random encounter rate, rebalanced EXP system, enhanced dialogue, additional save points, assorted bug fixes and quality-of-life updates, and more.

games.name: Signal Zone
games.summary: Defend your base against increasingly dangerous enemy waves each night in this minimalist survival strategy. Mine resources, build and repair defenses, and upgrade your structures, tools, and abilities to survive in this harsh world.

games.name: Soul Astray
games.summary: Jump, dash and use abilities granted by your immortal soul to outjump damnation in this challenging, yet whimsical, puzzle-precision platformer. Flex your creativity and precision as you overcome hand-crafted trials with minimal instruction.

games.name: Spark in the Dark
games.summary: The hardcore dungeon crawler where you will go to the endless depths of the mysterious grim dungeon.

games.name: Starfield
games.summary: Starfield is a single-player action role-playing game developed by Bethesda Game Studios and set in an open-world space environment. Players create a customizable character and explore a region of the Milky Way galaxy spanning approximately 50 light-years, landing on over 1,000 planets with procedurally generated landscapes. Gameplay includes first-person and third-person combat using firearms, explosives, and melee weapons, as well as spaceship construction, outpost building, resource gathering, and crafting. Players recruit companion characters, join factions, and progress through skill trees spanning Physical, Social, Combat, Science, and Tech categories.

games.name: Starfield: Shattered Space
games.summary: This will be the first story expansion to Starfield. This DLC is bundled with Premium Edition (digital), Premium Edition Upgrade (digital), Premium Edition Upgrade (physical), and Constellation Edition of Starfield.

games.name: Steeplejack
games.summary: What is this darn thing? Why, it's Steeplejack, of course! Play as a flag-man trying his hardest to keep his flags up-to-date with the news, which comes and goes fast these days! Raise and lower the flags with the Playdate's crank to match the emotion of the news:

games.name: The Cure
games.summary: The Cure is a 3D, action, survival horror game, in which the player must evade a monster that is continually chasing them. The player can evade by running or shutting doors, blocking off pathways to not be followed. The player must collect three cure vials in order to mix the final cure.

games.name: The Dragon and the Sword
games.summary: Clea’s parents were murdered by a “dragon”―a creature that shouldn’t even exist. Determined to find it and gain the strength to slay it, she steps onto the adventurer’s path. When four individuals, each driven by different motives yet bound by a single purpose, come together, their story takes a dramatic turn...

games.name: The Spotter: Dig or Die
games.summary: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

games.name: Tick Hop 2
games.summary: Leap, climb, and dash at high speed! With enhanced mobility, face tougher challenges and diverse puzzles. Simple mechanics, plenty of items—experience the pure joy of platforming.

games.name: Towerix91
games.summary: Towerix91 is an incremental tower defense inspired by PC games of the late 80s and early 90s. Collect crystals, unlock dozens of upgrades in the tech tree, place towers on walls, upgrade them and use abilities. Repel waves of enemies while steadily strengthening your defenses.

games.name: TR-49
games.summary: Narrative deduction meets audio drama, from the creators of Heaven’s Vault, Overboard! and A Highland Song.

games.name: Unwanted Dungeon
games.summary: A tactical survivorslike with classic RPG essence: unique builds, dual combat styles per class, rare loot, and semi-procedural level generation. Fast-paced action meets progression freedom and permadeath in a dark fantasy roguelike. Welcome to Unwanted Dungeon.

games.name: Who's My Secret Santa?
games.summary: A shy Secret Santa who I have to take care of, and a secret Secret Santa who surprises me with gifts! In the conflicting Secret Santa games, who will win the rookie's heart?

games.name: 5 Golden Skulls
games.summary: Can you escape the cursed temple of Quetzalcoatl? In solo or coop, look out for any anomalies. Observe carefully, as any mistake would be fatal!

games.name: A Heart Of Iron
games.summary: A mini game where you romance Simon from outside the Iron Lung. Be sure to be wise in his aid, something small could lead to greater consequence.

games.name: A Thousand Bees
games.summary: Spot the bees in this lovingly hand-illustrated hidden objects game. A literal thousand bees are spread out over a dozen beautiful levels. Can you find all secret levels, too? Enjoy a perfect summer day, deeply inspired by the cozy honeycore aesthetic.

games.name: Abject Abyss
games.summary: Abject Abyss is a first person horror adventure on a distant world. Explore Luminary Corporation’s most advanced research facility while piecing together what went wrong, and avoiding the horrors that lurk in the dark.

games.name: Agony Increment
games.summary: Abrasive first person bullet hell with a focus on physics. A linear boomer shooter with pseudo-RPG progression.

games.name: Airborne Empire
games.summary: Build, manage, and grow your unique city in the skies. Traverse a vast and rich open world full of exotic technologies, relentless dangers, and many hidden treasures. Defend your inhabitants – and the kingdoms below! – from destructive attacks. Only daring leaders can reforge the Airborne Empire!

games.name: Annulus
games.summary:
Incorporate dark fantasy elements into medieval knight wars to create a grand world-view war chess game
Players will play the role of the head of the mercenary group, continuously collect and cultivate resources such as mercenaries and weapons, and build their own mercenary group

games.name: Bark and Catch
games.summary: Bark and Catch - A fast-paced game for 1-4 players where you take on the role of dogs and must complete important farm tasks within a time limit: grow and prepare food, feed the animals, and deliver farm products to their destination.

games.name: Barking from the Dark
games.summary: Barking from the Dark is a first-person horror game about a lonely night shift worker at a remote railway crossing.

games.name: Brave Rounds
games.summary: Shoot, punch and get closer through bullets towards enemies in this close range-heavy arcade bullet hell shoot 'em up. A mysterious cult is going to make Mt. Krakatoa explode! By yourself or with a friend, stand your ground; the fate of the world is in your hands...!

games.name: Cat Screen
games.summary: Bring your desktop to life with 3D cats! Feed, pet, name your cats and earn points. Minimal menus, mouse-only controls, system-friendly design and weekly online rankings make you the best cat owner!

games.name: ChainStaff
games.summary: ChainStaff is a brutal action-platformer with a transforming spear and grappling hook, blazing weapon upgrades, and a rocking soundtrack. Aliens have taken over the Earth! Swing, shoot, and spear your way through hordes of mutating monstrosities and bone-shaking boss fights.

games.name: Chill with You: Lo-Fi Story
games.summary: "Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story" is a sound novel game where you work alongside Satone, a girl who loves writing stories. Customize lo-fi music, ambient sounds, and landscapes to create a focused environment. As you deepen your bond with Satone, you may discover a special connection with her.

games.name: CodeRed: Agent Sarah's Story - Day One
games.summary: Point-and-click adventure game. Together with special agent Sarah Young, follow and catch dangerous terrorist.

games.name: Console Archives: Seicross
games.summary:
"Seicross" was released by Nichibutsu in 1986 for an 8-bit home console.
In this shooting game, you pilot a hover bike to save the peaceful people of Petra, whose homeland has been invaded by a once-coexisting tribe that has turned to evil.
As you rescue the captive people of Petra from enemy territory, your bike's weight increases, causing it to consume fuel energy much faster—but in return, you'll earn massive bonuses upon clearing the stage!

games.name: Dice Card Heroes
games.summary: In this roguelike deckbuilder, every card features its own dice. Battle against many fantastic creatures across 3 chapters. Upgrade your cards, build countless synergies and find mighty weapons to shape your playstyle. There is only one goal: Be the hero, slay the dragon.

games.name: Draw Steel
games.summary:
A new game for a new age! Draw Steel is the breathtaking new, action-oriented, fantasy RPG from MCDM that’s both fun to play and fun to run!
In Draw Steel, your character grows more powerful over the course of the battle, not less! Characters build heroic resources over the course of the battle so battles get more interesting round by round!

games.name: Dream Trials
games.summary: Somehow, someway you achieved a complete balance between life and death. The universe has taken notice and now you must undergo the Dream Trials.

games.name: Duck Duck Hotel
games.summary: A 3D cute management sim where you're a duck building and operating a treetop hotel for a variety of bird species. Strategically expand your tree, cater to each species' unique needs, and keep your feathery guests happy through all four seasons. Just don't ruffle any feathers, or it's game over!

games.name: Evolution Adventure
games.summary: "Evolution Adventure" is an adventure game with elements of deck-building, idle mechanics, and the creation of your own unique monsters. Discover unique combinations and crossbreed creatures in the evolution chamber. Unravel all the mysteries and find all the monsters.

games.name: Fantasy Ore Shop
games.summary: Mine ore, run the store, unlock tech, and push a modest shop to its limit. Start with click mining, then automate; balance inventory, traffic, and sales through the tech tree for efficiency—from manual play to the peak.

games.name: FC 26 Quiz
games.summary:
FC 26 Quiz is a browser based interactive live-stream trivia game designed for Twitch streamers. Players compete in real-time by guessing blurred football player cards
through the live chat. Each round presents a blurred football player card,
and viewers race to identify the player using visual clues like rating, position, and
card design. Faster correct guesses earn higher scores, with a live leaderboard
tracking all participants. The game features customizable round timers, hint systems
(letter reveals, league/nation/club info), promo card categories, multi-language
support and full streamer branding customization.

Live Play: Real-time viewer interaction via streaming platforms.

games.name: Find This Pixel Anomaly
games.summary:
In Find This Pixel Anomaly your task involves monitoring real-time surveillance camera feeds. Identify any irregularities within the monitored areas. These anomalies can vary from missing furniture to cute visitors.

Found an anomaly? File a report and hope it will get fixed in time. Otherwise you will get in trouble, because too many anomalies will end the game.

games.name: Find Your Words
games.summary: Find your community at summer camp, one friendship at a time. Take a beat, enjoy a breath of fresh air - all while playing at the beach, strolling in the woods, and dancing with friends. This short cozy game was created by two dads, celebrating their kids’ journeys to find their voices.

games.name: Fogline Protocol
games.summary: randomized survivor locations, shifting fog density, and limited resources forcing quick decisions and risky pushes. Survive, extract, upgrade, and dive back in.

games.name: Ghost in the Feed
games.summary: Dive into the supernatural atmosphere of Ghost in the Feed! Monitor cameras to spot spectral anomalies across haunted maps. Test your memory and vigilance to survive the night or succumb to paranormal dread!

games.name: Good Luck
games.summary: You're late for a meeting, and the entire city seems designed to stop you. Then you remember Murphy's Laws; "Anything that can go wrong, will go wrong". Good Luck.

games.name: Hexa's Gone
games.summary: The Secret Hexa has vanished. Ask the right questions, stay strategic in your answers. Your goal will be to gather the clues from each player. By combining them, you will likely be the first to find the Hexa.

games.name: Hidden Sheep Puzzle
games.summary: Can you find every sheep and solve the Sheep Puzzle? Looks simple. Isn’t.

games.name: Hunt Club On Stream
games.summary: This is a Streaming intergraded game for players of all ages, i have created this game myself, its a simple free to play game for anyone, just to pass time and have some fun. Hunt and collect trophys

games.name: I Eat Paintings When Guards Aren't Looking
games.summary: Find hidden objects in famous paintings… then eat them. Decode bizarre cravings, rip chunks out of Renaissance masterpieces, and snack your way through art history like the absolute menace you are.

games.name: Ignarus
games.summary:
Ignarus is a Dark old school Action RPG with a story to tell.

There will be experience gained to level up and learn new abilities, as well as challenging monsters and boss battles to test your skills.

Some dungeons and puzzles will test your wits and solving skills and leave you satisfied.

games.name: Incantation
games.summary: "Incantation" is a first-person horror mystery game adapted from a movie of the same name. The game reveals the chilling story behind "Chen Village" from the movie. A mother searching for her missing daughter accidentally stumbles into a village filled with mysterious cults. Beyond the palpable madness and fear in the village, there's a sinister force that drives one to despair. What happens when one crosses the forbidden line of this evil deity?

games.name: Intelligence
games.summary: A retro-sci-fi themed mystery investigation puzzle game. Search for clues across the solar system, gather intelligence using your cutting-edge investigation tools, and figure out what happened. When you find all 15 ships, you win!

games.name: Jumpy Horse Show Jumping
games.summary:
In this beautiful graphics game you can choose whether to be:
A Course Designer: A Manege Wizard, that creates a fairy-tale in which magnificent horses and riders compete for victory. The inspiration leads you to endless possibilities of bold decisions and responsibility in the arrangement of obstacles and boundless imagination in decorating them.

games.name: Lay of the Land
games.summary: Lay of the Land is a sandbox adventure game set in a fantasy world where everything is physically simulated. Use the environment to your advantage and Explore, Fight, Loot and Build your way through mysterious lands.

games.name: Lost Lands: Stories About the Sorceress, the Prince and the Minotaur
games.summary: The great deeds of little heroes.

games.name: Man Game: Reflex Testing
games.summary: Man Game is a 2D fast-paced roguelike platformer with a uniquely goofy 3-color artstyle where you must control a Man and escape his evil clones copying his every move.

games.name: Morbid Metal
games.summary: Morbid Metal is a stylish fast-paced hack’n’slash action rogue-lite. Shapeshift into powerful characters in real time, chain impactful combos, and tear through waves of deadly machines and brutal bosses.

games.name: Mostly Trash Sometimes Treasure
games.summary: You've volunteered to clean a beach but the shore hides more than trash. Recycle the waste, upgrade your tools and discover the treasures.

games.name: Oceanopolis 2000
games.summary: Build the future under the sea in this retro sci-fi city tycoon.

games.name: Pokémon Champions
games.summary: Get ready to experience everything you love about Pokémon battles all in one place—in Pokémon Champions. This new, battle-focused game will feature familiar mechanics such as Pokémon types, Abilities, and moves, creating an environment conducive to rich and varied strategies for new and experienced Trainers alike. It’s not just familiar mechanics—you’ll be able to bring in classic Pokémon from Pokémon HOME, too! Look forward to cross-platform battles alongside your favorite Pokémon on Nintendo Switch and mobile, with a variety of different modes available for your desired experience.

games.name: Post Apocalypse Microbe Lab
games.summary: Leave the game on and watch Lyse work in a post-apocalyptic world on the corner of your desktop. Her job is to collect microbe samples; your job is to lend a hand when you can.

games.name: Print Gallery of an Artist
games.summary: A brief exploration of recursive spaces.

games.name: Purplearc
games.summary: PURPLEARC is a platformer where you control the main character, Baty, and explore a world of night.

games.name: Rope
games.summary: While repeating the same operation, the player's thinking deepens little by little. This is a puzzle game that values such a feeling. The rules are simple and clear. However, the accumulation of choices and results that unfold there creates a quiet tension and relaxation.

games.name: Samson
games.summary: Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is running. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

games.name: Slendytubbies Ø Records
games.summary: Slendytubbies Ø Records is the short sequel to the fangame Slendytubbies Ø, developed by HostGame Studio and released in April 2026. The game serves largely as a prequel, providing additional context to the events of the first game.

games.name: Snow Resort Simulator
games.summary: Step into the world of Snow Resort Simulator. Tackle daily responsibilities: upgrade facilities, maintain a cozy resort, satisfy guests with freshly cooked meals and drinks, and keep your inventory fully stocked. Be prepared for the challenges that come with winter.

games.name: Solid Void: Topsy Turvy World
games.summary:
A Fresh Mix Of Classic Nonogram And Jigsaw Puzzles.
Flex your puzzle skills and master nonogram and jigsaw challenges!

games.name: Sp(l/r)ite
games.summary: When you wake up, you are in a different space. "Sp(l/r)ite" is an adventure game in which you must cooperate with your neighbors and a vivacious goddess, separated by walls, to escape from a room floating in a different space, while solving riddles. Which door will you choose when you get there?

games.name: Subversive Memories
games.summary: Subversive Memories is a story driven survival horror set in Brazil during the last military dictatorship. Explore the backrooms of an oppressive regime, escape ominous presences and scavenge every corner of this land in search of your ██████.

games.name: Super Alloy Crush
games.summary: "Super Alloy Crush" is a 2D side-scrolling fighting action game. Play as Kelly and Muu (No.02) to defeat enemies and obtain treasure! Join hands with friends and take on challenges together!

games.name: Super Star Shooter 16
games.summary: Super Star Shooter 16 is a psychedelic retro inspired on-rails shooter.

games.name: Sylph
games.summary: Operate a spacecraft at the edge of a singularity. Use realistic orbital mechanics and Newtonian physics to explore a star system around a black hole and what lies beyond.

games.name: The Floor Above
games.summary: A claustrophobic anomaly-horror game where you can only turn, blink, and decide: is it real or not? Survive five endings and uncover Mike’s story.

games.name: The House of Hikmah
games.summary: The House of Hikmah is a narrative-driven 3D adventure game exploring grief, legacy and the search for answers after profound loss. Solve puzzles, encounter historical scholars of the Islamic Golden Age, and uncover timeless lessons in a beautifully imagined House of Wisdom.

games.name: The Mall Explodes!
games.summary: The Mall Explodes! is a visual novel about a security guard with only a few minutes to stop a bomb from exploding in a shopping mall. Figure out who the bomber is and stop them before it's too late!

games.name: The Occultist
games.summary: The Occultist is a first-person narrative thriller. You play as Alan Rebels, a paranormal investigator who travels to an abandoned British island after his father's disappearance. Explore GodStone island, face supernatural entities, and uncover long-buried occult rituals.

games.name: The Pirate: Republic of Nassau
games.summary: The Pirate: Republic of Nassau is an open-world pirate game that gives players the freedom to shape their own destiny. Plunder merchant ships or become a trader yourself. Take on missions from governors and follow tavern rumors to discover hidden caves and unlock special missions such as prison breaks or bandit camp assaults.

games.name: The Woods
games.summary: The Woods is a short first-person horror game emphasizing atmosphere and tension, inspired by games like Slender or Seeking Evil: The Wendigo. Players explore a dark, eerie woods to collect 5 mementos with only a flashlight and limited stamina, all while being hunted by a creature of the forest.

games.name: The Wreck That Should Not Be
games.summary: When the mysterious Doctor Hoffmann hires your submarine to explore the east Caribbean sea, you accept, unware of the danger he is leading you into...

games.name: Trash Can Tactics
games.summary: Ever since the Nature's Legacy Institute has opened their doors to all, there have been an odd string of thefts - not of rare artifacts, but rather of the food from the cafeteria. Play as either a museum staff member, or an intelligent raccoon, in this asymmetrical PvP heist game.

games.name: Triste
games.summary: Not all nightmares are scary. Some just repeat themselves, silent and slow, like a punishment that never ends... You are trapped in Triste’s world, where every turn decides your fate. Only your cards and your instinct can carve a path through the chaos in a cycle that never seems to end.

games.name: Wittengrad Is No More
games.summary: Wittengrad Is No More is a surreal, narrative walking sim with horror elements. The city's foggy streets will lead you through the story of a single evening in Barnaba’s life. You will encounter the peculiar inhabitants of Wittengrad, though… does it even matter? After all, Wittengrad is gone.

games.name: Xenogen
games.summary: A distant planet, a buried reactor, an atom of consciousness lost in darkness. Uncover the secret of Xenogen in a journey of precision and tension, where every jump reveals a fragment of truth—and every fall sends you deeper into the depths.

games.name: 67 Minutes in Heaven
games.summary: Your neighbor invites you on a double date, setting you up with the new girl from out of town. After sneaking into an abandoned house, your neighbor suggests everyone play a game, 67 Minutes in Heaven.

games.name: A Planet Full of Cats
games.summary: A Planet Full of Cats is a hidden object adventure with metroidvania-style exploration — in true Devcats fashion. Explore diverse biomes, unlock new powers and uncover ancient secrets!

games.name: Alien Grounds
games.summary: A score-driven arcade FPS built for short, high-intensity runs. Every mission escalates. Mastery beats brute force.

games.name: Anopsia
games.summary: A short story about a long dream.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Polaris
games.summary:
"Polaris" is a shooting game released by Taito in 1980.
Take command of a submarine and battle advancing enemy forces using missiles that can only be fired directly upward.
Navigate through a relentless onslaught from all directions—bombers in the sky, frigates patrolling the surface, and mines lurking on the seabed!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Polaris
games.summary:
"Polaris" is a shooting game released by Taito in 1980.
Take command of a submarine and battle advancing enemy forces using missiles that can only be fired directly upward.
Navigate through a relentless onslaught from all directions—bombers in the sky, frigates patrolling the surface, and mines lurking on the seabed!

games.name: Arcadia Fallen II
games.summary: In this sequel to the award-winning roleplay visual novel, Arcadia Fallen, you play as a senior student at Seven Wind’s Academy. Choose from three different magical disciplines, and let your choices shape the personality of your character as they navigate school life during a time of great change.

games.name: Barro 2026
games.summary: Barro 2026 is a racing game where you choose from 20 cars, master 5 unique tracks, and compete against up to 10 rivals in intense high-speed races.

games.name: Beastkeepers
games.summary: Beastkeepers is your creature taming adventure at the bottom of the screen. Breed and train powerful creatures, battle enemies, and earn coins. Use them to unlock new creatures, upgrades, and decorations. Grow stronger and progress endlessly!

games.name: BeatHero
games.summary: BeatHero blends rhythm puzzle, tower defense, and roguelite elements with energetic electronic music. Eliminate elemental tiles on a neon-lit 9x9 grid to unleash dazzling barrages against monster hordes. Randomized builds × pulsating synth tracks deliver an immersive disco-inspired battle experience

games.name: Beyond Words
games.summary: From the creators of GoldenEye & TimeSplitters comes Beyond Words, the genre-defining fusion of roguelike strategy and word-crafting. Build powerful combos, unlock upgrades, and master a challenge where victory is spelled one letter at a time.

games.name: Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 11 - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Pack your bags! Start your journey today, no luggage or visa required!

games.name: Borderlands Mobile
games.summary:
Create Mayhem YOUR way! Loot wild weapons and blast enemies in this mobile Borderlands experience.

Join other Vault Hunters in an ever-evolving universe to fight greedy corporations and open legendary Vaults. This action-packed looter shooter brings the signature chaos, art style, and gun-slinging adventure to mobile for the first time!

Hunt down legendary loot drops and power up your abilities to customize the way you play. Use everything from pistols to rocket launchers to make your enemies wish they never crossed your path!

Master devastating action gameplay that's been fully optimized for mobile. Fight skags, bandits, and bosses as you battle through a variety of exciting mission types, including Campaign Missions, Tower of Terror, and Circle of Slaughter.

What are you waiting for, Vault Hunter! The vaults won't open themselves( and those bandits won't shoot themselves either).

games.name: Case No.1: Rose Academy
games.summary: Rose Academy is a detective visual novel about a young special agent sent to an elite girls' school to investigate the mysterious death of one of its top students. As you uncover the dark secrets hidden behind the academy’s flawless facade, you'll be drawn into a world of intrigue, temptation, and romance.

games.name: Cat Doctor: For Loyal Servants
games.summary: Essential cat knowledge every servant should know

games.name: Choiceline Brawl
games.summary: Turn-based card game with fast runs: Choose one of many heroes with unique passive abilities, build your deck from 10 abilities, and face tactically selected opponents. Fight, unlock cards, and dominate short battles.

games.name: Constellar
games.summary: A reinterpretation of retro games like Space Invaders and Galaga with a modern twist. Battle through planetary sectors using elemental abilities that combine for powerful effects and make bosses vanish. If you’re looking for a short, modernized retro-style game, this is perfect for you.

games.name: Crafting in Berxley
games.summary: Craft, trade and grow your business in the charming kingdom of Berxley. Test your crafting skills using more than 180 blueprints and 250 items. Buy properties and storage to bring more items into each level or sell them for profit in the world economy. Become the master craftsman the kingdom needs

games.name: Crawlspace: Insanity Remastered
games.summary: CRAWLSPACE is the official remake of Insanity (2015), a classic Five Nights at Freddy's fangame that harkens back to Five Nights at Freddy's 2.

games.name: Crime Simulator
games.summary: You’re out of jail, but the debt isn’t gone. Sneak, steal, and break into houses solo or in 4-player co-op. Use lockpicks, sleeping gas, and brute force to complete jobs, outsmart security, and make enough money before time runs out. Will you pay back what you owe, or lose everything?

games.name: Cult Vacui
games.summary: Cult Vacui is a horror point-and-click adventure with survival and time management elements where your choices could keep you alive... or not.

games.name: DarkSwitch
games.summary: DarkSwitch is a vertical survival city builder. Build a city on a great tree and defend it against the Fog. Face the challenges of limited real estate, scarce resources, and tough moral choices as you seek to uncover the mystery of the Veil. The Tree Provides! The Tree Protects! The Tree Prevails!

games.name: Darts VR2: Bullseye
games.summary: Darts VR2: Bullseye is the most true to life Darts experience in VR which offers 16 player esports mode with league and voice support including single player fun. The game also features Around The World and Killstreak completely reimagined as rhythm games. There's no party without Darts and there can't be a dart game without Party where there's no wait to join the party. If it's a game, it has to have zombies so we bring in Zombie hunting using Darts for some casual fun.

games.name: Dawn Break
games.summary: In 2039, tsunamis of varying degrees occurred all over the world, and multiple small black holes inexplicably appeared in the sky, ruthlessly devouring the world. At first, scientists believed that this phenomenon was a common natural disaster, until one day, a test report shocked the world.

games.name: Demon Castle Story
games.summary: Demon Castle Building Dungeon Management Simulation

games.name: Doll Is Back
games.summary: What if every toy had a soul? Play as Lily, a discarded doll, on a desperate journey to reunite with her owner. In this 3D side-scrolling horror, you must hide, run, and survive against giant, soulless toys driven by madness.

games.name: Drivionline
games.summary: An online, free-to-play multiplayer driving and racing game where players can customize cars, roam freely, create their own servers, and make mods.

games.name: Easter Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers
games.summary: Lovingly designed Easter animals coloring book full of child-friendly illustrations

games.name: Eastern Block Summer
games.summary: Make your babushka proud and find all hidden objects in this cozy game with a hint of eastern European nostalgia. 10 black and white illustrations with hundreds objects fo find that get colors when you finish it. Made by an illustrator-developer duo it is entirely hand drawn, with no AI involved.

games.name: Eggconsole Schwarzschild II PC-9801
games.summary: As supreme ruler, survive the war-torn galaxy by mastering diplomacy and strategy. This game blends cinematic twists with punishing combat against an AI.

games.name: Final Sentence
games.summary: Final Sentence is a Battle Royale typing game. Together with other players, you find yourself in a hangar, with a typewriter in front of you and a revolver loaded with a single bullet at your temple. Every mistake can be fatal. Only one will remain.

games.name: Football Cup 2026
games.summary: Lead your nation. Claim the trophy. Become a legend.

games.name: Formula Legends: Iconic Tracks
games.summary:
Three countries. Decades of racing history. Countless legendary laps.

Expand your Formula Legends experience with the Iconic Tracks Pack. Master Austria across three eras — Vintage, Classic, and Modern. Take on Malaysia in its Classic form, and test your skills on Bahrain, featuring both Classic and Modern variations. Every track has been meticulously recreated to capture the rhythm, challenge, and atmosphere of its era.

Key Features
3 legendary circuits, spanning multiple eras:

Austria – Vintage, Classic, Modern

Malaysia – Classic, Modern

Bahrain – Modern

Era-accurate presentation: Relive the evolution of racing, from historic machines to modern precision.

New career challenges: Push your mastery across decades of motorsport history.

Time Trials & Leaderboards: Compete with the global community for the fastest laps.

Fully integrated: Career and Quick Race modes — history rewards mastery.

games.name: Gardener Simulator
games.summary: Start your own gardening business. Mow lawns, Trim hedges, blow leaves. Upgrade tools and become the ultimate gardener.

games.name: Gear Slots
games.summary: Spin the wheels of weaponry to incrementally upgrade your gear while endless monsters are defeated by your idle attacks. Watch your hoard of coins grow and find new ways to spend them to tip the scales of luck in your favor.

games.name: Gears Of Glory
games.summary:
Gears of Glory is a movement-based Tower Defense where you drive a van across the map to collect Gears, build powerful towers, and stop the robots from destroying your bases.

Developed for PC, Gears of Glory combines classic Tower Defense strategy with a unique twist: driving a stylish van through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic world.

Featuring a top-down pixel art look and fast-paced gameplay, the player takes on the role of a resistance pilot tasked with protecting the last human bases from hordes of robots that have taken over the planet and isolated humanity. To succeed, you’ll need skill behind the wheel, dodging obstacles or running enemies over. All while building towers with strategic synergies capable of turning the tide of battle.

Speed, strategy and survival collide in this game where every turn can mean the difference between extinction and the salvation of humanity.

The game’s inspiration comes from the desire to complement the Tower Defense genre and eliminate those idle moments where players would simply speed up the game after placing towers and wait. In Gears of Glory you are in constant motion driving the van to upgrade towers, collect Gears, and run enemies over.

The gameplay and art are influenced by titles such as Gemcraft, Kingdom Rush, Thronefall, Rock and Roll Racing, Biker Mice from Mars, GTA2.

games.name: Gentle Classical Music Course for Grown-Ups
games.summary: A quiz to learn classical music in a fun way

games.name: Geo Brain Boost! World Map Silhouette Quiz
games.summary: Can You Identify the World by Its Shape?

games.name: Glitchy: Cute Loop
games.summary:
Strange things are happening in the home of the cute little animals. The Ghost Patrol wants to give everyone a donut before bedtime, but they can only do so if everything and everyone is in their proper place. However, the over-eager crew is always trying to prank Glitchy the little ghost, coming up with new tricks every day. They hide, rotate pictures, repaint the room, or rearrange the furniture.

Help Glitchy the ghost find these anomalies! During the game, look around the cute home, check every detail, and find the differences in the level. If everything is correct, help Glitchy by choosing the green door. But if you feel something is wrong, simply choose the red door. If you help Glitchy 8 times without a mistake, you’ve successfully completed the game—and Glitchy will be very happy!

games.name: Gridwardens
games.summary: Gridwardens is a turn-based tactics game built for quick, satisfying battles on a grid. Pick your squad, read the battlefield, and outsmart your opponent with clever positioning, timing, and ability combos. Every turn matters, and every unit can swing the match.

games.name: Hand Meat Walker
games.summary: A fast-paced, strategy driven retro FPS in which you fight alongside a robot companion. Explore chunky, old school style maps and battle bizarre creatures together. Bring demise with your well-rounded arsenal and powerful ally.

games.name: Heavenly Guitars
games.summary: Play hits like "Senbonzakura," "Gimme Chocolate!!," and "The Beginning"! Experience the ultimate electric guitar "joy of playing" in this competitive music game. Realistic sound, intuitive controls, and hot online battles. Compete with guitarists from all over the world!

games.name: Hello, Yoshi!
games.summary: "Hello, Yoshi!" allows the player to interact with Yoshi. Pull his facial features, feed him powerups, and even play Peekaboo. The game was released as part of the My Mario brand of toys and games aimed at young children.

games.name: Hentai Succubus Aura
games.summary: Hentai Succubus Aura is an adult anime puzzle game featuring the seductive succubus Aura. Solve memory and puzzle challenges to unlock new illustrations, achievements, and gallery content.

games.name: Hexical
games.summary: Hexical is a retro twin stick action rogue-lite. Install modifications that change how you play. Fight through hordes of viruses to deliver components safely. Make your way through an evolving digital world. Can you defeat all the 3 viral aspects and bring order to the system?

games.name: Hidden Tails
games.summary: Hidden Tails is a cozy hidden object game where every squeak tells a story.

games.name: High Above
games.summary: High Above is a small rooftop-building game about finding peace in the skies. Design and grow your perfect rooftop retreat, from vibrant Cuban courtyards to modern urban hideaways. Watch the world come to life around you, at your own pace, in your own little oasis.

games.name: Holface
games.summary: Upon visiting his decrepit and dying grandfather, Isaac discovers an ancient evil that has parasitically dwelled within his ancestry for generations. Isaac must stop the parasite's symbiotic cycle from reoccurring or else become its new host.

games.name: Infinite Dungeon: Idle Adventure
games.summary: Idle Dungeon Crawling x Incremental Clicker: Experience the thrill of limitless growth. Master hero synergies and upgrade priorities to bring strategic depth to every dungeon run

games.name: Kawaii Force: Liberty Line
games.summary: Gunshots and neon lights collide in a city that never sleeps, and the most dangerously adorable girls squad you have ever seen is about to pull the trigger!

games.name: Killer Toys
games.summary: Survive the fast-paced rogue-like FPS chaos against murderous animatronic toys!

games.name: King of Meat
games.summary:
King of Meat is a co-op party platformer, pitting up to 4 players against devious dungeons filled with puzzles to solve, challenges to traverse, and ridiculous monsters to fight.

Progress through official and community-built dungeons to unlock new abilities and gear on your way to becoming the ultimate contender!

games.name: Knockout 2: Wrath of the Karen
games.summary:
In Knockout 2: Wrath of the Karen, a puzzle-boxing spectacle fighting game, take the role of an FBI agent (the bureau of Federal Boxing Investigations) tasked with uncovering the sinister secret behind a rise in wanton entitled law-breaking worldwide.

Knockout 2 pits you against the worst of society and the only way out is with your fists. The cable company stops giving you the discounted rate? That's a boxing match. Someone yields at an empty roundabout? That's a boxing match, too. In fact, all laws, court cases, and skimping out on sandwich toppings are resolved through combat in a world where the legal system has been replaced with boxing. The road to victory might not be easy, but it will be hilarious.

games.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Hujeong Auditorium
games.summary: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

games.name: Kyoufu Yawa
games.summary: Late at night, a teacher shares two bizarre tales: a corpse stuffed in a sheet, and an abnormal presence in the mountains. It was just a ghost story, but a creepy "sense of unease" lurks within. A short psychological horror visual novel offering a dense, terrifying experience in about an hour.

games.name: Legends Aligned: Land of Order
games.summary: Harmony in Every Fit

games.name: Let It Consume
games.summary: Let It Consume is a short, active incremental game about leading a dark cult. Raise loyal imps, harvest their emotions, and feed your all-consuming idol before it hungers for you. Expand your rituals, unlock dark upgrades, and watch devotion turn into divine power.

games.name: Lugh World
games.summary: A living world awaits new explorers. Capture creatures called Lughs, evolve your team, and face epic challenges in real-time combat. In Lugh World, your adventure is shaped by the choices you make, the Lughs you encounter, and the challenges you decide to overcome in an evolving world.

games.name: M Field
games.summary:
M Field is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are running through a minefield. Press a button to jump and press it twice to double jump. Hold a button to jump farther. Score points by destroying the enemies with the mine explosions, but be careful not to get caught in the explosion. You can jump on top of the enemies, but you can't touch them while you're on the ground.

The game is over when you get caught in an explosion or touch an enemy.

games.name: Mad Television Tycoon
games.summary: In Mad Television Tycoon, you take control of a TV station. Accept the challenge and lead your network to success. Your task is to create a diverse schedule, maximize advertising revenue, and outshine the competition.

games.name: Maid-Sama Cafe: Anime Boys Services in Cute Outfits
games.summary:
The cutest café just got a little more dangerous.
Charming anime boys serving with style.
Are you ready for the sweetest service in town?

games.name: Maid-Sama Cafe: Anime Girls Services in Cute Outfits
games.summary:
Welcome to the cutest café in town.
Adorable maids, sweet smiles, and playful challenges await.
Can you keep every customer happy?

games.name: Market is Fine
games.summary: Market is Fine is a grocery store simulation game developed by a single independent developer. Players build and manage their own grocery stores, taking responsibility for various business processes such as inventory tracking, shelf arrangement, customer satisfaction, and financial growth. The game focuses on experiencing the daily operations and strategic challenges of a grocery store business in detail.

games.name: Messy Recipe: A Hidden Object Game
games.summary: Time to get cooking in a chaotic kitchen! Search for the ingredients you want, customize the recipe, then mix things together and hope for the best. Make friends with the shy ghost who hides your ingredients every night, and cook through family recipes in this cozy hidden objects game.

games.name: Minos
games.summary: Minos is a maze-building roguelite where you, the fabled Minotaur, must defend your sanctuary from bloodthirsty adventurers. Design and re-design deadly labyrinths, set traps, and turn every brave fool into your next victim.

games.name: Missing The Point
games.summary:
Leon is going fishing, but he can't seem to focus...
There are many things to see along the riverbanks...
Try to relax and catch some fish. Don't think too much about it...

games.name: Motorhome: Traveling North America 3 - Collector's Edition
games.summary: A journey across America in a cozy motorhome. Relaxing mini-games, hidden object scenes, collectible baseball caps, and a Polaroid travel album make every stop unique and memorable.

games.name: Nandome ka no Shiki
games.summary: A supernatural mystery visual novel featuring a time-looping bride investigating her own murder.

games.name: National Adult General Knowledge Selection Test
games.summary: Test your adult knowledge

games.name: Nautical Survival
games.summary: Captain an armed sea vessel to fight hordes of oceanic terrors! Upgrade your seacraft, equip it with weapons and hire crew members to your aid.​

games.name: Nocturne Routes
games.summary: Plan your path. Control the night.

games.name: Off Garbage
games.summary: A sleep-deprived scientist must use a broken cleaning robot to contain a biological outbreak he accidentally caused before his wife returns and discovers the chaos.

games.name: Parallel
games.summary: Parallel is a competitive online strategy card game where every match is won through skill, deckbuilding, and tactical play.

games.name: Pictective 2: Around the World
games.summary: Oh nooo!! Oyen escaped again! Help Doma travel across 12 countries to catch him! Match up those little photo pieces and find where Oyen's hiding

games.name: Pixel Brave
games.summary: Pixel Brave: Idle RPG takes you on a retro pixel RPG adventure filled with epic battles, camp building, and hero collection.

games.name: Pluralys
games.summary:
Pluralys is a solo narrative RPG set in an alternate world to our blue planet.
You can explore almost every place in the game, talk to everyone, and immerse yourself in a rich story full of mystery.
You’ve been contacted by someone, but who are they, and what do they want? You’ll have to find out.
This place is certainly hiding a lot of things...

games.name: Pojangmacha: Korean Street Food Management Simulator
games.summary:
Under a snowy overpass, people gather around warm lights.
In this cozy management simulation game, run your own POJANGMACHA and serve Korean street foods like tteokbokki and ramyun.
Handle quirky events and grow your tiny stall into a street food success!

games.name: Pompeii: The Legacy
games.summary: Rebuild the city of Pompeii and climb the social ladder. Roman society is full of intrigues that you have to solve in order to become a powerful ruler.

games.name: Prop Sumo
games.summary: Prop Sumo is a physics-driven fighting game that pits ordinary props together in extraordinary battles!

games.name: Pulse Sweep
games.summary: Pulse sweep is a short incremental game where enemies are only visible when the radar sweeps them.

games.name: Puzzling Places
games.summary:
Puzzling Places brings relaxing and wholesome 3D jigsaw puzzling to VR. Put together hyper-realistic miniatures of beautiful places from around the globe. Enter the meditative flow of puzzling and enjoy each place coming alive with their unique & immersive soundscapes as you complete them.

Puzzling Places is a modern take on an age-old pastime that’s fun for the whole family thanks to its simple gameplay and easy controls. Play seated, standing, or at full roomscale!

games.name: Puzzling Places: 3D Jigsaw Sim
games.summary: A relaxed 3D jigsaw puzzle game about building detailed miniature dioramas of places from around the world.

games.name: Restore Your Island
games.summary: Heal a scarred island, rebuild habitats, play with your dog, design your sanctuary, and relax by the fire. Turn this broken, trash-filled island into a thriving sanctuary — one clean sweep at a time.

games.name: Science Literacy Check for Adults
games.summary: From basics to surprising trivia

games.name: Shika-Q
games.summary: SHIKA-Q is an online, real-time puzzle battle on a 10×10 board, where players link blocks to attack and defend. Original vocal tracks drive the action, creating an immersive experience that makes music a core part of gameplay.

games.name: Sidereal Wanderer St
games.summary: To master space warfare, the evolution of ‘Side Real Wanderer' continues. On a battlefield formed from an 8x8 grid, annihilate hostile forces.

games.name: Skara
games.summary: SKARA is a third person survival game. You need to find food and use pagan magic for healing. Wield primitive weapons to defend against enemies both animal and supernatural. Explore an open wilderness set in prehistoric times.

games.name: Skautfold: Moonless Knight
games.summary: Skautfold: Moonless Knight is a very open-ended Metroidvania, featuring a totally unique battle system. Set in an alternate history Japan in 1900, Lovecraftian horrors have plagued the world, as our very Moon opens up and becomes our end.

games.name: Solar Expanse
games.summary: Explore the Solar System. Mine and drop asteroids. Colonize and terraform. Lead the space race and compete with other corporations on your way to profit. Watch the expansion of human race over the centuries. Then go beyond and conquer the galaxy!

games.name: Spot Challenge Vol. 1
games.summary: Spot Challenge is a game series inspired by 'Find the Differences,' where you compare two images and spot over 360 differences across 35 levels. Play solo or with friends and family—test your attention to detail in this fun challenge!

games.name: Sumo Rumble
games.summary: Run, eat and fight!

games.name: Sunken Sky
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Sunken Sky and get ready for an epic action adventure through a vast open world. No place is beyond your reach - from the tallest mountains to the very minds of others. Battle bizarre creatures and befriend even stranger people. All in a detailed, hand-drawn 2D style.

games.name: Surface Breaker
games.summary: Sci-fi rogue-like mining/tower defense game. Mine through a procedurally generated world to discover artifacts. Defend your spaceship from waves of enemies. Discover and spend resources to improve your mining and spaceships combat ability.

games.name: SwooshCat
games.summary: 《SwooshCat》is a vibrant precision platform adventure game. Through jumping, dashing, slashing, downward strikes, rolling, and bouncing, help the little cat “Tangyuan” explore, fight, and make new friends in the cute pixel-art world!

games.name: Tears Revolude
games.summary:
A classic command-based RPG with 3D map interface and smooth battle animation!
A century ago, there was a unique artist named Orwiel. Sion and Michelle set off on a journey to discover his final works. The two meet a girl with no memories named Liara. What the girl carries will shake both the path they travel and their fate!

games.name: The Confinement
games.summary: The Confinement is a first-person precision platformer. Run, dodge and dash! You are trapped in Confinement, a simulation created by AmokAI. Use your sharp reflexes to overcome obstacles, escape and prove that you are the best at parkour through various levels!

games.name: The Fisherman's Secret
games.summary: The Fisherman's Secret is a web-based interactive narrative and text-adventure game built using the Twine engine. Developed as a single-player mystery, the game utilizes text-driven gameplay and player choices to dictate the progression of the narrative. Key features include a branching choice structure, multiple narrative paths, and an emphasis on atmospheric text delivery over visual graphics.

games.name: The Haunted House: Dark Island
games.summary: Dynamic anime-style battles, reimagined in a turn-based RPG!

games.name: The Last Survivors Harem
games.summary: This is a simple survivor game, and also a loot-collecting game. While fighting hordes of monsters, you can collect equipment of various qualities. Combining these equipment allows your character to gradually grow stronger.

games.name: The Way Home
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game set in the remote countryside of South Korea in the 1990s. Over the course of just three days, you will encounter a series of mysterious events and come face-to-face with an unseen, encroaching threat

games.name: Timo Boll Beats
games.summary: Timo Boll Beats is a unique rhythm game that takes place in the thrilling world of table tennis! In this game, you will have the opportunity to hit the ball like Timo Boll to the rhythm of the music, immersing yourself in a fun and thrilling experience like never before.

games.name: Tiny Utopia
games.summary: Wield over 15 unique magical tools and traverse more than 12 vastly different themed worlds in an unprecedented hidden-object adventure. In Tiny Utopia, every click is filled with strategy and wonder.

games.name: Town of Zoz
games.summary: Fight with flavor! As Ito, a young shaman chef adventurer, you'll hunt critters, gather magical ingredients and rebuild bonds by cooking for the townspeople. A shaman chef always aims to lend a helping hand, but the more Ito gets involved, the more he'll learn about the town and its ancient secrets.

games.name: Untimely Hidden: Patara
games.summary: Our Time Agent Jaxon has a new mission: his arch-nemesis has stirred things up again. Now he should follow her to the ancient city of Patara and find the modern-day objects scattered around the city that she left behind.

games.name: Viscerafest
