games.summary: Viscerafest is a Sci-Fi Fantasy Singleplayer Arena FPS with minor Collectathon elements. Fight through hordes of aliens and eldritch monstrosities wielding a slew of powerful weapons, juggling your resources, and exploring over 26 intricately designed hand crafted levels.

games.name: Weed Supermarket Simulator
games.summary: Grow weed and grow your business! Run your own weed supermarket, manage stock, set prices, and help customers. Try new strains, choose the best products, upgrade your shop, and keep your store running smoothly so people always come back.

games.name: Which Era Is This? Japanese History Era Guess Quiz
games.summary: Which Era? Master Japanese History in Quick Quizzes

games.name: Which Era Is This? World History Era Guess Quiz
games.summary: Name the era! A fast 4-choice World History quiz that connects the timeline.

games.name: Whisker Wanderlust: Unwritten Chapter
games.summary: Wait... WHAT?! My human just vanished into a magic portal! The 3rd Whisker Wanderlust adventure begins! Explore a whimsical fantasy world, meet quirky new friends, and follow the clues to bring your owner home. May every kitty be loved! ♥♥♥

games.name: Wrath: Aeon of Ruin VR - Brutal Edition
games.summary: Hunt the corrupted Guardians and purge a dying world in Wrath: Aeon of Ruin VR, a brutal old-school FPS built in the legendary Quake engine and reimagined for virtual reality. With dual-wielding combat, physical reloading, and deadly artifacts at your command, the darkness doesn’t stand a chance.

games.name: You’d Be Surprised!? Everyday English Vocabulary Fill-in-the-Blank Quiz
games.summary:
Everyday English Words You Might Not Know!
Fill-in-the-Blank Quiz Fun!

games.name: 100 Snack Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

games.name: [Redacted] the Safehouse
games.summary: You're a detective. Investigate the haunting events surrounding the murder of Ann Peterson and her boyfriend. Explore an old safehouse for clues, deduce keywords and reveal redacted words as you search Ann's digital journal, and piece together your case report as this unfortunate story unfolds.

games.name: A Game About Going Up
games.summary: A chaotic third-person precision platformer about climbing to the top of an unforgiving and brutal vertical level. Just go up and try not to fall. Your patience will be tested.

games.name: Alchemist Watch
games.summary: You're trapped in an Alchemist's Study, reliving the same day over and over. Use telekinesis to fix or destroy physics-based anomalies, break the loop, and escape.

games.name: Anime Minesweeper
games.summary: Anime Minesweeper with stories and secrets. Solve puzzles, meet girls, and unlock new modes. Squares, triangles, hexagons—the mines are waiting!

games.name: Beauty Store Simulator
games.summary: Run your own beauty store in Beauty Store Simulator! Manage a variety of cosmetics, fashion items, jewelry, and more. Design your store, keep customers happy, and build a successful beauty empire. Can you become the ultimate beauty mogul?

games.name: Bow and Banister
games.summary: Take control of a struggling violinist as he scales impossible stone staircases toward a fateful performance for the king. No shortcuts — just you, your bow, and the endless climb ahead.

games.name: Briefcase
games.summary: Briefcase is an atmospheric and satisfying inventory organization puzzle game featuring 50 handcrafted levels. Test your logic and attention to detail as you arrange weapons and items correctly to progress.

games.name: Cafe Business Manager
games.summary: Build, design and manage your own café in this detailed cafe management simulator. Hire staff, craft your menu, serve customers and grow your coffee shop business in a lively island city.

games.name: Card Trainer
games.summary: A simple but hard card game where you collect unique unit cards and use them to rummage through stages looking for new cards.

games.name: Cavedude
games.summary:
Battle your way through endless waves of monsters in a progression-driven action RPG where every run makes you stronger.

You take control of a lone hero fighting against increasingly powerful enemies in a continuously scaling world. Combat is real-time and focused on building a powerful character through upgrades, gear, and magical abilities.

games.name: Chop Chains
games.summary: Chop Chains is a relaxing incremental game where you chop, gather, and upgrade to become the ultimate lumberjack through trees, axes, and skills.

games.name: Cool Story Bro!
games.summary: Cool Story Bro! is a chaotic 2 - 4 player party game where you write short stories based on 4 random words. Vote for the most creative masterpiece, sabotage your friends with items, survive unexpected game - changing events… and if you really hate someone’s story? Just... Blow. Them. Up!

games.name: Cora
games.summary: CORA (Counter Offensive Rapidfire Automata) is a singleplayer/multiplayer top-down shooter created by Empty House Games borrowing inspiration from other arcade top-down shooters.

games.name: Crystalfall
games.summary:
Loot-Driven Action RPG in a Steampunk World

Take on the role of a convict who has been thrown into the dungeons by a powerful ruling organization. Embark on a journey through a world devastated by a mysterious asteroid, scattering powerful crystal shards across distinct world zones brimming with mutated creatures and steampunk enemies.

Delve into post-apocalyptic dungeons that randomize upon each visit and ascend to new heights of power with epic loot, extensive talent tree progression, theorycrafting and lootable skills.

games.name: Cube Hopper
games.summary: Cube Hopper is a 2D platformer where you cannot die. Goal is to complete levels as fast as possible, with or without friends. There is also a level editor that lets you make your own levels that can be played online.

games.name: Cursed Core
games.summary: Cursed Core is a small, hardcore survival sandbox set in an open, randomly generated world.

games.name: Damn Exam
games.summary: Defend your school from the unrelenting mass of cheating students. Can you survive exam week without getting fired, or will your students outsmart you? Fail those cheating, pesky students!

games.name: Drunk Woodcutter
games.summary: Chop wood, drink beer, hack yourself in the kneecaps. An absurdly escalating woodsplitting sim where booze makes you stronger, and upgrades only get more ridiculous.

games.name: Ethoterria's Last Soldier
games.summary: Ethoterria's last soldier is a platformer with integrated PvE combat. Dungeons, which act as levels, are connected through a broader open world. Completing dungeons upgrades your characters stats. The platforming has a very high difficulty leading to frustrating but satisfying gameplay.

games.name: Evershard: Heroes of Gallan's Landing
games.summary: A fantasy roguelite game where players gather their party of heroes and adventure into dungeons filled with dangerous monsters in order to collect Loot and Exp required to level up their party.

games.name: Extinction Day
games.summary: Extinction Day is a strategy simulation game in which players orchestrate the end of humanity using a variety of catastrophic events including disasters, diseases, and wars. Players combine different catastrophes to overwhelm human survival efforts and spread destruction across the globe.

games.name: Far From Dead
games.summary: A twitchy shoot 'em up boss rush game inspired by run 'n gun classics. Fight your way through seven challenging bosses and hitch a ride off this awful planet.

games.name: Fast Mine Sweeping: Skill Awakening
games.summary: 《Lightning-Fast Mine Sweeping: Skill Awakening》 Choose different characters, combine various skills, and quickly complete challenging minesweeper levels. Features classic minesweeper, standard roguelike gameplay, and challenge mode. With 4 characters and over 100 skills.

games.name: Feralpals
games.summary: Feralpals is a story-driven, chapter-based horror game created by Polypaw, with this release being Chapter 01: Old Friend

games.name: Fight Life: Vanguard
games.summary: Engage in strategic turn-based combat, manage and upgrade each character, and strive to reclaim harmony in a world on the brink of oblivion. Take on the mantle of leadership as you guide a mercenary squad through perilous landscapes, selecting your comrades from a diverse pool of skilled recruits.

games.name: FlapDeath
games.summary: FlapDeath is a CO-OP neon mouse rage game to play with friends. Avoid incoming hazards while trying to pass a bomb around. If you hold the bomb for too long, you die and all your team members go down with you so be careful!

games.name: Fog
games.summary: You have just escaped a murderous cult that has now summoned a ginormous being to track you down. It and the ones it controls will stop at nothing to hunt you down while you try to find food, money, and anything else you can use to survive in this horror roguelike adventure.

games.name: Fonsermónique’s Culinary Diary
games.summary: Fonsermónique's Culinary Diary is a short, linear narrative game where cooking becomes a bridge to the soul. As you prepare different recipes, you'll gather feedback that accompanies Fonsermónique on her personal journey, while you explore the temple in search of ingredients and of the dragon, gradually uncovering the peculiar relationship that binds them through small moments connected to the past.

games.name: Gas Station Simulator
games.summary: Gas Station Simulator is all about renovating, expanding and running a gas station along a highway in the middle of a desert. Freedom of choice and multiple approaches to run your business and deal with pressure are key ingredients in this game.

games.name: Glyph Gambit: Endgame
games.summary: Glyph Gambit: Endgame is a tactical grid battler powered by a real chess engine. Soulslike/roguelite runs, authentic chess movement, and tactical items create deep, replayable battles in the sequel the original was meant to be.

games.name: Goob Wants an Android Girlfriend
games.summary: A cute puzzle game about fixing up android girls! Grow your collection of girlfriends and prove your wits by solving clever yet intuitive puzzles!

games.name: Guts 'n Grunts
games.summary: Inspired by games like Contra and Turrican, Guts 'n Grunts is a mid-paced action game with lots of shooting, swimming, and rolling. Find power-ups. Earn upgrades. Fight for pig freedom!

games.name: Hentai Tales: Infinite Climax - Endless Ecstasy
games.summary: Enjoy a sensual story while completing tricky puzzles! Connect the numbers sequentially, using all of the squares on the board. After completing a puzzle, you will unlock a sexy new image and the next part of the story!

games.name: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
games.summary: Drive Fast. Crash Hard.

games.name: Labyrinth.os

games.name: Lady At The Costco Gave Me Her Extra Hot Dog Soda Combo
games.summary: She told me to make someone smile today!

games.name: Lastlore Saga
games.summary: Select your party in this tactical RPG roguelike. Choose from a list of characters with unique abilities and gear for vast amount of build ideas. Classic feel of old school 16 bit RPG games, updated roguelike gameplay and progression for infinite replayability!

games.name: Little One
games.summary: Explore the dreary world of Little One, an atmospheric 2D RPG, as you meet the unusual inhabitants and fight off the monsters that lurk in its darkest corners.

games.name: Looters
games.summary: A couch co-op goblin heist for 2 players. Sneak, stack, and steal your way through a guarded manor packed with enemies, secrets, and loot. Take everything… and get out alive.

games.name: Marooned
games.summary: In Marooned, players take on the role of the survivalist Ed, tasked with surviving in some of the most brutal environments across the globe, including the Thailand Jungle, a Philippine island, and the African Plain. Starting with absolutely no tools, clothes, food, or water, players must utilize their survival wits to overcome the harsh environment. The game requires building shelters, setting campfire nodes, managing extreme health parameters, and gathering resources through meticulous tracking and crafting.

games.name: Mask da Fart
games.summary: Beat the Stinky Allegations by Masking your Farts as an Intern at your first day on the job

games.name: Mota Must Die

games.name: My Friend Barrington

Play as a stuffed bear navigating symbolic worlds, FMV moments, platforming challenges, and emotional choices as fear turns into agency in a 15-minute story experience.

games.name: Nature's Question
games.summary: Climb the Ancient Tree and test your knowledge of nature

games.name: Ninjora Echoes
games.summary: Take control of the young ninja Hiko and his shadow clones to solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and save the village from the sinister monk Doku.

games.name: No More Work for Ito
games.summary: Trapped in a cursed office overnight, you must uncover a hidden password before morning... while reality distorts, blood seeps through the walls, and something watches you. Explore branching paths, face strange encounters, and survive this psychological horror visual novel.

games.name: Noslrac
games.summary: A casual dungeon crawler ARPG with three unique classes with differing playstyles and distinctive skill trees. Choose your conqueror, level up, slay monsters, complete campaigns, obtain better loot, and gather resources to craft the most customizable and powerful items the game has to offer.

games.name: Obey the Insect God
games.summary: Step foot into the lair of the Insect God...if you dare. Face brutal enemies in pulse-pounding combat with digitized sprites that harken back to your favorite controversial fighting game from the ’90s that your mom’s hairdresser’s kid let you play that one time. The castle awaits…

games.name: OpenQuacks
games.summary: Free, fast-paced, push-your-luck potion making game. Brew & sell your potions, buy ingredients to make better potions. But if you add too many berries, your pot explodes!

games.name: Paper Shakespeare 3: Girl Werewolf Hamlet Absolutely Solves the War of the Roses
games.summary: Guide a squad of ten young adults through a kingdom on the brink of war! Navigate court politics, deadly rivalries, and magical chaos between Humans, Fae, and Werewolves... where every choice can make or break your future.

games.name: Parcel Inspection Simulator
games.summary: Welcome to Parcel Inspection Simulator, where every package tells a story — and every detail matters. Step into the role of an inspector responsible for keeping the flow of parcels moving smoothly. From small envelopes to large shipments, dozens of packages pass through your hands each day. Check documents, inspect deliveries, and make sure everything reaches the right destination. Stay sharp, work efficiently, and turn a small inspection point into a thriving logistics operation.

games.name: Pick Three!!!
games.summary: The game where you pick from three! Choose your weapon ball and fight others in unstable best-of-3 matches, upgrade your stats, and bounce around the arena until you finally claim victory. Get popular and have your fans assist you, and befriend the Ref to maximize your odds.

games.name: Please Don't Shoot the Humans
games.summary: Click with laser-focus to blast zombies while civilians wander in like they missed every safety memo. Stack upgrades, unleash turrets, and watch the numbers explode. See how long you can keep pretending everything is under control.

games.name: Project Scrapper
games.summary: Project Scrapper is a casual 2D objective shooter with one caveat: players have no guns. Armed with just gravitational rivets and an anti-gravity jump, players will need to come up with their own strategies on the fly to succeed.

games.name: R.E.C
games.summary: A Survival horror shooter blending first- and third-person combat. Engage in tactical firefights, manage scarce resources, and survive intense hybrid encounters as shifting perspectives and unique environments heighten tension and immersion.

games.name: Railmount
games.summary: Monty is showing off!!!

games.name: Reappearance of a Stopped Clock
games.summary:
An Irish tech CEO disappears along with his company's time machine. Three hours later, he's found dead on the opposite side of the world.
Two witnesses to the disappearance start to piece together what really happened.

games.name: Rise Online
games.summary: Rise Online is the Massively Multiplayer Online Role Playing Game (MMORPG) developed by Rokosoft.

games.name: River Runners
games.summary: River Runners is a cooperative multiplayer adventure where you and your friends navigate a dangerous, unpredictable river. Clear communication and teamwork are essential to steer the raft, overcome hidden challenges, and survive the journey to the end.

games.name: Rogue Doodle
games.summary: "You’re a tiny ninja on a giant sheet of paper. Dash across ink-thin platforms, dodge brutal traps, drop enemies with your bow, grab every coin you can, and dive through portals to find the exit. Rogue Doodle delivers tight, fast platforming with crisp pixel style, quick-to-learn controls, and “one more run” challenge."

games.name: Rose Guns Days: Season 1
games.summary:
In 1944, unprecedented disaster struck Japan, forcing it to accept an unconditional ceasefire from its enemy nations in World War 2. As a result, the Japanese have become a people without a nation, but they still come together and do whatever it takes to live without giving up...

A multilingual HD version of 07th Expansion's Rose Guns Days by MangaGamer.

games.name: Samurai Obby
games.summary: Do you have the discipline to conquer the Samurai Trial?

games.name: Saturday Sábado
games.summary: A game with more than 100 unique challenges, in various gameplay styles, mainly focused on precision platforming.

games.name: Seth
games.summary: Become Seth, god of storms, and crush Apophis’s legions in a fast-paced roguelite FPS blending Egyptian mythology with science fiction. Fast combat, random challenges, and divine power in every run.

games.name: Skull Horde
games.summary: Skull Horde is an auto battler dungeon crawler where you play as a flying skull necromancer. Find powerful loot and create overpowered builds. Summon a horde of skeletons in a battle of bone versus flesh!

games.name: Sol Cesto
games.summary: Sol Cesto is a tactical and frenetic roguelite in which you have to master your luck. Choose a hero and reach the bottom of a random dungeon. In this grim world, every action has consequences...

games.name: Soulmask
games.summary: Soulmask is a sandbox game that prioritizes an authentic survival experience. As the "last one" blessed with the mysterious mask, players will grapple for survival in a primitive land steeped in mysterious faiths, carving out a path to ascendance. Start from nothing, explore, build, recruit tribesmen to fortify your clan, and ultimately unravel the mysterious truths hidden behind the civilizations of this world.

games.name: Space Salvage Simulator
games.summary: Welcome to Space Salvage Simulator. Saddled with an unfair debt, you're locked in a forced labor camp on the edge of the galaxy. Scavenge and craft from an endless stream of trash to earn an honest living, or bet it all in the underground arena for a quick jackpot. Pay your debt, buy your freedom!

games.name: Speedshot
games.summary: SPEEDSHOT is an ultra-fast FPS built for speedrunning. Master the fluid movement, chain abilities together, and destroy all targets to become a legend.

games.name: Spire of Chaos: Arcana Unleashed
games.summary: Spire of Chaos: Arcana Unleashed is a 3D souls-lite action game where you play as Arxis, a magical girl linked to the Tower, a source of chaotic power and one of the most feared arcana of the Tarot.

games.name: Tamashika
games.summary:
The game is about keeping your mind at one place.

Patterns in sensate experience reinforce an illusion of continuity. The dream is a construction of the mind that perpetuates the illusion.

The cartesian prison is a hall of mirrors, a recursive labyrinth. Each a reflection of me—only patterns and processes.

The present moment is the only thing that is real—focus. Chaotic attractors are seizing your attention. Don’t push or pull at it.

You have to reduce model complexity, you must cultivate flow. The game is about keeping your mind at one place!

Concentrate… and remember… Attention is all you need.

games.name: Terrier Manager
games.summary: Rats have infested your farm! Train a team of terriers to hunt them down in this incremental idle game. Breed your dogs to strengthen your team as you hunt down the ten Rat Lords who have taken over.

games.name: Tezzel: The Tilemaker's Tale
games.summary: Tezzel is a cozy, colorful, and crafty puzzle game where every move helps make a masterpiece. Discover mind-bending mechanics across 100 handcrafted levels.

games.name: That Summer: Hannah's Summer Vacation
games.summary: In a quiet, somewhat remote town, Hannah lives with her father and younger brother. Eventually the summer break comes, and with it the question: "How to spend the last summer before her senior year in high school?"

games.name: The Anubis Treasure
games.summary: Embark on an epic adventure in The Treasure of Anubis, a minimalist 2D platformer.

games.name: The Echoes of Me
games.summary: The Echoes of Me is a first‑person horror experience focused on tense exploration and completing objective‑based sequences under pressure. You’ll move through dark environments, search for key items, and trigger events that push the story forward. Typical gameplay centres on roaming, solving environmental puzzles, and avoiding enemies that react to your presence. Expect scripted scares, dynamic jump scares, a quick‑time event, and a chase sequence.

games.name: The Hunter Files: Case One
games.summary: The Hunter Files: Case One is a story driven point and click adventure about a private detective caught in routine work. What starts as a simple surveillance job slowly turns into a missing person case, told through dialogue, puzzles, and exploration.

games.name: The Pissing Game
games.summary: Step into a bizarre world where even taking a piss becomes a quest. Kill bugs, earn Piss-coins, upgrade, unlock hidden areas… and ultimately, flush.

games.name: The Shadow Architect
games.summary: Are new bans coming to your country? You, bring even more. Forget city-building games. You're not a builder, you're a DESTROYER. Use taxes and bureaucracy to collapse a flawlessly functioning dystopian industrial system from within. A card-based ideological collapse simulation game.

games.name: Tiny Bookshop
games.summary: Leave everything behind and open a Tiny Bookshop by the sea in this ambient narrative management game. Stock your wagon, set up shop in scenic locations, and navigate a post-capitalist future alongside Bookstonbury’s eclectic cast of characters.

games.name: Trees Adventure
games.summary: Trees Adventure is a 2D side-view platformer where in single player you control two characters at once, and in online or local co-op each player controls their own character

games.name: Turbo Rivals
games.summary: Turbo Rivals is a high-octane arcade racer where speed is a currency and every corner is a battlefield. Master the art of the perfect drift to charge your turbo, outmaneuver aggressive AI rivals who adapt to your every move.

games.name: Val's Adventures at Scure Manor

Players must rely on clever thinking, keen observation, and inventive use of everyday items to navigate the sprawling mansion, solve puzzles, and interact with quirky characters.

games.name: Veins of Darkness
games.summary: Veins of Darkness is a first-person horror game. The hero is an ordinary shift worker. During a business trip, his company rented him a house on the outskirts. But no one knew what evil was hiding in this godforsaken place.

games.name: Wannabe Galgame God!!!
games.summary: Those who skip Galgames are mere corporate drones; those who play are the true masters of wealth and power. That's just the way of the world! As an ordinary boy, wager your wildest fetishes and your dignity to reach the summit: Become the 'GALGAME GOD'!

games.name: We Need a Doorman.

games.name: Wobble Wobble

games.name: Wordy Online
games.summary: Rediscover the fun of wordplay in this modern, colorful collection of popular games with fresh ideas! Play through the campaign or a huge dictionary of words: learn, earn rewards, track your progress, and even climb the leaderboards — play solo, with friends, and with players worldwide!

games.name: Wrath of Sweetheart
games.summary: Wrath of Sweetheart is a 3D action-based RPG, exploration-driven open-world roguelike adventure game. The game has a high degree of freedom, game modes, and a wide variety of gameplay.

games.name: Xtreme Drift Racing Simulator

games.name: 8-Hour Workday
games.summary: 8-hour Workday is an anomaly search game inspired by Exit 8 and Platform 8. The player needs to explore a creepy, ominous office where dangerous anomalies are lurking around and try to make it through the work hours. There are 27 anomalies in the game. See if you can solve them all!

games.name: Agent Sirius

games.name: Horde of Viscount
games.summary:
Step into a land infested by the massive Horde of Viscount

Traverse through both classic-vania stages and regions with exploration where you use subweapons for your advanced movement. Be wary, you only have a limited amount of these subweapons. Instead, you must plan your actions wisely. Use the Dash Knife to attack your enemies from far away? -or perhaps use it to flee?

games.name: Making Lovers: First Blush
games.summary:
While you're helping out as an audio tech at the Shionari Tanabata festival, you cross paths with four unique girls. Each of them is charming in her own way, but while you're open to the idea of dating, you firmly believe that one should only date someone who is obviously your fated partner, and that the signs will all be there. But then you all end up in the same mystical place at the same time, so what if one of them is...?

Read this amusing story about a stubborn protagonist and the four cute girls with whom he has some sort of connection, and see how he grows to consider whether destiny really is as heavy-handed as he thinks.

games.name: Medieval Invasion
games.summary: Build towers, defend your main structure from waves of enemies in an intense strategy game. Prove your skills, join the legends!

games.name: Nepotism for Germany
games.summary: Satirical political strategy: From local party to Orban's palace. Corruption has never been this much fun.

games.name: Sad Virus Darkland
games.summary: Sad Virus is back now in dark themed land called darkland. Mission again collect beer bottles in this third person adventure walking game

games.name: Tactilite
games.summary: Tactilite is a modern, single-player football management simulation that blends deep strategic planning with RPG-inspired progression. Eschewing the complex spreadsheets of traditional managers for a more character-focused experience, it challenges you to take a team from the lower leagues to the pinnacle of world football.

games.name: The Old Man’s Will
games.summary: Welcome to your grandfather’s old property, a lonely patch of land deep in the woods. Strange creatures roam the area at night, hungry and unpredictable. Watch the cameras, keep them fed, and try to make it through five long nights alive.

games.name: The Succubus Trap Island
games.summary:
Leaf, a female knight serving as the princess’s bodyguard, visits the island of Torion — a tourist spot known for its ancient ruins.
However, due to a small mishap and the schemes of the succubi who manage the island, she ends up having to conquer a dungeon filled with traps.

Will Leaf be able to reach Princess Marika, who awaits deep within the island?

games.name: Treasure Blast Quest
games.summary: Easy to learn and fun to master, Treasure Blast Quest is perfect for players who enjoy casual treasure hunting, score chasing, and satisfying arcade-style gameplay.

games.name: Vida Loka Simulator
games.summary: Vida Loka Simulator is a motorcycle arcade game inspired by the urban chaos of São Paulo. Ride against traffic, dodge cars, perform wheelies to earn points, and survive as long as possible. Compete on the global leaderboard and dominate the digital streets.

games.name: Viking Farm
games.summary:
Survive in the Nordic lands, grow crops, raise animals, produce goods, and prosper.

Choose a character and manage the daily life of a Viking. Plant and harvest a variety of crops, feed your animals, and sell livestock or loot to expand and improve your farm.

Gather resources to grow. Mine gold, chop trees for wood, and use a pickaxe to collect stone. Manage your production carefully and keep your character well-fed to stay strong on your journey.

In addition to raising and caring for animals such as chickens, horses, sheep, pigs, and cows, you will also encounter creatures from Norse mythology, including the horse Sleipnir, the stag Eikthyrnir, the wolf Fenrir, and the world serpent Jörmungandr. In your fields, grow carrots, mushrooms, corn, turnips, cabbage, and wheat to keep your farm productive.

games.name: Almost Out
games.summary: Almost Out is a horror escape room simulator where you must escape a psycho while leaving no traces of your escape attempt.

games.name: Demining
games.summary: Demining is a 1-4 player semi open-world horror experience where every step could be your last. Work together or by yourself as you disarm deadly mines, delve into bountiful ruins, and fight to see another day.

games.name: Hungerwinter
games.summary:
IT IS THE WORST WINTER ON RECORD. FAMINE GRIPS THE CONTINENT.

Join Ida Guggenhofer and Rosa Huber as they meet their friends, meet their foes and explore the city they hope to save. HUNGERWINTER is a short, linear visual novel set in The Lovely Ladyverse, and is a prequel to the upcoming game Waterhead.

games.name: Iftar for Two
games.summary: Iftar for Two is a very short kinetic novel made for Ramadan game Jam 2024. It features two former friends who decide to have iftar together and talk about bits about this and that.

games.name: King's Lynn Leisure Farm
games.summary: King's Lynn Leisure Farm is a farm idle game with racing driver theme. Here, you can collect a variety of cute animals, play with them, feed them, and send them out to work. You can also collect various vehicles to decorate your farm. Enjoy your time on the farm with your little animal friends!

games.name: Please Weave the Red Stars Into a Shroud for Wrapping the Corpse
games.summary: This is a forgotten tale that took place in a now-extinct country.

games.name: Run the Backrooms
games.summary: Run the Backrooms is a cooperative horror game that supports up to 6 players. The game has several levels and entities that will certainly make your gameplay very exciting. The game has free updates, always bringing new game levels and bug fixes.

games.name: The Cluster
games.summary: Experience the story of Richard, a poor hunter, and his wife, Lilith. They are fighting to escape their circumstances with high hopes that their hard work is finally about to pay off, allowing them to leave this place behind forever.

games.name: The Fish Shack
games.summary:
A fun, free browser-based fishing game designed for Twitch streamers and their viewers.

Viewers can join the stream’s fishing pond directly through chat commands — no downloads, no sign-ups, completely free. Cast your line, catch fish, and climb the leaderboard in real-time alongside other viewers.

games.name: Treasure Clicker
games.summary: Tap the chest, buy upgrades, and grow a hoard that spirals into absurdity. Hire heroes, fund guild research, and spend Essence on a skill tree that persists between prestiges. When you need a change of pace, race the clock in speed challenges or descend into The Abyss

games.name: Words for in Between
games.summary: "speak, should the frost grow too bitter for thee to endure."

games.name: Atmosphere
games.summary:
Doing crimes is hard.

Made by walking away in silence for DOMINO CLUB. Music by Ketsa and Komiku Made with VIDEOTOME

games.name: ATYI
games.summary: Move your arms, move your legs!

games.name: Backpack Survivors
games.summary:
A crossover between bullet heaven and inventory management. In Backpack Survivors the player fills his backpack with weapons and items which are then used during the bullet heaven portion of the game. During this, the player will kill hordes of enemies and keep upgrading their backpack to grow stronger and even defeat bosses.

Backpack Survivors has roguelite elements with unlockables and a large talent tree, allowing the player even more customizability over the game.

Backpack Survivors is currently in Alpha and is slated for a release into Early Access in late 2024.

games.name: Before I Go
games.summary: Explore the haunting, dreamlike fantasy world of BEFORE I GO, a punishing Metroidvania where you embody the innocence of an inner child on an allegorical odyssey towards death acceptance. The end is inevitable, but will you brave the journey?

games.name: Cubetory
games.summary: Create the ultimate cube processing factory on an island that grows with your base! Progression is tied to your rate of production, so you'll face lots of scaling challenges as you work your way through increasingly difficult production chains. No enemies, no time limit, pure automation goodness.

games.name: Don't Skip The Beat
games.summary: Don’t Skip The Beat is a clean, arcade-style rhythm game where notes fall and you hit Up, Down, Left, and Right in time to the music across five energetic tracks. Learn the patterns, lock into the groove, and rack up points with precise timing—no fluff, just neon vibes, crisp feedback, and the pure satisfaction of nailing the beat. Quick to pick up and replayable by design, it’s all about chasing that better score and proving you won’t skip the beat.

games.name: Edu Simulator
games.summary: EDU SIMULATOR is a satirical horror roguelite with a distinct retro aesthetic inspired by the PSX era and Windows 98 interfaces. Players must survive unforgiving labyrinth chase mechanics while advancing through a perk-based progression system, navigating an atmosphere that blends survival horror tension with the absurd humor behind being chased by a flat sliding picture.

games.name: Elevator
games.summary: 电梯 Elevator is a first-person psychology horror puzzle game. You woke up in an malfunctioned elevator and found yourself trapped in the floors of a different era. Find your way to escape.

games.name: Forgive or Finalize
games.summary: A short-form psychological thriller. Confront the mysterious Finn through a monitor. No strategy or puzzles—just choices and their consequences. Simply answer his questions and witness the end.

games.name: Full Metal Sergeant 2
games.summary: The Sergeant is back. Ready to turn unqualified recruits into fearless war machines. Manage your camp and prepare your squad with tougher training and new challenges, will they be ready for a real battlefield? New skill tree, more abilities and a reworked battle system. Start you deployment now.

games.name: Funerama
games.summary:
Step into the sick mind of a novelist
As her inner world slowly falls into ruin, step into the mind of Othilie Wynne, a once-successful novelist obsessed with the darkest corners of modern literature.

games.name: Gunboat God
games.summary: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

games.name: Laundry Simulator
games.summary: Laundry Simulator is a chill, ASMR laundry cleaning, and shop management game. Open your own Laundromat, and deal with dirty clothes and customers. Clean and manage your shop, upgrade your equipment, unlock new skills and hire workers. Your laundry empire awaits!

games.name: Loot Loop
games.summary: Build a party of heroes and send them into dungeons in this quick incremental RPG. Fight monsters, collect loot, and unlock upgrades. Fast runs, deep skill tree, zero stress.

games.name: Lunaris
games.summary: Lunaris is a fast-paced sci-fi top-down roguelite shooter: survive escalating enemy waves, stack powerful passive and active abilities, craft wild build synergies, and turn the arena into a neon storm of lasers and explosions. Every run feels fresh and intense.

games.name: Mirror Protocol
games.summary: Mirror Protocol is an Arcade Hack and Slash Sci-Fi experience. Face relentless hordes of Humanoids and Drones in an arena where fast reflexes and a high-stakes combo scoring system dictate your survival. Become truly invincible by mastering an impenetrable defense, reflecting every bullet right back at your enemies.

games.name: ModernFire
games.summary: Assemble a combat group with infantry, vehicles, and commander abilities, attack and hold sectors using artillery and aerial reconnaissance.

games.name: Moves Of The Diamond Hand
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a first-person urban RPG, powered by dice and intrigue. This demo is the start of a journey where you might even shape the fate of a city. Whatever it takes to get the gig, right?

games.name: My Neighbor Stinks
games.summary: A 3D first-person horror-comedy where players explore spooky environments, solve quirky challenges, and encounter bizarre, funny, and frightening moments.

games.name: Never Ending Beyond
games.summary: The only roguelite where you must pet animals to survive. Each animal comes with its own unique weapons and passive abilities. Pet animals, mixing and matching abilities to create unique skill builds and conquer the Beyond.

games.name: Nimillion: The Last Expedition
games.summary: Metroidvania Spaceship adventure with physics-based rocket ship controls. Retro-inspired Thruster-only flight, unlock and upgrade abilities, solve physics puzzles, battle tough bosses, conquer brutal terrain. Easy to learn, hard to master old-school thrills!

games.name: Oceaneers
games.summary: A survival-crafting colony sim set in a flooded world of unstable islands. Build a colony, craft gear, design rafts, fend off sharks, manage your survivors, and explore island bunkers to uncover lost Float-Tech from an old-world corporation.

games.name: Paw Alliance
games.summary: Become the universe's deadliest and most adorable special agent in this high-octane 2.5D roguelite action game! Mow down hordes of mutant creatures, discover a vast arsenal of items and skills to craft your perfect build, and uncover the shocking truth behind the catastrophic Swarm!

games.name: Pebble Knights
games.summary: Eat your way to power! Hungry little pebbles fight back against the spreading Hell Fungus in this 1–5 player co-op action roguelike. Scavenge by day, survive relentless nights, and build massive synergies that snowball every run. Teammate down? Eat them back to life. Fight… or fall.

games.name: Pinball With a Gun
games.summary: If you die in Pinball, you die for real! Experience the classic arcade game with a Russian Roulette murderpop twist, and go for the Big Score! Don't worry about getting your head blown off, who even said that could happen?

games.name: Pippin Please
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a dramatic yet charming and witty world of evidence-gathering, deduction and courtroom battles in this adventure of mediocre lawyer Pippin Please.

games.name: Relic Abyss
games.summary: Experience a unique hand-crafted Bullet Heaven Roguelite RPG set in a Fantasy x Sci-fi world filled with might, magic, and lost technology! A mysterious tale centered around a world-devouring Abyss awaits...

games.name: Ruinlander
games.summary: Ruinlander is an open-world role-playing game with turn-based combat where you must survive in the post-apocalyptic wasteland as long as you can.

games.name: Sad Virus Cave
games.summary: Walking simulation and platformer game. Control sad virus in cave enviroment and try find all beer bottles and avoid traps

games.name: Seeds of Calamity
games.summary: Take part in healing after the Great Calamity. Tend your farm, complete quests for the villagers, and explore dungeons filled with challenge and treasure in this cozy, solo-developed farming sim. Build a new life in a recovering world with your fluffy Spellbook Companion.

games.name: Stoplights
games.summary: Stoplights is a strategy simulation game about creating an efficient train network to support the growing needs of your cities. Make connections by building rails, control train routes with traffic signals to get essential resources where they need to be - in time.

games.name: Tap Tap Loot
games.summary: The world is under attack, and every tap fights back. Each keystroke unleashes your cute cat hero, smashing enemies and showering you with loot. Dive into a never-ending desktop expedition with friends or solo. Tap. Tap. Loot.

games.name: Time Shock
games.summary: Rip through fractured timelines fighting robots, drones and bosses. Rank up as different characters with special abilities. Upgrade weaponized vehicles with future technology. Timelines favor the AI army. Will you tip the balance?

games.name: Tower of Square
games.summary: This is a simple puzzle adventure where you play as a triangle-shaped protagonist, moving up, down, left, and right to bravely ascend a 48-story tower, familiarizing yourself with and utilizing the movement patterns of various creatures within the tower.

games.name: Under the Disco Lights: 80's Bar Simulator
games.summary: Step into a neon-lit 1980s disco! Under the Disco Lights lets you manage the bar, serve drinks, read customers, and uncover secrets - all in first-person. Featuring stylized visuals, reactive characters, and a fully original 1980s-inspired soundtrack that keeps the night alive.

games.name: Universal Weirdness
games.summary: A 2D hand-drawn puzzle adventure that spans multiple dimensions and universes. Encounter a diverse cast of characters and unravel mind-bending mysteries as you embark on unique adventures across different worlds.

games.name: Unknown Space
games.summary: The Darkness Guild is lost in Unknown Space! Go on a top down, bite-sized adventure and blast off to three far out planets. Explore Unknown Space from your ship and collect resources to change the ship's look for the climactic Shoot 'Em Up battle! Do you have what it takes escape from Unknown Space?

games.name: Voidloop
games.summary: Voidloop is a mining adventure with roguelite elements. Explore procedural caves, fight dangerous enemies, and upgrade your abilities as you race to find your way back home to the void.

games.name: Wandsmith
games.summary: Wandsmith is a magical action roguelike with weapons that change every run. You cast spells that you build yourself, with wands that you are continually upgrading and customizing. Fight through castles of enemies in search of stronger foes and greater rewards.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate (Classic)
games.summary: Command a squad of up to 20 Space Marines and battle the forces of Chaos led by Chaos Lord Zymran. Chaos Gate is a squad-level, turn-based tactical strategy game set in the grim Warhammer 40,000 world.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Fire Warrior (Classic)
games.summary: Become an elite Fire Warrior and fight the forces of the Imperium of Man in an action-packed classic FPS. Experience Warhammer 40,000 from a unique T'au perspective with a story full of twists and betrayal.

games.name: Warhammer: Dark Omen (Classic)
games.summary: Enter the Warhammer Fantasy world in Warhammer: Dark Omen, a classic real-time strategy game known for its tactical battles, atmospheric campaign, and cult-classic status.

games.name: Warhammer: Mark of Chaos - Gold Edition (Classic)
games.summary: Command the armies of the Empire, the Hordes of Chaos, Orcs & Goblins, and other iconic Warhammer Fantasy factions in massive real-time battles. Warhammer: Mark of Chaos is a classic RTS celebrated for its unprecedented scale and detail for its time.

games.name: Warhammer: Shadow of the Horned Rat (Classic)
games.summary: Halt the tide of evil threatening the Empire in Warhammer: Shadow of the Horned Rat, a classic real-time strategy game where you command a mercenary army against the servants of the Horned Rat.

games.name: We Who Rise
games.summary: A fast-paced vertical arcade platformer where you, a brave knight, climb an endless tower packed with tricky traps. Leap over spikes, dodge spears, outmaneuver blades and saws, stay ahead of danger, and chase your high score in a light-hearted but thrilling test of reflexes and timing.

games.name: WEJbA: We Exist Just to be Alive
games.summary: An experimental mixed-media game about being bored and wasting time that combines a 3D world with 2D illustrations and photography of handcrafted plushies.

games.name: Where
games.summary: "Where” is a surreal horror visual novel with point-and-click elements. You awaken alongside a strange man in an endless, impossible space.

games.name: 100 Olympic Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️

games.name: 2nd Eve
games.summary: In 2nd EVE, a sci-fi side-scrolling combat RPG, you're Zola, Sister Superior of the colony spaceship ARGOS. After a catastrophic hyperspace event, battle rogue machines, twisted crew, and deadly anomalies to protect humanity's last hope—the cryo sleepers.

games.name: 6 Ways To 7
games.summary: 6 ways to 7 is a high-stakes roguelike twist on the classic dice game Craps! It combines the hard choices of a roguelike, with the push your luck gameplay of craps!

games.name: A Storied Life: Tabitha
games.summary: A wholesome narrative puzzle game about the objects we leave behind and the stories they tell. Complete a loved one's damaged memoirs by exploring their home and packing away their things.

games.name: Alaska Gold Fever
games.summary: Step into the role of a gold prospector during the Alaskan gold rush and build your own empire from scratch. Mine resources, refine different forms of gold, and upgrade your tools to increase efficiency. Explore diverse mines, survive the harsh climate, and complete engaging story and side quests!

games.name: Amanatsu+
games.summary: A story of adventure and young love by fan-favorite developers AZARASHI SOFTWARE. The protagonist returns to his nostalgic yet somewhat unfamiliar hometown, reuniting with past friends, stirring old feelings, and even finding love over the course of this fleeting summer's dream.

games.name: Animal Island: The Wolf’s Onslaught
games.summary: At sunset, starving wolves close in, drawn by your scent. As your tribe’s guardian, enlist forest animals: tame them at a recruitment hut, fortify defenses with wood and ore, and carve a safe haven between dawn and dusk.

games.name: Artifact Hunt: Yao
games.summary: Artifact Hunt: Yao is a roguelike deck-building game. Collect various Yao souls, seek out different artifacts, combine diverse inscriptions, and create your unique build to experience this adventure full of possibilities.

games.name: BaseStar
games.summary: Dive into a classic grid-based dungeon crawler RPG in a sci-fi setting with unique classes, each offering a distinct playstyle. Immerse yourself in a fully voiced sci-fi story brought to life by two main characters, guiding you through a narrative full of twists and turns with real-time combat.

games.name: Before Fate
games.summary: Before Fate is a time-traveling survival adventure. Journey through time portals to explore unique worlds, delve into dungeons, gather resources, and craft gear. Unlock the deepest secrets of the universe with your wisdom and stop an interstellar disaster with your courage.

games.name: Billiard of Chaos
games.summary: Billiard of Chaos is a casual indie game, where your goal is to shoot the cue ball and keep hitting the red and color balls into the pockets. No need to master complex skills, all you need to do is keep shooting, shooting, and enjoy watching those red balls shatter.

games.name: Cascadou
games.summary: A satisfying solitaire roguelike where you find and create cascading, exploding poker hands. Stickers, special cards and badges turn your deck into a rule-breaking machine. Will your deck crumble, or cascade to victory?

games.name: Catjinni Survivors
games.summary: Catjinni is a single-player survivors-like auto-shooter. Battle endless monster hordes, upgrade abilities, and unlock powerful customizations. Face the sinister Jinn Ifrit and break free from the darkness. Survive. Customize. Conquer!

games.name: City Transport Simulator 2026
games.summary: Step into the next generation of urban public transport with City Transport Simulator 2026! Experience the most immersive bus and tram simulation yet, with a dynamic city that reacts to your every decision.

games.name: Claim the Forest: Settling Peace
games.summary: Capybaras in Harmony in the Forest

games.name: Codex Combat
games.summary: Create a legendary spellbook to battle history's greatest mages in this arcane autobattler! Pick a hero, fill your codex with powerful sigils, cast mighty spells, discover ancient relics, and fulfill your destiny in this turn-based online PvP arena.

games.name: Company of Heroes 3: Hammer & Shield Battlegroup Pack
games.summary:
Company of Heroes 3: Hammer & Shield is a Battlegroup DLC pack consisting of two Battlegroups for Multiplayer and Co-Op/ skirmish vs AI.

This pack replaced the previous Hammer & Shield expansion, which also included cosmetic and single-player content.

games.name: Corner Streamer
games.summary: Corner Streamer is a chill idle game where your avatar streams from the corner, earning views, donations, and sponsors. Customize your look, upgrade your setup, and climb to the top of the streaming world.

games.name: Cronus Monument
games.summary: Cronus Monument is a surrealist adventure game where players must purify the world... No matter the cost.

games.name: Cywall
games.summary: Test your speed and reflexes in this special single-button arcade game!

games.name: Don't Play This
games.summary: Five scary stories, but they all have the same ending. Can you play it? A psychological horror game from the first person, which few will pass.

games.name: Doom Survivor: Horde Rush
games.summary: Bullet hell meets Survivor-like Roguelite! Battle endless zombie hordes as unique heroes. Combine talent trees with 11 weapons (dragon guns, laser rifles) and gear (masks/wings) for explosive fire, lightning, or summon builds. Unlock heroes, master dodge, and dominate the apocalypse!

games.name: Dosa Divas
games.summary: Platform through a vibrant world in an upgradeable mech and cook delicious meals. Fight off corpos in turn based combat, discover new recipes, build up your reputation with local communities, and bond with friends and family on a journey to taste everything life has to offer.

games.name: Explorers of Esmar
games.summary: Explorers of Esmar is a game about building your settlement and establishing complex production chains.

games.name: Extreme Forklifting 3
games.summary: Live the dream as a forklift operator! Experience the thrilling life of a warehouse giraffe! Use your trusty forklifts to solve problems and deliver pallets. Pick pallets up, put them down, the only limit is your imagination!

games.name: Fire Emblem Proto-Rogue
games.summary: A roguelike Fire Emblem fan game where you have to survive as many waves as you can. Build a team with 4 units to survive the onslaught of enemies and bosses! Grab items from the shop or chests to heal, gain temporary buffs to damage or defense, or permanently increase your stats!

games.name: Fishing Inc
games.summary: Fishing Inc is an addictive incremental fishing game! Catch fish, earn cash, and unlock powerful skills. Master new ponds, fill your Fish Log with Legendary catches, and become the ultimate angler.

games.name: Fronteeland
games.summary: Fronteeland is a fast-paced pixel-art hack-and-slash. Battle through perilous levels with weapons you find, survive enemy waves, and unlock more gear for pure, primal combat fun!

games.name: Gods of Sand
games.summary: Train gladiators. Manage a ludus. Fight in the arenas. Conquer the tower. Gods of Sand is a gladiator manager with intense turn-based combat, inspired by the Swords and Sandals series, in a dark and unforgiving setting.

games.name: Grid of Change
games.summary: Grid of Change is an indie strategy board game with active skills, smart moves, and diverse modes from solo puzzles to 8x8 battles with friends

games.name: Hades II
games.summary: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

games.name: Hordekill
games.summary: In an unknown realm, you slay hordes of nightmarish swamp monsters.

games.name: Idle Iktah
games.summary: Idle Iktah is a game about leveling up in the Pacific Northwest. It features local plants and animals, 18 skills, 5+ minigames, items affected by the phase of the moon, and even a real-time Oregon coast tide tracker. If you like idle RPGs, give this one a shot!

games.name: Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic
games.summary: Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic is an RPG with a deep turn-based combat system and a story filled with multiple choices and endings. Let yourself be carried away by this epic adventure: plan your moves, choose your destiny and be prepared to face the consequences!

games.name: Kaporanga
games.summary: Kaporanga is a local and online party game for up to 8 players of all ages, packed with mini-games set across iconic places in Rio de Janeiro. It’s free and accessible! Grab your friends, cousins, even the parrot — and get ready for some wild fun and friendly chaos. Time to Kaporanga!

games.name: Kill the Lich
games.summary: Kill the Lich is a minimalist incremental game centered around time compression and resource propagation. Your resources build automatically over time, but their growth accelerates when you optimize their downstream flow ratios, and you can manually push them along to go even faster. Each action grants attributes that reduce the requirements of other actions, allowing you to push further. Eventually, you can head north to Fight the Lich's Forces in an automated Phase 2, gathering three vital resources that make your next loop faster and unlock new goals.

games.name: Last Flag
games.summary: Hide your flag. Find the enemy flag. Run it back, then defend for a minute to win it. Welcome to Last Flag: a fast-paced 5v5 shooter with showstopping contestants, set in a televised competition where strategy, teamwork, and chaos blend in the ultimate game of Capture the Flag.

games.name: Lockstone Mountains
games.summary: Wake up in the world of Lockstone Mountains as the main Pilot of the Rook expedition. Explore the world, complete quests and gather materials to research new technologies, ships and weapons. Powerful enemies and intriguing mysteries await in the Lockstone Mountains.

games.name: MechsNBugs
games.summary: Two Mechs. One player. And an arena filled with alien bugs. Survive five rounds in the arena to become the new champion.

games.name: Mesudoku
games.summary: A game about Sudoku—it's okay to fail. Through the story, players are guided step by step into the world of Sudoku.

games.name: Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville
games.summary: A murder mystery where you are the main suspect! An ambassador on a peace mission has been killed on board the Clawville Express. Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? Or else.

games.name: Nekokami: The Human Restoration Project
games.summary: Start a relaxing world-building adventure with Nekokami! Architect beautiful, peaceful worlds in a far-future where Cats rule the universe. Befriend wonderous yet whimsical spirits of nature. Manage Humans. With Cats in charge, what could POSSIBLY go wrong?

games.name: Nekopara Sekai Connect
games.summary: Welcome to a new cats paradise where all kinds of nekos over the world will gather around you.

games.name: Oh Jellies!
games.summary:
The sea is full of bright, squishy jellyfish - and they love sticking together. Drag them onto the board and join four or more matching jellies to make them burst into shimmering light!
But the real magic happens afterwards…
When a group pops, the jellyfish above fall into place - and if they match, they pop too! Set off satisfying chain reactions, clear huge combos, and watch the board explode in color.

games.name: Overwatch
games.summary: Overwatch is a free-to-play first-person hero shooter developed by Blizzard Entertainment. Players choose from a large roster of role-based heroes and compete in 5v5 team matches across various objective-based game modes, with both casual and ranked competitive play. Originally released as Overwatch 2 in 2023 as a successor to the 2016 original, the game was rebranded to simply Overwatch in 2026 with a renewed focus on seasonal narrative content and expanded hero rosters.

games.name: Pinfall
games.summary: From the center of the Earth to the outskirts of reality, overcome the impossible in Pinfall: An extremely difficult physics-based platformer where momentum is key. While talking to NPCs, collecting items, and customizing your look, keep climbing as the impending fall awaits...

games.name: Politiks
games.summary: Political Roguelite Deck-builder with a twist. A card game where your worst build might actually work.

games.name: Radiation Caterpillar
games.summary: Are you willing to take risks to grow? Can you collect all the radiation without getting trapped in your own body? Test your skills in this unique space puzzle!

games.name: Regions of Ruin: Runegate
games.summary: Explore a rich and unique open world in this Adventure RPG. Uncover lost dwarven ruins, build a new society and re-establish dwarven kind.

games.name: Replaced
games.summary: Replaced is a 2.5D sci-fi retro-futuristic action platformer where you play as R.E.A.C.H. - an artificial intelligence trapped in a human body against its own will. Replaced combines cinematic platforming, pixel art and free-flow action combat set in an alternative 1980's.

games.name: Roblox
games.summary: Roblox is a massively multiplayer online platform marketed toward creators and players of all ages. It allows users to create their own virtual games using a variety of objects, which they and others can enter and socialize in. Games created on Roblox can be scripted using a sandboxed scripting language based on Lua 5.1 to affect events that occur in-game and create different scenarios.

games.name: Rogue Sundown
games.summary: Rogue Sundown is a 3D local splitscreen duel set in a desert village, where players outplay each other using tight gunplay, aggressive melee, and fast movement. Every fight is a test of positioning, timing, and skill.

games.name: S.U.S
games.summary: Super Ultra Stickman (S.U.S) is a fast paced action RPG game challenging your skills (or lack of it) versus the world, nay, THE UNIVERSE. Choose from dozens of unique weapons to fight your way to the top of the universe and reign as THE SUPER ULTRA STICKMAN.

games.name: Sable's Grimoire 2
games.summary: Sable's Grimoire 2 is a visual novel featuring monster girls in a magic academy setting. This is a sequel to the original Sable's Grimoire game. It follows Sable's studies of magic and his budding friendships with his demi-human classmates and teachers.

games.name: Shape Swarm
games.summary:
Shape Swarm is a top-down action arcade game where players survive increasingly dense waves of geometric enemies in fast, session-based matches. Players automatically attack while maneuvering through enemy patterns, collecting upgrades that modify weapon behavior, movement, and survivability.
The game features short, score-driven runs, escalating difficulty, and a variety of enemy shapes with distinct movement and attack patterns. Progression is contained within individual sessions, emphasizing positioning, build choices, and moment-to-moment decision-making.

games.name: Shards Of Solitude
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a survival game created by Miyuki, a girl with a split personality. Will you be able to escape, or will you choose a different path?

games.name: Shattered Dimension
games.summary: Dive into a world of mystery and wonder in Shattered Dimension. As an unexpected investigator, you're plunged into a labyrinthine plot filled with enigmatic puzzles and intriguing characters.Uncover hidden truths by engaging in conversations and following the intricate web of relationships.

games.name: SideQuest
games.summary: A desktop game designed to help you focus on real world tasks. Featuring a hat collection, different locations, romantic stories, and a built-in system clock.

games.name: Spica Adventure
games.summary: Glide with your umbrella or use it as a boat to cross the sea, allowing you to perform a variety of actions. Run through all 32 stages while searching for hidden items and bonuses in the stage!

games.name: Stack Chaos: Alien Express
games.summary: A physics-based arcade game where you pilot a UFO dropping possessed horror objects to build impossible towers. Swing the pendulum, time the drop, pray it doesn't collapse. 400+ objects, 11 game modes, and a sarcastic goblin that roasts your every move.

games.name: Striker's Instinct
games.summary: A retro inspired football game for mobile that captures the joy, drama and suffering that modern football games seem to forget

games.name: Super Scoundrel Solitaire
games.summary: A solitaire card game with a dungeon theme. Can you make it to the end?

games.name: Switchboard Shuffle
games.summary:
Play as a telephone operator in the 1960s, when exchanges were not yet fully automated. Plug the right cables to connect incoming calls before the switchboard overflows!

Switchboard Shuffle is a puzzle-game/score-chaser inspired by Tetris and Puzzle League, featuring unique cable-routing gameplay. Cables drop from the top of the board and must be guided to jacks of the matching color.

games.name: Teachers. With Love and Passion.
games.summary: Start your new life as a teacher! You worked hard to get here, but nothing prepared you for a lounge full of charming single teachers. Each has secrets, and your choices can change everything. Will you find love in this school romance?

games.name: The Cloudberry Abyss
games.summary: Hunt down 10 jewels in a haunted pastry shop, while terrifying creatures start to hunt YOU. This Point-and-Click Survival Horror Game is like FNAF meets "Emily Wants to Play" meets iSpy.

games.name: The Kendama Challenge: 100 Players
games.summary: Help the challengers who appear one after another succeed at kendama. Simply land the ball on the large cup for 100 people in a row. However, if even one person fails, it's game over. Can you overcome various pressures and guide all 100 people to success!?

games.name: The Universal Symphony
games.summary: Feel the beat, keep the city shining.

games.name: Trapped in the Omniverse
games.summary: FPS single-player de ciencia ficción con supervivencia y exploración interdimensional, donde combatís criaturas anómalas y luchás por sobrevivir en entornos distorsionados.

games.name: Turquoise
games.summary: Build your reef, observe wildlife, and learn about marine fauna. Turquoise is a contemplative game where you create and decorate a protected marine area to welcome a wide variety of aquatic species. Your screen becomes a window into a vibrant underwater world.

games.name: Ultimate Janitor Simulator
games.summary: Restore messy rooms to order by washing dirt, wiping windows, collecting trash, and organizing interiors. Each completed job earns money that you can use to upgrade your workspace and unlock new stuff. Clean, earn, upgrade — and enjoy the calm rhythm of a spotless day's work.

games.name: Ultratap
games.summary: ULTRATAP is an incremental game about defeating monsters and bosses, getting stronger and enjoying the process. Buy upgrades, complete quests and equip powerful items.

games.name: Vile
games.summary: A grotesque plague is mutating and reanimating London’s deceased. Parliament has ordered you specifically to eradicate the hordes of undead and discover the source of the infection before the capital collapses in this retro FPS.

games.name: Voxels.Place
games.summary: Voxels.Place is a browser-based multiplayer voxel-building game where players around the world place and remove blocks at real geographic coordinates in a shared, persistent world. Combining the creative freedom of a block sandbox with the scale of a global map, it lets anyone contribute to an ever-evolving collective construction. No fixed territories, just blocks as your presence and expression in the world.

games.name: We Gotta Go
games.summary:
We Gotta Go is a first person co-op horror game where you and your friends have to reach the only bathroom in a haunted mansion before your bowels betray you.

The mansion won’t make it easy: its many passages are blocked, locked, hidden, and haunted... can your team survive all the way to the porcelain promised land?

games.name: Windrose
games.summary: Embark on a PvE survival adventure in the Age of Piracy. Fight on land and sea, solo or with friends. Build, craft and explore vast open world filled with dark secrets. Master soulslite combat and take on challenging bosses, command your ship and plunder unspoken treasures!

games.name: Zaxoid
games.summary: Defend your planet in this twin-stick mayhem shooter. Rip through alien hordes across a seamless spherical battlefield while upgrading your ship and fortifying your city.

games.name: Zoo Manager Simulator
games.summary: Zoo Manager Simulator is your chance to build and manage the ultimate wildlife park! Step into the shoes of a zoo manager, where you’ll be responsible for creating a thriving, diverse zoo that delights visitors while ensuring the well-being of the animals. From designing exhibits to managing staff, resources, and animal care, every decision is in your hands.

games.name: 2 Cooks 1 Mess
games.summary: 2 Cooks 1 Mess is a chaotic online cooking game where you manage a team of chefs, servers and cleaners with unique skills. Cook, clean, serve and survive wild kitchen events as you climb from rookie to restaurant master.

games.name: 30 Minutes to Rescue
games.summary: 30 Minutes to Rescue is a tense sci-fi survival story set in a Mars colony. Manage resources, make critical decisions, and stop a cascading disaster before the colony collapses.

games.name: 3D Escape Room: Cursed Legacy
games.summary: After waking up in the manor’s basement, you discover that you’ve aged at an abnormal rate. As you fight to survive, clues and records from different eras gradually bring the mystery into focus. When you become young again, you will inherit the true “legacy”.

games.name: A Game About Sucking (Up Ghosts With a Vacuum)
games.summary: A short, active incremental game about sucking up a range of cute and mischievous Ghosts with a Vacuum and harvesting their Ectoplasm.

games.name: Age of History II: Definitive Edition
games.summary:
Age of History II: Definitive Edition is a remastered version of Age of History II, developed and published by Łukasz Jakowski Games. It was released on Steam with updated features, additional content, and technical improvements over the original game. The Definitive Edition expands the scope of the grand strategy title while retaining the core gameplay of diplomacy, conquest, and empire management.

The Definitive Edition introduces a larger map with 13,892 provinces, new civilizations, scenarios, and the addition of religions as a gameplay element. Other features include animated province names, a revised user interface, quality-of-life changes, and Steam Workshop support, aiming to provide an updated experience for both new and returning players.

games.name: Arcadox
games.summary: Welcome to Arcadox, a game where classic Arkanoid nostalgia meets the aesthetics of the early internet and 80s dreams.

games.name: Blockboy and The Wizard
games.summary:
Blockboy and The Wizard is a short linear game about a regular stickman with a square head and a bleak life, who becomes the apprentice of a wizard with no beard and his own brand of soda. The soda thing isn't really important at all, but it's very cool.

Click stuff and things happen!

games.name: Blood Reaver
games.summary: A Dark-fantasy, Round-based FPS. Become the Blood Reaver in solo or 4-player co-op. Harness forbidden magic and weaponry to shoot, blast and slice your way through endless hordes of demons. Upgrade your arsenal and survive long enough to discover the ancient secrets of the gods of hell.

games.name: Brush Jjaemu
games.summary: Brush Jjaemu is a free, lighthearted indie game created by Korean artist Byeori. It is often described as a "cat brushing" game where the main objective is to groom a plump orange cat to collect points while avoiding potential hazards.

games.name: Calamity Angels: Special Delivery
games.summary: A rag-tag group of kooky carriers protect and trek packages through treacherous terrains in this delivery service RPG!

games.name: Cleaning Up!
games.summary: Turn huge messes into sparkling spaces! Feel the satisfaction of restoring them to order with your super-powered cleaning tools. The quick, cozy joy of tidying up!

games.name: Command Thousands Troops
games.summary: This is a squad-building game set in a medieval fantasy world, blending turn-based development with real-time combat. As the commander of a small team, you will recruit soldiers, acquire skills, strengthen your army, and repel invaders. Write your own legendary story.

games.name: Crisálida
games.summary: A short emotional journey through memory, grief, and healing. Help Íris piece together her fragmented memories and uncover hidden truths about herself and those she loves. Your choices shape the story — only by revisiting the past you will unlock new layers and reveal the true ending (and music).

games.name: Cult Nation
games.summary: An incremental game about sacrificing all your cult followers and collecting blood to awaken the devil.

games.name: Don't Lose Aggro
games.summary: Experience the thrill of MMORPG tanking in this single-player roguelite that lets you perfect your tanking skills without guild drama or 4-hour raid nights!

games.name: Electrogical
games.summary: "Jigsaw Puzzle + Arithmetic" is a casual yet engaging game that appeals to puzzle gamers who enjoy immersive experiences. Customize your gameplay by rearranging "piece placement," "number manipulation," and "score selection" to aim for a high score in each stage.

games.name: Empty Gauge
games.summary: VHS-style single-player horror part-time job simulator. Endure the night shift at a remote gas station/convenience store, then return home and collect hidden clues. As the days pass, nightmares bleed into reality—and depending on the clues you uncover, the ending changes.

games.name: Fallen: Fatal Force
games.summary: Description:This game is a psychic action game. Escape from the maze-like research facility by manipulating telekinesis, levitation, and teleportation.

games.name: Find My Frogs
games.summary: Find My Frogs is a cozy hidden object game full of frogs, mushrooms and moss. Help Uncle Froger take a commemorative photo, or just lounge in the pond and relax.

games.name: Fishing Star: World Tour
games.summary: In Fishing Star World Tour, players will be able to catch over 180 kinds of fish across 40 different scenic locations from around the world, all the while completing objectives and tracking different species of fish within the game’s “Fish Book”. Players can customize several parts of their fishing gear, including their Lure, Reel, and Rod, each of which has its own stats that can improve your performance. Each time a fish is caught, the Fish Book makes a note of the gear that was used as well as the location of the catch. This information can be extremely helpful, especially when attempting to hook a Boss Fish!

games.name: Frontline: Afrika Korps
games.summary: Lead iconic WWII forces across stunning desert battlefields. Command, customize, and conquer in thrilling, historically rich campaigns. Outsmart foes with cunning tactics. The sands of Africa await!

games.name: Green Valley County
games.summary: Green Walley County is a survival computer game with a single and cooperative mode. Open world and first-person view.

games.name: Hatters
games.summary: Hatters is a cooperative bullet hell roguelike for up to 4 players. Random spells of five elements, magical artifacts, new heroes and a light story with humor. Chaotic battles where magic and laughter fly everywhere.

games.name: Hedgemaze
games.summary:
Hedgemaze is a logic puzzle inspired by nonograms, picross, and deduction puzzles. Use row and column clues to build a single perfect path through flowers, zen gardens, torii gates, and winding rivers.

Each puzzle challenges you to determine exactly which cells become hedge and which become path. Every puzzle has one unique solution and can be solved with logic alone. No guessing required.

Play 2,000+ puzzles across four difficulties. Start with 6×6 Easy grids and work your way up to challenging 12×12 Expert puzzles with rivers, bridges, and new twists to master.

Take on a new Daily Challenge every day. Solve three puzzles that reset at midnight, compete on global leaderboards for the fastest times, and track your streaks and best solves.

Built with a player-first mentality.

games.name: Honey Badger Don't Die
games.summary: Our game is about a man who wakes up in an unfamiliar place, and the only way to escape is with the help of a genetically modified honey badger that has bitten off his toe.

games.name: Hunkfrat
games.summary: Hunkfrat is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you try to get your almighty frat beverages in the most sarcastic and entertaining way.

games.name: Idle Deepcore
games.summary: Idle Deepcore is an incremental mining game where you dig ever deeper, smelt ore into ingots, upgrade your pickaxe and machines, and grow several mines in parallel to build a vast underground industry.

games.name: Karless
games.summary: A factory automation game where you build vehicle production lines to reconnect a shattered post-apocalyptic continent. Mine raw resources, research new technologies, and build vehicle supply chains — ship them out to reconnect the severed regions of Aris.

games.name: LaVonne's Lemons Idle
games.summary: Grow an ultimate empire in LaVonne's Lemons Idle! Click your way from a single citrus to deep cosmic automation. Unearth ancient Artifacts, build out the Endless Research Lab, "feed" (click) your screen pet monkey, and prestige into the stars in this deeply strategic resource management clicker!

games.name: Learn Basic Kanji!!
games.summary: A Kanji learning game which teaches you 80 basic Kanji.

games.name: Luckrot
games.summary: Roguelike shooter set in a dystopian, livestreamed gameshow. Obliterate waves of deformed freaks, earn donations from your sadistic audience and gamble your earnings for upgrades. Your life is a Performance. Your Death is Content.

games.name: Mongil: Star Dive
games.summary:
Dive into a world of wonder!
A dazzling monster-taming Action RPG!

games.name: Monmon and the Legendary Banana
games.summary:
Monmon is a sleepy little monkey who embarks on a big adventure inside the great sacred temple, in search of bananas for breakfast.

What he doesn't know is that (according to an ancient tale) the temple holds the legendary banana, home to yellow fruits that grant invincibility.

games.name: Nubby's Number Factory
games.summary: A plinko-style roguelike where you work at a number factory. Launch your spherical friend, Nubby, down a pegboard to make bigger and bigger numbers! But beware, if you fail to meet your number quota, the sun will explode.

games.name: Packmates
games.summary: Gear up your animal hero in this 1–3 player co-op survivor roguelite forged on tactical inventory mastery. Arrange loot for devastating combos, obliterate enemies, and battle to dominate the darkness infiltrating your forest!

games.name: Para//Llax
games.summary:
Two men wake with a hole in their chest. Watch their demise.

A dual-track narrative, where you advance two sides asynchronously. 27 end states, infinite looping.

games.name: Parcel Delivery Simulator
games.summary: You've landed a job at a courier company, but your boss has to leave town. Now you're the boss. Deliver packages, sign new contracts, expand your office, buy new vehicles. Hire employees, set up parcel lockers around town, and create the most profitable courier company in the world. Simulation game.

games.name: Pengilo
games.summary: Bounce your penguin with precision as you master brainteasing stages in chill wintry style!

games.name: Polt
games.summary:
Polt is a puzzle game where you are a boy stuck in a strange facility and your goal is to escape by the roof. The thing is that there are monsters in the shadows. You are safe but you can't see them in the real world. Your vulnerable but you can see them whenever you go to the shadow's world.

Defeat waves of enemies and reach the roof to win the game!

games.name: Project Breakout
games.summary: Project Breakout is a sandbox prison escape game, where you and up to three friends are put into a secured facility. Explore the area, train to improve your attributes and gather items, to craft tools that are necessary for your escape!

games.name: Race Max Pro
games.summary: Race through Street, Drift, and Drag with real licensed cars. Master every turn, upgrade your ride, and dominate solo or online.

games.name: Rebeloid
games.summary: A non-VR release of a an arcade brick-breaker.

games.name: Santa Slide Rush
games.summary:
Slide into a fast-paced winter adventure in Santa Slide Rush! Help Santa glide through slippery zig-zag snowy trails deep inside a magical pine forest while collecting presents for children around the world.

Master smooth steering, dodge tricky turns, and keep your momentum as the speed increases. new challenges, and even entirely different worlds to explore.

games.name: Shenjing
games.summary: "Shenjing" is a side-scrolling mystery game set in the Ming Dynasty. Players begin with an amnesiac identity and must investigate evidence, witness testimonies, and meticulously piece together clues to uncover the truth behind each case and determine whether the characters were involved.

games.name: Simultree
games.summary: Simultree is an incremental game about running a life simulation. Unlock new entity, items, food and upgrade inside a big tech tree. Compete in an online leaderboard.

games.name: Slimeward
games.summary: Slimeward is an idle game where players build and upgrade a village, recruit heroes, and defeat Monster 'Slime' that fell in front of the house one day,

games.name: Sprite's Honor!
