games.summary: A stranded troop of fairy scouts gather and farm as they try to find their way home!

games.name: Steamboat Willie Rescue Mission
games.summary: Step back into 1928 in this retro 8-bit platformer! Play as Willie, pilot biplanes, dodge angry ducks, and brave 20 challenging levels to rescue Winnie from the clutches of Captain Pete. Jump, climb, and collect musical notes in a nostalgic, public-domain adventure!

games.name: Synth Laser
games.summary: Synth Laser is a dynamic laser maze rhythm game. Get ready to dodge and weave around the deadly and stunning laser show, built upon the outrun and synthwave music.

games.name: Terminal Shift
games.summary: Trapped inside a desolate terminal, hunted by an unknown entity that has taken control and twisted the airport into a terrifying, looping nightmare. Gain access to the boarding gates and escape.

games.name: The Adventures of R.Sole: Nothing, Nowhere & Not at the Same Time
games.summary: A sarcastic IT guy becomes the universe’s least qualified hero in a crisis he can’t reboot. Surrounded by oddball characters and improbable predicaments, he learns sarcasm really can save the day. A comedy sci-fi point & click where chaos reigns, heroism is optional, and logic is a mere suggestion.

games.name: The Angel's Devil Tail: One More Question 2
games.summary: A Single-Player Lateral Thinking Puzzle game. This title features a Bishoujo ADV story where you deduce the truth behind bizarre mysteries. With Steam Workshop support for infinite puzzles, it's the perfect solo detective experience!

games.name: Tsugunohi: The Chamber of Phantom Name
games.summary: A new graduate, Kana Sakuragi, begins her new life in a renovated old house, "Akembara House." What seemed like a shiny, ideal property soon turns into a nightmare, as she is plagued by strange phenomena every night...

games.name: Undead Tread
games.summary: Mow down hordes of zombies in a high-speed vehicular roguelike! Tear through the undead with front-mounted guns, upgrade your car, and battle through procedurally generated highways, cities, and rural roads. Will you reach the cure, or become just another wreck in the apocalypse?

games.name: Valorborn
games.summary: Dive into a living medieval fantasy sandbox RPG. Whether you lead a group or walk alone, carve your own identity. Hunt, steal, trade, build, or wander freely. Explore a vast open world and shape your journey through immersive roleplay and boundless freedom.

games.name: Vanilla
games.summary: Relive the golden age of VR today with Vanilla!

games.name: Void Roots
games.summary: Void Roots is an autobattler Roguelite, widely influenced by the randomness. You'll find a range of upgradable tools , allowing you to manipulate your chances, and the choices you'll make will directly influence your progression.

games.name: Zero One Protocol
games.summary: No story. No mercy. Just perfect control and instant punishment. Every jump gets you closer, every failure punishes, and every restart dares you to go again. Welcome to Zero One Protocol, a minimalist, merciless, and dangerously satisfying precision platformer.

games.name: ZombieCam
games.summary: ZombieCam is a bodycam-style first person shooter zombie game. Coming Q4 2024.

games.name: 2048 Boys
games.summary: Get your players on the field! Build the strongest team possible!

games.name: 5 Nights at Timokha 5: Island
games.summary: A naughty guy showed a pie and ruined a vacation on a paradise beach!

games.name: 5omeday
games.summary: You have been assigned to guard a dragon girl set to be executed at the end of 5 days and have the ability to kill her instantly at any time with the push of a button in this multi-ending visual novel.

games.name: Angel Clicker
games.summary: It's Heaven vs. Hell in the annual Soul-Catching Contest! An incremental clicker with optional rhythm elements. Help Heavenly Architect Legion defeat her eternal archrival Lucifer once and for all! (Or not...?)

games.name: Angel Rhapsody
games.summary: A comical shooter where angels battle demons!

games.name: Anomaly Directive
games.summary: Anomaly Directive is a first-person surveillance horror game. Monitor live camera feeds, detect and report supernatural anomalies, and survive an escalating threat from a malevolent entity.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Konami GT
games.summary:
"Konami GT" is a racing game released by Konami in 1985.
Keep a close eye on your fuel gauge as you race through checkpoints, aiming to conquer all 6 grueling stages.
With beautiful, shifting scenery—from coastal highways and arid wastelands to plains bathed in the sunset—push the pedal to the metal and blast toward the finish line in a shower of glory!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Konami GT
games.summary:
"Konami GT" is a racing game released by Konami in 1985.
Keep a close eye on your fuel gauge as you race through checkpoints, aiming to conquer all 6 grueling stages.
With beautiful, shifting scenery—from coastal highways and arid wastelands to plains bathed in the sunset—push the pedal to the metal and blast toward the finish line in a shower of glory!

games.name: Backstory
games.summary: An immersive first-person experience about being kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a car. A journey in which sound is the main focus designed to be played using a standard controller (mouse) in a different way.

games.name: Beastfall
games.summary: A pure Boss Rush roguelike - no trash mobs, only epic boss battles. Find your sister's body in a journey of redemption and revenge. Encounter eight unique deities and uncover the truth buried 200 years ago.

games.name: Because It's a Dream, It Must Be Romance: Connecting Hearts Across Realities
games.summary: Three men. One dream. Your choice. When love begins in a dream… A visual novel where dreams and reality collide, and every choice you make changes everything.

games.name: Bid King
games.summary: BidKing: A multiplayer game of strategic bluffing and collectible hunting. Use unique character skills to gain intel in sealed-bid auctions. Analyze behavior and clues to win items cheaplyor bluff to make others overpay. Who will be the true Auction Master?

games.name: Blackout Arena
games.summary: Fight, explore, and survive in BLACKOUT ARENA — a cinematic action-adventure set in a city plunged into darkness. Battle through brutal arena trials, uncover hidden secrets, and take on a global journey filled with danger, rivals, and monthly new missions.

games.name: Blast Linkers
games.summary: Blast Linkers is a strategic 2-player local cooperative shooter.

games.name: Bunny Garden 2
games.summary: A brand new title in the Bunny Garden series, a romance adventure game where you can deepen your relationships with a unique cast of girls while visiting the gentleman’s sanctuary “Bunny Garden”. In addition to the return of familiar characters such as Kana, Rin, and Miuka, Erisa will newly join the cast. Furthermore, new characters are also planned to appear, promising an even more intimate experience than the previous title.

games.name: Butterfly Girl
games.summary: A puzzle-adventure game blended with visual novel storytelling. A mysterious girl and butterflies appear each time you solve a puzzle inside the room. Who are they? What do they want? Unravel each puzzle one by one — and the truth draws ever closer.

games.name: Cafe of Roses
games.summary: A lowkey, low stakes yuri story about a young woman and a mysterious maid. Who is the engimatic Magdalena, and is there more to her than meets the eye?

games.name: Can You Explain It? World History Test
games.summary: Can you talk about the history of the world?

games.name: CEO Sim: Cyberpunk
games.summary: CEO Sim: Cyberpunk is an economic strategy about corporation management in the world of cyberpunk. Become the CEO of Virtual Dreams company and, under the control of the board of directors, try to maintain your power in the face of a brewing corporational war.

games.name: Chunithm X-Verse-X
games.summary: Chunithm's 10th anniversary celebration continues with the Chunithm New series coming to Linked Verse.

games.name: Cipher Monk: Ancient Calculus
games.summary: The Secret of the Sacred Numbers

games.name: Coin of Fate
games.summary: Coin Slot System: Success lies in how you balance the odds between heads and tails. Strategic Resource Management: Maximize efficiency within the limits of your inventory and gold. Explosive Synergies: Unleash massive bonus effects by collecting and pairing specific sets of items.

games.name: Console Archives: Ishin no Arashi
games.summary:
"Ishin no Arashi" was released by Koei in 1990 for an 8-bit home console.
Step into the role of a Bakumatsu-era patriot in this historical simulation game, where you engage in fierce debates with feudal lords and key figures across Japan to win them over to your ideology and lead the nation toward a new dawn.
Experience the thrill of moving history not just with swordsmanship, but through intellect and passion! Prevail in the clash of opposing ideals and survive the chaotic upheaval of the shogunate's final days!

games.name: Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator
games.summary: Run your own conveyor belt sushi restaurant. Make sushi, serve customers, process payments, clean tables, hire staff, and design your restaurant’s conveyor belt. Set your own prices, manage troublesome customers, and expand your sushi restaurant.

games.name: Cozy Sanctuary
games.summary: Cozy Sanctuary is a relaxing pet simulation game where you care for adorable animals living at the bottom of your screen. Grow their food, and keep them happy and fed to attract even more furry friends! They'll stay out of your way while you work or study, but don't forget to give them attention!

games.name: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss
games.summary: A mining station in the Pacific abyss is no longer responding. As an investigator of the occult, unravel the mysteries of the deep. Test your wits and sanity in this thriller inspired by the master of Providence.

games.name: Curious Copy Cats
games.summary: Get ready to flip your perspective with Curious Copy Cats, the purr-fect puzzle adventure that keeps you on your toes! Each level presents two adorable cat-filled scenes that may look identical at first glance… but there’s a twist, the images are mirrored, turning familiar details into a clever visual challenge.

games.name: Death by Scrolling
games.summary: Welcome to Purgatory, now under new management! Death by Scrolling is a rogue-like vertically scrolling RPG where you kill enemies, collect gold, and avoid the Grim Reaper long enough to pay the Ferrymanʼs exorbitant river-crossing fee to the afterlife.

games.name: Dog Jigsaw from Japan
games.summary: 【Up to 150 Pieces!】 Everyone’s favorite! Collect puzzle pieces of iconic Japanese dogs and complete the puzzle!

games.name: Eggconsole Psycho World MSX2
games.summary: Master 8 unique ESP powers to command fire, ice at will! Transcend mere reflexes and experience the strategic thrill of crushing massive bosses with godlike power.

games.name: Elevator Mayhem
games.summary: Terrorists have taken control of a building, eliminate all enemies, reach the top floor and defuse the bomb

games.name: Ereban: Shadow Legacy
games.summary: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe.

games.name: EXD: Extra Dimensional
games.summary: A delivery guy. A dimensional rift. A quest across another world. Master telekinesis and elemental magic in Erath, where everyday objects become legendary weapons. Battle mythical creatures. Solve ancient puzzles. Uncover dark truths. Advanced VR physics meet epic fantasy adventure.

games.name: Express Car Wash Simulator
games.summary: Use colorful soaps and enjoy the satisfaction of a perfect clean. Collect rare vehicle cards to unlock iconic rides, add new services to your shop, and expand your craft. But stay sharp - taking down non-paying customers with a tennis ball gun is all part of the job!

games.name: Fathom's End
games.summary: Fathom’s End is a first-person lighthouse keeper simulation set far out in the Atlantic. Maintain the light, endure the isolation, and keep the station running through long nights, unpredictable weather and scarce supplies.

games.name: Firework
games.summary: Firework is a Chinese horror puzzle game.

games.name: Fix & Flip Dream House
games.summary: Turn ruins into masterpieces!

games.name: Fortnite Ballistic
games.summary:
FORTNITE BALLISTIC is a first-person, 5v5 tactical FPS. Prove your talents, precision and teamwork to overcome your opponents.

Each round, use your skills and gadgets to Attack and Defend your side. Avoid elimination and outplay your opponents to secure victory for your team.

TACTICAL CHOICES MATTER.
Choose your gadget and lock in! Fortnite Ballistic provides unique, Flex gadgets that can alter the outcome of a round. Once you’ve locked in your gadget, add it to your arsenal during the Buy phase of each round and go ballistic.

FIRST PERSON, FULL IMPACT
Fortnite Ballistic is the first Fortnite mode built using the First Person Camera Mode Device in UEFN. Experience Fortnite in an all new way, challenging your skills and testing your tactics.

Getting this experience is not necessary to access this content. When you launch Fortnite using this through your Library, the experience will be pre-selected for your convenience.

games.name: Fortnite: Save the World
games.summary:
Discover the epic PvE action-building co-op campaign. Take on the monster hordes either solo or with up to three friends as you explore a vast, destructible world, with dynamically created maps where no two games are ever the same.

Build & Defend: Construct elaborate trap tunnels and towering fortresses to protect your objectives from relentless waves of monsters.

Loot & Craft: Scavenge the environment for materials to craft legendary weapons, from neon scythes to heavy-duty rocket launchers.

Level Up: Rescue, recruit and customize a massive roster of Heroes from one of four classes - Soldiers, Ninjas, Outlanders, and Constructors - to suit your playstyle.

The fight is on. Gather your squad, find your favorite gear, and Save the World.

games.name: Fun with Ragdolls Plus
games.summary: Embark on an epic and fun platforming adventure with ragdoll physics. Create worlds and stories or follow Danny and Rickie's journey through the world of ragdolls, uncovering the dark truth it holds.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Digital Devil Saga Avatar Tuner - A's Test Server
games.summary: Escape the Tower of Karma. If you want to survive, transform into a Devil—tear your enemies apart, slaughter them, and devour them!

games.name: Gecko Gods
games.summary: Explore a mysterious island as a tiny lizard. Complete ancient puzzles, effortlessly climb cliffs, and eat bugs as you make your way across an island civilization lost to time.

games.name: Grim Pulse: The First Blood
games.summary: Grim Pulse: The First Blood is an ARPG that follows Aelthar, an ancient vampire who awakens 9,743 years after being sent to his Eternal Slumber within a modern city locked in a dreamlike state of blood, control, and forgotten history. As he dismantles vampire Covens embedded within towering skyscrapers, Aelthar uncovers a hidden hierarchy known as the Vampire Council, and the truth that his resurrection was never accidental. Through combat, exploration/eavesdropping, and fractured memories, he must confront his past, a tragic love named Lisette, and the burden of the First Blood itself.

games.name: Ground Zero
games.summary: Fight through post-apocalyptic South Korea in this retro survival horror. Uncover the truth behind the devastating meteor impact that left the country in ruins and turned every living organism into a terrifying monstrosity. Fight. Solve puzzles. Upgrade gear. Make every bullet count.

games.name: Hentai Furry Pig
games.summary: Hentai Furry Pig is a puzzle game for those who love logic and a hot atmosphere. Two mini-games in each level: memory matching and a jigsaw puzzle. Unlock explicit biker-girl illustrations, earn achievements, and view unlocked content in the gallery.

games.name: HexSwarm: Hostile Worlds
games.summary: HexSwarm: Hostile Worlds is a faithful adaptation of the board game by the same name. You and your friends will tackle building a prosperous and successful colony on a planet that does not want you there. You'll face hazards at every turn; untold amounts of bugs, and a mind bending movement map.

games.name: Hideous
games.summary: Hideous is a dark fantasy boomer shooter mixing Heretic-style action with Diablo 1’s grim atmosphere. Blast through undead hordes with fire staves, lightning rods, and arcane fury as you face zombie warriors, evil mages, and grotesque bosses.

games.name: HoloBase
games.summary: Enjoy real baseball action with hololive talents!! Create your own team with talents, fans, and mascots, and dive into intense, exciting games!

games.name: Home Rescue Clean And Restore Collector's Edition
games.summary: Roll Up Your Sleeves and Get Ready to Sparkle!

games.name: House Cleaner Simulator
games.summary: Build your own cleaning empire! Unlock tools, take on bigger jobs, and clean your way to fame and fortune in this unique cleaning simulator.

games.name: Hyakki Fantasia Mini Game Selection Vol.1
games.summary: A compact yet richly packed anthology of bite-sized games you can enjoy anytime.

games.name: Inhuman Resources: A Literary Machination
games.summary: A literary machination about corporations, conspiracies, and the unspeakable horrors you’ll commit for minimum wage.

games.name: Japanese Culture Literacy Test
games.summary: Are your Japanese manners up to par?

games.name: Just One Man
games.summary: JUST ONE MAN is a VR hack-and-slash game where you are the OVERPOWERED VILLAIN. Stylishly slaughter enemies with weapons, combo attacks and devastating abilities while listening to banging beats. Choose your own playstyle and invent the wildest combos to achieve the highest scores imaginable.

games.name: King of Gladiators
games.summary: In a city built for bloodsport, you are just another warrior among hundreds—until you choose to rise. King of Gladiators: Blood and Glory throws you into a brutal fantasy arena where steel, fire, and fury determine who lives and who dies.

games.name: King of Holo
games.summary: Hololive × Chess × SRPG × Deckbuilding × Roguelike × Strategy Game! Featuring 76 Hololive members! Make your oshi the King!

games.name: King's Downfall
games.summary: Defy the tyrant. Build your settlement, defend it from invasions, and gain enough power to overthrow the king.

games.name: Kings Do Not Fall
games.summary:
When the kingdom needs a legend, you don’t fall... you rise. In a land torn apart, an entire army has fallen. Embark on a classic beat ’em up, just like we loved to play in the 90s.

Players will step into Alden’s boots, battling through six hand crafted levels that culminate in epic boss encounters. With each fight, the stakes rise: every fallen knight fuels Alden’s resolve to “not fall” even when all hope seems lost.
“Fight! Smash! Break through the horde!”

games.name: Kitty Finder
games.summary: Find the adorable kitties hiding in every corner of a huge mansion! Discover the little friends hiding behind the sofas, bookshelves, and attic. A peaceful adventure experience awaits you in a relaxing atmosphere!

games.name: Kletka
games.summary: Kletka is a co-op horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

games.name: Lucky Tower Ultimate
games.summary: Crude slapstick humor assists you, as you continue to fail escaping a dangerous tower in this unique narrative roguelike. Slashy slashy!

games.name: Mace Knight
games.summary: Line 'em up and bring the pain in this action-packed arcade game. Grab your mace of choice, bash your way through hordes of enemies, and compete for the top score on the leaderboard!

games.name: Make it! Gyoza
games.summary:
Get ready for a delicious gyoza-making challenge!
Make lots of gyoza and watch your food cart prosper!

games.name: Marrow Marrow
games.summary: Wield deadly weapons and master high speed parkour combat in intense VR shooter MARROW MARROW. Slide on walls, dash through the air, and charge head first into danger to get the upper hand as you rain down destruction on the foul Vermin onslaught.

games.name: Maxo Scringle's "Human Rocket" Mini-Type Rocket Golf
games.summary:
Created for game-a-week 2026, week 5 (theme: "risk and reward")

Maxo Scringle's "Human Rocket" Mini-Type Rocket Golf is the premiere 3-d hypersimulation of mini-type rocket golf!! world famous akronite "human rocket" maxo scringle himself has sponsored this game, lending his iconic look and advice for aspiring rocketeers!

games.name: Meatlock
games.summary: Meatlock is a short point & click horror experience focused on tension, observation, and environmental storytelling. Explore, interact with your surroundings, and progress from room to room.

games.name: Medetashi Medetashi
games.summary: Play the role of an ordinary main character in the story—a nameless cat. He journeys through the pages of the book in search of the heroine's secret.

games.name: Mirai's Midnight Training
games.summary: In their fateful battle, the mighty exorcist succeeded in defeating the legendary two-tailed fox spirit, Kanou Mirai. He thought that was the end, but their story...was only just beginning.

games.name: Mouse: P.I. For Hire
games.summary: Join private investigator Jack Pepper on a guns blazing, jazz-fueled adventure in MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. MOUSE combines the charm of hand-drawn rubber hose animation inspired by the classic cartoons of the 1930’s with the adrenaline and action of an explosive first person shooter.

games.name: Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After - Episode 00 Remastered
games.summary: In a desperate attempt to exterminate the BETA, mankind has forsaken the Earth. Stranded onboard a TSF carrier in the South Pacific, a handful of survivors scramble to find a way back home to America. This is where Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After begins.

games.name: Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After - Episode 03 Remastered
games.summary: The stakes grow higher in this latest episode of Muv Luv Unlimited: The Day After! The shadow of nuclear annihilation looms over mankind, as France places the city of Seattle in the crosshairs. Can humanity overcome this crisis and unite to face the BETA?

games.name: Myth of Empires: Throne
games.summary: Myth of Empires: Throne is a free seasonal multiplayer warfare sandbox. Explore vast lands inspired by multiple civilizations, tame creatures, forge powerful weapons, and build your guild. Lead cross-server expeditions, conquer territories, and compete with players worldwide for the ultimate throne!

games.name: Nationwide Academic Check Junior High Level
games.summary: Nostalgic yet challenging — a complete check of junior high knowledge

games.name: Neon Warfare: CyberArena
games.summary:
The city of the future shows no mercy to the weak.
Only those who shoot faster and strike harder survive.

games.name: North Hunt
games.summary: An online social deduction game that will ruin your friendships. Thieves hide as Viking villagers, fake NPC behavior, and use chaotic abilities while Chiefs try to expose them. Trust no one.

games.name: Nullstar: Solus
games.summary: Be. Faster. You are a corporate scavenger drone, sent to rip through the decaying corpse of a dying world to salvage its nullstar. Master flight, thrusters, and face ancient guardians and hazards in 80 precision platformer levels set in the ruins of a civilization where all is not as it might seem.

games.name: Office Chair Curling
games.summary: in this game you throw office chairs at a target

games.name: Opus: Prism Peak
games.summary: Opus: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where your choices lead to divergent endings. Play as a photographer lost in an ethereal realm, and unveil its mysteries with your camera to find a way home.

games.name: Outage Navigation
games.summary: The power is out! No worries. With the help of you and your flashlight, we'll get that power back up and running before you can say "this is dangerous!" Oh yeah, watch out for the objects left around the floor.

games.name: Pixel Game Maker Series: MagicalShot The AttackBump
games.summary:
Blast enemies away with magic shots and smash them into walls to defeat them!
A top-down, fixed-screen 2D action game!

games.name: Priest Simulator: Vampire Show
games.summary: Imagine that you have divine powers. What do you do? Help people or take the piss out of them? That's a priest's life.

games.name: Prince Date Diaries: A Fairy Tale Love
games.summary:
A kingdom bound by duty.
A prince longing for something real.
Will your love rewrite his destiny?

games.name: Princess Date Diaries: A Fairy Tale Love
games.summary: A kingdom ruled by tradition. A princess longing to be truly seen. Will your love change her destiny?

games.name: QuizMasters
games.summary: QuizMasters is much more than a trivia game. Play alone or with friends in a thrilling mix of three round types — no purchase needed for your friends to join! Features multiple choice trivia (powered by Open Trivia DB), 8 puzzle games including maze and minesweeper, and creative rounds where players invent subtitles for funny videos and get voted on. Friends join FREE via browser on any device (PC, Mac, Android, iOS). One person buys it on Steam, everyone else can play. Build your own custom quiz with 11 mini-games across 3 round types.

games.name: Reseed
games.summary: Reseed is a puzzle platformer about planning. Record your path through a safe level, then watch it execute through the same level, now filled with traps. Will the seed survive?

games.name: Rift Miner
games.summary: Rift Miner is a 3D voxel roguelite: mine resources against the clock, escape through the portal, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock Echo Cards for powerful synergies. Brave the high-risk Deeper Rifts for even greater rewards.

games.name: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
games.summary: Run your manuscript workshop, receive orders to illustrate medieval books, decorate them any way you like, send them back to clients to get paid, and unlock new jobs, decorations, and items. Welcome to your very own medieval scriptorium!

games.name: ShantyTown
games.summary: ShantyTown is a relaxing diorama-building game about finding beauty in everyday chaos. Bring new locations to life, stack your urban buildings high, and fill each little nook and cranny with your own touch. Even messiness has its own little charm.

games.name: Sintopia
games.summary: Build the resurrection business of your dreams with Sintopia! You are charged with managing the bureaucratic administration of Hell, your team of Imployees punish the dead souls for their Sins, generating a profit to help you build and sustain your Hellish empire.

games.name: Slash Cash
games.summary: A turn-based simulation game, where you manage a game development company. You can choose to run the company honestly and diligently or resort to some unconventional methods.

games.name: Smash It Wild
games.summary: Smash It Wild is a tactical turn-based game combining volleyball and dodgeball in a fantasy universe. Upgrade your players and defeat your opponents in an intense roguelike competition!

games.name: Smoke & Lottery Simulator
games.summary: Manage your own tobacco shop and bar! Sell cigarettes and lottery tickets, serve drinks to your customers, manage your stock, and grow your business in first-person. Can you juggle between the counter and the shelves to make your business thrive?

games.name: Solitaire Legends: Card Masters
games.summary: Classic Solitaire with progression, skins, and endless replay value.

games.name: Starward
games.summary: "Starward" is a 3D competitive game that combines mecha girls with classic GVG fighting gameplay, with 1V1 and 2V2 battles as the core. In "Starward", players can control mecha girls with distinct personalities and different fighting styles, and experience a three-dimensional combat experience that goes beyond the ground through fighting shooting, agile operation, and tactical formulation.

games.name: Stickman 3D Tennis: Deluxe
games.summary: Play tennis matches in a 3D environment with cartoony graphics! Defeat your opponents in either a quick game or tournament mode. Use the Lob, Slice and Volley to win matches! Fully 3D environments for beautiful stick tennis.

games.name: Stickman 3D Wingsuit: Deluxe
games.summary: You are a stickman wingsuit pilot! Fly through beautiful 3D levels and avoid deadly lava, spikes and saw blades. Remember to open up your parachute! Skydiving as a stick man has never been so bloody and deadly! Gorgeous 3D levels! People will say this is the best wingsuit game with stickmen!

games.name: Stranger Maidens Please Protect Me!
games.summary: Tactical squad based Roguelite Action RPG. Lead your band of powerful Stranger Maidens to battle, find your best team and mow down all adversaries! Unfold your story by combat, and melt the heart of your beautiful companions.

games.name: Strike World
games.summary:
Pull, Aim, and STRIKE! — turn-based action.

Pull, aim, and STRIKE! The 64 million-total-player hit arrives in India! Unlock heroes, build your team, and crush bosses.

Intuitive Controls, Explosive Action!
No complex controls here! Just pull your hero, aim at the enemy, and release. Immerse yourself in simple yet deep, high-octane battles where every move counts. Your strategy changes everything!

Dynamic Stages and Tactical Battles!
As you progress, stages become more exciting and challenging. Skillfully break through intense situations using your ultimate team. The tougher the challenge, the greater the sense of achievement and the better the rewards!

Hundreds of Unique Heroes to Choose From!
The game features hundreds of unique heroes. Defeat bosses and collect fragments to unlock your favorite heroes, then power them up and build an unbeatable team to conquer even more difficult bosses.

games.name: Super City
games.summary: Play as a biological experiment released by the nefarious Dr. Suffer to wreak havoc across the city. Fly around the city using superpowers to do anything you want - see the sights, race your friends, destroy the world!

games.name: Switchboard
games.summary: 1952, Empire Grand. Inhabit the frantic life of a telephone exchange operator in this thrilling voice-acted historical puzzle game. Connect calls, consult the directories and listen closely to earn your family a better life. When agents of war and rebellion begin to call your name, will you answer?

games.name: Task Time
games.summary: Task Time is a Gameshow inspired competitive party game where 8 friends dive headfirst into 6 rounds of unpredictable tasks and physics-fuelled chaos, to finish top of the leaderboard. From (some of) the people who worked on Gang Beasts and Fall Guys, this is your new favourite friendslop.

games.name: The Amusement
games.summary: An abandoned amusement park, a tangled memory, a family shattered by the Great War… Discover an intense story in this redirected-walking VR adventure in which every step counts.

games.name: The Case of the World between Worlds
games.summary: Hidden magic, real mates, and a city that is quietly falling apart.

games.name: The Day I Became a Bird
games.summary: Join Frank, an awkward young boy, as he discovers newfound feelings for his classmate, Sylvia - who only has eyes for birds. Explore, collect, and solve puzzles as Frank attempts to catch her attention with a homespun, feathery transformation in this warm and nostalgic return to childhood.

games.name: The Immortal Is Watching
games.summary: Players will take on the role of a little flower fairy and tap on wish plaques to send blessings. Each character’s story will unfold differently based on your choices. Once all wishes have been fulfilled, she will also experience different endings depending on your decisions.

games.name: Timing X
games.summary:
Created for game-a-week 2026, week 4 (theme: "tides and cycles")

Timing X puts you in the seat of a mech in a footrace. Sprint around a course, utilize the raising and lowering tides and get a good time. Made in UZDoom.

games.name: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
games.summary: Create Mii characters based on family and friends, someone you admire, or something completely original—there are plenty of personality traits, little quirks, and physical traits to choose from—including some face customization options you haven’t seen before! Go deep into getting every detail just right, or create Miis quickly and easily by answering some simple questions, and then help them explore their likes and dislikes, find relationships, and get up to all sorts of fun. Your Miis are bound to surprise you as they take on a life of their own!

games.name: Train Plus Mini 1
games.summary: Take the controls of the Big Edo Line and enjoy a compact yet exciting train-driving experience!

games.name: Umbra Lumen
games.summary: Roguelike Deckbuilder meets puzzle gameplay. Collect tarot cards and mystic items as you face unpredictable events, meet memorable characters, and explore the beyond life. Each run is different, and every decision matters. Will you ascend or fall in this unique turn-based RPG?

games.name: Under Par Golf Architect
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a golf architect as you build and manage your own golfing paradise! Sharpen your strategy by designing incredible courses to challenge the most demanding golfers and watch your club flourish as you attract VIP players, hire quirky staff and hold prestigious tournaments.

games.name: Unguided Order
games.summary: In a world where ancient barriers are crumbling, Darkness approaches Master Leo's home. Using a powerful artifact, Leo attempts to repel the threat. Your key tasks are strategy, creature selection, and tactical deployment, while your troops and the Master handle the battles and application of magic.

games.name: Void Blasters
games.summary: Void Blasters is an arcade space shooter where you battle waves of enemy ships, collect upgrades during combat, and increase your firepower to face the final bosses, The Hunter and The Crystal, in decisive encounters.

games.name: Void Daggers
games.summary: One touch kills you. Your timer is your score. Neon wireframe horrors swarm from infinite darkness. Shatter them, harvest their essence, forge your daggers through 5 tiers of devastation. Bunny hop the void. Dagger jump to survive. Prove your skill on Steam leaderboards. For fans of Devil Daggers.

games.name: We Are Prophet
games.summary: We Are Prophet is a free fast-paced real time multiplayer game for two players. Ideal to have a quick tournament among friends, on gaming festivals or LANs.

games.name: Weltkrieg 1: Firestorm
games.summary: Experience large-scale World War I battles in a realistic multiplayer shooter.

games.name: Witch Dance
games.summary: A fantasy-themed click 'em up in which a young witch dances around an arena and fights summoned familiars. Teleport to attack and strike as many enemies as you can!

games.name: Without a Dawn
games.summary: Without a Dawn is a dark, psychological, and philosophical visual horror novel featuring a hauntingly beautiful pseudo-ASCII art developed by award-winning Finnish solo developer Jesse Makkonen (DISTRAINT -series, Afterdream, Heal).

games.name: Wormies
games.summary: Wormies is a cozy indie game about running your own worm shop! Buy and breed hundreds of different wormies. Get to know your customers and fulfill their wormie orders to progress through different storylines!

games.name: Zombie Brawl Slayer
games.summary: Survive the swarm. Upgrade your arsenal. Become the ultimate Zombie Slayer.

games.name: ZPF
games.summary: ZPF is a retro-inspired horizontal shooter for the Sega Genesis/Mega Drive. Blast your way through a cosmic gauntlet of epic boss battles, addictive scoring, and hidden secrets in a thrilling arcade-style adventure through fantasy, sci-fi, and alien-themed worlds.

games.name: 5-Minute Maid
games.summary: Rimu has lost her memory and become trapped in a looping phenomenon. Moreover, only a tiny fraction of her memories carry over between loops. Within each five-minute cycle, she must retain only the crucial “memories” while setting the necessary flags. Will Rimu ever regain her memories?

games.name: A Girl Adrift: Reunited Horizon
games.summary:
The survival of a girl who drifts around in a world that was submerged in water!
A new open world game by DAERISOFT, a popular Google Play game developer!

games.name: Aicomi
games.summary: Create your own personalized classroom full of dream girls with an incredibly detailed character creation system, then romance them to your heart's content!

games.name: Angry Dog
games.summary: No More Mr. Good Boy

games.name: Apocalypse Day: Survival Z - Craft & Build
games.summary: The apocalypse doesn’t forgive the unprepared.

games.name: Asterfel
games.summary: Asterfel is a third-person Action-RPG. You find yourself shipwrecked on an island nation, where greed and magical mining rouse an old god from it’s slumber. Encounter three factions, discover forgotten history, and shape the island’s future. Will you thrive, survive, or witness the end of an era?

games.name: Beta Kafe: Write Your Love Story
games.summary: A man with a broken heart, trying to love and be loved—though it’s hard. In this dating simulation, you’ll be facing some of the most terrible first date experiences. It’s cinematic, funny, and brutally honest!

games.name: Cat From Hell: Cat Simulator
games.summary:
In this game you're about to destroy the grandma's house. Knock over priceless vases, shred curtains mid-nap, and bat heirlooms into oblivion! Whether it's eating the fish from the aquarium, breaking flower pots, or throwing random items across the room, a cat simulator lets you do it all.

Scratch carpets, couches, and any furniture in sight as you explore different rooms filled with destructible objects. Every scratched sofa and shattered plate fuels Granny’s escalating rage. How much havoc can you unleash before she snaps?

games.name: Cloud Dwellers
games.summary: Cloud Dwellers is a 2D simulation and city-building game set in a world of scattered floating islands. Guide your settlers to harness technology, optimize production, and transform fragmented skies into a thriving, beautifully crafted aerial haven.

games.name: Convenience Store Simulator
games.summary: A game about running and managing your own convenience store. Actively work the register, master stock and inventory, make and sell coffee, hire unique staff, and fully decorate your space. Strategically expand your business and play special mini-games for prizes.

games.name: Cralon
games.summary: Cralon is an authentic 3D dungeon crawler with RPG and adventure elements, inspired by the ultimate dungeon classics. Hunting a demon, you fell into the abyss of an old mine. Equip yourself, fight creatures, solve quests, uncover secrets and find a way out.

games.name: Dark Edge
games.summary: DARK EDGE is a medieval-themed action game. As darkness approaches, plagues and zombies relentlessly consume the homeland. Players will manage and build city-states, recruit warriors, investigate plagues, and resist zombies and monsters. The game includes single-player, co-op, and PVP.

games.name: DataFall
games.summary:
DataFall is a fast-paced cyberpunk action game built around risk, optimization and player decision-making.

While it appears to reward min-max strategies, the game dynamically reacts to over-optimization, forcing players to adapt instead of relying on static builds.

Featuring neon-styled visuals, escalating difficulty systems and reactive mechanics, DataFall challenges players to balance greed, efficiency and survival.

games.name: Dead 4 Now: Bio-weapon Simulator
games.summary: Craft bio-weapons, master lethal science, and unleash global annihilation. Experiment. Fail. Adapt. Evolve. Repeat until humankind falls.

games.name: Dead Hospital
games.summary:
the world is dying.

it's april first - all the local news stations have begun extensive coverage of an unknown disease making all food items inedible. your world will soon succumb to famine. people flood into hospitals in hopes of treating symptoms of the disease, and the sky turns dark under an eternal red moon.

games.name: Decollate Decoration
games.summary: This is a point-and-click, command-selection style adventure game where the protagonist is a girl who has become a ghost. The objective is to fulfill her desires by speaking to her beloved "him" causing poltergeists, visiting in dreams, or even cursing.

games.name: Dig & Deal
games.summary: Dig & Deal is a game where you dig underground to find valuable items and bargain with customers to sell what you find. Upgrade your tools, grow your shop, and make the best deals to build your fortune.

games.name: Drowning Song of the Stagnant Sea
games.summary: A dark fairy tale set in the deep sea. The fated encounter between a sea monster and a human forever changes their lives in this yuri visual novel.

games.name: Dunk Cookies
games.summary: Break cookies. Dunk them in milk. Repeat. A satisfying incremental game where you crush cookies into a swirling vortex of milk. Upgrade your breaking power, unlock new stats via an expansive skill tree, and discover the ultimate satisfaction of the perfect dunk.

games.name: E.S.O: Don't Forget
games.summary: A terrifying test of memory. Escape the creatures and don't forget what door you've been assigned...

games.name: Flee, My Elven Ninja! 3D
games.summary: It was just another one of your super secret ninja missions—until you rescued the elven maiden Lizet. Flee from the royal guards hot on your trail as you train her... in more ways than one. Get ready to set out on a romantic adventure that's filled with as many laughs as there are intimate moments!

games.name: Fremd Wagen: Mod Chaos
games.summary: Fremd Wagen: Modding Mayhem. The ultimate frustrating mathematical mod simulator. To stop the crashes, ensure your Mod Sum obeys the Rule of 42. Install the bypass fix, clean the DLLs, and solve the equation. Failure results in a 0xC0000005 crash!

games.name: Generation Exile
games.summary: Generation Exile is a turn-based city-builder taking place aboard a generation starship where instead of extracting more and more natural resources to meet your populace’s needs, you only have what you brought with you. Rebuild the ship’s fragile ecosystems before the ship reaches the end of its journey. Procedurally generated characters and storylines mean that every journey — spanning several hundred years — will be uniquely yours.

games.name: Gloomvex
games.summary:
Gloomvex is a dark sci-fi arena roguelite about surviving relentless enemy waves on a hostile alien world.

Fight your way through increasingly dangerous runs, collect gold and experience, unlock upgrades, and shape your build with weapons, stats, and powerful augments. Each run pushes you to adapt quickly, improve your damage output, manage movement, and survive against growing swarms of enemies and powerful bosses.

With permanent progression, escalating difficulty, and a grim sci-fi atmosphere, Gloomvex focuses on fast survival combat, build optimization, and the constant push to become stronger with every attempt.

games.name: Graphic Design Is My Passion
games.summary: Graphic Design is my passion is a cooperative game, where one player tries to describe a specific painting order, that the other has to build from pieces of different artworks. But be careful: everything must be ready before the timer stops!

games.name: Hell Is Empty, Demons Are Playing Apokerlypse
games.summary: A deck-building roguelike shedding card game. You will play as Satan—a humble civil servant in Hell—and embark on a 3-chapter Story Mode. By combining various skills and demonic chips, you will take down powerful bosses and claim your throne as the new King of Hell.

games.name: Hero x Hero
games.summary: Hero x Hero (SigmonVR) is a free-to-play, standalone VR multiplayer action-RPG for Meta Quest. The game features an anime-inspired superhero theme centered around fighting demons. Its main mechanic is collecting "souls" from defeated enemies to transform into different heroes, each with an independent skill tree. It offers both cooperative PvE dungeons and competitive PvP arenas.

games.name: Hope Harrison
games.summary: Hope Harrison takes a twist on the survival horror genre and remixes it with Hand Crafted RNG, Nightmarish Monsters and Permadeath. Can you find hope?

games.name: Hunting World
games.summary: Hunting World is an open-world hunting survival game set in a vast safari wilderness. Track wildlife, manage hunger and stamina, craft weapons, and face powerful boss creatures. Explore freely, survive harsh environments, and prove yourself as the ultimate hunter!

games.name: Last Shinobi
games.summary: Dive into a tactical roguelike where every decision counts. Build a unique strategy, unlock new skills and companions, and refine your synergies. Each level is a strategic puzzle to solve. No deck, minimal randomness, only strategic choices.

games.name: Mawgate
games.summary: Maria Moore is wrongfully imprisoned in the dreaded Mawgate Asylum. To survive she must do things she never thought herself capable of. Fight, hide, solve puzzles, and investigate the illusive dark forces behind the asylum. Maria must escape, or be consumed by the madness of Mawgate…

games.name: Millions of Billions of Suns
games.summary:
Millions of Billions of Suns is a next-generation 3D space MMO playable directly in your browser—no downloads required. Set in an ever-expanding universe engineered to host hundreds of thousands of players simultaneously, the game combines deep empire-building strategy with thrilling space combat.

Start with a single ship and build your way up to a massive interstellar empire. Gather resources, research technologies, and construct powerful fleets to defend your territory or conquer new solar systems.

games.name: Mina
games.summary: Mina is a psychological thriller and story-driven TPS about psychiatrist Koray and patient Kagan investigating whether their world is a simulation. Players also experience Mina’s traumatic past and her attempts to escape, shaping the narrative through their choices.

games.name: Neve
games.summary: Neve is a non-linear interactive fiction in which your decisions can completely change the course of history. Manage your team, race against time and unravel the mysteries surrounding your ship's crash in this suffocating retrofuturistic thriller that will have you hooked from the first second.

games.name: Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu
games.summary: Dash, dodge, and dive through the ultimate Japanese gameshow experience! Up to 4 contestants race through chaotic obstacle courses across Japan, filled with hilarious hazards and obscure obstacles. It’s so crazy, you’ll be shouting ‘Konnichi-what?!’ instead of ‘Konnichiwa!’

games.name: Nori Game
games.summary: A chaotic 1–4 player chest-heist party game. Steal treasure from your friends, hide your loot, build defenses, and race to be the first to secure 5 chests.

games.name: Noskovrazdor
games.summary: Noskovrazdor is a humoristic incremental game. Player takes a role of unnamed operator in goverment structure, and is blocking the outer web.

games.name: NTR & Zombies
games.summary: NTR & Zombies! Survive, go out, find secrets and... well, maybe be cheated and cheat? It's up to you!

games.name: Oni Sazae Tori
games.summary: Free diving and shell collecting 2D action game.

games.name: Patent Tycoon
games.summary: This is a management simulation game in which you develop your company by making full use of patents. Grow your company through inventions, applications, license negotiations, and litigation!

games.name: Peace Incarnate
games.summary: Stop the enigmatic crisis of the disappearing city. Fight or troubleshoot your way across warring factions.

games.name: Phazika
games.summary: Click to freeze time. Release to redirect your momentum. That's all you need. Bend time and wrangle physics as you dodge bullets and zigzag through impossible obstacles in the abstract psychedelic worlds of this roguelike/speedrunning joyride.

games.name: Plane Flight Simulator
games.summary:
Experience the thrill of aviation like never before in Plane Flight Simulator. Step into the cockpit of realistic aircraft, from small private planes to massive commercial jets, and master the art of flying.
Soar through open skies, navigate changing weather conditions, and complete challenging missions that test your piloting skills. Explore airports around the world, practice smooth landings, or simply enjoy free-flight mode for a relaxing journey above the clouds.

games.name: Planet Lust
games.summary: Due to unfortunate events, you end up at a military base on Mars with four beautiful women. You'll have one month to spend there. Better make the most of it!

games.name: Pragmata
games.summary: Pragmata is a sci-fi action-adventure game set in the near future. The story follows Hugh and his android companion Diana as they navigate a Lunar research station. Gameplay incorporates action elements alongside mechanics involving interaction with systems within the environment.

games.name: Project Dejavu
games.summary: Blast, dodge, and drift through treacherous 3D mazes in a vibrant, retro-inspired tank platformer! Master twitch-action combat, survive bullet-hell showdowns, and uncover shortcuts to conquer nearly 50 challenging stages. One wrong move, and you're sunk!

games.name: Repeat After Death
games.summary: The task is simple, defeat enemies using various Characters. But, your past move will consume you the more you continue down the path. Discover the dungeon mysteries while engaging with the other dungeon dwellers

games.name: Sanctum Ruins
games.summary: A strategic roguelike deck-builder. Build your deck, master 8 unique classes, and conquer the Sanctum in quick sessions. Free to play.

games.name: Scarlet Idol
games.summary: Scarlet Idol is a 3D Chinese folk horror puzzle game featuring a co-op two-player mode. The game integrates various folk cultural elements, including the funeral rituals of the Wu-Yue region, Ghost operas, Mulian operas, the duomin (outcast communities)

games.name: Skatr
games.summary: SKATR is an inline skating game where you skate fast and do cool tricks. Do advanced tricks for more points and maintain max speed! It's also just fun 2 skate around.

games.name: Skidddddd: Tori's Frozen Racing
games.summary:
Skidddddd: Tori's Frozen Racing is a physical-based friendship-destroying cooperative racing game that plays with only trust (or distrust) in each other.
Do you want to reach the finish line with your perfect teamwork or throw your friendship into the icy water?

games.name: Slay All Bosses: Idle
games.summary: Slay All Bosses: Idle, is a short incremental RPG. Cut down waves of enemies, defeat powerful bosses, and rapidly grow stronger through character skill trees, weapon and skill upgrades, and equipped passive abilities, all on your path to becoming the ultimate hero.

games.name: SpaceSlog
games.summary:
SpaceSlog is a challenging sci-fi spaceship simulator that focuses on shipbuilding, crew interaction, and exploration. Inspired by games such as Rimworld, Starship Theory, Dwarf Fortress and X-COM, as well as iconic media such as Firefly, Battlestar Galactica, Stargate Universe and The Expanse.

Your colony ship has been destroyed. Fortunately, a few survivors managed to escape on a small ship. Now alone, hungry, and lost in space, you must explore the cosmos and guide them to safety.

games.name: Starlight Mining Company
games.summary: Build and defend your base to mine starlight crystals in this roguelike co-op tower defense! Carve paths, build defenses, and upgrade your operation as 1-4 players battling escalating waves of hostile threats across a procedurally generated galaxy.

games.name: Sunlit Journey
games.summary: Sunlit Journey: The Town Small Town is a short, heartwarming visual novel. As the opening chapter of an ongoing series, it centers on gentle everyday life and tells a tender encounter set in a quiet small town.

games.name: Sunrock Lake
games.summary: Welcome to Sunrock Lake

games.name: Survivor TD
games.summary: A tactical defense game where you build the battlefield itself. Lure enemies through your maze using traps, towers, and godly powers.

games.name: Syr and the Stars' Revival
games.summary: “Syr and the Stars' Revival” follows the new Nextuber “Syr” as she sets out to restore the fallen Cyber World. Stream, gain fans, and help the Cyber World flourish once again! A brand-new raising simulation where building your room is the key to streaming success!

games.name: Tacticell Arena
games.summary:
Tacticell Arena is a 2D top-down shooter centered on tactical squad management with a primary focus on local PvP. The game features shared-screen gameplay where each player controls a squad of three soldiers. At any time, the player directly controls one soldier using the controller, with the ability to switch control between any of the three squad members instantly. The two soldiers not being directly controlled can receive tactical orders to coordinate movements and secure objectives.

The gameplay involves navigating the arena, engaging the opposing player’s units, and collecting power-ups that modify unit statistics. The game includes a variety of adjustable match settings to customize the experience.

games.name: The Butler
games.summary:
You play as Deacon, the son of George, a maintenance man who mysteriously disappeared years ago. Driven by years of unanswered questions, you’ve devoted years to finding him. But the deeper you dig, the darker the truths you uncover, secrets you wish you’d never known, and horrors that will linger long after the game ends.

The Butler is a spin-off set in the world of Claire, centered on George—a figure briefly mentioned in the original game. What was once a passing detail now unfolds into a story of its own, revealing events that connect back to Claire in unexpected ways.

games.name: The Ember Guardian
games.summary: Explore a post-apocaliptic world in a beautiful pixel art style. Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and setup your defenses during the day. At night, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons.

games.name: The Empty Desk
games.summary: Dive into a psychological thriller filled with adventure and puzzles, with touches of horror. Join Detective Bennett on his final case and unravel dark secrets in a world where reality twists and sanity crumbles.

games.name: The Forest Watches
games.summary: You are the newest member of a forest cult. Complete assigned rituals, obey their rules, and uncover the forest’s unsettling secrets. Every step is watched.

games.name: The Tale of Spring City
games.summary: Ziqing Xu, a young girl from Spring City. Her father mysteriously disappeared soon after. During a strange turn of events, she suddenly gains the ability to see into the supernatural realm—the so-called "Yin Yan." Will she be able to uncover the truth?

games.name: Tokyo Trigger
games.summary: Tokyo 2050 glows with neon, but darkness simmers beneath. Akihito, a warrior with a fractured past, uncovers a plot threatening the city. Blast through a top-down cyberpunk world in this fast-paced 2D shooter. Can you fight back against the tide of oppression and reclaim your memories and honor?

games.name: Towers of Scale
games.summary: A resource management optimization puzzle game with metaprogression under a guise of an RPG. Explore the towers, get high scores, obtain gems and push the scores even further beyond!

games.name: Treeplanter
games.summary:
Create and enjoy a peaceful, interactive woodland throughout the changing seasons.
For every copy sold, we plant a real tree!

games.name: Venice After Dark
games.summary: A visual novel adventure alongside young Japanese engineer Aiko and her AI friend. Solve the mysterious case around the Stucky family and unravel what it means to be human through the eyes of an AI programmer.

games.name: VertalStrike
games.summary:
Vertal Strike is a fast-paced multiplayer FPS built around momentum, clean sightlines, and aggressive map control. Queue into online matches, host your own room, or fill the server with bots to keep the pressure on while you practice routes, recoil, and reactions.

Every map is designed for readable fights and constant decisions. Hold angles, snap between cover, rotate with your squad, and punish over-extensions before the next push starts. The low-poly presentation keeps combat clear while bold effects and distinct spaces make every firefight easy to read.

games.name: Word Quest Fantasy
games.summary: Wield enchanted swords, explore ancient castles, and unravel word puzzles charged with mystical power. Each grid hides words that bring you closer to becoming a true hero of the realm. Defeat challenges, unlock secrets, and let your imagination guide you through a storybook world where every word is part of your adventure. Are you ready to prove yourself in the ultimate fantasy word quest?

games.name: Write Warz
games.summary: Dive into Write Warz, where creativity clashes in thrilling story battles! Craft sentences, vote on favorites, and navigate plot twists in diverse themed worlds. Unleash your imagination in this multiplayer creative writing adventure one sentence at a time.

games.name: Abyss Cards
games.summary: Abyss Cards is a strategic roguelike deck-builder with real-time auto-battle combat. Recruit powerful units, cast devastating spells, and collect ancient relics as you descend deeper into a cursed dungeon — where every choice is permanent and death means starting over.

games.name: Bahnfrei
games.summary: Race down icy slopes packed with sharp turns and unforgiving obstacles. A fast, chaotic co-op game built for speedrunners and friendship stress-tests.

games.name: Deep Soup
games.summary:
Deep Soup is a surreal, soup-like exploration game.

Each room contains one unique object. When you get close to it, you can interact to move on to the next room.

A credits text file is included in the game folder.

games.name: Discovery 2
games.summary: Build, share & explore! Discovery 2 is a beautiful sandbox game. Now available on Nintendo Switch!

games.name: Echo 91
games.summary: A video blogger explores an abandoned Soviet school to film content — but the deeper he goes, the more disturbing the truth becomes. Discover secrets, solve puzzles, and try to escape a place that doesn’t want to let you go.

games.name: For Luna the Bell Tolls
games.summary: A chime heard once in five years. A past that never left.

games.name: Hentai Special 4-in-1
games.summary: Step into the world of passion, love, and true connection!

games.name: Hole ASMR
games.summary: Absorb fruit and grow your hole

games.name: Kamikaze Strike: FPV Drone
games.summary: Fly a kamikaze drone through fast-paced FPV missions. Dodge bullets, sneak past jammers and radars, and crash into tanks, troops, and enemy bases. Discover diffferent drones and face tougher challenges in every level.

games.name: Low Magic They Said
games.summary: They lied about the magic being low. A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where victory matters - beat the game with one class, their magic unlocks for all others. 3 classes at launch. Optional dungeons. Gods who answer prayers. Vibrant fantasy descending into cosmic horror.

games.name: Magical Girl Yusya-chan and the Labyrinth of Lust
games.summary: Everyone's favorite idol "Yusha-chan" stars in a new turn-based roguelike! Conquer deep dungeons, grow stronger, and seize victory, or taste a brutal defeat! Guide Yusha-chan, brought to life with fluid Live2D animations, to her destiny. Streamers welcome!

games.name: My Winter Drive
games.summary:
Brace yourself for a chilly adventure through icy roads and snowy landscapes. In My Winter Drive, you take the wheel of various vehicles and navigate realistic winter conditions where every curve, skid, and snowdrift tests your driving skills.
Whether you're delivering cargo, rescuing stranded travelers, or just enjoying the serene beauty of frozen wilderness, this game offers a true-to-life winter driving experience with immersive physics and dynamic weather.

games.name: Night Creed
games.summary: In the ruined lands of an ancient kingdom, evil, hidden for centuries in the ruins of old castles, awakens. Monsters begin to emerge from dark rifts, filling the deserted fortresses and forgotten roads.

games.name: Not My Child
games.summary: A psychological horror where a father returns home, only to find toys and haunting notes that whisper a truth he refuses to face.

games.name: Open For Business
games.summary: Open For Business is a shop management simulator, but not a typical one. This isn’t about selling water, food, or random everyday items. It’s about nostalgia — that feeling you get when you pick up a game, a movie, a cartridge, or a VHS, and it actually means something. In this game, you build your own store and sell games, movies and animated films, consoles, collectible figures, and more — from retro VHS tapes and cartridges to modern entertainment.

games.name: Opi Popi
games.summary:
Opipopi is a short point-and-click adventure game where the player spends time in their room before falling asleep.

Players can interact with various objects in the room in any order. Each interaction increases the character's "sleepiness." Once the sleepiness reaches a certain level, the night ends, and time progresses.

The game features three different endings, which branch depending on whether the player discovers specific elements in the room before falling asleep. Hints for unlocking these conditions are hidden within the game's UI, such as backlog text colors and speech bubble shapes. The average playtime is 15 to 20 minutes per playthrough.

games.name: Radiance of Annihilation: Disorder Eclipse
games.summary: In a post-apocalyptic world, a government employee works together with his partner to stop criminals from uncovering weapons that once devastated the world, only to get caught in a conspiracy that could decide humanity's fate. Follow Ikusu and uncover a dark conspiracy in this classic visual novel experience.

games.name: Sad Virus Military
games.summary: Sad Virus mission to collect beer bottles in this 3rd person adventure game in military based land

games.name: Space Memory: Fairies
games.summary: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable fairies in space

games.name: Stella Pastoris
games.summary: Shepherd the last remnants of the Malthusian monks marooned on Proxima Centauri B. As the colony AI, will you delve into forbidden means to save your people or allow them to go quietly into the night? Set up production chains to spend limited resources to save as many as you can.

games.name: Stretchy Adventure
games.summary: Stretch through obstacles!

games.name: Wyred
games.summary: You play as a little robot looking after a lonely outpost on a distant planet. In each puzzle, your goal is to find a way to the other (or one of several) connectors while laying down a wire as you go. But be careful; you cannot cross over the wire you have laid, lest you break it!

games.name: Brutus Maximus
games.summary: Embark on a hellish road trip around the Roman Empire. From Teutoburg to Rome, slay anything standing in your way, survival roguelite-style. Unlock new heroes, weapons, and skills to create synergies. Wipe out entire Roman legions in this hack-and-slash, stab, and shoot survivors game.

games.name: Castle Craft
games.summary: Castle Craft is a game where players build huge castles in an ancient war-torn world and defend them against hordes of enemies in chaotic siege battles of epic proportions. Castle Craft is a unique blend of voxel sandbox, action, and horde defence.

games.name: Cazzarion: Laser Puzzle
games.summary: Sharpen your aim in this precision-based puzzle game with 20 playable levels. Rotate laser cannons, mirrors, and prisms to direct beams toward radiant crystals. Some challenges include switches that reveal hidden doors. This Game is a true test of logic and ingenuity

games.name: Creepytape Rewind: Not From Here
games.summary: A change of environment, isolation in a remote area, and a chain of seemingly random events can leave the mind vulnerable. But what will your imagination create when you're met with hostility from the locals?

games.name: Faithfall
games.summary: Faithfall is a fast-paced Boomer-Shooter where you play as Maria, a girl infected with demonic blood after a demon invasion in the city of Valdovia.

games.name: Forever With You
games.summary: Finding love isn't always easy. Within a limited time, manage your life and find someone you truly love.

games.name: Red Capture
games.summary: Red Capture is a side-scrolling game where the player controls a red square, dodging dangerous figures and jumping on constantly shifting and randomly changing platforms. The game also features a competitive two-player mode where you can see who can last the longest.

games.name: Whisper
games.summary: Whisper is a chilling first-person horror game set in a haunted mansion filled with dark secrets and eerie whispers. As an investigator, explore the shadowy corridors, solve haunting puzzles, and uncover the tragic past of Whisper Manor. Will you survive the terror within?

games.name: WishPot
games.summary: Korean folklore comes to life in a strategic board game where you chase your wishes! Combine number-and-ability cards to battle, upgrade your deck, and claim territory. Every match feels fresh—and tense—thanks to missions, talismans, sponsorships, and the Read system!

games.name: 3Chess
games.summary: 3-player chess on a symmetric 127-cell hex board. Three armies — Gold, Azure, Crimson — compete in a game that chess engines cannot solve.

games.name: All Hail the Orb
games.summary:
All Hail The Orb is a quirky and short active incremental game in which you devote yourself to The Orb!
Explore the once lost dungeon as you build your gathering of cultists and bring the dungeon back to its former glory!
Explore and enjoy the light-hearted progression and story!

games.name: Alternis
games.summary: "Alternis is a hack and slash combat game in first and third person, for single player and multiplayer, still in the early stages of development."

games.name: Asterobits
games.summary: You've escaped from the galaxy's most secure space prison, and now there's a bunch of angry lawless chasing you. You must survive, fight for your freedom, and outrun these grumpy pursuers. Asterobits delivers a relentless (and slightly absurd) escape in an arcade-style roguelike space shooter.

games.name: Bacon in Zane
games.summary: Who would have thought – In the human body, every tiny action is being controlled by a simple tap. In this game, accompany a piece of bacon through the digestive process and control the bacteria in the small intestine, the breathing of the lungs, or the neurons in the brain: all with just one finger.

games.name: Bad Range
games.summary: Skewer them all! Control a spear‑wielding tank in this updated single‑screen arcade-like action game. Line up targets and pierce multiple enemies at once. Conquer each stage with a satisfying, steady challenge. 7 interwoven storylines gradually reveal the truth behind the unfolding incidents.

games.name: Bee my Bloom
games.summary: It's a cozy little flower-matching game where you buzz around as a bee, carry pollen from flower to flower, discover new blooms, and slowly fill out your collection as each day loops back around.

games.name: Beer Gunner
games.summary: A fast-paced run-and-gun shooter in the spirit of the classics — shoot, jump, and shred monsters to energetic music.

games.name: Bigfoot Hunting
games.summary: Hunt the legend and survive the untamed wilderness.

games.name: Blades, Bows & Magic
games.summary: Blades, Bows & Magic is a casual medieval fantasy multiplayer / singleplayer strategy card battler. Based on the mechanic of Rock, Paper, Scissors - but with Warriors, Archers, Mages - fighting with special abilities.

games.name: Bloodbane: The Crimson Nocturne
games.summary: Scavenge for resources, collect equipment, and carefully manage your servant’s temper as you prepare to face and defeat a rival vampire lord.

games.name: Bylina
games.summary: Embark on an epic journey to the Far Far Kingdom and challenge Koschei the Deathless to save your immortal soul and become a true hero in Bylina, an Action RPG rooted in Slavic folklore and myths. Take on the role of Falconet, a young bogatyr born without hero's powers, shunned and underestimated by almost everyone. Conquer numerous ordeals, overcome insurmountable odds, and become a legendary hero whose tales will be told for ages to come.

games.name: Chipmatic
games.summary: Chipmatic is a factory building game where you control a mining robot on a mission to reach Earth’s core. Explore deep underground, research new tech and create the best (and only) factory on Earth! Can you discover what mysteries lie beneath the surface in this ruined planet some used to call home?

games.name: City States: Medieval
games.summary: You are the leader of a city-state in high medieval Europe. Expand your city through deep city-building systems, build a trade empire across the known world, and lead men to war to defend trade routes in a high-stakes struggle of global strategy and brutal tower defense warfare.

games.name: Current
games.summary: A peaceful speedrunning game with flowy platforming and extensive movement tech. Only the fastest can earn their place in The Haven.

games.name: Dead Rush
games.summary: Dead Rush is an FPS arcade shooter that combines fast-paced action, stylized visuals, and relentless waves of zombies. Choose your weapon, fight with friends, and see how long you can survive.

games.name: Deckbane
games.summary: Embark on a strategic roguelike quest to save the World in Deckbane, a tactical blend of turn-based deckbuilding and poker-powered combat. Collect cards, forge explosive bonds with pets, and play winning hands to unleash devastating attacks!

games.name: Depth Diver
games.summary: Depth Diver is a co-op game where you go on an underwater trip with your friends to gather resources and repair underwater facilities in dangerous waters.

games.name: Dialoop
games.summary: This is a roguelike puzzle game where quick thinking determines your survival. Every run offers a fresh experience based on your choices—deck-building, puzzle-solving, and exploration all shape your journey. Master the mysterious stone tablets and uncover the secrets hidden within ancient ruins!

games.name: Do a Crime
games.summary: Do A Crime is a casually-chaotic-cozy platform puzzler where you play as a Raccoon - doing crimes! Do A Crime takes the whimsy of being a mischievous raccoon and allows the player to live out their chaos gremlin dreams.

games.name: Dungeon Within
games.summary:
"Reclaim Your Throne as the True Dark Lord!"

Awaken as an amnesiac Dark Lord in an endless dream world and construct your own ruthless dungeon. Explore the realm to rally scattered monsters, deploy deadly traps, and bring ruin to insolent invaders.

Death is not the end, but the beginning of new power. Through endless roguelike runs, forge your DUNGEON into the ultimate, inescapable fortress!

games.name: Fool's Court
games.summary: You are the king. Petitioners bring tales of theft, betrayal, and ambition to your throne. Listen to their pleas, issue your decrees, and watch stability tip, shaping a kingdom of grudges, loyalty, and consequence.

games.name: Fracture Field
games.summary: Welcome to Fracture Field, an incremental game about managing a dynamic quarry and wielding earth-shattering power. Unlock deeper layers and various upgrades for tools, drones and more. Fracture the world to get access to persistent upgrades.

games.name: Fries Drive
games.summary: Hit the gas and fire up the fryer! Build your street food empire in this cozy cooking adventure. Navigate a charming open world, find the perfect parking spot, and serve crispy, golden fries to hungry customers. Master the kitchen, upgrade your truck, and become a street food legend.

games.name: Gravity Break
games.summary: Physics-based single-player space adventure about discovering ultimate freedom in the Solar System while the Earth is burning.

games.name: Haywire
games.summary:
A 3rd-person game made for ludum dare 59 where every strike is driven by signals sent directly from your brain to your body.

Each attack triggers a “Brain Rush”, a quick reaction check you must pass to land the hit. Take too many hits, and your brain overloads, sending false signals that disrupt your attacks.

Set in a biopunk world, you fight to stay in control as your own mind becomes your greatest challenge.

games.name: High on Life 2
games.summary: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

games.name: Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch
games.summary:
Jump in the shoes of Lunch Box and Mr. Snoogans in a colorful Side-scrolling 2.5D over-the-top multiplayer brawler! Play as the dynamic duo alone or with a friend in a tag team combo fight fest. Destroy your enemies with fists, feet, and the magic of self-esteem destroying shit talk while you embark on a mission to find your long lost pot customers trapped in an Orwellian shopping center.

Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch is a colorful side-scrolling tag-team beat-em-up where players swap back and forth between our heroes on the fly or perform special moves simultaneously with a friend. Our heroes embark on an epic adventure from the humble corners where they ply their trade to the gates of hell itself.

games.name: Loot Tycoon
games.summary: You are not the Hero—you are the Merchant who bleeds them dry! Dive into a unique mix of Hack & Slash and Shop Simulation. Farm dungeons with fully automated combat, loot legendary artifacts, and crash the market. Build your shop from a dirty rug to a medieval monopoly.

games.name: Love Surge!
games.summary: Love Surge! is a comedy dating sim where you can romance human versions of your appliances, merging visual novel text with card game mechanics. As you rack up point combos, you will simulate deeper conversations. Who will you choose?

games.name: Magissy
games.summary: Magissy is an Open-World Story-Driven Adult RPG where you take place as a charismatic adventurer and excellent lover, who fears not the danger of dark corners of the Lyrn nor the darkest fantasies of it's behaviors.

games.name: Mech Robot: Battle Shooter Warrior
games.summary: Control the machine. Control the fight.

games.name: Medieval Machines Builder
games.summary: Acquire plans, gather resources and create the most destructive device in history in Medieval Machines Builder! Become the greatest inventor in the whole world!

games.name: MMO98
games.summary: An incremental game where you go from small-scale MMO development studio up to global market domination. Improve your server infrastructure, address the technical challenges of running an MMO, release new games, and become the world's #1 MMO game studio.

games.name: Murder Mystery Mayhem AI
games.summary: Find the murderer in this AI-powered 1920s whodunit. Interrogate richly layered characters and piece together clues in procedurally generated cases as you roleplay a detective in this unique blend of deduction, strategy, and immersive conversations that drive each case forward.

games.name: No Retreat! the Russian Front
games.summary: This game is a Strategic game on the Eastern Front of World War II.It is a digital port from the famous and eponym boardgame, No Retreat!, designed by Carl Paradis.

games.name: One King Is Enough
games.summary: High-speed territory control battle! Build structures, earn money, and grow your army to expand your territory. One King Is Enough is a strategy roguelike deck-building game where you compete against players worldwide in asynchronous battles. Outsmart your rivals with your own powerful builds.

games.name: Pratfall
games.summary: A co-op game where you fall, dig, and explode your way down a dangerous cave system to find your lost dog. Catch your friends and watch your step on this journey full of traps, hazards, and the most deadly force of all: gravity. Will you jump into the unknown to rescue your dog?

games.name: Rino Rush
games.summary: Rino Rush is a fast-paced arcade game inspired by the classic Snake formula. Collect coins, grow longer and try to survive as long as possible.

games.name: Runehaven
games.summary: Runehaven is an atmospheric roguelike dungeon crawler with an immersive magic system where you craft your own spells. Explore a mysterious procedurally generated world.

games.name: Saint Slayer: Spear of Sacrilege
games.summary: Saint Slayer is an NES-style 2D action game, featuring loads of stages, enemies, and gore set against the backdrop of late-17th century Europe. Play as the ex-soldier Rudiger and wield the Spear of Sacrilege as you save the Holy Roman Empire from the corrupt Catholic priest Father Pacer.

games.name: Scribed Castle
games.summary: Scribed castle is a city builder where you scribe whimsical towns, cozy villages, and gothic cathedrals in the medieval illustration art style.

games.name: Silent Snow
games.summary: Seth and May have moved out of the city and into a big old house that uncle John decided he didnt want anymore. Although the holiday spirit brings color and joy to an otherwise barren house, something lurks outside hidden in the snow. Watching. Waiting.

games.name: Slot Theory
games.summary: Pick 1 tower, modifier or upgrade every wave. Stack insane tower synergies and watch your build spiral out of control.

games.name: Socturnal
games.summary:
SOCTURNAL is a sniper-focused tactical FPS. Play as Liswn, HORRIBLE KNIGHT, ROGUE EX-MERCENARY who now acts on his own. See the end of Kapyr and his Glowing Prance soldiers.

Make your way through 2 large, hand-crafted levels in this Ghost Recon/Delta Force-inspired shooter. Your sniper gives you free reign on open spaces, but managing stealth and efficiency inside bases will be a challenge.

Liswn's ghost-Bravo vs. Kapyr's zero-Alpha.
Behold the white cloud. Enact vengeance.

games.name: Space Drilling Station
games.summary: In Space Drilling Station, manage and automate a drilling station on a distant planet. Build a multi-level vertical structure to produce and manage your resources and staff, in order to solve the energy crisis and destroy the competition.

games.name: Stellar Wreck
games.summary:
Stellar Wreck is a game where you control a child who must survive in space aboard a partially broken spaceship.

(more content is still in development) You must complete quests and uncover your character's past, but you can also take it slow and build up your ship with beautiful decorations.
