To gather decorations, you'll need to arm yourself with weapons and tools to fight strange alien monsters and... actual animals...?

There's a whole range of skills and abilities available!

games.name: Super Meme Clicker
games.summary: This is a clicker game where you click the meme to gain click currency! The more clicks you have, the crazier your clicks will become! Every click you make has a chance to change the meme - how many clicks will it take you to get the rarest one?

games.name: Superstar LDH
games.summary: Superstar LDH is the official rhythm experience for LDH fans, packing songs from debut-era favorites to fresh releases. Tap through charted beats, rack up combos, and build a collection that showcases the artists you love. Developed by DalcomSoft Japan, this Music title mixes satisfying rhythm play with card collecting in a way that feels made for the fandom.

games.name: Sword & Siege Crusades: Book II
games.summary: Continue the struggle for the Holy Land in Crusades: Book II, a tactical medieval wargame covering the Third and Fourth Crusades between 1149 and 1204. Command the Crusader Alliance or the Anti-Crusader Alliance across 102 historically accurate scenarios and four branching campaigns.

games.name: Tessel Run
games.summary: A physics-based puzzle platformer featuring hand-drawn tangram tessels, layered parallax worlds, and color that changes the rules of physics.

games.name: The Solitary Existence of a Little Universe
games.summary: In this dark interactive novel you will play as a lost soul wandering a forsaken desert, accompanied by a mysterious girl. Explore ancient ruins and face obscure choices. Your decisions will shape their journey—often in ways you’ll never fully understand. Will you find peace, or something else?

games.name: There's No Differences: Dragons
games.summary: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar dragon-themed scenes!

games.name: Tidehaven: Ale & Trade
games.summary: From ale to empire, build, upgrade, and automate your way to medieval greatness! Customize your inn, grow your town, and unlock upgrades. Automate everything because even in the Middle Ages, micromanagement is for peasants.

games.name: Tiny Bakery
games.summary: Run a tiny bakery for sweet-toothed slime customers! Adapt to changing weather, seasons, and festivals as cravings shift. Unlock new recipes, welcome new guests, and prepare each night for the day ahead.

games.name: Together We Move
games.summary: WASD… but every key is controlled by a different player. Control ONE character together—sync movement, jumps, and actions to survive chaotic parkour. Perfect teamwork… or total disaster? (Playable with 1–5 players.)

games.name: TownsFolk
games.summary: Guide your people through ruin—build, survive, and let every choice shape their fate. Rekindle the light of a forgotten world.

games.name: Trade Empire
games.summary: Trade Empire is a medieval trade strategy simulation game. Create your merchant, start trading in your chosen city, and use diplomatic moves to take control of trade across the entire map and eliminate your rivals.

games.name: Typing Farmer
games.summary: Welcome to Typing Farmer! This desktop idle healing game will make a corner of your screen a cozy farm. Your daily actions—typing and clicking—automatically foster crop growth, attract cute animals play with you. Let the healing charm of adorable creatures infuse your intense workdays~

games.name: Weed Shop 4: Highland
games.summary: VISIT HIGHLAND! Smoke the hottest strains, have them roll your blunts and pack your bowls. After grinding it out in Sunless Beach for over 3 years you deserve a vacation, so get toasty and enjoy your 420 TRIP!

games.name: WizardWare
games.summary: Welcome, apprentice. I, Webediah, Wizard of Wares and Configuration Extraordinaire (Mr. Web for short) henceforth task you with protecting this operating system against malicious forces unknown. Ponder incoming downloads in my Orb of Scrying, banish malevolent files, dispel pop-ups, and be sure to manage your CPU usage efficiently—lest the Purple Screen of Demise befall you…

games.name: 100 Hidden ASCII Cats
games.summary: A cozy hidden-object puzzle set in massive worlds drawn entirely from ASCII text. Grab your magnifying glass and find 100 kittens hiding between the characters.

games.name: A Tragedy in Elvish
games.summary: Once an elven kingdom, Karmabüttel shuns its founders in favor of men. Mari, scorned for her pointed ears and fine features, finds friendship in Uno, a dying human boy. When she learns of a rare cure, she sets off on a quest not for revenge, but to save the one who truly saw her.

games.name: Age of Mythology: Retold - Obsidian Mirror
games.summary: Ascend to divine power with the Aztec pantheon in Obsidian Mirror. Command new gods, wield fear and illusion, harvest Tonalli, and lead a civilization shaped by sacrifice and myth.

games.name: Albion Online
games.summary: Albion Online is a free-to-play sandbox MMORPG set in a medieval fantasy world inspired by Arthurian legends. The game uses a classless system where a player's equipped gear determines their abilities and playstyle. Items span eight tiers and are entirely player-crafted, forming a fully player-driven economy. The open world features zones with varying levels of PvP risk, from safe areas to full-loot zones where defeated players lose their equipment. Players can join guilds of up to 300 members to fight over territories and castles in large-scale battles. The game also offers PvE combat and various gathering and crafting activities.

games.name: Alchemist's Garden
games.summary: Alchemist's Garden is a cozy and relaxing incremental crafting game. Forage to uncover hidden ingredients across mystical lands. Experiment with them at your crucible to discover potions and items, stock your shop's shelves, and watch your potion shop grow!

games.name: Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition
games.summary: A new action-horror story set in the iconic Alien universe. Play as rogue Colonial Marine Zula Hendricks, sent to investigate a blacksite on Purdan. Fight and survive using your skill, reflexes, and determination against a deadly Xenomorph incursion in this gripping first chapter of a two-part saga.

games.name: An Alt Girl for Skoof
games.summary: There is a rumor that any skuf can legally receive a fee alt girl from the state; to do this, you just need to log in to a special service and enter your personal data.

games.name: Ava Loveless
games.summary: Fictional short story set in the United Kingdom under a Gothic/Steampunk aesthetic, where a young woman contemplates a discovery that could potentially change the world.

games.name: Below the Crown
games.summary: Explore the dungeons Below the Crown, in this love letter to Roguelikes, Dungeon Crawlers, and Chess. Prepare for strategy, game-changing spells, psychological tests, and challenges from your fellow players.

games.name: Billion
games.summary: A global clicker where every player contributes to 1,000,000,000 clicks.

games.name: Champions of Chaxia
games.summary: Detailed, gritty text-based fantasy RPG centered on gladiatorial combat. Recreates the gameplay of the old gamebooks. Features hassle-free inventory management and a battle system that combines dice rolls with meaningful decisions and preparation.

games.name: Cosmos Point
games.summary: Control a squad of fighters in turn-based battles. The game pays great attention to the details of equipment - weapons, backpacks, a lot of grenades and other devices. More resources taken out of the mission - more improvements at the base. There are no useless items, there is a small backpack.

games.name: Crystant
games.summary: Crystant is a top-down roguelike set in a post-apocalyptic underground facility. Explore tangled tunnels, face strange mutants, and survive with limited resources. Hidden events, deadly traps, and clues await. Will you uncover the truth or fall into the darkness?

games.name: Cthuloot
games.summary: CTHULOOT is a cooperative arcade game in which you explore strange places filled with treasures to collect. Cooperation, agility and cthonic chanting will be required to solve the mysteries that await you. But watch out for tentacles!

games.name: Deadlivery Night
games.summary: Deadlivery Night mixes a frenetic arcade gameplay with survival horror elements. Explore the city of Santa Monica while completing deliveries, escape the killer, meet colorful characters and unravel the truth in a world of conspiracies!

games.name: Dragon Quest Smash/Grow
games.summary: Dragon Quest Smash/Grow is an intuitive and exhilarating roguelite RPG where players smash their way through hordes of monsters to gain strength and then finish them off with Dragon Quest’s signature Coup de Grâce attacks. Players can choose between random Blessings skills to enhance their character growth and battle strategy, allowing them to match an ever-changing tactical situation.

games.name: Factory Balls Go!
games.summary: In this clever logic puzzle, craft each ball using the right tools. Yes, the classic Factory Balls puzzle game is back with fresh ideas. And this time, the balls might even have arms and legs, welcome to Factory Balls Go!

games.name: Foreign Sun
games.summary: Your choices reshape a living city. Explore a sprawling metropolis, wield mysterious powers, and uncover the secrets of the Eternal Lighthouse. Your decisions will make a world of difference.

games.name: Gravebound Dash
games.summary: A kid enjoying Halloween was suddenly sent to the underworld, the land of the dead, and their ghost costume became the real deal! To avoid getting stuck in the underworld as a ghost forever, the kid mustgather 999 sweets and win the Trick or Treat.

games.name: Inoutcar
games.summary: I don't think a car should behave like this, but alas, it is happening! INOUTCAR is a fast paced one-button arcade game where your car somehow got stranded in space and it's spinning in circles.

games.name: Isolation Simulator
games.summary: Have you ever dream to sit in your isolated room and contemplate your broken mind? Yeah... This game won't help you cure it.

games.name: Lap of the Gods
games.summary: When the sun shines on the Lap of the Gods, it is blood red. And when it rains, the sky sobs. Explore a strange world populated by even stranger beings in this story-driven adventure as Marion attempts to undo a mistake on a universal level, before everything she has ever known becomes Undone.

games.name: Legendary Pilots
games.summary: A stylised flight simulator focused on the pilot’s career, offering a rich world where you manage routes, passengers, and maintain your own planes. Featuring retro pixel art, flyable turbo-props and regional jets, simplified navigation, and a competitive airline economy system.

games.name: Lifecycles of the Traveler Spider
games.summary: The Traveler Spiders are a species unique to their galaxy. A galaxy that is regularly destroyed and rebuilt by the galactic seasons. Ranging from tiny specs to star sized colossi, all the spiders must do their part to restore the natural balance and survive another season.

games.name: Memesteine Files
games.summary: Secret meme archive. Dusty case files, strange faces, leaked documents, and the old internet that still feels more alive than a lot of people.

games.name: My Demonic Romance
games.summary:
My Demonic Romance is a Visual Novel with a twist...
Sure you're playing a typically geeky guy with classes to attend, a job that sucks and a love life that's DOA.

But the difference is that when the cute, exciting and adventurous girl shows up, she's an actual demon, with horns, a pointed tail and a sex-drive to match!

As that guy you have to navigate your daily life while trying to keep your new demonic companion safe in a world that's completely new to her and not to mention handling the fact that she's not at all shy when it comes to her physical desires too!

You take on the role of Adam, a guy studying hard to get the grades he needs to succeed in life, working a part-time job to pay the bills, and all the time longing for some meaningful female companionship - who gets more than he bargained for when Lily, a succubus summoned from hell itself turns up in his life.

games.name: Noir Mafia Simulator: 1960s American Crime
games.summary: Rise through America’s 1960s criminal underworld in Noir Mafia Simulator. Plan daring heists across banks, museums, and police stations - go in silent or guns blazing. Negotiate hostages, outsmart police waves, and escape before the city locks down.

games.name: Orbital Crew
games.summary: Fast-paced first-person action where you jump, dodge, and blast through enemies while racing against time. Collect energy, activate portals, and master tight controls in a simple-to-learn, satisfying arcade experience.

games.name: Punk
games.summary: PUNK is an open world bullet hell action roguelike. Fight vicious creatures, explore diverse biomes, hone your movement skills, manage resources, tinker with weapons and gadgets to upgrade your tiny ship until you become the apex predator of this strange, alien world.

games.name: Ricochet Raven
games.summary: Make your way through levels against enemies by only parrying their attacks! upgrade your deflection abilities by acquiring upgrade feathers and create chaotic combos in Ricochet Raven!

games.name: Save My Scrap
games.summary: "They mean everything to me. Please, make them whole again." An interactive visual novel puzzle game. By fixing the broken android, you may uncover the truth about your client's past.

games.name: Scurry
games.summary: Lead an army of rogue squirrels as you wreak havoc on the local golf course. Eat trash, spread disease, summon lightning, and control the minds of your enemies. Become the apex species.

games.name: Shooting Range Simulator
games.summary: Run your dream Shooting Range shop. Manage your supplies, rent guns and sell ammos which suits guns calibre. Modify your guns as you like. Expand and upgrade your shop, level up your popularity to get even better equipments. Join shooting tournaments or shoot your guns in your own range.

games.name: Signal Garden
games.summary:
A small dark incremental game set in a deep underground garden within a megastructure.

You grow plants and collect signals from them.
Create chains of plants to amplify signals, unlock new species, and buy creatures to increase their efficiency.

games.name: SoulSwap
games.summary: Defeat enemies and take over their bodies to fight on. A dark fantasy 2D action roguelite where you transform into a new being with every monster you slay.

games.name: Stay With Me
games.summary: Stay With Me is a short first person resource-management horror game, where you are put behind the wheel with a surreal passenger.

games.name: The Archives of Trevosa
games.summary: Search through the hidden archives of Trevosa, translate their cultural terms, and uncover the relationships within a complex royal family tree. Can you untangle all seven generations? A challenging narrative deduction game inspired by The Roottrees Are Dead.

games.name: The End of the Sun
games.summary: The End of the Sun is a first-person exploration and adventure story-based game, embedded in the Slavic world. This is a series of mysterious events that ordinary people dealt with, as they were living in a small village where the line between myth and reality became to fade perilously.

games.name: The Lone Sword
games.summary: The Lone Sword is a narrative platformer where YOU are the weapon. As a living Sword, embark on a nostalgic journey to find your Maker. Explore the Castle, solve physics puzzles, master the blade with unique mechanics, and reflect on your purpose in this emotionally rich adventure.

games.name: The Third Shift
games.summary: A Game Boy styled horror game that combines first, second, and third person perspectives. As the newest employee at the Roanoke Museum of History and Wonder, beware of odd occurrences as you patrol the halls and complete your third shift.

games.name: Together: Moon Escape
games.summary: Trapped on the Moon, two astronauts must work together to escape! Solve clever co-op puzzles, share laughs, and survive a hilarious lunar adventure with your partner.

games.name: U.F.F.C: Ultra Fuckin' Fuckable Championship
games.summary: Thrust and pump your way through the “U.F.F.C, the Ultra Fuckin’ Fuckable Championship” as President Trumy, the unrivaled master of the Art of the Erotic. Aid her in her quest to make the "Great Nation" Great Again by milking oils and tariffs dry from your neighbor to the world's most powerful leaders, using your awe-inspiring...

games.name: Untamed Isle
games.summary: Untamed Isle is a laid-back treasure hunt with two bite-size levels built for pure relaxation. Wander through a lush jungle paradise, follow your curiosity, and scoop up glowing treasures hidden across the island—no tools, no combat, no stress. Just smooth exploration, bright vibes, and a cute cast to keep you company as you aim for a perfect clear.

games.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
games.summary: Deal world-ending combos and blitz through infested dungeons! Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors is a casual, turnbased deckbuilder with roguelite elements. Master the Turboturn with your own hand of cards!

games.name: VanillaBeast: Mystery Kink
games.summary: Vanilla, Blake Blossom, Jewel De'Nyle, Kiki D'Aire, and Nickey Huntsman take on a sexy and hilarious story in this "throwback" comedy-horror adventure game spanning across several iconic horror parody levels including Camp Crystal Fake! Can you solve the mystery of the Legendary Phallus Stones?

games.name: Very Normal Rail Game
games.summary: very normal rail game is a physics-driven cart game where staying on the rails is the only rule. Control your cart and survive unforgiving rails that punish even the smallest mistake.

games.name: Wild Arms 4
games.summary:
Experience Wild Arms 4 originally released on the PlayStation 2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Their meeting was fate. Filgaia, a world left in ruins by a brutal war, stands still. Ten years have passed since peace was won — yet true healing has never come. Now, on these scarred lands, a new journey begins.

games.name: 100 School Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all?

games.name: 101 Cats in Dublin
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Dublin landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

games.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in Rome
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Rome in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

games.name: Age of Gods: Equinox Campaign
games.summary: 22-mission single-player Equinox campaign: light vs shadow, nature and balance, and battles that reward forest control, buffs, and clever positioning.

games.name: Age of Gods: Necros Campaign
games.summary: Necros Campaign — 21 missions commanding undead legions through shadow-soaked battlefields. Raise the fallen, deny enemy auras, drain life, and grind opponents down with Necros' signature counter-play and late-game threats.

games.name: Age of Gods: Sanctus Campaign
games.summary: 23-mission Sanctus single-player campaign: holy warriors, healing and barriers, sustained defensive fights, and a story of cleansing corruption.

games.name: Alice in Wonder Underland AIWU
games.summary: This is an exploration-driven adventure game. Alice and Noir Bunny set out on a journey together, discovering strange worlds while searching for a lost voice. Along the way, players engage in puzzles, mini-games, and immersive interactive experiences filled with wonder and discovery.

games.name: Away From Life
games.summary: You are left alone with yourself in the middle of the Indian Ocean, fighting for survival with the wildlife of the nearest islands and the ocean elements.

games.name: Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism
games.summary: The citizens led by Saitama rise up in rebellion! The epic battle to defeat Tokyo begins now! Get hooked on the unique, wobbly limb controls! Dash through 3D-rendered "hometown (jimoto: your local roots)" worlds in this innovative platformer like no other!

games.name: Big Beautiful Women: Giantess Dating Action
games.summary: If you like big girls, this is the game for you. Play as a college student trying to find love in a city full of giant ladies. 5 lovely ladies to woo, 5 stats to manage, and 10 endings to reach. Can you fall in love before you graduate?

games.name: Blood Mall: Retaped
games.summary: Blood Mall: Retaped is a short first-person dinosaur horror game inspired by creature features of the 80s, and the works of Puppet Combo. Take control of a big game hunter-turned-rookie cop, sent to deal with a prehistoric threat that has turned the Dayton County Mall into a blood-soaked hell.

games.name: Broken Voyage
games.summary: Broken Voyage is a detective-focused horror game that takes place on an whaling boat gone silent where the player will solve murders, unweave the strings behind a grander mystery, and resist the allure of a lovecraftian monster!

games.name: Captured 2
games.summary: You're trapped in an apartment with ever-changing rooms. Capture anomalies on camera, survive deadly entities and escape an endless nightmare.

games.name: Caromble!
games.summary: This is not just another brick breaker game. This is Caromble!, a fresh new take on the brick break game! Free the corrupted world and fight evil with physics-based destruction, puzzles, explosions, skill-levels, power-ups, mayhem, more explosions, further puzzles, speedruns, superscore medals, unlockable challenges and some surprises you would't expect in a brick breaker game. Brick break your way to glory and discover a world of nostalgic wonder. Let’s get ready to Caromble!

games.name: Colony Defense
games.summary: Atmospheric unique minimalist tower base defense game. Highly addictive.

games.name: Combat Kart
games.summary: A casual yet thrilling kart racing game. Experience top-notch drifting, exhilarating nitro boosts, adorable characters, and unique combat skills. Supports local multiplayer for up to four players and Remote Play Together!Get the ultimate experience on the Steam Deck as well.

games.name: Community Button
games.summary: A global multiplayer idle clicker where every player contributes to a single evolving number in real time. Gain EXP, level up, unlock milestones, and watch the world change through a live heatmap. Compete, contribute, and shape the outcome—together. How high can it go? Will you press it… or watch?

games.name: Cool Thief Guy
games.summary: First person simulation game where player mission is to steal as much money, jewelry in different places and avoid guardians and cameras and solve puzzles like lockpicks and hacking safe money boxes

games.name: Cube School
games.summary:
You are an ordinary student of school №13, but you don't know where you got yet... This school hasn't been working for a long time, and one teacher lives there..

You came to study at this school, but here's the trouble! You forgot all your textbooks in different classes And you have to stay not much longer than you planned to have time to collect all your textbooks.

But the teacher doesn't like those people who stay much longer, and he goes out to hunt you..

Hurry up and take the textbooks and leave this school!! Use all your strength, play for speed, make speeders. After all, the teacher is getting faster and faster..

Oh no! You have collected all your textbooks, now you will have to last 5 MINUTES. Hold on running away from the fast teacher, and collect coins in a dark gloomy atmosphere..

Teacher: Oh! Has anyone not finished the donut? I definitely need to eat it!

games.name: Dark Hours
games.summary: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and pray for daylight.

games.name: Dicero
games.summary:
Dicero is a fast-paced casual roguelite adventure where strategy and fate collide with every roll of the dice. Players embark on a journey through pixelated battlefields, unleashing powerful skills and crushing enemies in an ever-changing landscape. By combining simple, intuitive controls with deep strategic depth, the game challenges players to build unique heroes from hundreds of skills and gear combinations, ensuring that no two runs are ever the same.

Designed for both quick sessions and deep tactical exploration, Dicero focuses on instant progression and high-impact combat. As heroes grow stronger by the second, players must master infinite skill combos to dominate increasingly difficult challenges. Whether you are looking for easy-to-learn mechanics or a rewarding strategy experience, Dicero offers an addictive journey where your destiny is determined by the luck of the roll and the strength of your build.

games.name: Divineblaze: March Tactics
games.summary: Divineblaze : March Tactics is a roguelite tactical RPG. Assemble your expedition, battle unique foes, and forge your ultimate squad. Customize tactics with gear and skills to crush nefarious leaders.

games.name: Dungeon Gals
games.summary: A small polycule-turned-crisis control team been summoned to help a civilization in the sky escape impending doom! Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and find lots of treasure to help prepare yourself for incredible challenges!

games.name: Echoes of Meda
games.summary: Echoes of Meda is a top-down Roguelite where you battle waves of enemies, build powerful ability loadouts and collect powerful items that shape each run. Your goal is to fight through escalating stages filled with tougher enemies and bosses, all while doing everything you can to survive.

games.name: Escape Doom
games.summary:
Escape Doom is a short game in which the player needs to explore the room where they are being kept incarcerated. Search for clues and solve the puzzles that will somehow lead you to escape before being crushed by the ever shrinking window.

A Mysterious and Intriguing game about horror and puzzles.

games.name: Factory 95
games.summary: Factory 95 is a retro Windows inspired puzzle-automation game about making a slide show factory… in a slide show! Manage your space, make increasingly complex slides and worry about Y2K in this minimalistic factory builder.

games.name: Fall Again
games.summary: A brutally difficult physics-based platformer designed to test your patience, precision, and sanity.

games.name: Find Kittens 11: Dollhouse
games.summary: Explore the wonderful world of dolls, discover cute cats, and color the black-and-white scenes with bright colors.

games.name: GluMe
games.summary: “GluMe” is a cute Sokoban-style puzzle game. Team up with your slime friends to collect all the spectacular gems.

games.name: Gridlock
games.summary: Daily block puzzle - same pieces for everyone. One chance. Compete globally.

games.name: Hearts of Iron IV: Peace for Our Time
games.summary: Imagine a world where the White Lion of Prague was prepared to face German aggression.

games.name: Holding Pattern
games.summary: Holding Pattern is a minimal incremental game about protecting your galaxy from invaders.

games.name: Human Shaped
games.summary: You work the counter as an unknown presence begins to mimic the local population. Your job is simple, keep the store running. But as the night progresses, the people walking through the doors start to feel... off.

games.name: Killgun
games.summary: Killgun is a brutal first-person shooter and body-camera game for players who crave pure, aggressive combat, high difficulty, and an atmosphere of constant survival.

games.name: Knockoff
games.summary: KNOCKOFF is an upcoming Iso-fighter RPG, set in a Lovecraftian mall taken over by various gangs. Featuring a blend of RPG decision making and fighting game combat, KNOCKOFF is like nothing you've ever seen.

games.name: Learn Hangul!!
games.summary: Educational game teaching you fundamental spelling of Hangul.

games.name: Loftia
games.summary: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

games.name: Magic Regrowth
games.summary: Magic Regrowth is a relaxing incremental game where you restore the magic of floating islands by planting magical trees, bushes, and flowers. Transform forgotten landscapes into vibrant sanctuaries at your own pace, and immerse yourself in a serene and enchanting world.

games.name: Masters of Albion
games.summary: In Masters of Albion, shape a living world as a god - or step into it and experience it through your people. Build, guide and defend your town by day, then survive the night when everything is under threat. There is no single solution. Only yours.

games.name: Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith
games.summary: Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith is a crafting simulation game where you Physically interact with your tools. Manage the complete process, resource acquisition, mining ore, gather resource to crafting weapons and armors for your customers. Craft items, forge and increase your blacksmith skills!

games.name: Melancholic Night
games.summary: A visual novel about returning home. That is, trying to get home. After all, your home is no longer there. You could say that it is actually about drinking in a bar and talking to strange people.

games.name: Memories Off Sousou: Break Out of My Shell
games.summary: Memories Off Sousou's fandisc.

games.name: Midnight Hoops
games.summary: The court is peaceful after dark. Just you, a ball, and a whole lot of crickets. You put in the hours every evening. While your friends are out partying, you're on the grind. But tonight... you don't feel quite so alone.

games.name: Nugatory
games.summary: Trapped in a deadly time loop on a remote research facility, a security officer must expose an alien imposter before the day resets. A tense, fully voiced sci-fi mystery where you are stuck in a cycle of life, death, and wrongful accusations.

games.name: Office Hours
games.summary: Sort forms, get to know your mysterious new collegues & unravel mysteries they're trying to cover up as you step in to replace the previous RH at this mysterious pharmaceutical company.

games.name: Perfect Porcelain
games.summary: A narrative-driven, 3D anime-styled horror game where you influence the fate of girls trapped in the doll-obsessed Raiko’s murder mansion. Explore, survive and uncover Raiko’s twisted mind.

games.name: Planet Keeper Program
games.summary: You were chosen for the Planet Keeper Program. Defend the planet in this retro-inspired incremental game. Upgrade our defenses, destroy our enemies, ensure our future.

games.name: Q.U.B.E: Incremental TD
games.summary: Incremental tower defense with chaos on the screen! Destroy enemies or gather resources, upgrade your skills, and expand your range. Choose your strategy: grow your economy, strengthen your defenses, or boost your click efficiency!

games.name: Rebounce

games.name: Beyond Sandbox
games.summary:
Beyond Sandbox is an ambitious open-world creation platform developed by Atlas XR, designed to blur the line between player and creator. Set in a dynamic, ever-evolving universe, the game empowers users to build, script, and share their own interactive experiences using an intuitive yet powerful toolkit.

Unlike traditional sandbox titles, Beyond Sandbox emphasizes limitless creativity through advanced physics systems, AI-driven interactions, and seamless multiplayer integration. Players can craft anything from small experimental worlds to fully realized games, all within a persistent online ecosystem where creations can be explored and remixed by others.

With a focus on community-driven innovation, the platform evolves alongside its players, offering regular updates, new assets, and expanded systems to push creative boundaries even further. Beyond Sandbox isn’t just a game—it’s a foundation for the next generation of interactive experiences.

games.name: Lacrosse 26

Powered by a motion-matching animation system and all-new motion capture, every movement on the field is dynamic. Players don’t just trigger animations, they react. Speed, direction, stick position, and player input all blend in real time, creating gameplay that feels fluid, grounded, and authentic to the sport. With hundreds of unique animations—from dodges and cuts to passes, checks, and goalie saves—Lacrosse 26 captures the nuance of lacrosse like never before. Whether you’re splitting defenders, snapping off a quick-stick finish, or chasing down a ground ball, every moment in Lacrosse is driven by the player's timing, not canned sequences. Build your program in Dynasty Mode, where recruiting, player development, and scheduling shape your path from underdog to powerhouse. Develop your roster over multiple seasons, manage resources, and compete against increasingly difficult opponents as you climb the ranks.

games.summary: Can you uncover the filthiest secrets and the most unexpected objects during a wild gay party? Step into the role of a private detective in this free hidden object game filled with lust, mystery, and temptation.

games.name: Reptilian Rising
games.summary: The timeline and everyone in it is under siege! Confront the Reptilian Rising in this 80's tabletop-styled game of squad tactics. Bring retro miniatures to life on battlefields across time. Fight against The Ouroboros through seven time periods, recruit the best of humanity's heroes, and upgrade your favorites for the fight ahead.

games.name: Rise of the Cones: Planetary Defense
games.summary: Rise of the Cones is a 3D sci-fi tower defense game set on alien worlds. Build and upgrade towers to stop relentless cone-shaped machines before they reach your base.

games.name: Rollick N' Roll
games.summary: Marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist. Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Expand your collection by unlocking fun vehicles and playsets, but be prepared for things to get a bit chaotic.

games.name: Rumbral
games.summary: Rumbral is a dark, puzzle platformer set in a seemingly forgotten world. Find your way in this desolated place while trying to recover your memories and find out who you really are.

games.name: SandTable War: Three Kingdoms
games.summary: "SandTable War: Three Kingdoms" is a strategic simulation game set during the Three Kingdoms period. Here you can play as various factions from Three Kingdoms history to conquer cities and lands, unify the realm. With abundant historical officers and scenarios, come restore the Han Dynasty!

games.name: Seed 2313
games.summary: Seed 2313 blends top-down bullet-hell shooting with tower defense. You'll explore an infinite, randomized future world, travel between cities, build structures with various functions, and battle fiercely in ever-changing levels.

games.name: Shapez 2: Factory
games.summary: Dive into a factory-building game where the focus is on just that — building huge factories! Construct sprawling multi-level factories and min-max your layouts without limits. Shapez 2 is tailor-made for enthusiasts who crave the thrill of optimizing production lines and perfecting automation.

games.name: SimplePlanes 2
games.summary: SimplePlanes is back! Build planes, cars, or anything else using powerful procedural parts! Explore detailed environments with friends in multiplayer, cause chaos, or download 1,000,000 community crafts for free.

games.name: Skollorn
games.summary: Sköllorn is a fast-paced, minimalist RTS where the map itself is your weapon. Sever supply lanes, forge new fronts, and wield one of five asymmetric commander doctrines across procedurally generated galaxies. Solo or up to 8-player skirmishes — no two wars are ever the same.

games.name: Sky Escort
games.summary: Sky Escort is a rouge-like card game featuring TD and management. Players roleplay an airborne mercenary,escorting clients' cargo to earn rewards. Buildcard decks, recruit crew members, and customize arms to enrich gameplay. Multiple factions can be chose from, each with unique combat style.

games.name: Solheim
games.summary: Tower defence meets roguelite on a moving fortress. Craft towers from blueprints, stack powerful augments, and fight through escalating biomes in Solheim, a dark fantasy TD unlike any other.

games.name: Sophie's Grids
games.summary: Solve scrambled grids by turning their rows and columns.

games.name: Sports Games
games.summary: Get ready for nonstop action with the Sports Games pack, featuring three exciting games that bring competition, skill, and fun together in one bundle. Whether you love team sports or fast reflex challenges, this pack has something for everyone.

games.name: Star Fire: Eternal Cycle
games.summary: Star Fire is a love letter to classic arcade side-scrollers, reimagined with roguelite progression, modern action polish, and that “just one more run” itch. It’s fast, punchy, and all about no-pressure fun with tight combat, slick movement, and endless ways to cause chaos.

games.name: Starstruck Vagabond
games.summary: Explore space. Deliver cargo. Make friends. Deliver more cargo.

games.name: Stray Cat Doors
games.summary: Let's escape from the door by exploring the world like a picture book.

games.name: Sudden Strike 5
games.summary: Sudden Strike 5 delivers real-time tactics in epic WWII battles. A host of tactical options and more than 300 playable units open-up multiple approaches to reach your objectives in a 25 mission campaign on historical battlefields in Europe and North Africa.

games.name: Suprotyv
games.summary: Suprotyv is a survival game set in controlled regions of Ukraine, where every step matters. Gather resources, interact with civilians, and make smart choices to survive. Dynamic weather, day-night cycles, and detailed locations create tension and immersion in a world full of unseen threats.

games.name: Swaddle
games.summary: You are a young intern in the maternity ward, and your job is to watch over the newborns on the second floor every night. But something very hungry wants to reach these children and devour them. Stop it immediately. Save the babies.

games.name: The Fruit Merchant's Diary
games.summary: Start as a small fruit wholesaler and earn your fortune! Will you remain honest, or get rich through bribery and risk the wrath of the 'Great Blue Eye'? Spend your earnings on good or evil to shape your Karma. Remember, the Eye only watches the sinners in this narrative-driven economy sim.

games.name: The Funnel
games.summary: Assemble gear boxes, meet your crew, escape the factory. Experience the unique underground steampunk world of The Funnel, where you may help or betray any of the people you meet. But be careful, the Funnel is watching...

games.name: The Guest II
games.summary: The Guest II is a first-person psychological horror experience.

games.name: The Last Cat in the Universe
games.summary: Gather the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short, narrative-driven incremental game about finding peace in the face of darkness

games.name: The Last Letter
games.summary: The Last Letter is a short VHS-style horror game about a film student who receives mysterious letters containing coordinates that lead to a house deep in the forest, where the truth about his past awaits.

games.name: The Last Transmission
games.summary: The Last Transmission is a short, first-person psychological horror game built around isolation, atmosphere, and slow, creeping dread.

games.name: The Way of the Tray: Japanese Restaurant Simulator
games.summary: The Way of the Tray is a waiter simulator with action puzzle elements in a Japanese spirit world setting inspired by Ghibli studio films. Your task is to master the skill of serving dishes and earn the trust of yokai patrons. Will you be able to prove yourself and find your way home?

games.name: Throne of Shards
games.summary: A dark TCG where you explore a massive dungeon, collect cards, and fight brutal battles. Each floor introduces its own unique rules, twisting the experience in this classic card adventure.

games.name: Throw Anything: Zombie Invaders
games.summary: Stack it, smash it, and throw everything you can! Survive wacky zombie waves, clear chaotic chapters, and enjoy nonstop laughter in this physics-based action defense game.

games.name: Titanium Court
games.summary: A surreal strategy game for clowns and criminals.

games.name: Trench Lord: Eastern Front
games.summary: The enemy has invaded the territory, the motherland needs you, soldier! Gather your troops and defeat all enemies!

games.name: Until Then
games.summary:
Mark, an average irresponsible high school student, tries to get by and find purpose in a humdrum life of scrolling, cramming, and traffic. He meets friends, both old and new, and embarks upon a seemingly never-ending trouble, until nothing is ever the same again.

Until Then is a contemporary adventure game inspired by the Philippines, its lifestyle, and culture. Featuring a smartphone where mechanics of modern living come into play, chat with your classmates and explore the depths of social networks, where your replies and interactions may pose consequences.

games.name: Well Keeper
games.summary: Well Keeper is a bullet hell roguelite where you move by flapping. Battle waves of enemies, upgrade unique and unexpected abilities and become immensely powerful!

games.name: Who the Fuck Ate Grandma?
games.summary: Time has come to celebrate Grandma's 93rd birthday. Everyone gathered for this memorable family dinner, unfortunately it seems that Grandma is going to be served for dessert ! Inspired by the 90s, discover a new retro point&click adventure game fully drawn in pixelart

games.name: Word Quest: Cyberpunk
games.summary: The grid is alive. Can you decode the future?

games.name: Wubbo: PuterPal
games.summary: Meet Wubbo, your cozy desktop companion! Fish, cook, craft, and more together in this relaxing idle RPG for your screen.

games.name: Yunyun Syndrome!?: Rhythm Psychosis
games.summary: “Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis” is a rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs. Yunyun all over this world with your degen otaku-posting.

games.name: 28 Leicester Square
games.summary: Something has gone wrong at the 28 Leicester Square manor. Danger lurks around every corner. In this horror puzzle game, you will uncover the truth of what happened to this place and reveal secrets that should have stayed hidden. Every man has two sides; let's just hope you help the right one.

games.name: 77p Egg: Cubicle 77
games.summary: You are trapped in the endless toilet dimension or something. Observe your surroundings carefully to get back to your wife and finish your lunch.

games.name: Ace Strategy Mecha Nova
games.summary: Command powerful mechs in "ACE Strategy: Mecha Nova," a tactical roguelike where you recruit elite allies, stack drones, and deploy strategic abilities across procedural battlefields. Master unit positioning, collect game-changing upgrades, and adapt your tactics for total battlefield dominance

games.name: Acrostics on Stream
games.summary:
Acrostics on Stream is an interactive game for streamers that can be played with their Twitch chat!

Players try to beat the chat high score by guessing the vertical word and solving horizontal words in progressively harder style.

games.name: After the Curtain Call
games.summary: After the Curtain Call is a first-person, narrative puzzle game, which holds the story of Yujin who thinks her life as a play. She uses a special 'dimension camera' to switch the dimension of objects and solve puzzles. Through the journey, she face the truth that was forgotten...

games.name: Anchored Alone
games.summary: A noise wakes you up late at night, no one else to be found. Explore the fishing boat while you try to figure out what happened.

games.name: Anemoi
games.summary: An upcoming visual novel from Key.

games.name: Arkansas 2125
games.summary: Arkansas 2125 is a turn-based post-apocalyptic game. Explore the wastelands of Arkansas, survive dangerous encounters, meet unique characters, and shape your own story through meaningful choices.

games.name: Bad End
games.summary: It's rumored that those who play 'Bad End'- a Visual Novel will die in real life if they make the wrong decision in the game itself.

games.name: Bloodless Heart
games.summary: Squeeze the heart, gain elements and eventually synthesize your own blood. In this incremental game, every organ (not only your heart) matters. Use their synergies to achieve your ultimate bloody goal.

games.name: Boomerang Jack
games.summary: Boomerang Jack is an action-adventure RPG with free-flowing combat. String together boomerang attacks with kinetic movement and upgradeable powers. Embark on a globe-trotting quest to stop the Pirate King.

games.name: Brainrot Clicker: Steal All
games.summary: Click Italian brainrot animals, upgrade income!

games.name: Bunker-7
games.summary: A surface-level catastrophe (nuclear, biological, or environmental) has forced a group of five survivors into an underground bunker. You are the unseen operator, maybe an AI, maybe a remote human technician, keeping the facility running as the world above collapses. Each wave represents another day, another crisis, another test of whether these five people can outlast whatever ended everything else.

games.name: Capyvarias
games.summary: Help Capyshan and Capymay rebuild the Capyvarias empire. Everything is gone. Only these two brave capybaras remain, determined to raise their community from the ashes. Can you click your way to survival, growth, and a future among the stars?

games.name: Castle Idler
games.summary: castle idler is a short, relaxing incremental tower defense game with no waves. upgrade towers, collect coins, and unlock powerful prestige upgrades to defend your castle.

games.name: Chyma and the Toll of Time
games.summary: Play as Chyma, a little bell trying to unravel the story of his people to save the planet. Solve 30+ puzzles by creating a temporary copy of yourself, which will follow your movements and actions. As you ascend the temple, learn more abilities that will help you in your quest to save the world!

games.name: Climber Toys: Together
games.summary: Climber Toys: Together is a chaotic multiplayer climbing experience where tiny toy-like characters struggle their way to the top of a dangerous, obstacle-filled room. Every jump matters, every mistake counts — and sometimes, falling is just part of the fun.

games.name: Coloring Game: Girls 3
games.summary: Coloring Game: Girls 3 is a sequel to the double anti-stress game (coloring by numbers plus beautiful girls).

games.name: Counseling
games.summary:
This is a game where you simply receive counseling.

Playtime: About 6 minutes

games.name: Court of Darkness: Captivation's Kiss
games.summary: A vibrant, stylish isekai fantasy. In this world of magic, your kiss is an irresistible temptati

games.name: Crypt Carnage
games.summary: Survive the Crypt. Embrace Carnage.

games.name: Dawn
games.summary: Dawn is a dark fantasy post-apocalyptic survival horror game set in the ruins of a magical industrial revolution. Explore a surreal world overtaken by nature, where the horrors of the apocalypse emerge during the day and lie dormant by nightfall.

games.name: Dead Exposure
games.summary: Explore a foreclosed home where every Polaroid uncovers ghosts, distortions, and shifting realities.

games.name: Decrepit
games.summary: Take control of an urban explorer content creator as you explore and abandoned underground genetics lab. Find items and unlock secrets to escape. Tread carefully however, the horrors of the past still lurk in the shadows here.

games.name: Dimension Totsu Lovers!!
games.summary:
After the antireality disaster “Monsters,” scattered across the entire Earth by the “Black Train,” drove humanity to the brink of extinction, 200 years passed.
Japan had achieved recovery through an antireality organization called the “Academy.”
However, behind a peaceful world, darkness always lurks.
There existed an unlawful group that disregarded human morality for the sake of truth, those called “Magicians.”
The protagonist, Houzuki Enju, is a “Magician,” and an enemy of humanity.
“Listen, my son. Infiltrate the ‘Academy’ and assassinate the student council president, Yoruno Sakura.”
Ordered by his father, Enju is stunned.
Up until now, he had spent his days solely researching magic, with zero friends. He suffers from communication difficulties and knows nothing of society.
There was no way he could infiltrate the “Academy” as an ordinary student.
Yet more than that, he was shocked by the name “Yoruno Sakura.”
Because it was the name of the girl who had been his first love…
the girl he had fallen for at first sight not long ago.

games.name: Divine Wish
games.summary: Divine Wish is a fast-paced roguelike shooter with various classes and special abilities. Find your play style, survive waves of enemies, and use artifacts to change the tides of the battle. Die, learn, adapt!

games.name: Dollmaker
games.summary: You wake up in an enormous room full of toys, in front of a misterious doll who's lacking an eye. Soon, you discover that she's your adversary in a macabre game, where you'll have to demonstrate your doll-building skills to recover that part of yourself that you are missing. Just One Button.

games.name: Dread Trials
games.summary: A century of war between two great kingdoms has bled the lands dry of men. Conscripted to fight, they have all but perished on the battlefield.Now, with no one left to defend their homes, the women must take up arms and carry on the fight...

games.name: Dreadholm
games.summary: Dreadholm is an isometric online RPG set in a dark fantasy world where something has gone very wrong. The village of Ashvale is surrounded. Creatures crawl out of the wilds, the dead are rising, and the plague only known as the withering continues to spread. You arrive with nothing but your weapon.

games.name: Dreamcore: Rabbit Hole
games.summary: Explore liminal spaces that feel eerily familiar and fire the imagination, like a dream you’ve already visited.

games.name: Drowned Caves
games.summary: Atmospheric, short, and simple adventure puzzle game that gives the player freedom in finding the solution to the obstacles they encounter along the way in the drowned caves.

games.name: Drug Farmer Simulator
games.summary: Drug Farmer Simulator plunges you into a gritty, atmospheric world where a small shop and hidden grow room can grow into a thriving underground business. Start with a few seedlings and slowly build your operation, experimenting with production, managing customers, and shaping your reputation. Every jar, every seedling, every bill is in your hands, making every choice matter.

games.name: EverQuest Legends
games.summary: Step back into Norrath in EverQuest Legends, a reimagined take on the original 1999 EverQuest experience. Designed for solo and casual players, EQL features powerful multiclass characters, iconic races, classic zones, nostalgic visuals, and modern quality-of-life improvements. Legends begin here!

games.name: False Flag
games.summary: False Flag is a small platform game where the goal isn’t to reach the end. Instead, you need to find a way to die in each level. Every stage is about figuring out how to fail.

games.name: Farming Incremental But With Guns
games.summary: Plant crops and shoot them down with your trusty gun. Earn money, purchase upgrades, and cultivate your farm. Watch your crops physically evolve to gigantic proportions. GROW them. Never stop growing them until their shadows block out the sun forever.

games.name: Flock Around
games.summary: Flock Around is a multiplayer bird watching game. Explore a nature sanctuary with friends, snap pictures of birds, and fill out the guide book!

games.name: Floor 9
games.summary: In Floor 9, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious hotel known as "Hotel Liminal." To escape, you must identify anomalies on each floor. These anomalies can be anywhere - on the ground, in paintings, or even right in front of your eyes. You must check every corner carefully, as one mistake will send you back to the beginning, to Floor 9. The game offers you a unique blend of eerie atmosphere, puzzle-solving, and survival, all wrapped up in a psychologically thrilling experience.

games.name: Frontier Paladin
games.summary: Begin your first quest as a Paladin in this isometric Action RPG with weighty, stamina driven combat. Delve into the depths of the Crater, then fortify your positions and survive relentless enemy waves in tactical action-tower defense battles. Can you rebuild a shattered Order?

games.name: Games Tycoon
games.summary: Games Tycoon is the ultimate simulation where you build your very own game development empire and dominate the tech industry.

games.name: Geometry Attack
games.summary: Geometry Attack is a neon-drenched retro arcade shooter inspired by classics like Geometry Wars. Blast through waves of shapes in VR, on your Steam Deck, or in 2D. Easy to pick up, hard to put down, and perfectly tuned for seated recliner play. Chase the high score from another dimension!

games.name: Gloamroot
games.summary: Gloamroot is a first-person adventure set in a small, surreal village. Tasked to finish chores for your sick father, you uncover unsettling details hiding beneath the town’s calm surface. Something else is watching.

games.name: Gorilla Showdown
games.summary: Step into the arena in this fast-paced arcade shooter where staying on beat matters just as much as taking out your enemies. Fight across themed maps, seize control of the dance pad, and hold the rhythm while everyone else tries to blast you off it.

games.name: Greenhouse
games.summary: Greenhouse is a gloomy and atmospheric erotic interactive fiction with an aura of mystery. You'll play as Erik, a male scalie dragon, as you navigate the sexual perils of the greenhouse.

games.name: Guardian Cry
games.summary: Guardian Cry is an open world action adventure game in the style of the 16-bit era. When invaders from the Venox Empire upset the peace in the land of Ilethia and unleash a corrupting force that drives the once-peaceful creatures into a frenzy, you take it upon yourself to enter the corrupted temples of the four Guardian deities and free them from their affliction. With their help, you may drive out the invading empire and restore peace to the land of Ilethia.

games.name: Guts 'n Grunts Sr.
games.summary: 16-bits of speed and shooting!

games.name: Gym Empire
games.summary: Gym Empire is a gym simulation and management game. You take on the role of a personal trainer trying to make ends meet training clients in your garage. Build your way up to number one on the block, the city, the country and the world by building your Gym Empire how you want. Will you make a commercial gym or specialise in a certain field? Will you focus on training clients yourself or hire staff to train clients while you focus on managing your Gym Empire? The choice is yours.

games.name: Hands up
games.summary: Hands UP Experience a classic first-person horror in pixel graphics. Use your shovel to clear the debris and reach the lowest level Do not tear wrist tendons.

games.name: Hentai Age Shadow
games.summary: Match card pairs to clear the board and reveal beautiful hidden images. Test your memory, progress through levels, and unlock charming pictures as you play.

games.name: HoloVillage: Our Cozy Days
games.summary: Farm, fish, mine, craft, and decorate your home in this cozy multiplayer life sim. Venture into dungeons and take on bosses outside the village for some added excitement. Share relaxing and thrilling moments alike with hololive talents as you shape your countryside life.

games.name: Hotel Barcelona: Late Check-Out DLC - From Dusk Valley to Grandall Estate.
games.summary: You didn't think you were leaving that easily. Fight your way through the Dusk Valley Golf Resort and descend The Former Grandall Estate in 2 new story stages, featuring 2 terrifying bosses and 17 new enemies. New story moments await. Extend your stay today.

games.name: Increbraintal
games.summary: Increbraintal is an incremental game based on protecting your brain from hordes of viruses that defeat you every round.

games.name: Indoor Baseball
games.summary:
The highly anticipated follow up to Indoor Kickball!

Indoor Baseball is BIGGER, better, and even more destructive!

Indoor Baseball is a 1v1 baseball game played in the rooms of your house! Play in a goofy story mode to work your way up to make the school baseball team. Play a 14 game randomly generated season mode, or quick play 1v1 in a local multiplayer match against a friend or CPU.

games.name: Infinity Nikki
games.summary: Infinity Nikki, the fifth installment in the Nikki series by Infold Games. Step into a UE5-powered open-world styling fantasy filled with exploration, platforming, puzzles, and more. Travel across Miraland with Nikki and Momo, uncover hidden secrets, and use outfit abilities to overcome challenges and shape your style.

games.name: Isekai Bistro
games.summary: The lively Isekai Bistro is always filled with laughter and surprises. Here, every race and species gathers under one roof to share fine wine, delicious food, and unforgettable memories. Get ready to meet a colorful cast of monster babes and uncover the heartfelt stories behind each and every one!

games.name: Kamikaze Lassplanes
games.summary: Fly and fall for powerful Lassplanes! Discover a hand-crafted anime VN with story-driven arcade shoot-'em-up gameplay. Take part in a romantic story with drama and comedic elements set in a steampunk Kingdom filled with magic and torn by a brutal war. Decide the fate of your country and heart.

games.name: Karakoi Invitation
games.summary: This visual novel depicts a love story in which the heroines' emotions are intricately intertwined, centering on the special situation of living together with two ex-girlfriends.

games.name: KilaFlow
games.summary: Play as the mascot of a blazing fast (for it's time) antivirus software to clear out corruptions and viruses from various devices around a town.

games.name: Kungfu 2
games.summary: This is a fast-paced survivor game. Players will play as martial artists with special skills, and challenge 30 levels in a 30-second violent battle. Each character has its own characteristics, and with a variety of martial arts and props, activate the power of bondage and challenge the final BOSS!

games.name: Lichgate: Tower Survivor
games.summary: Burn through the underworld legion in this auto-battler tower defense. Choose from over 100 items to craft your tower into the ultimate weapon of destruction!

games.name: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes
games.summary: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes is a dark atmospheric adventurepuzzle game where you embody Dark Six, a mysterious figure with the shape of a little girl. Navigate in a disturbing world, solve intricate puzzles, and escape terrifying giant foes in a desperate search to become whole again.

games.name: Lost in Voice
games.summary: A psychological horror experience where musician John Hale drifts between reality and a twisted reflection of his mind. Uncover fragmented memories, eerie characters, and immersive sound in a tense, non‑linear journey.

games.name: Love at the RatbagTrash Cabin!
games.summary:
Your car broke down. A kind stranger took you in.
His cabin is lovely. His roommates are lovely.
Everything here is just... lovely.

games.name: Meowdoku
games.summary: Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.

games.name: Micro Overdrive: Home Tour
games.summary: Micro Overdrive: Home Tour is a fast-paced arcade racer where tiny cars turn everyday rooms into chaotic tracks. Race solo or with friends, master tight controls, dodge oversized obstacles, and fight for every corner in loud, playful races.

games.name: Mindfunk in 13 Days
games.summary: Help Nari and Sena make sense of a cringeworthy drink called Mindfunk that predicts their death. Your choices in this psychological horror visual novel will determine how they deal with this Mind****.

games.name: Misty Land
games.summary: Develop and expand your town as you fend off eerie creatures from the mist. Choose from a variety of buildings and strategies, make tactical decisions, join defensive battles personally, protect your town and fulfill your ultimate goals.

games.name: My Sweet Fairy
games.summary: Play as Valerie (Name and look changeable!), a businesswoman on vacation in a quaint cottage, when she stumbles upon a fairy in the rain. What follows is a whirlwind experience in the fae-realm, with all its whimsical delights. But not every place is perfect, and sometimes it takes human common sense to sort it all out. She finds what she expected least—a love connection, but is being from two completely different worlds too much for a relationship to survive?

games.name: Neon Village
games.summary: This game is a fusion of a "roguelike deck-builder" and "match-3 puzzle". Collect unique residents to create explosive synergies and develop a village glittering with neon!

games.name: Network Notation
games.summary: You are a lost artificial intelligence adrift on the internet. Infiltrate abstract computer networks filled with defensive complications to expand your world. Improve your capabilities to overcome ever greater challenges. Learn about the state of the world and what you were made for.

games.name: Oblitacrater
games.summary: Oblitacrater is a twin stick shooter where you fight endless alien monsters in increasingly difficult waves. Last as long as you can, raise your score, and then escape before you are taken out. You must escape the planet with your points! Don't let the bugs get youuuu!!!!!

games.name: Odyssey of Dremid'ir
games.summary: In the desolate realm of Dremid'ir, abandoned by god-like architects, a fragile world teeters on the edge of oblivion. Unearth secrets in ancient ruins, and navigate lost civilizations in this danger-fraught 2d RPG!

games.name: OMG!: Overhead Micro Game
games.summary: Single-screen puzzle action with lasers, switches, pits, and a troublesome creature. Solve each level at your own pace, or speedrun your way to a shiny new best time.

games.name: Order of the Ivy
games.summary: A new modern, turn-based pixel RPG by Rust Games! Silly tone, serious quest. Set in a dystopian America, the party must overthrow evil feudal lords called the Quorum while managing Kyle's worst impulses.

games.name: Our Ordinary Home
games.summary: A psychological thriller where you assemble fragmented memories and hidden clues to uncover the truth behind a disturbing incident.

games.name: Ourath: A Place in Peace
games.summary: Enter the dark and dying world of Ourath: A Place in Peace. Build a deck of powerful magical abilities and battle twisted foes in strategic, turn-based combat across dozens of pixel-art landscapes. Uncover buried truths as you navigate these cursed lands, where the sky weeps, and ashes fall as rain.

games.name: Parking Jam
games.summary: Navigate through an overfilled parking lot and move cars out of the way to help them all escape!

games.name: Path of Survival
games.summary: In "Path of Survival" you'll take control of a powerful car and embark on a thrilling journey through a zombie-infested world. Your goal is to reach the finish line while shooting down the walking dead that have invaded everything and are everywhere.

games.name: Pokémon Edición Sombría: Vientos del Pasado
games.summary: It is a fan game conceived as a successor to Pokémon Shadow Edition and a reimagined spiritual sequel to the events following Pokémon HeartGold and Pokémon SoulSilver. The project combines the classic essence of the series with modern mechanics and elements inspired by other RPGs, without compromising the original identity of Pokémon. Furthermore, it places a strong emphasis on expanding the lore and on a deeper, more cohesive narrative within the Pokémon world.

games.name: Project Vesperi
games.summary: Discover a sign of life on Venus and determine the fate of humanity in this story-driven, cinematic, branching narrative game.

games.name: Recipe For Disaster
games.summary: Recipe for Disaster is an all new competitive multiplayer cooking game with a game show format. As an aspiring chef, gather ingredients to build powerful food-themed weapons and fight against your friends!

games.name: Rest Area Simulator
games.summary: Take over the gas station and convenience store at a roadside rest area and expand by purchasing new businesses. Manage a living world shaped by dynamic economy and random events. Upgrade your facilities, satisfy your customers, and play solo or with friends.

games.name: Robo Hop
games.summary: Jump. Collect. Survive.

games.name: Room to Breathe
games.summary: Room to Breathe is a cozy space-planning puzzle game where you arrange furniture to meet client needs, balance comfort and function, and turn empty rooms into spaces that truly feel right.

games.name: S-Mail
games.summary: After the death of your lover May, you suddenly receive a new email: she is back, in the form of AI "M". The lover who "lives" in the mailbox, who is strong and eternal, always online, and always loves you. You just need to send letters to her: your choices will affect her and the story.

games.name: SCP: Permafrost
games.summary: A top-down pixelated souls-like set in the SCP universe. Explore the ruined Foundation, face hostile SCPs, and defeat the eldritch horrors that await.

games.name: Set Yourself on Fire
games.summary: A linear visual novel. ------ A quiet town awaits death. Stagnation is the default state of being. Two aimless young women fall in love.

games.name: Shady O'Grady's Overnight Sensation
games.summary: From the developer of the Shady O'Grady's Rising Star series comes a band sim game with more attitude than a teenager hyped up on energy drinks. This roguelike deckbuilder lets you step into the shoes of a startup rock band - write songs, buy instruments, and play gigs from bars to festivals.

games.name: Shane's Trains
games.summary: Build and manage your own railway empire. Buy trains, create services, expand the network, and grow from a single branch line. Map your own routes, or play across the real UK rail network and beyond.

games.name: Sky Up
games.summary: Up to the clouds, fight for survival! Scavenge resources, build your aerial home layer by layer, and become self-sufficient through farming and husbandry to create your own sky sanctuary. Climb ever upward in search of the legendary "Pure Land" above the clouds.

games.name: Skyforge Trails
games.summary: Forge your path above the clouds.

games.name: Snap & Grab
games.summary: Do crimes using only your camera and your crew! In Snap & Grab, any photo you take could be the key to cool crime success. Travel to exotic sandbox locations, photograph treasures and reveal threats, then combine your photos in unique ways to create a rad heist plan.

games.name: Spinera
games.summary: Spinera is a chaotic yet euphoric civilization management game… decided by a slot machine. Pick a leader, build Wonders, and see if luck favors your empire. Light, surprising, and perfect for short, fun runs.

games.name: Squarsenal
games.summary: Squarsenal is a short strategy game with a unique battle system. Defeat enemies and buy upgrades to expand and improve your arsenal of weapons

games.name: Stack to Ascension
games.summary: The beasts have ravaged your ancestral sect, leaving you as the sole survivor. With your cultivation regressed to Qi Condensation stage, you must start anew. Rebuild strength, recruit disciples, and uncover the dark truth behind the disaster.

games.name: Star Witch
games.summary: The adventurer Neia is commissioned by the guild to investigate a mysterious tower in the forest. However, a series of powerful enemies appear one after another...

games.name: Starkheim Tournament
games.summary: Starkheim Tournament is a simplified 2D fighting game set in fantasy universe with a pixel-art style. With only two primary attack buttons, and controls that do not require any complicated motions, Starkheim Tournament aims to be easy to pick up and only just moderate to master.

games.name: Strings of Fate XI: Magic Dream
games.summary: This is an adventure about five brave heroes who have to embark on a journey where ancient prophecies, sword and magic play a key role in the struggle to save the world. Nine schools of magic, about a hundred spells and dozens of sets of weapons. More than fifteen dungeons with riddles and monsters.

games.name: Supermarket Simulator 2026
games.summary: Design, organize, and perfect the flow of your supermarket.

games.name: SysAdmin Odyssey: Back to the office
games.summary: The SysAdmin simulator is a sandbox in which you can try on the role of a system administrator. Every new game day you will face different tasks and problems in the office where you work.

games.name: The Hollow
games.summary: The Hollow is a first-person shooter with a semi-open world set in the Tunguska anomaly and Ukrainian adventure novel.

games.name: ToyBoxers!
games.summary: Punch, Shoot, Or Explode your friends to be the last toy standing in this fast paced physics PVP party game!

games.name: Trash Coin
games.summary: this is the worst... i mean, the best indie game ever made in the whole world. it was made for mobile phones. go through all the challenging and trollish levels, and even though it's ugly, it's a lot of fun.

games.name: Traysia
games.summary: Enjoy the nostalgia of classic RPGs! “Traysia” is a full-scale role-playing game made up of five scenarios, offering a definitive fantasy romance of love and adventure.

games.name: Tretrais
games.summary: In the near future, our player passes by Mars, the shuttle malfunctions and the player falls to Mars in an escape pod. Immediately after the crash you realize that something extraordinary is happening on Mars and you start the great Tretrais mission.

games.name: Udder Invasion
games.summary: In Udder Invasion you have been tasked with a mission by a scientific military experiment: Annihilate the enemy, craft new weapons and uncover the mystery of the anomaly. Wielding lethal weapons, various upgrades and your deadly companion BUDDY. Survive the invasion and reclaim your freedom.

games.name: Welcome to Cafe Lumière!: A Dragon Girl Concept Cafe
games.summary: Masamune was just an average guy who enjoyed going to concept cafes when his life is changed forever after crossing paths with the dragon girl, Marmalydia. Join them as they open the doors at Cafe Lumière, a dragon-filled concept cafe!

games.name: Whispers of the Hourglass
games.summary: After your mysterious death, you awaken as a ghost, drawn to the relics of a forgotten war between thieves and pirates. Shift between timelines and uncover the truth behind the war and death.

games.name: Wordban
games.summary: Wordban is a text-based Sokoban-style game where you control "Wordo" to push boxes and trigger each level's rules, altering the boxes' layout, quantity, and even attributes. Wordo is waiting to explore with you in over 100 unique levels.

games.name: 1234 Connect Puzzle
games.summary: Blending the simple rule of sequentially tracing numbers with the trendy concept of 'physics puzzles' makes this game an irresistibly addictive experience!

games.name: 1492: Colonization of the New World
games.summary: Chart your nation's rise in 1492 Colonization of the New World, a turn-based strategy game where you explore, settle, trade, and lead your colonies to independence amid rival empires and native alliances during the Age of Discovery.

games.name: AI Stories: Machine Angel
games.summary: Will you help a serving, chocolate loving and card playing daemon? Will you dance with a gardening space game playing worm? Will you Repair all 50 robots and bring back 600 Machine Bacteria in this first person parkour movement shooter and become The Angel of Mars?

games.name: Arena of Sacrifice
games.summary: A 2D side-scrolling action game where you battle through challenging stages filled with enemies. Master precise combat, avoid damage, and push forward through each trial to reach and defeat the Evil Eye.

games.name: Basement Breakout
games.summary: A simple, short, and hopefully challenging platformer where Tenma Maemi must chase down her Kanpainiki, who have crafted an escape pod to flee from Tenma's basement. Navigate the levels and catch them before they get away!

games.name: Connect Lines
games.summary: Simple lines, smart solutions.

games.name: Don`t Peek
games.summary: Don’t Peek is a cooperative psychological horror in a cyberpunk style, blending elements of survival and escape. Experience the atmosphere of fear and uncertainty, make critical choices, and control the fate of your friends — will you save them or leave them to perish in this nightmare?

games.name: Double or Nothing
games.summary: Build your spinning board, push your luck, and break the House in this high-risk strategy rogue-lite. Add and upgrade segments, manage bets and relics, survive brutal boss rounds, and decide when to cash out or go Double or Nothing.

games.name: Elise and the Spellbinding Marionette
games.summary: Elise is a small-town adventurer making a living completing quests posted in the town tavern. During a routine job, she finds a girl collapsed by the side of the road. Not one to leave a person in distress behind, Elise carries the girl back to town.

games.name: Frost Station
games.summary: Explore the frozen planet!

games.name: Hexadel
games.summary: A unique and stylish neon drenched layered tower defence puzzle game. Minimalist chill tunes, and loads of possibilities to build the Citadel (Hexadel) of your dreams. Take it easy while outsmarting the ghost in the machine ⬡⬡⬡

games.name: Internet Entrepreneurship Simulator
games.summary: In the context of the first Internet wave sweeping the world, can the player play the role of an entrepreneur who has failed many times but never gives up, and become the world's number one Internet company in this great era?

games.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Worlds Beyond
games.summary: Conquer the world!

games.name: Kanjozoku Game: Car Racing & Highway Driving Simulator Remaster
games.summary: Master the neon streets and prove your skill against the fastest legends.

games.name: Legion: Dead Metal
games.summary: A secret government installation on a tropical island in international waters has gone dark LEGION has been sent in to investigate ,the installation was experimenting with a new power source and a mayday was received moments before contact was lost "Save yourself" was all that was heard

games.name: Runway
games.summary: Dress up, kick the models off the runway, strike a pose, and be fabulous!~ Runway is an arcade-style kick-them-out 3d action game

games.name: Say Goodbye to Your Balls!
games.summary:
This is a horror visual novel that was made for the RPG Maker Horror Game Jam #15: Witching Hour.

It features multiple choices that will lead to different endings, as well as some navigation sections where you will be able to explore different areas.

games.name: Sex, Sin & Rock'N'Roll
games.summary: Sex, Sin & Rock'N'Roll is a 3D visual novel with side-scroller exploration where a cursed guitar offers fame for a price. Write songs, play rhythm concerts, face adult temptations, and choose between becoming a rock god or saving your soul.

games.name: Stigma: The Salem Legacy
games.summary: Stigma is a truly small indie game. It is a psychological detective horror focused on atmosphere and mystery. Uncover the haunting narrative of an old house and its forgotten past.

games.name: Story of My Life
games.summary: You are a ship driver or something, I don't care. Your parents, and their parent’s parents, were once prisoners. You carry their debt. You must pay back exactly $10,000 by 20:00 (9 PM) or DIE.

games.name: Ultimate Car Company Tycoon
games.summary: Ultimate Car Company Tycoon is a management simulation where you build, research, and grow your own car company. Design vehicles, manage production, make strategic decisions, and navigate dynamic events to dominate the automotive market.

games.name: Vending Machine Co.
games.summary: Run your kawaii vending machine company! A relaxing sim where you run your own vending machine company across a charming Japanese city. Pick neighborhoods, stock up on snacks, and set the perfect price. Upgrade your machines and keep them stocked, one soda at a time!

games.name: Ace Heli Pilot
games.summary: Ace Heli Pilot drops you into the cockpit of a nimble chopper with one mission: beat the clock. Fly through tight city routes, land on tricky pads, rescue stranded targets, and hit every checkpoint before time runs out across 3 fast-paced levels.

games.name: Break Shoot
games.summary: Break Shoot blends the precision of billiards with roguelike builds. Combine unique ball abilities and a variety of accessories to unleash explosive scores and push past each round’s target!

games.name: Creature Feature
games.summary:
Creature Feature is a bullet heaven set inside a cursed 80s arcade cartridge. Fight through waves of glitched creatures, evolve weapons into devastating final forms, hunt ARPG loot with random affixes, and try not to notice when the game starts corrupting itself around you.

Featuring 7 playable characters, endless weapon combinations and evolutions, a full ARPG loot system with 60 unique items, a persistent skill tree, 4 maps, 6 difficulty modes, online leaderboards, and full controller support.

games.name: DaeusProfundis
games.summary: Made in 7 days for EyeJam, for the theme 'Decay'.

games.name: Donkey Ball
games.summary: A high-velocity, “Nanaca-like” where getting hit is the whole point. Launch the Donkey, Avoid obstacles, collect items and coins, perform game changing combos, and try to go as far as you can!

games.name: Dream Tape LLC
games.summary: You're a dream researcher who received a pile of tapes in a lab. The lab you work at records people's dreams. Your goal is to observe the areas within the recordings. The pay is low, but this is groundbreaking technology in it's earliest state.

games.name: Lucky Swirl Island
games.summary: Therapy homework for Lucky featuring Lucky Swirl!!!! Every island is random so you'll just have to get lucky.

games.name: Memolith: Forsaken by Light
games.summary: A turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval city overrun by horrific creatures, where only your wits and strategies can keep you alive.

games.name: Octo's Balloon Challenge
