games.summary: It’s the world’s most adventurous hand! You play as a hand on a gripping handventure, a quest, a calling, through a strange and dangerous world. And in the end figure out why your beloved arm has left you.

games.name: The Hidden Room: Pyramid
games.summary: Continue your adventure in The Hidden Room with The Hidden Room: Pyramid! After what happened in Tom Barkley's house, you think that it's not over yet. That something else might have been hidden. This is your chance to find it out...again

games.name: Top Shot Pool
games.summary: Step up to the table in Top Shot Pool - the ultimate cue-sport experience combining realistic physics with fun, competitive arcade action.

games.name: ¿Me verán?
games.summary: Will They See Me? is a visual novel where you play as a transgender woman who is worried about whether or not she is perceived as a woman. With the help of a magical website, she becomes a ghost and spies into the minds of others to find out what they think of her. There are three endings depending on the interactions she has with other people.

games.name: Above Eden
games.summary:
"As fog obscured the moon, I accepted those words, and she chose levitation."
Above Eden is a short visual novel about a girl.

games.name: Antique Backgammon
games.summary: Classic backgammon, simple and familiar

games.name: Autonomous Warfare Evolution
games.summary: A real-time strategy simulation where you evolve and command swarm-intelligence autonomous weapons using genetic algorithms. Whether you simply watch or deeply intervene in the evolution, both are valid ways to play the game.

games.name: BanHown
games.summary: There was a widespread epidemic crisis, causing utilities and industry to halt, resulting in famine until the city became uninhabited. This forced people to rely on themselves for survival. However there is a family area coming and have decided to return to live in other provinces.

games.name: Barbarous: Survivor's Quest
games.summary: Battle the horde and survive the quest!

games.name: CD-ROM
games.summary: 10 CDs, 10 passwords. Find hidden messages, text, numbers to unlock next CD to continue your steganography puzzle journey.

games.name: Duplicity Loop
games.summary: A dark magical girl VN that takes place in an Alice in Wonderland inspired world.

games.name: Ecchi Crush
games.summary: One hot match leads to another.

games.name: ECH8
games.summary: ECH8 is a single-player narrative puzzle game about uncovering the mystery behind the disappearance of an entire species. Communicate with their past to uncover the truth and decide the future of their species. Will you uncover the truth in time, or are you doomed to make the same mistakes?

games.name: Farm to Table
games.summary: A farming & restaurant management sim with base building elements. Grow in backyard to cook & serve! Discover new recipes by exploring ingredients on the island; gather, fish, raise animals & produce with machines. Manage resources, hire staff & grow your organic business into a 5-star restaurant!

games.name: FNAF All-Stars
games.summary: FNaF All-Stars is a bite-sized Fnaf experience that aims to be on the short-but-sweet side of things, featuring 5 main nights, 5 challenges, a custom night, an endless mode and a few achievements to get!

games.name: Hand-me-downs
games.summary: A roguelike deck builder where you are your own worst enemy. Manage your deck as your opponents use your old hands against you. Use powerful trinkets to take full control of the table.

games.name: Ichika-chan Kanippatsu
games.summary:
A game of strip rock-paper-scissors!
If you win…Ichika will take off one piece of clothing at a time!
If you manage to get her completely naked…You’ll get a reward!

games.name: It's Too Late to Apologize
games.summary: A strange puzzle adventure in ancient ruins, defying worship and casting birthday cakes into the abyss.

games.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Around the World
games.summary: Every puzzle is a new destination!

games.name: No Backup
games.summary: Escape together or die alone. In this intense co-op bodycam horror game, you and your team are hunted by a relentless creature. Communicate, stay quiet, and fight to survive. Every move counts. Every sound could be your last.

games.name: No Backup
games.summary: Escape together - or die alone. In this intense co-op bodycam horror game, you and your team are hunted by a relentless creature. Communicate, stay quiet, and fight to survive. Every move counts. Every sound could be your last.

games.name: Orpheus: Echo of Hades
games.summary: Eurydice died on an ordinary autumn day — in a garden, among flowers, while Orpheus sat beneath an apple tree finishing his melody. Now the greatest musician of his time packs a bag and heads somewhere the living aren't usually allowed to go.

games.name: Periodic Lottery
games.summary: “Periodic Table Lottery” combines lottery-style gameplay with the periodic table. Place bets, earn rewards, complete level objectives, and see how far you can go!

games.name: Pixelarium: Free Lands
games.summary: Pixelarium is an open-world roguelike RPG with deep character building, fluid turn-based combat, rich lore, and ASCII-inspired art. Collect unique items, master powerful spells, and embark on quests as you uncover secrets in the Free Lands.

games.name: Sakura Drift
games.summary: Unleash high-octane chaos in Sakura Drift! Experience a stunning 3D anime open world where racing has no limits. Switch between ultra-fast cars, bikes, and jetskis in high-fidelity environments. Explore, compete, and dominate land and sea in the ultimate next-gen racing adventure.

games.name: Sopwith
games.summary:
Originally created by David L. Clark in 1984, Sopwith became one of the most beloved shareware games of the DOS era. This Unity remake preserves the tight, responsive gameplay of the original while bringing it to modern systems with Steam multiplayer support.

Easy to pick up, tough to master. Can you clear all eight levels?

games.name: SurrounDead Poly Construction
games.summary: SurrounDead Poly Construction is an open-world survival adventure game where players will solve puzzles, collect items, and defeat all enemies to reach the end.

games.name: Ubai Again
games.summary: Return to the world of Ubai. Pick between Ryouko or Aina and follow a major turning point in their lives. Make choices that will drastically shape the outcome of their stories in this exciting visual novel. Live through their experiences as you read through their stories and follow the ladies to the thrilling conclusion.

games.name: WitchGhost
games.summary: A spooky adventure through a weird and wonderful land. Boost your powers and change the world as you help Ezme, the WitchGhost, collect her memories so she can remeber how to go home.

games.name: 100 Marshmallow Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️‍

games.name: Aeschylus: Death
games.summary: Die. Fight your way back to life. Save the world. After his death, Aeschylus unintentionally stumbles into an adventure that leads him on a path back to life. Dodge traps on the path, use the weapons you find to defeat hordes of monsters and fight powerful boss monsters.

games.name: Aquanore
games.summary: A cozy idle aquarium game: collect, breed, and sell fish, shape your tank with decorations, grow your economy, and relax while your fish earn for you.

games.name: Beach Ball Bounce Back
games.summary: BBBB is a challenging physics platformer. If you fall down, just bounce back!

games.name: Bhard
games.summary:
Ward Off Evil Spirits by Wielding Saint Brigid's Cross!

Bounce your crosses off the environment to kill the Evil Puca and Defend Ireland.
Every level has multiple solutions.
Can you beat them all in the least amount of throws?

Made for the Diagra 2026 Ireland Convention

games.name: I Am Dog: Chaos Simulator
games.summary: Play as a dog and experience the adventure in first-person view!

games.name: Joly Blocks Blast
games.summary: Joly Blocks is a modern block game where the familiar classic comes to life thanks to photorealistic graphics, spectacular destruction effects, and deep style customization.

games.name: Landmark Battle
games.summary: Landmark Royale is a two-player real-time arena game built for streamers, where players battle to capture zones and use skills while viewers can send chat commands or donate to spawn monsters, create events, or disrupt actions, turning each match into unpredictable chaos.

games.name: MusicRunner
games.summary: Welcome to MusicRunner, a new type of rhythm and action game!

games.name: Refbals
games.summary: Time to juggle like a real pro! Refbals is a super fast paced, one-button arcade game which will test your juggling skills to the max!

games.name: ShelfLife: Art School Detective
games.summary: ShelfLife: Art School Detective is a Mystery Adventure featuring a cast of loveable weirdos! Befriend and investigate 7 potential suspects. Use psychic powers to astral project into their artwork and learn their secrets. Unmask the mysterious ART KILLER that’s terrorising your campus!

games.name: Sussy Cat
games.summary: Can you find the cold-blooded killers who have infiltrated your adorable feline friends? In this 12-player multiplayer game of betrayal, complete missions as an innocent or sabotage systems as a killer, exploiting the chaos to hunt everyone down. Sharpen your claws and survive!

games.name: The One Behind You
games.summary: A short psychological horror experience about a day in the life of a psychopath

games.name: The Siege of Jeomdo
games.summary: In this narrative-driven RPG, play as Dujom, a retired war veteran compelled to lead Jeomdo Village amidst dire circumstances. Make critical decisions, manage resources, and defend against overwhelming odds.

games.name: 100 Cats Lost in Space Find & Color
games.summary: Explore 10+ space-themed maps and find 1,000+ hidden cats in 100 Cats Lost In Space: Find & Color! Enjoy guided color-by-numbers or free coloring modes. Play solo or local co-op in a relaxing cosmic adventure.

games.name: Asphalt Paver
games.summary: From gravel to smooth rides

games.name: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes
games.summary: In Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, take command of a fleet escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies. Manage crises on board as you prepare for the next encounter with the Cylon Fleet. Times are dire, and hard choices must be made. Your only hope: rejoin the Battlestar Galactica.

games.name: Besmirch
games.summary: The town of Besmirch starves. Stave off the hunger as the latest farmhand in this survival horror farming sim, earning the trust of paranoid townsfolk under the thumb of the corrupt Baron. Tend to both your farm and the town while avoiding unholy terrors that come in the night.

games.name: Blue Steel
games.summary:
Made for the PSX Story Jam 2.

Mecha, Armored Core inspired action game where you fight through the city to protect your new friend's life, and your own.

games.name: Boardwalk Builders
games.summary: Design and expand your boardwalk by building rides, shops, and restaurants to draw in crowds. Manage and combine your attractions to create even grander experiences. Host festivals, attract VIPs and stay ahead of shifting demand influenced by local events and rival businesses.

games.name: Chart Weaver
games.summary: Break the board with powerful synergies, discover game-defining relics and alter your deck in this market-inspired roguelike! Chart Weaver is a mesmerizingly simple but deep score-attack deckbuilder where you create magnificent combos and weave intricate patterns.

games.name: Chill & Reel
games.summary: A cozy idle fishing game where you play as an adorable alligator angler. Designed to run in the corner of your screen, it's the perfect companion for work or study—featuring rich animations that make every moment feel like watching a charming short film.

games.name: Descension
games.summary: Descend into the Alternate Realm to save your lost friend and face The Ultimate Entity. Customize your party, master unique Soul Shards, and grow stronger—physically, mentally, and emotionally—in this stat-driven sandbox RPG.

games.name: Dilemma
games.summary: You don't cure patients; you decide their fate. In this grim medical sim, review records and face impossible bioethical dilemmas. Consult the Medical Bible and choose who gets the bed. Every signature impacts your Ethics, Reputation, and Legal Risk. In a broken system, mercy is a dangerous luxury.

games.name: Don't Panic! It Is Just Turbulence
games.summary: A frantic co-op puzzle game where a Pilot and an Air Traffic Controller must communicate, decrypt, and improvise to save a failing aircraft. Talk fast, solve faster, and try not to crash.

games.name: Dragon Hop
games.summary: Put your jumping skills to the test in this beautiful 3D platformer, playing as a dragon! Explore unique areas to find hidden treasures, collect crystals and trade them for skills to help you on your journey. Can you get to the top?

games.name: Drifting Dots
games.summary: A minimalist physics roguelite where you create a mesmerizing cascade of droplets. Choose from three distinct modes and discover powerful upgrade synergies to master the flow. Calm, complex, and endlessly replayable.

games.name: Echo's Inc
games.summary: You work the late shift at Echo's Inc reviewing bodycam footage of employees that vanished. Tonight it's Melvin's tape. You press play and suddenly you're not watching anymore. You're him. Living his last shift.

games.name: Greenhearth Necromancer
games.summary: Raise a garden — from the dead! Greenhearth Necromancer is a cozy, witchy, semi-idle game about caring for a balcony garden — living and undead plants alike! Grow cute plants, cast spells, and brew potions, enjoying the chill idle gameplay and balcony ambience throughout your day.

games.name: HoloExpo20XX
games.summary: Feel like you're at HOLOLIVE SUPER EXPO! Explore four exhibition halls and move forward by spotting anomalies—turn back if you find something strange, or stay on course if everything looks normal. This game will help you enjoy HOLOLIVE SUPER EXPO even more after you play.

games.name: Kill -9
games.summary: Cyberwarfare-inspired Roguelike Deckbuilder

games.name: Land of Ghosts
games.summary: A literary horror adventure made in RPG Maker MV, where you explore a land of endless rain and continue a lonely journey through fleeting encounters with ghosts. Rain-soaked landscapes and quiet conversations shape a desolate, melancholic road ahead

games.name: Last Draft
games.summary: Finish your final manuscript before sunrise while the horrors of Blackwood Manor awaken around you. Every word brings you closer to the truth—and closer to the entity stalking you. Type to progress, hide to survive, and endure seven nights of psychological terror.

games.name: Meow and the Diamond Jump
games.summary: Meow and the Diamond Jump is a casual platformer featuring 40 levels, progressive difficulty, and infinite lives.

games.name: Nook Fall: West Town
games.summary: A charming yet fantastical town, where vitality and decay constantly collide. We hope that through interactions with characters and objects, and the sensory experience created by visuals and sound, you can connect with the emotions and charm of this little world of West Town.

games.name: Operation Epic Furious: Strait to Hell
games.summary: The Trump Administration knows that the best way to sell combat is by making it a video game, that's why they've been pumping out the sickest Iran war video game hype reels. But why stop at clips when you could go full throttle? Introducing Operation Epic Furious: Strait to Hell, a high-octane, flag-waving, boots-on-the ground simulator where freedom isn't debated, its deployed. No briefings, no hesitation; just pure pixelated patriotism. Strap in and play hard, because this game may never end.

games.name: Outbound
games.summary: Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

games.name: Ping & Pong
games.summary: Ping&Pong is a frantic roguelite bullet hell where you deflect enemy attacks, build powerful card combos, and survive endless chaos.

games.name: Puzzle Park II
games.summary: A new adventure awaits you in a beautiful park filled with puzzles related to finding patterns in the amazing world of the game. Engage your logic and carefully examine your surroundings to find clues to solve the riddles and mysteries of this place.

games.name: Rope Up!
games.summary: Shoot your rope, latch on, swing, and climb higher.

games.name: Schizophrenia
games.summary: SCHIZOPHRENIA. A psychological horror game, which will immerse you in a dark, sad, environment. This bastard is knocking, wake up, and open the door now. First game of TheCourget. Created by TheCourget

games.name: Slot Heroes: Reels of Fate
games.summary: A fantasy RPG where slot reels decide your strategy. With 243 paylines, spin the reels to unleash your heroes’ skills. Trust in luck or control the board — journey with allies and carve out your destiny!

games.name: Spell Alchemist
games.summary: Spell Alchemist is a short incremental resource-gathering and crafting game about digging for resources and processing them into powerful spells. Craft the most powerful healing spell to cure humanity of a mysterious disease.

games.name: Stu the Fisherman
games.summary: Stu the fisherman is a fishing rogue-lite experience like no other. Buy mysterious items from a hooded figure that enhance the value of your haul, help to fix the town and discover the mysteries of the sky fish, the sea fish and the people who just might know it all.

games.name: Super Night Riders S1
games.summary: A full remake of the 2016 retro-inspired checkpoint arcade racer Super Night Riders.

games.name: The Last Question
games.summary:
The Last Question is a psychological interrogation game where every suspect is powered by AI.

Step into the role of a detective and question suspects in your own words. Uncover contradictions, apply pressure, build trust, and piece together evidence as you search for the truth behind each case.

Every suspect has their own personality, secrets, motivations, and breaking point. There are no predefined dialogue trees. Instead, conversations unfold dynamically based on your questioning style, the evidence you've discovered, and the psychological tactics you choose to employ.

Will you gain their confidence? Expose their lies? Or push them far enough to confess?

Featuring dozens of unique criminal cases, progression systems, skills, achievements, and community-created suspects, The Last Question challenges players to think like real investigators and uncover the truth one question at a time. Inspired by detective fiction, interrogation psychology, and modern AI technology.

games.name: The Last Winter Knight
games.summary: Haunt a suit of armour. Explore an abandoned castle. Recover your memories... and bring the ghosts of the past to rest in this melancholy visual novel about love, family and regret.

games.name: Typical NPC
games.summary: Run a grimy fantasy weapon shop while heroes save the world somewhere else. Sell rusty swords, survive arrogant customers, repair the damage, and fight for your retirement before the final battle arrives.

games.name: Umbra Flora
games.summary: In a world where green has vanished, plant, grow, and fuse plants into fearsome creatures. Lead your farm-grown warriors in a turn-based strategy fight against the forces of nature.

games.name: Zhuishu
games.summary: Can you hear it? The faint sound coming from an abandoned radio, calling out for forgotten children. Trace back a chilling tale lost to time and unravel the mysteries hidden within the ruins. Who is silently watching you? And who lurks within the fog, waiting for answers?

games.name: A.R.A. Astro Rescue Alliance
games.summary: At the heart of a sci‑fi world awaits a series of logic puzzles that reward prudence, perseverance, and ingenuity. Skills you hone here prove useful in everyday life. No violence — just thrilling, high‑stakes challenges. Curious how it works? Play!

games.name: Better Than Dead
games.summary: "Better Than Dead," is a FPS where brutal and realistic gunfight meets the haunting beauty of a photorealistic Hong Kong. Inspired by classic Asian bloodshed cinema

games.name: Black Jacket
games.summary: Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

games.name: Breath Bound
games.summary: Breath Bound is a 2D co-op puzzle adventure where two divers share one oxygen tank and have to keep each other alive by scrounging air and navigating the treacherous obstacles of the sea. Every stretch of the journey back to the surface is a small test of coordination, timing and teamwork.

games.name: BugDive Complete
games.summary: Plummet down a massive hole as you collect 40 unique bugs hidden amongst the falling objects in this fully realized ultimate edition of the 2021 Ludum Dare 48 classic, "BugDive". Holy freaking crap. Includes a full scene creator mode, two bonus games, and a look back through BugDive's history.

games.name: Burgle Supply Company
games.summary: A co-op horror comedy game for you and your friends about burglarizing a nightmarish neighborhood full of mutated pets. No one said this would be easy, but maybe you can make it out of there with a sweet wood paneled video cassette recorder.

games.name: Call of the Elder Gods
games.summary: Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

games.name: ClassBoom
games.summary: This is a physics-based casual sandbox game, where there are no limits to your creativity. Mess around with liquids, explore the space, build machines, or just explode everything you can see.

games.name: Clockwork Ambrosia
games.summary: Clockwork Ambrosia is a compelling steampunk fusion of metroidvania and a 2D shooter. Players pull on the boots of an airship pilot to combat an army of deadly robots and monsters. Experiment with a range of rule-breaking weapons modifications and armors to prevail through this wild adventure!

games.name: Cloud Crashers
games.summary: Fight for victory across airborne stages in Cloud Crashers, an arena platformer fighting game in the skies. Choose from a diverse roster of characters with unique weapons and abilities, and brawl it out against other Challengers in intense PvP action!

games.name: DinD
games.summary: Will the Earth be better off when it loses humans？ 'DinD' is a 3rd person action-adventure,Walking in a world where mankind has disappeared, but not in peace。 Explore worlds that are no longer familiar, slay all sorts of monstrous creatures, and find out the answers to the world。

games.name: Directive 8020
games.summary: Earth is dying and humanity is running out of time. 12 light years from home, Tau Ceti f offers a small sliver of hope. When the colony ship Cassiopeia crash lands on the planet, its crew soon realize they are far from being alone. In space, death takes many forms.

games.name: Duel Draw: Katana Clash
games.summary:
"A lone samurai. Seven trials. One path to enlightenment.
The Crimson Wanderer walks a road few dare to find. At its end stands the enlightened one, undefeated, untouchable, the living myth of the blade.
Between you and him, seven legendary warriors wait in silence. Each one a wall. Each one a lesson.
This is not a battle of strength. It is a battle of stillness. One breath. One moment. One truth.
Honor the fallen. Carry their wisdom. Let each duel shape the swordsman you are becoming.
The path is long. The silence is deep. The enlightened one is waiting."

games.name: Duriano
games.summary: Duriano is a top-down arena shooting Slasher roguelike game where the player will be a hero durian of the norse wielding a weapon to fight upon a god of norse mythology. From different weapons, Durian hero, God’s trail, items will lead the player to create a build and defeat all gods of asgard.

games.name: Elfie: A Sand Plan
games.summary: A perfect day at the beach requires sand castles. Help a small ambitious elephant with her ideas in this relaxing geometric puzzle game! Or enjoy building your own!

games.name: Enihcam eht ni tsohg
games.summary: Yu opens the front door of his apartment and finds himself in a liminal network of the same room of his with no escape. Explore this surreal world and help him find a way to break out of the loop.

games.name: Exit, Seriously?
games.summary: An observation horror game by a student dev and a tired AI. Observe the hallway carefully: if you find an anomaly, turn back; if not, keep going. No saves, just pure student-made

games.name: Fail Fail Succeed
games.summary:
Fail Fail Succeed is a compact logic-driven puzzle platformer about turning failure into progress, inspired by the developer's struggles with cycles of manic highs and depressive lows.

You're an anonymous individual trapped inside a dream-like dimension. From somewhere a dog has appeared. She wants to guide you forward. But the path forward is full of deadly traps… and your one real ability? To fail.

Fortunately for you, there are mysterious orbs that let you leave a fragment of yourself behind. What remains will become barriers against hazards or platforms paving your way forward.

Fail and fail again, until you succeed! Persistence and clever thinking is the only way out of this place.

games.name: Fetter and Feeling
games.summary: Short Visual Novel intended to be a companion to a research questionnaire on consent and warnings in visual novels.

games.name: Flaw
games.summary: Find a way out of here and get back to earth in FLAW, a retro-FPS inspired by cult classics: Unreal, Quake 2, Half-Life and many others. You and the Flaming Dawn’s passengers were looking for a better life among the stars, you have yet found only despair and darkness.

games.name: FOF: Fear Of Failure
games.summary: FOF (Fear of Failure) is a physics-based precision platformer where every shot counts. Use the powerful recoil of your shotgun to propel yourself through challenging environments, overcoming obstacles with skill and strategy. one wrong move, and you’ll experience spectacular failure.

games.name: Forgotten Records
games.summary: What would you do if you were stuck in an ancient shrine filled with creatures unknown to reality? Forgotten Records is a romance visual novel set in the modern world, where the protagonist wanders into the wrong shrine at the wrong time and has to escape.

games.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
games.summary: Uncover one of history’s greatest mysteries in Indiana Jones and the Great Circle, a first-person, single-player adventure set between the events of Raiders of the Lost Ark and The Last Crusade. You’ll become the legendary archaeologist in this cinematic action-adventure game from MachineGames, the award-winning studio behind the recent Wolfenstein series, and executive produced by Hall of Fame game designer Todd Howard.

games.name: Maitoläikky
games.summary: Maitoläikky is a milk-preservation unclimber descent platformer type dairy experience. Made for The Fainting Room Game Jam 003 in 4 hours.

games.name: Nitro Gen Omega
games.summary: A Spaghetti Anime turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a crew of mercenaries through wastelands overrun by ruthless machines. Engage in high-octane cinematic Mech battles, recruit pilots and grow relationships. Play solo or join an online world where every character is procedurally generated.

games.name: Octopinbs
games.summary: A multiplayer action game for 3-10 people. Firefighters (octopuses) must capture the artists (squid) who have infiltrated their ranks! These saboteurs may tell clever tales...but actions never lie.

games.name: Orbit's Grocery
games.summary: Manage the galaxys quirkiest store in Orbits Grocery! Balance retail tasks like window wiping and shelf stocking with chaotic mini-games. Encounter eccentric aliens that trigger FPS, racing, and horror events. Survive cosmic phenomena in this genre-bending workplace adventure.

games.name: Poolscape
games.summary: Poolscape is a retro reimagining of the Poolrooms, evoking the nostalgia of classic PSX games by immersing players in the iconic liminal space with authentic ’90s-styled visuals and atmosphere.

games.name: PsyUp
games.summary: An emotional breather disguised as a physics puzzle. Break blocks, solve puzzles, and explore stages inspired by psychological phenomena — each world is a dive into the human mind through the lens of a clinical psychologist.

games.name: Quartet
games.summary: A series of unlikely train robberies. A mysterious deck of cards. A fleet of deadly airships. An accidental mage. Choose from four stories, in any order, and see how they eventually intertwine in this turn-based RPG.

games.name: Raccoon Survival Simulator
games.summary: Be clever, be quick, and think like a raccoon!

games.name: Rellion
games.summary: Rellion: NPC Survival is a captivating mobile idle RPG set in a fading.

games.name: Roots And Sprouts
games.summary: Roots and sprouts is a garden game where the player will explore an island with different species of plants and trees. Each day you're uncovering this new environment and its history.

games.name: Saint of Chains
games.summary:
Psychological single-player first-person horror. Explore dark environments, fight with melee and guns, and solve puzzles in this retro 2000s-inspired nightmare where the truth is more terrifying than the monsters.

Retro Horror - Reborn: A love letter to Silent Hill 3, Lost in Vivo, Condemned: Criminal Origins, and Cry of Fear.

Built in the haunting visual style of the PS2 / Xbox360 era — when every shadow felt alive, and every step sounded like a confession.

games.name: SeaQuest Dungeon
games.summary: SeaQuest Dungeon is a fast-paced, twin-stick shooter roguelite. With limited resources, choose different props to create powerful combinations to challenge higher difficulties and unlock new skills and weapons.

games.name: Silent Paradise
games.summary: Mainland has lost contact with the submerged city of Paradise and sent you to investigate the disappearance of its inhabitants. Explore the station and look for the upgrades you will need to navigate this sinking city and fend off the automated security system.

games.name: Sill Cats
games.summary: Tiny cats have moved onto your desktop. They walk along windows, play with your cursor, curl up and sleep, and may suddenly sprint around at 2 a.m. Includes 2 cats for free.

games.name: Stitchlings
games.summary: Stitchlings is a couch co-op action game where the monsters you defeat become parts to stitch onto your character, allowing you to customize your combat style and dress up your Stitchling! Grab a friend and embark on a grand adventure to rekindle a fading world where all you have is each other.

games.name: Tennis Manager 26
games.summary: Step into the most advanced tennis management experience ever. Run your academy, develop top talent, upgrade your staff and facilities, and dominate the junior and pro circuits. A new chapter begins, are you ready to take control?

games.name: The Azure One
games.summary: Follow the young boy Qiuxu to meet the girl who always sprints in the sunshine, and get to know three other girls with distinct personalities. In the daily life of the Second Municipal High School, you will witness a youth that cannot be turned back — a story destined to go somewhere.

games.name: The Door in The Skybox
games.summary: “The Door in The Skybox” is a third-person puzzle game about manipulating door frames to connect fragmented spaces. Featuring a surreal, dreamlike style inspired by 19th–20th century art, the game spans fifteen levels, each with a distinct visual identity.

games.name: The Wilds of Dacrima: Field Notes from a Poorly Supervised Alchemist and his Clockwork Robot Companion
games.summary: Uncover the secrets of the forest in this tale of two unlikely friends, with alchemist Edric Tayte and L-P1N. Forage for weird and wonderful ingredients, brew Potions to empower you with potent abilities, and all the while discovering that this adventure isn't quite what it seems..

games.name: Uncle Lee’s Cookbook: Five Recipes for Disaster
games.summary: Uncle Lee has done it again. It’s up to you to pick up the pieces. Join rebellious teen Ines as she deals with the fallout of her uncle Lee’s experiments/inventions/cooking, in a modern point & click adventure in five self-contained episodes.

games.name: XFlight
games.summary: A top-notch FPV simulator with excellent control feel and a wealth of engaging content.

games.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in Istanbul
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Istanbul in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

games.name: Actuator: Overt Abnormality
games.summary: "Actuator : Overt Abnormality" is a new action RPG that expands your horizons as you level up.

games.name: Angel's Return
games.summary: Kill the returning angels, parry their shots, And enter a state between world to allow yourself to revive

games.name: Arie: Moonprayer
games.summary: "Arie: Moonprayer" is a storytelling exploration game. Moon is falling, and the world is ending. Diallo, a man who can sense the memories of the gone, has one last mission on earth: Go up to the peak nearest to the moon with his mentor's daughter, find out the truth of this world.

games.name: Dead Sector: Outbreak
games.summary: Survive a brutal desert wasteland after a devastating outbreak. Scavenge, build, and defend yourself in a hostile open-world filled with ruins, wreckage, and deadly infected.

games.name: Feline Forensics and the Meowseum Mystery
games.summary: There's only one detective to unravel this murder turned museum heist... and they're the cat's meow. Interrogate a "colorful" cast of suspects until they cough up hairballs... and the truth. Will you wrap up the case in time for an afternoon nap, and make injustice knead its last biscuit?

games.name: Hauntsville
games.summary: You're a nameless traveler, stranded in a ghost town in the Cursed West. Use your wits, elbow grease, and the iron on your hip. Build a homestead, work the land, and survive against unspeakable monsters in this unique Western horror survival game - alone or with friends!

games.name: Hell's Bell
games.summary: GO TO HELL ... in this hand-drawn, hack-n-slash adventure. "Hell's Bell" is a story-driven brawler following Bell, who after learning a family secret, finds herself fighting endless hordes of demons in the underworld.

games.name: Heroes of Artadis
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a dark fantasy world. Build a squad of unique heroes, combine abilities, think tactically, and win PvP battles!

games.name: Inquiry Counsel
games.summary: "Hold on!" A court battle game set in ancient China's Song Dynasty! In the government office of Lin'an County during the Song Dynasty of ancient China, many bizarre murder cases occurred! The protagonist engages in intense court battles with the county captain of Lin'an to find the real culprit!

games.name: Kami: Parade of Senses
games.summary: The parade of senses begins and you are forced to become its participant. So make the most of the situation! Explore the Kami Space, help to other forced, who have been trapped here, look for answers to questions, betray, kill... or spare and protect.

games.name: Kernelbay
games.summary: A cozy idle fishing game that lives on your desktop. Explore handcrafted islands, unlock new species, upgrade gear and customize each island’s look as you uncover the stories hidden beneath the waves while your fisher works quietly in the background.

games.name: Mazebound: Hunt, Gather, Run!
games.summary: In this survival horror, you're surrounded by sea and a towering gate ahead. Walk into the maze, hunt, gather, and run to survive, alone or with friends. Remember: You're not the only one starving...

games.name: Monkey Gang
games.summary: Monkey Gang is an autobattler based on teamwork, where you can create a team of monkeys for fighting waves of enemies! Create strategies, unlock new monkeys, buy upgrades and make unique teams to reach the furthest you can!

games.name: Moviedle
games.summary: Type any movie title and submit your first guess. Each column shows you how close you are.

games.name: Mr Toilet
games.summary: Your toilet - your rules. Clean, charge fees, kick out freeloaders. Turn a filthy restroom into a royal, automated empire in an absurd simulator!

games.name: Nightfall Empress
games.summary: A 16‑bit dark fantasy action adventure with metroidvania‑style maps, RPG growth, and hidden secrets. Lead the Nightfall Empress through a mature journey suspended between the sacred and the profane.

games.name: Notmads
games.summary: Your home is a living beast. Raise it, build on its back, and explore the world as it becomes a moving fortress. Fight, gather resources, and grow stronger alongside it in a fast-paced action RPG with progression, crafting, and exploration, playable solo or with friends.

games.name: Overtime: Paper Trail
games.summary: Nothing good gets printed at 3 AM. Work the graveyard shift at a rundown copy shop. Smile at the strangers. Copy their files. But when the machine whirs, look deeper. There's a reason they came in the dark. Find out what they're hiding, before they realize you know too much

games.name: Panic Delivery
games.summary: A horror/comedy co-op game for 4 players: deliver packages in a dystopian world ruled by a ruthless and grotesque society of monsters! Failure is not an option: if the customers don’t kill you, the company will… and another expendable human will take your place.

games.name: Rogue Runner
games.summary: Rogue Runner is a high-speed running, rogue-like, third-person shooter, action, and parkour game. You must run to break the cycle. As you run, you'll discover different possibilities. Run, Kill, Die, Try new skills, and Repeat to break the cycle!

games.name: Sad Virus Waterland
games.summary: Sad Virus mission to collect beer bottles in this 3rd person adventure game in waterland map and avoid traps

games.name: Space Haven
games.summary: Embark on a space journey with your patched-together crew of civilians in search of a new home. Build spaceships tile by tile, create optimal gas conditions, manage the needs and moods of their crew, encounter other space-faring groups, and explore the universe in this spaceship colony sim.

games.name: The Knight of Niraking
games.summary: Play as the hero to save the land of Niraking from the Nohak Lord. Explore dungeons, castles, and ancient temples. Fight bosses and natural beasts to gather more gear or progress in the story. Talk to NPCs and add some of them to your party to advance your quest.

games.name: Torima Headbang
games.summary: You are a badass bird thug with a sick crest. Strap on your HMD, throw your sanity away, and blast through the concrete jungle BACKWARDS on a mini-skateboard. The better you match the rhythm, the more wind you blast — and the faster you RIDE!

games.name: Urban Golf: Hot Dog Edition
games.summary: Break free from the golf course and turn the streets into your fairway! No dress code, no rules — just freedom and creativity as you take golf anywhere.

games.name: Vultures: Scavengers of Death
games.summary: Face zombies and fearsome monsters in this turn-based survival-horror roguelike as you seek the path to recover a valuable artifact. Unravel the history of Salento Valley and its downfall after a bioterrorist attack led by a secret cult involved with the powerful corporation Eugenesys Tech.

games.name: Wagee
games.summary: Climb the corporate ladder in WAGEE! WAGEE is a roguelike deckbuilding game where you play cards and roll dice from your desk to reach increasingly difficult score quotas. Buy powerful items at the shop, merge cards to discover new ones, and upgrade your cards to create the strongest deck possible!

games.name: Wingsuit: Romsdalen
games.summary: Feel the rush of Norway’s Romsdalen Valley in this intense action sports game. Pilot a high-performance wingsuit through challenging exits, daring stunts and vast mountain landscapes. Are you ready to hit the slopes?

games.name: Wrispell
games.summary: Wrispell is a side-scrolling 3D magic action game where players combine runes to create spells. Play as the apprentice mage Lirabera, explore a collapsing world, collect runes, battle magical disasters, and solve puzzles. Discover new spell combinations and develop your own unique magic style.

games.name: Yomawari: Midnight Shadows
games.summary: The dark is no place to be alone. After a beautiful show of summer fireworks, two young girls begin to make their way home. However, a mysterious attacker separates them, and both must brave the haunting night filled with unspeakable terrors and survive the darkness.

games.name: Yomawari: Night Alone
games.summary: Yomawari is a Japanese horror action game and features a female protagonist that is searching for her older sister and pet dog, while exploring a creepy town at night. She only has a flashlight at her disposal, and using said flash light will let her “see things that shouldn’t be seen.”

games.name: Yomi 2
games.summary: A fighting game in card form. Learn your character, practice combos, and read the opponent's tendencies. Strategic, turn-based card battling that lets you experience the nuances of fighting games like Street Fighter and Fantasy Strike by a lead designer who worked on both.

games.name: A Playground Afternoon
games.summary: A 3D platforming party game, play with your friends in a colourful environment and enjoy yourselves!

games.name: A Tale of Silent Depths
games.summary: A Tale of Silent Depths is a turn based tactical RPG set in a post-apocalyptic underwater setting. Explore a procedurally generated Ocean, command your submarine and fight beasts, pirates and creatures beyond your crew's comprehension.

games.name: Aery: Calm Horizon
games.summary: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

games.name: Allfiring
games.summary:
Enter a beautiful anime-style action RPG set in a world consumed by darkness.
Explore mysterious lands, battle powerful enemies, and fight alongside unique companions in an epic adventure.

games.name: Amazing Facts: World Proverbs True or False Quiz
games.summary:
How well do you know the wisdom of the world?
Test yourself with surprising proverbs from around the globe!

games.name: American Truck Simulator: Illinois
games.summary: Welcome to the beautiful Prairie State! Illinois showcases the best of what the USA has to offer. Hop into your rig, hit the legendary Route 66, and journey through Springfield, the state’s historic capital, to Chicago, one of the Midwest's most iconic cities.

games.name: Animal Farm Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers
games.summary: Draw & paint cute farm animals using the touch screen. A relaxing creative coloring book preschool game for kids.

games.name: Apex 2026: Rise of Legends
games.summary:
Jump into high-speed racing
Master every corner
Become a legend

games.name: Ax RPG II
games.summary: Endless tactics, shaped entirely by your choices. This is the second entry in a turn-based command RPG series where freedom of strategy defines every battle. With deep skill customization and flexible decision-making, each player forges a completely unique way to fight.

games.name: Balorizon
games.summary: Tianping Line is a strategy RPG that blends event choices, character recruitment and growth, and auto-battles. Rule a fledgling nation, make decisions in domestic affairs and diplomacy, recruit unique characters, build your forces, expand your power, face crises, and shape the nation’s fate.

games.name: Bandits On West
games.summary: After a group of bandits breaks out of prison, the sheriff must chase them down, restore order, and bring justice to the Wild West.

games.name: Bug Alliance
games.summary: Bug Alliance is a pixel style top-down action RPG, where you play as bug warriors, each with unique abilities and weapons. Choose your Bug, select a game mode and dive into battles against worm tyranny. Fight, upgrade, farm resources, evolve and become a legend. Alliance is calling you!

games.name: Build a Flexible Brain! Shape Search
games.summary: Spot the shapes, wake up your mind!

games.name: Captain's Call
games.summary: Captain's Call is a live community strategy game built for Twitch, where every stream becomes a shared adventure. Viewers rally behind their Captain to build an army, deploy units, and overcome battles together in ongoing campaigns. Matches run on a regular schedule, giving your community something to anticipate while you focus on creating content. Earn rewards, recruit new units, customize your forces, and work together to conquer increasingly difficult challenges.

games.name: Case Files: Internal Affairs
games.summary: Case Files: Internal Affairs is the third installment in the Case Files series, a choice-driven detective adventure in which players investigate the deaths of two police officers and uncover the truth behind a mysterious case through evidence gathering, questioning suspects, and critical decision-making.

games.name: CaseCracker3
games.summary: Sift crucial evidence from a sea of data. Reconstruct the case from fragmented narratives. Catch logical gaps hidden between the lines. Unearth the truth from the faintest traces! Youll need sharp logic and keen insight to conquer this fully immersive deduction challenge. Come onIm waiting.

games.name: Colorizing: Daylight
games.summary: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation

games.name: Console Archives: Master of Monsters - Disciples of Gaia
games.summary:
"Master of Monsters: Disciples of Gaia" was released by Toshiba-Emi in 1997 for a 32-bit home console.
This is a simulation war game where Iros, a boy granted power from the heavens, embarks on a journey with the goal of defeating Gaia.
With the help of Master, who can freely control monster armies, summon monsters from another world, defeat your enemies, and raise your own monsters.

games.name: Countryside Farm Clues
games.summary: Countryside Farm Clues is a cozy spot the difference game that turns peaceful farm life into a satisfying test of observation. At first glance, every scene looks perfect, but subtle changes are hidden everywhere, challenging players to slow down, focus, and spot what others might miss. With relaxing countryside visuals, quick “just one more” gameplay, and both timed and stress-free modes, it’s the perfect blend of calm and challenge. Players will care because it delivers that rewarding “I found it!” feeling again and again, whether they want to unwind or sharpen their attention to detail.

games.name: Crayon Farm Animals
games.summary: My child's first digital sketchbook, color in the colorful farm animals! Complete cute cow, horse, and sheep friends with my fingertips, and fill your own animal picture book.

games.name: Creepy Tale: Snow Child
games.summary: A volatile cocktail of action and puzzles, spiced with pitch-black humor and a deliciously sinister atmosphere. Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?

games.name: Dark Light: Survivor
games.summary: In a dying multiverse, the Phantom Train is your last hope. Traverse a post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk world of nightmarish creatures. Experience dynamic shifts between top-down and third-person views, deep customization, and epic battles across universes in this action roguelike survival game.

games.name: Deadhaus Sonata
games.summary: Deadhaus Sonata is a cooperative multiplayer, free-to-play, action RPG where you play the dead fighting the living. An unstoppable force from Deadhaus, you are a monster among men, dealing death and destruction on a massive scale.

games.name: Destiny Powers: Goblins Realm
games.summary: Not all goblins are evil and dangerous.

games.name: Do Not Feed the Virus
games.summary: Grow your organism, gather biomass, and expand your colony. A casual, mouse-driven incremental game focused on growth and progression.

games.name: Drifters Don't Brake: Midnight
games.summary: Drift through different terrains and tackle challenges while your car auto-accelerates nonstop.

games.name: Eggconsole Meurtre d'un Clown PC-8801
games.summary:
Uncover the truth behind the clown murders in Brighton, England!
A serious adventure game tailored for adults is here.

games.name: Eternal Exodus
games.summary: A monster-catching RPG set in the afterlife. Catch and fuse 150 unique demons as you journey to conquer Hell itself.

games.name: Food Processing Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your own food processing factory. Automate production with machines, expand your facility, and keep inventory under control as you grow from a small workshop into a large-scale production empire.

games.name: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
games.summary:
Enter the world of the HBO hit series, Game of Thrones.
Experience an open-world action RPG with an original story found only in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad!

games.name: Gesui Oukoku
games.summary: A tower defense game that educates about water and sewage treatment, produced by the real-life water treatment company Meidensha.

games.name: Girl.exe
games.summary: You and your friends go to another world because you wanted to find a girlfriend. And you found one.... There is one crazy girl in this world. Will you be able to get out of this world or will you stay with her forever?

games.name: Hentai Sake
games.summary: Relaxing 18+ puzzle game with a bar vibe: complete mini-games, unlock seductive illustrations, and enjoy the smooth atmosphere of sake and nightlife.

games.name: Hidden Weekend: The American Getaway - Collector's Edition
games.summary: This is your chance to escape the hustle and bustle of city life and spend your weekend exactly the way you want.

games.name: Hiddenius: Sorceress Journey
games.summary: Avoid dangers and help Elvy become a real sorceress!

games.name: Hotel Architect
games.summary:
Step into the chaotic 24/7 lifestyle of a hotel owner as you design and build grand hotels across the globe. Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in Hotel Architect, the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.

Advance in a career campaign mode, with a variety of objectives to complete, in order to unlock the sandbox mode across each location.

Create your own hotel from scratch or transform a dilapidated plot into a thriving business. Design the layout and hire construction workers to lay the foundations and build different facilities across multiple floors. Building requires careful planning, as it plays out in real-time, so be careful annoy, disturb or remove items your guests are using – or else they might leave a bad review!

games.name: Ignore the Blackbird
games.summary: Ignore the Blackbird is a hand-drawn watercolor puzzle game. Explore the greenhouse, solve puzzles woven into its surroundings, and uncover what happened to Sonya and her family.

games.name: InVein
games.summary: Traverse this never-ending hospital as you discover clues of where and who you are. As each day passes by, the world around you decays, and you can’t help but wonder what is real. Utilize your time and resources as you roam these collapsing halls, but be careful; you may not be alone after all...

games.name: Iridio
games.summary: Seized by criminals, the island designated for your research needs your help. Join Yatziri and the Wazhari tribe to liberate their hostages, explore hidden secrets, craft essential items and weapons, and strategically use fire and water in challenging puzzles and life-or-death battles for survival.

games.name: K-Pop Fandom Korean Quiz
games.summary:
A Must-Play for K-Pop Idol Fans!
Learn Useful Korean with
Fun 3-Choice Quizzes

games.name: King Crab
games.summary: Dig trenches, build walls, explore the beach, and defend your sandcastle from the rising tide - on PC or in VR.

games.name: Klifur
games.summary: Casual 2D bouldering. Make your way through over 30 hand-made campaign routes or use the level editor to make your own routes and share them with friends!

games.name: Let Me Play!
games.summary: After shouting "Let Me Play!" to the cast in a theatre, the fiction comes crashing down as everyone, including you, becomes aware they're only following a script. Will you let the play continue? Or will you write your own ending?

games.name: Logic Training IQ Quiz for Kids
games.summary:
2 2 4 [?] 16 32 64 — What number goes in [?]?
Train your programming brain with fun puzzles!

games.name: Luna's Room
games.summary: An unfamiliar room. Vague memories. Explore Luna's room through the objects inside it in this intimate narrative experience about loss, told as a classic-style graphic adventure.

games.name: Mad King Redemption
games.summary: Mad King Redemption is a unique blend of a traditional beat'em'up game with strong roguelite progression, mixed in a pixelated graphic style in a 2.5D world. Relieve the king from his madness while beating up corrupted enemies, in a fresh way at every run!

games.name: Maze Creep!!
games.summary: A satire co-op horror game where players aim to reach the end of an infinite series of mazes, evading the all-hearing Maze Creep and various other threats.

games.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
games.summary: Turns raw rock into valuable minerals and jewelry grade gemstones through a hands on production chain. Mine ore, crush it into fragments, refine it, and scale your operation with better machines and smarter workflow. Optimize every stage of the pipeline to maximize efficiency, quality, and profit.

games.name: Move, Move, Melon!!
games.summary: You’re Melon, a tiny hamster with a huge goal. Collect mix-ins, roll fast, and build momentum to churn the biggest ice cream scoop ever in this whimsical, on-rails runner.

games.name: Mutiny's Wake
games.summary: A hardcore pirate survival game set during the Golden Age of Piracy. Stranded on a hostile island after a mutiny, you must scavenge, hunt, craft, and survive against pirates, wildlife, and dwindling resources.

games.name: Mysteries of Old Tokyo
games.summary: Step into the Imperial Capital, where knowledge is your weapon. Research and explore 40+ real-life Tokyo locations, past and present. Encounter a cast of wandering spirits, interrogate their stories, and separate the truth from their lies.

games.name: Never Experiment On Cats!
games.summary: The test cats have broken free! They're getting into all the equipment, from jetpacks to lawnmowers and paintball guns! Bounce, bash, and blast your way to the top of the scoreboard! Is there more to the lab? Who's behind it all? A family-friendly game you can play by yourself or with friends.

games.name: Nighthawk no Shokuzai: Zenpen
games.summary: The story follows two women — an FBI agent with emotional scars, and the Osaka Prefectural Police protection officer who supports her, as they struggle to prevent an assassination plot against the President. It's a tale of the Osaka Prefectural Police in action.

games.name: Nova Fighter
games.summary: Are you ready to face a brutal, fast-paced pixel-art 2D action platformer where every level is a test of skill? Slash through ruined lands, master high-speed combat, overcome precision platforming, and fight ruthless boss battles in a journey built for players who love a real challenge.

games.name: Nova Patria
games.summary: Nova Patria is a Roman Steampunk Colony Sim. In this alternate history, the empire never fell and lived on to discover the New World and steam power. Manage intricate supply chains, expanding cities, and innovations in a hopeful, procedurally generated, isometric simulation of industrial antiquity.

games.name: Paranormal Observation
games.summary: Start your career as a ghost hunter with the latest technology. Use your computer to find out what type of ghost you are dealing with. Are you prepared to face the challenges of ghost hunting?

games.name: PawRebuild
games.summary: Five animal friends turn messy ruins into a cozy haven by matching identical items. It features 10 scenes with 5 renovation stages for each, adopts a distinctive cardboard art style, has no time limits or penalty mechanics, and allows you to unlock all achievements effortlessly.

games.name: Perfect Tides: Station to Station
games.summary: A point n' click sequel to Perfect Tides about the momentum and whiplash of young adulthood.

games.name: Port Authority
games.summary: Port Authority is a real-time harbor management game where you draw routes guiding cargo ships to color-matched docks. Navigate increasingly chaotic traffic through harbors inspired by real-world locations as more vessels arrive. One collision ends it all. How many containers can you deliver?

games.name: RoadOut
games.summary:
The world is dominated by an A.I. and rebel groups take refuge in a desert area known as the DeadZone.

Claire survives by executing delivery, sabotage and murder contracts for local leaders, while discovering about her past, revealing strange evidence that links her existence with the origin of the A.I.

games.name: Rocket Cars
games.summary: Rocket-powered cars meet competitive soccer in intense 3v3 matches. Master aerial tricks, teamwork, and split-second saves in this fast-paced, physics-driven sports game.

games.name: Rogue Command
games.summary: True RTS gameplay reinforced with roguelite build crafting. Control units with bullet-time precision. Call down bases and raise armies. Drafted from a different arsenal every run. Weave builds that break the game. Or the game breaks you.

games.name: Sea Walker Saga
games.summary: An exciting steampunk adventure with strategy and RPG elements. Fight pirates, explore the seabed, build your own battle island and set out into the vast world ocean in search of a mythical continent!

games.name: Sektori
games.summary: Sektori is an intense, fast paced twin-stick shooter where every run is unique. Choose your upgrades carefully and create powerful builds to take on numerous enemies and epic bosses on a constantly evolving battlefield.

games.name: Sinners Landing: Bane of Passion
games.summary: Sinners Landing: Bane of Passion continues the story of rogue mage Tristan Lamprey in a world of danger and divine temptation. Battle new monsters, explore new dungeons, and fall for new lovers while collecting art, unlocking scenes, and diving deeper into the seductive chaos of Sinners Landing.

games.name: Skate Rush: 90s Retro Arcade
games.summary: A fast free-to-play retro arcade skating game where you dodge obstacles, keep your speed, and chase a better score in quick single-player runs inspired by classic 90s energy. Many real life skate tricks included!

games.name: SkyDungeon Shinobigaeshi Peak
games.summary: A tough ninja precision platformer with 150+ short courses, a built-in level editor, and Steam Workshop support. Master jumps, dashes, and wall moves, chase faster clears, and create your own brutal challenges.

games.name: Smalland: Survive the Wilds
games.summary: Experience a big adventure on a tiny scale! Enjoy multiplayer survival in a vast, hazardous world. Preparation is key when you're this small & at the bottom of the food chain. Craft weapons & armour, tame & ride creatures, build encampments & explore a strange new land.

games.name: Snack and Quack: Duckling Steps
games.summary: Quack, Push, and Feed the Ducklings

games.name: Snowdrift
games.summary: In this cozy, quiet, romantic, science fantasy visual novel, read from the perspective of Arrim as he falls in love with Rosim: a wheelchair-bound woman with red eyes who lives alone with her robot servant, in a region that's been scarred with cold weather, after a war with aliens.

games.name: Solo Shift!
games.summary: From cash register to fryer—you've got to manage it all! Take on waves of customers all by yourself! Run a convenience store solo in this frantic action game!

games.name: Subnautica 2
games.summary: Subnautica 2 is an underwater survival adventure set on an all-new alien world, developed by Unknown Worlds. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op. Adapt to survive by building custom bases and crafting tools. Explore the unknown to uncover the mysteries hidden within the depths.

games.name: Surprising Laws Around the World True or False Quiz
games.summary: Do you think this law actually exists?

games.name: Swing of the Valkyries
games.summary: Swing, dash, and dodge through bullet storms and monster swarms in this relentlessly difficult 3D bullet hell platformer. The objective is simple - survive till you reach the end of the level- but getting there alive? That's another story.

games.name: Söldner-X 2: Final Prototype - Definitive Edition
games.summary:
In Soldner-X 2: Final Prototype, you will return to Gota IV as part of the Soldner-X defense force. Mankind will once more rely on your battle against new mysterious powers. Staged across seven unique action-loaded levels accompanied with an adrenaline pumping soundtrack, Soldner-X 2: Final Prototype combines traditional 2D gameplay with detailed high definition graphics and a taste of fresh innovations.

Twenty years after the Virus Wars, you return to Gota IV as part of the newly formed Söldner-X defense force. Your mission: to free the galaxy from the D'aarg, a technologically superior race that is threatening mankind. Staged across up to 10 unique action-loaded levels, Söldner-X 2: Final Prototype delivers a must-have, shoot' em up experience, blending classic gameplay with the astonishing audio-visuals.

games.name: Take It Seriously! Extreme Common Sense Challenge
games.summary: A common sense test so difficult you can’t solve it — even though you should know the answers

games.name: Tavern Timer
games.summary: Welcome to your Tavern! A cozy focus tool where you pick a keeper to run the tavern while you work. Customize from floor to fireplace with 200+ items. Pomodoro, custom timers, and to-do list included. Productivity has never felt so magical!

games.name: The Backrooms
games.summary: The Backrooms is a horror adventure game where you explore the liminal space of the Backrooms while you interact with strange and creepy characters. Explore the Backrooms, find the unexpected as you go into impossible spaces and see things you shouldn't have seen.

games.name: The Caribou Trail
games.summary: The WWI story where your goal isn't to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.

games.name: The Clubies
games.summary: The Clubies is a party platformer where players navigate cute cube characters through the disco to reach the dancefloor! Encounter various hazards, puzzles, and shortcuts in a fun, colorful environment as you master user-built levels together.

games.name: The Melty Way
games.summary: You move, you melt. Play as a brave size-shifting slime in this colorful precision puzzle-platformer, dashing through handcrafted puzzles and perilous traps on your journey in The Melty Way.

games.name: The Ramen Shop
games.summary: A horror game where you manage a ramen shop. Take orders from your customers, serve hot delicious ramens and sweet cold drinks to hungry customers.

games.name: The Real Academic Challenge High School Level
games.summary: A high school–level academic challenge that even adults stumble over

games.name: Tindark
games.summary:
Tindark is a loop-style psychological horror puzzle game where players take on the role of a dating-app user tasked with spotting anomalies among their daily matches.

Each day, eight profiles must be reviewed — swipe right on normal profiles, swipe left on anomalies. Reach Day 9 without making a mistake to escape the loop. Inspired by anomaly-spotting horror titles such as The Exit 8, a single playthrough lasts roughly 15 to 60 minutes.

games.name: Tohotopia
games.summary: A 4X strategy craze sweeps Gensokyo! As the "Esports Tournament" begins, the girls join the fray. Warlords rise: will you be "Pharaoh" Remilia, "Emperor" Kaguya, "Great" Kanako, or "Philosopher King" Miko? Launch the game now, lead your empire, and dominate Gensokyo!

games.name: Trace Blackout: The Perfect Crime Mystery
games.summary: Clean up the evidence at the crime scene and pull off the perfect crime!

games.name: Underling Uprising
games.summary: Play as the Underlings, a group of experiments created by evil mad science, as you seek revenge on your previous captor, the maniacal Dr. Baldrick! On their journey, the Underlings will need to fight across the globe, overcome the demons of their pasts, and accept help from unexpected places.

games.name: Wall Street Raider
games.summary: Wall Street Raider offers the deepest stock market simulations in gaming history. Control publicly traded corporations, futures, options, and even crypto. Whether you want to make billions in equities, short-sell overvalued stocks, or hedge risk using derivatives, the market is yours to conquer!

games.name: What'Sub
games.summary: Work together as a pirate crew and plunder coffee across the oceans! Hold your (t)rusty submarine together, dodge disasters, fight dangers, and finally get the black gold home! Play this co-op action game with up to 4 players and try become the mightiest pirates of the underseas!

games.name: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
games.summary: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

games.name: Who Do Voodoo
games.summary: A social deduction game where crafted cards become spells. Protect allies, sabotage rivals, or prank everyone in a magical fight for survival.

games.name: Wizard Confidential
games.summary:
Sling spells and borrow trouble in a city lousy with bootleggers, bent coppers, and vampires. Can you crack the case and save your partner before a wizard dooms Seattle?

Wizard Confidential is an interactive urban fantasy noir novel by Anthony Eichenlaub, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based, 220,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects, fueled by the vast unstoppable power of your imagination.

games.name: XIII: A Final Game of Tarot With Death
games.summary: XIII is a hypnotic and psychedelic card game. Let death read your future with tarot cards and decide your fate. Play the right cards in the right places to keep the scales of karma in check, for that's the only way to delay the inevitable. And never forget: death comes to us all.

games.name: Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship
games.summary: The Last Ship Take command of the last ship in a zombie-filled world and defend against endless waves of the undead. Build turrets, lead your crew, and upgrade the ship while gathering loot in this exciting "Tower Defense-on-wheels zombie survival roguelite" game.

games.name: Život Není Krásný: Poslední Exekuce
games.summary: A hand‑drawn, old‑school point‑and‑click adventure filled with dark humor and unapologetically over‑the‑top violence. Step into the shoes of the degenerate bailiff Vladimír Brehowski and follow him through his final day on the job.

games.name: 'In You We Trust, Not Algorithms': Newbie Matsumoto's Manual Elevator Operation with Sticky Notes
games.summary: A hyper-stressful, strictly manual elevator simulation! You're the corporation's new "control system" (a human). Drag and drop sticky notes to transport employees. Amidst massive clock-out rushes and blaring complaints, can you survive this extreme one-man shift?!

games.name: Abyss Runner
games.summary: Meet Lily, the Queen of the Underworld. She possesses incredible magic abilities, but to be honest, she's a bit of an airhead... She tried to pull a prank on an adventurer using a monster-filled pit, but fell into it herself... and now she's stuck. Just how will she get out of this one?!

games.name: Ace Thunder: Aircraft Wingman Simulator
games.summary: Precision in flight. Power in combat.

games.name: Anomaly Jobs : Data Center
games.summary: You work the nightshift at Data Center DC4-31. Something is off this time. Spot the anomaly, take the correct exit multiple times in a row and finish your shift.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Mr.Do!
games.summary:
"Mr.Do!" is an action game released by Universal in 1982.
Take control of a colorful clown as you clear stages by defeating monsters and collecting cherries.
In addition to the two widely played versions, this edition includes the rare "Oldest version"—the very first iteration featuring a unique character design for the protagonist!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Mr.Do!
games.summary:
"Mr.Do!" is an action game released by Universal in 1982.
Take control of a colorful clown as you clear stages by defeating monsters and collecting cherries.
In addition to the two widely played versions, this edition includes the rare "Oldest version"—the very first iteration featuring a unique character design for the protagonist!

games.name: Augment Anthem
games.summary: A 2D sci-fi metroidvania. Explore Bunker 7, fight biomechanical threats shaped by corrupted superintelligence, and rebuild Haven, humanity's final refuge.

games.name: Backrooms: The Last Observer
games.summary: Backrooms: The Last Observer is a cooperative horror game. Descend into something that resists understanding, where perception itself begins to fracture. You are here not to fight, but to witness — and sometimes, witnessing is the worst thing you can do.

games.name: Bad Raccoon
games.summary: Welcome to the life of a Suburban Bandit!

games.name: Before Closure
games.summary: An experimental narrative game that tells its story through sound and memory. Sort through a box of personal mementos and relive memories from a relationship by closing your eyes in real life.

games.name: Bible Quiz: Trivia Game
games.summary: Race the clock across hundreds of Bible trivia questions! Test your knowledge of scripture, famous figures, miracles, parables, and more. Perfect for faith communities, trivia fans, and anyone curious about the world's most read book.

games.name: Blueblood Arena
games.summary: An indie fighting game with simple controls and anthropomorphic characters. Developed by the same dev as Among Us Arena.

games.name: Boba Buba
games.summary: BobaBuba Is the Boba Bubble-Pop Puzzle Adventure with story mode featuring cute beverages and an endless mode for huge replay value. With global leaderboards from launch!

games.name: Boogie Fungi
games.summary: Build and maintain a colony of Mushrooms, keep them happy with constant parties and make sure to deploy some defenses to deal with foragers

games.name: Bubble Shooter Piratery
games.summary: Pop your way to pirate glory.

games.name: Carrot Kingdom!
games.summary:
A rabbit and carrot puzzle-platformer!
Stretch your ears to grab the carrots!

games.name: Cat Island Petrichor
games.summary: "Cat Island Petricolor" is an exploration adventure game set on Japan's summer "Cat Island." Become a cat, explore the island, and uncover the mysteries of Cat Island together with the heroine!

games.name: Catjong 5: Paw Canyon
games.summary: Embark on a cozy mahjong-3 adventure with your playful cat! Solve 200 fun levels and build a charming Wild West town in a warm, sunlit canyon.

games.name: Centipede Simulator
games.summary: Experience life as a centipede! Munch on crickets to grow longer and evade deadly predators in a frantic struggle for survival across multiple game modes. How long can you last?

games.name: Cook the Word
games.summary: Mix Letters, Make Words

games.name: Copycat Games: Imposter Party Games
games.summary:
Copycat offers a variety of fun social games, including imposter, imposter drawing, codenames and more! Can be played on your pc or phone, anywhere anytime with anyone!

Gather a group and play the most popular party games all in one app! Find the imposter, catch the fake artist, and give clues to get your team to pick the right words.

games.name: Crafty Survivors
games.summary: All heroes got corrupted! Unlock a diverse cast of crafty professionals, use their unique skills, create your own builds and defend your home by eliminating hordes of monsters. Gather materials, rebuild your village and craft your way to the origin of this malignous curse!

games.name: Dead Spell
games.summary: Dead Spell is an open-world fantasy RPG focused on exploration, magic, progression, and adventure. Explore, craft powerful magical spells, complete epic quests, adventure into dangerous dungeons, battle bosses, and discover rare items!

games.name: Deathplane
games.summary: Deathplane is a 2D puzzle-platformer game about moving the actual deathplane below the level up and down to kill enemies and find solutions and secrets.

games.name: Deep in the fields
games.summary:
First-person walking simulator
Inspired by Argentine folklore and rural legends
Simple interactions that reveal the story
Atmospheric experience focused on narrative

games.name: Dereology Chime
games.summary: Explore the school map freely and build relationships with the heroines in this exploration-based romance sim. Improve your stats by interacting with students, then win their hearts through actions like “Talk,” “Gift,” and “Charm” as you uncover the legend of the “Lovers’ Bell.”

games.name: Down with the Ship
games.summary: Strategic auto battler where you design a heavily-armed spaceship. Draft 200+ items, outfit your hull, and unleash it in async PvP. Blend captains and factions for absurd combos and galactic domination. Roll, buy, place, pray.

games.name: Dream Doctor
games.summary: Dream Doctor is a platformer BOSS RUSH where you take on the role of a "psychologist", capable of entering your patients' dreams to confront their worst nightmares through brute force.

games.name: Drive Together
games.summary: One car, many drivers! Team up with your friends and share control of the gas, brakes, and steering to reach the finish line through chaotic tracks. Will it be perfect teamwork, or a total disaster? (Playable with 1–4 players)

games.name: Dungeon of Calibris: Demon Orb
games.summary: Descend into a sprawling, perilous dungeon in this old‑school first‑person RPG. Build your party, uncover hidden rooms, battle deadly creatures, and meet a large cast of adventurers trying to survive the depths. Designed with the spirit of classic “dad‑era” dungeon crawlers.

games.name: Dungeons of Freeport
games.summary: A Daily Extraction Roguelike Dungeon-Crawler. Play the same dungeons as everyone else, once a day. Select your gear and delve into dungeons, attempting to escape with the loot you obtain. Inspired by classical roguelikes of decades past, but with a modern interface and metagame.

games.name: Eggconsole Hydlide II PC-8801
games.summary: Hydlide Series Part 2. Become the chosen one and seal the evil consciousness targeting Fairyland! Utilize magic to conquer a field map six times larger than the previous

games.name: Endless Snake
games.summary: A chill snake game until you choose otherwise. Cruise through Endless, then test yourself with combos, risky routes, Two-Body control, Strategist planning, evolving builds, daily runs, 10 bosses, and 100 achievements.

games.name: Enigmic: Crime Puzzle Cases
games.summary: Enigmic is a mystery deduction game where you solve cases using only your logic. Read the clues, analyze every detail, and place each suspect in the correct position. Every case is a small brain challenge where you must mark, eliminate, and deduce until you find the only possible solution.

games.name: Entiled
games.summary: Entiled is a spatial tile-clearing puzzle game where every move matters. Remove tiles without collisions, match the active color to build your multiplier, and trigger chain reactions to maximize your score in quick, replayable runs.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6
games.summary: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend at the Horizon Festival. Start your journey as a tourist and explore a world full of hit music and Japanese culture. Build a Valley Estate, acquire awe-inspiring homes, and display your prized car collection in fully Customizable Garages. Cruise the roads with your friends and join Car Meets around Japan, unleash your imagination with EventLab and build together in Horizon CoLab.

games.name: Furry Necromancer
games.summary: You died, but I got good news and bad news for you. The good news - you have been resurrected, the bad news - you have been resurrected by a necromancer who has some "special" plans for you (although it might not be "bad news" at all...)

games.name: Futa Fucks Femboys
games.summary: Futa Fucks Femboys is an explosive mix of 2D Visual Novel and Collectible Card Game, where an alien symbiote turns the main hero into a FUTANARI and drags her into an adventure full of passion, absurdity, and FEMBOYS. Saving Earth has never felt so spicy

games.name: Galaxy Grinder Incremental
games.summary: Galaxy Grinder is a fast-paced incremental game where you destroy planets and asteroids with your cursor and weapons. Earn resources, unlock new worlds, and grow stronger through upgrades, skills, and power-ups between runs.

games.name: Global Football
games.summary: Global Football is a multiplayer football game focused on real skill, teamwork, and identity. Here, each player controls a single athlete on the field — not an entire team. No pay-to-win. No scripts. Victory depends solely on your game awareness, technique, and team chemistry.

games.name: Gold Gold Adventure Gold
games.summary: Gold makes god. Embrace city-building chaos. Pet giant monsters! Watch puny adventurers! Bend nature to your will with powerful spells and the greatest of all forces of nature - GOLD. Colony sim / reverse RPG

games.name: Halls of Nyarlathotep
games.summary: Explore the shifting labyrinths of the Dreamlands in this Lovecraftian roguelite FPS, where every shot, step, and secret chips away at your sanity as you face eldritch horrors and ancient Outer Gods.

games.name: Hyperwurm Is Back!
games.summary: A cyber‑worm engine roaring through a deadly maze. Guide a growing creature through tight corridors and sometimes face bosses using mouse, controller, or keyboard ...or let an AI Agent take over control.

games.name: Karkaba
games.summary: Choose from 10 iconic Middle Eastern fighters and battle across legendary Arab stages. Karkaba is a deep, skill based fighting game where timing, combos, and character mastery decide every fight. Experience smooth 60 FPS combat with friends locally or compete online.
