games.summary: Build your empire and dominate the world in Capital Kings! Start as an ambitious entrepreneur, buy lucrative businesses, expand your influence, and outmaneuver rivals in this thrilling, location-based monopoly game. Make critical strategic decisions, accumulate wealth, and shape your destiny. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate tycoon? Your rise to power starts now!

games.name: CleanSheet 2
games.summary: From the creators of CleanSheet Football, CleanSheet 2 delivers the definitive goalkeeping experience on PlayStationVR2. Step between the posts with faster gameplay, advanced training systems, and authentic match situations designed to test your reactions, positioning, and composure under pressure.

games.name: Console Archives: L'Empereur
games.summary:
"L'Empereur" was released by Koei in 1991 for an 8-bit home console.
This simulation game puts you in the shoes of the legendary Napoléon, aiming to save France from crisis, become emperor, and unify Europe, carrying the hopes of the people.
Overcome the challenges of realistic HEX-based warfare, requiring consideration of varying topography and bridge construction, and develop sharp diplomatic strategies by your genius military tactics and political power.

games.name: CosmoKick.io
games.summary:
CosmoKick.io is a free to play, fast paced, multiplayer 3D soccer game, developed by an indie game dev over the last 3 years.

Play even on low end devices, straight in your browser. No downloads required!

The game has unique characters with special abilities, and an upgrade system. Always free to play and no pay-to-win or gatcha mechanics.

Chaos is guaranteed!

games.name: D.O.T. Defence
games.summary: Welcome to the frontlines of D.O.T. Defence! Build towers, muster armies, and conquer the map. Fight local matches in 1v1, 2v2, or free-for-all battles against friends and AI-controlled bots. Victory comes with the last HQ standing!

games.name: Dark Auction
games.summary: The game is a mystery adventure centering on the idea of a historical figure having surreptitiously bequeathed a fictitious estate, following the drama that plays out among the characters faced with an enigma extending all the way into their modern world.

games.name: DragonLoop
games.summary: The heroine who lost her memory was trapped in a five-day loop. Connect with your partners to travel through a world with strange time changes, continue to become stronger, retrieve memories, and understand the truth. The game is a time loop Metroidvania.

games.name: Dreamstranded
games.summary:
Dive into a survival adventure with a cozy atmosphere! Enjoy gathering, crafting, and building — but beware, monsters lurk in the shadows, ready to challenge you!

At the beginning of the story, you awaken in a mysterious world with your memories lost, and the journey unfolds from there.

First, you must learn to survive — gathering resources, crafting items, and building a camp. You can choose to survive alone or recruit villagers to establish a thriving tribe.

As you explore the wilderness, you will encounter various monsters. Arm yourself with crafted gear, master magic, and defeat them!

Embark on a vast journey, follow clues, and unravel the mystery of why you drifted here. Or, you can simply relax and enjoy the pastoral life. The choice is entirely yours!

games.name: FIFA World Cup: Launch Edition
games.summary: Experience the rush of FIFA World Cup 2026 soccer matches with this fast-paced game for up to four players. Play instantly on your TV or computer.

games.name: Flippy Jump
games.summary: You close the door of your refrigerator and an interesting life begins inside. Fruits and vegetables try to escape from this big white cage. Break everything around you and smash through shelves to find a way out. The more precise the timing of the jump, the more powerful the impact. That's exactly what you need to succeed! Try to get out all the fruits and vegetables out of the fridge. Carrot, cucumber, sausage, and even a spoon for some reason.

games.name: Frog Sqwad
games.summary: Storm The Sewers for the glory of the Swamp King! Swing, jump, catapult your friends, and eat eat EAT until you grow into a humongous Megafrog. A co-op extraction puzzle-platformer for up to 8 players. Squad up with your frog friends for a friendslop party in this slapstick physics adventure!

games.name: FZDDR
games.summary: A silly side-scrolling arcade game where you play as a flying demonic zombie dinosaur with a chainsaw for a tail. Dodge obstacles, collect coins and cut demons in half. How long will you resist in this madness?

games.name: Gem Venture
games.summary: Jump, dash, and mine your way through obstacles and enemies in this platforming tribute to the classics! Restore the Sacred Gems of Aventurine, or else it will become a land of nothingness.

games.name: Girl Terminal
games.summary: "Girl Terminal" is a desktop pet game where you earn reputation through mouse and keyboard actions, unlock outfits, and weapon mods. Spend your day with this apocalypse girl! Team up with friends and form your own squad!

games.name: Guild of Dungeoneering: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
Guild of Dungeoneering Ultimate Edition is a completely rebuilt and remastered version of the award-winning 2015 indie hit from Gambrinous.

In this turn-based dungeon crawler with a twist, instead of controlling the hero you build the dungeon around them. Using cards drawn from your guild decks you lay down rooms, monsters, traps and of course loot!

games.name: Hentai Morgana
games.summary: Hentai Morgana is a puzzle game filled with dark magic, midnight temptation, and gothic charm. Meet Morgana — a seductive vampire who hunts not only in the darkness, but for your attention as well. Complete levels and unlock new revealing illustrations.

games.name: Honey Sprint

games.name: Imago Season
games.summary: A true narrative roleplaying experience. Explore an alien city inhabited by human-insect hybrids. Roll dice, join a revolution, become a mutant yourself. The choices are yours, but so are the consequences.

games.name: Kebab Chefs!: Restaurant Simulator
games.summary: Kebab Chefs! is a Co-Op, cooking and restaurant management game that can be played up to 4 players. Design your own restaurant. Cook delicious foods, fill your menu with various recipes, feed customers and become the biggest kebab restaurant in town!

games.name: Kill the Super Duper Big Monster
games.summary: Kill the Super Duper Big Monster is an idle/incremental game where you face different monsters while the game is running. Defeat various monsters to improve your skills, unlock cosmetics, and customize your island.

games.name: Laser Logic
games.summary: Guide laser beams through clever puzzles in this relaxing yet challenging brain teaser.

games.name: Legolast Tiny Builder
games.summary: Build incredible creations brick by brick in a relaxing 3D construction puzzle adventure. Complete detailed models, unlock new sets, and become the ultimate tiny builder.

games.name: Lost Castle 2
games.summary: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

games.name: Lovely Deco House
games.summary: Create your own healing space through collecting and crafting, a deco adventure with cute friends!

games.name: Maximum Sports Silver Collection

games.name: Memebonk

games.name: Mirklurk: Every Step Matters
games.summary: You've been exiled to The Mirk - an unforgiving swampland where every step could be your last. You must constantly make choices: what paths to take, which tree to shelter under, what beasts to engage or avoid, what items to bring into the darkness of dungeons, and what treasures to leave behind.

games.name: Mousebusters
games.summary: The player character just wanted to move into their new apartment, but when they end up transformed into a mouse they find themselves having to join the Mousebusters to take out the ghosts haunting every resident of the building.

games.name: Nosferatu no Otome-tachi
games.summary: “—I am a genius. That is how I have defined myself.” Nosferatu no Otome-tachi is a visual novel set on a rooftop at night. A brilliant girl and a drowsy girl—two complete opposites—find themselves connected by the Nosferatu disease, and through it, they begin to build a genuine friendship.

games.name: Onigiri Shop Simulator
games.summary: Your own onigiri (rice ball) shop in Japan awaits! Serve perfect rice balls and crispy sides to hungry customers. As a solo operator, you'll manage inventory, perfect your cooking flow, and handle the rush. Can you turn your tiny stand into a beloved town eatery?

games.name: Oxygen Not Included: The Aquatic Planet Pack
games.summary: Dive into the deep end of space colony expansion in The Aquatic Planet Pack! This DLC features a new flooded planet with marine biomes, resources, critters, plants, and more. Towel not included.

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary:
In Pardon My French Toast, you play as a Toasty (a talking slice of brioche) who dreams of participating in the new edition of the bread wrestling competition. To be physically up to the challenge, he decides to follow a training program organized by the previous champion of the discipline, which will take him all over the world and make him meet a bunch of wacky weirdos.

Pardon My French Toast is an adventure / platform game in 2D top view in which the player explores different worlds, solves puzzles and meets a whole bunch of fun characters. Bread wrestling is a... special sport. We will introduce the discipline later.

games.name: Pixel Rain
games.summary:
Pixel Rain is a relaxing falling-sand physics sandbox where every cell on a giant grid obeys its own rules. Pour water, drop sand, ignite lava, grow crystals — then sit back and watch it all interact.

There's no campaign, no fail state, no pressure. Just you, a canvas full of physics-driven pixels, and a lot of satisfying emergent behaviour.

games.name: Reel it! World Fishing
games.summary:
Embark on a fishing adventure around the world!
Cast your line and reel in fish from across the globe!

games.name: Road to Jonin! The 3-Choice Ninja Quiz

Train your ninja knowledge and rise to elite rank!
A quick 3-choice quiz challenge!

games.name: Soccer Kick-ups
games.summary: Take on the challenge and become the king of kick-ups.

games.name: Solitaire Legends: Sakura Dreams
games.summary: Play classic Solitaire in a calm, anime-inspired world. Choose between 1-card or 3-card draw, earn score and experience, and unlock beautiful card skins, card backs, and backgrounds.

games.summary: A fast-paced retro arcade shooter inspired by classic 1980s side-scrolling space combat. Weave through organic obstacles, survive relentless enemy waves, and defeat powerful end-level bosses in a pure, skill-driven singleplayer experience.

games.name: SpaceCraft
games.summary: The Universe is yours. SpaceCraft is an online space exploration and building game. Explore a vast galaxy of solar systems and planets, mine and craft resources, design and build ships, automate planetary bases and interplanetary logistics, trade and cooperate.

games.name: Sportal
games.summary: Retro fps where you use sport equipment - baseball bats, hockey sticks, golf clubs, bowling balls and pigskins to launch projectiles into monsters straight from classic creature features. Collect upgrades, find gear and hit fastballs to get back home in this stylish action game set in 50’s America.

games.name: Spot the Impossible with Common Sense!

Something in this era doesn't belong.
Trust your common sense and spot it.

games.name: Super Arcade Soccer 2026
games.summary: Fast-paced, classic arcade football with a next-gen feel and pinpoint control. The 90s soccer feel you loved, rebuilt with modern physics and a fresh cartoon style. Just in time for the 2026 World Cup.

games.summary: Where cosiness becomes a story!

games.name: Tabletop Tavern
games.summary:
Total War meets Slay the Spire in a new RTS rougelike.

Dive into Tabletop Tavern, a real-time strategy roguelike where every battle is a roll of the dice—and every victory is earned. Command your mercenaries on a chaotic tabletop battlefield, recruit a wild roster of warriors, and forge your legacy against relentless goblin hordes. With infinite builds, brutal choices, and endless replayability, this is RTS chaos for roguelike fanatics.

games.name: Tales of Seikyu
games.summary: "Tales of Seikyu" is a fantasy farming sim game set in a lost fae land called Seikyu, inhabited by legendary creatures. However, the town is frequently threatened by the old gods' forces. As a new arrival, can you successfully manage the old inn entrusted to you by God Inari?

games.name: The Grey Company
games.summary: Tabletop Tavern: RTS meets roguelike chaos. Recruit mercenaries, command them in real-time on a tabletop battlefield, and face endless goblin hordes. Unique runs, tough choices, infinite replayability.

games.name: To a T
games.summary: to a T is a 3D narrative adventure game developed by Keita Takahashi and the uvula team, with a strong focus on character, interaction, story and exploration. Play as a teenager (Teen), with a unique posture just trying to live a normal life in a small coastal town. Explore the town along with the help of Teen’s loyal dog and loving mother. While going to school and contending with bullies, Teen discovers a new ability granted to them by their extraordinary posture, and they start to uncover more about their mysterious lineage.

games.name: Underwater
games.summary: Set in the Mariana Trench inside a marine biology research laboratory, where everything goes wrong. Discover, scavenge, collect, and hide. Find out what happened and how to escape, if you can. Will you survive?

games.name: Unrailed 2: Back on Track
games.summary: Unrailed is back on track with more co-op railroad construction chaos! Choose your path in a new world packed with bold biomes and bosses. Permanently upgrade your character and engines, even create and share your own levels - just don‘t let your train derail!

games.name: Urban Jungle
games.summary: Turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your tiny apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet the cat!

games.name: Worldly: Country & Maps Quiz

games.summary: Roar, match, and blast through prehistoric marble mayhem!
0.5% is a hand-drawn black and white visual novel. It features two college students June and Tai. June's choices and discovery will uncover Tai's secrets.

games.name: 100 Railway Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️

games.name: Black Zen White
games.summary: Black Zen White is a puzzle platformer where the world flips every 10 seconds between two versions: black and white. Think, time your moves, bend time, and interact with strange creatures in this contemplative, hand-drawn journey inspired by East Asian ink paintings.

games.name: Block In
games.summary: Shoot, smack, RUN or metal pipe yourself out of endless waves of enemies. Level-up to unlock weapons, classes and perks to create the most bricked-up build. It's time to Block In!

games.name: Brainrot Autobattler
games.summary: Brainrot Autobattler is a chaotic roguelite auto-battler/autochess where you buy brainrot units, evolve them into stronger forms, trigger trait synergies, and survive a run full of shops, bosses, boons, and bad decisions.

games.summary: Pull up a chair at Gigi's table. Six classic card games — Setback, Hearts, Cribbage, No-Limit Hold'em, Spades, Euchre — wrapped in a cozy cocktail-lounge hub.

games.name: Cinescape VR
games.summary: CINESCAPE-VR is a virtual reality escape game where you must solve puzzles within film studio sets, using the power of Cinemorphosis – a unique ability that lets you transform the objects around you – to uncover the secrets of the Cinetech company.

games.name: Clown Camp
games.summary: First-Person Survival Horror, 90’s style. Hostile clowns lurk the woods. Fight-or-flight to uncover their gruesome secrets throughout a chilling Single-Player Story. Clever inventory management and resourcefulness are your only hopes to escape the Summer of 1999 alive.

games.name: Cozy Home Unpacking
games.summary: Make Every Room Feel Like Home.

games.name: Cradle of the Dark Brood
games.summary:
Cradle of the Dark Brood is a dark fantasy incremental breeding game about building power through inheritance, mutation, automation, and conquest.

You begin as something trapped outside the rules of the world, able to act only through the creatures you create. Breed new offspring, preserve stronger bloodlines, cull weaker results, and shape your brood into a force capable of surviving beyond the cradle.

Every generation can push your numbers higher. Improve core traits such as Lethality, Vitality, Durability, Motility, and Synapticity, then use those gains to unlock new systems, stronger roles, and more dangerous forms of progression.

games.name: Creepy Shift: House For Sale
games.summary: Handyman needed—ASAP! The investor’s coming in the morning, and the house still isn’t ready! Take on an extra shift where horror meets simulation. Tackle the chaos, uncover dark secrets, and finish everything before dawn.

games.name: Cursed House 16
games.summary: The Cursed House series returns with new gameplay mechanics and a rewarding bonus system. Explore a shadowy manor as you solve engaging Match-3 puzzles and unlock exciting bonuses. Uncover hidden secrets and banish evil spirits in this strategic puzzle adventure.

games.name: Deadhead Angel!
games.summary: Wander through broken realities with an angel stuck in your eye.

games.name: Don't Let It Starve
games.summary: A horror roguelike deckbuilder. You're trapped in a kitchen, forced to feed a half-chef monster that crawls through the vents. Don't let it starve.

games.name: Don’t Stop Smiling
games.summary: Smile—and survive. A first-person “forced-smile” horror game that tracks your facial expression in real time. PC camera required.

games.name: Driftland: The Magic Revival
games.summary:
Driftland: The Magic Revival is a unique real time strategy game, building both its mechanics and story around the innovative concept of manipulating fragments of a shattered planet - moving, terraforming and connecting them with bridges to achieve victory!

After a devastating war between ancient mages, Driftland has become a shattered planet, held together by a powerful spell. Take on the role of a mighty mage who is able to move and connect flying islands. Develop a great Empire and restore Driftland to its former glory!

Build your own magical empire in a real-time 4X strategy god game! Driftland: The Magic Revival officially announced for PC.

Inspired by hits like Civilization, Populus, Majesty, and The Settlers, Driftland: The Magic Revival is set in a beautiful fantasy world filled with scattered islands, and it is your task to expand your kingdom and bring them all together.

games.name: EA Sports UFC 6
games.summary: EA Sports UFC 6 is powered by fighters. Evolved striking and motion systems bring UFC stars to life in the Octagon, while new game modes introduce immersive storytelling that makes every fight feel personal. Square up and fight your fight.

games.name: Eggfish
games.summary: An Unstable Universe fishing game.

games.name: End of Starchild
games.summary: A beguiling first-person shooter with more to explore and exploit the further you sink in. You are Elph, and up until this very moment, you've been drifting aimlessly. A voice reaches out through the haze: "rise and shine." It's time to use your faculties to their fullest.

games.name: Escape the Marine Lab

games.name: Ex Change

On the day Nabi breaks up with her NEET, stay-at-home boyfriend, Trip, a freak accident causes them to swap bodies!

Trip (now in Nabi’s body), must now live the life of a girlboss career woman—perhaps this is also his chance to make Nabi (now in Trip’s body) fall in love with him again!

games.name: FeeBay Simulator
games.summary: Flip fake trading cards for real profit in FeeBay Simulator, a comedic marketplace tycoon game. Snipe underpriced cards from clueless and scammy sellers, grade your best pulls, crack open mystery lots, and run your own storefront to build a reselling empire.

games.name: Fire Lookout: Abandoned Post
games.summary: Fire Lookout: Abandoned Post is a first-person psychological horror and narrative-driven mystery game. Where you play as a newly stationed lookout in Summit Ridge National Park.

games.name: Fragments of Fear
games.summary: A VHS found-footage horror anthology where everyday chores become your worst nightmares. Experience a growing collection of bite-sized analog horror episodes, from a late-night trip to the laundromat to a terrifying walk home. Can you survive the mundane?

games.name: Frogborne
games.summary: A long way from the pond — but home is worth the leap.

games.name: Fuck's Quest II
games.summary: in this game u play as Fuck and u get to use crappy weapons and talk to horrible NPCs and find the bible crystals and explore my game and find secrets and play further to see what the next part of the game is

games.name: HaeTae: Guardians
games.summary: A challenging top-down fantasy action game set in mythological Joseon. Master precise dodging and synergy with the divine beast, Haetae, to purify the corruption. Forge your build and conquer the 'Chambers of Challenge'—where elite foes and unique rules await those seeking a true test of skill.

games.name: Hellbrella
games.summary: This is a fast-paced action roguelike where you are a Cat in a Raincoat fighting hordes of demons using an umbrella to survive!

games.name: Hexpand
games.summary: Real-time multiplayer strategy on the actual map of Earth. Spread hex territory across continents, capture cities for income, launch planes around the globe, and broker alliances you'll probably betray. 5–20 minute matches. The world is on the table.

games.name: Jolly and Whimsy
games.summary: 'Jolly & Whimsy' is a short, experimental picture-book style visual novel. When her best friend, Whimsy the cat, suddenly returns to the Cat Planet, Jolly will try any spell to bring him back.

games.name: Keepers of the Keep
games.summary: When a thief comes to The Keep, only to be captured and forced to work off their debt, they must now make a new life for themselves in a strange new town.

games.name: Kleopatra
games.summary: Kleopatra is a hybrid Visual Novel / Action RPG that combines a retro cyberpunk noir narrative with stat-based shooting gallery combat.

games.name: Lilies in the Graveyard
games.summary:
You are tasked with finding and eliminating an anomaly.
This task leads you to a small, remote village.
Then, in the graveyard, you meet a strange girl scattering ashes who introduces herself as Lily.
You make a deal.

games.name: Liminal 98
games.summary: Navigate four procedurally generated liminal spaces. Reach the exit. Beat your time. Something may be watching.

games.name: Little Kitty Meow
games.summary: Tiny Paws. Cosy Office Adventures.

games.name: Lobotomy
games.summary: James, a freelance journalist, breaks into the notorious "Lobotomy" asylum to expose decades of brutal experiments. Armed with a camera and flashlight, he must navigate the suffocating darkness. Record the truth, survive the shadows, and escape before the asylums dark history claims you next.

games.name: Magia y Demonios
games.summary:
Old-school isometric RPG game with some more modern concepts.

You must challenge the forces of evil by eliminating monsters in a world where evil expands. As evil increases, the difficulty of the game also increases.

games.name: Match! The 12 CZ Wars
games.summary: Match! The 12 CZ Wars is a roguelike strategy game blending match-3 and buff-building. Partner with 12 Zodiac Maidens to repel ancient primordial beasts. Navigate random events, battles, and upgrades. Carefully choose paths, manage resources, and empower your Maidens to secure victory.

games.name: Neverend
games.summary: First-person parkour. Run, fall, get back up. Chain wall-jumps and boosts to crush the times of other damned souls. No enemies—only time can judge you.

games.name: Norectus: Theatre of War
games.summary:
Norectus: Rebellion is a digital collectible card game set in a gritty world of five nations locked in a decades-long war.

Collect from 400+ cards across five nations and a Neutral faction, each built around six elements (Flame, Frost, Nature, Spirit, Ki, Neutral) and more than 35 keyword mechanics. Build nation-aligned decks and take them into a deep roster of modes:

Ranked & Casual PvP: 1v1 ladder, 2v2, and free-for-all
Cooperative: team up to take down Raid Bosses and a persistent server-wide World Boss
The Gauntlet: a 100-floor roguelike climb with stacking boons and mini-bosses, solo or in a co-op party
Throne: defend your seat against an endless challenger queue
Story Campaign: 45 chapters of nation lore with NPC dialogue and branching paths
Grind your way up the level track, master your chosen nation, and climb the ELO rankings. Earn cosmetics, season-pass rewards, and nation essence along the way, then relive your best matches with full replay scrubbing.

Pick your nation and win the war.

games.name: Pantomime Horse Obstacle Course
games.summary: Pantomime Horse Obstacle Course is a wacky, slapstick, co-op platformer. Grab a friend and two gamepads, and show off your teamwork - or drag your partner to the finish line (sometimes literally). Filled with chaotic levels and tough challenges for you to complete, get out there and break a leg!

games.name: Phone Flipper Simulator
games.summary: Run a second-hand phone shop, climb from slums to the top. Honest trade or dark paths? Convince customers, invest, take risks. Loan sharks, gambling, luxury stores... Every choice leads to a different ending.

games.name: Pitstop in Purgatory
games.summary: Astrid wakes up in Purgatory and has to make peace with her death. Only problem is... she doesn't remember anything! Point and click your way through adventure based gameplay mixed with visual novel storytelling, and solve the mystery of our heroine's untimely demise.

games.name: Pokémon Infinite Fusion 2: Hoenn
games.summary: The sequel to Pokémon Infinite Fusion, taking place in the Hoenn region.

games.name: Pyramid Quest Junior
games.summary: Exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games

games.name: R.E.G.O
games.summary: R.E.G.O is a first-person psychological horror and narrative investigation game. On an isolated farm, the nights reveal clues tied to disappearances and an ongoing police investigation. The deeper you investigate, the further you are drawn into a mystery that was never meant to be uncovered.

games.name: Reactor Critical
games.summary: High-stakes starship combat on a hex grid. Outmaneuver your enemies, unleash devastating firepower, or swarm their capital ships with fighter squadrons. Every decision counts.

games.name: Sakura Hime 6
games.summary: Step into this world where charming girls of all kinds long for your touch. Win their hearts one by one and embark on a soul-stirring journey through another world!

games.name: Seeing Double
games.summary: In this puzzle platformer, your screen is split down the middle. Control Pitter and Patter simultaneously as you jump, dash, and climb through two parallel realities in this atmospheric adventure on your quest to reunite them.

games.name: Silvarn
games.summary: Silvarn is a first-person psychological horror game set in a fog covered rural village. Players explore abandoned locations, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover fragmented memories while being pursued by an unseen threat. The game focuses on atmosphere, tension, and narrative-driven exploration rather than combat.

games.name: Skibidi
games.summary: SKIBIDI is a clicker game where you click on toilets! Click more on the toilet and get even more toilets!

games.name: Slice the Crops!
games.summary: Slice, earn, upgrade, repeat. Slice mutant fruits in an addicting incremental game! Annihilate armies of unique mutant crops, dive into a deep talent tree, unlock new levels, and research powerful fruit mutations to maximize your harvest and dominate the farm.

games.name: Space Pew Pew
games.summary: Aboard your ship, destroy the hordes of aliens attacking you by choosing your weapons and upgrades as you play, and defeat the final boss! In this Bullet Heaven Roguelite, each ship has a different weapon layout, giving each one its own unique playstyle. Then create your ship and develop your own strategy!

games.name: Super Farming Boy
games.summary: Your farm is under attack! Fly, harvest, grow crops & whack enemies with your shape-shifting one-button superpowers as you seek revenge from your evil nemesis, Korpo, who has captured your mom & friends! An action-puzzle farming sim featuring chain reactions and combos.

games.name: Survival Machine
games.summary: Build your base on a machine in a constant motion, travel through biomes with different resources, and prepare for the night when a zombie threat is much higher than during a day. Would you go solo or explore this new world with your best friends?

games.name: Teddy Roller 2
games.summary: Teddy is ready for another super-charged adventure. The bear will roll, jump, and leap through perilous maps on his trusted ball of yarn. Expect the unexpected while traversing over 90 unique stages. Fantastical and strange creatures stand in Teddy`s way as he sojourns to Teddy village.

games.name: Teeny Quests
games.summary: A browser-based isometric adventure game with an emphasis on the level editor. Each quest can have multiple ways to complete it.

games.name: Tell Me Owl
games.summary: Embark on an exciting journey in a top-down western shooter inspired by classic NES action games. Battle through handcrafted levels, buy abilities, upgrade weapons to face multi-phase bosses in a world where a man's best friend is his revolver.

games.name: Teller's Duty
games.summary: Teller’s Duty is a simulation game where players take on the role of a bank teller in a dystopian world. They must process transactions, verify documents, and detect fraud while navigating complex moral dilemmas that shape the story. Featuring a vintage paper-inspired aesthetic and a choice-driven narrative, the game challenges players to balance their duties with ethical decisions that impact their future

games.name: The Shu Legend
games.summary: The Shu Legend is an interactive adventure novel. In an apocalypse ruled by the Dog Clan, bandit Shi Jin is forced by a terrifying army to undertake a mysterious mission after his squad is wiped out. This quest unravels the clan's buried history, sparking a tense fight for survival...

games.name: The Sphere
games.summary: A grieving mechanic. A sphere that fell from the sky. A mystery that was never meant to be found. The Sphere is a short, atmospheric point & click adventure about loss, wonder, and the unknown.

games.name: Tome of the Damned
games.summary: Tome of the Damned is a dark top-down roguelike where a cursed mage fights for freedom. Defeat castle guards, enhance weapons and spells. Enchanted weapons, elemental grimoires, ruthless bosses. Die, adapt, try again.

games.name: Waterpark Manager Simulator
games.summary: Build your summer water park adventure!

games.name: Wet Wealth
games.summary: Casual casino slot + adult visual novel. Spin reels to collect items, finish quests, earn gold and crystals, and renovate a luxury penthouse. Upgrade girls to unlock new outfits, story chapters, and fully animated intimate scenes.

games.name: World of Claudecraft
games.summary: A classic-style micro-MMO: nine vanilla-flavored classes, real classic-era combat formulas, a hand-built quest world across three zones, 5-player elite dungeons, a ranked 1v1 arena, parties, trading and duels — on an authoritative server with persistent characters.

games.name: X-Force Genesis
games.summary: This game that brings back all the charm of shmup games from the 80s/90s. X-Force Genesis is a frantic and chaotic space shooter created from big and beautiful graphics with insane boss battles. Embark on epic battles and stop enemies from establishing a military base in orbit around X-planet

games.name: Xanthiom 2
games.summary: Play through the next chapter in the Xanthiom saga, now bigger and better than before!

games.name: Archery King
games.summary: Rule the Range.

games.name: Asphalt Dominion
games.summary: Power. Speed. Victory.

games.name: Birthday Visit
games.summary: What do you do when your child is visiting on their birthday that you totally forgot?! Microwave your child's birthday meal to perfection, navigate through tense conversations, and pay close attention to select a gift they'll love! Can you restore your relationship with your child? Or will you destroy what's left?

games.name: Bladefall
games.summary: BladeFall is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game featuring fluid melee combat, 2.5D movement, and challenging battles against varied enemies and powerful bosses. Master timing and skill-based attacks as you fight through an evolving system built to test your abilities.

games.name: Bounty Pro Pulling
games.summary: The first Truck and Tractor Pulling game! Customize your vehicle, name it, tune it, and hop online to compete against others in the most realistic Pulling game yet. Bounty Pro Pulling has in depth tuning, paintable vehicles, and online competitions to test yourself against pullers across the world.

games.name: DAL'T-4
games.summary: Whatever you do — don't press ALT and F4. No body. No memory. Just two keys: ALT and F4. You are a virus — and this PC is your hunting ground. Burrow into the system, devour programs, and corrupt everything in your path. Rule this digital world. Or be deleted trying.

games.name: Folklore Reloaded
games.summary: Nothing beats a few brewskis on a temperate summer evening while camping in northern Ontario, however a rustle in the bushes reveals an onslaught of monsters who seek to separate your beer from your hand! Respond the natural way by taking up arms and defending yourself from this travesty!

games.name: Garden Designer Simulator
games.summary: Turn forgotten gardens into cozy little paradises where every flower matters

games.name: Girl With Gun
games.summary: A dating simulator, but... The girl has a shotgun, and if she doesn't like how you answer her questions, you die. Your date takes place in a living, watching cave where every element of the environment actively reacts to your tension and tries to break you.

games.name: Minesweeper Pro
games.summary: The classic challenge lives on in a whole new form.

games.name: Pixel Hook
games.summary: Pixel Hook by Pixelbones — The free browser fishing game that talks back. Chase rare fish by tracking the fish, survive your angler's commentary, grind the global leaderboard, and reel in catches under dynamic day & night skies. No download required.

games.name: Retrowave Barro Crazy Drift
games.summary: Retrowave Barro Crazy Drift is a racing game with small cars and challenging tracks.

games.name: Reverse Dream of the Menasphere
games.summary: You live a peaceful life alongside your sister Mea, until a fateful meeting with a succubus leads to a life-changing quest you never expected.

games.name: Rina's Undercover Train Operation
games.summary: A rouge-lite simulation animated game where you play as Rina, a special investigator with psychic powers that aims to cut down crime rate on trains. Upgrade your skills, combine them, and take down your enemies before they get you! Oh, and have fun changing Rina's outfits too!

games.name: The Blackwood Project
games.summary: You're an agent investigating a distress signal, armed with your trusted flashlight and revolver. Creep through the horror infested darkness of Blackwood Manor to uncover its secrets. A Short and sweet game made by students over a 9 week period

games.name: The Towers
games.summary: Climb and Conquer

games.name: Third Walker
games.summary: Third Walker is a raw, experimental sci-fi first-person shooter (FPS) set inside a dying space station at the edge of known systems. Developed solo by Abrham Tekuam under Apex Nova Games in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, this early playable prototype focuses strictly on tight gunplay mechanics, tense atmospheric exploration, and emergent combat encounters. Currently in an active technical demonstration phase, the project allows players to engage in the Station Alpha arena to test weapon recoil and combat pacing, with the development roadmap driven directly by community feedback.

games.name: Ultimate Blacksmith Tycoon
games.summary: Run a blacksmith shop as a shopkeeper with a rare appraisal skill. Craft weapons and armor, sell to a shifting cast of customers, and dispatch adventurers into dungeons for loot. Manage a 28-day business loop with dynamic item rarity and a deep tech tree. A management sim blending crafting, shop-keeping, and a dispatch RPG layer. Now in Early Access.

games.name: Zero Clearance
games.summary:
You’re isolated in a building swarmed with hostile AI drones. Fight through and escape.

Realistic firearm handling is simulated. Pay attention to your weapon condition and master handling it quickly and correctly.

games.name: Beggar's Life
games.summary: You play as a beggar in an idle incremental game where you beg for food. Become a priest, a thief, a rat lover, or a sadistic pyromaniac. Textually explore a city during medieval times, complete with church politics. But first, could you spare some food?

games.name: Better Minesweeper
games.summary: A modern take on classic Minesweeper, focused on quality-of-life improvements, flexibility, and customization.

games.name: Caca Clicker
games.summary: The most absurd clicker on Steam! Click, produce, prestige, and dive into Corrupted Mode. Face bosses, challenge the casino, unlock 25 skins, 33 wallpapers, and dozens of achievements. A wacky universe for hundreds of hours of gameplay.

games.name: Ember Seeker
games.summary: An atmospheric exploration game set in a Dark Fantasy world. Explore the ruins of an ancient civilisation and uncover it's forgotten past through a short nonlinear story with timeless retro graphics.

games.name: Galaxian Wars: Alien Shooter
games.summary: A fast-paced, skill-based arcade space shooter heavily inspired by classic Galaxian-style games and running on a custom hybrid ZX Spectrum emulation engine. Featuring relentless waves of alien swarms in deterministic arcade combat where precision, reaction, and positioning are key. No upgrades, no grinding — only pure skill, mastery, and survival.

games.name: Kiou
games.summary: Welcome to Kiou. Test your skills against players from around the world in ranked matches, or face off against friends. A cast of charming characters welcomes you to the board, with AI move guidance for newcomers and a wide range of time controls for seasoned players. From your very first move to hard-fought battles, Kiou opens the door to shogi for players of every level.

games.name: Luna's Adventure: The Overlord
games.summary: A special friend to rescue. A final boss accessible from the start. A whole world to explore until you can defeat him. Risk your life to save the person most important to you in this fantasy adventure RPG in 3D and real-time combat.

games.name: Not a Customer
games.summary: Good job! you just got hired at your local grocery store and have to serve customer, it's simple as it sounds but theres a twist, make sure you serve real humans and not dopplegangers or it might be your last shift...

games.name: Pact of Steel
games.summary: A WW2 Tower Defense game, with minor aspects of an RTS game.

games.name: Saint George's Tavern
games.summary:
Hilarious tavern simulator set in the early 1800's. Take food and drinks orders, catch and cook the food, pour ales and serve. A cozy game that occasionally ramps up the pace for a short while with tavern fights, drinking games, arm wrestling, happy slaps and many more.
Decorate your tavern ready for Christmas and watch as a choir of chickens sing Christmas carols to entertain your customers.
Earn money, buy new items, hire a worker, and increase your tavern rating. The tavern with the highest rating in London will be hosting King George III for Christmas dinner - guaranteed to be an absolute spectacle!!

games.name: Sewer Call
games.summary: Sewer Call is an atmospheric indie horror game that plunges players into the dark, claustrophobic depths of an underground sewer system. Tasked with answering a mysterious call or investigating a sudden anomaly beneath the city, you must navigate a maze of damp tunnels. As you manage your limited resources and solve environmental puzzles to find a way out, you quickly realize you are not alone. Something dangerous lurks in the shadows, and every step could be your last.

games.name: Sneaky Bimbuls
games.summary: One team hides among a crowd of NPCs. The other has to figure out who's a player before the map gets sabotaged. A chaotic local party game for 2-8 players on a shared screen.

games.name: The Castle of the West
games.summary: A Fast-Paced, Fantasy-Themed, First-Person-Shooter in which you get a rapid-fire crossbow and take down hordes of classic fantasy monsters

games.name: Trauma Pets
games.summary:
Batticuore. What was once nothing more than one of many european islands turned touristic attractions after their practical use faded over time, with plenty of history and untouched natural scenery... now has been rid of any life form by a mysterious curse. The only survivor? An eccentric fisherwoman that goes by the name of Martha Mahkklen.

Not only that! The waters surrounding Batticuore have been repopulated by a new race of creatures, the Trauma Pets! Bloodthirsty animals that have seemingly no other desire than to cause chaos and destruction, which is hardly worth concern for us humans since they're tiny acquatic creatures.

While scientists continue to research their bizarre biological makeup and behaviour, the common people have began to use them for sports in all sorts of competitions, both peaceful and violent. Now that's where you step in, not to stop this senseless abuse, but to be the very best at it.

games.name: Wordnerd 3D
games.summary: Wordnerd 3D is a mobile word game where players take turns placing their tiles on a 3-dimensional board. Words can be played in any direction, which leads to many possibilites for scoring points.

games.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in London
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in London in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

2-0 is a web-based basketball simulation game that challenges players to build an all-time NBA roster capable of going undefeated across an 82-game season. Players choose legendary basketball players, construct a lineup, and receive a simulated win-loss result based on the game’s roster evaluation system.

games.name: A Day to Remember
games.summary: Play as aino, she has secret feelings for her childhood friend name Rain, can she possibly confess her feelings to rain before the day ends or will it be to late and will she lose her childhood friend Rain forever?

games.name: Alaric
games.summary: Boomershooter meets Metroidvania. Fight like hell and defeat the evil king. Explore a giant castle full of secrets.

games.name: Animal Times
games.summary: Command animal armies and conquer territories in this turn-based strategy game where every attack can backfire! Master blunder-style combat, where failed strikes let defenders capture your lands. Bold moves win big in this high-stakes battle for cunning victory.

games.name: Autotelic
games.summary: One may use an array of tools and items to complete obstacle courses, and one may also talk to various characters to amass useless information.

games.name: Beauties and the Stranded
games.summary: You wake up in a bunker, surrounded by five stunning women. But something doesnt add up. Their beauty feels out of place in this desolate ruin. Their strength and cryptic clues make you question everything. Will you capture them, trust them, or love them? The choice is yours!

games.name: Birdie Blitz
games.summary:
A golf game where you need to birdie each hole in order to make it to the next course on the Campaign.
Play against your friends and find out who can get the lowest score across a 9 hole golf course.

games.name: BlackJack Math
games.summary: BlackJack Math is a game about mixing the cards to match the correct formula in order to get 21 as a result. Swap the cards in order to find the correct order to solve the puzzles.

games.name: Break The Chain
games.summary:
Break the Chain is a physics-based puzzle game where every step matters.
You are bound together — and your only goal is to escape.

games.name: Broken Crown
games.summary:
Broken Crown is a fantasy real-time strategy game built for players who miss the depth and intensity of classic RTS titles — reimagined with modern systems and large-scale battles.

Build your base, gather resources, recruit armies, and command your forces in battles where formations, positioning, and decision-making truly matter.

In a world shattered after the fall of the Crown, factions rise from the ashes.
Only those who master economy, technology, and battlefield control will survive.

games.name: Cat Chases Mouse
games.summary: Cat Chases Mouse is a simple arcade chase game where you control a hungry cat navigating a grid in search of mice. Eat mice to increase your score, avoid crashing into walls or your own tail, and watch out for special rats that grant bonus points. With colorful visuals, classic snake-inspired gameplay, touch controls for mobile devices, and endless score chasing, Cat Chases Mouse offers a fun experience suitable for players of all ages.

games.name: College Quest
games.summary: College Quest is a retro-style point-and-click adventure inspired by classic Sierra and LucasArts games. Set in a 1990s art college, players navigate classes, friendships, campus life, and bizarre situations while solving puzzles and managing their academic performance. Featuring hand-crafted pixel art, humor, multiple endings, and numerous optional activities, College Quest continues the story begun in School Quest.

games.name: Crococo
games.summary: An urban legend says there are alligators living in the sewers of New York. Go down there and see for yourself. A 90s-style comedy horror game featuring classic single-voice VHS dubbing.

games.name: Eldara
games.summary: Eldara is a single-player dark fantasy idle RPG inspired by classic MMORPGs. Train 17 interlocking skills — mining, smithing, fishing, combat, cultivating and more — to hunt monsters across the realm, raid dungeons, and challenge three mythic world bosses. Collect over 100 unique items, complete dozens of achievements, and tame 16 wild pets. Progress continues whether you play actively or step away, with rebirth and prestige systems for the endgame.

games.name: Elemental Run
games.summary: Elemental Run is a first-person 3D endless runner. Navigate through increasingly dense traffic and survive as long as possible. By jumping, sliding, and using skills at the right moments, you clear obstacles and spend collected coins on upgrades to push further each run.

games.name: Ferrum
games.summary:
FERRUM is a award winning, student developed, 10 week Souls-like Boss Fighting prototype made for a university course.

"Enter a world dominated by ruin and brutality, where humanity has achieved biological immortality, at the cost of their humanity. These creatures are fused together with iron components, trying to stop the stop the spread of rampant mutations. As societies fell and civilizations ceased, as people lost control, the only goal left was to get energy for another day, at any cost."

Play as an amalgamation trying to survive, and consume your way up a Sun cult mountain, and assimilate the leader.

games.name: Idle Knight
games.summary: Idle Knight turns every click, keystroke, and controller input into XP. Level up your warrior, build your stats, fight in ranked duels, conquer dungeons, join guilds, and crush seasonal events all from your desktop.

games.name: Jungle Shoot
games.summary: Enter an unforgiving forest where every second counts. Fight waves of enemies in a frantic platformer based on precision, movement, and constant progression. Jump between platforms, dodge deadly attacks, collect coins, and unlock powerful upgrades as the chaos intensifies around you.

games.name: Last Kid on the Bus
games.summary:
This game is inspired (a total rip off) of the popular mobile game Granny.

Figure out how to escape by using equipment scattered around the school while the bus driver is lurking with his sledgy hammy hammer.

Q to drop objects.

This game was made in 1 week.

games.name: Lumeera and the Glow Reefs
games.summary: Save the reef in a magical underwater interactive storybook!

games.name: Mini Lucy
games.summary: Mini Lucy is a 3D platforming adventure where players take control of Lucy, a young girl who has mysteriously been shrunk to only a few centimeters tall after discovering a strange green crystal.

games.name: MixCD
games.summary: MixCD - This Games Industry Darling of an A.I. Powered Driving SIM is Sooooo Amazing, it plays itself!

games.name: MOLE
games.summary: Voices of the dead are calling you from deep below the earth. Pilot the Mole, a Soviet drilling vessel, in this PSX-style simulator-horror game set during the waning days of the cold war.

games.name: Morbus
games.summary: Morbus is a psychological horror steeped in the terror of the unknown. Amnesia veils the truth, while ghosts guide you through a warped hellscape of the mind. Yet the more you remember, the closer you drift toward oblivion. The ending is inevitable. Who are you, really?

games.name: Oil.exe
games.summary: Drill the wells. Run the refinery. Read the market. OIL is a free text-based simulation of running a petroleum operation, played at a 1980s green-phosphor terminal. End each year richer or bankrupt. Mind the bear market. Climb the leaderboard.

games.name: Pickupbal
games.summary: A simple game all about picking up a ball.

games.name: Pro Cycling Manager 26
games.summary: Dive into the heart of cycling management with an ever more realistic simulation. From recruitment and staff, to season planning and race strategy, make every decision and lead your team to victory in the sport’s biggest competitions.

games.name: Rock, Paper, Scissors, Shoot!
games.summary: A hand-drawn roguelite duel where rock-paper-scissors becomes a streak-based gamble. Win money, buy upgrades, face bizarre opponents, and unlock SHOOT when luck turns ugly.

games.name: Seal of Shadows
games.summary: Shatter the darkness in this 3-player co-op ARPG. Master 3 unique classes, loot epic gear, and battle through a 20+ hour hand-crafted campaign. Inspired by classics like Shadows of Mystara—grab a controller and forge your legend in Banesmeire today!

games.name: Songtail: Whiskers of Destiny
games.summary: A cozy pixel art rhythm game blending light investigation and performance. Explore charming fantasy locations, uncover hidden details, and prepare your song before taking the stage, where every note you play influences how the moment is remembered.

games.name: Stream plays Gustav
games.summary:
Chat controls the character.
The streamer tries to help.

It’s both teamwork and sabotage at the same time.

games.name: Tales of Wakana
games.summary: "Tales of Wakana" is a thrilling action-adventure game like Galaxy Castlevania. Explore a mysterious and challenging world, battling monsters using magical skills. Uncover the true meaning of life, family bonds, and self-knowledge for an enlightening experience.

games.name: The Apothecary Diaries Palace Chronicles
games.summary: The Apothecary Diaries Palace Chronicles is a free-to-play browser-based character-raising simulation set in the world of the anime The Apothecary Diaries. Players raise Maomao, a young apothecary, and solve stage-based incidents within the imperial palace and pleasure district by combining apothecary knowledge with item compounding. The game features the original Medical Office facility system, over thirty-five characters from the source series with exclusive newly drawn illustrations, and full multilingual support across Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese and Korean.

games.name: Till The Light
games.summary: You work the night shift at a mysterious convenience store that's anything, but normal, however others say otherwise making you question whether or not you're really the sane one here. Each night after your shift you meet with a guide-like entity in your dreams, helping you slowly uncover the truth surrounding the store, the world you live in, and most importantly who you really are...

games.name: Tilt It! Golf
games.summary: Mini-golf with a twist, all for the price of a coffee! Tilt the entire golf course to guide your ball into the hole, dodge tricky obstacles, and beat the clock to earn star ratings across 300 progressively challenging courses.

games.name: Unconventional Broadcasting Department Mika & Luna
games.summary: In a modern world of humans and demons, energetic Mika and sharp-tongued Luna are trapped on Earth with a 500 million debt! This free visual novel has ongoing anime-style updates. Join their hilarious adventures and uncover the mysterious otherworld's truth!

games.name: You Within Me
games.summary: Indie single-player 2D narrative-driven yandere horror game with hide-and-seek and puzzle-solving mechanisms, as well as multiple endings. After unknowingly and unintentionally gaining the romantic attention of an unhinged individual, will you survive, or will you be... consumed?

games.name: 101 Cats in Munich
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Munich landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

games.name: 101 Cats in Sydney
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Sydney landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

games.name: 8 Ball by Pokerist
games.summary: Play the most realistic pool game with amazing graphics! Play for free with millions of players from all over the world!

games.name: Again: Loop
games.summary: Find anomalies hidden within a repeating hallway. Miss one, or make the wrong choice, and everything resets back to the beginning.

games.name: Atelier's Key
games.summary: Atelier's Key is a dark-fantasy FPS set in a root-bound Victorian world inhabited by puppets. Severed from a hivemind and armed with a mysterious weapon; shoot, grapple, and unlock your way through this world to save a Father from his own damned creation.

games.name: Auto Shop Simulator
games.summary: Ready to become the ultimate car tycoon?

games.name: Barbie: Horse Ride & Rescue
games.summary: Start your Western horse riding adventure with Barbie at Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch. Rescue and rehabilitate charming horses, test your riding skills and customize your style as you uncover the mysteries of Moonrise Valley!

games.name: Block Story
games.summary: There isn’t much better than a wide open game world in which you have essentially no limits and can alter the very landscape in which you play – that is, unless you add dragons, of course…

games.name: Car Guys
games.summary: Experience the thrill of Car Guys, a high-octane multiplayer racing game! Represent your nation, compete in explosive races, and climb the global leaderboard. Customize your ride, engage in daily and weekly championships, and enjoy seamless online play with Photon Quantum. Join the race today!

games.name: City Car Driving 2.0
games.summary: City Car Driving 2.0 is a driving simulator designed to help novice drivers master driving in a setting as close to reality as possible.

games.name: Copa City
games.summary: Organize high-stakes football events in the first football tycoon! Get the urban space and the stadium ready, ensure safety, and provide fans with an amazing football fiesta! But stay alert: Your decisions will not only influence the city but also the emotional rollercoaster for football fans!

games.name: Darkness Has Eyes
games.summary: Survive the dark in this tense atmospheric horror game. Face your fears and explore abandoned floors while searching for key items to escape the dark.

games.name: Daughter of the Rift
games.summary: Daughter of the Rift is story-rich card-battling adventure with a unique deck-building progression system.

games.name: Demeo x Dungeons & Dragons: Battlemarked
games.summary: A cooperative tactical RPG set in the D&D universe. Embark on a fantasy tabletop adventure. Your quest, on your schedule.

games.name: Do You Really Know About Soccer?
games.summary: Climb the Tower and Prove You Know Soccer

games.name: DreamRace
games.summary: DreamRace is a high-speed arcade racing runner where you blast through 30 levels across six unique worlds.

games.name: Fight or Flight
games.summary: Survival Horror Battle Royale, You are a specially trained operative that will drop into the virus infected region and attempt to recover research and eradicate any of the infected that remain. Features game modes, "Extraction" (Monster Hunting), "Battle Royale" and "Drop Zone".

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood & Gears
games.summary:
"The past has a voice and its calling you home."

"You hoped you'd never have to return to this place of sorrow, but after 20 years, something has called you back."

Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood & Gears is a complete reimagining of Scott Cawthon's original *Five Nights at Freddy's* game. The game is directed by JDBRYANT and is created by Bloody Fungi, a passionate team of over 30 people.

games.name: Gitaroo Man
games.summary: A port of Gitaroo Man, a rhythm video game featuring visual production by Mitsuru Nakamura and an original soundtrack by Japanese band COIL, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Gobbo Quest Idle
games.summary: Help Gobbo escape a mysterious cave, grow stronger, collect pets, fight strange bosses, fish, farm, mine, craft, upgrade gear, and continue the adventure in an endless fantasy world.

games.name: Grid Tactics: Duel
games.summary: Grid Tactics: Duel is a competitive card game built on an 8×8 grid. Every move is about positioning, timing, and resource trade-offs. With limited resources, choose when and where to play—set up or apply pressure. Each placement reshapes the board. Win through deckbuilding and precise execution.

games.name: Heartlight PC
games.summary: Heartlight PC (1994) for the Playdate console. Heartlight is a grid puzzle of falling rocks and dig-and-collect: dig through grass, push rocks, dodge falling hazards and bombs, and collect every heart to open the exit, then step through it to clear the cave.

games.name: Icaria
games.summary: Automate a team of robots to gather resources, scale up production, reshape terrain, and expand your colony on a procedurally generated alien world.

games.name: Infinium
games.summary: Discover a new adventure with every playthrough in this unique fantasy RPG. Every choice matters as you uncover what secrets Infinium is hiding. Will you become a daring adventurer or a rich mogul?

games.name: Junkster
games.summary: Junkster is a 3D action platformer with an awesome building mechanic. Plucky, little construction bot, UM-13 has crash-landed on a dangerous junkyard planet. Armed only with his trusty robo-wrench, Um must find the parts to repair his ship and recover his lost cargo of precious human artifacts.

games.name: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth Expansion
games.summary:
A new era is born in the action-packed Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth Expansion.

Delve into a game expanding narrative inspired by the dramatic events of Jurassic World Rebirth. Take control of three top-secret locations, and come face to face with four new dinosaurs, including the terrifying Distortus rex!

games.name: Karting4Fun
games.summary: Have some fun with friends on one computer or online! Enter a race full of adrenaline and fast turns. Hitting and pushing are allowed! There are tracks in the open air or the halls.

games.name: Knee Slide
games.summary: A short time attack game where you race across rainbow courses in outer space by knee sliding. Master drifting and turbo while avoiding falling off the course to achieve the fastest time possible. The game features 5 stages designed for quick play sessions and repeated attempts.

games.name: Liminal Escape
games.summary: Liminal Escape is a Backrooms co-op survival horror game for up to 4 players, where you and your friends will fight to escape from the unsettling, endless depths of Liminal space.

games.name: Meowtabolism: Examining Feline Behavior Within Unicellular Algae
games.summary: Explore the interior of an algal cell on your four paws. Built with experimental data and populated with actual protein structures, Meowtabolism offers a glimpse of the vast world inside the basic functional unit of life.

games.name: Merge Hidden
games.summary: An innovative hidden-object game where every treasure is split in two! Find both halves in beautifully crafted scenes, then merge them to solve the puzzle. Five unique themed scenes with brain-opening combinations like straw hat + snowman, shield + sword. Simple to learn, endless challenges await!

games.name: Nacho Chihuahua: The Movie - The Game
games.summary: Join Nacho as he pursues his true destiny: to return to his homeland, South of the Border!

games.name: Obscuris
games.summary: Co-op horror for 1–6 players set in modern Japan. Play as Japanese high school girls, explore eerie locations (some procedurally generated), collect Obscure at night, meet deadly quotas, and escape before dawn. Customize your character. Story mode not yet available.

games.name: Oliver's Last Run
games.summary: Oliver’s Last Run is a Hotline Miami-style top-down pixel art action game created as a tribute to Oliver Tree.

games.name: Poker Matrix
games.summary: In this turn-based poker strategy game, you and the AI take turns selecting five adjacent cards from the board, forming poker hands to determine the winner and earn chips. Convert your chips into points round by round to unlock more game modes!

games.name: RF Online Next
games.summary:
RF Online: NEXT, and Beyond
A grand space opera unfolding over eons against the backdrop of a vast universe.
In the next era, where machines have replaced flesh and blood, and the struggle for survival has become a way of life...
The saga of heroes, each forging their own path through a universe in chaos, begins now.
RF Online Next: the official successor carrying on the legacy of RF Online, beloved by 20 million players worldwide.
Join the battlefield now, on a scale unlike anything before.

games.name: Serious Carnage: Adrenaline Shooter
games.summary: Built for pure adrenaline

games.name: The Magic Master
games.summary: A soulslike inspired game with a magic-only, long-range combat system. Defeat unique bosses along a linear path and unlock new spells.

games.name: The Magic School
games.summary: Join Lumi and friends on a magical floating adventure about friendship, courage and finding your inner strength!

games.name: The Office: Dirty Secrets
games.summary: Power. Desire. Secrets. The Office : Dirty Affairs is an adult game with multiple choice routes and endings. Navigate office politics, forbidden relationships and dangerous choices in this branching visual novel.

games.name: Total Driftin': Touge Dreams
games.summary: Master each corner, burn rubber, and become a legend high in the Japanese mountains. Total Driftin': Touge Dreams is a tribute to classic '90s drifting, with precise physics, retro aesthetics, and a cult-like soul. Do you have what it takes to become a touge god?

games.name: Trail & Error
games.summary: A chaotic co-op survival game for 1–8 players where you travel the trail, manage supplies, survive disasters, and argue with friends. Work together to keep the wagon moving, adapt to random events, and try to make it to the end in one piece.

games.name: Vibe or Dare
games.summary: MoodTrue: Vibe or Dare is a party card game where friends reveal truths, complete dares, vote on outcomes, and compete for the strongest vibe in the room.

games.name: Weekend Solitaire: Summer Village
games.summary: It's time to take on Solitaire Challenge. Pass the game's several stages. Conquer challenging card configurations and take on a big, vibrant game with several levels of varying difficulties. Overcome challenges, create combinations, and get bonuses.

games.name: Weekend Solitaire: Voyage
games.summary: Embark on a Serene Journey with Weekend Solitaire Voyage!

games.name: What Have You Done, Father?
games.summary: An atrocious scandal threatens the Catholic Church when the lifeless body of a woman is discovered in the rectory of a young priest.

games.name: And Roger
games.summary: It was a morning like all others, until she realized her dad wasn't home. In his place, a stranger who speaks nonsense and insists she "takes her medicine". Who is he? Where is dad?

games.name: Backrooms Lost Runners
games.summary: Backrooms: Lost Runners is a co-op survival horror game where teamwork, voice-reactive AI, and immersive puzzles merge. Explore unsettling liminal spaces, outsmart cunning entities, and dive into a deeply interactive story—remember, even your whispers can betray you.

games.name: Beat the Markets
games.summary: Beat The Markets is a turn-based digital board game based on investing in the stock market. Play with 2 - 6 players in this competitive financially based game inspired by 80s style board games and family game night. Players will buy investments and sell them to gain capital and sabotage their opponents with cards. Play is based on dice rolling and cards. The winner of the game is the player with the most cash on hand when the markets close at the end of the month.

games.name: Bee Streamer Idler
games.summary: Bee Streamer Idler is an interactive desktop overlay for streamers! Engage your chatters by turning them into bees that work together to gather pollen and build honeycombs! Use chat commands to control your bee and see how much honey can you collect together!

games.name: Bind
games.summary: BIND is a slow-paced metaphysical puzzle journey set in the liminal realm between death and rebirth.

games.name: Burger Bots Inc.
games.summary: An online co-op burger flipping game with scary and strange customers that you shouldn't anger. Play either solo or up to group of 8!

games.name: Caged In Concrete
games.summary: A student made platformer game about a lost individual looking for a better life. They must make their way through a brutal city while facing manifestations of their thoughts and feelings on their journey to escape the city. The game features a platforming and puzzle system that rewards the players death by giving them moveable box they can position or push enemies with.

games.name: Cowboy Busy: Mowdown
games.summary: Saddle up, partner. Dodge hordes, level up active/passive skills, fuse them into devastating Super Skills. Wield knives, turrets, or railguns. Every run (10 min) is a new roguelite build. Die? Respawn. Evolve. Survive the zombie apocalypse.

games.name: Date Math
games.summary:
A dating simulator where the player will be able to romance all kinds of mathematical concepts, ranging from basic algebra to topology.
Features over 25 concepts to date and multiple endings!

games.name: Drug Dealer Simulator 2
games.summary: What turns a person into a drug dealer? A drug dealer into a drug lord? Find out in DDS2, a first-person sim set in a dynamic open world. Make contacts, cook drugs, and manage your cartel on Isla Sombra, where power is the only law.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Pac-Man
games.summary: The timeless masterpiece that has taken the world by storm is here! Eating all Pac-Dots while dodging the ghosts!

games.name: Get The Ball Away!
games.summary: Get The Ball Away! Is a game where you have to get a blue ball away from the red balls, if you touch any of the red balls you fail.

games.name: Ghosts Keep Out
games.summary: Defend your base in this Roguelite survival shooter TD! Mix random skills + evolve gems to craft your Build. 5-min fast rounds, intense zombie & ghost hordes. Triple progression: Spirits, guns, heroes. Easy to learn, hard to put down. Low barrier, high ceiling. Every run is fresh!

games.name: Glimvale: My Mini Overworld
games.summary: Manage and customize your little fantasy village, make your adventurers happy with cute and varied shops and decorate their environment as you please. After all, you are the master of the game !

games.name: Gloria Victis
games.summary: Gloria Victis is a low fantasy Medieval MMORPG with an emphasis on realism. What does this mean? Open PvP with territory control, non-target combat, sandbox crafting, player-driven economy and no fireballs. All served up with a deep, mature story.

games.name: GoblinAmerica
games.summary: goblinAmerica is a squirmy, bouncy shooting game filled with lovely sights and horrible places. Careen across the planet, blast yourself to new heights, and discover the dark tunnels and deep places of a world beneath our own.

games.name: God For A Day
games.summary: In this 2D, narrative-based simulation game, you play as the Son of God. Your mission: Decide, bless or condemn city residents. Uncover the person's story through their items and secrets before making decisions. Your choices alter the city's destiny, and impact your revelation on Judgment Day.

games.name: Going Once!
games.summary: Going Once! is a cozy art gallery / auction house management game. Appraise and buy art, display it in your gallery and auction it off to the highest bidder!

games.name: Grand Vegas Casino
games.summary: Become a gambling master without the financial risk as you test your skills in the world's most popular casino games!

games.name: HeartCore Descent
games.summary:
Fly to the center of the planet to destroy its core!

HeartCore Descent is a simple yet challenging 2D Precision Platformer Indie game, where you control a rocketship through various terrains. The goal is to fly through all levels, and reach the heart core at the center of the planet.

There are 5 Chapters, each with a different theme. Each chapter has 5 levels, so 25 levels total, each level progressively getting harder. When you crash, you restart at the beginning of the level. If you close the game mid-chapter, you need to play the chapter over again.

This game is incredibly hardcore (heartcore), so good luck! (You'll need it.)

games.name: Incremental Ragebait
games.summary: Nodebuster inspired, relaxing, incremental game. Hover on mortals to ragebait them and take their souls. Buy new weapons. Unlock upgrades. Build a purgatory. Ragebait god.

games.name: Invisible Opus
games.summary: A game for SOUPJAM2026 created by Caim Luna in RPGmaker VX Ace.

games.name: Juno and Hope Destroy Capitalism
games.summary: A quick visual novel about hungry lesbians who destroy the American economic system after going to a burger joint.

games.name: Komu
games.summary: Komu is a live multiplayer party game built around community-versus-community competition. Two streamer audiences face off in real time across a rotating catalogue of mini-games spanning chaos arenas, racing, and trivia, with crowd participation mechanics that let viewers influence the action rather than only watch.

games.name: Kooeh: A Timeless Delight
games.summary: Kooeh: A Timeless Delight is a heartwarming cosy narrative-driven restaurant management game about rediscovering lost family recipes and reviving the family restaurant.

games.name: Melon Clicker
games.summary: Click the melon to accumulate points. Ideal for short breaks or unwinding.

games.name: MuteX+
games.summary: MuteX+ is a challenging hack-and-slash inspired by the flash game Amorphous+. It focuses on tackling enemies that can merge mid-fight while mastering a fluid moveset with an unconventional control scheme.

games.name: Myth Requiem
games.summary: Myth Requiem is a mythology RPG with idle and auto-battle mechanics. Lead legendary heroes like Ulysses and Sun Wukong, explore ancient realms, and build a living bestiary by capturing, battling, and cataloging hundreds of legendary creatures in a story-driven quest for divine power.

games.name: Null Horizon
games.summary: Survive the void in Null Hørizøn. Trade, fight, and explore a retro-futuristic 3D galaxy with 2D sprites. Upgrade your ship, smuggle goods, and travel across the universe. Tactical Real-Time combat meets Grid-based exploration in this atmospheric space sim. The Null Hørizøn calls, Captain.

games.name: Pornographer
games.summary: Pornographer is, first and foremost, an interactive FILM. A film where you can influence what happens on screen. The dark and absurd humor will definitely leave no one indifferent.

games.name: Pppoker
games.summary: PPPoker-Hold'em,Omaha Poker App,Global Battle,Home Games,Play Poker With Friends

games.name: Prologue: Go Wayback!
games.summary: Prologue: Go Wayback! is a single-player open-world emergent survival roguelike where every journey is unique. Traverse a new wilderness that is generated for you every time you play. Chart your path, overcome the elements, and write your own story of exploration.

games.name: Slipspace Panic
games.summary: A trip through slipspace gone awry. Shoot and evade waves of attackers for your freedom in this twin-stick shooter micro-game!

games.name: Strozowka
games.summary: Operate the gate, let the cars in, and make sure the generator doesn’t die before dawn. People park here because it's cheap, but it’s their fuel that keeps your generator running. No cars means no fuel. No fuel means total darkness and trust me, you don’t want to be here when the lights go out.

games.name: The Last Salvage Squad
games.summary: Battle enemy forces reminiscent of alien weapons from retro sci-fi works in this single-player 2.5D FPS.

games.name: The Scroll of Taiwu
games.summary: "The Scroll of Taiwu" is an indie game themed around Chinese mythology and wuxia. Players assume the role of the mysterious "heir of the Taiwu clan" in an alternate ancient China, working through generations of heirs to defeat a powerful hereditary enemy and shape the fate of the human world.

games.name: The Seven Days I Spent With You
games.summary: With the enigmatic girl who imprisoned you――seven days in an unfamiliar room.

games.name: Total Simp Death
games.summary: You're a waifu just trying to get by, eating burgers to get thicker. The simps keep coming but you have your trusty rocket launcher.

games.name: Whisper of the House
games.summary: What's happening in this seemingly peaceful town? Strange residents, bizarre incidents, and unexpected storylines! Please be sure to let go of all your human lifestyle preferences and strive to meet the special requests of your otherworldly employers. Decorate this house with peculiar furniture!

games.name: #Drive Rally
games.summary: Drive Rally lets you relive the 90s in the most exciting era in motorsport history, where dust, mud, and snow are badges of honor. Unleash the raw power of legendary rally beasts, admire every second of the stunning landscapes, and remember: the faster you go, the better!

games.summary: Angels Online Global is a charming 2D fantasy MMORPG featuring flexible builds, faction warfare, and deep customization. Enjoy 4× leveling, expanded inventory, real-time chat translation, and dungeon-earned outfits with fusion upgrades!

games.summary: You are the Monarch. Protect your rule and your kingdom. Pursue the heart of your chosen lover, manage fragile alliances, or bring the world to heel, no matter the cost, in this character-driven interactive tale. The choice, and the crown, are yours.

games.name: Astrophidia
games.summary: Astronomical Tips:

games.name: Backrooms: Escape Together
games.summary: A visually lifelike 1-6 player co-op survival horror made in Unreal Engine 5. Explore procedurally generated levels that host liminal environments, puzzles, and entities with new levels and content added regularly. You are at the mercy of what's lurking and must do whatever it takes to escape.

games.name: Backrooms: The Void
games.summary: Backrooms: The Void is a cooperative psychological horror game for 14 players. Trapped in an endless emptiness where space feels alive and reality constantly distorts, you must navigate decaying corridors, forgotten places, and impossible structures while something unseen follows your every move.

games.name: Bakso Simulator 2
games.summary: The Sequel to Bakso Simulator with new gameplay, areas, characters, and more!

games.name: Barbecue
games.summary: Barbecue is a co-op party game where 1 to 4 players manage a backyard BBQ that spirals into total chaos. Light the fire, grill the meat, serve the guests, and try not to burn everything down.

games.name: Baron Misanthrope
games.summary: A short 1-2 hour denpa visual novel about a man of dubious sanity and his mysterious top hat-wearing companion.

games.name: Bloons TD 6
games.summary: Bloons TD 6 is a tower defense game in which players place various monkey towers along a path to pop waves of balloons ("Bloons") before they reach the exit. The sixth entry in the Bloons Tower Defense series, it features 3D graphics viewed from a bird's-eye perspective and introduces Hero units that level up over time. Towers have three upgrade paths with a maximum of five tiers each, allowing for varied strategic builds. The game supports solo play and up to four-player co-op, and includes Boss Events, Paragon upgrades, and paid expansions adding roguelike and story-driven modes.

games.name: Building 0: Hakuei University
games.summary: I'm a second-year university student in a paranormal club facing disbandment. In a desperate bid for survival, I sneak into the mysterious "Building Zero" — a place campus whispers warn you never to approach. What awaited me there was a terror beyond anything I'd ever encountered.

games.name: BunnyBakery
games.summary: Play as a little bunny running a cute bakery — bake and sell all kinds of sweets like cupcakes, donuts, pancakes, banana splits, and more!

games.summary: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!

games.name: Color-A-Cube
