games.summary: ORCSOFT’s surreal summer buddy comedy VN about two painfully available best friends, their crush-worthy moms, and the awkwardly inconvenient feelings that surface—sometimes when we least expect them...

games.name: Laira Cut Me Open
games.summary: Laira Cut Me Open is a 2D interactive story about a woman's fear and hatred. Find the perpetrator who cut you open, stole part of your body, locked you up in a psych ward, and snatched your husband, money and job. When she shows her face, you're gonna return the favor.

games.name: Lanesplit
games.summary: Push performance bikes to the absolute limit, and weave through traffic where one wrong move can spell disaster.

games.name: Last Dive: Echo Trench
games.summary: Descend from the fragile safety of your diving bell into a dark shipwreck zone, search for sunken gold, survive escalating anomalies, and uncover what keeps pulling you back.

games.name: Layer Land
games.summary: Layerland is a sandbox survival game set in a world that mirrors Earth’s terrain. Travel through gates, capture monsters as pets, and team up to battle, gather, craft, and build.

games.name: Limby
games.summary: LIMBY is a twisted puzzle platformer. Play as Limby, a frat bro turned zombie. Traverse through 30 absurd and brain scrambling levels. Use your severed limbs to reach new heights and unlock new pathways to achieve your ultimate goal: Devour. The. Nerd.

games.name: Lone Voyage
games.summary: You are the last living organism in the galaxy. Adrift and alone in a cold dark world you must scavenge for resources to keep your ship running, and arm your ship to prepare for the swarms arrival.

games.name: Loser Got Isekai’d: Sex, Side Jobs, and Odd Tasks
games.summary: The official sequel returns—more unrestrained than ever. In a city consumed by desire, seven unique heroines await your “hands-on” help. Build your squad with 3×3 tactical formations, character evolution, and gear upgrades. Raise affection to unlock exclusive story events and 21 fully animated H-CGs

games.name: Lumina Veil
games.summary: Lumina Veil, a horror game with a modern twist! Step into the shoes of a popular streamer on a journey into a strange new game. As you dive deeper, you'll find yourself escaping the isolation of your own world, only to discover that the lines between fantasy and reality are beginning to blur.

games.name: MAGE
games.summary: An action-packed 2D projectile fighter inspired by controller couch party classics. Players can master one of 21 unique Mages across over 200 maps with only 3 buttons. The large range of gamemodes and modifiers combined with the Mages and maps creates an environment of uniquely chaotic combat.

games.name: Magic War Legends
games.summary: Magic War Legends is a tactical, turn-based strategy RPG that brings classic army-building and hex-grid exploration adventures to mobile platforms. Players collect powerful heroes, master ancient arcane magic, explore custom campaign maps, and build armies consisting of mythical creatures like dragons, minotaurs, and undead warriors to conquer enemies and secure their kingdom.

games.name: Maple Ridge
games.summary: After losing his wife in an accident, Alex is left alone in a suburban house where every little detail reminds him of the past. An ordinary evening quickly turns into a series of strange and unsettling events.

games.name: Mendel Simulator
games.summary: Welcome to Mendel Simulator: Flower crossbreeding, a game that blends relaxing simulation with the authentic science of plant genetics. Become a master breeder in your own private greenhouse, where every bloom tells a story of inheritance.

games.name: Meshuda
games.summary: Meshuda is the retro style 2D adventure game and it's adopted simple command battle. Choose from three command in the battle --ATTACK, EVADE, SPECIAL SKILL-- . You fight as Aziga village's warrior, Meshuda, to save your village.

games.name: Mine Empire
games.summary: In Mine Empire, start with basic mining and expand by gathering resources, upgrading equipment, and deploying machines for full automation. Blast through deep mineral veins with explosives, unlock rebirth upgrades and advanced technology, and build your own powerful mine empire.

games.name: Mini Murder Mysteries
games.summary: Solve cozy, crafty whodunits. Puzzle your way through nine unique investigations – and use your noggin to make intelligent deductions. Explore the evidence, scrutinize statements, and connect the dots.

games.name: Moldwasher
games.summary: Clean moldy messes as a brave food hero! Equip your high-pressure spray, choose the right nozzle, and clear away sticky messes in this cozy, arcade-style fridge-cleaning adventure.

games.name: Moonrise
games.summary: Moonrise is a third-person 3D puzzle-adventrure, where open-path level design and visuals take centre stage, demanding a different reading of the space at every turn.

games.name: Mythic Love: Iberian Legends
games.summary: Think you can handle a little romance with creatures from Spanish folklore? Careful: your love life isn’t the only thing at stake at Mythic Love: Iberian Legends.

games.name: Mythic Manager
games.summary:
Mythic Manager is a fantasy guild management simulator where players recruit, train, and develop a roster of heroes across long-term seasons. Players make decisions around party composition, progression, resources, and strategy as their guild takes on dungeons, raids, and arena tournaments.

Built around roster building and management rather than direct combat control, the game focuses on planning, specialization, and adapting to the strengths and weaknesses of each guild member. Success comes from developing the right team, making difficult cuts, and preparing the guild for increasingly demanding challenges.

games.name: Neko-Mimi Sweet Housemates Vol. 2
games.summary: Mint and her friends return in Neko-Mimi Sweet Housemates 2! In order to save her family, a girl will defy fate itself and become the personification of miracles...

games.name: Nestify
games.summary: Nestify is a cozy sandbox room design and decorating game where you draw layouts, furnish interiors, and customize objects by adjusting colors, lighting, scale, and rotation. Create a relaxing atmosphere with music, weather, and scenic views. Chill and build your own nest.

games.name: Night Duty Log: A Shōwa School Record
games.summary: A short psychological horror set in a Japanese school during the Shōwa era. At night in the school, you begin to realize that you are not alone. As you investigate classrooms and hallways, you notice strange occurrences. Your choices shape the story, leading to multiple endings.

games.name: Ninja Cat Remewstered
games.summary:
You have nine lives. Make them count.

Ninja Cat Remewstered is a challenging fast-paced platformer where a lone cat seeks to prove himself to the big bosses of the world. Starting with only shuriken on hand, he will find tools throughout his journey, laying claim to gold while he's at it!

...But stay aware! There are a variety of relentless enemies and hazards that will stand between him and his goals.

games.name: Nodwar
games.summary: Nodwar is a Real Time Strategy game based in the browser.

games.name: Northeast Past
games.summary: Immersed in the turbulent "Tohoku" underworld epic of the 1980s, "Northeast Past" is a real-life interactive video game that combines hardcore underworld survival rules with multi-branching narratives, taking you to experience the underworld and get involved in the bloody fate of gang disputes.

games.name: Notebook Workshop
games.summary: Manage your own cute notebook shop. Create unique designs in your workshop. Carefully package orders and make your customers happy with distinctive designs. Grow your small shop and become one of the most beloved notebook stores.

games.name: One Last Box
games.summary: One Last Box is a short indie first-person horror game. You have just been hired as a package sorter for a mysterious company. Examine boxes based on clues, decide whether to accept or return them, but be aware... you are not completely alone here.

games.name: Operation: Black Genesis - The Immortal Trials
games.summary: top-down co-op survival horror game where players deploy into deadly Quarantined Zones, fight mutated experiments, and extract with everything you can carry—because if you die, you lose it all.

games.name: Orb of Creation
games.summary: A magic theme incremental about creating everything from nothing.

games.name: Our Dreadling
games.summary: Step into the world of our little pink dreadling on its mission to uncover the enigmatic Monono. Our Dreadling is a minimalist platformer with Metroidvania-inspired exploration, delivering a unique blend of humor, storytelling, and surreal environments.

games.name: Paper Paws
games.summary: Paper Paws a cozy card collecting game about kittens! Scratch, clean, laminate and collect all the cats in your album. Can you collect them all?

games.name: Patchkins Party
games.summary: Patchkins is a multiplayer racing game for 2 to 6 players where you build the course as you play. Each round, players draw and place objects like Platforms, Obstacles, and Specials, then race to the finish without dying.

games.name: Pixelords
games.summary: Pixelords is a 2D pixel art autobattler where victory is decided before battle begins. Build a squad from 10 elements and 35 units, place them freely on a gridless battlefield, and enjoy solo campaign, 4-player co-op Trials, and real-time PvP.

games.name: Postin Paradise
games.summary: Chill, relax... and stamp! Postin Paradise is a satisfactory incremental game where you work as post office manager. Grab the mail, stamp it, throw it into the hole, collect your coins, and repeat. At night, when your shift ends, you can buy upgrades to improve your performance. Stamp 'em all!

games.name: Potter About
games.summary: This side scrolling platformer lets you explore a beautiful, cozy home as a well-worn flower pot. Navigate through the clustered rooms and wield peculiar, plant-inspired powers on this comfy, meditative adventure.

games.name: Prism Wilds
games.summary: You wake up on a beautiful island, with no memory of how you got there. Stranded, you and 6 strangers must survive, explore, and make this island your home all while uncovering that mystery. Farm, fish, build a home, decorate, form relationships, and uncover the truth hidden in the mountains.

games.name: Project: Firmament
games.summary: Project: Firmament is a top-down horde shooter where you blast through missions using a unique aiming system that puts quick-minded positioning, map knowledge, and loadout planning as the main contributors to your success.

games.name: Public Fears: George's Farm
games.summary: Felix Turner is forced out of the police force by mysterious forces. His friend George urges him to seek refuge at his remote farmhouse. In search of peace, Felix has no idea what awaits him…

games.name: Quadrix
games.summary: Rule the board with chaotic card synergies in a high-tempo block-placement roguelite. Bend physics, reverse board collapses, and chain game-breaking combos. Dominate online PvP, Co-op, and a 100-level Campaign. Draw your cards. Break the game.

games.name: Raccoon Packer
games.summary: Mischievous raccoons bring you the weirdest items to pack. Fit everything perfectly, add the right stickers, then ship it off. A cozy, satisfying packing experience with a touch of chaos.

games.name: Rally TS
games.summary: Rally TS - The Ultimate Auto Simulator Experience Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in TS Rally, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street car and rise to the global championship glory.

games.name: Raze
games.summary: Raze is an action roguelike based on randomization. Destroy thousands or tens of thousands of enemies in a single run, adapt to random events, and survive through to your cat reflexes. There are no easy paths here, and no room for mistakes.

games.name: Recess
games.summary: A chaotic multiplayer party game where childhood playground games turn into all-out competition. Tag, hide, chase, and outplay your friends across imaginative maps all before the bell rings.

games.name: Relief
games.summary: Relief is a deckbuilding roguelike featuring a post-Journey to the West urban legend setting! In a bizarre world of corrupted deities, harness overpowered tech to enhance your deck and forge custom affixes onto your cards. Combine over 1,000 cards and 300 artifacts to create your ultimate OP build!

games.name: Rewound
games.summary: Rewound is a first-person VR narrative exploration game where players experience the world through the eyes of a black cat, using object interaction and time-rewinding mechanics to explore the fading memories of a novelist living with Alzheimers disease.

games.name: Rift Wizard 3
games.summary: Rift Wizard is a hardcore combat strategy roguelike and wizard simulator featuring an extremely deep build system. Customize your Wizard with more than 500 spells and magical artifacts. Blast, summon, or enchant your way through 20 levels of pure turn based chaos.

games.name: Rogue Mate
games.summary: A roguelite chess RPG where your pieces evolve beyond the board. Unlock branching skill trees, recruit and build your warband, then battle through ten handcrafted boss encounters, each with unique mechanics designed to dismantle your strategy.

games.name: Runeveil
games.summary:
Runeveil is a roguelike deckbuilder where your strategy isn't just about what you play, but how you sequence it. Step into the shoes of powerful 7 Elemental Mages and travel through various Arenas. Your goal: Complete the 7 Kings' Trials of the 7 Unique Arena, and survive the escalating chaos.

Unlike traditional card games, where you play one card at a time, in Runeveil, you are the architect of your own turn.

games.name: Scientific Project: Optic
games.summary: Welcome to the thrilling world of 'Scientific project: Optic'! This immersive first-person puzzle game invites you on a journey through the realm of optical science, from its philosophical origins to modern understanding.

games.name: SCP: Mr. Jupiter
games.summary: A first-person SCP horror adventure where you survive a catastrophic containment breach, explore a collapsing facility, and evade the mysterious Mr. Jupiter.

games.name: Scratch Off!
games.summary: Scratch cards meet roguelike. Build a deck, collect coins, and scratch your way to rent. Every run is different. Every scratch matters.

games.name: Shatterhold
games.summary: Idle survivor meets shared world. Your Hold produces resources 24/7. Your expeditions push back a fracturing reality. 25 regions. 8,000 zones. One world. Every player matters. Success and failure is shared by your entire region.

games.name: Shed
games.summary: Flush your friends. Burn the deck. SHED everything. SHED is a competitive card-shedding game where your goal is simple: get rid of everything before your opponents do.

games.name: Sixth Force
games.summary: A family-friendly action adventure for two players full of humor and heartfelt insights. Play together as a father and son trapped by hallucinating AI in secret neural network. Explore all ever-existing types of co-op and discover emerging combos! May the Sixth Force be with you!

games.name: Sloop
games.summary: A fast-paced, sea-faring, adventure where you’ll have to learn to turn. Brave the waters!

games.name: Sludge Department
games.summary: A murky point-and-click puzzle game where a straightforward repair job gets stranger the deeper you go. Solve 2D and 3D puzzles, meet weird characters, and figure out what is happening below the sludge.

games.name: Soccerboy vs. Aliens
games.summary: Play as Soccerboy, a plucky little soccer fanatic in this 2D action, puzzle platformer. Honing your ball skills, you must take on an alien invasion to save the galaxy and your soccer idol Bro-naldo, in this fun take on the platforming genre.

games.name: Sovereign's End
games.summary: Feel invincible. Until you're not. A 3D space survivor-like with deep build-crafting, auto-firing abilities, and one Sovereign at the end of every run. Few will reach it.

games.name: Stamp Collector
games.summary: Stamp Collector is a relaxing and satisfying collection simulation. Use stamp punchers to punch collection objects and add the resulting stamps to your collection. Discover new themes and gradually expand your collection step by step.

games.name: Stealth Operative Syn: Virtual Training
games.summary: Synthia “Syn” is training to become a Stealth Operative. In order to do so, she trains in the Virtual Simulation Room. Use different tactics and techniques to sneak past the guards and obstacles. Finish every level to complete your virtual training!

games.name: Stuck Together
games.summary: A co-op climbing game about two stuck-together toys on an escape mission from their evil owner. Failure is always one slip away.

games.name: SubPrime Delivery
games.summary: Drag & Drop Various Action Blocks to Guide The Robot to The End of The Level!

games.name: Synergy Strike
games.summary: Arcade game where you play as triangles that dash strike enemies. Enter the flow state to climb global leaderboards while earning massive combos. Up to 4 friends can join in synergy with couch co-op team mode. Unlock prizes using your precision, poise, and persistence as 2D colorful combat ignites.

games.name: TetraPlinko
games.summary: Tetra-Plinko is a high-energy physics puzzler that collides two classic arcade games! Drop blocks strategically to navigate a peg-filled board, unleash massive multiplier combos, and watch the chaos unfold. Rack up points in this addictive, fast-paced mashup of strategy and gravity!

games.name: The Bone Crypt
games.summary: Steam’s first PvP Domino Deckbuilder! Connect pips on bone tiles to chain attacks and outsmart enemies in a tactical roguelike tomb. Master a deep solo campaign or crush rivals in online PvP. No cards, just pure bone-clinking strategy. Do you have the marrow to escape the crypt?

games.name: The Grid
games.summary: Four original puzzle games — words, logic, and patterns — wrapped in a single elegant arcade package.

games.name: The Light That Binds Us
games.summary: Dive into The Light That Binds Us, a puzzle-adventure game where light shapes reality. Play as Yuè, a tormented soul, accompanied by her faithful protector, Yún. Cast shadows into paths, reshape the world to solve puzzles, explore breathtaking environments, and uncover the past that binds you!

games.name: The Miki Komori Project
games.summary:
Before the streams…
Before the audience…
Before anyone knew her name…

there was Miki.

Enter a surreal visual novel exploring the hidden lore behind TheMikiKomori, the mysterious angel shark VTuber drifting between loneliness, memory, and the endless pull of the digital sea.

This is the story before the streams, before the audience, and before the name “TheMikiKomori” ever existed. Follow Miki as she navigates loneliness, identity, and the strange events that slowly guide her toward an uncertain future.

Uncover hidden secrets, forge emotional connections, and piece together the origins of a girl who was never meant to be found.

games.name: The Puppet's Casket
games.summary: The Puppet's Casket is a 2D puzzle adventure set in a mysterious Victorian manor. Navigate among eerie marionettes, solve intricate puzzles, and gather clues to seize the artificial eye and uncover the truth behind the Thorn family's tragic downfall.

games.name: The Queens Gondola
games.summary: Stuck on the Queen’s royal aircraft, you have been trapped in a mystical loop fueled by dark magic. Armed with nothing but your wits, keep an eye out for anomalies, and you might just find an escape.

games.name: Tiny Cats vs Toys
games.summary: Timy Cats vs Toys is a hidden object game – the player's task is to find the kittens, free the trapped cats, and eliminate the warlike toys.

games.name: Tow Truck Police Simulator
games.summary: Command the fleet that keeps the city moving.

games.name: Triston
games.summary: Help survey towns using your trusty Tetromino surveying kit, and a deck of cards.

games.name: Truck Simulator Driver 2026
games.summary: Control the road ahead

games.name: Venture
games.summary: Two astronauts awaken on an alien planet. With only minutes of oxygen left, they must work together to scale staggering cliffs, study strange lifeforms, and search for a way home in this atmospheric co-op survival adventure.

games.name: Voltage High Society
games.summary: Punch, evolve, escape! This cyberpunk FPS Metroidvania pits you against horrific cyber-monstrosities as you master deadly abilities to break free from the derelict prison island of Nemo Ultra.

games.name: Wanderstop
games.summary: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes Wanderstop, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.

games.name: Wave 43
games.summary: Capture fish. Grow stronger. Break the ocean. Build insane combos and climb the leaderboard.

games.name: Where the Hell Am I?
games.summary: Where The Hell Am I? is an atmospheric first-person exploration game. Its diverse locations draw you into an unknown world where every shadow hides a story and every step deepens the mystery. Uncover the truth behind the mystery that started it all. Are you ready to get lost in different realities?

games.name: Witchworker
games.summary: A true spellcasting magic simulator

games.name: Wyldernook
games.summary: Choose your champion. Predict, then outwit. Every move resolves simultaneously in a charming storybook universe. Wyldernook is a free-to-play trading card game with roguelike campaign, 1v1 and multiplayer PvP, and a custom card creator.

games.name: Aces of Avalon
games.summary: Soar into 2334! Pilot cutting-edge jets in intense aerial dogfights against alien invaders. Upgrade your fighter with credits to dominate the skies.

games.name: Aleryos
games.summary: Aleryos is a free-to-play multiplayer 4X strategy game played in a web browser. Players build and specialize a galactic empire through resource production, research, colonization, exploration, espionage, diplomacy and warfare. They design and personalize custom ship models to create unique fleet compositions based on their strategy, fight both in space and on planetary surfaces through the Pillars, join alliances with shared technologies and bonuses, and take part in PvP, PvE and recurring competitions. When enabled, Galactic Catch-up reduces costs and completion times for empires behind the leaders, helping newcomers join an established universe. Aleryos is available in 20 content languages across 25 locale variants.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Moon Shuttle
games.summary:
Moon Shuttle is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1981.

Players can enjoy alternating stages in which they destroy or dodge through groups of meteors to reach the goal, and stages in which they defeat enemies with wave motion cannons.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Tekken
games.summary:
A port of Tekken – a 3D fighting game originally released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994 – released as part of the Arcade Archives 2 series.

It was one of the earliest 3D-animated fighting games, incorporating many of the concepts from Sega's Virtua Fighter. Unlike traditional fighting games that require inputting commands as rapidly and accurately as possible, Tekken slows the action down by emphasizing rhythm, strategy, and deception over speed.

games.name: Aura Farming
games.summary: Aura Farming is an incremental tower-climbing game where you play as an immortal warrior, rescue allies, and grow your Aura to reach the top and save the princess.

games.name: Axiom of Echoes: Proof Refactor
games.summary: Axiom Of Echoes: Proof Refactor is a story-rich logic puzzle game where you build mathematical rules to reconstruct 2D and 3D memory fragments, solving precise spatial puzzles as a cold sci-fi mystery unfolds.

games.name: B-Run
games.summary: b-Run is an immersive exploration FPS with a bodycam perspective. Navigate the rubble of an isolated environment with an advanced tactile experience on PC.

games.name: Bartender Life Simulator
games.summary: What is a bar owner to you? A manager? A bartender? An interior designer? A psychologist? And what if you had to take on all these roles? Interact with customers, manage supplies, craft cocktails, and redesign the interior to earn the title of the best bar.

games.name: Battle Food Mania
games.summary: Food fights hit the streets! Battle Food Mania is a fast-paced, action game packed with humor and chaos. Play as pizza, cupcakes, bottles and more as you battle to deliver the box - or stop the delivery! Run, shoot and blast your rivals in wild food wars, play solo or with friends.

games.name: Beatlow
games.summary: A fast-paced rhythm game where every mistake costs a life. Hit the right keys in time with the music, survive escalating mutators, upgrade your skills, and push your run as far as possible.

games.name: Blood Welkin
games.summary: Shoot, smash, and eviscerate abominations in BLOOD WELKIN - an FPS roguelite with dozens of unique kit-building items and a gripping story for you to discover. YOU. ARE. NOT. CRAZY.

games.name: Blosharper: Battle of Blossoms
games.summary: Blosharper is a roguelike deckbuilder that twists the rules of traditional Korean Hwatu. Don't rely on luckuse illicit "cheat" skills to manipulate the deck and survive a deadly underground gambling den. Pay off your crushing debt, defeat ruthless bosses, and become the ultimate sharp!

games.name: Bouncy Ball
games.summary: Your goal: hit the red button with the ball! Each click teleports the ball across the screen, jumping between all four corners. Time your clicks, control the movement, and land every shot.

games.name: Core.Sys
games.summary: Break in, retrieve highly protected data and get out clean in a fast-paced hacking simulation!

games.name: Corelith
games.summary: Corelith is a wave-based roguelike top-down action game. Explore the Corelith Dungeon, craft Skill Cores, and create your own unique build.

games.name: Cryptoria
games.summary: Cryptoria is a 2D pixel dungeon crawler where every step and every coin is a decision. Greed is punished. Hesitation can be fatal.

games.name: Deep in The Mine
games.summary: In a fantastic universe, form a group of up to 5 dwarves. Choose a class then set off on an adventure in mines. Be careful, one of you will have become a monster, born to hunt you. Your goal is to extract materials there. Survive by working as a team but also using many gameplay features

games.name: Don't Knife Me!
games.summary: Don't Knife Me! is a funny knife-throwing game. Throw knives at the target and hope that you hit it. You'll be laughing by the end of the game!

games.name: Dorm Janitor's Revenge
games.summary: Experience an old-school RPG in a female-dominated slice-of-life setting. Live the life of a broke and humiliated janitor living in a girls' dormitory. Interact with the ladies, explore various kinks, exploit, and make choices that lead to your prime goal or an entirely different ending.

games.name: EagleRoad: WorldRise
games.summary: This is an open world 3D gunfight game based on the law of the jungle, which emphasizes the survival of the fittest. It is also a mission centered combat game based on experience leveling. It combines elements of role-playing, tactical strategy, and experience leveling.

games.name: Ellixir's Dream
games.summary: Ellixir's Dream is a single-player otome adventure where players, as an alchemist’s daughter, uncover their origins through choices and shape their fate with multiple endings.

games.name: Empulse
games.summary: Empulse is a fast-paced 6v6 movement shooter where movement is the weapon. Outmove and outgun your opponents across the post-utopian streets of Freehold, chain wall-runs into grapple swings into mid-air kills, and fight for Crews to control mechs for the ultimate power spike.

games.name: Extreme Racing Line
games.summary: A fast minimalist top-down racer where you push tight lines, skim the edge of the track, and chase faster lap times on fully visible single-screen circuits.

games.name: Flux Heroes
games.summary: Flux Heroes is a side-scrolling beat ’em up focused on high-freedom combo combat. Fight through horizontal stages and boss battles with no fixed strings—launch, juggle, knock back, interrupt, and wall-bounce enemies to create your own skill-driven flow.

games.name: Fortune Fragments
games.summary: In Fortune Fragments, you run your own shop as a ‘Foreteller' and guide your customers' fates by reading their souls! Sink in the unique blend of Visual Novel roleplaying and hex-tile based rune building set in the bustling modern-fantasy city of Clearcastle.

games.name: Forward Assault
games.summary:
A first-person shooter with tactical gameplay, become the leader of a swat team, and get ready take down killers, terrorist and international criminals. High-quality graphics, and fast-paced shooting action game play.

Several guns, shotguns, snipers, rifles, assault rifles and more powerful weapons you can choose from. Choose your side you can be with the good cops and combat terroirs attacks or international criminal actions from happening, or you can become the criminal try to make the world burn. Fight as the counter terrorist S.A.W.T CT team or the terrorist mafia leader and plant bomb.

games.name: Full Metal Coffin
games.summary: A 4 person multiplayer game that has you and your friends man a submarine through treacherous waters. navigate your way though underwater trenches and try to survive the onslaught of dangerous as you scout and plan your way ahead repairing your vessel and using sonar to help guide you.

games.name: Guessed It!
games.summary: Guessed It! is an online party trivia game where players race to guess songs and movies from progressively easier clues. Each round begins with a harder clue and becomes easier as the round continues, rewarding players who guess early with more points. The game includes Music Mode, Movie Mode, local pass and play, online rooms, live scoring, custom filters by decade and genre, explicit content controls, and multiplayer rooms where friends can join from their own devices.

games.name: Hangin' Off!
games.summary: Lean deep into corners, race against the clock, and battle rival riders in a retro-inspired arcade motorcycle racing experience where every corner asks you the same question: do you brake, or do you believe?

games.name: Haven Restored
games.summary: A cozy restoration simulator focused purely on cleaning and tidying - no money, no timers, just calm, satisfying transformation.

games.name: Heavenly Island
games.summary: Welcome to the once-every-few-centuries “Seeder Festival,” held on a secluded island shrouded in mystery! You’ve been chosen to become the “Great Seeder,” the fertility god of a mysterious, remote island. Gather the 17 “Golden Balls” and gain the favor of the island’s God!

games.name: Hell Forest
games.summary: Hell Forest is a digital board game. In Hellwood, you take on the role of a strategic commander, leading a magnificent, non-violent war. With limited resources, you will use your wisdom to claim victory in one region after another.

games.name: Hexara
games.summary: Rotate hex tiles, create powerful combos, and chase high scores in this fast-paced puzzle game. Simple to learn, hard to master, with endless replayability and global leaderboards.

games.name: Idle Keep
games.summary:
Wyverns have stolen the Kingdom's Light! Rebuild the Keep, grow stronger and gear up to defeat the Wyvern Queen and restore magic to the Kingdom.

Idle Keep is an Casual Idle game where you set your own path to defeat the mighty Wyvern Queen - best played as a second monitor game!

games.name: Jump Duck
games.summary: Jump and duck the shots to survive. Don't blink! Test and train your reflexes and timing. A modern remake of the Xbox 360 Indy game Jump Duck. Inspired by Twisted System from Fuzion Frenzy.

games.name: Kill Loop
games.summary: Ricochet! Destroy! Accelerate! This is a minimalist, high-speed action game. Dive into an endless loop of ricochets and destruction, and experience the pure thrill of the kill in a minimalist world!

games.name: Kokutoto
games.summary: Beyond Good and Evil: What Will You Choose in This Ambiguity? KOKUTOTO is a multi-ending adventure game that questions the realm beyond good and evil. Its compact length lets you experience the bleak aspects of modern society and make nerve-wracking scenario choices. What ending will you reach?

games.name: Let's Aim! Crane Game
games.summary: The hugely popular crane game series is back and better than ever! Aim, grab, and hook your prizes! Master a variety of crane arms and win tons of prizes!

games.name: LetMeSee
games.summary: A collection of fun and relaxing puzzle games.

games.name: Lost In The Store
games.summary:
A Short Horror Game where your mom left you alone at the register, what will you do?
Try to survive and find a way back to go to the real world.

games.name: Make it Meme
games.summary: Make it Meme is the free party game, about creating and rating memes: Each player gets a random meme and has to think of a text for the meme within a given time. After that, the players rate each other's memes and award their Meme Buddy. Whoever has collected the most points at the end wins!

games.name: Mini AirHockey
games.summary: Turn your undocked Steam Deck into a Mini AirHockey table for two. -- Mini AirHockey can only be played on an undocked Steam Deck.

games.name: Mini Raid Leader
games.summary: Mini Raid Leader is a single-player Action RTS, in which you command an ever-growing party of heroes to take down powerful bosses.

games.name: Mitako Tatari’s Cursed Village Stream ZP
games.summary: Horror game styled like a livestream

games.name: Myriad Realms
games.summary: Rare pure single-player retro 2D side-scroller on Steam. Recreates classic MMO golden-era vibe, no pay-to-win, no IAPs, no forced social. Enjoy pure, stress-relieving fun of slaying monsters, hunting loot, and free exploration.

games.name: Nights at the Convenience Store
games.summary: Nights at the Convenience Store is a first-person horror simulation game where you work the night shift at a 24/7 store. Scan groceries, restock shelves, take out the trash — and try not to think too hard about what's lurking in the back.

games.name: Orbosis Gloriosis
games.summary: A physics-based incremental game where you split and merge orbs

games.name: Pedals in Panic
games.summary: Pedals in Panic is a small physics-based bike game where you control each pedal separately, steer with the mouse, jump over obstacles, and survive chaotic procedurally generated platforms.

games.name: Quack Quack Up
games.summary: A voice-controlled party game that will have you and your friends screaming until you pass out! Drop the controller and use your vocal cords to herd a flock of ducks to the finish line—or watch them all yeet off a cliff because someone yelled a bit too loud!

games.name: Rakete
games.summary: Every button is a thruster. The rest is physics. Land your rocket without crashing. Play solo, or put a friend on each thruster and watch teamwork turn to chaos.

games.name: Rat Protocol
games.summary: Escape dangerous labs as a mutated rodent in a pushing puzzle adventure about twisted experiments!

games.name: Redline JDM Drift
games.summary: Experience stylish JDM drifting with online multiplayer, smooth handling, and striking visuals. Drive legendary-inspired cars, score massive drift combos, explore the roads solo or with friends, and rise as the next Drift King.

games.name: Rhythmic Retro Racer
games.summary: Rhythmic Retro Racer is an 3d arcade racing game where you can drive classic sport cars in a neon illuminated world with fantastic art style... Retro Racer mostly offer rhytmic based gameplay including unique synth wave soundtrack, and additionaly time challenge and free ride levels, all together with 80's retro world!

games.name: Rogue 21
games.summary: The House always wins... unless you rewrite the code. In this blackjack-based roguelike card game, you don't just play the hand you break the system. Stack illegal exploits, distort probability, and bankrupt the Gamble-State. Hit. Stand. Exploit. Survive.

games.name: S.A.N.D.Y.: Beach Cleaner
games.summary: This is a cozy, narrative and dark game in which you clean oil off the beach, sort out trash and rescue animals. Relaxing cleanup in a post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: Scriver: A Word Game
games.summary: In this word-crafting roguelike deckbuilder, you buy, sell, and arrange art in your gallery strategically to build synergies and impress the colorful cast of characters. Every piece of art, gift shop item, and critic can drastically change the course of each run.

games.name: Slice To Meet You
games.summary: A cozy idle incremental game about the satisfying rhythm of chopping ingredients. Unlock new produce, upgrade your knives, and grow your earnings — all at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

games.name: Sphere TD
games.summary: Sphere TD is an RPG tower defense game that combines strategic base defense with deep tower and projectile customization. Players build and upgrade towers, modify projectile behavior through a wide range of systems, and progress through handcrafted stages, endless mode, and a large world map. The game emphasizes experimentation, long-term progression, and replayability through its buildcraft, resource management, and progression systems.

games.name: Spirimonz
games.summary: Spirimonz is a game in which you hunt down evil spirits and capture various ghostly companions who will help you and follow you on every new mission.

games.name: Station Nexus
games.summary: A survey vessel bound for a destination 96,000 km away. While investigating a destroyed spacecraft, you encounter an unexplained spatial anomaly. Manage power and resources to continue your journey, and uncover the truth behind a phenomenon that is slowly consuming reality itself.

games.name: Strangeland
games.summary: A point-and-click adventure game set in a morbid, otherworldly carnival. Caught in the maze of your own mind, find hope hidden among the horrors.

games.name: Succubus Successor: Delilah's Juicy Journey
games.summary: Succubus Successor is a seductive-themed Metroidvania. Play as a succubus on a mission to hunt down the demon lord. Use your powers of seduction to charm enemies and engage in intimate encounters. Explore a vast world and solve tricky puzzles to uncover dark secrets.

games.name: The Last (Hotdog) Stand
games.summary: Run your own hotdog stand in this fast-paced food management game! Take orders, make dogs, and keep customers happy as you work to grow your hotdog empire, and restore hotdogs to their former glory. Upgrade your stand, unlock new ingredients, and expand to bigger, busier locations!

games.name: The Necromancer's Tale
games.summary: A story-rich gothic RPG. Master the rituals of an ancient spellbook. Raise an undead army to march against your enemies. Commune with the realm of the dead & struggle with your descent into madness. Progress through secrecy, diplomacy, blackmail, coercion & seduction until ready to reveal yourself.

games.name: Trashy Cashy
games.summary: A small incremental game about building a business by selling trash. You become a partner in the mysterious "Trashy Cashy" franchise. Extract trash from packages and ship it off for sale. Ask fewer questions. Enjoy outrageous profits. Sounds simple, right?

games.name: Virtual Perspective
games.summary: Virtual Perspective is a first-person puzzle-action platformer where you manipulate Power Cells using your perspective to solve spatial challenges.

games.name: Wobbly Heist
games.summary: Take control of three capybaras infiltrating a fashion event in this stealth puzzle game. Stack under a disguise to blend in among humans, split up to solve puzzles, avoid suspicion, and steal a legendary jewel. But be careful: one wrong move could reveal what’s really under the coat!

games.name: 123 Early Learning Games for Kids, Toddlers, Babies: Language
games.summary: Early learning numbers from 1 to 20 for kids. Count, listen, and say them aloud. Made for toddlers and preschoolers. Including first math and fun games.

games.name: 7 Nights with Vroombi
games.summary: Play as Vroombi, a brave little robo-vacuum who needs to keep Lily's house nice and clean! Clean away dust, dirt and debris in this satisfying twist on an interactive cleaning simulator. What awaits little Vroombi at night? What is Lily scared of?

games.name: Abyssus
games.summary: Gather your friends and dive into Abyssus' fast-paced multiplayer shooting action. Fight through gorgeous hand-crafted levels in a roguelite adventure that will put your tactical skills to the ultimate test. Wield powerful brine-powered weapons and refit them with ancient technologies to gain an edge over your foes. Obtain divine blessings to enhance your firepower with elemental and mystic effects.

games.name: All one click
games.summary: Prove yourself against thousands of enemies in seemingly endless waves. Upgrade your skills from fighting with an ordinary bow up to casting powerful magic spells. "All one click" is an Action-RPG that reduces player input to the most existing part of every RPG: the level-up.

games.name: Baff B
games.summary: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

games.name: Blood Park
games.summary: A first-person VHS horror game where forgotten tapes lead you through abandoned locations, terrifying creatures, and a hidden nightmare.

games.name: Boxpast Lov3you
games.summary: Inspired by the true global virus outbreak of 2000. Play as BOXPAST, a forgotten defense program awakened as a familiar PC. Forge weapons from computer parts and fight to stop the mad AI "evolution" of the very father who created you, before all of humanity is permanently purged.

games.name: Bring The Rift
games.summary: Bring the Rift is a competitive color-matching puzzle game that blends frantic strategy with visual novel-style storytelling. Master unique abilities to warp reality, launch attacks against rivals, and unravel the mystery of the portals in story mode, or enjoy local multiplayer.

games.name: Can You Make the Cut? Worldwide Common Sense Check
games.summary:
Could you hold your own anywhere in the world?
The global common sense every grown-up should know.

games.name: Captain Soda
games.summary: Captain Soda is a charming soda-themed arcade arena shooter about refreshing chemical warfare. Wield weaponized soft drinks to defend earth from waves of invading aliens!

games.name: Catto's Post Office
games.summary: Deliver mail as Catto, the town's dedicated Postcat, while meeting new and old friends in a vibrant cozy town filled with kitty residents.

games.name: Chronime Puzzle: Girls
games.summary: Chronime Puzzle: Girls is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

games.name: Citizen Sleeper
games.summary: Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.

games.name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
games.summary: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector is a narrative-driven science-fiction RPG in which players take on the role of a Sleeper, an artificial human. Using a tabletop-inspired dice system, players manage resources, make difficult choices, and build relationships while seeking a new life among the settlements of the Starward Belt. Expanding on the original game, the sequel introduces a customizable ship, recruitable crew members, and high-risk contracts that require planning and adaptation. Player choices, character classes, and skill-based interactions shape both the story and the path forward.

games.name: Clock Rogue
games.summary: Clock Rogue is a rogue-like game that challenges you to count without the time displayed to activate the attack. Build your own time clock and protect the hedgehog from viruses attack!

games.name: Console Archives: Bokosuka Wars
games.summary:
"Bokosuka Wars" was released by ASCII in 1985 for an 8-bit home console.
This RPG game puts you in the role of King Suren, fighting alongside your soldiers to restore peace to the Kingdom of Suren, which has been conquered by the tyrant Ogoreth of the Basamu Empire.
Help your soldiers, who have been transformed into trees and rocks by King Ogoreth's magic, as you make your way to Basamu castle to defeat your arch-enemy, King Ogoreth.

games.name: Dark Descent
games.summary: Dark Descent is a 4 player multiplayer cooperative horror game where you and your friends venture into an old elevator, aiming to reach the deepest levels. However, the journey won't be without it's challenges.

games.name: Dead End: Escape Your Fears
games.summary:
Everyone thinks they can make it out... but they've never met the Millers.

Missing college students plague the small town of Roberta, but you never thought you’d be one of them. When you’re kidnapped in this puzzle horror game, there’s no one to rely on but yourself. Do you watch horror movies and believe you’d be smart enough to make it out? It’s time to prove it. Can you escape before you become just another local tragedy?

games.name: Dead or Alive 6 Last Round
games.summary: Fan-favorite 3D fighting game Dead or Alive 6 is back with stylish moves, striking animations, and a cast of colorful characters to go head-to-head in the fighting game world's most extreme battles!

games.name: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift
games.summary: A dream among the stars — or a nightmare. 1,000 colonists in the dark between stars. Every pragmatic decision rewrites who they are. Discover what your choices mean for humanity, for better or worse.

games.name: Death Run
games.summary: Dodge lethal lasers in a dark sci-fi death show — or die trying.

games.name: Dicepath
games.summary: DicePath is a puzzle game where every move costs Action Points. Plan your route, collect dice to stay alive, and reach the exit before you run out. 50 handcrafted levels. One resource. No margin for error.

games.name: Directors Cut: Train
games.summary: A narrative 2D single-player game about working in an underground tobacco shop, funding a collapsing film project, taking on tasks, exploring a dangerous city, and watching reality gradually break apart.

games.name: DogPunk
games.summary: DogPunk is a high-octane FPS where you play as a prototype dog soldier, fighting to escape confinement and uncover the mystery of your creation.

games.name: Dragon Quest X: Jikuu no Mayoigo-tachi Online
games.summary: Dragon Quest X: Jikuu no Mayoigotachi Online is the seventh major expansion for Dragon Quest X, known as Version 8. It adds a new story, characters, and content as part of the ongoing Dragon Quest X experience, but requires prior access to earlier Dragon Quest X Online content (or the All-In-One version covering versions 1–7) to play.

games.name: Dragon Soul
games.summary: Forge your legend in a brutal fantasy world inspired by classic action RPGs. Master fast-paced melee combat, dodge deadly attacks, and collect lost souls to upgrade your warrior.

games.name: Dynasty Protocol
games.summary: Command your space fleet, mine asteroids, and conquer colonies in this immersive real-time strategy game. Build powerful space stations, upgrade your ships through combat experience, and manage vital resources as you expand your dynasty across a star system.

games.name: Eggconsole First Queen IV PC-9801
games.summary: Control two squads at once?! Experience epic strategy on a whole new scale with all-new features like troop recruitment and fatigue mechanics.

games.name: Enarian Online
games.summary:
An online, single & multiplayer, text-based action role-playing game.

Dive into a fast-paced, loot-driven adventure, across the shattered fragments of reality. Equip powerful items, gather powerful abilities, and conquer bosses, all through beautifully formatted text.

games.name: Escape From Vlogger: Runaway
games.summary: You broke into the house of a popular blogger to uncover all his secrets, but it’s not that simple! He locks you inside, and now you must do everything you can to escape. Hide, solve puzzle quests, and make your way out in this horror escape adventure!

games.name: Escape game R00m14
games.summary: Explore 3D space and escape

games.name: Exofinity Clicker
games.summary: Discover new worlds and earn credits by mining the legendary Infinity Crystal in Exofinity Clicker! Tap to extract rare cosmic minerals, upgrade your buildings and expand your reach as you evolve from a small outpost into a multi-planetary powerhouse.

games.name: Flesh Made Fear
games.summary: Tank controls. Fixed cameras. Pure Terror. Set in a haunting world of twisted experiments and occult nightmares, this game brings back the survival horror mechanics you know and love while pushing the genre into terrifying new depths.

games.name: Floor 12
games.summary: A horror-infused walking simulator inspired by the classics of anomaly hunting. Watch the lights closely, listen to the sounds, and trust your intuition. One wrong step and the journey begins anew. How many floors separate you from freedom?

games.name: Gamba God
games.summary: Bet, raise, and gamble your life away as you try to beat the 7 Stages of Draw Poker to become the Gambling God in this Poker Roguelite game. Every hand matters, every risk holds weight, and every upgrade counts toward your goal.

games.name: Get Fit: Beach Boys
games.summary: Start your interactive beach fitness journey now.

games.name: Get Fit: Beach Girls
games.summary: Start your interactive beach fitness journey now.

games.name: Gion Corridor:Re
games.summary:
A yokai that loathes change.
A fox that manipulates anomalies.
―In a world without allies, uncover the truth.

games.name: Glorpotron
games.summary: A tower defense roguelike about robots and ooze. Play solo or local multiplayer, protect the Glorp, and defeat the creeps.

games.name: Go Hell Go Gou: Tsukiotoshitego
games.summary: An expanded version of goHELLgo with a new facility and corresponding characters, new events for the main heroines and 3 new story characters.

games.name: Gone Me
games.summary: You happened to meet a college student girl who studies witchcraft, and together you entered the mysterious illusions at 30 degrees north latitude, starting a romantic and fantastical adventure. But you know, this is just the beginning...

games.name: Huntsman Against Darkness
games.summary: A dark roguelite action experience where you fight through endless hordes of corrupted creatures, free your family and rebuild the village. Survive brutal arena battles, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat massive bosses, and rebuild a fallen medieval village one run at a time.

games.name: Impulse Response
games.summary: Engineer Cadence Quinn is woken from cryo sleep to blaring alarms. Make your way through the ship and discover what happened and solve the mysteries of the ship. An audio only experience.

games.name: Invisible Ascent
games.summary: A rage-inducing memory platformer where the path disappears before you jump. Study the platforms, trust your memory, and climb upward one painful mistake at a time.

games.name: Kinetic TwinZ
games.summary: In this Motion Control party game, turn volleyball into an act of defiance! Seize your Joy-Cons, dodge powerful attacks, and coordinate with your duo to defeat the "Anti-Fun" police. This game was created by students from the video game school ISART Digital as part of their final-year project.

games.name: Kiyo: Bunny Tyranny
games.summary: Control the body of Kiyo, a feline ex-predator trapped in a neon-lit, dystopian city dominated by smartphone-addicted bunnies. Discover their deepest secrets, and free everyone from their tyrannical grip in this stealthy platform adventure.

games.name: Lawn Care Simulator
games.summary: Take Back the Yard in Lawn Care Simulator! Grab your mower and bring unruly lawns under control. From overgrown backyards to massive estates, cut through the chaos one blade at a time. Satisfyingly slice, edge, and clean your way to perfectly manicured greens — all in a day's mow.

games.name: Left Fore Dead: Zombie Battle Golf
games.summary: A chaotic multiplayer golf game where zombies keep showing up and your friends make everything worse.

games.name: Love Confessions on the Adventure
games.summary: I arrived, full of spirit, only to find the dungeon already conquered?! While searching for clues to a new one, I ended up helping a village in crisis—gathering materials for every shop! How did I start getting close to all these unique and charming women?! What will become of my adventurer life?!

games.name: Love Island: Forbidden Boys Temptation
games.summary:
You have someone waiting at home.
But the island doesn't know that, and neither do they.

games.name: Lovepical-Poppy!
games.summary:
LOVEPICAL-POPPY! is a sweet, comedic visual novel from the beloved Japanese brand SMEE. In this game, you'll find yourself surrounded by a charming cast of heroines, enjoying the delightful and hilarious moments of everyday life together.

This title features a talented team of SMEE's best, with a story penned by Yakamoto Uto, Minase Takumi, Nanao Yuhi, and Nakajima Taiga. Hanamaru’s fresh and vibrant art style brings the characters to life, while the adorable chibi art from Ameno Ame adds a touch of lighthearted humor. Under the direction of Yakamoto Uto and production coordination of Asami Akira, the game achieves a perfect balance of character development, narrative progression, and audiovisual experience, offering players a deeply immersive story.

Through a series of strange coincidences, Yaotome Tetsuya finds himself the new manager of an all-girls dormitory. He looks after the residents by cooking their meals and tending to their daily needs, all while working a part-time job at the dorm's attached crepe café. This charming café, located on the first floor to give the girls real-world experience, becomes a place where he shares the sweet and sour moments of work life alongside them in their cute uniforms.

His tireless efforts do not go unnoticed, and the heroines come to hold his kindness deep in their hearts. And when so many bright personalities live together under one roof, isn't it inevitable that a single spark will ignite a flame?

games.name: Make It Cozy!
games.summary: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!

games.name: Mamiya
games.summary: Mamiya is a captivating, dark visual novel in which a group of young men struggle against existential dread before the end of the world.

games.name: Manga English Native Phrase Quiz
games.summary:
Master the business English native speakers actually use!
Have fun levelling up your skills through quizzes!

games.name: Marble Mirage
games.summary: A homoerotic thriller visual novel set in a luxurious men’s spa. Investigate a murder, pursue romance, solve puzzles, and uncover dangerous secrets.

games.name: Massi vs. José
games.summary:
Explore 8 different themed worlds, get collectibles and find the key, in 40 levels with different kinds of platforms and diverse challenges. Massi vs. José is a 2D platformer with beautiful pixel-art and wonderful music.

Get achievements and aim for the top of the scoreboards!

games.name: Mechanical Defense Line
games.summary: This is a tower defense, card-based roguelike game. Build and modify your turrets, equip gear to challenge levels and experience the story. Strengthen yourself via various functions, choose talents in battles to win. Get no less than 10 pieces of equipment in every fight.More content awaits in-game

games.name: Medabots Card Robattle RB
games.summary:
A new Robattle where ingenuity and strategy collide is about to begin!

The history and excitement built up by Medafighters.

That story now begins anew as a card game.

games.name: MemGrid
games.summary: MemGrid is a polished and fast-paced memory-matching puzzle game that challenges your concentration, recall, and strategic thinking under pressure. Whether you're looking for a quick brain-training session or a competitive duel, you can play solo against an AI opponent with adjustable difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, and Hard) or challenge a friend in local multiplayer, where every turn is limited by a strict 15-second timer. Designed for endless replayability, MemGrid offers multiple board sizes ranging from beginner-friendly layouts to an intense 12×12 master-level challenge. Personalize your experience with Dark Mode and multiple background themes, including Slate Gray, Mint Green, Soft Rose, and Ocean Blue. Track your progress through a detailed statistics system that records every win, loss, and draw across all game modes, allowing you to measure your improvement and strive for mastery with every match.

games.name: Mind Detective Psychology Test
games.summary:
Read the clues, choose the behaviour!
A casual psychology quiz for quick play
Discover personalities in everyday actions

games.name: Mini Airways
games.summary: Mini Airways is a real-time management game where you play the role of an air traffic controller. Clear your aircraft to take off & land, direct them to the destination...and most of all don't let them crash!! London, Tokyo, Shanghai... Test your ATC skills in distinctive maps around the globe!

games.name: Monster Viator
games.summary: Ride a dragon and soar the skies or on a raft down the river! Compelling pixel art breathes life into your adventure. Journey with more than 20 monsters, each with their own abilities. Hang tight and take your time in exploring not only challenging dungeons but what this fantasy RPG has to offer!

games.name: Murder on the Disorient Express
games.summary:
An interactive murder mystery on the world famous train!
Step into the role of a cunning detective tasked with solving a perplexing murder before time runs out.

games.name: Namco Legendary Mountains
games.summary: Classic Namco arcades, reborn as a 3D puzzle! 80s legends return in a brand-new form!

games.name: Nano Code:X
games.summary: A small 2D game where you sneak through a lab simulation, collect parts, and rebuild your drone companion with multiple possible looks.

games.name: Necromancer Delivery Service
games.summary: A 3D physics-driven action racing game where players take on the role of a struggling necromancer forced into a delivery job in a chaotic city. Deliver packages, collect money and souls as tips, and use chaotic spells.

games.name: Nophenia
games.summary: explore atmospheric dreams of vagrant but familiar memories.

games.name: Nuclear Epoch
games.summary: Nuclear Epoch: Open-world survival mixing base building & extraction shooting. Explore with friends, raid dangerous instances for loot, but death means losing everything. Craft weapons with fully customizable stats in this post-apocalyptic wasteland.

games.name: OK Boomer
games.summary: A 4-player cooperative survival horror where you’ll explore the terrifying depths of the internet alongside your team of analog tech enthusiasts. Use old-school technology to purge glitches, preserve your digital sanity, and survive the strange monsters lurking in the deep web.

games.name: Omen Exitio: Hunger
games.summary: A Lovecraftian investigative gamebook. New York, 1927. A case pulled from real history, wrapped in cosmic horror. His name was Billy Gaffney. The man who took him was real. But his purpose was from another plane of existence. You play a journalist. You make choices. The story remembers all of them.

games.name: Once a Pawn a King
games.summary: Once a Pawn a King is a roguelike, turn-based strategy game with party-building mechanics, where chess meets chaos. Venture into the ever-shifting castle of the evil White King on a quest to rescue the beloved Black King, who was recently taken by the tyrant.

games.name: One Question and You'll Want to Share It! 1000 Trivia Quiz Questions
games.summary:
Animals, space, history, food, the human body — 1000 "huh!" facts you didn't know.
One question, and you'll want to tell someone.

games.name: Outta Space
games.summary: Where is your cat flying right now? Outta Space is an idle game where a tiny cat explores the universe from your desktop corner. Every keystroke, every click fuels the spaceship. From the Moon, past the solar system, to distant stars. Come back and see how far your lovely cat has gone.

games.name: Peach Hills Division
games.summary: An erotic point-and-click adventure game blending paranormal fantasy with military intrigue. Woo your squadmates, collect clues, and uncover the secrets of the Peach Hills Division!

games.name: Pixel Game Maker Series Arcanion: The Mekanos Invasion
games.summary: This game takes place a full year after the events of Arcanion: Tale of Magi and the in-between game, Arcanion: Magi Side Story.

games.name: Professor Neumann's Adult Certification Test
games.summary: Animals, nature, space, the human body — does your knowledge measure up?

games.name: Project XZ
games.summary: PROJECT XZ is a high-octane fusion of platforming, action, and tower defense strategy. Shoot, brawl, and upgrade your arsenal of skills to tear through anything in your way and decide the fate of the future.

games.name: Pupillary
games.summary:
Pupillary is a short surveillance horror game where your job is to monitor live camera feeds, identify anomalies and report them before the situation gets out of control.

Anomalies can be subtle or aggressive, ranging from moved objects and missing items to camera distortions, disturbing images, and hostile intruders. Across 2 levels, you will encounter 10 anomaly types and over 100 different anomalies designed to test your memory, attention and nerves.

To help you keep track of suspicious changes, Pupillary also lets you draw directly on the camera feed. Mark objects, circle details, or leave notes to yourself.

Report every anomaly you can find, survive until 6 AM and do not trust everything you see on the cameras.

games.name: Quantum Beast
games.summary: Quantum Beast is a hardcore sci-fi stylish action fighting game where you need to execute massive crazy robots to save the city. Be sure fully acquiring various skills to pass through those hard battles.

games.name: Quiet Evidence: A Detective Mystery Case
games.summary: Quiet Evidence: Unravel deep mysteries, spot hidden clues, find the truth.

games.name: Race: Rocket Arena Car Extreme
games.summary: Race cars, fire rockets and win the league. 3D car racing action battlefield

games.name: REMinal
games.summary: REMinal is a non-euclidean, procedurally-generated horror game. Run from your shadows, seek out cursed curios, and build safe spaces in an endlessly sprawling house. Can you escape with your soul intact?

games.name: Resort Beauties: Hentai Photo Puzzle
games.summary: Rotate each photo into place! A relaxing summer puzzle for quick play Enjoy solo or solve together with friends

games.name: Retro Asylum
games.summary: A psychological horror experience where isolation is your greatest enemy. Explore abandoned asylum, uncover disturbing secrets.

games.name: Run, Sandwich, Run!
games.summary: Want to know how sandwiches are really made?

games.name: Saeko: Giantess Dating Sim
games.summary: You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you. Experience the fate of Saeko and the little people in this cruel yet captivating story with avant-garde art.

games.name: Saga Onirica: Angelic Engine
games.summary: Saga Onirica: Angelic Engine is a top-down shooter featuring experimental control schemes and mechanics, where you fight endless waves of demons by crafting the ultimate loadout from firearms, magic spells, and advanced technology.

games.name: Sands and Relics
games.summary: Every Step Sinks the Path

games.name: SherloCat Nonogram Bahia
games.summary: Take on 120 nonograms and embark on Sherlock Holmes' adventures in Bahia. Choose between relaxing in Classic Mode or testing your limits in Challenge Mode. Guaranteed fun for everyone from beginner to puzzle master!

games.name: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2
games.summary: Find the cats. Discover the instruments. Reunite the orchestra!

games.name: Slot or Die
games.summary: Lost in a cursed castle, a knight confronts the horror with the help of a relic-shaped slot machine. Stop the reels, chain attacks and bonuses, manage your inventory, and survive in this dark roguelite where every spin decides your fate.

games.name: Something's Off in This World: Era Anomaly Quiz
games.summary:
Something's off in this office, isn't it?
Spot the old tool hiding in plain sight today.

games.name: Spot It in the Picture! Worldwide Knowledge x Academic Quiz
games.summary:
Where's the heart? Which one is the stamen? Which moon is full?
That diagram from school — open it up again.

games.name: Star Fox
games.summary: Star Fox is an action-packed adventure based on Star Fox 64, featuring newly overhauled character designs, freshly revamped looks for each stage, plus detailed cutscenes, fully voiced dialogue and a sweeping orchestral soundtrack. The game also includes Joy-Con 2 mouse controls and a brand-new GameChat feature that puts you in the cockpit as your favorite characters from the Star Fox universe.

games.name: Starvault
games.summary:
Choose your hero. Squad up. Push lanes. Farm creeps. Clear jungle camps. Upgrade your abilities mid-match. And dominate the map in intense 5v5 team fights.
Classic MOBA with stunning visuals that push the Meta Quest to its absolute limits.

games.name: Steel Seraphim: Proving Grounds
games.summary: STEEL SERAPHIM: PROVING GROUNDS: Play as Aster, a lonely young pilot as he controls a colossal mech to fight off volcanic monsters. In between missions, romance your fellow pilots aboard the massive Faraday Station. Find love, survive in this hybrid third-person shooter/visual novel.

games.name: Strike Pack
games.summary: Three explosive shoot 'em up adventures in one action-packed bundle.

games.name: The Backrooms: Forsaken
games.summary: What would you do if you were trapped in a dimension of seemingly endless rooms that went on for eternity?

games.name: Tiny Terra Spaces
games.summary: Tiny Terra Spaces is a cosy, slow-paced builder where you can create your own charming medieval island. Choose whether to design an island from scratch, expand on an existing one, or take on gentle challenges in hop mode to unlock new places. With cosy 3D buildings and a theme inspired by the beauty and history of Scotland, you can build at your own pace and enjoy the process of bringing your world to life.

games.name: Too Accurate to Be Scary...Your True Feelings Revealed by This Image
games.summary:
What did you feel? That choice reveals your true self.
One image. Four feelings. Which one is yours?

games.name: Type or Die
games.summary: In the heart of a medieval manuscript, a horse takes up arms to avenge its fallen master. Type to attack, collect cards, explore a living board, and survive in a roguelite where every word becomes a weapon.

games.name: Villion:Code
games.summary:
A new school RPG produced by Koji Okada.
Genome editing ushers in a "new era of life."
To live with the burden of karma. —Is there hope beyond that?

games.name: Wacky! Deer & Munk Adventure
games.summary: The weirdest, funniest, most addictive game of the year. Meet Deer and Munk, the goofiest duo you'll ever love. This wild adventure has to be played to be believed.

games.name: Walkable Cities
games.summary:
Walkable Cities are an exciting new topic in urban development. This game explores the possibilities and consequences of truly pedestrian focused city designs.

Made for The Very Serious Juniper Dev Game Jam

games.name: Wantama Life
games.summary: Starring the Vtuber Tamaki Inuyama! Exposure means over. The secret school trip begins...

games.name: Wetline: Fire Break
games.summary: Fire spreads through everything it touches. Pilot your water bomber low to refill, and lay wetlines that cut the blaze off before it reaches town. Ignite controlled fires when water isn't enough. A fast, tense firefighting puzzle where every second feeds the fire. What will you save?

games.name: Wheel Balance
games.summary: Wheel Balance is a hard and fun physics-based game about balancing on two wheels. Master controls and beat all locations, compete with your friends. Try not to fall far away down!

games.name: Wings of Aviora
games.summary: Become an aviator on the planet Aviora in this steampunk flight action-adventure. Build unique aircraft. Test them in combat and refine them to perfection. Help the locals and drive back the mechanical beasts rising from the sea.

games.name: YinYang Street
games.summary: Set in a small town on the border in the 1980s, "Street" is led by Li Minglai, an active soldier engaged in a homeland defense war. A trip back home in the usual but, Once warm and happy home is now only a mystery, everything points to a mysterious and weird legend - "Yin and Yang street".

games.name: YinYang Street: Separate Ways
games.summary: YinYang Street: Separate Ways is a Chinese micro horror game set in 1980s China, combining the story of understanding puzzles and text adventures. In the game, the scroll scene that can be moved by four axes is applied to bring different game experience to the player.

games.name: A Game About Bouncing DVD
games.summary: A minimalist incremental game where you watch DVD logos bounce endlessly, earn points, upgrade your screen, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades.

games.name: A Lost Man
games.summary: A fully hand-drawn point & click adventure game. 1916. Somewhere deep in the night. War. Death. Play as a lost man, stuck between two front lines. Traverse a desolate countryside, facing unusual encounters, bursts of violence, and mystical surges.

games.name: A Lucky Hunt With: Myrina
games.summary: Embark on a sensual ladybug-hunting adventure with Myrina, an attractive young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Myrina's enticing layers.

games.name: Acorn Avengers
games.summary: When the forest ranger is abducted, it's the Acorn Avengers to the rescue! Classic 16-bit platforming mayhem for up to 2 players co-op!

games.name: Altus Chess: Archaic Beginnings
games.summary: Classical chess plays one move at a time. Altus plays in resonance. Link pieces through quantum-inspired entanglement and trigger cascading resonance reactions across the board. A premium single-player chess experience that preserves every classical rule while dramatically raising strategic depth.

games.name: Arcanion: The Mekanos Invasion
games.summary: The sequel to Arcanion: Tale of Magi, and Magi Side Story, where the Warriors of Arcanion face their greatest foe yet, the Mekanos Army. And it'll be a fight for their lives as they defend their home against these new invaders. Play as Magi and take part in missions to defend your home!

games.name: As:9-nine- Arteisia
games.summary: A spinoff to the 9-nine- series written by Yukihito. The story is about a girl whose powers are too strong for her to handle, and a young researcher who treats her condition

games.name: B.O.B.Y's Journey
games.summary: Follow a robot’s journey to find the Spiritual Island, seeking the key to offering genuine emotional support while healing and transforming within, a story of resilience, self-discovery, and inner growth.

games.name: Bab.gg
games.summary: Bab is a daily browser game where a different guard stands at a door and you have to talk your way in. You get only a few messages to charm, outsmart, or out-argue them. Most people don't get in, and that's the fun. It works in both Arabic and English, and it was made in the UAE.

games.name: Backrooms: Exit 8
games.summary: SCP-6876 has escaped. Your mission: retrieve 10 vials of Toilet water for DARPA to synthesize into a poison against it. Carefully observe each stall to escape the Endless Bathrooms, avoid SCP-6876, and reach 'Room 10'

games.name: Balance It!
games.summary: Balance It is a difficult game about transporting physics objects without dropping them while also avoiding obstacles.

games.name: Battle Live! The Idol School Collection
games.summary: Battle Live! The Idol School Collection is a compilation of episodic, short stories that take place in the idol school of Pride Park.

games.name: Bittersweet Blossoms
games.summary: A lesbian romance set in England shortly after WWI. The story centres around Dot, a young maid who begins to work in the crumbling stately home of Bly, and her young mistress: the devious, devilish Patience.

games.name: Bitvania
games.summary: Bitvania is a chaotic action platformer where you start weaponless. Grab anything you find—from daggers to durians to slippers—manage stamina, and hope for a rare 1% critical hit that deals massive damage when it matters most.

games.name: Blood Gauntlet
games.summary: Blood Gauntlet is a fast-paced, pixel art action platformer where you’re constantly bleeding out. The only way to survive is to keep moving and destroy everything in your path!

games.name: Blox 3D World
games.summary: Create beautiful worlds with simple clicks, from giant windmills to craggy castles and add animals,humans and birds for an amazing creative experience.A super fun toy with a surprising amount of depth. No goals, no distractions, just a beautiful visual and audio experience for the zen at heart.

games.name: Burgie's Cozy Kitchen
games.summary: A relaxing kitchen game. Manage your burger joint restaurant: minimize the game in the corner of your desk while you do your business and wait for new orders. It can also connect to your Twitch chat to welcome your viewers.

games.name: Cartagra
games.summary: An all-ages port of Cartagra: Tsuki Kurui no Yamai - Rebirth FHD Size Edition, with English and Simplified Chinese support. It will also have new CGs made specially for this version.

games.name: Clover's Quadrants
games.summary: A moderately challenging puzzle game where you are what you eat - and you have four stomachs. Your four directions of movement are also inventory slots, and items in those slots will affect only that direction of movement.

games.name: Code, Solve, Revolt!
games.summary: "Code, Solve, Revolt!" is a puzzle game where you solve factory tasks through intuitive drag-and-drop programming. Write code for your robot to clear each level, delve deeper into the factory, encounter new puzzle concepts and data-structure creatures, and uncover the truth.

games.name: Colorace
games.summary: It will be an extraordinary ride! Drive your car through walls made of colored blocks, collect useful power-ups, dogle obstacles on the road, and compare your skills with other players.

games.name: Count Down
games.summary: Count Dracula is going Down

games.name: Cozy Mining
games.summary: A cozy idle mining game that lives on your desktop. Click to send your miner digging. They'll walk, dig, and collect automatically while you work or relax. Forge pickaxes, equip accessories, unlock adorable animal miners, and grow stronger with every run. Reach Floor 1000 — together.

games.name: Cure for Danmaku Synd
games.summary: Parry action only top-down shooter! Explore body and destroy pathogens!

games.name: Curling
games.summary: Build a deck of curling stones with abilities so broken they should be illegal. Face random opponents in the tour with or without friends. A roguelike deckbuilder unlike anything else.

games.name: Deadly Obsession
games.summary:
"Deadly Obsession" is an intense visual novel where you are the main character. In this game, you awaken in a mysterious, unfamiliar basement, only to realize you've been kidnapped by a dangerously obsessed yandere. His motives are twisted and every interaction teeters on the edge of love and madness.
As the story unfolds, your choices determine your fate: Will you escape? or will his charm and obsession lure you into staying by his side? Each decision shapes the narrative, unraveling dark secrets and emotional depths.
Prepare for a thrilling journey of psychological tension, complex relationships, and a fight for control over your destiny. Some decisions will influence the story, everything has consequences. ENJOY!

games.name: Death Spiral
games.summary: one button horror roguelike.

games.name: Decked Out
games.summary: Decked Out is a card-slinging deck-building roguelike. Use cards in real time to wipe out waves of enemies in order to defend and upgrade your town.

games.name: Deluge
games.summary:
Take the role of a resurrected warrior in service to an evil entity known as Ganglim. Your instruction is to finish off a terrorized community after they've settled into their new home. How you accomplish this task is left in your hands.

The village of Figaro is full of locked doors, buried history, and the occasional monster in a box. Explore at your own pace, choose where to go and who to trust, and decide whether you’ll rely on your sword, your magic, or your conscience to withstand the night.

Will you carry out your new orders, or embrace who you once were?

games.name: Dig Out of Prison
games.summary: One Spoon - One Way Out

games.name: Eyes of the ElderWood
games.summary: Eyes of the ElderWood is a first-person adventure horror set in Kashubian folklore, emphasizing diverse locations, challenges, and enemies. Draw spells to solve puzzles and deal with foes, or fight using a revolver. Keep an eye on your sanity level to avoid descending into madness.

games.name: Eyes of the Factory
games.summary: Explore the abandoned Blackforge Industries factory and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Solve puzzles, survive terrifying encounters, and discover why the factory never forgot you in this atmospheric first-person horror experience. Now are you ready for join Black Forge Industries?

games.name: Eyes of the Forest
games.summary: A third-person stealth adventure set in a quiet, post-human woodland where survival depends on patience, observation, and restraint. Towering ruins, tangled roots, and dimly lit paths create an environment where every movement matters and safety is never guaranteed.

games.name: Fu Sha 3: Night Clinic
games.summary: Spend a terrifying night of uncertain life and death in a late-night hospital via text adventure. *Fu Sha 3: Night Clinic * has numerous side choices and over twenty endings. Every choice may trigger unbearable horror—can you make the right ones, avoid fatal dangers, and escape this death curse?

games.name: Gartic Phone
games.summary: Gartic Phone is a free online multiplayer party game based on the pen-and-paper game Telephone Pictionary. Players take turns writing prompts and drawing pictures in alternating rounds, with each participant only able to see the previous player's contribution. The humor comes from how messages become distorted as they pass through the chain of drawings and descriptions. The game offers various modes including Normal, Animation, and Crowd, and supports play through web browsers on PCs, tablets, and smartphones.

games.name: Geckos & Deckos
