games.summary: There are four lizards at this table, but only one pirate can leave victorious. Play your cards strategically and blow up your rivals. Don't forget to sling your tail at your friends' heads (because it's funny). Can you manage to take the helm?

games.name: Glisynth
games.summary: Glisynth is a rhythm game that uses two types of notes. The Q row on the keyboard is used for yellow notes, while the A row is used for white notes.

games.name: Heroes Saga
games.summary: You've lost everything and found yourself in a world where a smile can become a deadly trap. "Heroes Saga" is a fantasy visual novel about choice, power, and temptation. Are you the hunter or the prey?

games.name: Horse Spirit Valley
games.summary: Ride peaceful 3D valleys on your horse, collect every diamond on the map, and spend your sparkle on new pastures plus deep unicorn-style looks—coats, manes, saddles, armor, and horns—with Steam achievements to chase along the way.

games.name: Infinite Evo TD
games.summary: A tower defense game where mechanics evolve through your choices. Strengthen classic tower defense, blend in other game genres, or abandon tower defense entirely. Each level unlocks a fresh ruleset, making one purchase feel like many games in one.

games.name: Interrogator 2
games.summary: You work as a detective specialized in the art of interrogation. You're given cases to solve and people to interrogate, together with your loyal partner, Charles. Interaction with other entities is based on written or spoken words.

games.name: IronWood
games.summary: IronWood is a first person shooter that takes inspiration from many of the older games that first popularized the genre, like Blood, Quake, and Unreal. Travel across a variety of levels, find powerful weapons and artifacts, and use them to your advantage against the enemies prevalent in each area.

games.name: Item Collector Ball
games.summary: You're a ball that collects items! Explore this carefully crafted time trial platformer with a plethora of unique physics based obstacles. Unique music and retro aesthetic define this game and provide a relaxing and satisfying experience. Easy to pick up but challenging to master.

games.name: Kanji de Go Go!
games.summary: A kanji quiz game where you write kanji and compound words by hand. Test your kanji skills across multiple modes, from the accessible Entertainment Mode, to the challenging Serious Mode, the same-level Rush Mode, and the bonus score attack mode KAKITORI ISSEN.

games.name: Lil' Quests
games.summary: Where every Quest ends in Laughs and Chaos. Lil' Quests is a sandbox, adventure, co-op game with wacky physics, funny moments, and horses!

games.name: Lord of the Trough
games.summary: Lord of the Trough is about getting to the desired girth and claiming the superior oats. Enjoy the pastures of Svinwald with up to 5 other players. Live to impress the tall skinny ones. Compete in a range of mini-games to determine the superior pig. Serve up a range of undesirable slop to your ungirthed brothers.

games.name: Magalumina
games.summary:
April, spring.
A quiet port town in the countryside.

The protagonist, Fukutome Yamato, came to Japan to begin living on his own.
He was a seemingly ordinary young man, apart from being half-Japanese –

"I get lost."
"I'm mistaken for someone else."
"Even the packages delivered to me are for someone else."
"My life is, in short, plagued by 'mistakes'."

No sooner had he arrived in town than a princess from some country fell from the sky.
Due to a double contract for an apartment, he ends up cohabiting with a female spy.
He's made to attend a different school than planned, and catches the attention of a suspicious, low-level gal classmate.

"I want to live quietly without drawing attention."

He grumbles, but he's also excited about this bustling, deception-filled new life.

This is a cheerful tale of "deceptive love" spun from lies and mistakes.

games.name: Medieval Castle Siege Defense vs. Invaders
games.summary: Stand between chaos and the kingdom!

games.name: MFTK: Survivors
games.summary: Conquer and pillage planets as a one-man army in this brutal action roguelite set in a bizarre and dark technofantasy universe. Battle hordes, plunder your enemies, forge devastating arsenals, and carve your path through endless intergalactic god-wars under the watchful eye of a mysterious goddess.

games.name: Minigolf Rush
games.summary: Chaos on Every Hole.

games.name: Mortem
games.summary: With the recent disappearances going on around in town lately, it hasn't been safe to go out at night. Your uncle requests you to take care of his corner store for the night, you agree. The night takes a turn for the worst...

games.name: Mosaic no Tenshi
games.summary:
A man who has lost all dreams and hopes, living days of mere existence—
the leader of an amateur AV filming circle, Hiraki Shuu.

A female college student addicted to hosts and buried in debt as an OL,
or perhaps a single mother struggling through life, or a sex industry worker…
He had grown weary of dealing only with such women every day.
Then, he meets one female student: Ibuki Hina

The mysterious runaway girl wrapped in the cool summer breeze says: "Turn me into money."

The secrets hidden within her. The wishes she keeps concealed.
Through this encounter, even Shuu's own previously flavorless and monotonous life begins to change—

Her dreams,
hopes and salvation
wrapped in fiction.

games.name: Ms. Spinderella
games.summary: Ms. Spinderella is an arcade-style score attack game where players weave intricate spider webs to capture wandering insects and earn the highest score possible. By drawing complete web outlines, players can trap multiple bugs at once, wrap them into spinning silk cocoons, and cash in increasingly rewarding captures before sunrise. Combining strategic territory control with fast-paced arcade gameplay, Ms. Spinderella challenges players to balance risk and efficiency while mastering the art of the perfect web.

games.name: Normal Dev Guy: Inside Kenney World
games.summary: Norman is just a regular game dev who jumped inside his own game to test it — and now he must fix bugs in the most unexpected way possible: by playing crazy minigames from within the code!

games.name: Operation Obliteration 2
games.summary: Operation Obliteration 2 is an old-school FPS stripped to the bone. Play any level in any order. Cut scenes are cut. Filler removed. No hand-holding. No safe spaces. Just weapons, enemies, and unlocked levels built to hit fast & hard. Adapt or die. learn or die again. Fight through a brutal alternate-history WWII campaign where aggression is survival and hesitation means death. Play the campaign straight through—or drop into any mission instantly. Nothing hidden or locked and every level available. All levels can be finished, your are given the resources, find them and use them correctly! Improvise, adapt and overcome!

games.name: Painting PC
games.summary: Think you've got what it takes to become a famous artist? Start with one brush and absolutely no followers. Take on commissions, gain fans, unlock new tools, and build your reputation one painting at a time. Will clients happily pay the full amount, or wonder what they've just spent their money on?

games.name: Pixel Blaster DX
games.summary: Tap, shoot, sort, and clear colorful pixel cubes in this fast-paced conveyor belt puzzle game!

games.name: Pixel Empires
games.summary: Pixel Empires is a pixel-art real-time strategy game where you build and manage medieval colonies, automate resource gathering with intuitive AI, explore uncharted lands, and wage tactical battles to expand your empire’s reach.

games.name: Raining Cats and Dogs
games.summary: It’s literally raining cats and dogs. In this game you platform, overcome about 100 unique obstacles, fight 3 janky bosses, find comments added from YouTube Shorts and make it stop raining cats and dogs by fighting Jeff in the end. Here's a message from Jeff: "YOU WILL NEVER STOP ME YEEEHAWWW"

games.name: Rapta
games.summary: 15 minutes and a terminal. Your sister's life in your hands. Navigate the Silicon Sneaky system, explore the digital underworld to secure $20,000, and make irreversible decisions. Your choices define her fate.

games.name: Richer Than the King
games.summary: Create immense wealth, build a rebel army, and overthrow the crown in this medieval economic strategy game. Trade daily, invest wisely, bribe royal scouts to stay hidden, and rally fellow nobles to survive clashes against the King's forces.

games.name: Scarlet Backrooms
games.summary: A Supernatural Multidimensional Puzzle Liminal Exploration Game The Scarlet Dimension is meant to be a purgatory.

games.name: Shadow of Ancients
games.summary: Shadow of Ancients is a 3D, Narrative-Adventure game with a stylized and colorful world. You can explore this new world with our main character Aiden, learn its secrets and decide how the world will continue with unique but familiar game mechanics.

games.name: Shoot the Wall
games.summary: Shoot the wall! Simple, right? Use your gun to blast your way through the wall, upgrade and change your weapons so you can shoot your way through the wall even faster!

games.name: Sky Sword Strategy
games.summary: An RPG adventure with strategic gameplay. Recruit an army to repel invaders in a war-torn land. Reunite with your family and help people along the way. Survive long enough to unlock your special abilities. Awaken the power of the Sky Sword.

games.name: Spirit Dungeon
games.summary: Party building × deckbuilding × auto battle. As a summoner, collect spirits, choose your cards, and brave the depths of a dark forest dungeon in this roguelike RPG.

games.name: Stray Sheep vs. Unreal Killers
games.summary: The first out of 2 volumes of the new Stray Sheep series by MOONSTONE, which is their first new series in 10 years.

games.name: Swordsmith of Greyhaven
games.summary: Run a weaponsmith shop in dark medieval city of Greyhaven. Sell weapons, manage gold, debt, materials, and fame, while customers, beggars, bandits, and rumors reveal the consequences of every choice.

games.name: Template!!: An Angel’s Gift
games.summary: The 4K Ultra HD Remaster of "Template!! An Angel's Gift"—a hilarious slice-of-life visual novel—is now on Steam! Follow Sakura Sora, whose bizarre new condition makes ridiculous "classic tropes" real, sparking a twist-filled daily comedy with unique companions.

games.name: The Anomaly Unit
games.summary: Forced into working as an Anomaly Observer in a space stockroom, you must explore, observe carefully, and report inconsistencies. Earn Credits to buy upgrades, but beware: hideous horrors are creeping in the dark.

games.name: The Colors of Love: Re-Colored
games.summary: A romantic visual novel about connection, choices, and the colors of the heart. Features an animated Live2D love interest, multiple endings, English and Spanish support, Steam achievements, and hidden secrets to uncover.

games.name: The Cursed Ward
games.summary: A system-driven psychological horror game where every threat has a pattern and every death has a reason. Each run is unique and will be timed.

games.name: The First Million
games.summary: An idle deckbuilder where you constantly unlock new cards and upgrades and discover one game-breaking strategy after another to make THE FIRST MILLION — and then many more!

games.name: The Minesweeper
games.summary: The classic game of minesweeper from a fresh new perspective. Play alone or with a friend in this third person puzzle game, where you toss grenades, plant flags, and math a path to victory. Enjoy the calm of nature, chill tunes and chaotic reveals.

games.name: The Tartarus Loop
games.summary: Play as a copy of Theseus. Run around in a maze, having to defeat the very Minotaur in Tartarus after it perished by the hands of the original Theseus. Over and over again. The soul of the Minotaur can't rest. All it can do is chase the player and try to outsmart you.

games.name: Threshold of Awakening
games.summary: In 1960s USA, Jane Ferguson, a New York restaurant owner, receives an information on her CIA agent husband Mark, who had vanished mysteriously during a Tibet mission. To uncover his hidden secrets, she follows his trail, delving into the enigma of his disappearance.

games.name: Universal Flight Simulator 3 PvP
games.summary: The sky is no longer the limit - it's the battlefield.

games.name: Unlucky Day
games.summary: A clicker game about surviving a day that hates you. Starting with terrible odds, can Mika make it through ten disasters in a row and meet her friend at the bar?

games.name: Unquiet Grey
games.summary:
Unquiet Grey is a visual novel about love and grief.

You wake up by the side of the road, alone and freezing. A stranger’s jacket covers you.

You don’t recognise it. You don’t recognise the man it belongs to either, staring out from the ID card you find in the pocket.

So why is there a picture of him and you on his phone screen?

games.name: Verto
games.summary: Drop blocks, match colors, rotate everything. This puzzle game adds mind-bending board rotation to classic gameplay. Choose from timed challenges or endless modes, and compete for high scores. Easy to learn, impossible to master.

games.name: Wild West Supermarket Simulator
games.summary: Run a General Store in the Wild West. Customize and expand your shop. Make sure that your customers’ constantly changing needs are satisfied. Work every job yourself or let your employees stack the shelves and work the till. Find out what it feels like to own a Wild West Supermarket.

games.name: You Are the Loading Screen
games.summary: The loading screen never ends. Solve bizarre challenges, survive fake system failures, defeat corrupted software, and uncover the truth behind a self-aware progress bar in this meta-comedy puzzle adventure.

games.name: Bilson
games.summary: Bilson is an open-world detective game where players will take on the role of the great detective Bilson, solving various bizarre cases in an open world. The game not only features a main storyline for players to solve, but also offers a wealth of additional content for players to explore.

games.name: Book Organizer
games.summary: Book Organizer is a cozy 3D simulation game where you become a library volunteer to mindfully organize cluttered shelves. Without stress, it delivers a satisfying visual and auditory experience as books snap perfectly into place, offering pure relaxation and deep immersion.

games.name: Cash Movers
games.summary: Cash Movers is a 2D cooperative puzzle-platformer about two unlikely partners trying to escape a heavily guarded building collecting as much cash as possible.

games.name: Dala and The Cursed Forest
games.summary: A strategy survival adventure game in Roguelike - Deck Building. Embark on an epic journey as a young Mutant maiden, Dala. Explore to uncover the mysteries of curses, and cleanse them to restore peace and serenity to her cherished forest sanctuary.

games.name: Finding Lake Chewaucan
games.summary: You’re a time-traveling detective with a bone to uncover. Hunt for clues, solve puzzles and complete minigames to unlock pieces of the past and identify fossil animals.

games.name: Ganbaru Kimi to no Futari Gurashi: Iede Gal Icha Love Seikatsu SLG
games.summary:
Overworked with overtime every single day, only coming home to sleep.
The protagonist, who feels no hope in his daily life, begins living together with a runaway gal named "Kaede."
In exchange for letting her stay, the promise she proposed was "to cheer up the old man."
Through her devoted support, he gradually regains his energy.

games.name: Gods and Kings
games.summary: A game that combines real-time strategy, card collection and role-playing. It's based on Greek mythology. You can play as heroes who can manipulate the power of Rune, summon the army and cast magic to defeat enemies, challenge or defend the authority of the Gods.

games.name: Hyper Thruster
games.summary: High Speed Tunnel Racing

games.name: Infinite Empire
games.summary: Infinite Empire is a strategy and simulation game that blends 4X and LitRPG mechanics within a sci-fi and fantasy universe featuring steampunk, bio-organic, and necromantic aesthetics. A core feature is modular ship building, where players physically draw their hulls and place components that directly impact their tactical vulnerabilities. These massive vessels engage in slow, deliberate "Age of Sail" style combat focused on positioning and broadside attacks. Between battles, players expand their territory in a dynamic galaxy, managing an escalating notoriety system against autonomous AI factions while looting and crafting hybrid technologies.

games.name: Lemure Lemure
games.summary:
A string of serial murders sends the Whitechapel district of Londinium into a fearful frenzy. Amidst those blood colored whispers, a white cat continues her daily life in the slums doing odd jobs and nothing of note.

Then, one day—as if ordained by God— she meets her fated lover: a dirty, dirty liar.

games.name: Luxmithar
games.summary: Luxmithar is a 2D survival defense roguelite built in Godot, where you defend a crashed forge-ship against escalating waves of hostile forces. Each run unfolds across multiple days as you harvest resources, expand a modular grid-based world, and construct layered defenses to hold back relentless alien incursions.

games.name: Neodrive
games.summary: Tear through a solo time-attack campaign in a 1600HP stick-shift muscle car. Manage nitro and perfect your drift lines to get the author medal on every single one.

games.name: Ocean Planet
games.summary: Button and Drop Bear live rent-free above their friend's steam bun shop. When their friend goes missing, it's up to them to figure out what happened and bring them home.

games.name: One Death at a Time
games.summary: One Death at a Time is a first-person exploration game. You play as John, in the middle of a midlife crisis. A suspicious milk carton offers you a wish in exchange for 14 souls… but because you're a good person, you'll have to die yourself and explore the city in search of 14 ways to do it.

games.name: Red Bull GeoGamers
games.summary:
Red Bull GeoGamers is a web browser visual quiz game set in the world of video games.
Play solo or challenge up to three friends in fast-paced matches to find out who has the ultimate gaming culture knowledge! Create a lobby, invite your friends, and let the battle begin!

games.name: Smile and Play
games.summary: After a fun weekend at Smile Land, you realise you’ve left your wallet behind. Returning after hours to grab it feels harmless at first, until you discover this place is far from normal.

games.name: The Therapist Impostor
games.summary: "Dr." Trigger, a man with no experience whatsoever, starts a therapy clinic. Will he cave under the pressure, or can he fake it till he makes it? Become the worst therapist ever (on purpose)! An interactive FMV comedy experience with dozens of choices, branching paths, and over 90 total endings!

games.name: Touhou Defense Tale: AI Test in Touhou
games.summary: A 2D Touhou fan game combining tower defense, tower merging, RTS-style control, and chaotic bullet-filled battles. Merge Touhou characters, build your defense, and compete for the fastest clear time on the leaderboard.

games.name: Tune My Car: Tuning Studio & Mechanic Simulator 2026
games.summary: Are you ready to create the car of your dreams?

games.name: V-Dash Dungeon
games.summary: A brand new, free, indie vtuber fangame inspired by games like Holocure and Vampire Survivors! Play as your favorite vtuber, summon their chatters to aid you, earn over 100 upgrades and unlockables to make your perfect build, and descend endless dungeon floors filled with familiar foes!

games.name: Vertex
games.summary:
Reach the peak of your freedom.

Welcome to Vertex, the unique 3D platformer adventure with creative sandbox elements from Dyro Studio. Step into the role of a brave little robot and embark on a journey high above the clouds! In a colorful world made up of floating islands, mysterious blocks, and tricky parkour challenges, your skill and creativity are put to the test.

Build your path, jump over dizzying chasms, and collect valuable treasures as you work your way up level by level.

games.name: Carceri
games.summary: Exploration game created for SOUPJAM2026.

games.name: Desktop Snail Assassin
games.summary: A idle desktop snails-like. Every now and then the murderous snail assassin is hunting your mouse cursor, turning your desktop into a chaotic bullet hell. How long can you survive?!

games.name: Eskinita
games.summary: Eskinita is a short atmospheric Filipino-inspired suspense horror game about working late nights in a small neighborhood lugawan and surviving the walk home through dark alleyways.

games.name: Even or Odd 1
games.summary: "Even? Odd? Forget the math!" Enter the Collatz Conjecture—mathematics' greatest unsolved mystery—reimagined as a high-speed roguelike action game. Play as "Ichi," the muscle-brained magical girl, teleporting between lanes to smash back incoming numbers with charge shots!

games.name: Galaksia Online
games.summary: Galaksia Online is an action-packed, 2D multiplayer space MMORPG blending retro pixel art aesthetics with mechanics. Forge alliances, custom-build your starships block by block, and engage in massive faction-based PvP wars or challenging PvE raid battles across dangerous stellar sectors.

games.name: Integrity
games.summary: If grid-based, board-game-like turn-based combat has ever felt restrictive to you, experience Integrity. Move freely, destroy or create terrain with your skills, and manage line of sight and stamina in a turn-based tactical RPG where every decision can decide the outcome.

games.name: Light Dark
games.summary: The screen is split horizontally in two halves: light and dark, and the dark side is upside down. You are constantly moving forward and every time you press a button you switch between the sides. You also jump by pressing a button and can fly some distance by holding a button. Collect the coins to score points and avoid hitting the spikes.

games.name: Lost In Dimensions
games.summary: This is a survival game where you must unveil the story and find your truth. Decide your fate and avoid trouble in the form of military bandits and keep an eye out for those pesky sharks! Explore dimensions, islands and discover civilisations. Good luck!

games.name: Mental Medicine
games.summary: Mix medicine and control emotions. Mental Medicine is a puzzle game themed around mental illness. Create medicine through puzzles and use it to treat growing emotions. Red represents mania, blue represents depression. Prevent emotions from overflowing and compete for high scores.

games.name: Nasubi
games.summary:
YOU TOOK PART IN A CONTROVERSIAL TV SHOW.

Experience an intense simulation of psychological endurance, inspired by the legendary late-90s Japanese reality experiment Susunu! Denpa Shõnen.

You are trapped in an empty room with no personal belongings, no provisions, and no human contact. Your sole connection to the outside world is an analog rotary phone...

games.name: Ocean Diver
games.summary: An arcade high-score based game where you shoot enemies from a submarine. Score more points with the missile by shooting enemies far away and pierce multiple enemies with one harpoon shot to score more points.

games.name: Our Light Affliction: Spider's Covenant
games.summary: A dark fantasy/yandere otome game about a girl who can see spirits, the spider apparition who tricks her into a contract, and the exorcist who is after them. Decide who to trust, and whether you'll fix them, or make them worse...

games.name: REM Hemispheres
games.summary: A short exploration game made for SOUPJAM2026.

games.name: Scum's Errand
games.summary: Raid cursed dungeons, claim powerful loot, and escape before it's too late. Scum's Errand is a top-down roguelite horde shooter with extraction mechanics where every run makes you stronger, but greed can cost you everything.

games.name: Shadows In Sanluca
games.summary:
In the heart of a bustling Latin-American city, between the sounds of droning sirens and booming church bells, a family quietly mourns the death of someone they once cherished.

Attune your ears carefully to the echoes of the past, listen in on the memories of a forgotten home and disentangle the tragic and sinister story of the family who once lived there.

Identify characters by name, connect them to a growing web of connections, and even find out secret identities in this Return of the Obra Dinn and Roottrees are Dead inspired story.

games.name: Stackpot!
games.summary: In this tiny trivia game each question you answer will either reward you with a new expensive item or punish you with a worthless piece of junk. Stack these rewards, or punishments, as high as you can without your pile falling over and make lots of money.

games.name: Suds and Buds
games.summary: Suds and Buds is a short visual novel in which you play as the lovely Protagonist, who makes a late-night trip to the laundromat after finding their washing machine broken. However, in a world where vampires roam free, crazy scientists experiment on the undead, and other creatures wander with pride. . . our Protagonist is nothing but a fast-food employee. Isn't that embarrassing?!?!? Choose a peculiar stranger to talk to and mix your laundry loads with, spin the conversation in your favor, and get that washing machine spinning to win a lifetime friend!

games.name: When Stars Collide
games.summary: In this sci-fi romance visual novel, join the crew of The Ophelia after awakening from a 500 year slumber. Forge new bonds, find romance, and unlock a secret that could change the galaxy's future.

games.name: Zetrya: Dungeon Dive
games.summary: A group of adventurers work their way through a dungeon with the goal of clearing it. Finding new threats along the way.

games.name: A Simple Square
games.summary: A simple square is a puzzle game with many interacting mechanics, which you will discover throughout your adventure in a large amount of diversified levels.

games.name: Aiocá
games.summary: In vast open seas and aboard a vessel equiped to withstand the depths of the ocean, a lone fisherman fights day after day to survive the challanges brought by the endless blue. As he tries to reach an important place from his past, our protagonist, Omari, is being haunted by sins of the past during his trip. Before he loses his sanity, Omari must face countless dangers that threaten his life, while supernatural forces seek to pull him to the abyss. Hold on to your faith and survive in this cruel ocean to unravel Omari's past in Aiocá.

games.name: At Run Time
games.summary: At Run Time is a first-person parkour game focused on speed, precision, and risk-taking. After stealing an energy source from a smuggler’s hideout, escape through deadly traps using advanced movement skills before time runs out.

games.name: Bird-Shot
games.summary: Bird-shot is a wild west themed 1-bit light gun game where the player plays as an retired outlaw hunting down ducks.

games.name: Bit Maze
games.summary: Guide Bitty through the mazes in this twisting plattformer.

games.name: C.L.A.S.H: Colonial Life Advancing Self-sustained Hemisphere - Chapter 1
games.summary: C.L.A.S.H: Colonial Life Advancing Self-sustained Hemisphere - Chapter 1 is an action/adventure title with platformer elements. Parkour your way through 25 unique buildings to collect hidden individual objectives/powerups. While you're at it, avoid toxic blobs that will radiate you into nothingness.

games.name: Calmed by the Dαrk
games.summary: Calmed by the Dαrk is an open-world Action-RPG where you can explore the fantastical world of Umbra Milenio. You play as John, a regular guy that ends up with the power to change the entire world. Break the rules, unlock new powers, make friends (or foes) and decide the fate of everyone!

games.name: Cloudsea Frontier
games.summary: This is a classic long-form RPG inspired by the masterpieces of the 1990s JRPG era. It unfolds a story of adventure through the Cloud Sea world and saving the world.

games.name: Cultivation: Mystic Realm of Spirit Mountain
games.summary: You'll explore uncharted spirit mountains teeming with spirit plants, stones, treasures, and beasts. Gather resources, grow plants, refine pills to advance, with spirit roots, skills, and pets aiding your relaxed cultivation. Begin your journey!

games.name: Desktop Driller
games.summary: An idle game that runs while you work. Your activity powers the drill: dig, earn, upgrade and go deeper. Build your system, automate everything and reach the center of the Earth.

games.name: Domefender
games.summary: RTS city builder, where you can build and customize your battle mech to fight waves of enemies side by side with your troops.

games.name: Dracs After Dusk
games.summary: "Dracs After Dusk" is an arcade, top-down shooter. Blast through bloodsuckers as the sharp shootin’ sheriff of a wild west town. Battle the deadliest bosses, claim weapons from the Armory to fuel your leaderboard topping run. It's an old school quarter muncher but luckily you have unlimited credits!

games.name: Dungeon Bomber
games.summary: Dungeon Bomber is a chain-reaction roguelite where you place bombs and blow through the dungeon. Drop a bomb each turn, earn coins, and upgrade your deck. Fuse bombs to boost range and effects. Defeat advancing monsters and destroy the required blocks before your HP runs out.

games.name: EXO-Roid
games.summary: A space rangers journey to escape planets. Build your own in the map designer or play the pre made map. Save your progress by making a 'Testament' (Notepad and pen required). The choice is yours. God speed, Ranger!

games.name: Exploring the Endless Land: 60s
games.summary: Disaster strikes, and you only have 60 seconds. Scavenge supplies with up to 3 teammates in a lab about to self-destruct, escape into an unknown forest, and use 500 types of random events to write your survival story—will you wait to be rescued alive, or uncover the truth the company is hiding?

games.name: Heroes of Retribution
games.summary: A rogue-like RPG set in a ruined world. Take on the role of a tank commander. Discover other heroes and factions. Upgrade your tank, acquire new skills, and find forgotten relics in this devastated world. Choose your side, get stronger and become humanity's savior.

games.name: Horn of the Warlord
games.summary: A turn-based grand strategy game focused on ruthless conquest and clever planning. Command armies, conquer procedurally generated regions, manage resources, and outthink rival warlords through smart timing, army composition, and siege tactics.

games.name: Idle: Doodle Realm
games.summary: Idle: Doodle Realm is an idle loot-based game with equipment and relic systems. Combat plays out like a castle war, where your units automatically fight and push forward. All you need to focus on are unit synergy effects, collecting relics and equipment, and upgrading talents and buildings.

games.name: Jupiter-Saturn: Testing Conviction
games.summary: "Jupiter-Saturn:testing conviction" is a space-themed Visual Novel, with choices that affect the plot.The story follows a scientist and his struggle against the enemies he encounters along the way

games.name: Laby's Village
games.summary: A quirky fantasy 2D pixel roguelite action game. Play as Laby, a goblin officer of the fallen Demon Lord's army, setting out from a small village to subdue ambitious rivals. Combine weapons and relics to forge your own chaotic build and enjoy absurd, fast-paced battles.

games.name: Lost Altr
games.summary:
LOST ALTR is a solo rogue-lite card game set within the crumbling halls of a forgotten temple. You’ll face a series of Trials—mysterious encounters drawn from an ever-shifting deck. Each completed Trial leads you deeper into the Ruins of ALTR. Use Aspect cards to shape your fate—mysterious forces that grant you powerful advantages, but always at a cost.

Built on the foundation of the Scoundrel card mechanics by Zach Gage and Kurt Biegand, a heavily reimagined experience, LOST ALTR blends strategy, luck, and lore in a dark, esoteric world. The path forward is never the same. The further you go, the more the ruins remember.

Early Access will evolve with new cards, mechanics, and layers of mystery—shaped by feedback from those brave enough to enter the ALTR.

games.name: Mono
games.summary: 『Mono』 is a 2D action game set in a monochrome world. Explore the land to enhance your abilities, defeat the formidable foes standing in your way, and resolve the crisis befalling this black-and-white realm.

games.name: Nomnomia
games.summary: Consume enemies to steal their abilities and survive by replenishing your constantly draining HP. Fight for survival on the mysterious planet Nomnomia in this food-chain action shooter.

games.name: Nopotions
games.summary: A dark fantasy role-playing game set in Valdaria, a perilous world ruled by gods and monsters. Players create a customizable character and adventure through a persistent, open world. An AI Narrator drives emergent storytelling, giving voice to its inhabitants, resolving combat with d20 dice rolls, and simulating a living world that reacts to and remembers every choice. Players shape their own path with the freedom of a tabletop campaign, exploring the continent, facing its beasts and horrors, and gathering rare loot along the way.

games.name: Persuasion RPG
games.summary:
A Text-Driven Victorian Roguelike Mystery: Step into the fog-drenched world of Persuasion, a haunting retro-inspired RPG where choices are dynamic, every shadow hides a secret and every whispered lie could be your last clue.

Victorian Gothic Atmosphere: Set in the eerie halls of a decaying Victorian estate, Persuasion draws you into a labyrinth of candlelit corridors, locked attics and crumbling cellars—each filled with cryptic objects, ritualistic clues and unspeakable horrors. Lovecraftian madness blends with British restraint in this masterclass of moody mystery.

games.name: Plinko Dungeon
games.summary: Drop orbs, cast spells, survive the dungeon. Plinko Dungeon blends plinko physics with roguelite action combat. Build your spells and items around each run's machine, then fight your way deeper into the dungeon.

games.name: Professional Cats
games.summary: Professional Cats is a cozy collection of 4 mini-games where cats dressed in different professions challenge your observation and memory skills. Find, match, and organize them while competing on global leaderboards!

games.name: Railroad Rummy
games.summary: A classic multiplayer rummy card game where you draw, discard, build winning hands, and outplay friends and family in tense, easy-to-learn matches inspired by real camping table traditions.

games.name: Reverse Survivors
games.summary: A reversed survivors-like where you are sending waves of monster to stop the survivors.

games.name: Rewind
games.summary: Rewind is a hardcore text-based detective puzzle game containing nearly a hundred clues. Players need to carefully examine and deduce the clues to find the answer to the case.

games.name: Rift Rumble
games.summary: Rift Rumble is a lightning fast, platform party fighter where fighters from across the universe have come to battle for control of The Rift. Play with unlimited players locally across numerous unique maps.

games.name: Shaggy Run
games.summary: Dive into this captivating 2D platformer where you guide Shaggy through three exciting worlds filled with entertaining levels. Shaggy moves forward automatically, and a quick tap on the screen sends him soaring into the air. Thanks to magical carrots, Shaggy can become a speed wizard in seconds, leaping over seemingly insurmountable obstacles to reach secret platforms. Your goal? Embark on action-packed adventures! Collect valuable items, defeat enemies, and rescue needy cats in the levels to earn achievements and unlock valuable rewards. You’ll also find yourself in exciting tournaments where, with a ticket, you have the chance to prove yourself. Your mission: Reach the end of each level as quickly as possible. And if you stand high enough in the rank at the end of the tournament, a juicy reward awaits you. This game is not just a solo adventure but also oﬀers the opportunity to make friends and challenge rivaling friends. Immerse yourself in the world of competition and see how you stack up against your good friends.

games.name: SpinWhisker
games.summary: A 2D puzzle-platformer about a cat that spins when it jumps and needs to escape rooms by traveling through dimensions.

games.name: Su8way
games.summary: You are Henry, a man who only wanted to take Train 8 to work. But you quickly realize that something is wrong. Everything seems to repeat itself like a loop. Objects and people begin to change, and nothing is quite the way it should be.

games.name: Symptoms of Infection
games.summary: Examine and test patients for common and novel infections using sophisticated medical instrumentation and disinfection procedures. All infected patients must be sent to the isolation ward for further evaluation or treatment. Rumors of mysterious diseases and human experimentation are unconfirmed.

games.name: The Message From Deep Space
games.summary: Mission: Translate an interstellar message, using the universal languages of math & science.

games.name: The Office Void
games.summary: You’re stuck on the night shift. The code refuses to compile, the deadline is on fire, and your mind is no longer yours. To keep from passing out and blowing the entire shift, you have to drink coffee. Lots of it.

games.name: The Serpent & The Seed
games.summary:
An artistic retelling of the story of The Bible through the lens of the typological seed of the woman mentioned in Genesis 3.

In a post apocalyptic future overrun by thorns and the power of the snake king, a bird discovers an ancient book that may have the answer on how to save the world.

games.name: The Wackytown Game
games.summary: Survive 14 waves of escalating absurdity. Defend the base, bank the cash, buy stupid upgrades. Bring a friend if you're brave.

games.name: The Wedding
games.summary: Get ready for romance, laughs, and wild choices in 'The Wedding,' a Visual Novel where your choices matter. Fake date, elope, or sabotage a wedding – your decisions will shape the story.

games.name: Vizul 1: Empatia - Adventure in Nice Colors
games.summary: bullet hell boss battles; adventure; urban fantasy; 4 difficulty modes; single-player, 2 playable characters; generous save points and checkpoints

games.name: 3 Sheep Puzzle
games.summary: 3 Sheep Puzzle is a 2D Sokoban-style logic game with remote movement. Guide the sheepdog through the barn to complete each level. A minimalist, relaxing challenge, perfect for quick minds looking to test their ingenuity.

games.name: A Philosophical Discussion of Worms
games.summary: A Philosophical Discussion of worms is a Kinetic Visual Novel that explores two characters, Vynder and Ophiel, as they navigate cohabitation in a strange, unfamiliar house when they don't speak the same language.

games.name: Abyss Ring
games.summary: Survive, cook, and conquer the depths! In this survival roguelike, cook monsters to stave off hunger through 100 floors of dungeons. With over 200 equipment and randomly generated dungeon, every playthrough offers fresh challenges and endless possibilities.

games.name: Advaria: Chronicles of Immortality
games.summary: Welcome, my Lord, to the cursed kingdom. A land plagued by black magic and creatures that crawl out of the darkness. Once this was a great kingdom. It could be great again. That's all up to you. Enter the world of Advaria - a hero defense game set in a world of fantasy and adventure.

games.name: Adventurers Shop
games.summary: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

games.name: Adventures of Ruby Rabbit
games.summary: "The Adventure of Ruby Rabbit" is a light action shooter adventure game. In the game, you can control Ruby the cute bunny, fight the bunny balls, and grow as she grows.

games.name: Airport Contraband
games.summary: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

games.name: Alice and the Looking-Glass
games.summary: A magical interactive 3D video book about friendship, kindness, and courage!

games.name: Alien Snap
games.summary: Explore an alien planet, snap pictures of wildlife and build relationships with your crewmates in this cozy sci-fi Point & Click - Visual Novel.

games.name: Alonitaire
games.summary: Break the rules of solitaire in this atmospheric roguelike deckbuilder. Unleash forbidden sigils while the Jack of Spades begs for your help in secret. Forge game-breaking combos under the Joker’s watchful eye and uncover the truth behind the deck. Don’t investigate… just play.

games.name: Alpha Crisis
games.summary: Alpha Crisis is a fast-paced 2D platformer focused on grappling hook movement and precise platforming, challenging players to descend into a collapsing facility to repair its systems and save humanity.

games.name: Alyup
games.summary: Alyup: An insane power fantasy. Unleash a cosmic barrage of hyperspheres with godlike powers, ascend the vast reaches of space like blazing rockets to razor-edged arena clashes, rescue fallen allies in tactical duels, grind stats to forge apocalyptic strikes, or perish in one devastating flash!

games.name: Am I Here?
games.summary: No character. No body. No mercy. Just footprints… and your inevitable failure.

games.name: Amp
games.summary: Dive into the synesthetic world of Amp, the neon rail shooter set in a polygonal rhythmic universe.

games.name: Angler's Journey
games.summary: Idle Clicker fishing game where you attack with different weapons to catch fishes, sell them to upgrade your equipment, unlock new skills. Explore diverse fishing spots, challenge mighty boss fishes, and strive to complete your massive fish collection.

games.name: Arca
games.summary: News of the Great Flood has reached the South Pole, and rumor has it there's an Ark ready to help... but only one spot per species! Jump, slide, and sabotage your rivals as you race against time to secure your place. It's every penguin for itself and the world against them all!

games.name: As One We Survive
games.summary: As One We Survive is a top down survival game set in a post-apocalyptic America. Step into the shoes of a father as he tries to find help for his sick daughter during a grid down post-pandemic event. Fight, scavenge, craft, and gather resources for your family's survival.

games.name: Astralis: Dawnblades
games.summary: Astralis: Dawnblades is a turn-based tactical RPG that combines stronghold management, dungeon exploration, loot-based equipment crafting, and optional rhythm-based combat tied to an orchestral soundtrack.

games.name: AstroDiner Manager
games.summary: It is a fast-paced diner sim set on an asteroid where you serve alien customers, upgrade your restaurant, and uncover the mystery hidden beneath.

games.name: Athanasia
games.summary: Athanasia is an action survival horror immersive sim where you explore a mysterious facility and use everything you have to survive with an arsenal of equipment as well as your wits against time traveling predators from prehistory and the future.

games.name: AutoSquad
games.summary: AutoSquad is a turn-based roguelike autobattler where you build and refine a squad of units, choose their formation and strategy, then watch the battle unfold. Recruit new units, combine them into higher tiers, collect relics, and defeat the final boss.

games.name: Backpack Survivor
games.summary: Backpack Survivor: is a strategy + combat roguelike game featuring meticulous backpack management and auto-battles with movement-only controls. Players craft unique builds to survive, racing toward ascension with all their resources

games.name: Banshee Bash
games.summary: Banshee Bash is a local-multiplayer party game. Fight with up to 3 friends (or add bots) to battle as a team, or in an epic free-for-all. Stack spell books to create unbalanced chaos and grab potion bottles to stay in the fight.

games.name: Barbarization
games.summary: Barbarization is a roguelite dungeon crawler with elements of bullet hell, deck building and strategy. Civilization fell to the dark legions now swarming this land. From the ruins of what is left, unlikely heroes emerge to reclaim it from the scourge.

games.name: BattleTabs
games.summary: BattleTabs is a modern, strategic twist on the classic Battleship game, featuring ability-based ship combat and cross-platform multiplayer. Players place 4 ships on a grid and take turns attacking opponents, with each ship having a unique ability and cooldown that adds strategic depth. Quick 3-5 minute matches across Web, iOS, Android, and Steam with ranked leagues, a branching research tree, and extensive fleet customization.

games.name: Beso's Shawarma
games.summary: Beso's Shawarma is a short, narrative-driven horror game. A late-night call lures you on a surreal journey through empty streets to a sketchy shawarma shop. Talk to a cast of strange characters, make a terrifying choice, and try to escape a disjointed, looping nightmare.

games.name: Bet on It
games.summary: Step up to the table for a high-stakes game of intense survival where every pull of the trigger could be your last. Wager your life for chips against friends or AI, and unlock rare loot. Will you walk away wealthy, or lose it all?

games.name: Blazeo
games.summary: Hell's failed Eden must burn. As Lucifer's right hand, tear through endless hordes of grotesque mistakes. Grow stronger, spread fire, erase your master's shame.

games.name: Blue Oath
games.summary: Blue Oath is a solo combat action-adventure game in which you play as a warrior swordfish who sets out on a journey to free a giant, cursed moray eel. Using powerful dash attacks, you can impale enemies and objects onto your beak, stack them, and throw them back as weapons or tools.

games.name: Boby and the Witch
games.summary: Boby’s girlfriend has been abducted by a witch—race through 3 worlds and 18 levels to save her. Can you beat it in under 5 minutes?

games.name: Boiled
games.summary: America, 1925. A simple errand for an old friend pulls ex-gang leader Dan into a violent smuggler war on the border. A narrative-driven, adrenaline-pumping top-down shooter inspired by Hotline Miami, set in the 1920s Old West.

games.name: Bravest!
games.summary: The “Braveast” series—a retro RPG from the feature phone era—and its landmark first installment!

games.name: Breath of the Pasture
games.summary: A heartfelt life-sim about love, land, and the magic of the countryside. Compose your very own pastoral symphony— Listen to the rain as it falls. Chase the breeze on sunny days. Watch crops reach for the sky. Let your cows and sheep rest in peace. Fall in love. Grow a farm. That is THE GAME!

games.name: Broth Bounty
games.summary: Broth Bounty is a fast-paced 2D shooter inspired by classic lightgun games. Blast ingredients into a bubbling pot, dodge hazards, and adapt to roguelite challenges as you cook your way to culinary victory!

games.name: Bubbly
games.summary: Fast-paced roguelike extraction arcade game. Pop endless waves of bubbles, build devastating upgrade combinations, defeat powerful bosses, and decide when to extract before losing everything.

games.name: Bugscraper
games.summary: Bugscraper is a solo or co-op roguelike shooter. As you climb toward your tyrannical boss's office, you'll battle floor after floor of enemies. Using a wide arsenal of weapons and upgrades, mow them down and aim for the top!

games.name: Bōnin
games.summary: Battle your friends in this exciting PvP sudoku showdown! Run around nature-themed puzzle boards while avoiding dangerous pencil projectiles, making good use of power-ups, and, most importantly, fill in the missing numbers faster than your opponent.

games.name: Caravan: The Trade Road
games.summary: Every journey is dangerous and every decision shapes your fate in this 2D pixel-art open-world trading RPG. Start as a novice merchant, level up, build powerful setups, trade wisely, fight bandits and bosses, clear dungeons, and rise as a legend of the trade routes by climbing the leaderboards.

games.name: Cardinal Descent
games.summary: Cardinal Descent is a card building roguelike where you craft elemental synergies and find game breaking sticker combos.

games.name: Changer Seven
games.summary: Fast-Paced Lane-Based Action Brawler. The legendary Changers 7 heroes must fight a new threat that changes the citizens of Sunny Point into terrifying beings! But as they investigate and defeat "villain of the week" like enemies, they suspect that someone from their own group may be behind it all.

games.name: Chew Your Food
games.summary: It didn't chew you properly. Escape its stomach by crawling, solving puzzles, listening carefully, and avoiding monsters in this horror dungeon-crawler.

games.name: Chibi Knight Classic
games.summary: 3 beasts have ravaged the land of Oukoku, legend tells of a small knight who will save the kingdom. Re-live this classic Flash RPG platforming hack and slash beat 'em up adventure for free here on Steam! Lovingly-crafted by dad and 4 year old daughter (who also stars as voice actress!)

games.name: Chicken Blaster
games.summary: Chicken Blaster is a casual arcade shooter where quick reflexes are the key to victory. Shoot coins, avoid hazards, and see how long you can survive as the chaos ramps up.

games.name: Circle of Bosses
games.summary: Circle of Bosses is a realtime tactics game that provides the complex mechanics of MMO-like Bosses but on a singleplayer experience. Tactical combat with a top-down view where the player assumes the role of a guild leader that can give instructions to AI characters.

games.name: Citystate Metropolis
games.summary: The creative, pragmatic, limitless city builder. Engineer a masterpiece of urban design, a small sustainable town or a futuristic metropolis. With procedurally generated buildings, grid-less zoning and powerful editor tools, everything is customizable: the city is yours.

games.name: Cleaner Company
games.summary: You have officially joined the elite team of "Star Wipers"! Your mission? Cleaning! Alongside your trusted crew, you will embark on exciting expeditions to abandoned space stations, ruined restaurants in the cosmos, and unexplored planets.

games.name: CloserLook VR: Oldways
games.summary: CLoserLook: Old Ways, a captivating interactive story VR adventure game set in modern day west Africa. Awakening in a locked university administrative building, you'll need to solve a series of intricate puzzles to find your way out. As you navigate through the game, explore secret locations and uncover a gripping narrative that delves into themes of exploitation, corruption, and betrayal.

games.name: Coding Day
games.summary: In "Coding Day", you are a videogame developer whose project is about to be released, but a sinister entity threatens its publication, and you must survive it throughout the night in a dark office building full of mysteries and dangers.

games.name: Coin Harvest
games.summary: Harvest coins with robotic arms, unlock islands and conquer realms. An incremental idle desktop widget game that runs while you work or game.

games.name: Combat Train TD
games.summary: This is a tower-defense roguelike strategy game centered around combat trains. Select a suitable base, carefully plan orbital routes, upgrade your combat trains, create an unique build, and then defeat the endless waves of monsters.

games.name: Construction Store Simulator
games.summary: Start with a small construction store and turn it into the place every contractor relies on. In Construction Store Simulator, you will stock goods, set prices, move shelving with full physics, and keep checkout lines under control—while simultaneously expanding the store, hiring staff, and improving the look and reputation.

games.name: Contraband Police - Crimson Fall
games.summary: It is the year 1983, a month has passed since the end of the Great War. The situation in the territories of the former Republic of Kagastam remains tense. The remnants of General Morin's army are engaged in bloody battles with representatives of the new regime. As an experienced war veteran, you are appointed as the commander of an outpost located at the very heart of the ongoing conflict.

games.name: Coven: All Powerful
games.summary: A chaotic spell-slinging party brawler where Sages clash in ever-changing magical realms. Stack wild enchantments, unleash devastating spells and combos, and outlast your friends in fast, unpredictable battles full of pure arcane mayhem.

games.name: Covenant 21
games.summary: Defeat the Covenant, round after round, using the mechanics of Black Jack and help yourself with powerful power-ups.

games.name: Cozywood Creek
games.summary: A gentle idle game with a living stream flowing quietly at the bottom of your screen. Terraform the land and watch as animals arrive to make Cozywood their home. Cultivate the surrounding area and bring this cozy ecosystem to life.

games.name: Crimson Banner: War of Liberation
games.summary: Are you ready, comrades? You will command the People's Liberation Army, strike a heavy blow against the aggressive Nationalist reactionaries in the War of Liberation, and win the liberation of all of China!

games.name: Crystal Journey: Lum's Adventure
games.summary: Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure is a captivating 3D puzzle/adventure game where your goal is to guide Lum, a brave light spirit, through a world filled with challenging puzzles and stunning environments. Rotate the levels, think creatively, and solve intricate puzzles to reach the magical purple crystal that hold the key to Lum's journey.

games.name: Cthulhu Go Teaching
games.summary: Go has never been so 'within tentacle's reach'! With Lord Cthulhu as your teacher, playing Go is no longer boring. Whether you want to learn the basics, improve your skills, or grind Life & Death problems, Lord Cthulhu will accompany you until the end of time!

games.name: Cubex
games.summary: Cubex is a horror escape room game in first person, collaborative (or not) for up to 4 players, where your objective will be to find the exit of a giant cube.

games.name: Cute Away: Paws Caretaker Simulator
games.summary: Run the town’s coziest cat caretaking home! Renovate and upgrade your house, manage inventory and order supplies online. Fulfill specific feline requests with specialized furniture and engaging toys. Play with cats, keep them happy, and optimize your layout to create the perfect daily workflow.

games.name: Daomei Village
games.summary: You have been banished to Daomei Village for your offense. In order to return to the Emperor's favor, you must make an effort. Repair, build, cultivate fields and fight various adversities. Meet new friends and learn their stories. Do whatever it takes not to be banished forever!

games.name: Date the Difference
games.summary: Date the Difference is a casual puzzle game where you spot differences between images while enjoying a light dating-themed atmosphere. Explore stylish scenes, find hidden details, earn rewards, and unlock charming characters through relaxing, attention-based gameplay.

games.name: Deathbulge: Battle of the Bands
games.summary: A role-playing game featuring musical themes with an affinity for the sick and righteous. The story revolves around a deadly battle of the bands contest, where entrants can attack and be attacked with music.

games.name: Defense of Kyrath
games.summary: Tower defense meets roguelike in a fantasy kingdom. Position 9 wardens across enchanted forests, pastoral meadows, and volcanic badlands. 30+ enemies with resistances and weaknesses. A talent tree for meaningful progression. Climb the Folly - a 20-tier roguelike ascent. Kyrath will not fall.

games.name: Deforb
games.summary: Deforb is a roguelite top-down shooter game where a mad orb defends its tower using up to four melee guns, a long-range gun, and strategically placed turrets. Upgrade your skills and craft powerful builds to survive relentless waves of enemies.

games.name: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
games.summary: Vicious demigods demand sacrifices! To please them and uncover their secrets, take control of captive creatures, explore Demigod Islands and solve 50+ mindbending puzzle rooms by... killing yourselves. In this puzzle platformer, death is the goal and it can take many shapes and forms.

games.name: Desk Space: Idle Spacefleet clicker
games.summary: Grow your fleet of space ships in this incremental space game. Extract wealth from the asteroids and stations, unlock upgrades to find synergies, defend against pirates, and unlock [REDACTED]. Pin to your desktop and watch your empire grow while you do "more important" things.

games.name: Destiny Is Dice
games.summary: The knight ‘Ail’ awoke in a dungeon where everything is decided by dice. Right beside ‘Grin’, witch who can manipulate every die. With this witch's help, ‘Ail’ heads toward the dungeon. To rescue someone trapped within it. Roll, manipulate, and change fate in turn-based roguelike. ‘Destiny Is Dice’.

games.name: Die or Die
games.summary: Roll the dice and choose how you will die. Die or Die is a top-down shooter roguelite where you run, shoot and dodge enemies to get dice with which to disable threats or unlock abilities. Roll. Die. Repeat.

games.name: Dino Citadel
games.summary: Command a castle-on-a-dino through a corrupted world. Rescue fallen allies, lead them in battle, and build your deck. Manage your economy to draw cards and confront the Voidrift in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Dino Time Raiders
games.summary: Travel back in time to capture dinosaurs and turn them into profit! Lead a team of scientists through chaotic time-travel missions, catch prehistoric beasts, and build the ultimate dino park. Manage research, upgrades, and disasters - all in the name of science and the free market.

games.name: Dolls Made Here
games.summary: You find yourself alone in an abandoned doll factory, assembling and inspecting dolls because you needed the money. Each order ends with the sense that they should never have been shipped, but leaving is no longer an option.

games.name: Dreaming Worlds
games.summary: Dive into the dreaming worlds of the four dream keepers and find out why they don't answer anymore. Rescue the trapped inhabitants of the dream worlds, change the dreams back to good and discover mysterious places and puzzles. But something dark will stand in your way.

games.name: Drive With Friends
games.summary: Drive With Friends is a chaotic co‑op driving game where one car is shared by multiple players. As one of the top friendslop games, teamwork and rivalry collide on a mysterious island. Can your crew reach the PEAK of madness and escape together? Only the best bros survive the ride!

games.name: Elemdian
games.summary: RPG that combines exploration with magic combat. Unfurl your claws as a powerful werewolf warrior wielding the power of the Elegems! A journey to find the Elegems, unleash devastating spells, and unravel the mysteries of Morrok.

games.name: Emblems: Sunless Vow
games.summary: Can they stop arguing long enough to escape the void?! A Roguelike Visual Novel with QUICK turn-based combat and flexible difficulty. Calculate, power-up, and stack favors to The Heart's content... Or take on a narrative campaign filled with Mystery + Drama + Shenanigans.

games.name: Entity Research Group
games.summary: First-person psychological co-op investigation horror. Players act as researchers, completing tasks and gathering evidence to identify various entity types.

games.name: Ephemeral Frame
games.summary: Step inside picture frames, films, and other imagery that connect a variety of dreamscapes in this surreal first-person exploration game.

games.name: Escape From Area 51
games.summary: A story-driven sci-fi detective puzzle game where mind reading, shapeshifting, and social roles open different paths through the game. Explore Area 51, use dialogue, avoid enemies, and uncover a conspiracy inside a secret military base.

games.name: Escape of The Hammer Princess
games.summary: A retro-styled rampage in both 3D and 2D! After years of waiting to be rescued, the Princess has decided to rescue herself. Escape as the princess in exciting retro-styled 3D, and relive the deaths of her would-be rescuers in classic 8-bit 2D! Bash some Skulls, Break Stuff, and Rise as a Legend!

games.name: Eternal Mist
games.summary:
Eternal Mist is a game that involves real-time tactics where you will be in charge of commanding different types of squads including paladins, hunters, and mages. Each squad possesses unique skills that can be improved as you progress in the game.

Elements such as bonfires, cauldrons, and other objects on the battlefield have an impact on the abilities of your warriors. Placing your units near these objects can provide a significant tactical advantage.

The Mist is a source from which hordes of creatures emerge. These formidable beings represent a relentless force that poses a significant threat to all who cross their path. Their agility and speed allow them to swiftly traverse the terrain, making them a daunting challenge to overcome. Only a skilled commander can give confident and well-thought-out orders to inspire their soldiers and guide them towards victory.

games.name: ExoMecha
games.summary:
ExoMecha is a brand new free-to-play online competitive first-person shooter that takes place in Omecha, a new and untouched planet with exotic environments. ExoMecha offers you breathtaking gaming experience with its flexible playing style, mechs, unique gadgets and abilities, and boss battles.

​ExoMecha is an immersive experience with team-based large scale battles, a unique battle royale game mode, and an objective-based game mode.

games.name: Fall of the Final Age
games.summary: Take command of the last Stronghold of humanity, fighting back against the advancing monsters. Decide where to prioritize the forces of your Heroes, as the number of turns before the invasion is limited. A turn-based tactical strategy with RPG and roguelike elements.

games.name: FamCram
games.summary: FamCram is a 3D grid-based puzzle game about two dads putting their kids to bed. Guide the children through increasingly challenging and multicultural settings, each with unique items, mechanics, and humor.

games.name: Fearwoods
games.summary:
Fearwoods is a cooperative survival horror game for up to three players, set in a cursed and hostile forest environment. Players explore a dense wilderness filled with supernatural threats while searching for a way to escape.

The gameplay focuses on exploration, survival mechanics, and cooperative decision-making. Players must locate GPS fragments, journal entries, environmental clues, and other objects that help them navigate through the forest and progress toward escape. Light and noise play a critical role in gameplay, as visibility can improve navigation but also increases the risk of attracting hostile entities.

Throughout the game, players are pursued by a supernatural demon that reacts to movement, sound, and player behavior. Survival often requires stealth, teamwork, and resource management rather than direct combat. Environmental storytelling, puzzles, and dynamic encounters shape the experience as players move deeper into the forest.

The primary objective is to escape the forest by collecting GPS components and restoring navigation systems. While progressing, players can uncover the story of Aveline, whose disappearance is connected to the events within the forest. By discovering her journals and hidden clues, players may attempt to free her soul, which can influence the outcome of the game.

games.name: Feed The Pit
games.summary: JOIN THE SOCIETY. Avoid unpredictable horrors that will pursue you relentlessly. Perform rituals in a haunted forest to find dead bodies. Feed these bodies to THE PIT, lest you be fed to it yourself.

games.name: FFA Cards
games.summary: A 6-player free-for-all strategy game. No P2W, minimal randomness—just brains, bluffing, and skill. Made by players, for players.

games.name: Final Fantasy Blackmoon Prophecy Remake
games.summary:
A full remake of the 2011 RPG Maker 2003 game, Blackmoon Prophecy, redeveloped in RPG Maker and released in 2026.

Save Gaia from a malevolent evil in this oldschool retro JRPG by traversing the planet to safeguard the Crystals of the Element from harm.

games.name: Flowerbots
games.summary: Flowerbots is a chill and bouncy incremental game with synergies, strategic optimizations and a whole playground for your physical experiments!

games.name: Flowsxty
games.summary: FLOWSXTY is a brutal, beautiful 3D trench runner where you dodge in four lanes and fight to survive to 60 seconds to clear a mode.

games.name: Forged: Reconquest
games.summary: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.

games.name: Forgotten Blood
games.summary: Drawn by the call of an ancient crystal dagger, you journey into the Forgotten Valley, now ravaged by the Stone Plague. Forgotten Blood is a first-person action RPG inspired by King’s Field and the Souls series. Explore an interconnected world filled with secrets, danger, and hidden paths.

games.name: Forsaken Lands
games.summary: Brave heroes unite to challenge the gods themselves and decide the fate of the world! Dive into an epic roguelite deckbuilder adventure. Gather your friends and take on divine foes together in thrilling online co-op battles!

games.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows
games.summary: Fight enemies, upgrade your squad, and explore new planets! Make tough choices and shape the fate of an entire sector in Frontier: Path of Shadows. Experience a richly crafted 25th-century world and tactical combat where X-COM meets Final Fantasy.

games.name: Func Key
games.summary: Deck out your keyboard with powerful upgrades in this roguelike word-builder. Snap on keycaps to buff entire rows or columns, install "broken" function keys, and pick your projects as you rise from a lowly intern to a corporate legend.

games.name: Function Sue
games.summary: Welcome to the world of “maSUEmatics”! Draw equations, shape the world, and roll Sue to the goal in this free-form physics puzzle.

games.name: Fête De La Soupe
games.summary: A soup-like made with BAPALON for the SOUPJAM 2026.

games.name: Galactic Diner
games.summary: Become the best chef in the galaxy! Cook for aliens, make new friends, and go head-to-head against other chefs to win it all in a game show where the customer is always right!

games.name: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
games.summary: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).

games.name: Get That Box, Girl!
games.summary: You're just a girl trying to do her job: collecting boxes, solving puzzles, and doing whatever it takes to meet your quota!

games.name: Gloom Punks
games.summary: Not your average co-op roguelike. Where the price for power is death, and you’re trapped in a gloom-scape of fever dreams and fairytales gone feral, you can only rely on Punks like yourself. Cheat death, bounce back, and take on a world that so badly wants you dead!

games.name: Golden Gambit
games.summary: Spin. Gamble. Conquer the Machine. Golden Gambit is a slot machine roguelite where every choice is a gamble. Build insane combos, unlock risky modifiers, and push your luck to the limit… or crash and burn trying. Use unique powers with each slot machine to win the Golden Gambit.

games.name: Golden Swirl
games.summary: GOLDEN SWIRL is a Roguelike Deck Builder blending fast-paced action with strategic card play in a dark fantasy world. Journey through shifting dungeons, uncover swirl secrets, and adapt to challenges with unique cards, relics, and a depravity system.

games.name: GolFall: Make Your Way Up
games.summary: Hit, fall, and try again. A hard and unforgiving golf action game where you land precisely on floating platforms to reach the top. Fall and you start over—but the higher you climb, the more retries you earn. Play solo or with friends and aim for the summit!

games.name: Gone Digging
games.summary: Dig together by day. Feed the darkness by night. A 1–4 player co-op digging thriller where loot, upgrades, and sacrifices decide who survives after sundown.

games.name: Gowf: A Golf Adventure
games.summary: Gowf is an arcade style golf game with a classic 3-click hit system. Features an RPG style adventure mode where you can level-up and customize your character's skills and equipment to win tournaments across a variety of courses and online play with up to 8 friends.

games.name: Grapple Gunners
games.summary: A fast-paced multiplayer experience about grappling hooks and guns! Play against friends and compete to be the winner in this action-packed PvP game! Fight to be the last one standing across 30 unique maps!

games.name: Gridwalker
games.summary: Gridwalker is a 3D isometric open-world puzzle game. Explore a mysterious island of ancient ruins. Communicate with the world. Solve puzzles, rescue trapped spirits, and awaken the pillar stones to uncover secrets and find your way out.

games.name: GU Fighters
games.summary: GU Fighters is an action roguelike where you unlock and upgrade new abilities after every round of combat. Play with up to 4 players locally or online to create your own unique build and be the first to win, or go solo/co-op to traverse varying environments and defeat hordes of enemies.

games.name: Guildamation
games.summary: Guildamation is an Idle AutoBattling RPG that let's you build an automate a guild.

games.name: Guilty Pleasures
games.summary: You are Marcus Holmes, a young private detective and nephew of the legendary detective Arthur Holmes, known among the elite as the “Detective of Passion” — a man who uncovered the intimate secrets of the rich and famous: affairs, love triangles, model disappearances, scandals in high society.

games.name: Hallow Maze
games.summary: Hallow Maze is an epic action adventure through an intricate world submerged in war. Explore twisting caves, enormous palaces, battle unhuman horrors and help those in need, in a gothic hand painted 2.5D artstyle.

games.name: Hammerhead
games.summary: A short narrative-driven game that explores themes of isolation and nostalgia as player unravels suppressed memories through solving cryptograms.

games.name: Head Chef
games.summary: Head Chef is a restaurant management game. Supply the kitchen, select your staff, create a delicious menu and… cook! Make your guests happy and find your way to the stars. Keep control of your team and finances, because the higher you climb, the harder you fall.

games.name: Hecatomb
games.summary: Hecatomb is a mythic deckbuilding roguelike that tests how much you're willing to sacrifice. Every action produces Offerings, which can be relinquished to the Gods in exchange for powerful effects. But which Gods you worship and which you scorn have lasting effects on your journey to the Underworld.

games.name: Hex Shop
games.summary: After inheriting your grandmother’s witch shop, buy, craft, and sell apothecary wares while demons slowly consume you.

games.name: Hexforger
games.summary: Craft your spells in ONLINE CO-OP with your friends in this SURVIVORS-LIKE! Slaughter monsters, gain gold, upgrade your spells to infinite heights. Crush challenges and unlock new spells, upgrades, pickups, realms. Up to 4 players in this unique twist on the survivors-like formula!

games.name: Horny Academy
games.summary: Horny Academy is an adult visual novel that blends interactive storytelling with a deep, branching narrative. Every choice you make leads to steamy animated scenes or unexpected twists within the mysterious walls of the magical Academy

games.name: Humanize Robotics
games.summary: Command a robot that thinks for itself. You choose the destination; its neural network battles the physics. Struggle through brutal obstacle courses, evolve your body with collected data, and master the chaos of movement. Lose a leg? Keep crawling. The Company is watching.

games.name: Hunter Desert Simulator: Sniper Rifle
games.summary: Do you have the patience to become a master hunter?

games.name: Hurling Herman
games.summary: A unique platformer where you hurl vials to create temporary platforms, navigate sprawling caves, and battle creatures. With an original soundtrack and immersive environments, a challenging adventure awaits you.

games.name: HyperRouter
games.summary: A fast-paced, mind-melting, reality-twisting 3D platformer for the digital age. You are a Router, running files to every corner of the internet while a reactive soundtrack accentuates your every leap. Learn to traverse the unfathomable geometries of an untamed Netspace, and NEVER. SLOW. DOWN.

games.name: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs. Demons
games.summary: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs Demons is an action game where you survive waves of zombies and demons in explosive environments. Fight, collect weapons, and master each level.

games.name: Imagine Future
games.summary: "Imagine Future" is a Visual Novel with a campus theme. You will follow the perspective of the protagonist Ji Wang, experience the life of a high school student. The final examination seemed so far away. one day, it was close at hand. Standing at the crossroads of life, what choice will you make?

games.name: Inanis: Into the Abyss
games.summary: Embark on an endless journey alongside your crew and traverse the true distances between celestial bodies. How far will you be able to go?

games.name: Indigo's Dreams
games.summary: A mixed-media video game of a Wonderland. Play as Indigo, a young girl trying to find her way back home after her dreams take her to a land unknown. Traverse through abandoned beaches, hidden forests, a cloud town, and more. Discover newfound purpose along your way.

games.name: Infinity Knights: Xross
games.summary: A King and his Infinity Knights wield The Armaments - weapons capable of reviving slain enemies. Xross, the newest Infinity Knight, will embark on a life-changing adventure as he experiences both the thrill and dark reality of what it means to be eternal.

games.name: InfinityMine
games.summary: No enemies—debt and a volatile ore market are your true foes. Mine a dungeon that changes every day. Drop to 0 HP and you lose the day’s mined ore. Upgrade tools, manage carry limits, time sales, and descend to the deepest layer.

games.name: Innocence Rewrite
games.summary: "Innocence Rewrite" captures the summer before and after the college entrance exam.As old bonds mend and distant feelings return, it's a season of healing amid chaos.No need for correction fluid — just feel, and slowly rewrite the innocence of youth.

games.name: Inverted Dreams
games.summary: This dream driven psychological exploration game guides you through shifting landscapes shaped by buried fears, fractured memories and unsettling truths. As the world bends, every shadow becomes a clue, and every step pulls you deeper into the subconscious you’ve tried to forget.

games.name: It Was That Summer
games.summary: A narrative game set in Cambridge, 2006. Spend one unforgettable summer as Leon, a visiting student, balancing studies, friendship, and love. Your choices shape who you become: yourself, or someone new altogether.

games.name: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O.
games.summary: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O. is a classic Game Boy-style adventure set in the Jett Rider universe. A small mission. A big heart. A true handheld hero.

games.name: Just A Shadow Game
games.summary: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game".

games.name: Korinki
games.summary: In Korinki you play as the dinosaur Archie. Fight and survive the arenas as the new chosen gladiator. Craft your weapons on the spot and take on the challenges each different arena provides. Discover your playstyle with the multiple skilltrees.

games.name: Labyrinth of Aetheria
games.summary: A grid-based 3D dungeon RPG inspired by classic titles of the 1980s and 1990s, such as Wizardry and Might & Magic. Experience classic dungeon crawler elements, including tense turn-based battles, trapped treasure chests, and the discovery of rare equipment.

games.name: Little Cheese Works
games.summary: This is a cooperative action game where you have to carry cheese to the goal without being found by cats. You can have a conversation with voice chat, but the slightest noise will wake up the cat. Let's carry the cheese quietly by breathing quietly so that the cat won't find it!

games.name: Little Woody
games.summary: Little Woody is a 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you guide a small wooden soul through a mysterious world of shifting environments. Meet unusual companions along the way, solve handcrafted logic puzzles, explore atmospheric locations and uncover a forgotten past.

games.name: LlamaRPG: Farm to Fable
games.summary: A turn-based combat RPG following a llama traveling around the world trying to be a hero. Full of great itemization, crafting, story, hat collecting, and more.

games.name: Loop of Command
games.summary: ️ Loop of Command is a minimalist automation puzzle where you program obedient robots to survive in a cold corporate machine ruled by the Overseer’s cruel absurdity.

games.name: Lucipurr
games.summary: Lucipurr is a multiplayer horror game. Players(1-5) try to disrupt a cult’s ritual aimed at harnessing the captivating power of cats. Meanwhile, another player controls a demonic cat and hunts them down.

games.name: Macaronpolis
games.summary: Macaronpolis is a simulation game that creates an efficient and universal process for customers to produce the products they want. You develop sales strategies by predicting customer demand, developing production designs, and sometimes finding solutions to problems faced by neighbors.

games.name: Mainland
games.summary: Enter a cooperative medieval realm, forge alliances, lead armies, and engage in epic battles. Shape history with dynamic politics, or test your mettle against others in fierce player-vs-player combat.

games.name: Make Magic Great Again
games.summary: A Roguelike survivor-style action game of elemental mastery. Harness eight core elements, survive endless demon hordes, and join up to 4 players in co-op to unleash ancient formulas—embark on an epic journey to revive the lost glory of magic!

games.name: Maneuver Warfare 2: BTG
