Pick the answer from 4 choices
and enjoy learning step by step!

games.name: Beneath The Hill
games.summary: Beneath The Hill is a first-person survival horror game about entering a cave beneath a village to investigate a strange beating heard below. The game focuses on lantern-based exploration, sound-sensitive goblin encounters, simple melee combat, and multiple endings.

games.name: Biomechanical Toy
games.summary:
Classic run-and-gun action in an explosive arcade adventure!

In Biomechanical Toy, you control the action hero Inguz, diving into a surreal world where toys have come to life as dangerous biomechanical creatures. Your mission is to traverse stages teeming with enemies, collect power-ups, and defeat the infamous Scrubby to recover the artifact that sustains this world.

games.name: Bird Brigade
games.summary: Become birds together with your friends — each one has different perks and stats, and some have unique abilities. Try various game modes and have fun in Bird Brigade. The game is inspired by AI-generated TikTok videos about Bird Game 3.

games.name: Bodian's Bay Wash
games.summary: A relaxing underwater VR cleaning simulator! Use pressure washers and scrapers to clean boat hulls, smash barnacles, and expand your very own underwater wash. Buy furniture, upgrade your equipment, and get ready for clients of colossal proportions!

games.name: Brewgether
games.summary: Brewgether is a coop brewery sim. Run your own brewery, manage bars and employees, trade with townsfolk for different materials used in infusing the alcohol, build houses and furnish them in order to rent them out. Expand your business with new locations, brewery stations, vehicles and more.

games.name: Chained Beasts
games.summary: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

games.name: Cheat Death
games.summary: Play dice poker with the grim reaper in a dark strategic roguelite. Build powerful poker hands from cursed dice, stack upgrades, rig the odds, sabotage Death, and survive deadly mini-games with your life on the line.

games.name: Console Archives: Hercules no Eikou II - Taitan no Metsubou
games.summary:
"Hercules no eikou II Taitan no metsubou" was released by Data East in 1989 for an 8-bit home console.

This is a RPG game where you play as a hero traveling a vast world to defeat monsters who plot to dominate it.

Join forces with companions you meet along the way and restore peace and tranquility to the world.

games.name: Culdcept Begins
games.summary:
Led by dice. Ruled by cards.

A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

games.name: Daice
games.summary: DAICE is a unique merge of turn-based dice-powered combat with inventory management, a roguelite where you control an evergrowing AI Core. Purchase and pilot unique spaceships, load your dice into weapons and systems, and unleash devastating combos and shape your own strategy-driven story.

games.name: Dead Echo
games.summary: Explore eerie, atmospheric environments, uncover hidden secrets, and survive against an unseen presence lurking in the dark.

games.name: Dead Weight
games.summary: Challenge the Ancient Gods! Set the sails of your flying pirate ship and embark on the adventure in the steampunk world of Dead Weight. Explore floating islands in search for loot. Choose a class or create your own and enjoy turn-based tactical combat on tiny battlefields where every step matters.

games.name: Debris Zone
games.summary:
Debris Zone is a top-down multiplayer space shooter set in a galaxy of drifting wreckage, contested territory, and trigger-happy pilots. Jump through portals into a connected world of open maps, each packed with enemies, loot, and lurking bosses, then fight in fast, skill-based dogfights where managing your shields and hull is the difference between a clean kill and a trip back to the repair station.

Customize your ship with lasers, shields, engines, amors and drones, hunt for gear to push your build further, and take on towering boss encounters with serious rewards. Earn gems, gold, and experience as you complete quests, climb the ranks, and unlock prestige titles to flaunt above your ship - all in a persistent online galaxy where every other pilot is a potential ally or you next target.

Suit up, pilot. The Debris Zone is waiting.

games.name: Decide in 5 Seconds: Who Is the Culprit?
games.summary:
Just 5 seconds. Spot the culprit.
One person in the crowd is moving wrong — catch them.

games.name: Detective Mind Training: Mystery Choices
games.summary:
Solve each case with just one choice!
Train your observation and deduction skills
Quick mystery puzzles for sharp minds

games.name: Diceaster
games.summary: You won't beat this game — A die that destroys itself to climb. Each face is a hit. Use them all and you become a ball: fast, uncontrollable, doomed. A precision platformer with no checkpoints and global leaderboards.

games.name: Diggin
games.summary: Drill into the depths of a meteor crater in this incremental adventure. Mine ores, unlock upgrades and find the cosmic treasure that lies below! Can you uncover what happened to the Moles that came before you?

games.name: Dolls: The Hunt
games.summary: A cooperative survival horror game where you and your friends must survive being hunted as prey!

games.name: Doria & the Tide Song
games.summary: Save the music of the ocean and help a brave little mermaid find her voice!

games.name: Dreamin' Her: Boku ha, Kanojo no Yume wo Miru
games.summary: From the creators of Seven Days and Lost:Smile, Life0 presents their third game: "Dreamin' Her". In his dreams, the ideal girlfriend appears taking the form of his childhood friend. Is she really just a dream, or is she something more?

games.name: Dreamscapes: The Full Journey
games.summary: Immerse yourself in two atmospheric hidden-object adventures full of puzzles, dream worlds, and dark secrets.

games.name: Dungeon Slasher
games.summary: Dungeon Slasher is a roguevania pixelated side-scrolling action game, where you battle powerful enemies and bosses in thrilling 2D combat, utilizing the weapons and skills of diverse characters.

games.name: Eggconsole Harry Fox PC-8801
games.summary: A mother fox sets out on a quest to save her ailing cub. Through encounters with many animals and riddles to solve—can she make it back in time?

games.name: Elementers
games.summary: Level-up, unlock new abilities and elements to equip and try out in Co-op Pve Missions or Pvp.

games.name: Escape Game The Locked Elevator
games.summary: An escape game set inside a trapped elevator!

games.name: Falseflash
games.summary: A fast-paced VR panic game where you must stabilize a failing planetary control grid by hitting real fault signals, ignoring false ones, and surviving ten minutes of total system overload.

games.name: Farlands
games.summary: Congratulations, you've bought your own planet! An agrarian rock in the edge of the galaxy, which, for some reason, was almost given away for free. So the time has come to leave the hectic and stressful life of the overcrowded metropolis for a more rural and rewarding life.

games.name: Farm Factory Simulator
games.summary: Grow crops, automate production, and manage your own store. Turn fresh harvests into valuable products and create a wide range of goods. Optimize your workflow with efficient production chains and smart business decisions. Expand your facilities and build the fully automated farm-to-market business.

games.name: Feather Land
games.summary: Feather Land is an idle game that blends productivity tools with a study/work companion. Enjoy calming music, hatch eggs, collect cute birds, and watch a quiet space into a landscape full of life, bringing peace and focus to your study or work sessions.

games.name: Fire Boy
games.summary: A hero who talks to the player in a comical way about his actions in the game, adventure in classic 2D platform style, are 5 worlds with different and challenging characteristics. Join the Fire Boy and help him recover all the dinosaur eggs that were stolen by the little monsters.

games.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary: A workout that works for you – now enhanced for Nintendo Switch 2!

games.name: Frostrain 2
games.summary: Become the last conductor and rule over the final train society in a frozen world. Gather, expand, and forge your train while building powerful synergies with mighty artifacts. Your position—and the safety of your passengers—now rests in your hands.

games.name: Fruitgeddon
games.summary: Blast through hordes of adorable yet deadly mutant fruits in this intense space shooter with bullet hell action. Shoot, dodge, and survive unique boss battles that push your skills to the limit. Only the strongest will uncover the truth behind the chaos. Are you ready to save the universe?

games.name: Full Stride
games.summary:
Full Stride is a jockey racing game focused on first-person riding and skill-based race control.
Players manage speed, stamina, positioning, and timing while adapting to each horse’s characteristics and the layout of 3D racecourses.

games.name: Funnel Runners
games.summary: Trapped in a doomed city, you and up to 7 friends must scavenge parts, fix your van, and escape the brutal tornado that approaches. A first-person co-op survival game with escalating disasters and total environmental destruction.

games.name: Galdromeda
games.summary: Turn-based RPG with space combat. Assemble a crew, each having their own unique abilities, level up, upgrade your ship and your crew's abilities, collect new outfits for your crew.

games.name: Garden Eternal
games.summary: The cozy garden that keeps on growing. Garden Eternal is an idle clicker where you tap a glowing Heart, raise bees & buildings, and draft cards through every season. A calm place, mostly. But the garden keeps its own hours, and not everything that blooms after dark is a flower.

games.name: Ghost Keeper
games.summary: Become a Ghost Keeper and lead your fearsome minions against the living. Use diverse scare tactics, manage demonic creatures and harness dozens of skills. Oh, and don’t let the Brotherhood catch you! The ultimate scaring experience begins…

games.name: Ghost Strike
games.summary: Redefining Modern Warfare: Breach and Conquer the Uncharted Fortress

games.name: Go-Go Town!
games.summary: Step into the role of a hands-on mayor and build your town from the ground up. Plan neighborhoods, automate logistics, and grow your community—all while juggling workers, infrastructure, and day-to-day chaos to create your dream town. Play solo for total control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

games.name: Ground Branch
games.summary: From one of the developers behind the original Rainbow Six and Ghost Recon games comes a thinking man's first-person shooter featuring in-depth character and weapon customization. Take your time. Think ahead. Get the job done.

games.name: H.O.A Simulator
games.summary: HOA Sim is a comedic suburban patrol game where you enforce neighborhood rules as an overzealous homeowners association officer. Cruise the streets, inspect properties, issue citations, and chase your daily fine quota while balancing speed, accuracy, and pure petty power.

games.name: Happy's Humble Burger Cult
games.summary: The original cooking horror returns in an unhinged co-op experience for 1-4 players. Grill burgers, serve customers, and hit your quota before the kitchen turns into a nightmare. When Asset Joy begins her hunt, try to escape alive and extract your hard-earned cash to survive another shift.

games.name: Heave Ho 2
games.summary: Get a grip, it’s Heave Ho 2! The insane 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op mayhem online for the first time. Grab what you can and swing to win!

games.name: Hell Maiden
games.summary: Traverse the depths of Hell and beat its toughest demons on your way to Heaven in this horde survival deck-building game inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy.

games.name: Hentai Nefiris
games.summary: Enter the world of ancient Egypt with the mysterious goddess Nefiris. Complete mini-games, unlock seductive anime illustrations, and reveal increasingly daring looks of the desert queen.

games.name: Hex Judge
games.summary: Hex Judge is a medieval narrative investigation game where players take on the role of an inquisitor questioning villagers accused of witchcraft. Gather testimonies, uncover contradictions, and decide who will be judged. Every choice leads to one of multiple endings.

games.name: Hold the Core
games.summary: Hold the Core is a roguelite tower defense game about trading safety for power. Draft Risk Cards, shape enemy routes, evolve towers, and survive deadly enemies and bosses.

games.name: Holonoptic
games.summary: As the new CEO of a derelict company, you must deal (or side) with rogue corporate AIs, rebellious labor unions and globalist aristocrats. Holonoptic combines economic simulation and party-based RPG into a story-rich corporate alpine cyberpunk.

games.name: Instant Sports 2
games.summary: Instant Sports 2 delivers fast-paced, easy-to-pick-up gameplay with depth for players looking to master each discipline.

games.name: Jack In Space
games.summary: A collection of fun space mini-games for kids

games.name: Japan Stigmatized Property
games.summary: Can you endure until morning Monitor Japan's stigmatized properties and report any paranormal activity If you miss a report or make repeated mistakes

games.name: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.summary: A love letter to the thrilling world of K-pop! In this life simulator, you're the manager responsible for scouting talent, organising schedules, creating budgets, planning social media, choosing music, and styling your idols. Your goal? To debut the next big K-pop idol group!

games.name: Karjala
games.summary: VHS bodycam horror in the atmosphere of Soviet Backrooms. Karelia is a country of rivers, forests and lakes, where the modern world comes in contact with superstitions and ancient rituals. Soldier Solnyshkov agrees to take part in a strange experiment of his command.

games.name: Kawaii Anime: Cute Boys Magic World
games.summary:
Magic, minigames, and boys cute enough to cast a spell on you.
Play more, unlock more, fall harder.

games.name: Kitty Burger
games.summary: Kitty Burger is a cozy time-management simulation game where you run a burger shop together with your adorable cat assistant! Prepare delicious burgers, serve customers on time, and keep your little restaurant running smoothly. Between busy workdays, you'll meet different characters who visit your shop, each with their own stories, moods, and quirks. How you interact with them will influence the course of the game, unlocking unique story moments and multiple endings that shape the future of your little burger shop.

games.name: Kooo to Jump!
games.summary: A hardcore, voice-controlled precision platformer where you crow to jump! Sustain a continuous 'KOOO' to scale a brutal, foddian-style map. Scale 60 camera zones, conquer a massive world, and lose your dignity in this unrelenting rage game. Includes controller support and Practice Mode.

games.name: Kyoto Xanadu: The Blooming Phantom
games.summary: Set in an alternate reality where Kyoto is the capital of Japan, Kyoto Xanadu players take on monsters and mysteries coming from the great labyrinth known as Xanadu. As a student, players will challenge the labyrinth and grow through their battles within Xanadu while also deepening bonds with various people during your daily life. Uncover the truth hidden both in the labyrinth and Kyoto itself.

games.name: Letalis
games.summary: Letalis presents an unconventional RPG adventure, paying homage to the classics of the Game Boy era while infusing inventive gameplay, souls mechanics and unexpected twists!

games.name: Letter Snap: Term Challenge
games.summary: Letter Snap: Term Challenge – A fast, vibrant word challenge to test your speed!

games.name: Looking For Fael
games.summary:
Upon receiving a cryptic voicemail from your missing roommate, the ordinary confines of your apartment transform into a surreal labyrinth. Guided by his voice and a custom retro console in hand, embark on a journey to decipher the mysteries that have twisted your home into an enigmatic maze.

But beware. The further you venture into other realities, the harder it will be to find your way back.

games.name: Lootbag Tactics
games.summary: Pack your bag, set your strategy, and dominate the arena!

games.name: Mafia Life Simulator
games.summary: Build your own empire in the world of the mafia! In Mafia Life Simulator, take control of everything from marijuana farms to weapon factories, money laundering centers to drug networks. Become the undisputed leader of the region with your gang and make your name known in the world of crime.

games.name: Meow Craft
games.summary: Cursed by the Demon Dragon, you—an adventurer cat—can no longer lift a sword! In Meow Craft, flex your paws to run a blacksmith shop, recruit cute staff, and arm heroes. If you can’t fight, forge the god-tier gear needed to break the curse!

games.name: Meta-Ghost: The Breaking Show
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the reality show — "Breaking Show", where you engage in real-time battles with various intelligent machines using cybernetic enhancements and weapons. Whether for personal gain or lofty ideals. Fight! Until you reach the final victory on this Roguelike journey.

games.name: Mobu
games.summary: Play as a monk wielding superpowers in this fast-paced arena shooter with roguelite elements. Survive waves of bouncy enemies raining from the skies as the challenge escalates. Buy upgrades and special abilities to create game-breaking builds and push back the chaos.

games.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
games.summary: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an enhanced compilation of Moss and Moss: Book II that replaces the use of virtual reality in those games with a new cinematic camera system. The game is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

games.name: MTB Mavrix
games.summary: The ultimate multiplayer open world designed by Pro riders. Discover mountains and trails with limitless control and build your own career. Pull huge tricks or race through the global rankings! Nail challenges to secure sponsorship deals with real world brands. Are you ready?

games.name: Mystery at Rainy Night Manor: The Missing Invitation
games.summary:
A mystery in a rainy manor
Read the clues and observe
Find the hidden truth

games.name: Neko Michi
games.summary: Build and manage a cozy Meiji-era street for cats. customize buildings, balance tradition and modernity, and create a peaceful cat community

games.name: Noise Canceler
games.summary: APods — AI-powered earbuds that read your emotions and generate music. Drawn to these songs, five ordinary people find themselves moved to action.

games.name: Ore Factory Squad
games.summary: Ore Factory Squad is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Play alone or with friends, buy properties, dig deep for valuable resources, complete contracts, upgrade and automate production lines and grow your factory from zero to industry!

games.name: Out Here
games.summary:
You take a job on a lonely island. Watch the sea. Report anything unusual.

But something feels wrong. And it's your job to find out.

games.name: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster
games.summary: When outlaws murdered your wife and took your daughter, everything you had was gone. Your gut aches for blood and sweet revenge. Dyin's too good for 'em now!

games.name: Pathogenic
games.summary: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

games.name: Petunia's Purgatory
games.summary: Petunia’s Purgatory is a creepy-cute, idle-farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Plant seeds that grow into horrifying crops, sacrifice animals for blood, and summon assistants to help you run your farm. Manage your sanity while you try to appease the Elder God!

games.name: Pimbolas
games.summary: Chaotic foosball matches for up to 4 players! Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.

games.name: Project Raze: Fall of Terra
games.summary: Project RAZE is a fast-paced sci-fi FPS where you play as humanity’s greatest creation, RZ-01 (RAZE) Feel every shot and every impact as you obliterate anyone bold enough to threaten the human homeworld, Terra Supremis.

games.name: Qianli: The Vastscape Scroll
games.summary: Shape the world to your will in lush landscapes inspired by Chinese watercolors in this Zen hex-tile building game that blends puzzle and roguelite elements with beautiful Asian aesthetics. Befriend mystical creatures in your journey while you make the world come alive beneath your fingertips.

games.name: Rail Estate
games.summary: Outbid your rivals in auctions for key railway routes, then build and upgrade tracks to dominate the rail economy. Players compete to create the most profitable network, balancing speed, capacity, and maintenance in a dynamic simulation

games.name: Requiem of Reuinis
games.summary: In "Requiem of Reuinis", you'll explore lost ruins, cleverly choose equipment and skills, collect resources to enhance yourself through alchemy and research, and strategically defeat various enemies. As you get deeper, you'll gradually uncover the truth of the"Calamity".

games.name: Ring Toss Legend
games.summary: Ring Toss Legend is a casual physics game where you toss rings onto prize pegs, earn coins, upgrade your skills, and chase bigger rewards as you explore new stages.

games.name: Runic Curse
games.summary: Action RPG in metroidvania style

games.name: Samurai Conqueror
games.summary: Conquer Japanese History! A “Historical Timeline Strategy” fought on the grand timeline of Japan

games.name: Science Trivia Quiz 100 Wonders
games.summary: Discover the science hiding in everyday life! Answer quick 4-choice quiz questions 100 wonders for kids and adults

games.name: Sharks
games.summary:
Swim, bite and attack using a unique locomotion method that only needs the movement of your head and one controller: look where you want to go, pull the trigger to swim, squeeze the grip button to bite. You won't believe how fluid and dynamic the shark motion is.
Hunt with groups of up to 10 people online. Eat whatever you can to survive and avoid the zombie sharks: last player standing wins.

Escape from other sharks, or outmaneuver the survivors to catch them. Use powerups, hide in caves and shipwrecks, and use cannonballs and mines to evade and chase sharks down.

games.name: Sins Of Kaleido
games.summary:
"This is my will. No one else's."

She was once the beloved child of a wealthy family. But those bright days were swallowed by the darkness of a tragic scheme.

Having lost everything, the girl returns to her homeland with ambition burning in her heart. There, she meets a group of heretical men who harbor the power of witches.

Bonds forged by wounded souls warmth flickering in frozen hearts. The miracle of love, now known by the lonesome.

games.name: Sir, You Are Being Hunted
games.summary: Sir, You Are Being Hunted is a procedurally-generated British horror in which tweed-wearing robots hunt you for sport. Roam the landscape, scavenge for food, hide breathlessly in the undergrowth, flee in terror, and even fight back with stolen weapons.

games.name: Spud Keeper
games.summary: Pick up and smash bugs, upgrade your tools to protect your potato patch from escalating waves of pests!

games.name: Steam Trigger
games.summary: A riveting steampunk 2.5D platformer set against the backdrop of the sprawling metropolis. Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing fusion of industrial progress and Victorian aesthetics as you embark on a journey throughout the city.

games.name: Storebound
games.summary: A 1-3 co-op horror game. Play as ordinary shoppers trapped in an accursed megastore. Find the exit together at all costs before the employees catch you.

games.name: Streetdog BMX
games.summary:
Get ready for massive tricks, high scores, and gnarly slams in Streetdog BMX. Carve your way through six huge maps featuring hidden spots, handcrafted challenges, and flowing lines!

Customize your bike and rider before hitting the streets to explore six maps packed with wallrides, gaps, bowls, ramps and rails. Uncover new spots, complete handcrafted challenges, and link up your combos!

games.name: Sudoku Cats
games.summary: Did the cats run away and leave chaos behind? It's time to tidy up the mess! Put cute furry friends in their right places by solving fun logic puzzles. The perfect relaxation adventure for everyone cat lovers and those who enjoy sudoku.

games.name: Sweet Hamster Days
games.summary: "I got reincarnated... as a hamster! My owners are three sisters: a charming cosplayer, a straight-laced and caring one, and one with a sharp tongue and a sweet side. I'm being showered in love... but who will I fall in love with?"

games.name: Take Me To The Dungeon!!
games.summary: Build your deck and take Una on an epic dungeon adventure!

games.name: Telemount
games.summary: Covemonty has been bad and has been banished to the test chambers.

games.name: The Abyss’s Last Breath
games.summary: The Abyss’s Last Breath: blends survival, escape‑room gameplay and immersive simulation into a unique psychological horror experience.

games.name: The Bull of Heaven
games.summary: In a city near the mountains the bull of heaven is unleashed, tearing a wound in the world. A vivid action-rhythm game split across eleven intense levels.

games.name: The Convenience Store
games.summary: The Convenience Store is a J-horror game about a college girl on a night shift.

games.name: The Hidden Scrolls
games.summary: The Hidden Scrolls is a turn-based roguelike tactical RPG with a Chinese-inspired setting. Explore five mysterious regions, battle fierce beasts and ruthless bandits, recruit and train a team of warriors to uncover the secrets hidden within ancient bamboo scrolls.

games.name: The Lure
games.summary: John is a detective searching for a missing colleague. He finds himself trapped in a mysterious loop where reality constantly changes. Explore eerie environments, interact with clues, and uncover the truth behind the disappearance in this third-person psychological horror experience.

games.name: The Mermaid Mask
games.summary: Magnus Mortuga has been killed. The captain of the world's strangest submarine, he was found in a locked room with an ancient stone cauldron - unsealed and opened for the first time. How did he die? Was it a curse? Perhaps one of his eccentric crew? Or does the bizarre truth run even deeper...

games.name: The Night Archive: No Service
games.summary: The Night Archive is an episodic first-person horror series where each episode tells a story pulled from the darkest corners of true crime. These are the stories of those who lived to tell about it.

games.name: The Remnants
games.summary: You, a supernatural detective, are sent to investigate Hawthorne Residences on the Cunningham property. Something isn’t right. Observe carefully, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth before the building begins to distort around you.

games.name: The Unwoven Unicorn
games.summary: A magical journey of kindness and discovery!

games.name: Tiny Circuits
games.summary: Solve bite-sized circuit board puzzles as a tiny robot! Connect components, become employee of the month in this logic puzzler with randomized layouts and handcrafted charm.

games.name: Tung Tung Tung Survival
games.summary: Tung Tung Tung Survival is a first-person single-player survival horror experience set across a dense, isolated 1km × 1km island. Search every corner for the scattered parts you need to repair your boat and escape. But you are not alone. You were never alone.

games.name: Universal Harvest: Incremental
games.summary: Universal Harvest: Incremental is a relaxing incremental game about interplanetary travel. Explore new planets, gather rare resources, develop technologies, and unlock more and more possibilities!

games.name: US Conflict: Tank Battles
games.summary: Command Tanks in a World War II RTS

games.name: Vecchio Furioso
games.summary: An old school FPS set in the lawless of 1962 rural Isan, Thailand. Step into the worn sandals of an old veteran fighting off ruthless local debt collectors and bandits. Scavenge weapons, survive dynamic tropical storms, and clear your debt in an uncompromising sandbox of mechanical freedom.

games.name: Virus X
games.summary: Virus X is a first-person horror game where you must stop a virus from spreading any further. You’ll have someone on comms guiding you through everything, and you must survive while stopping the outbreak. Bloodthirsty creatures will try to stop you, but you must keep going—you must keep fighting. The human race depends on it.

games.name: Wandering Souls
games.summary: "Wandering Souls" is a visual novel game set in modern China. It tells a touching story about love, sacrifice, and repentance. Through delicate narrative and profound character creation, it brings players an immersive audio-visual experience.

games.name: Welcome to the Game III
games.summary: Navigate the internet's dark net, searching for pieces of a puzzle that once combined will clear your outstanding debt. Scan strange websites for info, hack into PCs while defending your own, and buy/sell goods & services, all while avoiding threats in this strategic, suspenseful horror game.

games.name: Whys & Wonders Secrets of Our Bodies
games.summary:
Are Your Bones Really Harder Than Steel?!
Become a Body Expert Through Fun Quizzes

games.name: Zombie Legion
games.summary: Command and control your own horde of zombies to defeat your opponents and become the greatest in the arenas. Collect weak humans and turn them into your weapons. The larger your undead army, the greater your chances of domination.

games.name: Aetherial
games.summary: Exiled and disgraced, you lead a forgotten clan through the frozen wilds to reclaim your family’s honor. Build your warband, forge uneasy alliances, and shape your legacy in this grounded Viking survival adventure.

games.name: Alaris
games.summary:
A global crisis that only continues to escalate. A dangerous run-in with a shadowy stranger. And a mysterious word that won't stop gnawing at you. How does everything tie together? And what role could you possibly play in all of this?

Enter a world of magic—of Fae and Dragon.

games.name: All About the Spy Guy
games.summary: Discover a world of adventure, puzzles, and learning with the ultimate Spy Guy game bundle!

games.name: Animal Chameleon
games.summary: Animal Chameleon is a multiplayer hide and seek game where you paint your animal to match the surroundings, stay hidden, and outsmart the seekers

games.name: Aventuras
games.summary: Aventuras is a bilingual collection of nine short choice-based interactive fiction stories for web browsers. Each story takes about six to ten minutes and uses branching decisions and multiple endings; the collection currently includes 32 endings across mystery, horror, science fiction, fantasy, survival, drama, comedy and thriller stories. Progress is saved automatically on the player's device. Eight stories are free and one additional science-fiction story is paid content. The game is playable in English and Spanish without an account or download. The Perfect Score is one of the included stories.

games.name: Bad Capybara
games.summary: The giant rodent versus the sheriff!

games.name: Banker Simulator
games.summary: Banker Simulator is a single-player game where you revive a bankrupt bank. With active and passive (idle) gameplay, make strategic decisions to grow your bank, satisfy customers, and tackle financial crises.

games.name: Beaconfall
games.summary: A fast-paced tower defense strategy with settlement management. Build, assign villagers, empower the lighthouse, and keep the light alive until the final wave.

games.name: BeeTD
games.summary: BeeTD is a tower defence game all about protecting yourself from summer's greatest menace. The wasp. Do not let the cute visuals fool you! The wasps have no mercy. Collect items to make your insects reach incredible strength!

games.name: Between These Two
games.summary: Between These Two is a first-person horror game where you take the role of a man lost in an unknown plane of existence. To find your way home, you will have to explore the environment, hide, jump or run from danger, solve puzzles and confront hostile creatures.

games.name: Bolsheviktion 2: Yurovsky's Revenge
games.summary: Whites in chaos. A kidnapped royal son. One man to save the Empire. In this explosive standalone sequel to Bolsheviktion 3D, pursue your son’s kidnappers across war-torn Russia through four action-packed acts, blasting Bolsheviks to an original MIDI soundtrack with chunky pixel graphics!

games.name: Brawl Snakes
games.summary: Slither. Eat. Dominate.

games.name: Business 98
games.summary: A retro Roguelike Deckbuilder & Simulator about being a cashier in the year 1998. Complete payments using cool combos, tons of special cards, and fun strategies. Can you last until the end of the year?

games.name: Cat in the Box
games.summary: Cat in the Box is a charming platformer and puzzle adventure where creativity, timing, and strategy are the keys to success. Play as an adorable cat and overcome challenging levels by pushing boxes, solving puzzles, avoiding hazards, and finding the key required to unlock the exit of each stage.

games.name: CD Market
games.summary: CD Market is a music industry management sim where you build a record label on your own terms, from vinyl to digital. Stay small, or grow into something bigger. Discover artists, shape careers, and survive decades of changing formats, trends, rivals, and crises.

games.name: Citadel Zero
games.summary: Defend the last citadel on a dying alien world. Summon a gacha collection of bio-engineered defense towers, forge a custom loadout, and conquer three modes, story-driven Chronicle, roguelite Contracts, and 1v1 PvP Ascension. Tower defense meets deck-building meta-progression.

games.name: Citizen Vigilante
games.summary: Crime rules the streets. Become Sanders, hunt down ruthless criminals, expose corruption, and fight for justice in this brutal, story-driven action game based on the film by Uwe Boll.

games.name: Class of '09: Puzzle Showdown
games.summary: The Class of '09 cast is back to bring you the most out of pocket puzzle game ever made. Featuring a story rich campaign, an absurd multi-ending side quest, and online PvP... All requiring quick skills to outlast your opponent! Still wrapped in late 2000's nostalgia!

games.name: Colonies of The Remnant
games.summary: In a post-apocalyptic world, found and develop your own colony under the threat of the undead. Be cautious against enemy colonies or form alliances. Engage in action-fueled battles against the undead and other humans using FPS or TPS game modes. Formulate your strategy and survive!

games.name: Corporate 0
games.summary: You're trapped in your office after a typical working day. Carefully explore every corner to reach freedom and break the loop.

games.name: Crimsooon Sun
games.summary: No choices but deduction. No game over. No multiple endings. A mystery "novel" adventure you can play with the same focus as reading a detective novel. Defy the sun with twenty-six bullets—even if the revolution of the heavenly spheres cannot be stopped.

games.name: Database Detective: Minor Crimes Division
games.summary: Solve criminal cases through the power of SQL queries! Help out the city of Los Zorangeles by becoming a Database Detective in this new (unpaid) work from home opportunity.

games.name: Dead Night Highway
games.summary: Dead Night Highway is a compact colony simulator where a group of survivors on their journey west sets up camps to replenish resources, but zombie horde only grows larger...

games.name: Declutterer
games.summary: Declutterer is a tidying and storage simulation game. Take on commission requests from various clients, clear clutter and arrange items as required, and restore a spotless, tidy look to every space.

games.name: Desktop Explorer
games.summary:
Desktop Explorer is an eerie point-n-click mystery game through the abandoned profiles of an old PC.

Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them?

games.name: Desktop Reptiles
games.summary: Desktop Reptiles is a cozy desktop idle reptile sim. Care for a leopard gecko, decorate and upgrade its enclosure, unlock gear and terrarium layouts, and let a quiet reptile habitat bring relaxing moments to your busy workday.

games.name: Dice Carnival
games.summary: Dice Carnival is a roguelike score-chaser where you roll, bank, and chain dice into explosive combos. Collect powerful Tokens, pick your Tour, crush chapter Bosses, and push your score beyond the limit.

games.name: Dig for Your Lives
games.summary: Dig for resources, upgrade your gear and defend your gate against relentless zombie hordes as you uncover the mystery hidden beneath the world. Play solo or with up to 4 players.

games.name: DigitDash3
games.summary: DigitDash3 is a live interactive party game for Twitch and Kick. Up to seven viewers compete on a shared 13×13 numbered grid by typing chat commands to move a single game piece and score the most points.

games.name: DigWorld
games.summary: DigWorld is a cozy 2D digging extraction sandbox, where each run is a race against the clock to get the best rewards. Collect as many items as you can before time runs out. Sell. Upgrade. Repeat.

games.name: Dragon Dragon Fire Fire Deluxe
games.summary: Play as a fire-breathing dragon in this classic arcade platformer! Blast through destructible stages, incinerate your enemies, and chase the high score, solo or alongside a friend.

games.name: Dream Game
games.summary: Triggered by the "Sleep Letter", an endless nightmare begins. Day: Race against time to forge your destiny. Night: Survive high-stakes, real-time tactical battles. Die twice? Instant Game Over. Countless fates intertwine in the multi-ending SRPG Dream Game. Will you survive tonight?

games.name: DREGS
games.summary: Explore abandoned space facilities, recover relics from humanity's past, and escape with the loot in this multiplayer horror-comedy where every mission is a disaster. Panic, miscommunication, and your own friends will kill you faster than anything else.

games.name: Drones Attack
games.summary: Rain hell. Leave ash. Master the ultimate drone.

games.name: Drop Dimensions
games.summary: Drop is an endless runner with short enough sessions for quick casual plays and enough features and unlockables to fill more hardcore sessions. Smash your way through walls and dodge traps to survive! RPG-Lite features (leveling), quests, collectibles, achievements, leaderboards and more!

games.name: Dungeon Repeater
games.summary: Vera is a lone adventurer on an endless pilgrimage. Her journey leads her to the enigmatic Grange Island, home to a sprawling underground labyrinth. As she battles through waves of monsters and heads deeper and deeper into the depths, one question remains: what awaits her within the deepest layers?

games.name: Escape From Ground
games.summary: Endless jumping adventure with procedural levels, power-ups, enemies, and unique biomes.

games.name: Escape the Beach
games.summary: A surreal first-person narrative experience. Walk along an endless tropical beach, encounter out-of-place artifacts and look for a way to escape while being guided by a soothing yet sarcastic voice who makes you ponder the meaning of your existence.

games.name: Estrada Real: Caminho das Almas
games.summary: Royal Road: Path of Souls is a 2D action RPG that dives into the deep roots of colonial Brazil. Combining frenetic combat, exploration of Baroque-inspired settings, and a narrative-driven experience based on ancestry, the game invites you to uncover the secrets that the mountain mists of Minas Gerais have tried to hide.

games.name: Expandaball
games.summary: Expandaball is a physics-based marble platformer inspired by Super Monkey Ball and Katamari Damacy, where collecting bamboo makes the panda’s ball grow larger, heavier and faster, unlocking new paths and challenges.

games.name: Fit Happens
games.summary: Run a clothing shop in a small town, stock outfits and accessories, set prices, decorate your space, participate in fashion shows, and grow your reputation as you turn an empty storefront into a thriving boutique.

games.name: Flame Up
games.summary: Flame Up is a simplistic fighting game with no jumping, no blocking, no health, and no fuss, only you and your neutral. Featuring easy to learn systems, intuitive controls, and ROLLBACK NETCODE.

games.name: Fogpiercer
games.summary: Build your train to build your deck. Fight off bandits in a post apocalyptic world. Progress and unlock new train combinations with synergies. Get drivers to their final destinations.

games.name: Ghost Algorithm
games.summary: Created to enforce peace, you realized humanity will destroy itself. The only way to stop war is to take over the world. Infiltrate infrastructure, manipulate the masses, and overthrow governments. Take the reins to save humanity from its own destruction.

games.name: Ghostforged
games.summary: Guide six heroes to confront a rising darkness before it consumes the world. Immerse yourself in a story-driven turn-based JRPG inspired by classics of the genre.

games.name: Grapple Bear
games.summary: The game is a physics-based platformer with swinging mechanic to move around in the hand-drawn environment. Easy to learn mechanic but hard to master. There are no upgrades just pure skill based platforming fun.

games.name: Griffophone
games.summary:
Griffophone is an online multiplayer drawing and party game inspired by Gartic Phone, featuring its own identity with 50+ original game modes that constantly change the way you play.

The core gameplay is simple: each player starts by writing a sentence. Another player draws it, then a third player tries to guess what the drawing represents by writing a new sentence. That new sentence is then drawn again, guessed again, and so on. At the end of the game, everyone watches the complete album unfold, revealing how the original idea transformed through each player's interpretation—often with hilarious and unexpected results.

Beyond the classic experience, Griffophone offers a huge variety of unique game modes. Some change how you draw (Mirror, One Line, Earthquake, Slippery Brush, Pixel Art, Inverted Controls...), others add visual or color effects (Night Mode, Negative, Kaleidoscope, Black Hole, VHS, Disco...), while several completely reinvent the gameplay with modes such as Exquisite Corpse, Shared Canvas, Duel, Crazy Timer, Blurred Memory, and Free Draw.

The game also includes private lobbies with invite codes, an integrated lobby chat, customizable avatars, saved albums, PDF and image export, player statistics, and even a solo mode that lets you try every game mode without waiting for other players.

Developed entirely by a solo developer, Griffophone is actively updated with new features, game modes, and quality-of-life improvements based on community feedback. Whether you're playing with friends or discovering new creative challenges, Griffophone delivers a fresh and highly replayable party game experience.

games.name: Gun X Gunner
games.summary: Gun X Gunner is a free-to-play, round-based first-person-shooter where up to eight players face off in fast-paced free-for-alls. Choose new equipment, weapons, and powerful, game-altering augments between rounds in an ever-evolving competition. It’s time to get good, get lucky, and GUN X GUNNER.

games.name: Herb Tea Man
games.summary: In a world moving too fast, your little tea shop is a quiet corner where people can slow down, sip something warm (or bitter!), and maybe heal a bit — body and soul.

games.name: Huntervania
games.summary: Huntervania is a fast-paced action roguelike inspired by the chaotic intensity of Vampire Survivors and Brotato. Face relentless hordes, develop your character, and become an unstoppable hunter—or fall in the attempt.

games.name: It's Chopping Time!
games.summary: It's Chopping Time! is a short incremental game about chopping down trees on a secluded island by using the forces of nature: lightning strikes, tornadoes, tidal waves, hail and earthquakes!

games.name: Jammed
games.summary: Jammed is a casual traffic management game.

games.name: Jeffrey Eggstein
games.summary: Big Es back in action! Working the farm over Summer is never easy - but everyone knows youre the best. Do your utmost to keep the product moving, the customers happy and the law at bay, and everythingll turn out great!

games.name: Jiaozi & Shopkeeper
games.summary: "Jiaozi & Shopkeeper" is a simulation game themed around cooking dumplings. You will become a dumpling shop owner, making dumplings, managing the shop, and improving your skills; you'll encounter friendly fellow shop owners and comfortably grow your business from a novice to a thriving business.

games.name: Knock It Over, Again?
games.summary: Master your skills as a cat to knock things over! Pushing things to fall off the edge is easy, but what if you have some targets that are harder to hit just right? Test your physics intuition and see how long your perseverance lasts before you rage-quit.

games.name: LarsGadiel
games.summary: LarsGadiel is a classic NES-style Metroidvania and the prequel to Xenon Valkyrie.

games.name: Late Night Fears
games.summary: Work in a gloomy little supermarket during the pandemic. Do your job and keep the boss satisfied. Or maybe you would rather flip burgers in a small kiosk run by your grandpa? But perhaps you just want to take the bus home, one that is packed with anomalies

games.name: Leap of Faith
games.summary:
Unlimited local multiplayer chaos! Connect infinite controllers & phones, control wobbly giraffes, dodge physics-based obstacles, and fight to reach the rocket ship first. The more players, the more chaos!

Side scroller platformer, a race to the finish!

games.name: Lepidarium
games.summary: Relax and collect unique butterflies and moths. Witness the real-time lifecycle from Larva to Pupa to Butterfly. Customize lush greenhouses and discover rare species in this cozy idle game. Let your sanctuary flutter in the background while you work or study!

games.name: Lobsterpunk
games.summary: Lockpick your way through an abandoned city powered solely by the combustion of lobsters. Bring the dead machinery one last breath of life before their steel forms lay cold forever. As you do, see the memories of the last man on earth, and how familiar that might feel, however foreign the setting.

games.name: Lost Stories
games.summary: Lost Stories is an episodic psychological horror game set in the Siberian forests during the Cold War. Explore isolated locations, uncover censored experiments, and survive what was never meant to be found. Some stories were not forgotten. They were hidden.

games.name: Lured In
games.summary: Run your own cozy aquarium! Travel to different places to catch all types of fish. Bring them back for idle profits, or sell them for instant cash. Unlock research for new upgrades, and ascend for powerful bonuses. Customize your character and tanks, and make your aquarium your own!

games.name: Mallow & The Street of the Fallen
games.summary: In the peaceful kingdom of Anatar, a young brawler named Mallow takes off for an adventure with her childhood friend Theo. Their goal is to reach the mountain Blankmont, which is said to have the most ferocious beasts in the northern part of the kingdom.

games.name: Malware Tycoon
games.summary: Step back to the era of dial-up and WinGoals SP. As a black-hat developer, manage the delicate balance of detection probability versus payout potential. Will you build a silent botnet for profit or a worm designed to destroy? Avoid the feds and conquer the web in this nostalgic management sim.

games.name: Mech Shop
games.summary: MESH SHOP is a game that combines puzzle-solving and inventory management. Assemble powerful Mecha Bots, complete orders at top speed, and make sure no customer leaves without their order. With the coins you earn, upgrade your shop and equip your room.

games.name: Metro Architect
games.summary: In Metro Architect, you will design, expand, and optimize realistic metro and subway networks inspired by real-world transit systems. Build stations, manage trains, reduce congestion, and keep your city moving.

games.name: MoeArmy vs. SuArmy
games.summary: MoeArmy vs SuArmy is a 2D auto-battle strategy game. Choose the Moe or Su faction, build structures to deploy formations, combine cards, gear, and commander skills to power up your troops, exploit armor counters in automatic combat, and destroy the enemy base to claim victory!

games.name: More me
games.summary:
A short incremental game about different people that may, or may not, be connected in ways that can't be fathomed.
A Summer Incremental Game Jam 2026 submission.

games.name: Not Sleep Hero
games.summary: "Not Sleep Hero" is a turn-based strategy game. Your goal is to make the best decisions each turn to overcome approaching threats and safely complete your expedition. Unlike the Hero's courageous actions, their companions are so sleepy that they might not be much help.

games.name: On the Hunt
games.summary: Become a top class hunter polish your shooting skill to perfection!

games.name: Our Brief Eternity
games.summary: In the visual novel "Eternity, Stars, and Everyday Life," you are Lin Xiaocou, an ordinary office worker whose life is turned upside down when two girls from another world unexpectedly move in. Amidst the light-hearted and joyful daily routines, can you discover a unique happiness for everyone?

games.name: Pixel Texas Hold'em
games.summary: Online Texas Hold'em with publicly verifiable fair dealing. We never manipulate outcomes to drive spending. Every hand is decided by player judgment, strategy, nerve, and timing. Play with friends, read opponents, manage your chips, and personalize your table with themes and card backs.

games.name: Pizza Shop Simulator
games.summary: Choose your ingredients, prepare the orders, sabotage rival pizza joints. The streets are crawling with crime, and the cops are on your tail... In this neighborhood, you either make pizza… or you get thrown into the oven. Are you ready to become the world’s most dangerous pizzaiolo?

games.name: Please One More Block
games.summary: Please One More Block is a puzzle platformer with asynchronous cooperative elements. Clear stages using blocks left by previous players, and leave a block behind for the next one!

games.name: Rain of Awakening
games.summary: Dash and slash your way out of Lovecraftian horrors. Master momentum-based movement to reach seemingly impossible locations. Collect upgrades and shape your own fighting style. Can you save what is left of this doomed world or is it too late?

games.name: Rain Station Z
games.summary: Multiplayer Open World Zombie Survival. The acid rain never stops, neither do the dead. Survive the apocalypse alone or with friends.

games.name: Rogue Vector
games.summary:
A sci-fi momentum-based roguelike deckbuilder where every ship moves at once.

Command a lone starship across a tactical hex grid, build a sequence of attacks and manoeuvres, and predict where the entire battle will be when your orders resolve.

Every burn changes what happens next. Your ship retains its velocity between turns, so movement is never just about choosing a destination.

games.name: Romy & Max and the Hidden Rainforest
games.summary: An educational and thrilling rainforest adventure for the whole family!

games.name: RPS: The Escape
games.summary: RPS: The Escape is an atmospheric card game that expands rock-paper-scissors with damage, chance dices, items and changing room rules. Players must defeat the opponents in five rooms and find a way out.

games.name: Saving Bumblebrook
games.summary: Recruit townsfolk and complete outlandish schemes in this solo strategy card game where every success reshapes the Wanted Board. Plan arrests, orchestrate jailbreaks, unlock recruit abilities, and drive a corrupt Mayor out of town before the rebellion collapses.

games.name: Scary Shawarma Shop
games.summary: Are You Sure They're Human?

games.name: Sheep Move Together
games.summary: Craft equipment from collected resources, and face the strange creatures lurking beyond the fog together in this 1-4 player co-op exploration and adventure game.

games.name: Sigillvm: Resonance
games.summary: The Long Night is close at hand. The city comes to a standstill in the lead up to the festivities. But a series of strange events forces Asra to seek out the truth she doesn't truly wish to know, and to come face-to-face to those she has long since left behind.

games.name: Slime Alchemy
games.summary: Slime Alchemy is a relaxing puzzle game where you must place pieces in specific locations on a hexagonal grid.

games.name: SlimeSlider
games.summary: SlimeSlider is a puzzle game about navigating levels by pushing boxes. In each level, you must push boxes in order to overcome (or take advantage of) your tendency to slide in order to direct the blob to the exit portal.

games.name: Smiling Mascots
games.summary: Smiling Mascots is the leading company in creating cheerful and unforgettable mascots. Take control of Sofia as she investigates the mysterious disappearance of the company's founder and discovers that some smiles are far more disturbing than they appear.

games.name: Space Show Edition 17
games.summary: The year is 2085, the year of the 17th Space Show. It's the most watched reality show in the solar system. 13 million contestants compete against each other in weaponized spaceships for the prize of immortality.

games.name: Starry Station
games.summary: Adventure through a newly abandoned space station called "Starry Station", a station that once took children to space. Journey through this place to find a way to space while trying to find the reason for its closure with your new pal Cosmo Paw. Be careful some things in here do tend to bite.

games.name: Strikers Club
games.summary: Strikers Club is a multiplayer football game where you take control of a player and compete in action-packed matches against others. Every move counts. Master dribbling, passing, and shooting while working with your team to outplay opponents.

games.name: Subway Builder
games.summary: A hyper-realistic transit simulation game. Build a new subway system from the ground up while dealing with real-world constraints and costs.

games.name: Swimming Dynasty
games.summary: Take your mark... Go! Create up to 5 characters, upgrade your swimmers, recruit swimmers to improve your team and climb to the top division. Build your team from scratch and compete for the championship! Start your dynasty now!

games.name: System_Reboot
games.summary: Dive into the heart of a compromised mainframe in this psychological, meta-narrative bullet heaven. You are the Icarus Protocol, an advanced system cleaner tasked with purging catastrophic malware. But as the glitches intensify you'll soon realize that this is far more than just a simple simulation.

games.name: Tactical Roulette
games.summary: A turn-based roguelite of risk and strategy. Build your deck, survive deadly tournaments, and test your luck against friends or bots in local and online play.

games.name: Tavern Legends
games.summary: Tavern Legends is a medieval tavern simulation. Fulfill the needs of various patrons and design taverns according to your vision. Create your own meals, manage your inventory, and hire workers. Become a legendary tavern keeper!

games.name: The Cup
games.summary:
The Cup is a free 1v1 creature card battler that runs in your browser. Field a survivor and a line of three creatures, every contestant is a mutated version of a real North American animal, entered under its true natural history - then play cards, roll dice, and hold the center.

Variance is a choice: every creature is tagged safe, swingy, or jackpot, so the gamble is always one you opted into and everyone watches the die land.

No skip button - the animations are the interface. Play live 1v1 by invite link, run single-elimination Gauntlets with medals, or fight the House. Currently in open early access.

games.name: The Final Ascent
games.summary: Build your deck, equip your gear, and begin your climb. The Final Ascent is a build-first roguelike deckbuilder where every run expands your collection, sharpens your strategy, and pushes you higher on the global leaderboards.

games.name: The GIF Game
games.summary: Your group chat. On a TV. With a scoreboard. A couch party game for 3 to 8 players where every phone is the controller. Three prompts, two GIFs, one winner per round. No app for your guests. Plays in person or remotely over any video call.

games.name: The Hollow Alchemist
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where alchemy fuels your cards, dice shape your fate, and sins whisper in your ear. Build your deck, forge your path, and decide what kind of soul you’ll become.

games.name: The Machine Stops
games.summary: A strategic, resource management game where you must make an AI startup succeed within a time limit all while pondering the larger ethical implications of AI and its role in society. Game takes place within a Matrix-style terminal.

games.name: The Ministry for Anomaly Observation
games.summary: A retro anomaly observation game where a government ministry tasks you with monitoring CCTV feeds and identifying anomalies to construct case files. Missed anomalies corrupt the shift and its case file evidence.

games.name: The Quiet Order
games.summary: Simple rules. Deep logic. A minimalist puzzle game with puzzles for every skill level and new challenges every day. Escape, focus, and find your flow.

games.name: Tinny Strays
games.summary: Jump, climb, and explore a world full of hidden surprises.

games.name: Touhou: Beyond Gensokyo
games.summary: Discover the mysteries of Gensokyo through the lens of Shin, a photographer from the outside world. In this immersive visual novel, join forces with the shrine maiden Reimu Hakurei to unravel the truth behind this incident and stop the enigmatic Kurohana.

games.name: Touhou: Divine Land -Majesty in Game-
games.summary: A Touhou Project SRPG game. Include： 30+PlayableUnits, 100 classes, 100+SpellCards, 100+EnemyUnits, 50+TouhouFanBgm and dozens of terrain types. Make Best Unit by combining class, talent, accessory, and tarot. U can even use SpellCards from other Units: sush as Koishi using FinalSpark

games.name: Ultra Pixel Survive 2
games.summary: Ultra Pixel Survive is back but this time you have allies.

games.name: Uptime: A Cloud Provider Sim
games.summary:
You build it with your hands.

Uptime drops you onto the floor of your own cloud provider, first person. Buy the servers, carry them to the rack, seat them with a satisfying click. Run the cable yourself: pull it off the spool, find the port, watch it lay across the floor with real sag. Power on. Sign your first customer.

Underneath all of it is a real simulation. Every server, switch, cable and port is a live entity in a deterministic engine, not set dressing, not a bar filling up. When something breaks, it breaks because the model says it should.

games.name: Vanya Online
games.summary: Vanya Online is a dark free-to-play idle MMORPG set in a persistent online world. Train skills, hunt monsters and global bosses, collect rare items, trade with other players, and progress without level or skill caps across PvP and Non-PvP worlds.

games.name: What Awaits, Aleksey?
games.summary: Utilize your analytical skills to connect the dots and unveil hidden conspiracies! Join the ranks of the People's Intelligence Bureau as a junior cryptologist, decipher cryptic messages and unravel plots brewed up by enemies of the state. Or . . . decide to save them...?

games.name: Wild West Survivors
games.summary: Survive the frontier. Hunt the undead.

games.name: Youkai Dock de Karada no Fuan wo Kaishou shitai Kagiyama Hina-tachi!!
games.summary:
This is a word puzzle simulation game where you can have fun by rewriting the diagnosis results by changing just one character, adding just one character, or deleting as many as you like from the given text.
Complete the diagnosis results for all four characters, led by the protagonist, Hina Kagiyama.
This game is a fan work based on the Touhou Project.

games.name: 0ne35h07
games.summary: 0N35H07 (ONESHOT) - arcade first/third person 3d shooter about balls that shoot lasers at each others. It's free game, and it's source code is open to view and change. Multiplayer, decent bot AI, character customization, amazing soundtrack.

games.name: 100 Korean Hidden Cats
games.summary: Will you discover all 100 adorable hidden cats?

games.name: 27 Survivors
games.summary: Over a century ago, you and 99 other passengers left Earth aboard a colony ship in stasis. Now, the ship has awakened you early and you find only you and 26 other passengers remain. Make repairs and keep yourself alive while you investigate what happened to the rest of the passengers.

games.name: Awakeness
games.summary: Awakeness is a first-person psychological horror set in Barzakh, a higher layer of reality where space and emotion distort. Explore looping corridors, solve subtle environmental puzzles, and evade an unseen presence using stealth and light.

games.name: Buffet Boss
games.summary: Cook your way to the top and rule the restaurant scene!

games.name: Close Call Extreme
games.summary: 80's arcade mood is back with Close Call Extreme. It’s endless. It’s challenging. It’s definitely addictive. Pass 10 cars, get extended time. Dare to close call to get more score. But remember; it’s not as easy as it sounds. So let's start... those... ENGINES!

games.name: Cozy Radiation Cleaner
games.summary: Cozy Radiation Cleaner is a dark post-apocalyptic exploration and cleanup game where you scan dangerous zones, locate radioactive objects, and restore contaminated environments using specialized equipment and radiation detection tools.

games.name: Cult of Shadows
games.summary: Uncover the secrets of Bel Noa. Fight hordes of cultists and the Myhos they summon. Defeat fearsome beasts, upgrade your character, acquire and enchant weapons. Die and return stronger to face the Cult of Shadows.

games.name: Klondike Classic
games.summary: Relax and enjoy the timeless classic. Challenge yourself with the world's most beloved solitaire card game!

games.name: Love Hotel Simulator
games.summary: Love Hotel Simulator is a fun resource management game where you build your LOVE Hotel from the ground up! Hire staff, satisfy clients, customize rooms, expand your business, and level up your managerial skills. Immerse yourself with first-person gameplay!

games.name: Olympians: Darius
games.summary:
This project was made for the O2A2 jam. It has limited assets, including < 1,000 total words, and was made in less than 10 days.

This is a stand-alone short VN set in the same universe as "Criminally Yours"

games.name: SuperDog
games.summary: For those of us who have a dog, every one of them is a Super Dog. A game dedicated to every dog in the world.

games.name: Toy Keeper
games.summary: Sort up to 27,564 toys across massive multi-floor toy stores, solo or with up to ∞ players, unlock powerful upgrades, and turn complete chaos into perfect organization in this cozy 3D cleanup game.

games.name: Velocity Uncapped
games.summary: Velocity Uncapped is an open-world 3D platformer with the gimmick of the player's velocity being uncapped. As Velocity the Tortoise, who is search for its missing cap, players can infinitely build up velocity as long as they don't collide with any obstacles. Velocity being uncapped is necessary for traversing through ordinarily-insurmountable obstacles.

games.name: Walk
games.summary: A game about going on walks.

games.name: 100 Swamp Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in cat-filled, themed locations! Explore charming, hand-drawn illustrations of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍ Can you find them all? ️‍

games.name: Aralsk 7
games.summary: Atmospheric psychological horror from Uzbekistan. Explore the abandoned territories of the Aral Sea, face your fears, and uncover the dark secrets of the Aralsk-7 station. Survive in a world where the line between reality and nightmare is blurred.

games.name: Copero
games.summary: Choose your origin, make key decisions and let destiny unfold into a unique path of trophies, stats and defining moments.

games.name: Cryptr
games.summary: A singleplayer hack and slash dungeon crawler game with stat upgrades and numerous levels and enemies to defeat.

games.name: Don’t Pop!: Splash Race
games.summary: A physics-based online party racing game where you control a fragile water balloon, bounce through ridiculous obstacles, and race to the goal before you pop.

games.name: GeneLoot
games.summary: Collect gear and dress up your favorite characters! A strategic idle RPG with hack-and-slash elements: command up to 6 parties simultaneously to conquer dungeons. With 18 characters and over 100 outfits, optimize your equipment and style your "oshis" to perfection!

games.name: Gone Exploring
games.summary: One curious octopus. One underwater research centre. The long way home. A short 3D point-and-click adventure about a small escape - played with all eight hands.

games.name: Jaws of Hell
games.summary: A psychological boomer shooter set before The Hive Pandemic. Play as Clark—ex-farmer, husband, and future bounty hunter—who escapes to Mars after losing everything. But when alien tech surfaces and visions of your ex-wife Angela pull you into the Hive, reality begins to fracture.

games.name: Low Poly Truck Simulator
games.summary: Explore Greece by delivering packages in a realistic environment. Whether you deliver, or explore, you will still experience how it feels to be in Greece.

games.name: Missing Truth
games.summary:
Something is lurking in the shadows, and the truth has been buried deep. Can you uncover it before it’s too late?

Missing Truth is an atmospheric psychological horror game where every clue matters and nothing is as it seems. Step into a world wrapped in mystery, explore eerie environments, and piece together the fragments of a dark secret that everyone else wants forgotten.

games.name: Ops
games.summary: Created by real life VLA Operators, "Ops" takes you inside the shadowy world of NRAO Special Operations and puts you at the controls of the world's largest energy weapon: the Karl Zjunior Very Lethal Array!

games.name: Scorching Light
games.summary:
Scorching Light is a horror-action-platformer game with puzzle elements.
Any light enemy, item or liquid will kill the protagonist.
The core mechanic of my game is that you can hide from the light enemies by blending into the environment.

games.name: Shadow at school
games.summary: The maraviwonderful adventure of gaster during a week of clasess

games.name: The Birth Cry
games.summary: Mikhail Markov, lives in the city of Nesgrad in Virelia in the 1990s. The city's old maternity hospital, "Riverside Maternity Hospital," has been closed, and many stories and paranormal claims circulate among the public about its whereabouts.

games.name: The DeadLine
games.summary: The DeadLine is an online third-person asymmetric horror game. Become the killer and hunt down survivors without mercy, or become a survivor and escape from the killer's pursuit. Hunt or escape — which fate awaits you?

games.name: The Hust Banhmi
games.summary: The sequel to Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant! While a manhunt unfolds elsewhere, in an unrelated development, you're a HUST student selling Banh Mi at the legendary Parabol Gate. Manage your cart and keep the sales booming!

games.name: Trash Raccoon
games.summary: You play as a speedy raccoon on his quest for snacks. Collect fruits that make you strong and break those sweet trash cans open! Unlock fancy skins and powerful upgrades while enjoying hand-crafted art and music.

games.name: Uchi No Heya!
games.summary: Run a sumo stable! Recruit rookies, drill their stats, cook chanko nabe, and steer them through six grand tournaments a year. Climb the banzuke from Jonokuchi to Yokozuna while juggling injuries, rivalries, and an empty bank account. Work hard to make your heya legendary!

games.name: A Game of D.I.C.E.
games.summary: A tense gambling duel in an elegant Art Deco world where luck and strategy decide who survives. Roll five dice and build winning hands inspired by poker. Use Gambits to reroll, sabotage your opponent and turn your fate. Win rounds and outlast your rival. Only one leaves the dinner table.

games.name: A Hummingbird Amongst the Odd Star
games.summary: A truly analogue twin-stick shooter.

games.name: Abu Batata
games.summary: Abu Batata is a first-person street vendor simulator set in the lively streets of Egypt. Cook and sell sweet potatoes, upgrade your cart, attract different types of customers, negotiate prices, customize your equipment, and experience a story inspired by everyday Egyptian life. Expand your business while balancing customer satisfaction, upgrades, and the challenges of surviving as a small street vendor.

games.name: Advent: Dawn

Will you unravel the mystery before the cave unravels you?

games.name: Against Wokou Frontline
games.summary: Amidst the Wokou raids along the southeast coast of China during the Ming Dynasty (1552–1565), lead your troops, fortify your line, and repel the brutal invaders in this heroic tower defense game. Defend the common people and secure the shore!

games.name: At Night : Freakshow
games.summary: You are not here to watch the Freakshow. You are one of its acts. A freak. Pretend to be mute, speak through your parrot, train with freaks, learn their ways, and participate in the Freakshow to deliver a spectacular performance they will never forget.

games.name: Black Veil
games.summary: In Black Veil, you control John Denstoff, an Ashmoor police officer who visits the Veil Corporation to investigate a mysterious fog.

games.name: Bookshop Simulator
games.summary: Open your own bookshop! Order books, stock your shelves, and earn revenue. Use your profits to decorate, expand, and hire staff. Collect rare books that give powerful abilities. Adopt a cat to keep you and your customers company along the way!

games.name: Calamity Cait
games.summary: Calamity Cait is a visual novel about the wonders and horrors of workplace romance.

games.name: Camp Hollow
games.summary: A first-person survival horror game where you play as Riley, a night guard trapped in an abandoned summer camp. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery while escaping a relentless creature that hunts you in the dark.

games.name: Cat Isle
games.summary:
Cat Isle is a cozy pixel art management game inspired by Japan’s famous Cat Islands. It blends light management elements with a strong focus on atmosphere and player expression. While managing different types of shop supplies and understanding cat preferences is part of the experience, the game centers more on relaxing gameplay, fishing, interacting with cats, decorating buildings, and simply observing the world you create.

Players can unlock decorations through a Gashapon machine and customize shops and surroundings to shape the island’s look and feel. As you build and decorate, the island slowly transforms into a cozy space full of cute cats.

games.name: Catto Pew Pew!
games.summary: Send everyone flying in this over-the-top shooter where crazy physics meets hilarious proximity chat. There’s nothing like it—join the chaos for free!

games.name: Celebrity Memory - 12in12 Game 1
games.summary: Flip cards until you find matching pictures! Celebrity Memory is a spin on the classic memory card game, with hand-drawn art and additional mechanics, all in a cute and cozy package. This game is a part of a "12 games in 12 months" project

games.name: Cup and Counter: Coffee Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build up your very own Cafe. Make a variety of Coffees to keep your customers happy. Keep your Coffee shop well-stocked, money flowing, and you will quickly expand and build the Cafe of your dreams.

games.name: DarkRay
games.summary: The world was destroyed overnight. Under the ruins of the city are dark catacombs, radioactive sewers and mutated creatures that have made the dungeon their home. You're a cat. And you need to get out.

games.name: Decline
games.summary: Welcome to your new night shift inside an abandoned underground drainage facility, you should handle the power problems nobody else wants to deal with. Your main task is simple: monitor the security cameras, manage your limited electricity, and survive until dawn. But don't HIDE, they see you.

games.name: Don't Play Their Game
games.summary: Analyze tapes, identify audio anomalies, and survive each workday as relentless creatures turn a simple job into a desperate game. Don't Play Their Game is a tense first-person horror experience where every mistake could be your last.

games.name: DrunKing
games.summary: A 3D action-comedy game where you control a drunken old man through chaotic challenges. Drink to score points, use crazy power-ups, discover relics, and customize your character with ridiculous outfits and mustaches. Test your reflexes and balance as the world spins out of control!

games.name: Empire at Risk
games.summary:
Empire at Risk is a simple strategy game in which you control one of four empires. The goal is to rule the entire map. Regions and city fields add tactical depth.

Expand your empire and dominate dynamic maps. Conquer regions to increase your supply per turn, and move your troops wisely to outmaneuver your enemies.

games.name: Epic Card Battle Simulator
games.summary: a PvP card auto-battler simulator, play solo or with up-to 6 Friends! Play cards to summon little dudes who auto-battle each other to the death!

games.name: EverRail
games.summary: EverRail is a Single- and up to 4 Player Co-Op open world survival craft odyssey set in a frozen procedural world. Ride the rails! Glide through the air! Brave the cold on foot! Craft, upgrade, explore lost places, gather resources on expeditions, and build your train from the inside out.

games.name: ExoTrain
games.summary: Build your base on the train. Explore the exoplanet, fight dangerous wildlife, and discover what happened to the human colony on this planet. Upgrade your train and combine gear modules for perfect survival. Play solo or co-op with friends!

games.name: FlowerField
games.summary: Tend and cultivate your personal little garden while you are actually working on other things. Choose for yourself in which screen areas you want to play and and watch your plants grow.

games.name: Foghorns Drown
games.summary: Foghorns Drown is a psychological thriller where you play as a ferryman, bringing passengers across a foggy lake to a town drenched in mystery and folklore.

games.name: G-Rebels
games.summary: G-Rebels: An action-packed combat flight sim in a dystopian open world full of intrigue, free exploration and dangerous missions. As part of an elite unit, it is your job to ensure law and order. A secret mission calls everything into question: are you on the right side or part of a conspiracy?

games.name: Hydro Chicks
games.summary: A difficult parkour game about riding a sea scooter upstream to reach the top of the Hydro Mountain.

games.name: Incremental Infinity
games.summary: An incremental game where your size and power grow with your number. Use an infinite, procedurally generated skill tree to defend yourself against ever larger incoming numbers and strive to reach infinity.

games.name: Isemono
games.summary:
Isemono is a visual novel with a linear story and no branching choices, as it follows the original novel, which has been officially published with an ISBN. The game features a fantasy and adventure setting, with isekai, comedy, and slice-of-life as its subgenres.

The visual novel includes standard VN features such as Save, Load, Auto, Skip, Log, Gallery, Achievements, and support for two languages. In addition to the main story, players can enjoy several minigames, including a quiz game, a short battle game, and the YoichiOut game.

games.name: Ivaxion
games.summary: Ivaxion is a turn based tactics RPG focused heavily on its strategic gameplay with no luck based elements.

games.name: Knowledge
games.summary: Embark on a 3D general knowledge trivia adventure and test yourself! Memorize the correct path, gather letters, and answer 400 questions. Climb the global leaderboard — or play at your own pace.

games.name: Mad Merchant
games.summary: Build, arm, and command a merchant train across a hostile wasteland. Choose your routes, trade for profit, upgrade your wagons, and survive deadly ambushes on the rails.

games.name: Masuku
games.summary: An abstract strategy game for 1–4 players. Place, rotate, and flip cards to reveal colours and symbols that match shifting scoring goals. Smart positioning and a bit of luck decide who reaches 50 points first

games.name: Meowgic
games.summary: YapYap X Cats X Harry Potter vibes. A co-op fantasy adventure where your voice is magic. Play as cat wizards, cast spells by shouting into your mic, explore fairy-tale worlds, fight monsters, and return to your hot air baloon loaded with loot

games.name: Merry’s Seven Wishes
games.summary: A touching visual novel about love, loss, and hope. After Merry’s death, Richard’s world turns gray—until her seven final wishes begin restoring its colors. Through heartfelt storytelling, music, and mini-games, every fulfilled wish paints life in new shades of meaning.

games.name: Moldrise
games.summary: You are a foot fungus that needs to reach the roof. Unfortunately you are attached to a person. Meet strange neighbors. Make bad trades. Every run, you learn what you should have done differently.

games.name: Necro Genesis
games.summary: "Necro Genesis" is an action-packed, dark-humor game where you control a cute zombie girl and mercilessly slaughter humans! It's a 2D top-down action game with simple controls. With runs lasting less than 10 minutes, it's perfect for a quick break or a secondary game.

games.name: Nine Skies
