The course splits along the way, where deserts, coastlines, and city nightscapes dynamically flash past. Goals all around the world?! Cross the finish line and claim your glorious checkered flag!

games.name: Arcade Archives: TX-1
games.summary:
"TX-1" is a racing game released by TATSUMI in 1983.
Enjoy a powerful race, unique to the triple-screen display.
The course splits along the way, where deserts, coastlines, and city nightscapes dynamically flash past. Goals all around the world?! Cross the finish line and claim your glorious checkered flag!

games.name: Asteranova
games.summary: Fast-paced vertical scrolling space shooter featuring intense boss battles, challenging enemy waves, and score-driven arcade gameplay.

games.name: Be Kind Rewind
games.summary: The fate of movie night is in your hands.

games.name: Beats of Un'sonia
games.summary: Dive into a rhythmic combat game where every move counts! Adapt your playstyle, explore diverse biomes, face epic bosses, and push your score higher. Face the beat... and conquer it!

games.name: Ben's Zombie Apocalypse
games.summary: That unstoppable arcade addiction is back, once you start, you can't stop! Ben and Carmen, two agents, join the fight! Blast zombie heads and take down the towering bosses closing in!

games.name: Bicycle Quiz & Riding
games.summary:
A game to learn about the Blue Ticket system
Two gameplay modes: Quiz and Action
Simultaneous Japanese and English display

games.name: Blackwood Lodge: The Siblings
games.summary: Uncover the dark secrets of Blackwood Lodge in this atmospheric psychological horror game. As John Wilson, use your lighter to brave the dark, explore fractured spirit memories, and solve puzzles to piece together a tragic crime, all while evading a terrifying supernatural stalker.

games.name: Bloody Grids
games.summary: A single move to carve a path through blood.Use the information on the grid to avoid, fight, and devour unseen enemies in this Minesweeper-style puzzle adventure.

games.name: Blue Flag Down, Guard Up
games.summary: A fast-paced Blue Flag, White Flag arcade game where a split-second choice determines your score. Follow changing commands to test your reflexes and focus. Enjoy classic rules with fresh features, perfect for casual family fun.

games.name: Blue Reflection
games.summary:
A remaster of the first Blue Reflection game included in the Blue Reflection Quartet bundle.
Textures and character models have been updated to high resolution versions, and new visual effects such as glistening water add to the world’s atmosphere. New quality of life features such as autosave and increased movement speed have been included, offering a more enjoyable experience than ever before.

games.name: Blue Reflection Ray
games.summary:
A condensed game adaptation of the Blue Reflection Ray's anime included in the Blue Reflection Quartet bundle.

Follow Hiori and Ruka as they explore the Common while re-experiencing their memories on their way to confront a girl trying to recreate the world. New short stories expand on the anime’s story, and a new prologue and epilogue connect this entry to the other works in the series.

games.name: Blue Reflection Sun
games.summary:
An offline remake of the Blue Reflection Sun gacha game inclunded in the Blue Reflection Quartet bundle.
It has been remade as a console game using the systems of Blue Reflection: Second Light to recreate the memorable battles of the original game. 24 new character events have been added alongside the main story.

games.name: Blue Reflection: Second Light
games.summary: A new release of Second Light included in the Blue Reflection quartet bundle. This release features eight additional characters from Ray and Sun who can join you in battle, as well as new quality of life features such as increased battle speed, faster movement speed while exploring, and event fast-forwarding.

games.name: Bobble and the Tri-Crystal
games.summary: Swim, shoot, and save the ocean! Play as a detective fish in this fast-paced 2D Game Boy-style shoot 'em up! Unlock multiple weapons, defeat enemy hordes, and defeat bosses before it's too late!

games.name: Boli
games.summary: Boli is a retro-style JRPG with hand-drawn ASCII art. Venture forth into the wilderness to find a cure for a rare disease that is decimating your village.

games.name: Boreal Tenebrae Act 0
games.summary: A surreal narrative adventure set on the night Tamarack Narrows collapses into static, fire, and aurora. Follow Sarah, Bree, and the townsfolk as an unknown visitor arrives promising salvation. A lo-fi, analog-horror

games.name: Bowling in a Skate Park
games.summary: Analyze the playfield, find the best trajectory, pick the right time and go for a strike hit.

games.name: Bringers of Darkness
games.summary: Fight for the forces of darkness in a fast-paced bullet heaven survivors-like. Become a champion of darkness, master unique abilities, and bring ruin to the kingdoms of light that created their own nightmares.

games.name: Buttons Up! 2
games.summary: The Gnomes are back! Buttons Up! is a incremental button collecting game where you hoard Buttons and keep them safe from stealing intruders. Get those Buttons Up by buying and crafting buildings. Unlock new skills from the tech tree and automate your income!

games.name: Card Homestead
games.summary: Card Homestead is a roguelike deckbuilder where card placement decides everything. Each day, draft one of three delivered cards and stack them onto your plot, engineering powerful chain reactions. Produce gold with efficient synergies and layouts to survive the ever-rising taxes.

games.name: Cento
games.summary: CENTO is a game where you enter commands in time with music and activate skills to fight. Collect gifts while reinforcing your skills and fight on stages with a wide variety of songs!

games.name: Chameleon Dummy Hunt
games.summary:
Can you spot what does not belong?
Chameleon Dummy Hunt is a colorful first-person hidden-object action game where sneaky dummy.

games.name: ChronoQuest VR
games.summary: Narrative VR adventure inspired by classic graphic adventures. Explore historical eras, interact with characters, and solve story-driven puzzles through dialogue and immersive environments. Designed for experienced players who enjoy story-driven challenges.

games.name: CipherMind
games.summary: Explore the eerie ruins, complete missions to obtain clues, deduce one's own and others' identities, and finally escape.

games.name: Click Build Repeat
games.summary: Click Build Repeat is an incremental game about building and collecting model kits.

games.name: Console Archives: Doraemon
games.summary:
Doraemon was released by Hudson (current Konami) in 1986 for an 8-bit home console.
This is an action game in which Doraemon goes on adventure using various Secret Gadgets to search for Nobita, Shizuka, Gian, Suneo who have been sent to "Space," "The haunts of evil," and "Undersea" due to a problem with their Time machine.
Once you defeat the bosses in each world and rescue all of them, a wonderful ending awaits you!

games.name: Crayon Mandala
games.summary: Enjoy healing time with your family through soothing mandala coloring!

games.name: Culdcept The First Saturn Tribute
games.summary:
The Culdcept series has captivated players worldwide. Now, the original masterpiece returns, enhanced with convenient new features.

Build your deck from over 300 types of cards and witness the dawn of a new battle among Cepter.

games.name: Cute Animals
games.summary: Adorable animal puzzles where toddlers learn, explore & grow.

games.name: Cyber City: Science Crime Mystery
games.summary:
The evidence is hidden in the artwork.
Find the truth with a keen eye — a cyber sci-fi mystery!

games.name: Defense of Fort Burton
games.summary:
Defense of Fort Burton is a top-down action RPG that fuses intense hero combat with strategic tower defense. Rebuild a besieged fortress, master legendary heroes, and face waves of corrupted creatures in heroic battles for survival.

This is a single player gameplay with blend of action and strategy. Defeat the series of various enemies, each enemies bring different character and ways to defeat them. Fight against unique bosses through at the climax situation.

games.name: Destroy The Universe: Solar Mayhem
games.summary: Choose a planet. Unleash cosmic weapons. Decide how the world ends.

games.name: Digital Survivor
games.summary: A neon bullet-heaven survivors roguelite. Outrun the swarm as 4 hunted programs, forge 20 weapons into ultimate forms, master build-defining synergies, raid extraction vaults, climb leaderboard seasons — and face ROOT, the administrator that wants you deleted.

games.name: Dimension Defenders
games.summary: Tower Defense Redefined. Race friends in ranked 1v1, defend together in 2-player co-op, or solo your way through dimensions of escalating chaos.

games.name: Dinosaurium
games.summary: Crack. Hatch. Roar. Extinction was never the end. Hatch and raise hundreds of unique dinosaurs through real-time growth in this cozy idle game. Your prehistoric park thrives with ancient giants, even while you work or study.

games.name: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Super Limit-Breaking Neo
games.summary:
Super Limit-Breaking Neo has come to Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero
Adding new Playable Characters, new Customization, new Stages, and Solo Mode!
Experience the Super Limit-Breaking battle!

Adding about 30 characters including those joining the Budokai Tenkaichi series for the first time such as Super 17, Bardock, Super Saiyan, and Champa and Vegeta (GT)!

games.name: Dramatic Road: The Origin of Wind
games.summary: A full-fledged simulation RPG set in modern Japan! A variety of characters unique to modern times, such as riders, magicians, and baseball players, have appeared. Command them, nurture them, and use their skills to protect the peace of the school!

games.name: Eden Coil
games.summary:
upgrade your snake
manage more snakes at once
solve puzzles

games.name: Elementis TD
games.summary: Elementis TD is an elemental tower defense game. Basic towers are intentionally weak, and the core mechanic consists of combining them into 21 discoverable fusions. A Corruption system can affect the player's own towers during a wave. The game features a 7-chapter campaign, an endless mode with progressive scaling, and 90 achievements.

games.name: Escape game R00m15
games.summary: Explore 3D space and escape

games.name: Exstetra
games.summary: The only way to save the world is a kiss——. 《EXSTETRA》 is a fantasy RPG set in “Amazia,” a Tokyo fused with another world and burdened with a doomed fate, where you rise as the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” to confront the threat of the world’s destruction.

games.name: Fantasy Journey
games.summary: The core combat gameplay is similar to Sekiro, emphasizing precise parrying, counterattacks, and dodging—players can even trigger powerful counters with regular attacks. The game features richly detailed environments and a vast, expansive world map.

games.name: Fantasy Maiden Wars: Dream of the Stray Dreamer
games.summary: A fantasy tactical RPG where you command over 70 characters across grid-based battles. Customize skills, unleash flashy Spell Cards, and enjoy rich animations in a strategic, story-driven adventure set in the world of Touhou.

games.name: Forgotten Playland: Party Edition
games.summary: Step into Forgotten Playland: Party Edition, a 4-player social party game where the attic becomes your Playland and PlushKyn take center stage. Compete, socialize, and express yourself in a beautifully crafted world.

games.name: Get Fit: Beach Workout
games.summary: Train with hot beach trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer,

games.name: Hachishakusama
games.summary: 『She Is Always Right Beside You』 The fate of one summer — a boy beloved by the eight-feet-tall Hachishakusama, the urban legend. A heartwarming yet terrifying Japanese horror game.

games.name: Hex Core
games.summary: Hex Core is a short, incremental clicker-style defense game where you help PeteOS hold back waves of viruses until you can wipe them out for good. Spend resources to unlock a huge spread of upgrades, new mechanics, weapons, and research.

games.name: How Many Dudes?
games.summary: How many dudes does it take to beat up 1000 toddlers? A gorilla? Twelve bears and a horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out.

games.name: Hyperstacks
games.summary:
Hyperstacks is a VR world of combat, parkour, logic-driven puzzles, memorable characters, and community-made levels.
Meet its residents through quests and discover a growing library of player creations.

games.name: Ira
games.summary: A character-based shooter with roguelike elements, IRA celebrates the artistry of what shooter fans call “bullet hell”: enemy projectiles that weave intricate, geometric patterns across the screen and force you to seek out the precarious safe spaces between them. Set in an Eastern-influenced fantasy world marked by ethereal beauty as well as grave danger, it’s a procedurally generated action game that requires skill, inspires strategy and rewards patience.

games.name: Jump Protocol
games.summary: Leap across towering rooftops, wall-run over obstacles, and master fast-paced parkour as you race through a dangerous city filled with enemies and challenging platforming.

games.name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
games.summary: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Norse Gods, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

games.name: Kimi ni Madoi, Kimi ni Oboreru.
games.summary: An omegaverse visual novel by Otomate.

games.name: Kusan: City of Wolves
games.summary:
Kusan: City of Wolves is a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter where players fight through a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption to save Haru — a girl fitted with a city-grade atomic weapon.

Welcome to Kusan: City of Wolves, a brutal top-down shooter set in a neon-drenched urban jungle consumed by violence and corruption.

Kusan delivers hardcore action where one mistake means death. Master gunplay, perfect your movement, survive the streets and combat arenas ruled by furious kingpins that demand speed, precision and flawless execution. Every moment of action is intensified by Korean hip-hop heavyweight Loptimist’s adrenaline-fuelled soundtrack drenched with head-bopping loops and deep 808s pushing you forward without mercy.

games.name: La vieja contra el Dibu
games.summary: The judge thought it was funny. He gave the kid a choice: two years behind bars, or get his mother to score a goal against the best goalkeeper in the world. The kid chose his old lady, he didn’t even think twice. So the judge signed off on the fine print: 30 penalty kicks, one per day. And if none of them go in, the kid will no longer get two years. He’ll be sentenced to death. No one asked the old lady, who’s sixty years old and has never even kicked a football. Nor did they tell Dibu that on the other side there was a woman. Or maybe they did, and that’s why he agreed. He waits for her every morning between the posts. He talks to her. He makes fun of her. He dances. She shows up every morning nonetheless.

games.name: Laptop Architect
games.summary: Design laptops from the PCB up and build a global tech empire! Balance complex heat and power mechanics, manage your corporate budget, and conquer international markets. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Laptop Architect?

games.name: Leafy Corner
games.summary: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

games.name: LEGO Party!
games.summary: LEGO(R) Party! is a 4-player party game that's built different! Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like Pirates, Space, NINJAGO and more. Play your way! Join your friends no matter their platform locally or online!

games.name: Loot Before the Law
games.summary: Sneak through guarded corridors, avoid police patrols, and steal valuable loot without being detected. Study their routes, stay out of sight, and escape before the law catches up with you.

games.name: Ludus: A Gladiator Story
games.summary: A fully voiced branching narrative RPG of the Roman arena with a unique engraving and VO for every choice and outcome. Four origins, over 1,800 choices, and 19 endings. You will bleed on the sand. The only question is whether you bleed for them, or for yourself. Every choice leaves a scar.

games.name: Machine Party
games.summary: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.

games.name: Mechaconda
games.summary: Survive hordes of monsters and bosses while collecting cards that add unique ability upgrades to the body of a small snake Mechaconda.

games.name: Midnight Moments
games.summary: A small, cyberpunk diorama-building game where you create cozy rain-soaked backstreets, glowing apartment blocks, or quiet neighbourhood corners. Decorate your designs with props and place citizens, crafting stories that bring your city to life. At your own pace. No goals. Just vibes.

games.name: Mikane's Hand
games.summary: A girl's card battle world — where you witness the turmoil of youth. What is this place?

games.name: Mimicry!
games.summary: Blend into the environment and eat objects around you as a sneaky Mimic, or burn, zap, and explode everything as a crafty Exterminator to root out the Mimics in this Prop-Hunt inspired multiplayer game of chaos and frenetic fun!

games.name: Moon Corona
games.summary: open your eyes from the ancient temple and embark on this adventure! Embark on an RPG adventure in a dark-themed sandbox world. Explore vast lands, collect all kinds of cards, craft diverse combinations, and make pivotal choices—seeking lost truths and redemption in the chaos and danger.

games.name: Mycubium
games.summary: Mycubium is a first-person 3D puzzle platformer where you grow bridges using mushrooms in a minimalist cubic world. Explore and solve spatial puzzles across shifting landscapes filled with secrets, platforming challenges, and evolving mechanics. Build your path as the day fades to night.

games.name: Nazi Zombies
games.summary: Nazi Zombies is a cooperative survival game where players fend off escalating waves of Nazi zombies, earning points by killing zombies and repairing barriers to buy weapons, upgrades, perks, and unlock new map areas to maximize their survival.

games.name: Neko Odyssey
games.summary: Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

games.name: Nightmare Shift
games.summary: Nightmare Shift is a psychological horror game that follows a female protagonist who starts a new job as a motel receptionist, only to find her life spiraling into a dark and mysterious reality. As she questions her sanity, she must uncover the truth behind the eerie and abnormal events around her.

games.name: Noun Town: Learn & Chill
games.summary: Learn 500+ words across 12 languages (including Japanese + Spanish). Test your vocabulary to earn credits, unlock relaxing lofi tracks, and customize your study space. Put your progress on autopilot and watch your vocabulary grow while you chill.

games.name: One-Move Checkmate: Chess Brain Trainer
games.summary:
Find the winning move
Solve checkmate puzzles
Train your chess thinking

games.name: Pixel Warrior
games.summary: Only forward - towards the enemies! Without fear!

games.name: Random Dragons
games.summary: Chance-based roguelike deckbuilder with silly and goofy dragons. Spin the roulette wheel to get insane crit damage on enemies, manipulate the odds, and use multipliers like Balatro. Build your synergic deck and kill Random Dragons.

games.name: Redtail Relic Rush
games.summary:
Adventure never slows down in Redtail Relic Rush! Join Redtail, a fearless red panda explorer armed with a grappling hook, on an action-packed journey through ancient ruins filled with danger, mystery, and legendary treasures.

Run nonstop through thrilling platforming challenges packed with traps, enemies, and daring leaps. Swing through the air, build momentum at just the right moment, and master the perfect rhythm to overcome every obstacle as you race toward the legendary Golden Idol.

Explore 30 exciting levels across 3 unique biomes, from lush jungle ruins and mysterious cliffs to ancient pyramids full of secrets. Every environment introduces fresh challenges that put your reflexes, timing, and precision to the test while keeping the adventure fun and rewarding.

With charming pixel art, responsive controls, and smooth gameplay that always makes you want to play just one more level, Redtail Relic Rush is the perfect adventure for fans of fast-paced platformers, exploration, and exciting action.

Grab your grappling hook, keep your momentum, and prove that no treasure is out of your reach!

games.name: Rita
games.summary: Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

games.name: Room 0
games.summary: A first-person horror game about a detective investigating an abandoned research facility, a missing girl named Carla, and the sealed room at the center of it all. Recover VHS tapes, follow the tracks left behind, and avoid what's left inside.

games.name: Rose Guns Days: Season 2
games.summary: In 1944, unprecedented disaster struck Japan, forcing it to accept an unconditional ceasefire from its enemy nations in World War 2. As a result, the Japanese have become a people without a nation, but they still come together and do whatever it takes to live without giving up...

games.name: Senara: The Sacrament
games.summary: "SENARA: The Sacrament" is a first-person survival horror aboard a ship. Uncover the truth while escaping fanatics and unspeakable horrors. In a place where blind faith and salvation intertwine, you’ll be forced to make choices that go far beyond survival.

games.name: Senatus
games.summary: Strategic card battles in the heart of the Roman Senate. Debate, persuade, and rise through the ranks to become Consul of Rome. Influence is power — and power decides everything.

games.name: Seventh Mansion: The First Escape
games.summary: Escape an eerie mansion where death resets everything. Solve puzzles, evade the Wicked Nuns, or use a camera to survive in this psychological horror experience.

games.name: Shard Squad
games.summary: In Shard Squad, join elemental creatures to save their lands in intense battles against challenging hordes and bosses. Strengthen yourself with unique allies, gather valuable items, face epic calamities, and unlock new members to create unique strategies on your path to victory!

games.name: Sheva
games.summary: Sheva is a card-based fighting game where both players act simultaneously in strategic 1v1 battles. Predict your opponent, adapt your deck, and master the chakras as you sharpen your skills with every run.

games.name: Shisya Zero
games.summary: A new series launches on the paranormal channel [Tatarium]. Your mission is to examine photos submitted by listeners and speculate on the incidents hidden behind them. But with each examination, inexplicable disturbances creep into the studio.

games.name: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods
games.summary: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods is a new kind of combo RPG where you and your pup piece together flashy combos to dismantle a plethora of enemies! Discover your hidden powers as you find yourself hurtled into a conflict amongst the gods.

games.name: Skillwarz
games.summary:
SkillWarz is a fast-paced, cross-platform first-person shooter featuring competitive multiplayer battles across web, mobile, and desktop. Currently, the game includes five action-packed modes (Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Gun Game, Team Gun Game, and Skull Hunt) set across more than 20 diverse maps. Choose from six unique classes and ten different weapons to dominate the battlefield. Additional content (including maps, weapons, and game modes) is planned for future updates.

The browser version is already playable, with mobile and Steam releases planned soon.

games.name: Skyformer
games.summary: A first-person survival and automation game where you build factories run by drones to power a machine that terraforms a planet. Build bases, prepare for different types of storms, and harness the weather along the way!

games.name: Solitaire Paradise: Anime Bikini Babes
games.summary:
A classical Solitaire game with a modern twist.
Play classic Solitaire in a calm, anime-inspired world.

games.name: Something That Shouldn't Be There Is Visible.
games.summary: Look closely at this image. One thing doesn't belong. Once you notice it, you can't look away.

games.name: Space Bar
games.summary: Space Bar is a short psychological horror experience where simply pressing one key slowly reveals that something inside the game is trying to communicate with you.

games.name: Spanking Exorcist
games.summary: Explore a somewhat alluring apartment complex, avoiding evil spirits while exorcising the ghosts of housewives, in this slightly sexy comedy horror game!

games.name: Spellcast
games.summary: SPELLCAST combines the strategy and deckbuilding of a card battler with the dynamic gameplay of word games.

games.name: Stoneguard
games.summary: To protect the magical Lifestone, you must strategise, manage and build a fortified settlement. Lead your fellow survivors into battle against waves of nocturnal monsters who wish to take this precious Lifestone from your world.

games.name: Sudden Attack Zero Point
games.summary: Sudden Attack has been cherished for 20 years. Now, an endless journey begins. With its signature fast-paced combat and strategic gameplay rooted in classic bomb defusal, we've upgraded the graphics and introduced a gun customization system. Dive into action and discover a new level of excitement!

games.name: The Organ Woman
games.summary: A 1–4 player cooperative horror game set in an abandoned hospital in Japan. Work together with your friends, collect boxes containing organs, and escape from the hospital where something lurks!

games.name: The Person Living Next Door
games.summary: Something about the neighbour is... off today. Can you spot the unease hidden in plain sight?

games.name: The Prince of Tennis: Doki Doki Survival - Eternal Passion! Tie Break Game
games.summary: Originally released on PlayStation 2 as two separate games and later combined into one on Nintendo DS, the Prince of Tennis game where you find yourself stranded on an island on the way to the National Middle School Tennis Championship is being remastered for modern platforms.

games.name: The Prince of Tennis: Sweet School Festival 0-40 and more…
games.summary: Originally released on PlayStation 2, the Prince of Tennis game where you play as a high school student preparing for the school festival is being remastered in celebration of its 20th anniversary.

games.name: The Ranchers
games.summary: The Ranchers is an open world country-life sim for 1-4 players. Raise animals, grow crops, craft machines, build your dream house and explore the gigantic open world where mines and dangerous monsters abound. Earn the villagers' respect and esteem. And who knows, maybe find love and start a family.

games.name: The Silver Crow
games.summary: You play Conrad - executioner, outcast, and the last man anyone would trust to solve a murder. A handcrafted adventure steeped in Renaissance atmosphere, occult shadows and moral ambiguity. A point & click mystery in a city where truth is buried, power decides guilt, and someone is always watching.

games.name: Truxton Extreme
games.summary: Truxton Extreme, which inherits the DNA from legendary arcade masterpiece Truxton, is a collaboration with manga artist and Toaplan alumni Junya Inoue.

games.name: Turnip Mountain
games.summary: In this hands-on climbing platformer, chart your own path as you reach, swing and soar to the summit!

games.name: Typomagical
games.summary: Type and cast your own spells! Typomagical is a spell-casting roguelike with a twist: create and cast spells by typing incantations! Spells and the elements are at your fingertips, literally -- creative synergies are the key to victory!

games.name: Ungodly
games.summary: UnGodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

games.name: Valkyrie Saga
games.summary: Up high on a floating island, Roll the Valkyrie must ascend and subvert fate. Climb, dash, jump and glide up to the summit of the Island, and stop it from crashing to the earth below, in this PSX style 3D platformer.

games.name: Verho: Curse of Faces
games.summary: Verho, a Dark RPG following the tradition of the King’s Field series, takes place after the catastrophic Era of Solitude, where masks have become the only protection against the Curse of Faces. Travel to the land of Yariv, find the source of this scourge and face its dangers.

games.name: Vision Quest: A New Ascent
games.summary: Vision Quest: A New Ascent is a twin-stick souls-like shaped by nature. Survive 2-hit death combat with well-timed critical hits that restore your Health and rise above failure with a generous respawn system. The summit is waiting.

games.name: Voidtrain
games.summary: Become a crew member of an interdimensional express! Discover a new mysterious world inhabited by amazing creatures, dangers and surprises. Upgrade your train, gather new materials and build better weapons! Available in single player, or in online multiplayer with up to 4 people.

games.name: Volcano Princess
games.summary: After the war between humans and demons, you found a baby on the battlefield and became a father. You will Plan time and courses for her, bring her into contact with various roles, and raise her up. The daughter's future and the ending of the volcano country depends on each of your choices.

games.name: Warshift 2
games.summary: Warshift 2 is a unique mix of Action, RTS and RPG gameplay elements that forms an innovative game genre. You can build base, manage troops, and then come down to keep your enemy at gunpoint in the dynamic battle and customize your main characters.

games.name: Waterpunk
games.summary: A roguelite action game set in a post-apocalyptic water world. Shape your strategy by choosing which abilities shine by day and which awaken at night.

games.name: Welcome, Sharehouse!
games.summary: Living in a share house with three pretty girls

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary: Command a group of Blades and lead them to countless strategic victories as you search for the fabled paradise Pyra calls home. This journey has been enhanced with 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second—and with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Torna - The Golden Country
games.summary: Guide a group of legendary warriors on a journey through the tragic history that doomed a kingdom and drove a hero down a dark path 500 years before the events of the Xenoblade Chronicles 2 game. Defend yourself from Malos and his forces using all the fury of this refined battle system, allowing you to fight as both the artificial lifeforms known as Blades and their masters, the Drivers.

games.name: Zentris
games.summary: Zentris is inspired by the classic 1988 falling blocks game, with modern controls and settings to make it more enjoyable today! Built with difficulty settings for a range of play from classic difficulty to full relaxation. 26 different tracks with built in music effect that immerse you in the game!

games.name: Zombie Graveyard Simulator
games.summary: Manage your Graveyard by day as you bury and cremate bodies, maintain graves, fulfill visitor requests, grow crops, run a shop and unlock upgrades. When night falls, face relentless zombie hordes as you build defenses to protect your work and fight to survive in Zombie Graveyard Simulator!

games.name: Zoominoes
games.summary: Build the ultimate Zoo in this number-go-up roguelike deckbuilder. Find powerful mythical animals, boost them with snacks, and even manipulate the board itself. Break the game by scoring millions (and more) with insane combos.

games.name: A-Spec: First Assault
games.summary: Engaging space combat simulator, using a realistic flight system with Newtonian physics, sophisticated and diverse gameplay featuring detailed ship systems, including ship weaponry and module customization.

games.name: A.D.D. (Anomaly Detection Department)
games.summary: A.D.D is a management simulation game where you run operations for a company investigating the Backrooms. Connect nodes, build workflows, dispatch employees, and deliver the results the company demands.

games.name: AfterWar
games.summary: AfterWar is a strategy about the world in 2028.

games.name: Alarm112: Fire Unit
games.summary: Command fire rescue operations under pressure. Receive emergency calls, dispatch units and make critical decisions in a realistic emergency response strategy simulation.

games.name: Angry Raccoon
games.summary: One Masked Bandit!

games.name: Appalachian Onslaught
games.summary: Build, upgrade and defend against an endless onslaught of cryptids being sent to destroy your tribe by the great Appalachian nightmare himself... the Rketari.

games.name: Bad Pixels
games.summary:
Have you ever wondered what a FPS game would look like in 8-bit? It's gotta look bad, right?

Introducing Bad Pixels. A first person shooter set in the old west, using computer graphics from about the same era!

games.name: Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles
games.summary: One hard-fought truth Batman has revealed over the years, Gotham City's darkest crimes won't solve themselves. In this cooperative party game for 1 to 4 players, you and your crew will step into the noir-drenched Gotham City of Batman: Caped Crusader the animated series, where every alley hides a secret and every case leads deeper into the shadowy depths of the city's criminal underworld.

games.name: Bee With Gun
games.summary: This construction bee will make never seen defenses.

games.name: Bingo Betty
games.summary: This ain't your average grandma's bingo! Put your bingo skills to the test in this strategic roguelite spin on the classic game as you collect items, customize cards, create combos, cash in scratch tickets, and take betty to the top! Betty isn't alone, though; Battle and Befriend both demons and angels, each with their own personalities!

games.name: Board Poker
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build a board, not just a hand. Drop cards onto the grid and score poker hands across every row, column, and diagonal at once. Stack rule-breaking augments, chain explosive combos, and rake in the gold.

games.name: Bound to Defend
games.summary:
Bound to Defend is an endless wave defense game that combines roguelite progression with persistent loot. Level up, draft new skills each run, and experiment with different builds while surviving increasingly difficult waves. Earn gear that permanently carry across runs, allowing you to upgrade, merge, and strengthen your character over time.

Combat blends automatic attacks with manually activated abilities, runs can be saved and resumed at any time, and a live cross-platform monthly Top 100 leaderboard lets players compete for the highest score.

games.name: Cloud Keeper: Shrine of Dal
games.summary: Summon an army of clouds in this auto-battler survivors-like bullet heaven inspired by Korean folklore! Recruit cloud companions, collect relics, befriend shrine visitors, and survive against the monster hordes!

games.name: Corsair Cove
games.summary: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

games.name: Crooked
games.summary: Crooked is a noir roguelite strategy game where rock-paper-scissors becomes a tense underground contest of bluffing, reading opponents and taking risks. Study your rivals, bend the rules when the moment is right, manage suspicion and climb through shady venues where every decision can turn the room against you.

games.name: CypherWars
games.summary: CypherWars is a cyberpunk-themed, Drug Wars-inspired, buy-low, sell-high arbitrage simulator roguelite set in the Maxx Cypher universe. Travel from node to node, buying and selling digital contraband for maximum profit, pay off your debt to the Syndicate, and try to maintain the highest net worth possible before your runner session runs out of cycles. But, watch out! Warden Stryker is always on the hunt for runners who strike it big in the grid and is ruthless when he catches you!

games.name: Dating Stories 2
games.summary: Dating Stories 2 blends the addictive satisfaction of solving jigsaw puzzles with the spicy thrill of seducing the most alluring women you can imagine.

games.name: Deadly Trick
games.summary: Survive the death game unfolding at school under the name "Special Class." You are not given any special role at the beginning. Depending on the situation or your own choices, you could become the White or the Shadow! Cooperate… or betray.

games.name: Dear Magical Girls
games.summary: Dear Magical Girls is a story-driven defense game about an overworked magical girl protecting the Mana Stone that keeps the city running. Move the vertices to reshape your magical field. Unlock modules and enchants, and build your own strategy to survive against waves of monsters.

games.name: Defrag Incremental
games.summary: A retro incremental where you optimize messy disks, choose the right algorithm, manage heat and wear, make a living from each job, and reboot for permanent BIOS upgrades.

games.name: Dig Baby Dig Company
games.summary: An online co-op horror game with 1-4 players. Explore and dig through strange alien fields, face hostile creatures, and harvest energy matter... all to satisfy the cruel demands of your master.

games.name: Don’t Pull Me!
games.summary: Dont Pull Me is a physics-based co-op parkour game for 1 to 4 players. Tied together by a rope, you and your friends must climb, swing, carry objects, and survive chaotic ragdoll disasters without dragging the whole team down.

games.name: Drifted
games.summary: DRIFTED is a 3d horror mystery game, as you explore a mansion looking for your missing friend, you will find many secrets within as you uncover the mystery behind their disappearance. Between locked rooms and fighting monsters, who knows what you will uncover!

games.name: Dungeons & Dummies
games.summary: Descend alone or drag up to 7 friends into a deep, ever-changing dungeon that does not care about your feelings. Chase loot, quests, and power while insisting “one more floor” is a great idea. Greed is encouraged. Survival is optional.

games.name: El Restaurante de Sam
games.summary: You're a former employee of El Restaurante de Sam, you've returned to find out what happened to your colleagues, your goal is to find them...

games.name: Elders K.O.
games.summary:
Welcome to Elders K.O., the elderly fighting party game nobody asked for… but everyone secretly needed!

A first-person online multiplayer game where up to 8 elders (or rather, the players controlling them) exchange punches, laughs, magical items, and a worrying amount of digital osteoporosis.

Run, jump, push, dodge, steal, explode, and punch other old folks with boxing gloves.
Yes. Everything is allowed here.
Fast fun, instant chaos, guaranteed laughter.

games.name: Fairtravel Battle
games.summary: Let your magic run wild in this fast-paced fantasy card game, with a unique resource system, back-and-forth battles, moddable cards and multiple unique game modes. Play alone or with up to four players online, all without a microtransaction in sight.

games.name: Fisher Idle
games.summary: Start from scratch in the middle of the ocean as a fisherman! Buy bigger boats, upgrade your ships, and build your fishing empire. Remember: more fish means more gold!

games.name: Flip
games.summary: A fast-paced memory game where every mistake costs time. Learn the board, build streaks, beat unique bosses, and clear 50 handcrafted levels before the clock runs out.

games.name: Flocked and Loaded
games.summary: Raise your herd. Arm them for war. Survive the wild! Guide your flock through dangerous environments, battling escalating waves of predators. Extract your surviving animals to your ranch to unlock powerful guardians, expand your roster, and prepare for even deadlier runs.

games.name: FPV PVP
games.summary: A competitive FPV drone shooter. Pilot an agile quadcopter with an RC transmitter, gamepad, or mouse and keyboard, and fight other players across 5v5 Bomb Defusal, Team Deathmatch, and 1v1 Ranked Duels. Two flight models, ranked ladders with global leaderboards, and a buy-menu economy.

games.name: Froggle
games.summary:
Froggle is a weirdly empowering, delightfully breakable (F)roguelite dungeon crawler!

Live. Die. Ribbit. Inspired by Slay the Spire, Balatro, and Inscryption - if you like any of these, you'll probably like Froggle

Rich, unique, tactical turn-based combat. Basic initially; progressively awesomer.

games.name: Get Out!
games.summary: Ever felt trapped in a nightmare? Get Out! is here to plunge you into the craziest VR horror experience on PSVR2! Inspired by 80s retro horror, this "popcorn" game is all about survival, thrills, and pure fun. As a wise adventurer once said, "Survive, Survive, Survive. And occasionally, Run!"

games.name: Helen Keller Simulator
games.summary: Explore a world without your eyes and ears to guide you. Uncover the secrets this world has to offer, hoard all the items you can find or get lost trying.

games.name: Hell O’ Halo
games.summary: "Lost your halo? Report to Hell!" Demoted from a cushy Heaven desk job to field duty in Hell, your fight for clock-out times and benefits begins! Build custom decks with opinionated office supplies, smash demon skulls, and loot your halo back. Welcome to Hell—no mercy, no overtime pay!

games.name: Horror Cliche
games.summary: The rules of horror are meant to be broken...

games.name: Hotel Tales
games.summary: Hotel Tales is a mystery hotel manager set in the crossroads between worlds. Dive into the amazing, frightening and funny stories of guests and colleagues, discover the hotel's secrets and try to survive at least to the end of your probationary period!

games.name: HyperCycle League
games.summary: Cut the line. Own the neon. Hypercycle League is a high-octane evolution of light-trail combat where milliseconds are the difference between glory and a data-crash. No RNG, no gimmicks—just pure, frame-perfect digital athleticism. Are you fast enough to leave a mark?"

games.name: Hyperdrive Inn
games.summary: Dive into the mysteries of an infinite hotel. Unveil an ever-shifting adventure where every playthrough is unique. Immerse in fabric-crafted visuals, guided by an enchanting score inspired by Finnish folk music. Hyperdrive Inn is a point-and-click journey like no other.

games.name: Into the End (Of the World)
games.summary: Drive, maintain, and survive. Explore procedural biomes in a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge for parts, and fight infected zones with friends. Build your survival machine from the chassis up and keep it running - because without it, you wont get far.

games.name: Jezebel
games.summary: Jezbel is a narrative-driven visual novel set in medieval Rosegate. Play as Duvessa Devereux, a ruthless noblewoman scheming her way to power. With RPG elements and branching paths, your choices shape her fate and the future of the kingdom.

games.name: Joker on the Spring
games.summary: Joker On The Spring - “ Fall. Learn. Jump again ” . Joker on the Spring is a precision platformer where you control a joker with a spring for legs. Instead of walking, you bounce and ricochet, turning every move into a chaotic mix of humor and frustration.

games.name: Keypad Simulator
games.summary: Try to guess a randomly generated 4-digit code on a keypad. It resets each day or when someone guesses it correctly. You only have one try each day. If you guess right, you earn a point.

games.name: Knockout Battle
games.summary:
Knockout Battle is a chaotic and fun multiplayer party game where up to 8 players clash in fully interactive sandbox arenas. The objective is simple yet endlessly entertaining: knock your friends out and hurl them into the void to secure victory!
Unleash absolute mayhem with an arsenal of wacky weapons and gadgets. Throw TNT across the map, blast fireworks and rockets into your rivals, or smash them with Thor’s hammer. Pull out blasters, revolvers, and all sorts of outrageous guns, or go full sci-fi and deflect attacks with a lightsaber.

Potions add another layer of madness, letting you grow huge, shrink tiny, run faster, or hit harder — flipping the fight in unexpected ways.

Every map is a sandbox of destruction, packed with hazards, traps, and interactive elements you can turn against your opponents. From launching rivals sky-high to chaining explosions together, no two matches ever play the same.

Whether you’re dodging rockets, spamming explosives, or laughing as your friends fall into the void, Knockout Battle guarantees non-stop action, hilarious moments, and pure chaos. And of course… expect a ridiculous amount of explosions and rockets.

games.name: Koi Frenzy
games.summary: A fast-paced arcade game where every second counts. Catch koi fish, build combos, beat your high score, and compete against players worldwide in one-minute runs that are easy to learn but hard to master.

games.name: Litterbox League
games.summary: Welcome to the Litterbox League! Compete with cute animals in this chaotic multiplayer brawler. Shove them all out, be the last one standing, and claim all the fame and glory!

games.name: Lockey
games.summary: Seal your enemies with the power of a mystical key. Wield your key as a weapon to build Seal Power. Seal enemies, absorb their power, and unleash devastating Engraving abilities. Fight through the Lock Kingdom, defeat the mighty Lock King.

games.name: Love Spell: Written in the Stars
games.summary: A romantic comedy visual novel/otome game about spells, adventures, penguins and the greatest magic of all: true love! "Love Spell" is the debut project of Great Gretuski Studios LLC, a female-founded, female-run indie game development studio focused on bringing romantic & creative stories to life.

games.name: Lurruna: The Island of Towering Automatons
games.summary: It's the GRAVITY-BOUND BOMBER!!! LURRUNA is an homage to CLASSICVANIA gameplay. Pelt bombs, beat baddies and cross chasms in a mysterious island adventure.

games.name: Meatballs
games.summary: A fast, juicy bullet-hell roguelike where you're lunch fighting back. Pick from 11 meatballs, blast through 10 levels of waves and 5 outrageous bosses, and build a god-tier meatball from 30 weapons & 55 items — without stacking so much you literally fall apart.

games.name: Medieval Market Simulator
games.summary: A cozy first person medieval fantasy shop simulation where you stock shelves, set prices, and haggle with adventurers by day. Master a living economy with shifting market prices. At night, visit the tavern to gamble or seek tarot readings that shape the fate of tomorrow.

games.name: Mega Snake: 16-Bit Edition
games.summary:
Relive the golden age of arcade gaming with Mega Snake: 16-Bit Edition, a retro-inspired arcade snake game featuring vibrant 16-bit visuals, responsive controls, and classic high-score gameplay.

Guide your snake through an endless grid, collect pellets to grow longer, avoid walls, obstacles, and your own tail, and survive as the speed steadily increases. Whether playing with a keyboard, gamepad, or touch controls, every run is a new challenge to beat your best score.

Designed for modern PCs and Xbox, the game supports offline play and delivers a pure arcade experience with no ads or microtransactions.

games.name: Metal Detector Island
games.summary: A cozy first-person metal-detecting adventure where you explore an island, follow signals, dig up buried chests, sell or collect your finds, upgrade your gear and unlock new areas in search of rarer treasures.

games.name: Micro Rush
games.summary: A Seconds-Long Speedrunning game about short levels and fast gameplay. The average level only takes a couple seconds to finish, so you can replay and hone your skills to earn higher medal ranks.

games.name: Mootation
games.summary: Mootation blends minigames, humor, and incremental systems where you need to optimize production to become the best Space Farmer in the galaxy!

games.name: Mr. President
games.summary: Can you face the challenges of the Oval Office? Find out in Mr. President, a sandbox simulation of the U.S. presidency. Pursue your legislative agenda. Compete with rivals Russia and China. Deal with crises from 9/11 to COVID-19; and direct the U.S. military against terror groups and rogue states.

games.name: Night at the Lake: Silent Watcher
games.summary: A night shift at a remote lake turns into something unsettling. Explore the area, log data, and uncover what lurks in the darkness.

games.name: Occulto
games.summary: Occulto is an indie adventure game with a focus on artistic hand-drawn visuals and a non verbal game play, set in a fantasy world. Guide Eliot through riddles, mysteries, puzzles, strange creatures, faraway places and help him find his master!

games.name: Ocean Shark Survival: Float Home Builder Simulator
games.summary: Build, craft, and fight to stay alive every day.

games.name: Ocean Survivors
games.summary: A pirate-themed, minimalistic, survivors-like where you dodge cannonballs, sink enemy ships, expand your arsenal, and loot their wrecks to climb the ranks. Upgrade your ship and become the ultimate pirate!

games.name: On & Off
games.summary: On & Off is a turn-based strategy game where you manipulate pieces on a grid to trigger explosive chain reactions. Toggle pieces ON to attack, defend, and heal. Read the enemy's telegraphed intents, unleash powerful skills, and master the board to survive!

games.name: Orbital Crash
games.summary: Fight other players in this fast-paced arena! Grapple across dynamic maps with shifting gravitational forces, blasting foes into black holes or the cold void of space. Master a diverse arsenal and dominate the competition with skill and cunning.

games.name: Papa
games.summary: Years after escaping your childhood home, you return to visit your dying father one last time. As strange events unfold, memories of the past begin to blur with reality.

games.name: Parkside: Decayed Soul Manipulation
games.summary: Parkside is an FPS-Immersive Sim that chronicles the future of biomechanical subterfuge and suffering. Shoot, hack, and either save or sour the future of humanity in the dismally attractive and dystopian city of Abbotsford, California in the awful year of 2038. Will you serve the Divine Rod?

games.name: Party Quiz
games.summary: Play a local Quiz game with your friends. Create your own Quiz using the Party Quiz Constructor or use the Steam Workshop to download one of the Quizzes made by the community. Test your knowledge with fun!

games.name: Paw Patrol: Dino World
games.summary: Join the PAW Patrol and Rex on colossal missions across Dino Island. Create roar-some looks, play minigames with friends and more.

games.name: Phantom Smog
games.summary: In a future suffocated by VX-Nebel, the megacorporation NOVA ATMOS controls every breath of the city. You are Kael, the only one immune to the gas — and therefore, the only real threat. Track and eliminate the leaders behind the conspiracy

games.name: Planetary Field Team
games.summary: Play as the team's operator in this Roguelike Auto-Battler RPG. Build your team to effectively fight against hostiles on an alien planet.

games.name: Pot's On!
games.summary: Got your soul completely crushed by a crazy witch and turned into a kitchen 'pot'! An inventory auto-battler where you beat up suspiciously pretty monster girls and boil them in your pot. Cram items into a tight space and experience the thrill of erasing cooldowns with a downpour of MSG!

games.name: Primal Axis
games.summary: Codex-driven creature collector in Aethel-Hearth — explore, fight, gather, craft, breed, and fill the ledger.

games.name: Project Glitch
games.summary: The result of a 6-month student project. A dangerous oil called Glitch is corrupting humans into mindless robots. Fight your way to the mountain's peak and destroy the source of the corruption.

games.name: Quasimorph
games.summary: Take on a role of a hardened PMC fighter in a dark turn-based extraction RPG. Engage in unforgiving combat, manage your ship and pile up the bodies of your clones to unravel the dark mystery behind threat to all life.

games.name: Retro Puzzles: Eviva L'arte
games.summary: A museum inspired jigsaw journey: 225 masterpieces, 45 artists, 9 regions, and three difficulty tiers up to 4160 pieces, plus fact based artist bios and artwork notes.

games.name: Rising Moonshade
games.summary: Rising Moonshade is a turn-based strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Lead your squad through ever-changing missions—gather resources, forge equipment, and build tactical playstyles. Under the dual pressure of survival and combat, you must ultimately withstand the Demon King's invasion.

games.name: Rocket Man X
games.summary: In this third-person platformer shooter, fight your way through enemies and platform your way through levels. Unlock new armor by finding the hidden boxes, and earn new weapons by beating the bosses.

games.name: Ryou-ude ga Oreta no de H na Osewa wo Sareru Hanashi
games.summary:
To save his landlord daughter who was about to be run over by a truck, the protagonist makes a dangerous dash!
…As a result, he ends up getting both his arms run over and suffers a fracture that requires several months to heal.

His parents are away on a long-term business trip overseas. Going back to his family home won't help,so she has decided to take care of him for the time being...!

games.name: Security Simulator: Nightshift
games.summary: A spot-the-difference-horror game; you use a camera system to locate and report disturbances and thieves, but you can't stay in the cameras the whole night. Getting up from your office to patrol is necessary to keep thieves at bay.

games.name: Seeding The Wasteland
games.summary:
Feeling like doing some gardening? Head to the planet Tau to relax with this narrative-driven plant management game!

You'll play as a small robot named Orchid, tasked with cultivating various plants to bring the planet back to life!

You'll have your ship, charging stations, and your trusty tools at your disposal. Aboard the Internode, your shuttle, you'll navigate across a desolate land to reach Demeter, a mysterious robotic entity.

games.name: Sephiria
games.summary: Sephiria is a top-down action rogue-lite game with pixel graphics. Go down the tower, meet various animals, and collect various talismans and artifacts to become stronger.

games.name: Shapemonger
games.summary: Shapemonger is a colorful arcadey incremental game about destroying shapes - in outer space! - getting money and buying upgrades

games.name: Soulmine
games.summary: Explore an abandoned mine, escape two entities working together and find a way out. Use your flashlight, search the tunnels and survive the dangers lurking in the depths.

games.name: Spacebolt
games.summary: What am I? Where am I? Who am I? Spacebolt is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game where you control a spark of electricity. Traverse walls and ceilings, travel through circuits, and awaken dormant machines as each discovery brings you closer to the truth.

games.name: Spooky Tales: Nini's Teddy
games.summary: Uncover the terrifying truth behind a cursed teddy bear in this first-person psychological horror adventure. Explore a haunted mansion, solve puzzles, survive supernatural encounters, and uncover Nini's tragic story in Chapter One of the Spooky Tales series.

games.name: Steel Judgment
games.summary: Steel Judgment is an ultra-fast roguelike movement FPS full of wacky combos and weapons that combines the expressive combat of beat-em' ups with the unhinged chaos of a roguelike. Wipe out hordes of enemies with a diverse moveset and arsenal while collecting powerful items with unique effects.

games.name: System Critical III
games.summary: Step into the fast-paced, high-energy world of System Critical 3, the ultimate VR platformer-shooter designed exclusively for PSVR2. With intense gunplay, gravity-defying jumps, and mind-bending virtual environments, you’ll navigate a futuristic cyber-realm where every battle is a test of skill and reflexes. Experience ruthless boss battles, traverse dynamic landscapes, and master an arsenal of powerful weapons—all in stunning virtual reality.

games.name: Task Bar of Ragnalis
games.summary: Your taskbar turns into a battlefield! *Task Bar of Ragnalis* is an idle auto-RPG for PC. Heroes fight, collect treasure, and level up on their own. Combine equipment, form a trio, and find weapons with random abilities. Just let it run and get hooked!

games.name: The Rebellion
games.summary: Fuel a people’s uprising through fast turn-based tactical battles and hard choices; lead your heroes, stretch scarce resources, heed the crowd’s needs, plan each move with care, break the tyrant’s grip, and let hope rise again!

games.name: The Relic: First Guardian
games.summary: "Guardian, gather the pieces of the great relic and seal the void of darkness." In this action RPG, you embark on a heroic adventure to save the world in the dark as the last guardian. Start your journey as a guardian, gather pieces of great relic and close the void.

games.name: The Stone Ship
games.summary: In The Stone Ship, paintings, maps, and photographs expand into living scenes, revealing hidden paths that lead back in time to the origins of an ancient megalithic monument. It is a single‑player, first‑person mystery‑exploration game featuring puzzle elements and navigation challenges.

games.name: The Two Body Problem
games.summary: The Two Body Problem is a physics-driven puzzle game where two robots must literally carry, throw, and reposition each other to survive. The catch: you, alone, control both robots. The world demands cooperation, but there's no one to cooperate with except yourself.

games.name: The Unfamiliars
games.summary: The Unfamiliars is a first person atmospheric horror experience presented through a VHS camcorder perspective. Players explore a small isolated mobile home while documenting strange and unsettling events unfolding outside during a rainy night.

games.name: Tibby and the Lost and Found
games.summary: Help Tibby and Truffle find lost stories and bring joy back to Cobblewick!

games.name: Tied to the Beat
games.summary: A roguelike where every lyric triggers unique effects. Choose your instrument, survive waves of lyric-powered enemies, and import your own songs. Your music. Your weapon.

games.name: Tiny Bomber
games.summary: Tiny Bomber is a 2D vertical scrolling action game blending roguelike elements with bullet-hell dodging. Players control a tiny bomber, navigating procedurally generated levels, avoiding bullets, and bombing enemies. With a countdown system and random upgrades, each run is a thrilling challenge.

games.name: Titan Force
games.summary: When a failed experiment unleashes a plague of the undead, civilization collapses overnight. Cities fall. Nations burn. And the dead keep coming. Climb into the cockpit. Bring a Titan back online. Turn the end of the world into the beginning of a counterattack. Turn extinction into vengeance.

games.name: Unload
games.summary: UNLOAD is an interception-focused top-down shooter where ammo is life. Intercept lethal projectiles to reload and survive by a thread. As a Visitor who lost everything in an explosion, hunt down those tied to the incident and uncover the truth behind that day.

games.name: Waterpark Simulator
games.summary: Build and run your own waterpark. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!

games.name: Wonderland
games.summary: Explore a world of swords and sorcery, and build your unique adventurer’s guild!

games.name: WordHive
games.summary: Build words, score points, and master the hive.

games.name: Xialuo: Kill All Flowers
games.summary: Xialuo: Kill All Flowers is an innovative turn based adventure RPG that combines the commonly used "dice elements" and "big map exploration" in board games. In the game, you will gradually uncover various monsters in this dark and mysterious world, achieve your mission.

games.name: Xtreme Traffic Racing
games.summary: Outrun the traffic. Outlast the chaos.

games.name: You Must Remember
games.summary: A dark past stops Patient 11 from retaining memories, leaving him hostile and lost in time. Dive deep into his mind through hypnosis to help him recover the truth. Every attempt is completely different. Are you up for the challenge?

games.name: Zero Pixel Dawn
games.summary: Scavenge, craft, and fight to survive in a post-pixel apocalypse. Explore dangerous biomes, wield guns and magic, and uncover a hidden truth buried in chaos. Every choice matters. Will you survive?

games.name: 10 Beautiful Postcards
games.summary:
THE IMAGE IS HOTEL TO THE BRAIN

Check in today!! 10 Beautiful Postcards - a wonderful pile of rubble to sift through on your computer. A resort of many rooms for your eyes and hands to drift around - 200+ mangled collage ruins, flattened into pleasure palaces for you to uncover and explore. Investigate the dimension's mysterious economy. Visit and review multiple themed locations. Take snapshots of your friend, the void - or simply have fun relaxing by the pool. A fun and upbeat game for new wavers of all ages. Won't you come dwell in my house?

games.name: 100 Undersea Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

games.name: All You Can Fish!
games.summary: All You Can Fish is an active, relaxing incremental fishing adventure where every voyage matters, every upgrade counts, and every fish brings you one step closer to maritime legend.

games.name: Autumn's Leaves
games.summary: Become an adventurer in Autumn's Leaves, a retro-inspired browser-based MMORPG. Collect equipment, discover spells, get married, become a mayor, or become a pirate.

games.name: Avoidvania
games.summary: AvoidVania is a 2D game Top-down Runner / Metroidvania taking place in a medieval-fantastic universe.

games.name: Ball Boy Simulator
games.summary: A first-person lost-item exploration simulator set in a Japanese high school baseball club. Search for missing baseballs while enduring the strict hierarchy and unreasonable treatment from coaches and upperclassmen.

games.name: Big Ambitions
games.summary: Big Ambitions is a revolutionary role-playing business sim. Go from nothing to the biggest entrepreneur in New York by opening small businesses or slowly building huge corporations any way you like.

games.name: Closing Shift
games.summary: An online co-op horror game where you're a fast food employee in Hell. You'll need to serve customers, cook food, and meet your night task quotas to keep your job.

games.name: Crown of Hispania
games.summary: Rewrite the Reconquista in a grand strategy game where population, religion, and war evolve dynamically based on your decisions. Will you become a legendary ruler, or will you be rejected by those forgotten by History?

games.name: CyberDeck: The Cyberpunk Roguelike Deckbuilder
games.summary:
A Fast Cyberpunk Deckbuilder Where Every Run Plays Differently
CyberDeck is a roguelike deckbuilder about making sharp decisions under pressure. Choose your route, draft new cards, install powerful chrome, adapt to random enemies, and build a deck that can survive the city.

Every run starts a new puzzle. The map, rewards, enemies, and upgrade paths change each time you play.

games.name: Devil Drive Polaris
games.summary: Devil Drive Polaris is a single-stage vertical shoot 'em up featuring a player-controlled dynamic difficulty (rank) system that encourages ratcheting up the difficulty to chase higher scores. This game was developed in about a week for the fifth TWG game jam.

games.name: Droned
games.summary: Droned is a small, passion project that brings friends together for some good old fashion action. In that spirit, get your friends online and hop straight in some top-down combat.

games.name: Dumb Dunks
games.summary: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

games.name: Elemental Witches
games.summary: In Elemental Witches world, you command Fire, Wind, and Thunder to craft unique spells from three elemental orbs. Merge identical elements to summon powerful pets. After each battle, upgrade elements, unlock items, and shape your own playstyle as you face new adventures.

games.name: Escape the House
games.summary: You're locked in your crazy Granny's house. She can hear everything and runs incredibly fast. Hide in closets, be quiet, solve puzzles, and find a way to escape before your days are up. A tense PSX survival horror game where every dropped object can cost you your life.

games.name: Fleet Conquest
games.summary:
Fleet Conquest is a space-themed strategy game: build your fleet, grow your supply network, and fight back against the enemies of Super Earth who are trying to take over the galaxy!

This is a fan-made game based in the universe of Helldivers 2 and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Arrowhead Game Studios AB or Sony Interactive Entertainment. HELLDIVERS is a trademark of Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC. All game content and assets are property of their respective owners.

games.name: Frebbventure Alliance
games.summary: That's right, the cat came back, and this time, with more. More what? More friends, more enemies, more action, more levels, more bosses, more story. More everything! Frebbventure Alliance takes the formula for a game that prided itself on being jam-packed no-frills action platforming madness, and does it even harder!

games.name: Ghostflippers
games.summary: Flip haunted houses with your friends… before the ghost flips you. Reach your quota, grow your business, and survive the night.

games.name: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy
games.summary: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy. The 2024 era, preserved exactly as you remember it. A brutal VR extraction shooter where every raid is a gamble and trust gets you killed. Scavenge, fight, extract. Make it out with your gear, or lose everything.

games.name: Gift From God
games.summary: Gift From God is a visual novel told through the eyes of Ryosuke Nikaido and Akane Yamamoto. As they face three missions from God, their hearts, pasts, and choices begin to intertwine, leading them toward the true meaning of God’s “gift.”

games.name: Guilds of Mountgate
games.summary: A living online RPG where economy, progression and world events shape your journey. Build your character, trade, craft and explore a persistent world that evolves over time — whether you are online or not.

games.name: Hacker vs It
games.summary: DOS old school game showing how a hacker and an IT workers do their jobs. The idea of this game is show the hacking and the IT process with less fantasy elements. Shows a WAY closer perspective the actual hacking strategies.

games.name: HackHub: Ultimate Hacker Simulator
games.summary: Unravel cyber secrets and foil mass surveillance as a skilled hacker in Hackhub. Challenge authority, rewrite the rules, and emerge as the ultimate digital rebel.

games.name: Hiderman
games.summary: Hiderman is a first--person psychological horror game about collecting mushrooms in a dark, ever-changing forest while a mysterious creature watches from the trees. Use your flashlight to expose the creature, follow the signs, and survive through multiple escalating horror phases. Features randomized vegetation and mushroom placement, two endings, and an average playtime of 25-45 minutes.

games.name: Infected Escaped
games.summary: A co-op PvE survival game where you team up with other survivors to scavenge resources, fight infected enemies, uncover the map, and reach the final extraction point.

games.name: Jobby
games.summary: Welcome to the corporate battlefield, where qualifications are meaningless and words are stolen property! In Jobby, players enter a cutthroat hiring process where their vocabulary is completely at the mercy of their competitors. After answering initial icebreaker questions, candidates watch as their original responses are harvested into a shared pool of snippets. To tackle the upcoming job interview rounds, applicants must construct clever, absurd, or completely unhinged answers using only the stolen words provided by other players. Craft the ultimate response, complete a chaotic resume, and convince the board that you are the uniquely unqualified candidate for the job.

games.name: Just Anomaly: Hospital
games.summary: 15 floors. One hospital. How careful can you be while shaking with fear?

games.name: Kara
games.summary: Kara is a visual novel following an ordinary high schooler whose life slowly spirals into a nightmare. Sleep deprivation, a tragic chain of events, and dark secrets will force you to question reality itself.

games.name: Keep It Up!
games.summary: Keep It Up! is a co-op slapstick physics game about keeping a balloon from touching the ground. You and up to three Facility test subjects scramble through chaotic obstacle rooms while slapping, jumping and colliding to keep the balloon up. Will you be able to Keep It Up!?

games.name: Kerf: Sawmill Tycoon
games.summary:
KERF: Sawmill Tycoon is a first-person sawmill sim where nothing happens without you. Every tree is felled by your hand, every plank comes off a saw you operate, and every coin is earned at a counter you built up from nothing. You start with an axe and a single clearing at the foot of a waterfall.

Fell trees with your own hands, saw logs into planks, chop firewood, craft furniture and sell it all to your customers. A first-person sawmill tycoon where you do the work yourself: take on commissions, hire a crew, replant the forest and grow a humble yard into a timber empire.

games.name: Kurohi
games.summary:
Explore interconnected areas, uncover hidden secrets, and unlock powerful abilities as you fight your way through deranged bosses and discover a mysterious world filled with danger, lore, and unexpected twists.

Kurohi combines tight platforming, overhead exploration, and arcade-style space shooter gameplay, creating a dynamic adventure that shifts between multiple styles of play. This represents an era of passion for retro gaming, pixel art, and authentic handheld development.

games.name: Law of Demons
games.summary: Law of Demons is a dark medieval action-adventure, brought to life with the twisted art and uncanny vision of Sierra Tunis. Traverse the surreal and violent world of Spire and face off against the diabolical foes which stand in your way. Do you have what it takes to fight the law?

games.name: Left Not Right
games.summary: Control Lefty with your left hand, and Righty with your right. At the same time! Don't worry — it's a single-player game. No friends required. Use both hands to control two characters at once and escape the underground research facility!

games.name: Loop Miner
games.summary: Loop Miner is a mining incremental game where a cute mole miner endlessly digs through mines, gathers resources, collects artifacts, and ventures deeper underground. Experience the satisfaction of growing stronger through endless mining loops.

games.name: Lordress
games.summary: Rhiannon was born into honor — and cast into chains. Some are born to wear a crown. Others must take it.

games.name: Mischief House
games.summary:
One housemate is playing both sides. The Menace gets chores too, but only as cover. Their real job is wrecking yours: snatching items out of your hands, jamming doors shut, cutting the lights, then drifting back to the dishes like nothing happened. After each round the whole house votes in secret on who they think it is, and nobody sees the results until the match is over.

The twist is that sabotage covers the Menace's tracks. Every job they pull off quietly wipes suspicion off their name, so a sloppy Menace gets caught while a careful one walks free. If the votes still stick, the hardest-working housemate wins. If they don't, you all just lost to someone who spent three rounds doing the washing up.

games.name: Monster Ops 21
games.summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

games.name: N00b.gg
games.summary:
n00b.gg is a free browser-based daily puzzle game about identifying video games from screenshots. Each day at midnight, a new heavily pixelated screenshot from a video game is presented. Players have six attempts to name the game; each incorrect guess reduces the pixelation, making the image progressively clearer. Points are awarded based on how early the correct answer is given.

The game features daily streaks, experience points and levels, over 40 achievements, weekly community challenges, daily medals for the fastest correct answers, and a cosmetic shop with banners, frames, titles and name styles that are earned exclusively through play. Completed days can be replayed from an archive. The game can be played as a guest without registration; an optional passwordless account (one-time e-mail code) stores progress across devices. Real-time community statistics show how many players have solved the current puzzle.

games.name: No Register
games.summary: Cross the threshold between existence and non-existence in search of a forbidden singularity. Decipher the logic of an abstract realm, solve puzzles, and survive the vigilance of the Guardians who protect this domain. Accept the destiny set before you or break the silence to forge your own.

games.name: Oradea
games.summary: A hexagonal rhythm game played on a controller or touchscreen.

games.name: Ore & Odds
games.summary:
Ore & Odds is an incremental game about extracting minerals and watching numbers spiral out of control. Every mineral you collect can be spent on upgrades or bet on the slot machine.

Your luck matters! Combine minerals and increase your chances of winning. Sometimes you win big. Sometimes… not so much.

games.name: Pieces of the Kingdom
games.summary: What if Chess…was a roguelite? Assemble your party and battle your way across a broken kingdom in a fantastical, tactical take on Chess. Loot epic gear, recruit powerful pieces with unique abilities, and strategize your way to victory.

games.name: Pilgrim Alliance
games.summary: PILGRIM ALLIANCE is a "Journey to the West" survivor rogue-lite. Lead your team through the "81 Tribulations" to reach India. Defeat and recruit Demon Kings to your squad! Mix teammates to create diverse builds, break through enemy swarms to defeat bosses, and craft your own legendary pilgrimage.

games.name: Pogopa
games.summary: In this funny & unconventional physics-based platformer, you help Grandpa conquer a treacherous mountain to rescue his granddaughter. Master the Pogo3000 and Grandma’s Balloon Helmet to reach the summit!

games.name: Pop! Pachinko
games.summary: Pop! Pachinko is a pachinko roguelite with city pop vibes. Build up your collection of enchanted balls to fire into the machine. Collect charms to build up powerful synergies between your balls. Listen to some pop music as you expand your Chibi Pop collection!

games.name: Project Sekai: Ayakashi Yokochou no Natsuyasumi
games.summary:
Before you knew it, you found yourself in an unfamiliar place.
It was a mysterious SEKAI inhabited by the ayakashis.
It seems you’ll need to make the summer festival a success to return to your original world!?

Work together with the ayakashis—who look familiar for some reason—to make the summer festival a success!

games.name: Radiorizon
games.summary: Dash into this challenging 2D platformer where you visit the remains of an old star system. You cannot fight the hostile creatures, only the god-like entities that sense danger in your presence. Explore the dangerous environment, talk to the inhabitants and destroy all 3 planets to save humanity.

games.name: Reawait
games.summary: After falling into a mysterious cave, your survival depends on your reflexes. REAWAIT is an intense underground puzzle-adventure where you must navigate a maze of shifting obstacles. Avoid deadly traps, unlock game-changing abilities, and discover what lies buried beneath the surface.

games.name: Resort Simulator
games.summary: Run and manage a seaside resort! Take care of guests and handle daily operations. Grow your resort step by step, create the perfect vacation atmosphere, and enjoy a calming simulation experience.

games.name: Rootlify
games.summary: Rootlify is a Roguelike Survival MMO, a cozy online space for gamers. Keep your plants alive and survive the 30 days. Meet other gardeners and grow together. In a world where everything is left up to chance, can you use fate to your adventure?

games.name: Roubaga
games.summary:
Roubaga is a fast-paced online multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Werewolf and Gartic Phone. No downloads, no accounts, and no setup required — simply choose a nickname, pick an avatar, create a room, share a 4-character code, and start playing with friends.

During each game, players are secretly assigned unique roles and divided into different factions. The villagers must uncover the hidden werewolves before it's too late, while the werewolves work together to eliminate everyone else. Special roles such as the Seer, Witch, Hunter, Cupid, Mentor, YooGos, Zenix, F1 Driver, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Algator37, and many others add strategy, mystery, and unexpected twists to every match.
