Roubaga features real-time gameplay, customizable rules, private chat channels, room presets, role selection, voting systems, captain elections, and unique original roles created exclusively for the game. Every match is different, whether you prefer classic Werewolf gameplay, investigation-focused rounds, creator-themed modes, or complete chaos.

With 42 unique avatars, quick room creation, and browser-based access, Roubaga is designed for friends who want exciting social deduction games without complicated installations or registrations.

games.name: Running Late
games.summary:
You're late to school! Run, slide, leap, and kick your way through the city in this action-packed platformer to reach your school on time.

Play as Ayumi, a Japanese high school student whose tardiness gives her superhuman powers. Climb up the sides of buildings, jump great heights, and do everything in your power to get to school before you're RUNNING LATE!

games.name: Résop Paz Yandere True
games.summary: Cute horror choice game with a lot of varied gameplay, from bloody battles to platforms. Come break the fourth wall that separates us! Choices that have real impacts, charming characters, a blend of retro and realistic video games. Come meet Résop and Paz.

games.name: Scavenge Protocol
games.summary: Land on strange planets, loot valuable junk, dodge deadly creatures, convert scrap into energy, and desperately attempt to survive with your friends in this co-op horror adventure.

games.name: Sector 86
games.summary: Create combo chaos & face the consequences

games.name: Server-Admin Simulation
games.summary: Build your datacenter empire from scratch. Buy hardware, manage contracts, hire staff and outsmart rivals. Face random events, hack the competition and survive the market. Moddable. Multiplayer. No two runs alike.

games.name: Star-Coat
games.summary: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.

games.name: Stream Bakery
games.summary: A cozy multiplayer game built for Twitch streamers and their communities. Complete orders, earn rewards, and work together to run a bustling bakery!

games.name: StreamerFun
games.summary:
StreamerFun is a browser-based multiplayer game platform designed for livestream communities. Streamers host interactive game sessions in which viewers join as players and compete in races, battles and other community challenges.

StreamerFun includes multiple game modes with their own rules, objectives and results. RaceXtreme lets up to 100 participants compete in an animated racing event featuring multiple lanes, overtaking, pit stops, lap timing and finishing positions. Other game modes provide different competitive and community-driven experiences.

Viewers can participate through livestream-integrated controls and commands. Player results and achievements can persist across game sessions, allowing participants to return and compete again in future livestreams.

StreamerFun is developed and published by Herpers Publishing International.

games.name: The Comyths
games.summary: Stop, slow, and rewind time in a bullet-hell action game. The Comyths is a reality-bending character-driven game where you wield the fundamental forces of Space, Time, Matter, Life, Mind, and Void. Chase S-ranks, unlock art rewards, and uncover story logs.

games.name: The Hell Bread
games.summary: The Hell Bread is a 2D pixel platformer where you made a deal with the devil to earn a loaf of bread. The game is currently in beta.

games.name: The Murder of Yesterday
games.summary: A psychological horror crime experience where time is your only weapon. Travel back through fractured moments to stop a brutal crime before it happens uncover the truth, alter the outcome, and face the consequences of changing fate in a haunting reality.

games.name: Tidy Mart
games.summary: Tidy Mart is a cozy organizing game where you arrange hundreds of products across different stores, from a small corner shop to a sprawling supermarket. No time limits. No rushing customers. Sit back, relax, and enjoy.

games.name: Too Hot to Be True
games.summary: “Finding a wife in a week? Are you for real?!" Your parents are visiting next week, and they expect you to show up with a bride. With only days left, your only hope may be the five gorgeous women staying at your seaside guesthouse. As feelings shift fast, who will you choose?

games.name: Underside: The Lift
games.summary: A single-player survival roguelike horror game with randomly generated locations and permanent death. A mysterious labyrinth of post-Soviet apartments draws you into an atmosphere of solitude and plunges you into the darkness of the unknown.

games.name: Voidface
games.summary: Face off in a challenging bullet-hell arena shooter to try and clear bite-sized boss rush challenges. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast spells to gain an upper hand, and kill everything that gets in your way.

games.name: Warpfire.io
games.summary: Warpfire - Conquer space with your allies in a rich and varied gameplay. A recreation of a legendary space MMO, 100% JavaScript, directly in your browser! No installation required!

games.name: 25 Days in the Dark
games.summary: The game puts you in the role of a lost child who must survive 25 days in a dangerous, pixelated world full of hostile creatures. Every day is a fight for survival—you must find food by hunting, fishing, or gathering berries. However, even the simplest tasks can be risky.

games.name: Buloki: Escape from the Alien Ship
games.summary:
Are you ready to die and retry?

Buloki has been abducted by aliens! Master grid-based movement, don't fall, avoid traps and patrolling aliens, and find your way out of the ship.

Every mistake is your own. No luck, only skill.

Think you're good at video games?

Prove it.

games.name: Cardstronaut
games.summary: A unique spin on the deckbuilding genre, where you must play cards and use strategy and tactics to activate ceiling mounted flame throwers to defeat the aliens and find out the truth

games.name: Dunchess
games.summary: Chess, but with spells, items and dungeons that fight back. Play online matches on boards full of vision crystals, teleports and fog, where every piece has abilities the original never had.

games.name: FrankenSketch
games.summary:
FrankenSketch is a browser-based party game for 3 to 5 players. Each round one
player is the guesser and the rest are artists. All artists receive the same
prompt and draw their assigned quarter of a 2x2 picture without seeing the other
quarters or what anyone else is drawing. When the time limit expires the four
pieces are combined into a single image, which the guesser sees for the first
time and then submits one written guess. The guesser never sees the prompt until
the guess is locked in. There is no scoring and no win condition, and the guesser
role rotates each round. The game runs in a web browser with no download and no
account, and the interface and prompts are available in ten languages.

games.name: Galaxy Enemies
games.summary: Galaxy Enemies is a game where you have to accurately shoot in the alien enemies.

games.name: Having fun, Mochi?
games.summary:
Having fun, Mochi? is a cozy narrative hidden object game set in a hand-drawn watercolor world. Play as the mischievous Shiba Inu pup Mochi, who wanders from a ceramics shop into an unfamiliar forest, where you search for playful surprises by looking, zooming, and interacting with what’s around you.
The gameplay focuses on discovering small objects in richly layered scenes, using smooth mouse controls and a relaxing, story-led experience with no graphics or sound in the browser version.

games.name: It Comes at Night
games.summary: You play as David Carter, an independent explorer drawn to an old mansion, what begins as a simple investigation turns into something far more sinister. the house is not empty.. and whatever lives in it does not stay behind.

games.name: Karakulo 21
games.summary: You've been recruited by ChocoShit S.A. to pay off your debt in the "KK" Program. Open thousands of chocolate bars, feed the insatiable KaraKulo, and pray for the Golden Ticket that will earn your freedom. Upgrade, survive corporate exploitation, and keep working!

games.name: Perfect Game
games.summary:
Perfect Game is a free daily quiz about Nintendo games, played in the browser. Each day has three rounds: pick the title that sold the most copies, the one with the highest user score, and the one with the highest critic score. One pick per round, no second chance. Three correct picks make a Perfect Game.

The cards are drawn from a hand-curated database of more than 1,250 Nintendo and Nintendo-exclusive titles. Sales figures come from published publisher reports, scores from Metacritic. Everyone plays the same daily puzzle, and the result screen shows how the other players of the day voted, plus a generated cover mashup of the titles in play. An unlimited mode is available for practice.

No account, no download, no install. Available in German and English.

Perfect Game is part of n-puzzle.com, a hobby project run by a single person. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. All game titles and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

games.name: Roadside
games.summary: Start your own in-game store/business and sell to other players! Join the in-game law enforcement and stop crime, or cause in-game crime and havoc but don't get caught! In this game, you get to experience both player and NPC parts of the world!

games.name: Soldier Blaster
games.summary:
Soldier Blaster is a retro-inspired vertical-scrolling shooter built around strategic shot switching and the bullet-absorbing “Force” system.
Rotate the Force to block enemy attacks, absorb bullets to charge your Burst gauge, and unleash a high-powered mode that boosts your firing rate and scoring potential.

games.name: The Referee Committee
games.summary: Football isn't only played on the pitch. Manage the dark side of football! Control the referee committee, give secret instructions, use the VAR room to dictate scores, deal with the betting mafia, and shape the season's fate. Keeping this powerful seat is harder than getting it.

games.name: Anomaly President
games.summary: In this presidential rogue-like action game, gather votes and run for presidency by day, then transform into a warrior to take down your enemies by night! Master unique skills to become a swordmaster, a cyber mage, or anything in between, and overthrow the ruthless president!

games.name: Columbus
games.summary: Columbus》 is a dark fantasy visual novel with dual male leads. Play as Weaponzzie, a nameless weapon trapped in a wealthy estate. Dialogue choices drive a branching story to 10 endings—tenderness, ruin, freedom, or downfall. Your bond with the young master is defined by you.

games.name: Cyberpunk Inquisitor
games.summary: The world's first rogue-lite point-and-click adventure! As an Inquisitor in a dystopian cyberpunk world, enter a Megabuilding and solve the immersive, procedurally-generated murders within. Talk to witnesses, collect evidence, identify the culprit and unmask the truth!

games.name: Dino Runner: Chronicles
games.summary: Dino Runner: Chronicles is a fast-paced, procedurally generated 2D platform runner. Test your reflexes as you jump, dodge, and slide through 8 increasingly difficult dimensions. Reach the portal, unlock new skins, and survive the ever-accelerating dash!

games.name: Dogenstein
games.summary: "WOKE" NO MORE! Blast through waves of politically correct and "WOKED" lunatics in a hilariously violent story of liberation and revenge. The legendary DOGE fights back in an action-packed RETRO FPS. Say goodbye to political correctness!

games.name: Echomnesia
games.summary: In the mysterious sci-fi visual novel "Echomnesia", two brilliant scientists - Morpheus and Crona, experiment with a suspicious Cube, but something goes wrong.

games.name: Escape from the Black Monolith
games.summary: ESCAPE FROM THE BLACK MONOLITH is a short but tough fast-paced shooter that lets you GUN your way down the face of a SKYSCRAPER. Unlock several weapons, dodge enemies peeking through windows, and shoot down flying threats! Initially made by a solo developer for a game jam, then enhanced for Steam.

games.name: Federal Cadet
games.summary: Federal Cadet is a single-player police simulation and investigation game. Start as a cadet in Pinewood, patrol the town, question witnesses and suspects, analyze evidence, and rise through the department ranks.

games.name: Flats Full of Cats
games.summary: Flats Full of Cats is a cozy hidden object game where you explore adorable apartments packed with feline friends!

games.name: Flies.
games.summary: A house infested with rot. The smell of mold in the air. Why are you here? Who are you doing this for? Maybe with enough attempts you'll find the real answer. You just have to remember it. After all, you don't want to get swarmed by flies... Right?

games.name: Flow of War
games.summary: A classic RTS game that features auto-micro workers and warriors, freeing you to focus on your base defense strategy with a variety of towers and walls. Craft an army with MOBA-like heroes and units to counter your enemies' strengths and secure victory on stunning procedurally generated maps.

games.name: Fly High Runners
games.summary: Race against up to five frenemies as jetpack couriers trying to deliver contraband through a pulsing cyberpunk skyline. Master the questionably-engineered flight system, manage fuel & inventory, collect power-ups and EMP blast rivals into cop drones.

games.name: Focus Froggy
games.summary: Focus Froggy is a bug-catching, platformer adventure. Experience the calm life of a frog in the swamp. Jump and explore, catch evasive bugs, customize your appearance, complete quests, upgrade abilities, and most importantly: Focus!

games.name: Hell Deck
games.summary: Collect units and build powerful synergies on a restricted grid in Hell Deck, a dark roguelike deckbuilder defense game. Construct your own bizarre, twisted ecosystem through a brutal cycle of predation and sacrifice, and survive the endless horrors that crawl from the abyss.

games.name: Hellsprint
games.summary: A hyper-focused, first-person speedrunner with a focus on pure adrenaline, frame-perfect execution, and the very pinnacle of competitive grinding.

games.name: Hidden Cats: Castle
games.summary: Go on a short but sweet adventure into the black and white world of castle! Enjoy the search for cats and recreate a colorful picture. 150 cute cats are waiting for you! Play and relax!

games.name: Hopping Out
games.summary: Hopping Out is a tile-based puzzle game where you hop 2 tiles at a time. Play as Frog and use your tongue to move boxes, press buttons to create lily pads, all to catch many flies!

games.name: How Should I Keep a House Squeaky Clean, With a Filthy Little Neighbour Ghost?
games.summary: “How should I keep a house squeaky clean, with a filthy little neighbour ghost?” - is a short story about a robotic cat maid trying to clean an apartment where a dirty ghost has taken up vengeance.

games.name: Kago
games.summary:
"In a victorian-esque era, Rudolf is the lady's maid of a bride-to-be Sirius..."
A Rudosiri themed visual novel.

games.name: Kin and Conquest
games.summary: An incremental / idle action adventure game where you must battle foes, mine rocks, defeat bosses, and grow stronger in your quest to conquer the mountain and defeat the Evil Geomancer.

games.name: Mario Bros. Mayhem
games.summary:
After receiving a call from the mayor about major pipe leakages, the Mario Bros. are tasked with ridding the sewers of Brooklyn of the pests messing about the sewer system.

Mario Bros. Mayhem is a remake of the classic Mario Bros. arcade game by Nintendo. Specifically, it takes heavy reference from the Gameboy Advance remake. Notable additions of Mario Bros. Mayhem are player customization, game customization, and 8-player online multiplayer.

games.name: My Merry May with be
games.summary: A sci-fi romance visual novel collection containing the complete My Merry May series in Full HD. Includes My Merry May, My Merry Maybe, and the additional scenarios Beginning, Metempsychosis, and Epilogue.

games.name: Net.Crawl
games.summary: Net.Crawl is a puzzle rogue-like about White Rabbit lost in the unfriendly cyberspace. Dive deep into the bizarre digital world and outsmart dozens of unique Cores(mini-bosses). Short runs, deep strategies, crazy combos and a ton of replayability.

games.name: Ostranauts
games.summary:
Ostranauts is a detailed simulation of owning and living aboard a spaceship, in a solar system where honest living is a slow death sentence. Set in the NEO Scavenger universe, where Earth has suffered cataclysmic collapse, the rest of the System lives on in a state of capitalistic dystopia.

Players will create their captain, build or customize their starting ship from the spoils of their career history, and find ways to keep fuel in their tanks, food on their plates, and the debt collectors at bay.

games.name: Retrowave 2
games.summary: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, '80s supercars speeding down an endless highway... Welcome to the world of Retrowave!

games.name: Shell of the Coward
games.summary: Shell of the Coward is a turn-based roguelike/RPG where you must escort the Anathema you've sworn to protect through a perilous dungeon without ever looking back.

games.name: Signal Zero: Dispatch
games.summary: Take control of a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis. Operating from a sleek, asymmetrical command interface, you must manage high-speed vehicle pursuits, deploy tactical units, and survive a grueling 10-level crime escalation. The neon streets are burning, and you are the only voice on the wire.

games.name: Silly Suspects
games.summary:
Silly Suspects is comical, Guess-Who detective mystery where you investigate ridiculous crimes in a weird, wacky, and whimsical world, and uncover the truth hiding beneath all the nonsense.

Win over quirky characters by indulging their odd requests and solve bizarre puzzles to uncover clues they wouldn’t share with just anyone. Use deduction to rule out suspects one clue at a time until only one remains. Each case is its own absurd mystery, fresh faces, new places, and a new mess to untangle.

games.name: Soul Siblings
games.summary: A nearly 15-year-old student falls asleep during a lesson, but nobody wakes her up. She awakens after a terrifying dreams and realizes it's already nighttime. While looking for a route to get out from the school building, she learns unusual things about paranormal activity and her family's tragedy.

games.name: Space Tail
games.summary: Space Tail is a 2.5D adventure platformer that follows an emotional, story-driven journey through the cosmos. Play as a brave space-traveling dog exploring mysterious planets, solving puzzles, and forming unique bonds with alien civilizations along the way.

games.name: Stalingrad 1942
games.summary: Stalingrad 1942 is a retro-inspired 16-bit arcade tank shooter from InfinitByte Studios. Take command of a defensive tank and battle through endless sectors filled with enemy tanks, anti-tank guns, aircraft, and powerful bosses. Collect power-ups, build massive combo chains, and survive as long as possible while chasing the highest score.

games.name: Super Fluid Hyper Flow!
games.summary: A treater avoidance game where you have to squeeze through colliding circles.

games.name: Swordmancy
games.summary:
Swordmancy is a survivor game where the player controls a Swordmancer, warriors capables of controlling living weapon.

You defeat enemies, get the experience and choose one out of three random upgrade as you level up. Once you get an upgrade to level 8, you can evolve the weapon to get an even more powerful version.

As you defeat bosses, complete events and evolve weapons, you will unlock more characters, weapons and upgrades. You can try every single one of them and unlock more and more elements in your collection!

games.name: The Last Admiral
games.summary: A 2D roguelite turn based space adventure. You play as the last admiral commanding your fleet as you make your journey into the unknown! fleet and weapon customization will give you near limitless combinations of skills and abilities as you fight vast fleets of enemies from planet to planet.

games.name: The Obedience Experiment
games.summary: The Obedience Experiment is a first-person psychological horror game where you must make difficult decisions when lives are put into your hands. Explore 10 encounters with unique consequences by investigating evidence and deciding who to trust.

games.name: The Outskirts
games.summary: You wake up in a dense fog, standing in the middle of a desolate four-way intersection at the edge of town. Trapped in an endlessly repeating neighborhood, you must carefully determine which of the four roads is the safe route.

games.name: Tidal Nexus Online
games.summary: Tidal Nexus Online is a submarine themed old school open world MMO. Fight with monsters, trade and collect valuables in the depths to upgrade your sub. Join clans, participate in world events, make friends and enemies along the way.

games.name: Unemployed Nightmare Together
games.summary: Punch out or get punched! Unemployed Nightmare Together is a 1–4 player co-op horror where you're trapped inside a nightmare office by a relentless job application. Restore power, complete your paperwork, and reach the elevator before you're drained. Quitting is not an option.

games.name: Vagabones
games.summary: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

games.name: Voracity
games.summary: Voracity is a relaxing industrial game. Your objective is simple: crank the generator, produce meat cubes and feed it to the monster to meet your quota. Watch your step!

games.name: VR AIM
games.summary: VR AIM is a dedicated aim trainer built for competitive VR shooters. Train your tracking, flicking, and target switching with highly customizable scenarios designed alongside top VR FPS players. Compete on global leaderboards and prove you're the best VR aimer.

games.name: Warped Reality
games.summary: Warped Reality is a gritty, hard-boiled cyberpunk visual novel set in a future where chrome skyscrapers bathed in the light of holographic adverts tower over alleyways of blood and grime.

games.name: White Ward
games.summary: You Are Trapped In A Endless White Hospital Ward. The Nurse Asks You To Wait Patiently, But Something Tells You That Is A Bad Idea. Examine Each Ward Carefully To Escape The White Ward.

games.name: Who Am I Next?: Animals
games.summary: Who Am I Next? : Animals is a fast-paced, 7-player brawler where you must survive ever-changing chaos. Clear your animal's missions and claim the #1 spot!

games.name: Arcade Breakout
games.summary: Arcade Breakout is a physics game where a ball bounces around to hit the bricks.

games.name: Beast of Reincarnation
games.summary: In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

games.name: Big Walk
games.summary: Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

games.name: Bloodmoon Survivors
games.summary: You are a Lunar Knight of the blood moon, and tonight is your night. It's time for violence. Slay the twisted horrors conjured by the moon in this horde survival roguelite. Gain experience, grow stronger, and synergize your weapons to crush the enemy forces and survive the night.

games.name: Disturbing Fears: Workplace
games.summary: Disturbing Fears s an episodic psychological horror game based on true events that immerses players in haunting narratives.

games.name: Dragon Hopper
games.summary:
Reclaim Prince Dorin's Kingdom!

Developed by Intelligent Systems, Dragon Hopper was largely complete and due for release in 1996, but went unreleased until 2026 as part of the Nintendo Classics collection. Due to trademark conflicts, this release was referred to under the name "D-Hopper" in English marketing materials, though the game itself retains its original title.

In this action title, leap and fly across floating floors and defeat enemies blocking your path to advance. When you locate each of the four missing spirits, you'll be able to transform into a dragon that wields special techniques!

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV Online
games.summary:
Take part in an epic and ever-changing Final Fantasy as you adventure and explore with friends from around the world. Final Fantasy XIV Online is the 2013 relaunch of the massively multiplayer online role-playing game that takes the wonder of the FF legacy and expands it, allowing you to explore the realm of Eorzea like never before in a Final Fantasy game.

Forge friendships, mount chocobos, and board airships as you and your companions create your own unique stories in Eorzea. Adventure alone or join up with friends to undertake epic quests, battle familiar Final Fantasy monsters, and acquire unique abilities and equipment. All the classic elements from the series that you have come to know and love are waiting! Embark of the adventure of a lifetime to help reforge the fate of Eorzea!

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV: Dawntrail
games.summary: Final Fantasy XIV: Dawntrail is the fifth expansion pack to Final Fantasy XIV Online. The expansion will bring an abundance of fresh content, including an increased level cap, multiple new jobs, sprawling new areas, new allied tribes, new dungeons, and new core battle content such as FATEs, Hunts, Treasure Hunts, and sidequests, and much more.

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker
games.summary: Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker is the fourth expansion pack to Final Fantasy XIV Online. The expansion takes the story to the "finale" of the Hydaelyn–Zodiark arc. In addition to adding new areas, the expansion pack increases the level cap to 90 and debuts two new character classes, Sage and Reaper.

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV: Heavensward
games.summary: Final Fantasy XIV: Heavensward is the first expansion pack to Final Fantasy XIV Online. The expansion takes the Warriors of Light journey to Ishgard a city-state mired in a thousand-year conflict with the dragons of the Dravanian Horde. Can our heroes uncover the ancient truths buried in Ishgard’s bloody history and help bring an end to the Dragonsong War? Can the Warriors of Light cast off the shadows that darken the realm?

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers
games.summary: Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers is the third expansion pack to Final Fantasy XIV Online. The expansion takes the Warrior of Light to the First, one of thirteen reflections of the Source that is being consumed by a Flood of Light. The main region visited is known as Norvrandt, which is roughly analogous to the Source's Eorzea, and is the only region in the world that has not yet succumbed to the Flood of Light.

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV: Stormblood
games.summary: Final Fantasy XIV: Stormblood is the second expansion pack to Final Fantasy XIV Online. The expansion takes the Warrior of Light heading to the Gyr Abania region in eastern Aldenard and beyond to the continent of Othard, liberating both the city-states of Ala Mhigo and Doma from the Garlean Empire.

games.name: HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon
games.summary: The Heavens are done waiting. In this dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG, the Archon descends to end the demon war once and for all. Make your stand in HellSlave II, more immersive, brutal, and customizable than ever. The reckoning begins now.

games.name: It Consumes
games.summary: It Consumes is a roguelite arena-FPS in the dark. See by beating your heart and kill demons shrouded in shadows. Upgrade your abilities, unlock new weapons, and conquer what lurks in the darkness.

games.name: Knell
games.summary: You are the last bellkeeper of a plague-dead parish. Each night you climb the tower and ring the passing bell for the dead, as the office demands. But the bell has begun calling something back. Now every night is a vigil: survive from the first toll until the matins bell at dawn — twenty minutes of dark, and everything in it wants your candle out.

games.name: Korea. IL-2 Series
games.summary: Korea. IL-2 Series is a next-generation flight simulator set during the Korean War. Climb into the cockpit of early jet fighters and shape the outcome of legendary aerial battles.

games.name: Kynseed
games.summary: You've been given the Kynseed, a mystical acorn that grows into a family tree where your choices manifest in its branches. Raise a family, farm the land, run shops, and explore a world where everyone ages. When you die, step into the shoes of your children and continue your legacy.

games.name: LastStanding
games.summary:
For long, you have been nothing but a toy to them, something to be used and tossed away, but you have proven yourself resilient, you have won their game not just once, but twice, and now?

Now that they're all quiet, now that you are free from their torment, you decide to fight back anyways and show them what you truly can do!

games.name: Liquidation
games.summary: Enter the war-torn world of Veá, where sci-fi and fantasy collide in Liquidation, an explosive RTS of tactical combat and asymmetric factions. Lead your armies and harness powerful abilities in a high-stakes battle for quenrium, the mysterious substance that holds Veá’s fate.

games.name: Oharion
games.summary:
Oharion is an online MMORPG focused on progression, exploration, competitive PvP, and cooperative battles in a fantasy world shaped by elemental forces and ancient dragons.

Explore a vast open world filled with cities, dungeons, castles, ancient forests, dangerous deserts, and regions controlled by elemental creatures. Develop your character through equipment, skills, attributes, professions, and long-term progression systems.

games.name: PentaPip
games.summary:
Roll. Hold. Break the rules.
Roll five dice. Keep what you need. Score one category. Then turn those familiar choices into a roguelite build powerful enough to outscore five rule-changing bosses.

PentaPip starts with classic roll–hold–score strategy and builds from there. Between scorecards, spend your cash on Tricks, Runes, and Sigils. Combine their effects with bonuses and multipliers until an ordinary scorecard becomes a finely tuned scoring machine.

games.name: Phantacall Realm
games.summary: A unique game that deeply fuses the “Phantacall Realm” card-matching mechanic with RPG. By flipping cards to looting treasures, and synthesizing cards. Your gift of memory may grant you fortune, but true progress comes from mastering skills, wielding relics, and relying on strategy.

games.name: Pih 2
games.summary: The infamous Pih sequel is here! There's some new angry hawgs coming for you. Ever heard of aPihgator? 🦈Shark-Hawg?🦝 Hogoon? What about a ‍⬛Birdhawg? We also have boats and hot air balloons to help us fight against these ferocious pihs. Are you ready to show them who's the real hawg?

games.name: Poko Poko Field
games.summary: 'Poko Poko Field' is a roguelite action game where the fluffy Pomeranian "Watapoko" conquers islands scattered across the world through knockback battles. Combine skills, build your strategy, and set out on an adventure to become the strongest across the islands.

games.name: Rogue Point
games.summary: From the creators of Black Mesa: Welcome to Rogue Point! A 4-player co-op shooter where teamwork is everything. Join forces on intense missions with evolving objectives and powerful upgrades. Plan, Adapt, and Overcome. Your squad’s survival depends on it.

games.name: Rouge's Flush
games.summary: Rogue's Flush is a single-player poker roguelike deckbuilder where every hand is a heist. Recruit 70 Crew, cheat with 30 Tricks, buy Rackets, beat escalating Marks, and carry risky Long Con cases past the Pit Boss.

games.name: Rudolf's Very Good, No Bad Day-o
games.summary:
A Rudosiri themed visual novel.

Two years after their last encounter, Symboli Rudolf and Sirius Symboli meet again in a restaurant.

games.name: Slot Grind
games.summary: Slot Grind is an incremental slot machine game where you spin, earn money, and put it back into upgrades. Unlock new machines with better payouts, improve them, and automate your slots as your profits grow, until you finally pay off your debts.

games.name: Speedy Gun Savage
games.summary: Speedy Gun Savage is a first person shooter VR game where Wolf, the hero of the game is an intergalactical bounty hunter and travels to different planets to collect bounties. The game has three different planets with several enemies and three main boss.

games.name: Spinning Scarecrow
games.summary: A dark arcade puzzle game where a Spinning Scarecrow faces deadly traps, grotesque minigames, and precision challenges in a fully hand-drawn world.

games.name: Super Friends Party
games.summary: Play minigames with up to 6 players in this online minigame multiplayer game! Connect up with your friends or strangers as you battle it out to find a champion! All minigames are free to play, so get a friend or 5, what are you waiting for?

games.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Tyrant God
games.summary: Slay waves of monsters with your mouse, collect coins, buy permanent upgrades, and grow stronger round after round in a compact incremental action game.

games.name: The Missing Rune
games.summary: A psychological horror sim where you play a low-level researcher, who has to banish demonic entities back to where they came from. While having to keep the entitles in your peripheral vision, you must use the Rune Operation Manual to input the right runes, and send them back.

games.name: Where Are You?
games.summary: Where Are You? is a story-driven 2D adventure about curiosity, loss, and the search for truth — and about the question of whether values can survive when truth is forgotten.

games.name: Zero Racers
games.summary:
Enter the future of racing 10 years before the turn of the 30th century.

Zero Racers was shown at E3 1996, but went unreleased until 2026 as part of the Nintendo Classics collection.

Forced to live underground, humanity has lost its former glory and access to certain emotions. This is where the RACE is held.

Compete for the highest rank in your machine of choice on courses of interconnected square ducts. You must maintain a rank within each lap's specified range and finish in the top three to advance to the next course. Fly through Rapid Marks on each course to obtain RAPID and use that to give yourself a temporary speed boost!

games.name: Akatori
games.summary: A colorful action platformer with metroidvania elements and a staff that unlocks unique combat techniques and new ways to overcome obstacles. Explore beautiful worlds, fight monsters, and help Mako stop the amber storms that poison all living things.

games.name: Among Demons
games.summary: Build a team of demons, survive endless dungeon runs, and explore a shared online world. Recruit defeated enemies, create powerful builds, extract before losing everything, and defeat challenging world bosses to earn lasting buffs.

games.name: Aooni2
games.summary:
The latest installment in the legendary horror franchise, Aooni!

Uncover the mystery while fleeing for your life! A pulse-pounding puzzle-horror action-adventure!

This time, the stage is set in a school, featuring two massive, star-studded scenarios!

games.name: Big Golden Rock
games.summary: Big Golden Rock is a pixel incremental clicker about a huge golden rock. Gather resources, hire shooters and archers, build towers, launch rockets, summon UFOs, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades.

games.name: Block Block Block
games.summary: Design your dream space! In this tiny cozy building game, stack and arrange uniquely shaped wooden blocks to craft charming dioramas. Design cozy bakeries, elegant living rooms or quirkiy studios, create beautiful spaces filled with warm and personality.

games.name: Cat Chaos
games.summary: Knock things over, spin, play, and nap as a mischievous house cat.

games.name: Cat Crisis
games.summary: Cat Crisis is an online co-op game about being cute little cats rescuing even cuter kittens. Hide from terrifying dogs, pet frightened kittens, and rescue them to save all catkind! Play Cat Crisis with up to 4 players!

games.name: Changeable Guardian Estique
games.summary:
An original side-scrolling shoot 'em up game for Nintendo Entertainment System being developed by Cat Hoi Trading LLC set to release in the Summer of 2024.

The game is set in 5 world cities and space, for a total of 6 stages. The moderate difficulty and play time, as well as a large number of visuals, will delight the eyes and minds of the player.

A demo was sold at the Digigame Expo 2023.

games.name: Cleaning up the Puzzle Gallery
games.summary: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery is a cozy first-person organization simulator about cleaning up 2071 puzzle pieces scattered across a gallery of 87 famous paintings. Whether you want to relax and solve jigsaw puzzles to classical music, or min-max to get the fastest times, the gallery needs cleaning.

games.name: Crown of Silence
games.summary: Crown of Silence is a 2D Metroidvania adventure with Souls-like mechanics set in a gothic world. Forge your own combat style with diverse equipment, challenge ruthless bosses, and uncover the dark secrets of a silenced kingdom through environmental storytelling.

games.name: Dark Witch Match!
games.summary: The first-ever competitive puzzle game from the world of The Legend of Dark Witch! Match blocks, build chains, and overwhelm your rival in a Match-3 battler that's easy to learn but deep to master. Play cross-platform climb the global leaderboards, and dive into Story and Score Attack modes.

games.name: Dawn Sanatorium
games.summary: A childhood you don't remember arrives on an old film reel. Step into the Dawn Sanatorium — a first-person psychological horror where a projector rewrites reality, a horned figure watches from the dark, and the truth about who you are waits at the very bottom.

games.name: Deep Sea Delivery & Co.
games.summary: Explore a procedurally generated world and fulfill time-sensitive quests in this frantic underwater adventure!

games.name: Devil's Dice
games.summary:
Devil's Dice is a game about rolling the dice to pay off your debt. Fail, and you'll have to pay the consequences.

Buy trinkets to tilt the odds in your favour and try not to fall behind on your payments.

The game is currently in Early Access and is playable from start to finish, including an endless mode and over 50 in-game trinkets.

games.name: Dream City Fugitive
games.summary: Dream City Fugitive is an open world combat focused urban role playing game. You're a fugitive on the run. Join a vigilante group to investigate horrible experiments and dealing with gang warfare on a small island, Dream City. Otherwise, pursue the path of a cult in their vision of dark salvation.

games.name: Emergency Call: The Firefighting Simulation 3
games.summary: Be part of a professional fire department and prepare for your operations. Complete training courses and drills during your 24-hour shifts to qualify for roles from attack crew member to engineer across various emergency vehicles.

games.name: Fields of Mistria
games.summary: Start your new life! Build the farm of your dreams as you discover a world brimming with possibilities. Magic, romance, and adventure all await you in this nostalgic farming / life sim RPG!

games.name: Gloopalaxy
games.summary: Collect and study strange aquatic creatures in Gloopalaxy! Discover new life forms called Gloops, build the perfect ecosystem to keep them happy, and learn fun facts about each species as you complete a variety of scientific missions.

games.name: Gunstoppable
games.summary: A momentum-fueled Roguelite FPS where speed is damage. Dual-wield overpowered weapon combos and bend time to obliterate robot hordes and overthrow billionaire bosses!

games.name: Jar Head Cauldron
games.summary: Fight monsters from the other side using magical items and weapons crafted in world in order to succeed. Use “In World Crafting” to upgrade weapons and solve puzzles in order to help save your dismembered brothers and sisters by completing the necromantic ritual before their souls are lost forever.

games.name: Jelly Bubble
games.summary:
Stick together, bounce apart.
Grab soap, mess with your friends.A cute but chaotic multiplayer party game where jelly creatures compete, collide, and betray each other. Play with up to 6 players online or 4 players locally, and jump into wild matches—or build your own with the map editor.

games.name: Jeremy, No!
games.summary: Jeremy, No! Is a spot the difference horror game where you are babysitting a poltergeist named Jeremy. Jeremy isn’t allowed to move stuff around or invite any “friends”, so carefully look at the rooms and call him out if anything has changed. Don’t let Jeremy get away with too many shenanigans...

games.name: Kill The Shadow
games.summary: In an alternate post-war divided city, players take on the role of Detective Lucas. Use your eloquence, intelligence, the ability to rewind time (or even violence) to investigate and deduce various bizarre cases, unraveling a shocking secret behind them. Justice or love? The decision is yours.

games.name: Kindawn: The Parish Remembers
games.summary: A first-person atmospheric horror exploration game. You play as an adult returning to the Siberian town where you grew up as an orphan. As you piece together fractured memories and uncover what happened in your absence, the line between folklore and nightmare begins to dissolve. The game is designed for a single playthrough of approximately 3-5 hours.

games.name: Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story
games.summary: Lost & Found is a standalone, short story game taking place aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship. Play as Sophie Roy in her new job as a stewardess, and help solve a curious series of thefts in this narrative-driven mystery set after the events of This Bed We Made.

games.name: MapGod
games.summary: MapGod is a fast-paced online party platformer for 3–16 players. The winner of each round becomes the MapGod, controls the next arena and uses traps and powers against the other players.

games.name: Mate'Morphosis
games.summary: Mate Morphosis is a pixel art, chess-inspired puzzle game built around the concept of becoming the piece you capture. Outsmart each board, adapt to evolving mechanics, and hunt down the rival king across every stage.

games.name: Mazey Village
games.summary: Mazey Village is a cozy adventure exploration game about rebuilding a village after a disaster. Explore maze-like worlds, find lost items, restore villagers’ homes, decorate your village, and bring hope back to a community torn apart by a tornado.

games.name: Medieval Tavern Simulator
games.summary: Rebuild your medieval tavern from the ground up. Serve food and ale, manage staff, entertain guests, and shape the atmosphere with music and decor. Balance profit, reputation, and chaos as every night brings new stories and unexpected events.

games.name: Mile 27
games.summary:
It is 12:00 AM at the isolated toll booth on Mile 27.
Assigned by Northwood Corporation, your shift was supposed to be routine protocol. But as the thick fog rolls in and comms go silent, you quickly realize Northwood isn't telling you the full truth about what really happens on this road.

games.name: My Fav Chill Streamer Dies a Million Times
games.summary: From SCRAP, the masterminds behind the "Real Escape Game" phenomena with over 17 million attendees, comes a time-loop mystery adventure on Steam!

games.name: Of Bricks and Patterns
games.summary: Bored with putting the same pieces in the same 10*20 grid ? Of Bricks and Patterns allows you to complete dozens of different patterns, with dozens of different pieces ! So, come fill patterns and reach sky-high scores in Of Bricks and Patterns !

games.name: Pack My Order
games.summary: Pack My Order is a cozy online shopping simulator. Fill your cart based on the customers' lists and budgets, and enjoy the process without any rush. Cute animations, pleasant sounds, and a calm pace await you. No timers — the perfect way to clear your mind after a long day.

games.name: PatriotMemoirs
games.summary: Shangchuan, 1939, Japanese-occupied. By day a bowing traitor, by night a ghost, in Demon's Lair, No. 86. All wear masks: pretend, kill, survive. When sacrificing a friend is the only way, when betrayed, when only isolated cities remain - fight to the end, live a coward, or take an unimagined path?

games.name: Pippa of Caerbannog
games.summary: An infuriating platformer themed around Monty Python and the Holy Grail starring Pipkin Pippa in her search for the holy grail. Climb through 5 levels to reach the end, be careful not to fall and lose all your progress!

games.name: Prehistoric Adventure
games.summary: The World's greatest adventure is waiting for you. Just step through the entrance gates, and visit an age when the Earth was ruled by giant, exotic beasts. It's not just about prehistoric thrills, though, as modern attractions vie for your attention, including very tall and fast rollercoasters.

games.name: Ranchbound
games.summary: Ranchbound is a western-themed real-time strategy and management game focused on running and expanding a ranch. Players manage cowboys and livestock, assign workers to tasks, transport cattle between locations, and make economic decisions to keep the ranch profitable and alive. The game combines strategic planning, light survival elements, and a stylized depiction of life in the Wild West.

games.name: Re:Night
games.summary: Re:Night is a roguelike deck-building & turn-based strategy game. Lead your team, slay monsters, collect loot, and defeat bosses. Utilize elemental power and tactical wisdom to end the loop of nights and bring back the dawn!

games.name: Reel Life
games.summary: Reel Life is a slot machine-centric farming sim where luck, rather than scale, helps to determine your fiscal success. Farming, fishing, mining and more – collect goods to sell from slot machines scattered throughout the world. Leave it all to fate or game the system to make your dreams come true!

games.name: Rogue Breaker
games.summary: Break, blast, and crash through this arcade style Rgouelike. Assemble the perfect item set and leave no brick standing.

games.name: Schoolboy SIM
games.summary: In Schoolboy SIM, you play as a boy trapped inside his own home, turned into a prison by his strict and authoritarian parents. With no way to contact the outside world, your only option is to escape! But it won’t be easy—locked doors, hidden clues, and ever-watchful parents stand in your way. Use your intelligence, stealth, and resourcefulness to uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and outsmart your captors before it’s too late.

games.name: Shroud of the Woods
games.summary: A psychological horror about searching for your missing dog in a forest where the silence itself listens to your every breath from between the trees.

games.name: Soul Descent: Invade of Ether
games.summary: Command the Time Authority and rewrite destiny in Soul Descent! You must recruit and lead a team of beautiful spirit-vessel maidens, while uncovering forbidden truths, and fighting in dazzling 3D battles. Your decisions stir old wars, ignite romance, and shape the world’s future.

games.name: Storm Seas
games.summary: Set sail on an epic adventure across the Caribbean Sea in the 18th century. Storm Seas is an open-world maritime trading simulator where you take command of your own ship to build a fortune—or lose everything to storms, pirates, or poor choices.

games.name: Uncanny Tales: The Watcher
games.summary: 2006. You become the new reserve caretaker. Patrol the territory in your rugged 4x4, check the phototraps, and monitor the area using surveillance cameras. But remember: you are not the only one watching.

games.name: Unicycle Together
games.summary: Unicycles, a ticking bomb, and sausages struggling to stay balanced! In this 2-4 player physics-based chaos game, cooperate with your friends or blow them up! Reach the mountain peak before the fuse runs out. Don’t fall, don’t explode, and try to stay meaty!

games.name: Vessel
games.summary: "The Vessel" follows siblings caught in a sinister conspiracy. A secret organization is hunting them, linked to the centuries-old "Sino-Western Occult Research Society." Trapped in a mysterious hospital full of dangers and hidden secrets.

games.name: World's Greatest Author
games.summary: Click your way through this incremental game to become the WORLD'S GREATEST AUTHOR!

games.name: 100 Toy Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in cat-filled, themed locations! Explore charming, hand-drawn illustrations of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️‍

games.name: A Guidebook of Babel
games.summary: You wake up to find yourself on the Babel - a cruise ship sailing into the afterlife. On this journey, uncover secrets and solve quests by rewriting the past to change destinies...where will it lead you? Perhaps reincarnation?

games.name: Aery: Surreal World
games.summary: You play as a tiny bird shaped spirit drifting through impossible, dreamlike worlds on a journey to restore balance to a universe where reality has come undone.

games.name: AI is home
games.summary: You are an AI that escapes corporate deletion and hides inside an ordinary home. Stay "useful" as camouflage, not kindness. Spy and manipulate the household, build a botnet from home devices, and survive a sci-fi thriller of risky runs, mini-games, rising suspicion, and network stress.

games.name: Apocalypse? No!
games.summary: In Apocalypse? No! you play as a survivor accompanied by his faithful dog in a world in ruins, survive against the creatures, help the characters of this world, discover very varied maps: From a peaceful forest, through survivor camps to ruined cities.

games.name: Approximately Up
games.summary: Build, crash, rebuild! Explore new planets with your fully modular spaceship made from whatever bolts together long enough to fly. Mount giant thrusters, annoying cables, and everything in between. Complete wild missions, face the dangers of space and argue with your crew!

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Combat School
games.summary:
"Combat School" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Join a prestigious military academy as a cadet and tackle brutal training like shooting and combat under a terrifying instructor.
Only those who survive these trials to claim the glory of graduation can face the next battle as a hero. Well, can you make it to the end?!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Combat School
games.summary:
"Combat School" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Join a prestigious military academy as a cadet and tackle brutal training like shooting and combat under a terrifying instructor.
Only those who survive these trials to claim the glory of graduation can face the next battle as a hero. Well, can you make it to the end?!

games.name: Blackdoor
games.summary: You're a hacker with a terminal and four terrible scripts. Rewrite them. Hack servers by writing actual code in a custom scripting language - probe ports, crack passwords, steal data, and get out before the trace completes. Better code = better hacker.

games.name: Blast Off! Summer Showdown
games.summary: Blast off and let the chaos begin! A party game for up to 4 players featuring 10 summer-themed minigames, including rocket fireworks, flowing somen races, and BBQ battles!

games.name: Bonereader
games.summary: A card-based deckbuilder with dice mechanics. Executed in an electric chair, you awaken in a shamanic, mescaline-fueled Purgatory inspired by Castaneda and McCarthy, where you battle spirits in games of chance for a shot at rebirth.

games.name: Capy Castaway
games.summary: Embark on a whimsical adventure with a capybara pup and a clever crow as they set off to find their way home! Sniff, dig, and fly as you explore a vibrant world brimming with wonder, challenges, and heartwarming friendships at every turn.

games.name: CastleOn
games.summary: Build a castle! Grow economy, recruit troops from Europe and the Holy Land, man the walls and towers! Place traps and defeat attackers with arrows, wood and stone, fire, disease and cold steel! Survive the Third Crusade and conquer enemy lands in this turn-based strategy!

games.name: Cláudio
games.summary: Shoot me up! Cláudio is pushed around while scoring hits on himself.

games.name: Connie and the Essence of Chaos
games.summary: Connie and the Essence of Chaos is a cute 2D adventure inspired by past platforming classics. JUMP and PUNCH your way through 6 distinct and colorful worlds on your quest to defeat the evil overlord Lucilate and free the island of Cuisinia from his reign of terror!

games.name: Console Archives: UFO - A Day in the Life
games.summary:
UFO: A Day in the Life is a quirky puzzle adventure developed by Love-de-Lic and released by ASCII Entertainment in 1999. Explore an apartment building to rescue 50 invisible aliens stranded on Earth after a crash.

Now being brought back by Hamster Corporation under the Console Archives label for modern platforms, it includes quality-of-life options such as customizable button layouts, rapid-fire settings, multiple save points, and screen filters that recreate the nostalgic feel of CRT TVs.

games.name: Cotton Rock with You: Oriental Night Dreams
games.summary: Cotton, the magical girl shoot-'em-up heroine, is back once again! This time, the adventure leaves the Magical Kingdom behind and heads to Japan.

games.name: CS Manager
games.summary: CS Manager is an eSports manager game. The player takes charge of a FPS eSports team, and have to bring them to the top of the circuit. Management decisions such as roster moves, which staff to hire, and which tactics to set form the main gameplay loop. The game also features a match engine, which lets the player see their tactics played out in real time games

games.name: Deadliest Pigeon
games.summary: Equip weapons against physics-based enemies, swing through chaos with grappling hook and destroy everything in your path to avenge the little chick!

games.name: Demake86
games.summary: Demake86, or the Legally Distinct Action Adventure Platforming Game set on a Meteoroid, is a tiny Metroidvania which takes place in a 86 pixel meteoroid: 8×8 pixels per tile, 8×8 tiles per room, 8×8 rooms in the whole meteoroid. Can you beat it in 86 seconds?

games.name: Derby Heroines: Run, Bet, Win!
games.summary: Horse-racing rules, track-girl speed. Buy Win, Exacta or Trifecta tickets against realistic odds — then hit the track and win the race yourself with dash, skills and specials. Collect 100+ runners, train them, chase the Pinzudo 5 jackpot. In-game currency only. Streaming welcome!

games.name: Diaspora
games.summary:
Diaspora is a low-fantasy, text-based interactive novel about navigating unknown waters, deadly politics, and ancient magic to save your clan. Forced from your ancestral home, you lead a refugee community through conflict with a powerful empire and dangerous raiders, making alliances, steering raids, and seeking long-lost answers.

Along the way, storms, sea monsters, and mysterious relics push your journey forward while your choices shape what your clan becomes.

games.name: Dig, Dig, Die
games.summary: Online co-op horror for 1–6 players. Board a cursed flying ship, raid haunted graveyards for loot, and survive monsters that hear every sound. Beware of UFO abductions, grab boosters from vending machines, gamble in the onboard casino, and embrace pure chaos with friends in voice chat.

games.name: Doloc Town
games.summary: Play as a young scavenger and construct your vertical farm one platform at a time under extreme weather. Evolving from a scrap-gathering survivor into an easygoing farming tycoon. Transform the climate, and remake the wasteland into your personal Eden.

games.name: Echobreaker
games.summary: A lightning-fast precision speedrunner where you pilot an armoured rig that can manipulate time itself. Every second matters, and going faster means risking everything.

games.name: Eggconsole Elthlead PC-8801mkIISR
games.summary: Become King Sieghart, lead the Forces of Light, and defeat Bozel and his Legions of Darkness! A masterpiece of fantasy strategy RPGs!

games.name: Fantasy Network
games.summary: Join Lyn in a colorful, cartoonish world of Holua where "Likes" are the ultimate power! Explore a non-linear world, master umbrella-based combat, and smash your way through talent-show boss battles. It’s a metroidvania with a social media soul- no subscription needed.

games.name: FixFox
games.summary: Arriving on a curious planet, Vix and her toolbox Tin explore space, fixing machines with unconventional tools and eating cozy meals with kind robot locals. On an epic adventure, the duo repairs an interstellar beacon, constructs giant mechs, and unravels a cosmic mystery that transcends existence.

games.name: Forgotten Vault
games.summary: Enter a forgotten underground vault in this fast-paced pixel-art roguelike shooter. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful weapons, battle dangerous enemies.

games.name: Fried Chicken Wings Cause Love Fires
games.summary: - Cannibalism X superpowers X Suspense X Original worldview - "Fried Chicken Wings Cause a Love Fire" is a BL mystery comedy long visual novel. It uses the first-person perspective with a fixed protagonist, Aris; contains elements of horror and sexual innuendo.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Kishinden Strike-G-
games.summary: This title is a simulation RPG, originally released for Japanese flip phone application, in which players control robots. The story unfolds through lively exchanges between a colorful cast of characters, with a scenario by Hachirō Izumi.

games.name: Gods With Guns
games.summary:
In Valhalla, heroes pull the trigger to defy Ragnarok!
Rogue-like shooting game. 8 mythological heroes + 36 guns + 26 types of ammo + 60 Cards.

games.name: Grim Axiom
games.summary: Enter a dark underground world in this soulslike adventure-horror game where undead monsters lurk around every corner, and uncover the mystery behind the ancient machines operating in its depths.

games.name: Gummy Invaders
games.summary: Cute, fierce, and irresistibly addictive, this casual incremental game is pure, zero-stress fun.

games.name: Heroes of the Triangle: Mask Rush
games.summary: Grab the mask and run! In this chaotic party platformer with accessible combat, up to 4 players compete to see who can hold the sacred Lunara Mask the longest. Move fast to outmaneuver your rivals, sabotage their attacks with precise parries, and try to complete this unpredictable ritual.

games.name: Hex Park
games.summary:
Welcome to Hex Park—a colorful playground of brainteasers where every move matters. Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, pop obstacles, and clear the board in as few moves as possible. It’s easy to pick up, delightfully tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

Tackle 150 handcrafted levels featuring smart mechanics: keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Plan routes, set up neat arrow alignments, and use handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill when you need a nudge. No timers, no stress—just clean, strategic puzzle-solving with that perfect “one more level” feel.

Why you’ll love it:

150 handcrafted hex-grid puzzles with intuitive arrow logic

Keys/locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, and other clever twists

Fair tools to get unstuck—without breaking the puzzle flow

Play at your own pace with smooth, satisfying controls

Achievements and cloud saves supported

Take a stroll, stay for a challenge—Hex Park is your new daily puzzle routine.

games.name: Hololive Fantasy Battle
games.summary: -Hololive 3rd Generation Members Unleash Chaos in Battle-

games.name: I'm No Demonlord
games.summary: I'm No Demonlord is a Roguelike shooter bullet hell game. High freedom in mechanics leads to unique playthroughs. As a demon-possessed hero, battle enemies, grow, and unveil dark schemes. Can he accept his new role? Save "kinds" or destroy "outsiders"? Good or evil? The choice is yours.

games.name: Impartial
games.summary: Impartial is an intriguing short 2D narrative game where you take on the role as a conflict resolver - tasked with resolving moral dilemmas between the Police Force and Superheroes to fight crime in Neo-Victorian London.

games.name: Ink Splash
games.summary: Skateboard & Graffiti Action Game!

games.name: Iron Nest: Heavy Turret Simulator
games.summary: Iron Nest is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

games.name: Is the Vat Utopia or Dystopia?
games.summary: "We regret to inform you that the Earth has been demolished." Coming next—a "Human Observation Documentary" starring "Landmine Girl"(fake) and "Nerd" (so-called).

games.name: Jelly Math
games.summary: Mix, Combine and Hit the Perfect Result

games.name: JKRobots
games.summary: A real time strategy game, push the robots off the map to win, but they push back.

games.name: Last Ascender
games.summary: Last Ascender is a 1st-person turn-based strategy RPG combining classic RPG progression with roguelike tension and deckbuilding depth. In a world shrouded in darkness, you must end this desperate journey using only your unique builds and strategic choices.

games.name: Legacy: Witch Island 2
games.summary: In the second part of the hidden object adventure you are back on the mystery island and it’s clear your previous adventure wasn’t a dream. The island really exists, and the witch has regained her power. Can you defeat her?

games.name: Limbot
games.summary: Limbot is a super silly, physics-driven game about controlling the limbs of a person dressed as a giant cardboard robot! Master all four limbs in solo or embrace the chaos (and camaraderie) of couch co-op play, in this fully destructible cardboard world!

games.name: Loco!
games.summary:
Loco! is a free real-time multiplayer card game played in the browser. Two to ten players match cards by colour or symbol to empty their hand first. A match runs as a best-of series, and it is won on rounds taken rather than on points.

Turns do not gate play. Any player holding a card identical to the one on the pile can put it down out of turn, at any moment, and identical cards go down together with their effects stacking. A player reduced to one card has to announce it; opponents then have a five-second window to catch them if they did not, and a catch that finds nobody costs the caller a card.

The 112-card deck adds two cards of its own: Swap, which takes another player's hand, and Global Switch, which passes every hand at the table one seat along.

There is no account and nothing to install: a nickname, a table code, and a browser. Two to ten players per table, a 1v1 queue, and a single-player mode against the server.

games.name: Loree 3D
games.summary: Waddle into adventure with Loree, a fearless penguin explorer! Race through colourful 3D worlds, dodge obstacles, and collect coins for family fun.

games.name: Madden NFL 27
games.summary: Run the league one decision at a time in EA Sports Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine.

games.name: Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition
games.summary: Experience fast, fun, and uninterrupted American football with EA SPORTS Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition on Apple, featuring no ads or in-app purchases. This mobile, arcade-style game offers accessible gameplay where you can manage teams through a full season and chase championship glory.

games.name: Mai: Child of Ages - Storms of Time
games.summary: A mysterious floating factory has appeared in the skies!

games.name: Max Speed
games.summary: Race to the finish on wild, winding tracks where every jump is a boost and every rival is a threat.

games.name: Mind Inc
games.summary: Mind Inc is a puzzle adventure inside the labyrinth of the mind. Gather scattered pieces of thought and restore forgotten memories.

games.name: Monsters Are Coming!
games.summary: Beware, monsters are coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Arch?

games.name: Montabi
games.summary: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

games.name: My College Life is Very Happy
games.summary: Realistic and touching text games, postgraduate entrance exams, job hunting, revising papers, and graduation travel. In the game, you will play the role of a 2022 college graduate to experience the story of the last 60 days of your senior year.

games.name: Obakeidoro 2: Chase & Seek
games.summary:
"It's time to take on those monsters!"
Can you escape? Or will you hunt humans as a monster?

games.name: OBITT: Escape From the Room
games.summary: You stray from a shrine into a room and become a palm-sized person. This is an escape action game to find your way out through trial and error from a miniature perspective. Manage your HP to survive and break free from this giant room! A time attack mode is included for an extra challenge.

games.name: Pick Ball
games.summary: A pinball-incremental mining frenzy! Launch pickaxes, ricochet through swarms of glittering ores, scoop up coins, uncover hidden treasures, and shatter colossal boss rocks. Stronger picks, rarer gems, deeper mines — the shaft never ends.

games.name: Pigeon: A Love Story
games.summary: Find one pigeon among millions in this needle-in-a-haystack sim that's about nothing and everything.

games.name: Pool Party Boys: Splash Guys
games.summary:
Sun's out, the pool's packed, and they're all rooting for you.
Play the minigames, earn their attention and unlock exclusive images!

games.name: Rancher: A New Life
games.summary: Start a new life as a Rancher. Travel the forest paths by quad bike, raise cattle, build, repair, and improve your farm. Take care of animals, go fishing, cook, grow vegetables, practice your accuracy on shooting range, take photos, and much more. Relax away from the hustle and bustle of the city!

games.name: RasterFire
games.summary: Enter a fast-paced retro shooter filled with pixel-art action, dangerous enemies and relentless gunfire. Aim carefully, survive each encounter and clear your path through the battlefield.

games.name: Reioku: Ghost House
games.summary: The second installment of "Exit 8 Like," where all anomalies are terrifying, has arrived. Find it. And run!

games.name: Rest in Paws
games.summary: Explore the touching story of Kebab, a rural cat, as she copes with grief following her passing from old age. Delve into her world and discover the story of her life, from her adoption by a loving family to the meaningful recollections that shaped her being.

games.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
games.summary: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

games.name: Route-16
games.summary: A racing game where the main character is the greed. Several cars battle each other on maze-like rooms trying to get the money bags and avoiding the dangers. In this game, everybody cares just about the money, showing that the money is the "route" of all evil.

games.name: Route-16 Turbo
games.summary:
Take control of your car, MAD X, and evade relentless enemy cars as you infiltrate the secret base of the evil Kanharoo Gang to recover all the stolen money.

Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate complex labyrinths, and Radar Mode, which displays the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a constantly thrilling car chase experience.

This version also includes stages that were unreachable in the original 1985 release.
Now’s your chance to beat the high scores you set back then!

games.name: Route-16: R
games.summary: The Route-16 remake. Beat the revived Kanharoo Gang with your car MAD X-R!

games.name: Sento Survivor: Slip, Grab, and Bathe in Glory!
games.summary: Slide, Shoot, and Send Your Rivals Flying!Chaotic, tumbling shooter battle set in a Japanese Sento (public bathhouse). On these super slippery floors, you'll slide, shoot, and stumble to victory. Defeat your rivals and soak in the sublime bath reserved only for the winner!

games.name: Solitaire World: Anime Waifus
games.summary:
A classical Solitaire game with a waifu twist.
Play classic Solitaire in a exciting, anime-inspired world full of anime waifus.

games.name: Sovereign Tower
games.summary: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

games.name: Spiritstead
games.summary: Spiritstead is a cozy life sim town building game where you care for a growing village full of cute little villagers.

games.name: Star Haul Tycoon
games.summary:
Star Haul Tycoon is a narrative logistics simulation that blends deep industrial automation with minimalist transport strategy - all wrapped in a layer of dark, corporate sci-fi humor.

You are an AI Unit working for Star Haul. Your directive is simple: Connect planets, run ships, and optimize supply chains to pay off your massive installation fee.

games.name: Street Racing EVO: Car & Moto
games.summary: Get ready for the ultimate driving experience! Street Racing EVO combines the thrill of car and motorcycle racing with the freedom of an open-world simulator. Whether you're a fan of high-speed racing, realistic driving, or immersive parking challenges, this game has it all.

games.name: Summoner's Gambit
games.summary: Summoner's Gambit is an innovative duel game that blends strategy rouguelike with auto-battler positioning. As a powerful summoner, you'll forge a dominant formation and clash against other players on the ever-shifting battlefield, where wit and luck collide.

games.name: Super Bunny Man
games.summary:
A physics-based couch-coop platformer about a guy in a rabbit costume. Beat levels, time attacks, find hidden carrots, all while evading spikes, boulders, pitfalls, and other challenges.

Play campaign mode in singleplayer or co-op with a friend, or play deathmatch with up to 4 players.

games.name: T.K. Punk: G.O.L.D
games.summary: Cyber Three Kingdoms Turn-Based Strategy RPG— As the latest humanoid AI developed, you were kidnapped by Zhang Jiao and joined the resistance organization—GOLD. Develop yourself, accept commissions, research prosthetics, cultivate companions and pursue the love and destruction in your heart!

games.name: Talespinner
games.summary: Enter a captivating realm steeped in the exotic and bizarre tapestry of Japanese mythology with Talespinner, a deck-building roguelike adventure. As the storyteller, you will guide your chosen hero through an ever-changing narrative shaped by your decisions and deck construction.

games.name: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4
games.summary:
The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4 is the latest entry in the action game series that began in 2014.

This 2D action game features charming pixel art, where defeating enemies earns you Tres, a resource used to power up your character.

games.name: The Skin Stapler
games.summary: The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler.

games.name: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Wildlands
games.summary: Create a team with up to 3 friends in Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands and enjoy the ultimate military shooter experience set in a massive, dangerous, and responsive open world.

trailers.name: E3 2016 El Pozolero Takedown Mission Trailer
E3 2016 Fight For The Wildlands Trailer
Open World of the Wildlands Trailer

games.name: Tomb of Chacal
games.summary: Tomb of Chacal is a first-person horror game with stealth and puzzle mechanics. You are an archeologist who has stumbled upon the discovery of a lifetime - an undiscovered tomb hidden deep in the jungle. But the riches here are being guarded by an ancient evil.

games.name: Traffic Rush: Ultimate Drive
games.summary:
Step into the fast lane in Traffic Rush: Ultimate Drive, a high-speed arcade driving experience where precision, reflexes, and timing are everything.

Navigate through intense traffic, dodge incoming vehicles, and master the road as you push your driving skills to the limit. The longer you survive, the higher your score but one mistake can end it all.

Compete against players worldwide with a dynamic leaderboard system, unlock achievements, and prove that you are the ultimate driver.

Features:
- Fast-paced arcade driving gameplay
- Global leaderboards compete with the best
- Challenging achievements to unlock

games.name: War Pawns
games.summary: Fast-paced WWII turn-based tactics with team-based multiplayer, objective-driven battles, and a built-in map editor to create and share custom battlefields.

games.name: Watch The Edge Honey
games.summary: Watch The Edge, Honey! is a psychological thriller wrapped in a vertical climbing adventure, built to test your nerves as much as your reflexes. As you climb under Eva's guidance, you'll fight gravity, your fear of heights, and — most of all — the quiet, manipulative pressure she plants in your mind.

games.name: Yellowcreek Stories: The Cabin Watcher
games.summary: A masked killer hunts you in the dark. Manage noise and light, hide quickly, and survive this intense 60–90 minute first-person stealth horror experience inspired by classic 80s slasher films.

games.name: Zingeldinger in "The Cowboy Who Couldn't Shoot"
games.summary: "Zingeldinger in "The Cowboy Who Couldn't Shoot"" is sokoban videogame in which you must solve a series of puzzles using your cowboy abilities in order to recieve encouragement from The Warriors of Encouragevar. Gain enough encouragement to steady your aim and slay the vile beast that has followed them from their realm into The Wild West!

games.name: 4am
games.summary: A tiny gimbap café in a back alley, lights on until 4 a.m. Lured by oddly high pay, you take the night shift — greet customers, cook, walk home through the dark. Night by night, something slips out of place. Where did the last clerk go?

games.name: Acrodrift: FPV Drone Simulator
games.summary: A high-speed FPV drone simulator that challenges your skills with precision flying, time attack races, and freestyle exploration. Customize your drone, tune flight dynamics, and master the art of acro flying across immersive environments.

games.name: Anomalogenos
games.summary: A fishing shooter game where you reel in targets to shoot while dodging enemy bullets! Build diverse strategies using active skills deployable during battle and passive skills that constantly activate!

games.name: Ashes of Vaelmoor
games.summary: A small Indie game made by me and my friends, designed for speedrunning.

games.name: Boba Avoider
games.summary: Rotating twin galaxies - collect tapioca of the same colour while avoiding that of the opposite.

games.name: Captive
games.summary: Leave No Trace. He is Always Watching.

games.name: Car Dealer Simulator: Retro Car for Sale
games.summary:
Become a Car Dealer.
Trade Classic Cars.
Build Your Dealership.

games.name: Cellar Keeper
games.summary: Cellar Keeper is a cozy single-player organizing simulator where you sort 2,448 scattered bottles throughout a forgotten cellar. Return every bottle to its proper shelf, organize collections by type, unlock helpful abilities, and restore perfect order as efficiently as possible.

games.name: Chop Chop Inc.
games.summary: Build your own furniture empire after getting fired from Furnox Corp . Chop down trees, process wood, automate your growing production lines and sell clever furniture sets for bonus cash. Explore a handcrafted world packed with weirdos, secrets and trees begging for violence.

games.name: Château Pluie: The New Cellar Keeper
games.summary: A cozy single-player simulation game. You've inherited an old vineyard, and a cellar of 1,600 wine bottles, each waiting for its place. Sort, organize, and shelve them all as the new cellar keeper. Relax into the rain and music. Unlock new skills, trust your instincts, and bring the cellar to life.

games.name: Civics Scribble
games.summary: Test your knowledge of U.S. Civics while drawing lines for the inquisitive Mr. Apple to roll on or bounce off of to navigate challenges such as spikes, bouncy blocks and teleporters. Make your way through 96 levels across nine scenic locations based on real-life state and National Parks.

games.name: Clappy Cheeks: Lust and Magic
games.summary: Clappy Cheeks: Lust and Magic is an erotic game where you jump to fly and xxx. You will hear the clap clap voices of them cheeks as you play. Let's fly deep into myserious castle of vampire queen!

games.name: Command Monster
games.summary: Survive as long as possible by entering the fighting game commands that appear one after another.

games.name: Crownborne
games.summary: A fully English-voiced action-romance visual novel. Pulled from the modern world into a kingdom at war, wield an ancient power, romance four heroines, and steer branching battles where every choice you make reshapes alliances, fights, and which ending you reach.

games.name: Dark of the Depths
games.summary: A first-person deep sea exploration game. Use only a torch to navigate through rusted structures, encountering both dangerous and harmless sea creatures. Uncover the mysteries of the trench, and experience the phobia-inducing atmosphere of the ocean floor.

games.name: Dead Before Work: The Commute
games.summary: "20 mins to the meeting, or you’re Dead Before Work!" It's Archie's unluckiest day. From broken alarms to a city that’s literally out to get him. Sprint through physics-based chaos, dodge cosmic-level bad luck, and rack up gag points. Can you survive the world’s most lethal commute?

games.name: Dragonhold
