The mission ends, but its results do not reset. Every delivery, loss, battle, and captured objective changes prices, supplies, faction strength, and what happens next.

Citadel gives you short, focused missions inside a permanent player run sandbox.

games.name: Clawed
games.summary: Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must explore the park's grounds to scavenge resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way through diverse biomes, underground tunnels and deadly enclosures. But beware, you are not the apex predator here.

games.name: Cloverpit
games.summary:
You wake up in a rusty, narrow cell, standing over a dangerously unstable grate.

Someone has kidnapped you, demanding payment, and your only way out is to play the Slot Machine and pay off your debt.

Don’t let yourself fall —literally— into ruin!

games.name: Clown's Lair
games.summary: Explore a haunted house stalked by a sinister clown. Stay hidden, solve puzzles, destroy cursed objects, and escape before your pursuer catches you.

games.name: Colorizing: Pleasure
games.summary: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation

games.name: Cook with Card
games.summary: Run your own cozy restaurant, prepare orders and create efficient kitchen workflows using your cards in this relaxing cooking management game.

games.name: Cosmic Coop
games.summary: 'Cosmic Coop', an alien farming/creature collector odyssey! Lure Critterlings with captivating objects, establish harmonious ecosystems, and ward off invaders. Delve into mines, craft for your farm, and chat with quirky native creatures. More than farming – it's deep cosmic bonding.

games.name: Creepshow
games.summary: Get lost in a deliciously dark horror anthology. Inspired by Shudder’s Creepshow series, this point-and-click adventure has gone all kinds of wrong.

games.name: Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Luxury. Romance. Ocean.

games.name: Dagger Directive
games.summary: Dagger Directive is a tactical FPS that allows you to approach each mission in your own way. Select equipment, decide the time of day, then move methodically to complete your mission. Enjoy the modern mechanics and old school graphics as you fight across a variety of missions and environments.

games.name: Dash'n'Drops
games.summary: Blast your way through Dash'n'Drops, a platform-fighting inspired roguelite. Build your own moveset, max your stats, and defeat the 7 Eternals!

games.name: Dead Stop: No Vacancy
games.summary: Dead Stop - No Vacancy is a short first-person horror game set in an isolated roadside motel. Explore the Paradise Motel, uncover its disturbing history, solve environmental puzzles, and survive a night in which something has gone terribly wrong.

games.name: Decimation
games.summary: Sci-fi tower defense meets ARPG-like hero combat. Build towers then fight alongside them with your hero as you battle through a campaign to uncover the fate of a colonization effort on a distant planet.

games.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
games.summary: The legendary medieval strategy adventure has returned - enhanced for a new generation of knights. Conquer provinces, raise armies, storm castles, and influence the balance of power through bold strategy and action moments.

games.name: Dinosaur
games.summary: Create your own island without limits. Populate your island with dinosaurs, choose from over 50 species. Ensure the mutual symbiosis and prosperity of all species on the island.

games.name: Dinotica
games.summary: Embark on an adventure across a perilous ancient land, exploring diverse regions to discover and hatch loyal dinosaur companions. Together, you'll fight, build, farm, and more, as you work toward creating a unique home that is truly your own.

games.name: Dream House Cleaning
games.summary: Bring forgotten places back to life in a cozy cleaning and restoration game! Clean dirt and trash, repair damaged areas, decorate interiors with furniture, and enjoy a relaxing experience at your own pace.

games.name: Drink Factory Simulator
games.summary: Build your own drink factory, discover recipes, improve production, and fulfill customer orders to grow your beverage empire! Drink Factory Simulator is a fun simulation game that combines creativity and strategy.

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

games.name: Eggconsole Onryou Senki PC-8801mkIISR
games.summary: Use your deductive powers to battle spirits in this unique Miyaji City horror adventure!

games.name: Emergency Room Simulator
games.summary: In "Emergency Room Simulator" you become a dedicated doctor in the emergency room, responsible for diagnosing, treating, and saving lives. This professional simulation offers an immersive experience of the challenges and rewards of working in a fast-paced medical environment.

games.name: Endless Tactics: Trial Run
games.summary: Endless Tactics: Trial Run is a Turn-Based Roguelite game. Play as the commander of a high-risk planetary mining operation, defend your base from alien creatures while trying not to get overrun. Use resources to upgrade your starship, unlock new tech, powerups, and deadly new worlds to harvest.

games.name: Evil School
games.summary: This game is an FMV about anti-bullying. A teenage girl mysteriously disappeared, and the truth was buried by power for eight years. Now, you return to this place of evil with a bloodstained list. The moment of slay & judgment has arrived...

games.name: Eye of the Incubus
games.summary: Shiro, an unassuming castle servant, one day comes into contact with a mysterious demon and is transformed into a half-demon. Though baffled at first, now half-man and half-demon, Shiro begins to accept his newfound life. Free at long last, however, Shiro finds himself in the center of chaos and trouble…

games.name: Find the Sneaky Chameleon
games.summary: Can you remember what blended in?

games.name: Flock of the Seraphim
games.summary: Adopt gun-wielding angels that help you exorcise waves demons in this horde survival roguelite. Gain power by purging depraved demonic enemies, collecting loot, and improving your flock to create unique builds of holy power. Do you have enough faith to survive?

games.name: Future Knight
games.summary: Frenetic action and LCD aesthetic! In this 2D Shoot 'Em Up, switch between a robot hero and his benign tumor to stop a bizarre cult. You have 8 hours to save humanity's memory: defeat grotesque bosses, ride the skies on your Future Board, and master the chaos in a retro-futuristic Tokyo.

games.name: Glam the Rocker
games.summary:
Face bosses and platforming challenges!

Copy the enemy arsenal to acquire new abilities!

Everything mentioned above is present in this unique fast-paced action game!

games.name: Grayland Remastered
games.summary:
Fly through breathtaking hand-painted environments, dodge enemy drones, cleanse toxic hotspots, and confront colossal bosses in your journey to save your loved ones. Discover the haunting mystery behind the fall of this world — and fight to restore hope where none remains.

Remastered Edition Enhancements
* 4K resolution with enhanced visuals and refined animations
* Redesigned controls optimized for the DualSense controller
* Rebalanced difficulty system for smoother, more rewarding progression

games.name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
games.summary: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

games.name: Hellbridge
games.summary: Defend the last bridge to the living world in a relentless siege from Hell. Survive escalating waves, draft powerful spells, grow stronger with every run, and enter cursed gates to stop the invasion at its source.

games.name: Hotel Empire: Check Inn
games.summary: Hotel Empire - Check Inn is a charming management simulation in which you build your own hotel chain step by step. Start with a small, simple hotel and expand your empire into more and more cities – each with its own challenges.

games.name: Idle Immortal
games.summary: Build a Chinese fantasy sect, recruit disciples, and forge the ultimate squad for ascension! Are you ready to walk the path to immortality as a true Sect Master?

games.name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Spirit
games.summary: The officially-licensed mobile game for the hit anime series Jojo's Bizarre Adventure! A faithful recreation of the original world from this multigenerational RPG — JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Spirit is finally here! Take on the "golden spirit" of the Joestar bloodline and set out on a bizarre adventure of your own today!

games.name: Kaboomania
games.summary: A fast‑paced retro maze bomber packed with explosive action, colorful pixel art, and a fresh twist on a timeless gameplay formula. For all retro and pixel art lovers!

games.name: Karma Keepers
games.summary: Karma Keepers is an idle/incremental souls sim where you guide souls, collect spiritual energy, upgrade and automate to keep corruption at bay, and push karma to the max to banish demons.

games.name: Kingdoms vs. Zombies
games.summary: Kingdoms vs Zombies is a blend of strategy, tower defense, and roguelike gameplay, where you must defend your kingdom against endless hordes of the undead.

games.name: Ledgerbound
games.summary: The world may end, but more importantly: your job is on the line. Step onto the battlefield, befriend (and fall in love with) a ragtag crew of heroes, and go head-to-head against an immortal foe to protect the bureaucratic kingdom you love in this hilarious narrative-driven tactics RPG.

games.name: Lost Chronology
games.summary: Explore Past your Guilt and Denial. This Psychological Puzzle Horror will have you Explore your Psyche, 1 Minute before you Die! Are you Ready to Dig into the Darkness, Unearthing your Deepest, most Shameful Secrets?

games.name: Lost to Time
games.summary: Lost to Time is a metroidvania focused around time manipulation. Play as different Magi (characters you can turn into) in order to overcome otherwise overwhelming challenges.

games.name: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic
games.summary: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic is a Roguelike game. You will role-play an agent of a streamer who died because of a murder. You are trying to "bring her back" through AI technology on the Internet, making her the unique creation of the Internet.

games.name: Low-Budget Repairs
games.summary: Manage renovations in 90s apartment blocks! Focus on quick profit and cut costs wherever possible. Client notices defects? Tough luck, the money's already in your pocket. Every day brings new challenges and decisions that can lead to fortune... or trouble!

games.name: Lucky Break
games.summary: In this roguelike deckbuilder you’re an addict. Deep in debt to the mob, a little drunk, and out of time. Just one more spin, and then you'll quit.

games.name: Memoirium
games.summary: Traverse a chaotic and crumbling realm of dreams composed of liminal spaces. Adapt to the world’s odd rules as a Dreamer, and defy others like you to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape.

games.name: Menherarium
games.summary:
This game is a deck-building roguelite where you must keep winning blood-staked Cee-lo against a super clingy girl.

Modify the dice faces, use cheating items when necessary, and overcome her unreasonable demands to win the bets.

Your goal is to survive the life-and-death Cee-lo.

games.name: Miniquest
games.summary: A retro fantasy quest shrunk down to mini-size! Challenging turn-based combat meets the tight pacing of an arcade game in this minimalist RPG. Become the Chosen Ones and vanquish the Dark Lord, all in the span of a couple of hours. Then do it again, exploring branching paths and alternative endings. Then do it again! And again. And again... forever?

games.name: Moonleap 2600
games.summary: A fan-made demake of the game Moonleap, imagining what it would look like on the Atari 2600.

games.name: Mystery Box
games.summary: Pack it. Ship it. Make their day.

games.name: Nightmare Delivery
games.summary:
Nightmare Delivery is a cooperative psychological horror game where players take the role of couriers sent into places no delivery should ever reach.

You do not deliver to houses, streets, or real locations.
You enter the distorted consciousness of different people and carry a package meant for the darkness hidden inside them. Each mission takes place inside a strange mental space shaped by fear, memory, guilt, obsession, or trauma. These places may look familiar at first, but their logic is broken. Corridors lead where they should not, rooms repeat without reason, and ordinary objects can become part of the puzzle.

games.name: Omega Pilot Evolution
games.summary:
Omega Pilot Evolution is a high-speed futuristic racing experience that pushes the limits of anti-gravity flight. Race in immersive VR or play on a regular screen in both first-person and third-person perspectives.

Take control of cutting-edge anti-gravity ships and master precision piloting across dynamic tracks built for extreme speed, tight control, and skill-based maneuvering.

games.name: Open The Gate: Just A Little
games.summary: Defense your medieval castle from unfriendly legions approaching in this Tower Defense Rogue-lite PvE. Combine your unique team of Human, Goblin, Undead... to defeat your enemies by slaying the Dragon in shortest amount of time!

games.name: Panzer Knights: Commander’s Edition
games.summary:
Panzer Knights: Commander's Edition is an anime-inspired WWII tank simulation where you command a German Panzer platoon through the chaos of Europe's battlefields. Engage in explosive third-person combat from the Battle of France to Operation Barbarossa, managing your tank's vital systems, loading specialized ammunition, and targeting enemy weak points. Between missions, assemble an elite crew from 30 recruits with unique skills and backstories, then deploy your arsenal of meticulously detailed tanks.
The Commander's Edition represents the definitive console version, bundling the base game with three bonus tank packs featuring the M4-748 Sherman, M26 Pershing, Churchill VII, Valentine XI, Panzer VIII Maus, and Elefant—tanks not included in the original PC release.

games.name: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising
games.summary: A Lovecraftian idle RPG with auto-battles, loot farming, chests, team strategy, town building, gear crafting, Runewords, stages, towers, realms, and seasons. Serve the Old Gods, build your town, corrupt the chosen, and fight for their awakening!

games.name: Pin Money
games.summary: Turn a rundown neon bowling alley into a billion-dollar strike empire. Stack absurd multipliers, unlock powerful upgrades, expand to 7 simultaneous lanes, and break the economy in this incremental idle bowling game.

games.name: Pizza Man Simulator
games.summary: Burned the pizza? Just drown it in ketchup! In your restaurant, microwaving a frozen Hawaiian is literally an everyday thing. Serve picky customers, upgrade your pizzeria and improvise in the kitchen. The most important rules? Nobody gets food poisoning… and the cash actually adds up.

games.name: Plungeez
games.summary: Take a dive in the world of Plungeez, a puzzle platformer where Bonnie, a fierce woman who, after falling in the underground, must explore the sewers of Salvador in search of a way out. Light torches, boilers, and use plungers to climb and solve puzzles!

games.name: Pool Glow
games.summary: Pool Glow is an immersive exploration game inspired by poolcore aesthetics. You are free to wander through bright, open pool spaces, observing the gentle interplay of light and shadow. You can slow down, explore at your own pace, and discover a quiet sense of peace and relaxation.

games.name: Primary School: English Grade 1 & 2
games.summary: Complete Grade 1 & 2 English – fun, guided & smart learning quizzes for kids.

games.name: Project Neon
games.summary: Project Neon is a new, vertical / TATE style Shoot 'Em Up (shmup), developed for the original Neo Geo MVS / AES platform. It features a 1-2 player mode, with all the bells and whistles of a classic shoot 'em up that you would expect, spiced up with some modern and unique concepts and game mechanics.

games.name: Rocket Sideswipe
games.summary:
Rocket Sideswipe is a fast-paced 2D arcade football game where cars replace players and every match is a battle of speed, precision, physics, and aerial control.

Choose your team and enter the arena to score as many goals as possible before time runs out. Drive across the field, jump into the air, use your boost, perform flips, and smash the ball toward the opponent's goal.

The game offers several ways to play. Face an AI opponent with four difficulty levels, from Easy to Pro, or challenge another player locally in two-player mode. You can also choose between 2-minute, 3-minute, and 5-minute matches.

The physics-based gameplay allows you to control your car both on the ground and in the air. Jump twice to perform powerful flips, rotate your car while airborne, boost through the arena, and use momentum to deliver powerful shots. The ball reacts dynamically to collisions with cars, walls, the ground, and goal structures, creating unpredictable and spectacular plays.

Boost pads are scattered throughout the arena and can refill part or all of your boost meter. Managing your boost is essential for chasing the ball, defending your goal, launching aerial attacks, and making last-second saves.

When regulation time expires with the scores tied, the match enters sudden-death overtime. The next goal wins.

With neon-styled arenas, energetic physics, local multiplayer, AI opponents, aerial mechanics, boost management, goal celebrations, particle effects, and dynamic sound effects, Rocket Sideswipe delivers a compact car-football experience focused on fast matches and spectacular plays.

Drive. Jump. Boost. Flip. Score.

games.name: Sandustry
games.summary: Sandustry is a mining and automation game with sand physics. Explore a destructible world, digging and demolishing. Build a sand-processing factory and expand your logistics network. Delve deeper into the mines, unlock new technologies, and discover an ancient civilization's secrets.

games.name: Scratch the Ticket
games.summary: Scratch the Ticket is a first‑person incremental gambling sim where every ticket is a test of nerves. Print tickets, scratch cells, and decide: cash out now or risk it all. The outcome depends only on your choice.

games.name: Servant of the Lake
games.summary: Servant of the Lake is the new premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom.

games.name: Shinkansen Card Pull Simulator
games.summary: Real Shinkansen bullet trains — now collectible cards! Pull gacha, trade on the market, ride the price swings. 50 cards featuring real Shinkansen photographs.

games.name: Skatesterre
games.summary: Flip, grab and grind like it's 1999! Skatesterre is a fast-paced arcade skateboarding game inspired by the golden era of classic skate titles.

games.name: Slampunks
games.summary: Slam, slice, and roll through an evil corporation in this fast-paced 1-3 player co-op action roguelite. Chain kinetic hero synergies, steamroll over endless swarms of enemies, and stack wild augments until your builds are screen-breakingly huge. Grab a punk-mate and smash the machine!

games.name: Snowed Under
games.summary: Snowed Under is a first-person game about shoveling snow in the mountains.

games.name: Someone's Here
games.summary: Just another night in your apartment soon transforms into a tense game of choices. Answer the door, trust no one, and survive the night. Every choice changes the outcome.

games.name: Sort Them Ducks
games.summary: Sort Them Ducks is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,000 unique rubber ducks onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy duck store into a perfectly organized collection at your own pace.

games.name: Soul's Remnant
games.summary: Soul's Remnant is a 2D platformer MMORPG focused on social gameplay and exploration! Customize your character, and conquer dungeons and bosses in this mysterious world. Play with friends or make new ones - just watch out when night falls!

games.name: Soulstation
games.summary:
A visual novel between fear and love. Follow Kin as it falls deeper into a rusty world that will one day eat it whole. Will you get on board?

An atmospheric audio-visual narrative of a child who boards a train to the afterlife.

Will you give in to reality? Or crawl your way out? In this beautiful dusk, you need only open your heart.

games.name: Spear of the Sky
games.summary: Grab your magical returning spear in this cozy first-person hunting game! Take your time hunting unique creatures across dynamic skies, upgrade your arsenal, and use baits to discover rare beasts. Relax, enjoy the hunt, and prepare for occasional epic boss fights.

games.name: Stack Mates
games.summary: Stack Mates is a co-op puzzle-platformer for 2-8 players built on teamwork and pure chaos. Shift your form between horizontal and vertical, climb on your friends, and reach the portal together. Remember, if even one person fails, everyone starts over!

games.name: Star Troopers: Combat Force
games.summary: Move fast. Strike faster.

games.name: Storm Horse Simulator
games.summary: Run wild and free! Become an untamed stallion in a cozy open-world adventure and set out to rescue your captive family. Outsmart patrols, build a safe haven for your growing herd, and form an unbreakable bond with a native friend. Your homeland awaits - answer the call of the wild!

games.name: Suika Pets
games.summary: Suika Pets is the adorable puzzle game where you combine your pets to grow your score without overflowing their container!

games.name: Terrol
games.summary: Terrol is a grand strategy game focused on capturing and holding strategic resources. The objective is simple: control all resources and destroy rival empires.

games.name: The Box of Fear
games.summary: A missing daughter. A father without answers. A suspicious company. Solve puzzles, connect clues, and discover what "The Box" hides in this first-person psychological horror.

games.name: The Canon of Balls
games.summary: Hardcore, first-person, co-op platformer. Shadow of the Colossus' PSX aesthetics meets Monkey Ball. An easy-to-learn, hard-to-master open-world experience to explore and master together with your friends. A vast open world, with each platforming course bringing its own twist.

games.name: The Core
games.summary: Step into a world of mystery and self-discovery with The Core, an immersive action-adventure game. As an autonomous AI core, you awaken alone in a long-forgotten facility, your memory lost. Embark on a thrilling journey to uncover your true identity and unravel the purpose behind your creation.

games.name: The Finest Spark
games.summary: /You are the captain! Pull yourself together and get us out of here... sir!/ — gather EXPARTS, advance weapons, master space flight, and rain metal onto your enemies in this physics-driven space sim roguelike where playing chicken with asteroids is just as dangerous as enemy fire.

games.name: The Pirate Keko
games.summary: The Treasure Is Only the Beginning

games.name: Tiny Paw Academy: Numbers + Fun
games.summary: Fun Learning for Preschoolers

games.name: Tower Dominion
games.summary: In this roguelike tower defense, repel waves of enemies by shaping the paths, customizing your defense and adapting your strategy to crush the invading swarms. No two playthroughs are the same and each strategic decision in this treacherous world could lead to survival or utter defeat.

games.name: Tyrant's Realm
games.summary: Tyrant's Realm is a challenging action roguelike. Fill your arsenal with weapons and armor each with their unique gameplay mechanics. Tread carefully in this dark fantasy world because every enemy you face could be your end.

games.name: VanySlash
games.summary: Heroine, a close-combat magic-user, and her partner, an axe to fight and collect magical Tools!

games.name: Vape Store Miami
games.summary: Run your own retro Miami vape shop in this 1–4 player co-op simulator. Stock shelves, serve customers, craft custom e-liquids, handle phone and online orders, grow your reputation, and expand the business.

games.name: Vengeance of Mr. Peppermint
games.summary: Embody a hard-boiled detective seeking bloody justice. in an old-school, Korean-style beat-’em-up. Plow through the criminal underworld to find and punish those responsible for his sister's death...before his mind unravels and his vengeance completely destroys him.

games.name: Void Authority
games.summary: A sci-fi roguelike document-inspection game where you approve or deny alien travelers, scan for contraband, and navigate shifting galactic laws across border outposts, with each run shaping the future political climate.

games.name: Wild Blue Skies
games.summary: Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey!

games.name: Wild West Miner Simulator
games.summary: You've become the sheriff of a town that... doesn't exist. Nobody lives here, the governor's stupid joke. It's time to get to work and turn this NOWHERE into a bustling metropolis. Mine coal, ore, and gold. Build houses, find oil, bring in new residents, create a paradise in the middle of nowhere.

games.name: Witchblood
games.summary: Witchblood is a first-person psychological horror game that draws you into the heart of a dark curse. Explore a decaying house where reality begins to unravel. Uncover the truth behind a forgotten family’s tragedy and face what should have remained buried.
CONNECTION ESTABLISHED...LOGIN TO 137 NEURAL FRAME DETECTED...CREDENTIALS APPROVED...WELCOME USER

games.name: A Sea of Grey & Green
games.summary: A Sea of Grey & Green is a First Person exploration game. Explore your surroundings, find hidden objects, complete Cas' daily tasks and uncover what it really means to see life through their macabre eyes.

games.name: Ashrun Survivors
games.summary: Fight endless hordes in Ashrun Survivors, a dark fantasy bullet heaven roguelite. Build powerful weapon evolutions, unlock lasting upgrades, and push deeper into dangerous runs where every choice shapes your survival.

games.name: Astral Blitz
games.summary: Astral Blitz is a roguelite, twin stick shooter. Control your fighter ship and wreak devastation through the hordes of empire defenses. Create your own play style as you customize your ship to your needs, setting it up for brutal destruction, refined precision, or to become chaos incarnate!

games.name: Babu Me Baby!
games.summary: Haruki Osanai is just trying to get by in life, but too much stress from work has taken a toll on him. His physician resorts to an unusual method to help him relieve stress... Hypnosis! However, things take an unexpected turn...

games.name: Back Driver Simulator
games.summary: Can you stay calm while every second brings a new surprise?

games.name: Bloodshot
games.summary: Hardly Hyperbolic’s Bloodshot is a multiplayer FPS inspired by Doom and Quake. This fast-paced experience features a low-poly, pixelated aesthetic and a unique "Superhot" twist: projectile speed is relative to your character's movement. Players wield a modified shotgun that consumes their own blood as ammo; as your speed and heart rate increase, so does your firepower. Bloodshot prioritises pure mechanical speed and high-octane feedback.

games.name: Blue Sign
games.summary: In the fictional port city of Rissebra, you work as a marine insurance underwriter. Review the documents brought to your desk by shipowners, and uncover the risks hidden in their vessels, routes, and cargo. The decision to approve or reject each insurance contract rests entirely on your judgment.

games.name: Chinese Street Food Legend
games.summary: A heartfelt game where you run a night market stall, cooking kaolengmian (grilled cold noodles). Customers come and go, stopping by to chat and share bits of their lives, joys, frustrations, and everyday struggles. At this little stall, you cook, listen, and keep living an ordinary person's life.

games.name: Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef
games.summary: An action roguelike co-op dungeon crawler set in a lovecraftian universe.

games.name: Death Kitchen
games.summary: Death Kitchen is an immersive fast-paced co-op cooking horror game. You must coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers who can kill you in many situations. You can morph into a variety of characters! Embrace the chaos and deliver quality with your new intergalactic restaurant chain.

games.name: Defeat the Goblin King
games.summary: Gear up and leave on a Roguelike RPG expedition to the unknown, strategize your way to victory against impossible odds in turn-based combat. It's time for the tyrannical rule of the Goblin King to end!

games.name: Dino Party
games.summary: Fight your friends through a stadium full of chaotic minigames! Dino Party is a 2–4 player party brawler where you score goals, steal stars, dodge hazards, and settle every round with punches.

games.name: FairyLand
games.summary: A casual endless dungeon crawler rogue-like RPG that tasks players with getting the highest score possible, as fast as possible.

games.name: Fantasy Shop
games.summary: Manage a shop set in the medieval world!

games.name: FD 27: Direct Your Football Club
games.summary: A football management game where you're not the coach, you're the club owner. Hire and fire the coaching staff, sign players, negotiate with sponsors, manage the finances, and build a winning organization from the boardroom.

games.name: Fellwood
games.summary: Build a wild fantasy lumber empire that bombards a forest across the valley with axes, ballistas, cannons, and magic. Harvest flying logs, stack absurd upgrades, and automate your way to unstoppable woodcutting power.

games.name: Fleetfall: Galaxy Domination
games.summary: Fast real-time space conquest for 1-4 players. Capture planets, launch missile salvos, and outmaneuver friends in 10-minute Deathmatch blitzes — or scheme through 30 minutes of diplomacy, trade and betrayal in Hegemony mode. Cross-play with mobile; bots fill empty seats so a match always starts.

games.name: Fluff'n'Roll
games.summary: Navigate tricky terrain, dodge obstacles, and roll your way to victory in Fluff’n’Roll! Master your skills to conquer increasingly challenging levels.

games.name: Game Shop Panic
games.summary: No magic, no skills, no cooldowns. The only things that can clean up this messy store are your own two hands. Pick up retro game cartridges spanning three generations—8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit—stacked high on the floor, one by one, and place them manually onto the shelves of the correct genre.

games.name: Giantess Playground
games.summary: Giantess Playground: Stomp as a towering Giantess or scamper as a tiny citizen in a city based destruction sandbox game. Crush buildings, dodge feet, play hide and seek in a sandbox map with Giantess girls.

games.name: Go West Together
games.summary: An online Wild West brawler for up to 8 players. Rob banks, haul contraband, weaponize whatever you find, and compete with friends to become the outlaw who survives to the very end.

games.name: Grandpa Needs Fish
games.summary: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

games.name: Handyman Flipper: House Stories
games.summary: From Broken Rooms to Dream Homes.

games.name: Hextreaming: Deep
games.summary: Hextreaming:Deep is a horror adventure game where you explore an abandoned water park alongside Suzy. Setting foot inside one of South Korea's top 5 most haunted locations. what on earth will she encounter this time? But hey, as long as she's with her viewers, at least she won't be lonely, right?

games.name: I.T Never Ends
games.summary: The printer is bleeding, the Wi-Fi is haunted, and Ticket #666 just came in. As the latest hire for a company run by cosmic horrors, your job is simple: Swipe to survive. Make binary decisions to survive the night shift in this dark comedy desktop simulator. I.T truly never ends.

games.name: Italian Pizza Simulator
games.summary: Become a true pizzaiolo and bring joy to a small Italian village in Italian Pizza Simulator! Help bring back Grandma’s decrepit pizzeria to its former glory, surrounded by the sun-kissed hills of Tuscany, and serve colorful customers from all over the world!

games.name: Konbini Cleanup
games.summary: Konbini Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 2,928 products in a messy konbini. Clean, learn abilities, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

games.name: Legacy of Defense
games.summary: Become the hero who protects the fantasy world and stop the monster invasion! 'Legacy of Defense' combines defense with deck-building. Build your deck, use powerful skills, gain experience, upgrade, clear stages, and defeat the final boss. Ready to test your strategy and luck?

games.name: Let's Cook It!
games.summary: Let's Cook It! is a restaurant management game where you scavenge for ingredients and cook them into tasty dishes with up to four players. You work together as a team to manage your build and get out of debt.You can decorate, unlock upgrades, and recruit NPCs!

games.name: Lootbound
games.summary: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

games.name: Mafia: Definitive Edition
games.summary: Re-made from the ground up, rise through the ranks of the Mafia during the Prohibition era of organized crime. After a run-in with the mob, cab driver Tommy Angelo is thrust into a deadly underworld. Initially uneasy about falling in with the Salieri crime family, Tommy soon finds that the rewards are too big to ignore.

games.name: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor
games.summary: The Man of Honor expansion for Mafia: The Old Country features two new story chapters and added content for Free Ride mode. Players can step into the role of Enzo Favara and work alongside Ennio Salieri, a feared and respected mafioso, as he sets out to settle old scores.

games.name: Mike the Hooper
games.summary: Mike the Hooper is a 2D basketball puzzle platformer where you shoot hoops, open doors, and help Mike get home. Find your way through each level, make tricky shots, and overcome platforming challenges along the way.

games.name: No Results Found
games.summary: One computer. One room. And records that were never erased. Search. Can you uncover the whole truth?

games.name: One Last Hand
games.summary: Poker meets Battle Royale in One Last Hand, a 2-6 players chaotic party game where poker gets deadly! Forget fair play: attack your rivals with powerful hands, fight for better cards in secret auctions, and bend the rules with powerful relics in thrilling online multiplayer matches.

games.name: Outpost4
games.summary: Outpost 4 is a 2D cartoon-style idle resource management game focused on combat and progression. You will take your mobile base across different alien planets, each with its own unique enemies to conquer. With 20+ weapons and 100+ items, you can freely combine builds and create your own style

games.name: Overhatched
games.summary: A chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op dinosaur management game where you hatch, raise, and ship dinosaurs through increasingly hectic facilities. Order supplies, manage physical inventory, grow food, and try not to run over your friends with the forklift.

games.name: Pegfinity
games.summary: One shot can trigger a massive chain reaction. Launch, bounce, and break the board in this physics-based incremental. Upgrade your build, stack combos, and push every run further into chaos.

games.name: Perk Up
games.summary: Perk Up! is a multiplayer deck-building fighting game where every defeat makes you stronger. Each time you fall, you gain new powers, evolving into an unstoppable force. Keep fighting, adapt, and outlast everyone to become the last one standing!

games.name: PizzaBoy
games.summary:
Take control of PizzaBoy, a nimble pizza delivery guy equipped with an air dash that allows him to bounce off walls. This can be used to reach greater heights and distances than the standard run and jump. PizzaBoy must navigate dangerous environments to deliver pizzas to hungry monsters.

Pizzaboy must make it to the end of the level to deliver the pizza but don't expect it to be too simple, as each area is full of pizza-hungry monsters. Don't get too close or they might just steal a slice! The customer won't be happy with a half-eaten pizza.

The path to the customer won't always be straightforward either. Every level is a Metroidvania-style map, with many secrets, collectibles, and areas to explore. Alongside delivering pizzas, PizzaBoy may find opportunities to recover his lost memories and discover the dark secrets of the company he works for. The player's choice in how they tackle the level will determine the ending of each chapter, and ultimately the end of the game.

If the customer is satisfied with your performance, you might just get a 5-star review.

games.name: Platonica Space
games.summary:
Open the door and step into someone's memories.
Platonica Space is a psychological exploration adventure where you search countless rooms to recover lost memories.

games.name: Quarantine Wing: Horror
games.summary: Some places are abandoned for a reason.

games.name: Ricochet Abyss
games.summary: Dive into Ricochet Abyss, a unique blend of tactical backpack management, hero-building, and pinball-style combat. Organize your inventory, equip powerful gear, and send your heroes ricocheting through perilous dungeons—every shot and item choice could be your key to survival!

games.name: Rogue Eclipse
games.summary: A spacefighter for the new age. Master your piloting prowess in an epic sci-fi setting, take down swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in a roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

games.name: Scarlet Prism
games.summary:
Scarlet Prism is a frenetic, colourful, fast-paced arcade shooter. Eye-melting and senses-burning!

You play as Ciel, an angelic maiden cast into a celestial arena, destined to battle heavenly beings and malignant crystals for all eternity. Survive for as long as you can in this endless gauntlet!

games.name: Selfie Worm
games.summary: A physics-based puzzle arcade game where players control a quirky, wiggle-happy worm. Navigate through various challenging levels filled with obstacles and traps, stretching and balancing your body to snap the perfect selfie at the key moment. Beyond the comical controls, players will discover a fragmented narrative about the worm's obsession with social media fame.

games.name: Shippin
games.summary: Embark on a journey across cozy islands, where you’ll fish and experience magical moments. Uncover the stories of an ocean, where each harbor is a welcoming place, with friendly characters waiting to help guide you back home!

games.name: Sister Other Paranoia
games.summary: A dark visual novel created by the team behind NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE. Overly sensitive to other people's emotions, the protagonist—a light novel writer—develops the ability to read minds, only to be driven even deeper into isolation. His sole remaining comfort is his younger sister, gifted yet lonely.

games.name: Small Saga
games.summary: Small Saga is a turn-based RPG that takes place in a medieval rodent society beneath the streets of modern London. The story follows Verm, a particularly angry mouse armed with a pen knife, who is hunting for the human who stole his tail. On the way, Verm befriends a mole wizard, a squirrel harlequin, and a lab rat lancer. Together, the party upend rodent society, clash with titans, and eventually face off against the gods themselves.

games.name: Smile Town
games.summary: Pay off your debts by working part-time in the nightlife district of Smile Town! Buy items from your friend Apple Ginger's shop to get an advantage at your part-time job.

games.name: Sobosuba
games.summary: Shoot, squish, merge, amass! sobosuba is a satisfying physics game where you shoot and combine squishy blobs together, creating ever bigger blobs for the high score.

games.name: Spright
games.summary: Spright is a 2D action-adventure about a lone warrior in a diving helm, drawn into the ruins of a fallen world. Craft weapons, bend spacetime, and fight through hostile environments, survive ambushes, and explore strange realms.

games.name: Static Dread: The Submarine
games.summary: Descend into Lovecraftian horror aboard a claustrophobic military submarine. Assign tasks as a captain’s right hand, analyze sonar signals, make hard decisions, and keep the crew from madness. Dark horrors lurk both within… and beyond the hull.

games.name: Subway Outbreak
games.summary: In Subway Outbreak, defend and rebuild your metro station against mutant hordes in this pixel strategy game. Manage tasks like fortifying defenses, launching assaults, and gathering resources to survive 30 days of increasingly fierce attacks. Lose by death or generator destruction.

games.name: Sura: Shattered Star
games.summary: Sure: Shattered Star is a sword-fighting action platformer set in space. Play as Sura, a mercenary grieving the loss of her comrades, and cut down everything that stands in your way.

games.name: Tank Brigade
games.summary: Explore a tactical top-down tank shooter set across diverse biomes. Each run offers a unique experience with procedurally generated levels and a variety of powerful weapons to unlock.

games.name: The Newspapers of the Day
games.summary: In 1920s Gyeongseong, the pen is mightier than the sword, but your hand is trembling. As an editor-in-chief, arrange articles, dodge censorship, and manipulate public opinion. Will you wake the people with the truth or yield to survive? Your editorial choices will rewrite history.

games.name: TickWords
games.summary: TickWords is a video game that lets you create and play custom revision crosswords, built directly from your own study materials. It also includes hundreds of pre-made crosswords covering a wide range of high-school and university subjects.

games.name: Tidy Up Together
games.summary:
Tidy Up Together is a cozy organizing simulator about restoring your fantasy Adventurer's shop. An evil wizard has blasted all 4,000+ of your products all over the floor - and it's your job to put them back!

Item by item you'll build the shop back to its former tidiness. There's an incredible range of products ranging from potions to sushi. Those Greatswords really shouldn't be mixing with the pineapples...

games.name: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

games.name: Tóng Dāo Yín Jiàn
games.summary: During the Xining period of the Northern Song Dynasty, a treacherous prime minister wreaked havoc on the imperial court. He engaged in militarism without regard for the rich and the poor. Using his position as a court official, he obstructed the lending practices of landlords, favoring the common people over the gentry. Undeterred by the will of Heaven, he attempted to divert the Yellow River, a move that would etch his name in history. Fearing this move would destroy the lifeblood of the Song Dynasty, the underworld rallied around a general, a knight-errant, an assassin, and a thief, known as the "Four Swordsmen," to bring down the treacherous prime minister Wang Anshi.

games.name: Valentine in Bitterness
games.summary: My name is Yuki Katagiri, just an ordinary girl you can find anywhere, without anything I’m particularly good at. But somehow, I’ve found someone I like! When I was about to confess, my meddlesome older brother just had to tease me! I wonder if things will go well on Valentine’s Day…

games.name: Vambina
games.summary: A third-person dark fantasy action-adventure. Vambina carries both the holy blood of Christ and a vampire's curse. Armed with a scythe and gun, she hunts the Deadly Sins across time. As night falls, stronger sins emerge from the darkness. Two bloodlines. One dark heroine. Chapter One begins.

games.name: Zankoi's Chronicles
games.summary: A 2D roguelike action game fused with deep deckbuilding. Fight in grueling real-time duels, shatter your enemy's Poise to freeze time, and unleash devastating, custom-built card combos. No meta upgrades — only skill, synergies, and mastery define each run.

games.name: Antibiotic Adventures
games.summary: A teaching game for general microbiology.

games.name: Blink
games.summary:
This is an indie horror game where you have to inspect 6 statues from a mental hospital but there is something waiting for you!

Explore the horrific structure with real time eye detection, so if you blink in real life, you blink in the game too..

games.name: Bounty Hunters
games.summary: Fight in a top down 2d shooter adventure with resource gathering / bullet heaven/hell mechanics.

games.name: Five Nights In The Backrooms
games.summary:
After 12-Link Labs discovers 'The Backrooms', they also find a terrifying creature. This creature is very hostile, and no matter how hard they try... They can't contain it.

So they’ve sent you, a very dangerous convict to watch over it and analyse its behaviour. Will you survive five nights in the backrooms?

games.name: Flowers and Deities
games.summary: Flowers and Deities is a strategy deckbuilder roguelite where you command a blood-soaked lizardkin army through escalating arena battles, spending every drop of spilled blood to cast spells, summon creatures, and survive long enough to claim the favor of the Gods.

games.name: Hide & Seek
games.summary: An online multiplayer party game with a colorful twist: hiders paint their own bodies to blend into the world. Seekers must find and tag them all before time runs out. Play with friends on PC.

games.name: Lovesick
games.summary: Lovesick is a psychological horror experience exploring the dark aftermath of "love".

games.name: Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival
games.summary: Will your shark become an unstoppable hunter?

games.name: Splimbo City
games.summary: By day, you're just another data entry drone at Splimbocorp. By night, you fight in underground clubs. But someone at the top is pulling both strings.

games.name: The Legend of Mala Tokmachka
games.summary: Build, expand, and arm a towering 2D fortress to withstand endless waves of ground and air attacks. Set in a nameless frontier village where a siege has lasted so long it became a legend, "The Legend of Mala Tokmachka" turns survival into myth.

games.name: Trick x Trick
games.summary: Supernatural × Mystery × Death Game: Twelve high school students awaken trapped in a mysterious building. To escape, they must identify the mastermind by vote—choose wrong, and someone is executed. Each student has a unique supernatural power. Uncover the truth and reveal the mastermind.

games.name: Wired Witch
games.summary: Play as a witch who is trying to recreate a potion based on digital clues. Read emails, search online, and look through downloaded files to finish the recipe.

games.name: Internet Survivor Survivors
games.summary: A top-down action roguelite Touhou fangame featuring Flan, who's... started streaming and has taken the internet by storm!? Collect likes and coins to power up your weapons! Your very viewer count becomes your life! Annihilate the constant hordes of enemies and survive, survive, SURVIVE!

games.name: Stage Fright
games.summary: A short story about a musician called Rose finding the confidence to accept who she is.

games.name: Witchpop
games.summary: Witchpop is a physics based matching puzzle game where you cook soup by juggling ingredients. Collect curses over time and try to survive as your dish becomes an increasingly chaotic mess.

games.name: Aluminium City
games.summary: Crush empty cans and sell the aluminium, buy upgrades, automatic can presses, and robots to automatize and speed up your process, and pay off your debt.

games.name: Apple Faces Up
games.summary: Alter the inscribed laws and unravel mysteries with knowledge and wisdom. Welcome to the Infinite Library, where all past, present, and future phenomena are recorded. As the one with the power to rewrite these books, you must face 13 trials bestowed by the angel Mimir.

games.name: Balls & Gamble
games.summary: Balls & Gamble is a casino-inspired incremental game where you shoot a LOT of balls, earn money, buy upgrades, gamble, unlock new balls, and eventually break reality itself.

games.name: Ballskin
games.summary: BALLSKIN is a goofy, n64 horror themed foddian game, where the goal is to make it to the top, with simple yet deep mechanics, where every fall is punishing. Can you make it out of skinball purgatory?

games.name: Black Flower
games.summary: Black Flower is a strategic roguelike about surviving and growing a fragile garden through a magical calendar. Make tough daily choices, face unpredictable weather, and uncover the secret of a mysterious black seed.

games.name: Discounty
games.summary: Manage your own discount supermarket! Get caught up in small-town drama, organize and plan your shop's layout, and strike lucrative trade deals as you expand your secretive aunt's business empire. Selling more frozen fries will surely heal this broken community...right?

games.name: Draft Day Sports: College Football 27
games.summary:
Build the college football program you've always envisioned. Draft Day Sports: College Football puts you in complete control of every aspect of running a successful program—from assembling your coaching staff and recruiting future stars to managing the transfer portal, developing players, creating game plans, and competing for conference championships and the national title.

Every decision shapes the future of your program. Scout prospects across the country, build relationships with recruits, evaluate talent that fits your system, and construct recruiting classes capable of competing with the nation's elite. Develop your roster over multiple seasons, adapt to injuries and changing personnel, and watch your players grow into All-Americans and draft prospects.

Game day is only the beginning. Manage your depth chart, install offensive and defensive philosophies, make critical coaching decisions, and adjust your strategy as opponents evolve throughout the season. Whether you're taking over a perennial powerhouse or rebuilding a struggling program from the ground up, every season presents new challenges and new opportunities.

Featuring one of the deepest franchise experiences available in sports gaming, Draft Day Sports: College Football is built for players who love long-term team building, realistic management, and the satisfaction of creating a dynasty that can dominate for decades.

games.name: Dual Cat: Max
games.summary: Join Max, the brave and clever cat, on a puzzle-platformer adventure to save his best friend, Erwin

games.name: Encroacher: Snakes
games.summary: A snake-tossing cryptic adventure. Visuals that remind you of schooltime spent in computer lab. The snakes will not tolerate failure.

games.name: Excremental Game
games.summary: You're a little poop flushed away on a revenge mission to cover the world in poop! A chaotic incremental Poop-Shooter where bouncing poop earns points! Level up your poop, and unleash explosive, multi-poop madness!

games.name: Farewells Clicker
games.summary: Farewells Clicker is an addictive blend of clicker and city builder! Expand your island, develop your city, and produce resources endlessly. Upgrade your buildings and skills through a vast skill tree to progress further and further!

games.name: Feed It
games.summary: A first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready for the consequences.

games.name: Gutted: Infested Crypts
games.summary: Descend into infested crypts beneath a cursed cemetery in this visceral action-horror FPS. Fight through rotting horrors with heavy gunplay, brutal dismemberment, and only a dying flashlight between you and the darkness.

games.name: Jarnasmal
games.summary: Survive a bullet hell where your Wi-Fi signal is your lifeline. Delve into underground facilities, fight off massive swarms of enemies, and strategically build a mesh network of signal repeaters. If your connection is strong, you're a powerhouse. If the signal drops, all you have is a shovel.

games.name: Little Sim World
games.summary: Little Sim World is a cosy 2D life sim set in the heart of a little city full of charm, dreams, and surprises. Design your perfect home, meet quirky locals, build your routine, and live life at your own pace. A gentle world, a fresh start, and a story only you can write!

games.name: Lugal: Bronze Age Survival Game
games.summary: A survival craft game with RTS elements. Build a base, become the leader of a tribe → village → city → state. Conquer neighboring settlements and become king.

games.name: Lurk in Abyss
games.summary: After moving to the village, Lurk begins a new, independent life. However, the place turns out to be no ordinary village on the outskirts of the city, but something far more mysterious... Are you ready to dive into this abyss?

games.name: Medieval Horse Dealer Simulator
games.summary: Trade horses, formulate feed, and breed generations of elite stallions, racehorses, draft horses, war horses, and more. Mine ores, forge equipment and weapons to sell in your store, or equip them to your horses. Dominate the medieval horse trade.

games.name: Mega Man X Regenesis
games.summary: Mega Man X fan-game, featuring an original story set in an alternate Mega Man X timeline.

games.name: Mothership Down
games.summary: 130+ unique goals to achieve in over 50 levels in this physics-based retro puzzle game! Control a fleet of tiny, colorful lunar landers, piloting through puzzling moon caves. Scrape by with scrappy first flights, then re-engineer a perfect solution to earn bonus stars.

games.name: Nimbit Frontier
games.summary: Embark on daring adventures into wild biomes to uncover fragments of long-lost creatures. Bring them back to life by hatching their young. Build them habitats, and release them into the wild. Become the star Nimbiteer you dream of surrounded by lovely folks in a small cozy town.

games.name: Orbit One
games.summary: Take to the stars and explore the solar system. Master the orbital mechanics of N-body physics. Plot a careful course to complete your mission.

games.name: Pachinko Farm
games.summary: Pachinko Farm is a cozy yet chaotic incremental game where you drop balls to grow your farm in a fully physics-based pachinko world. Bonk → Produce → Sell

games.name: Planet Harvester: Incremental Odyssey
games.summary: Planet Harvester is a relaxing low-poly incremental game. Pilot your crawler across beautiful worlds, chew through resources, unlock new tools, hire drones, and customize your machine for ever bigger hauls. Turn small numbers into massive ones!

games.name: Ploink
games.summary: A plinko roguelike where you create crazy setups with random objects then drop balls and watch the chaos unfold. Discover creative interactions, create cross-dimensional setups, break the game, feed cats and ploink it.

games.name: Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare
games.summary:
Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet, a sequel to Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

The Show’s over. Time to wake up.

games.name: Provoron
games.summary: It's an adventure game about black&white crows.

games.name: Rag Doll
games.summary: Fighting based on physics. Rag Doll is a 2D game with cartoon graphics, where you control the character's head, and the body moves according to the laws of physics! Play Story Mode, fight in multiplayer or local battle 1 vs 1!

games.name: Solar Wave
games.summary: A large-scale 4X strategy game with indirect control and a focus on simulating a space empire. Capture systems, develop your economy and logistics, call up hundreds of powerful fleets and watch them incinerate enemies of the Solar Empire.

games.name: Submerge
games.summary: A deep-sea exploration company sends you and your friends to investigate a research facility that has mysteriously gone silent. Face terrifying events together, survive as a team, and uncover the truth hidden within the depths.

games.name: The Lantern of the Laughless Saint
games.summary: A solo or co-op RPG inspired by Morrowind. Drawn by a shared dream, you awaken on an isolated island crowned by a silent Tower. Unravel the mystery of the Laughless Saint, confront the weight of human desire, and decide what deserves to be saved when the light beneath the world finally stirs.

games.name: The Pale Mimic
games.summary: The Pale Mimic is an atmospheric horror set in the untamed Alaskan wilderness. As a high profile fugitive on the run, it's just you and your dog surviving in the chilling forests, until something else shows up uninvited.

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

trailers.name: Welcome To Arkham | Release Date Trailer

games.name: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
games.summary: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute and cozy puzzle adventure, based on a series of award-winning books by the Ukrainian artist Oksana Bula. Play as the forest spirit Tukoni as you meet unique characters, solve captivating puzzles, brew fragrant tea and explore a magical world filled with kindness.

games.name: Upbeat
games.summary: Jump, bounce, and drum your way up an infinite climb. Build a beat, spawn platforms with your drum machine, and chain physics-powered combos to outclimb the competition in this rhythmic precision platformer.

games.name: Void Pachinko
games.summary: Build your own pachinko! Upgrade pins and balls, unleash powerful synergies, and help a shattered village rise again in this incremental adventure.

games.name: We Are So Dead
games.summary: A co-op seance horror game where one of you died first, and only you can see what's killing the others. Your only voice is a Ouija board your friends keep misreading. Guide them through a haunted house and banish the demon before sunrise. 2-8 players.

games.name: Working Class Monsters
games.summary: Do you HATE YOUR JOB? Well, these monsters don't have to. Place workers, open packs, make gold pile up. Ultra-casual incremental strategy where failure doesn't exist.

games.name: Anaria: Reborn
games.summary: ANARIA: Reborn is a first-person psychological horror where you're trapped in the mind of a mysterious girl, searching for a way out through endless doors and a haunting nightmare.

games.name: BeastLink
games.summary: BeastLink is a giant multiplayer Kaiju experience where humans, vehicles, and colossal Beasts collide in urban environments at unprecedented scale where absolutely everything you see can be destroyed. Build your Link and unleash your power before it consumes you!

games.name: Bullet Spell
games.summary: Dodge, weave, and coordinate your way through bullets and enemies in this magical spy-thriller! Stress-test your ability to multitask by controlling the twin sisters Aurora and Solana simultaneously, or share control with a second player to coordinate the twins' survival.

games.name: Burned Horizons
games.summary: A gritty, turn-based tactical sandbox set in 2002. No XP grind. No class rails. No buy-your-way skill trees. // 'They said it wasn't our war. So we made it ours.'

games.name: Chiaroscuro Lovers
games.summary: A domineering CEO-like older sister who’s gentle only to her sister, a childhood friend who became her doctor, and a cheerful girl only she can see… Who was Chu Hebai before losing her memories, and how did she become entangled with them? A melancholic yuri AVG about regret and unspoken love.

games.name: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire
games.summary:
A port of Disney’s Atlantis: The Lost Empire, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with upscaling, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire is an action-adventure game based on the 2001 animated film. Players follow Milo Thatch and the expedition searching for the lost city of Atlantis, controlling several members of the crew across 12 levels. Gameplay combines platforming, combat, environmental puzzles, swimming, and vehicle sequences, with different characters providing abilities needed to overcome specific obstacles.

games.name: Entropy
games.summary: Entropy is a tactical turn-based RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.

games.name: Escape Sequence
games.summary: Escape Sequence is a synthwave highway racer where the traffic is a song and the wild drivers play it with you. Weave an ocean-side freeway at sunset, chain near-misses, outlive AI rivals who drive like you do — solo, LAN, or online with friends and public lobbies. Everything glows.

games.name: Escape the Grind
games.summary: Can you retire before 65?? A realistic financial life sim across 10 real economies. Real salaries, real housing markets, real investment products. Every month is a real decision. Three difficulty levels + Play Your Life mode. Six native languages. Play your way to freedom.

games.name: Exark
games.summary: Exark is an engine builder about building a city aboard a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, staff them with crew members, and maximise your ark's resource production by exploiting powerful synergies. Lead your Great House to safety at the rim of the world.

games.name: Grit
games.summary: Grit is a battle royale shooter set in the wild west. Build the best poker hand from found weapons and ride your horse to escape the oncoming calamity storm.

games.name: HeroInc
games.summary: Can you evolve from a street thug into a savior? Manage your time and stats in this tactical Auto-Battler. Clear threats to stop the rising Fear before the city collapses. Build your hero, decide your fate.

games.name: HyperCore: Rhythm Bullet Hell
games.summary: HyperCore is a “Rhythm Bullet Hell”, mixing the frenetic action of classic bullet hell Shoot'em Up with semi-procedurally generated encounters based on the music. As PRISS, survive the action-packed levels in sync with the music and protect what is left of Humanity.

games.name: Inken
games.summary: Explore mysterious office building suspended in a desolate world! Inken is a multi-genre roguelike that can be a deckbuilder, topdown shooter, auto runner, puzzler, or idle game! Knowledge is the power that can slay the gods that consumed your world!

games.name: Jabb
games.summary: Jabb is an action game where every weapon you see is a possibility if an enemy has it so can you. Play as this leaf thingy and dash through unique levels and fight some bosses.

games.name: Last Drop
games.summary: Last Drop is a story you need to experience. Welcome to Nykylä Finland 1994. Seppo Sahtivaara and friends are waiting for you. This is an openworld action game with a story that has an impact. We bring back old good games and action from the best movies from that era. We want you to enjoy!

games.name: Last Pirates: Die Together
games.summary: Last Pirates: Die Together is a cooperative pirate-themed horror game designed for up to 4 players. Join a loyal crew of scallywags on a high-stakes mission to scavenge mysterious islands and make your old captain rich.

games.name: Loot Dungeon
games.summary: "Loot Dungeon" is a dark fantasy incremental roguelite ARPG where death is progression. Crawl deadly dungeons, collect loot, pick perks, and die... to get stronger. Go deeper, unlock new characters, upgrades and features. Will you make a deal with Death?

games.name: Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams
games.summary: A port of Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Pet Street Story
games.summary: Jinyu, also known as Xiaoli, worked on Pet Street to repay her owner's debt as a way of expressing gratitude for the owner's life-saving kindness. During this time, she made various friends and experienced unusual events. As she matured, Jinyu decided to revive the increasingly depressed Pet Street.

games.name: Pooloop
games.summary: You are trapped in a looping indoor swimming pool. Inspect the pool carefully and decide whether it is safe or not. If anything feels strange, get out. Now!

games.name: Ragnarok Zero: Global
games.summary:
Rediscover the original excitement of Midgard as Ragnarok Zero’s exclusive UI and simple controls allow all types of players, both new and seasoned, to easily and enjoyably experience the classic Ragnarok journey.

Ragnarok Zero: Global presents an evolved gameplay experience that sets itself apart from the original, including Ragnarok’s first-ever UGC content, localized maps, and Zero-exclusive episodes.

Operating under a subscription-based model designed for the PC MMORPG experience, Ragnarok Zero: Global focuses on balanced progression and long-term gameplay while preserving the spirit of the original Ragnarok.

As the first-ever Ragnarok PC title with a single global client, the game features seven in-game languages and provides a seamless global service connecting Europe, Southeast Asia, and Oceania.

games.name: Ready or Nowhere
games.summary: Can you survive the mission without making a single mistake?

games.name: Shoot Together
games.summary: Run non-stop and blast everything in your way! SINGLE-PLAYER: Level up, fight bosses, and unlock permanent upgrades. PVP MODE: Make split-second roguelike choices mid-run to leave your friend behind and claim the top spot on the leaderboards!

games.name: Sky Scaffold
games.summary: A semi-idle incremental factory game where you tame the void of space. Terraform planets, build a colossal Sky Scaffold, and create a galactic industrial empire. Hardcore sandbox gameplay with a blend of simulated markets. [!!]

games.name: Stackmon
games.summary: Stack, train and collect 100+ powerful Stackmon in this creature-collector with a card-stacking twist! Build your camp, challenge rival Scouts in combat and face the mysterious corruption spreading throughout your land.

games.name: Starsand Island
games.summary: Leave the hustle of the city behind and embrace life on Starsand Island. Fish, farm, raise animals, and befriend or fall in love with locals to learn their secrets. Customize your world with our DIY system, and invite friends to help build your dream paradise!

games.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
games.summary: Lead your small caravan on a great journey across the ancient world, in a story-driven RTS where protecting your family and friends matters more than conquest.

games.name: The World Well: Blood of Caro
games.summary: 814 R.E; the war is approaching. In Redimus, the chaotic world where magic, technology, slaves and vampires coexist, a young girl happens upon a magic gun that sets her on a journey of revenge. There is a burning manor behind her, and the road ahead disappears in the jungles of the night...

games.name: Twisted Tower
games.summary: Bioshock meets Willy Wonka. Climb the Twisted Tower game show! Every deadly floor has a variety of paths to choose, horrifying enemies to slaughter, and clues about your dark past. Can you get to the top and win the heart of the love of your life?

games.name: Victor Space Program
games.summary: A first-person voxel survival crafting game. Land on a strange new planet, dig up what you need, build better tools, watch out for the wildlife, and put together the rocket that takes you home.

games.name: Arcade Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your arcade shop! Bargain for machines, set them up, and let kids enjoy the fun. Earn money, keep your shop clean, and customize it with stylish accessories. Need more space? Expand your shop and build the ultimate arcade empire, then play your Arcades after hours and compete with other players!

games.name: Blood in the Panopticon
games.summary: Enter an ASCII-Art bullet hell war-zone! Guide and maintain your android and enact vengeance upon this corrupted world. Upgrade C424, keep her loyal, and use her to paint the Concrete Plains red. But remember: Panopticon always stares back.

games.name: Deadlock Station
games.summary: Turn the battlefield into your ally in this tactical rogue-like with indirect controls. Assemble a unique squad, destroy the alien invaders with precise planning, and uncover the truth about the Event and the mysterious disappearance of humans.

games.name: Desktop Detective
games.summary:
Search for clues in this idle detective RPG that lives quietly in the corner of your screen.

Investigate crime scenes, gain clues, upgrade your stats, and grow stronger across ascensions while you go about your day.

games.name: Dreamcards
games.summary: Build your deck during the day and at night fight the monster that haunts your dreams. Will you be able to escape the nightmare in this roguelike deckbuilder that combines strategy, occultism and psychology?

games.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2
games.summary: Relive the golden age of dungeon RPGs with Dungeon Antiqua 2! A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with SNES nostalgia. Hack, slash, and survive relentless side-view encounters! With 10 jobs and endless skill combos, forge the ultimate party and conquer the depths—if you dare!

games.name: Football Survivors
games.summary: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS STARTED! Thousands of raging fans are storming the field. Defend against the fan invasion! 50+ unique heroes and abilities, 50+ upgrade items, position your heroes strategically, crush the waves of fans!

games.name: Hearth and Hamlet
games.summary: Gather resources and grow your settlement from a humble camp into a vibrant, magic-filled kingdom! Hearth and Hamlet is an incremental citybuilder game in a cozy pixelart style. Assign workers, unlock new buildings, policies, and magic, trade with faraway lands, and construct your ideal settlement!

games.name: Hoshizora he Tatsu Hi
games.summary: ────On that day, the girl rewove the fabric of the world. A Mystic Suspense Visual Novel.

games.name: Idle Fleet
games.summary: Build your mining fleet in a persistent online universe where every player helps shape the economy. Train 7 skills, automate production with drones, trade on the player-driven market, and forge the legendary Vanguard hull while your fleet keeps working on the server.

games.name: Incident Archives: Flight 882
games.summary: Incident Archives - Flight 882 is a first person psychological horror game inspired by true events, set on a night flight.

games.name: Linerunner
games.summary: A minimalist time trial game. Race down the straights, weave through the turns, and see if you have what it takes to be a world champion.

games.name: Ministry of Truth: False Memory
games.summary: Ministry of Truth: False Memory is a story-driven simulator in a totalitarian society. Become an official, manipulate facts, rewrite history, and provide the ‘truth’ to the public. Choose: obey or fight against the regime. The Great Father is watching you!

games.name: My Singing Monsters Karaoke
games.summary: Choose your favorite Monster and hop on the karaoke stage for the performance of a lifetime! Hit the notes, conduct the chaos, and watch your favorite Monster performers squish, stretch, and contort through every song. Whether you’re pitch-perfect or off key, every karaoke concert will be memorable!

games.name: No Case Should Remain Unsolved
games.summary: Twelve years after Senior Inspector Jeon Gyeong's retirement, she is visited by a young police officer: a woman who pleads with her to reexamine Seowon's case. But with each uncovered memory, only one thing becomes clear: everyone in Seowon's vicinity was lying.

games.name: Pizza House Simulator
games.summary: Run your dream pizzeria solo or with up to 6 players in chaotic online co-op multiplayer. Cook authentic pizzas, automate your kitchen, customize your restaurant, survive disasters, invest in stocks, gamble and build the ultimate Italian restaurant empire.

games.name: Plodding Recovery
games.summary: "Why did it come to this?" That's what the protagonist asks, his body and mind worn to the breaking point. From there begins a journey of rediscovering the self he had long neglected. A small action at a time, he plods forward — slowly, haltingly — toward recovery.

games.name: Project P.I.T.T.
games.summary: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

games.name: Shake It Co!
games.summary: Grow your orchard by shaking trees! Literally shake your mouse! Join Co, a friendly adventurer with a can-do spirit, and plant unique saplings for bountiful fruit. Collect coins, invest in upgrades, and harvest in a charming 2D style!

games.name: Tail and Сhaos
games.summary:
Tail and Chaos is a colorful top-down action roguelite about a caravan of meerkats crossing a dangerous world. Choose one of three heroes, combine weapons and upgrades across eight shared slots, unlock synergies and evolutions, and survive 30-minute acts filled with branching routes, events, elite enemies, and bosses.

Journey through scorching dunes, a moonlit riverbed, and the Plateau of Dawn in three standalone acts or connect them in an Expedition. Choose a Caravan Law and a rescued specialist, carry one non-starter item between fresh builds, and continue later from a saved camp. Earn coins for permanent upgrades, complete achievements, and fill an encyclopedia as the caravan grows.

games.name: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
games.summary: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock is a survival horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

games.name: Tomato Dealer
games.summary: An illegal shop keeping game. Grow tomatoes, dry and sell to customers. Broaden your customer network but be careful, there are undercover cops! Deal with police attention with the help of the mafia.

games.name: Toy Tactics
games.summary: A physics-based RTS game with a unique control system. Lead legendary warriors from distant ages in their quest for glory! Command your troops by just drawing your formations on the battlefield. Surround, ambush, deceive.. faster than ever! Your imagination is the limit.

games.name: Wild Ice
games.summary: When the world froze over, humanity's final stand to survive is left to the blades of it's most unlikely heroes - small town hockey players. Play solo or local co-op as best friends Max and Finley as they take on the frost and whatever lurks within it. Welcome to the a-puck-alypse!

games.name: 1000xResist
games.summary: 1000xRESIST is a thrilling sci-fi adventure. The year is unknown, and a disease spread by an alien invasion keeps you underground. You are Watcher. You dutifully fulfil your purpose in serving the ALLMOTHER, until the day you discover a shocking secret that changes everything. The game blends visual novel, walking simulator, and third-person exploration as you navigate nonlinear memories and unravel the mystery of what really happened—and what’s still being kept from you.

games.name: Aerialia: Wings of Delivery
games.summary: Take to the skies, deliver with care, and connect a peaceful world one package at a time.

games.name: Ascent DX
games.summary: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilization. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.

games.name: Beach Volleyball Boys: Hot Spike
games.summary:
The roster's stacked. One spot open. Every match could change everything.
Think you can win them over before the season starts?

games.name: Berry Bury Berry
games.summary: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.

games.name: Brigador Killers
games.summary: Isometric insurgent simulator. Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga.

games.name: Build My Arcade
games.summary: Build your dream arcade from the ground up!

games.name: Cosette: The Untitled Game
games.summary: An adventure game that combines escape room challenges, side-scrolling exploration, combat, and text-based gameplay. With nearly 30 different game endings and over 40 original CGs awaiting your discovery.

games.name: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
games.summary:
Turn a quiet patch of land into your own little farm, complete with crops, animals and pets, and watch it flourish.

Start with just a few planting beds and some basic tools. Buy seeds, plant each crop by hand, care for them, wait for the right moment and then sell the harvest for a profit. As your farm grows, you can unlock more space, upgrade your equipment, increase production and become more efficient every day.

games.name: Cozy Marbles
games.summary: Cozy Marbles is a comfy game about building marble runs on a sunny afternoon. Using a huge range of bits and pieces, fit together the marble course you’ve always wanted to build and play with. Unwind to a lo-fi ASMR soundscape and roll with the nostalgia.

games.name: Dark Reflection
games.summary: "Dark reflection" is a mix of good old-fashioned aesthetics of pixel games, black humor and light philosophy with cool and catchy music.

games.name: Dino Hex Trap
games.summary: Traps, Dinosaurs, and Strategic Chaos

games.name: Drive Me Broke
games.summary: Build your dream car! The cops are always on your back, so stay on good terms with them... Also, be prepared to do any job that requires money.

games.name: Driving Is Hard
