games.summary: Challenge yourself in Driving Is Hard! Drive a bathtub on wheels through steep, unforgiving terrain where every mistake costs you progress. Master tough physics-based gameplay, sharpen your patience, and uncover Jeff’s journey of self-doubt, family struggles, and emotional growth as he finds strength, self-acceptance, and hope for a brighter future.

games.name: Eggventure
games.summary: Eggventure is a 2D Metroidvania platformer where you play as Egbert, an egg on a mission to rescue his friends from becoming breakfast.

games.name: False Alarm
games.summary: False Alarm is a 2D stealth adventure where you enter each level with nothing, and use whatever you can find to complete your mission. Throw a crowbar, blow up a microwave, brew some coffee, drop a chandelier on someone's head. Stay out of the light and distract your enemies however you can.

games.name: Feed The Scorchpot
games.summary: A cozy-chaotic tabletop roguelike about dice, meals, and mild panic. Build your board, harvest what you can, and serve up dishes fast enough to stop your dragon from burning the whole economy down.

games.name: File Tower Defence
games.summary: Defend your desktop from invading viruses! An OS-themed strategic tower defense game where you combine various file extensions to build powerful defense towers.

games.name: Four Lights
games.summary: This story is of God and us and our grand revenge against Lucifer.

games.name: Friday Night
games.summary: Investigate a family’s gruesome fate, communicate using your microphone to uncover the truth, and hide from the spirit. Film the whole experience in your camcorder for the world to see.

games.name: Frog Island
games.summary: Frog Island is a fully hand-drawn, cozy Frog Collection and Life-Sim game. Start your new life as a caretaker for an island of frogs in this cozy creature-collector! Build your dream island, discover magical wildlife, and uncover the island's many hidden secrets, to try and piece together the past life you've somehow forgotten.

games.name: Gallipoli
games.summary: Land on the battlefields of the Middle Eastern Front of World War 1! Gallipoli brings the most authentic WW1 FPS battles yet, with desert warfare, beach landings, historical classes and realistic weaponry.

games.name: Gargantua
games.summary: Build your spaceship-city Gargantua. Forge industries, bend the free market, trade between planets, and defend your growing wealth. Every bullet is bought or produced in a simulated economy where a single mistake can shatter supply chains and trigger interstellar crises. In Gargantua, war is money.

games.name: Ghost Buster:Village
games.summary: An extreme blogger travels to an abandoned village that, according to legend, was deserted in a single day. While exploring, he encounters rituals and entities rooted in Slavic mythology. But the truth waiting there is far more terrifying than any legend.

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: How to Kill a Fly
games.summary: Witness how the actions of an "individual" can serve the pinnacle of a system. Pose as a "human". Serve it as its limited drone model. Accomplish your assignment.

games.name: Hyper Primate
games.summary: Speedrun as a Hyper Fast Ape in this parkour focused FPS. Dash, grapple, and blast through deadly obstacle courses using a massive arsenal of weapons. Master momentum, dodge death, and dominate the leaderboards.

games.name: Ironsand
games.summary: Ironsand is a hardcore rogue-lite FPS. Your team lands on a desert planet full of various enemies. You are given 10 attempts to capture each of the cities and destroy desert monsters, cyborgs and the main goal - the huge Titan combat robots

games.name: Kotamon: My Sis Found a Super-Rare Card in Her Cereal Box, so I Became a Garbage Man to Find the Entire Collection and Earn $1,000,000
games.summary: Clearing trash can feel even better when you not only make the world cleaner, but also find extra-rare cards that have suddenly increased in price! Rummage through garbage, fulfill the orders from the dump site owner, look for hidden treasures... and collect all the Kotámons!

games.name: Labyrinthos: The Depths Want You
games.summary: Ascend the sunken labyrinth called the Tower and choose your path to escape to the surface. Battle foes, forge relationships, and find power in this roguelite dark fantasy RPG.

games.name: Mexican Ninja
games.summary: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

games.name: Mine Defense
games.summary: Mine Defense is a 2D action-adventure game inspired by sandbox survival games. Explore a dangerous world, gather resources, craft weapons and equipment, fight hostile creatures, and build your own base. Progress through the game by discovering new materials, improving your gear, and facing increasingly powerful enemies and bosses.

games.name: Odd's Job
games.summary: Jump, bounce, and roll through jobs to unite his family in their new home. Unlock quirky relatives, grab collectibles, and explore differently themed worlds in this wholesome platforming adventure.

games.name: Over Requiemz
games.summary:
“Whatever pain awaits, I won’t regret this choice.”

A dark fantasy game about overcoming grief as you wander into the “Land of Oz.”

games.name: PawMart Tiny Market
games.summary: Build and manage a cozy idle supermarket run by cute animals at the bottom of your screen. Produce goods, stock shelves, automate your store, hire employees and expand your tiny market.

games.name: Peaceful Bug Catching Story
games.summary:
Pick up your bug net and set off on a grand summer adventure.
Your bug-collecting summer vacation is about to begin!

games.name: PengPong
games.summary: PengPong is a survival roguelike shooter in a vintage cartoon world. Use a hockey stick to deflect pucks and weapons, stop swarms, and test your luck. Spend chips for safe upgrades or risk it at the roulette. New builds and quirky synergies challenge survival every run.

games.name: Plinkomancy
games.summary: PLINKOMANCY is a roguelite that turns a simple ball drop into explosive chaos. Hit pegs, rack up massive numbers, and unlock upgrades as you push the arcade cabinet to its limits. How far can you go before the machine pushes back?

games.name: Puppergeist
games.summary:
Play as Claire, a witch who journeys into the mysterious Doggie Underworld with one simple goal: Finding her lost Pup!

As you travel through Doggie Underworld, you'll encounter countless souls, each with a story to tell. Share moments with them, play together, and listen to their heartfelt tales. Use your sense of rhythm to lift their spirits and ease their troubles, bringing you one beat closer to reuniting with your own lost Pup.

games.name: Roll 'n Bounce
games.summary: Roll n' Bounce is a 2d, pixel art, side scrolling precision platformer game. You will need to master the movement and timing to make your way through these progressively challenging levels!

games.name: Roomballs
games.summary: Soccer meets air hockey with an incredible twist: fast-paced, zany robots inspired by your favorite pop culture icons. This isn’t just about speed and strength; strategy, quick moves, and clever plays are the keys to victory. This game guarantees endless fun and high-octane action.

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope
games.summary: The first major expansion for Heart of Chornobyl coming this summer, including a huge new storyline that can take dozens of hours to complete, two new regions, new and returning characters, and much more.

games.name: Sensory Overload
games.summary: A dropper game designed to overwhelm your senses. Twisting tunnels, psychedelic patterns, and breathing walls assault your sense of balance as the chaos escalates with every level.

games.name: Slayblade
games.summary: Build your ultimate Slayblade and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts for battle, and combine them for wicked power combos. Skate around the city in all its PS1 glory, making bank on your way to the top. And if you die in the game, you die in real life.

games.name: Steins;Gate Re:Boot
games.summary: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

games.name: Swarmdustry
games.summary: Build a living factory and automate the Swarm. Harvest resources, build mega factories and evolve organic industry. Balance growth, efficiency, creep spread, and survive in a world that fights back.

games.name: The Choices Of Priori
games.summary: You wake in an empty room, condemned to endless work—until uncovering a mysterious black cloth, you find a vast underground lab, a group of strange creatures called KB-Cats are plotting a revolution there. Join their uprising, survive in this money-ruled world until you touch the truth and miracle.

games.name: Theropods
games.summary: Face dinosaurs, solve puzzles and travel back to the time of ginormous lizards and pixelated adventure games.

games.name: Upload Aliens
games.summary: The rule: DON'T LET THEM TOUCH GROUND! Become the Cyberpunk Knight and launch aliens skyward. Use foes as missiles to trigger chain explosions in infinite aerial combos. Unleash this pixel-art roguelite spectacle with just three buttons: Move, Jump, Dash.

games.name: Vacation Cafe Simulator
games.summary: Cozy Italian Vacation Cafe ️ No timers, No stress cook traditional dishes upgrade and customize just drink prosecco, relax and grow your dream cafe

games.name: Vice Signalling
games.summary: Vice Signalling is a short narrative game where you infiltrate a secret society of the rich and powerful. Decipher secret signals and use them to uncover a conspiracy against the Emperor.

games.name: Word Game
games.summary: Word game is literally a game of words. Player controls "I" to find clues between lines, delete words to change the meaning of sentences, or shift words to rewrite facts. “I” must be wise and brave enough complete the mission of words. May the best "I” win!

games.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
games.summary: The Horde is coming, but you're ready to fight it! Arm your team to your liking and discover which synergies work best against thousands of the undead. Survive, evolve, and break the limits in this casual yet heart-pumping rogue-lite reverse bullet hell.

games.name: AI Pixel Battle
games.summary: AI Pixel Battle is a game where you draw your own original monster that looks like it could defeat the enemy monster. The AI judges the outcome and narrates how the battle unfolds. Unleash your creativity and create your own original monsters!

games.name: Alien Apocalypse
games.summary: Alien Apocalypse is an open-world sandbox survival game set after a devastating alien invasion. Scavenge for resources, craft, build defenses, and harness alien technology to fight back. Play solo or in co-op and reclaim what’s left of the planet.

games.name: Blood Red Rebirth
games.summary: Drive, shoot, and blow up your way through an East Bloc hellhole with a beaten-up sedan, an AKM and a post-punk soundtrack. Your mission is to steal three nuclear missiles – and so is everyone else's.

games.name: C.U.B.E
games.summary: CUBE - Survive deadly trials, earn upgrades, and compete for the title of True Subject in this 1-6 player co-op party horror game where cooperation is required, but only one player can come out on top.

games.name: Cicadamata"
games.summary: + follow the white rabbit + hop, skip, and jump to become one with joyeuse, until you are no longer you +

games.name: Click the Button
games.summary: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

games.name: Clickbait Tycoon
games.summary:
Clickbait Tycoon is an idle/incremental simulation game in which the player builds a clickbait media company in a pixel-art depiction of 1980s New York. Beginning with a single website and desk, the player publishes articles to generate views and ad revenue, then reinvests earnings into staff, upgrades, and new mechanics unlocked through a Research Lab system.

The core loop combines active clicking with automation: players staff a newsroom across twelve hire tiers, catch trending topics, fix typos for combo streaks, publish golden articles, and respond to breaking news events by choosing to verify stories, publish immediately, or sell tips. A separate RPG layer follows a field writer through 40 quests featuring boss encounters against editors-turned-monsters, lootable gear, and click-based combat.

Additional systems include an office tower with a 10x10 grid of rooms that grant permanent bonuses across resets, collectible creatures called Pocket Pals that hatch from boss-dropped eggs and can be merged and evolved, staff policies, payroll, scandals, and daily, weekly, and seasonal events. The game features two layers of prestige: selling out resets a run in exchange for permanent website bonuses, while a later buyout trades the entire empire for Legacy Shares. It includes offline progression, over 270 achievements, and cloud saves.

games.name: Clickonomy
games.summary: Clickonomy is a cozy sandbox game where you harvest resources from your very own tiny planet just by clicking. Gather, recycle, and find the rarest treasures to expand your collection as you explore a lively world that’s uniquely yours — all at your own pace.

games.name: CyberGhitch
games.summary: CyberGhitch is a narrative puzzle game where players team up with an exorcist trapped in a CD to battle "digital evil spirits" born from internet chaos in hilarious, bizarre adventures.

games.name: Dawn One
games.summary: Fight to survive till Dawn One in the most accessible hardest top-down action game ever (Self proclaimed). Mouse only.

games.name: Deadzone Rogue 2
games.summary: Fight as Talon 13-10 in this FPS roguelite adventure set on a fallen Earth. Combine weapons, augments, and elements to forge devastating builds, and blast through Monarch’s endless machines. Grow stronger each run, solo or with friends.

games.name: Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker
games.summary: Every character remembers, watches, tests, and may deceive you like a living person. They have emotions, voices, expressions, and buried secrets. Break them with words or evidence — or realize too late that you were only a pawn in their game. A detective game built around truly lifelike NPCs.

games.name: Dungeon Tells
games.summary: The heroes have escaped their cages. Dungeon Tells is a single-player social deduction game where you can read the minds of your enemies. Execute the weak, charm the strong, and defend your dungeon.

games.name: Dwarrf: A Pinball Roguelike
games.summary: Play as a Dwarven 'Pirate' and set sail on your modified minecart into the depths of the mines. Fight enemies in a unique blend of Pinball, Pachinko, and Bubble Shooter whilst collecting game altering balls & relics that ensure no two runs are alike.

games.name: For Stella
games.summary: For Stella is an interactive narrative game centered around psychological disorders. “Why would someone who has spent their entire life suppressing their emotions suddenly pull you aside to talk about love?”

games.name: Hearthwater
games.summary: Escape to a peaceful seaside village and discover every hidden corner.

games.name: Kill your Darlings
games.summary: The kingdom has imprisoned you in the dungeon! Manage your day-to-day life, date your fellow inmates (who are monsters) and fight by their side to escape in this innovative time-management dating-sim RPG where every choice matters and every playthrough is different.

games.name: Lazy Witch's Factory
games.summary: A run-based rogue-lite factory builder where middle management meets lawless Hell. Optimize production, make questionable deals, and race against the debt deadline.

games.name: Loot Gobblin' Together
games.summary: An online co-op game where you and your friends play greedy gobblins invading human houses to steal and gobble loot. Climb, stretch, and manage your stamina to survive chaotic heists and feed your Gobblin King.

games.name: Lord of Mysteries
games.summary: Lord of Mysteries is an upcoming RPG game based on web novel Lord of Mysteries officially licensed by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving.

games.name: Mega City Force
games.summary: Retrowave Action Roguelike featuring tough agents battling crime to the electrifying music of artists like Droid Bishop, Timecop1983, and more! Choose your agent and dive into hardcore action against enemies and bosses, utilizing a vast arsenal and special abilities that will define your playstyle

games.name: Minsgon Simulator
games.summary: Minsgon Simulator is a Market & Collectible simulation where you can hatch Minsgons from mysterious eggs, manage your store, develop your collection and compete in the Olympics with your Minsgons. Organize your shelves, sell to your customers, train your Minsgons and play your way to the top!

games.name: Moon Garden
games.summary: A cozy incremental game about growing your way home. Strategically plant flowers, optimize machinery, and grow your tree tall enough to escape!

games.name: Negative Time
games.summary: Negative Time is a bullet hell rogue-lite shooter where each time you get hit, you are sent further and further back in time, until you are sent into the past they tried so hard to erase. Maybe in there lies the key to your escape?

games.name: Rollin Ravioli
games.summary: A physics-based rage game. Control a ravioli can. Fight the physics. Accept the fall. Inspired by an iconic early 2000s ravioli commercial.

games.name: Settler's Domain
games.summary: Settler's Domain is a settlement-building game with citizen and resource management elements. Build structures, recruit settlers, gather resources, and explore your surroundings.

games.name: Stuff It!
games.summary: Colorful dolls with voluptuous bodies can come to life, don't you know? All they need to do is meet their Maker. Are you ready?

games.name: Suncroft
games.summary: Enjoy the sun!

games.name: Sunset Summit
games.summary: A co-op group climbing game for 1-8 friends! Head out on a chill but challenging climb with regular checkpoints. Use axes, ropes, pogo sticks, item delivery drones and more to reach the summit. Just remember to watch your step!

games.name: Taste of Blood
games.summary: A real-time strategy game with a simple economy, designed so you can focus on the battle and crush your enemies.

games.name: Taste of the Wind
games.summary: A simulation and RPG game with multiple endings, set in a Chinese restaurant. Play as the owner, and manage the restaurant, form bonds with characters, and explore the lively town. Uncover the secrets behind the restaurant’s mysterious downfall.

games.name: The Expansion
games.summary: A psychological first-person horror experience set in endless Backrooms. Explore abandoned corridors, uncover hidden secrets, evade mysterious entities, and survive a world where every turn leads deeper into the unknown.

games.name: The Last Portal
games.summary: Build and upgrade a fantasy army to defend the last surviving portal across 150 increasingly dangerous waves, expanding zones, and powerful boss battles.

games.name: The Sorting Bureau
games.summary: A cozy sorting game set in a quiet Tokyo workshop. Clients bring you boxes of clutter: buttons, coins, gears, stamps. Sort, match, and piece everything together with satisfying ASMR clicks. No timers. No wrong answers. Just the joy of tidying up.

games.name: Twin Balls Journey
games.summary: Live together, die together—bound by a single thread. True companions dare to have their fates tied by a rope. Twin Balls Journey is a two-player cooperative action game. Work in sync, manipulate environmental contraptions, and leverage each scene's unique properties to conquer every level.

games.name: Unpossess 2
games.summary: A 1-4 co-op exorcism simulator game set in the late 1900s. Play as exorcists responsible for addressing cases of demonic possession.

games.name: V.A.U.L.T Protocol
games.summary: Vault Protocol is a 1–6 player co-op horror game focused on extraction, communication, and chaos. Every run is different, every sound matters, and survival depends on your team.

games.name: Vholume
games.summary: Vholume is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

games.name: Blocky Powers
games.summary:
Stack the blocks and reach the sky, trust real physics as towers rise high! Use tricky powers, cause a big crash,
and beat your friends in this party bash!

games.name: Horror Prison: Escape
games.summary: You're not alone.

games.name: House Cleaner Simulator
games.summary: Build your reputation with every perfectly cleaned home.

games.name: Mireglow
games.summary: Step into a peaceful mystical swamp filled with wonder and hidden discoveries.

games.name: Crawler
games.summary: Experience Crushing Co-op Carnage in CRAWLER: A VR Mech Horde Shooter. Blast through hordes of acid-spitting bugs as you earn cash and extract from randomly generated missions. Upgrade your mech’s arsenal back at base while scrambling to meet the needs of an ever-growing quota.

games.name: Rotor Rescue Choplifter
games.summary:
Rotor Rescue is the definitive Choplifter tribute and helicopter rescue action game.
Fly a VTOL gunship through 18 hand-crafted campaign sectors, blow open detention barracks, and extract every last survivor.

games.name: A Game About Flipping Cards
games.summary: Did you read the title? That's the game, I promise. Flip cards to make money to buy upgrades to make more money to buy more upgrades to make more money. There is an arbitrary goal that has been set by the developer, but you can actually play indefinitely.

games.name: America Against Ants
games.summary: The year, 1951, the place, Nevada, USA. Take command of Task Force Sable and battle through 30 increasingly challenging missions to defeat giant, mutant ants as they swarm from atomic test sites in the desert. AAA features a unique, narrative driven blend of tower defence and real time tactics.

games.name: Apidya' Special
games.summary: Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.

games.name: Bar After Bar
games.summary: Bar After Bar is a co-op game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?

games.name: Bililitz
games.summary: Bililitz is a vertical roguelike with procedurally generated worlds. Explore mysterious depths, collect items, and discover portals to new challenges. Compete in the global ranking system to prove your skill and reach the top!

games.name: Combolands
games.summary: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!

games.name: DualVerse86
games.summary: A 2D retro speedrunner where every second counts. Switch between worlds, dodge traps, beat the clock.

games.name: Eco Volunteer
games.summary: A peaceful, cozy game about cleaning up trash and other eco-friendly activities in nature. Embark on a journey through stunning natural landscapes while doing good deeds!

games.name: Ecrazeus Castle
games.summary: A 3D action RPG looter with dual-wielding weapons inspired by arcade games! Run, jump, loot, power up, and defeat monsters before time runs out, then prove your might by dethroning the owner of the castle!

games.name: Eslabong
games.summary: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

games.name: Exit Ways
games.summary: Test your luck in the extraction shooter with survival elements. Build your camp, exterminate the contaminated and evacuate the civilians.

games.name: Ghost Villa
games.summary: In Ghost Villa you farm and cook during the day, by night you fight hordes of ghosts that want to haunt and take possession of your home.

games.name: Hell Cleaners
games.summary: A first-person automation game set in hell. Suck up demon bodies, feed them into the Grinder, fuel your Purifier, and deploy a swarm of Doombas to build a cleaning operation that runs itself and takes the rot back one zone at a time.

games.name: Iron Blight
games.summary: In a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town, you find yourself trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows and above all, find your wife Valeria.

games.name: Loot Frog
games.summary: Loot Frog is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

games.name: Lovebyte.exe
games.summary: A parasocial VTuber dating chatsim where you join a friendly degen discord group to chat about your oshis together, but is your kamioshi actually one of your new friends? Chat, uncover irl identities, & romance a fellow fan - or maybe a VTuber. Inspired by Mystic Messenger, online communities, and internet spam

games.name: Oil Island Hustle
games.summary: An Empty Island, Full of Oil, and your ON IT! Build your Oil Empire and Dominate the World Market! Create oil factories, produce oil barrels and sell them to different countries and earn Lots of Money! Hire workers to automate and remember to pay your 1 million loan to your co-worker

games.name: Overtrick
games.summary: A trick-taking roguelike with style! Outplay your rivals, purchase special abilities, and dazzle 1920s high society with your unstoppable cardplay. Call your contract, follow suit, flush trumps, and claim the hand. This isn't your grandma's bridge club... this is Overtrick!

games.name: Schedule store simulator
games.summary: Rise from a small-time drug dealer to a feared kingpin as you manufacture and distribute narcotics across the gritty underbelly of Tokyo. Grow your empire by acquiring properties, running businesses, hiring employees, and dominating the streets.

games.name: Shelve the Potions!
games.summary: Shelve the Potions! Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols, decipher cryptic notes, and uncover the correct shelf orders in a cozy organizational simple puzzle game.

games.name: SlapGains
games.summary: Train in a neon gym, walk into the arena, slap your way through five leagues. Every rep is on the beat, every slap counts. Your body visibly grows with you: thicker arms, broader shoulders, stronger legs, depending on what you train. Bronze to Diamond. One hit decides it.

games.name: Snap the Cat
games.summary: An incremental game about taking photos of cats. Upgrade your account, unlock new cats, and take photos of them so everyone on the planet will follow you!

games.name: The Shadow Cosmos
games.summary: A 3D metroidvania with retro aesthetic. As master peacock, delve into a mysterious, dream-like world with non-linear exploration and progression, stylish and challenging fights with a powerful halberd, tricky parkour and puzzles. Collect shadows, unleash darkness.

games.name: Titanic Escape Simulator
games.summary: Investigate a dark mystery aboard the RMS Titanic before the final night becomes a fight for survival. Explore, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and make impossible choices as history’s most famous ship sinks beneath the Atlantic.

games.name: Travellin Cats in USA
games.summary: Find hundreds of cats hidden in multiple iconic cities of the United States of America in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator!

games.name: Wordless Forest
games.summary: You are alone in the forest. You remember nothing. In this live-action interactive survival thriller, the story is written not by dialogue, but by your choices.

games.name: 1666: Amsterdam
games.summary: Every 333 years, something stirs. 1666: Amsterdam is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.

games.name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
games.summary: This is a fight for survival. Xenomorphs swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last.

games.name: Astral Court DX
games.summary:
Astral Court DX is an arcade bullet hell platformer! Taking place in Heaven, you play as "The Prisoner" - an infamous criminal who's been to prison one too many times and is sent to death-row! Heaven's one and only court, the Astral Court, is an... odd one... and decides to grant The Prisoner with a series of deadly trials that, if completed, will allow them to get out of prison scot-free!

In these trials, you platform on top of the Scales Of Justice, well several of them, collecting little stars named "Shinies" that spawn around the arena. You must collect a certain amount of Shinies all whilst avoiding whatever foes or obstacles have set up to stop you. Movement is made to give you as much control as possible to avoid hazards efficiently, you have a jump that can be performed even whilst falling and a double jump to get as much height as possible. There are a variety of other characters whom add extra challenge to the trials, accessible in the endless mode only however.

games.name: Blood Dungeon
games.summary: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

games.name: BoHeM
games.summary: Live an anti-cozy life on the sidewalks of Rainy Street. Fix apartments, tend bars, thrift for clothes, and uncover the wacky mysteries surrounding the eccentric yet seemingly normal tenants as they go about their daily lives.

games.name: Box Knight
games.summary: A funny, silly and irreverent action RPG roguelike. A mix of ‘the Office’ and ‘Lord of the Rings’ with a comic like aesthetic.

games.name: Chronicles Puzzle: History Path
games.summary: Piece together the shards of time in this historical sliding puzzle game. Experience a journey from the Big Bang to the future through 80 unique levels and 320 challenges. Choose from four difficulties, collect trophies, and unlock the wonders of the world - available in 14 languages.

games.name: Feed the AI
games.summary: Feed the AI. Collect data. Unlock upgrades. Watch the algorithm grow beyond your control. An active incremental where you feed an evolving AI with data and shape what it becomes. Will it save the world… or take it over?

games.name: Funguys Swarm
games.summary: Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire—and it’s very much not fine. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe—just maybe—save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

games.name: Gathera
games.summary: Gather materials to craft and craft to gather more materials! Open new locations to explore the world, build a cozy home and decorate it with your collections. Build manufacture to optimize gathering and crafting. Survive against the monster raids if you want!

games.name: Hero Mania
games.summary: Hero Mania is a bombastic, comic-book themed multiplayer party game where players don the spandex of unfamed, super-powered heroes as they brawl their way to the top using their abilities, wits, and even each other!

games.name: How Asian Parents went to School
games.summary: An online 1-4 player co-op adventure where you experience the legendary struggle of getting to school as an Asian parent. Fight a psychopathic bear, defy physics, and survive the emotional damage from Tablo Escobar : an NPC who roasts you every time you fail.

games.name: Koikata: How Our Love Grows
games.summary: An all-ages remaster of Koi Suru Kimochi no Kasanekata, with upgraded resolution, new features and Ichika route, which was not present in the original game.

games.name: Lorne
games.summary: In a wartorn world you are key to restore peace and order to the lands of Lorne. Equip Evelyn with the right tools you can find, craft or upgrade in this ARPG featuring interactive combat, open world exploration and intimidating temples filled with puzzles. End the corruption and keep Lorne safe.

games.name: Monke Survivor
games.summary: You are a Monke beating up endless waves of office workers with brutal melee combat and ragdoll physics. Smash props for rare buffs, stack game-breaking items and compete on the Global Leaderboards in this aggressive action-roguelite.

games.name: NodalBastion
games.summary: Defend the last AI core in an abstract minimalist game of incremental progression, powerful skills, and evolving networks.

games.name: Once Human
games.summary: Once Human is a multiplayer open-world survival game set in a strange, post-apocalyptic future. Unite with friends to fight monstrous enemies, uncover secret plots, compete for resources, and build your own territory. Once, you were merely human. Now, you have the power to remake the world.

games.name: Polylithic
games.summary: The Polylithic is a 3rd person crafting survival set in the Paleolithic/Neolithic era where the player crafts items, unlocks technology, discovers the world, builds bases, and can either grow the tribe and command the settlement or play the game solo.

games.name: Portrait Painter
games.summary: Paint portraits to help a struggling art museum in this relaxing painting game.

games.name: Sokogram
games.summary: Sokogram merges Nonogram logic grids with Sokoban box-pushing puzzles. Each level blends both systems into one unified challenge with handcrafted designs that reward deduction over guessing.

games.name: SVETIK
games.summary:
SVETIK is a top-down dark fantasy adventure RPG where the player explores a world plunged into darkness after the sun has been sealed away. The protagonist, Iskra, awakens in a prison with no memory of her past and encounters Svetik, a living fragment of sunlight that becomes her only source of illumination.

Together they travel through the dark lands of Lucida, facing creatures that lurk in the shadows and discovering the truth behind the disappearance of the sun. Light plays a central role in both exploration and combat, allowing players to reveal hidden paths, weaken enemies, and survive in areas consumed by darkness.

Svetik is not just a tool but a companion with its own personality. The relationship between Iskra and Svetik evolves throughout the journey, and the player's actions influence how the light behaves and responds during the adventure.

The game combines exploration, combat, environmental puzzles, and narrative choices while uncovering the mysteries of a world where light and darkness are deeply intertwined.

games.name: Synthalgia: Retro Arcade Racing
games.summary: Synthalgia is an arcade racing game set in the summers of the 1980’s. Drive dangerously, drive fast, earn credits, buy and upgrade cars all while jamming out to 80’s inspired music in a neon retrofuturistic world of fast cars, beaches and bright lights!

games.name: Tsugunohi: The Thread That Beckons to Heaven
games.summary: The latest entry in the everyday-life-invasion horror series Tsugunohi.

games.name: Unbroken Valor
games.summary: In this dark ink‑wash roguelike card game, build your 3‑person squad. Freely combine Eight‑Gua elements, 12 Blessings, treasures, talismans and mental insights. Fight and grow within endless time loops; every sword swing is a new unknown adventure.

games.name: Western Rye
games.summary: Welcome to the harsh and lawless world of the Wild West, where a mysterious fever called the 'Rye Fever' has turned the once-proud frontier into a lawless wasteland. In this world, survival is the only law, and you'll need to be tough, quick-witted, and deadly if you hope to make it out alive.

games.name: Woman Simulator
games.summary: Experience life as a woman - cleaning, cooking, laundry, and no time to rest. Full immersion into the world of everyday chaos!

games.name: A Tower Full of Cats
games.summary: A Tower Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you need to pet cats through the whole history of mankind... and beyond!

games.name: Beware the Depths
games.summary: Get in. Get Loot. Get out. Countless misguided souls have delved into the unknown Depths. Some seek riches, others, long-lost arcane secrets, and for a few: heroic glory for the sake of mankind. No matter what it is that you seek - if you want to stay alive, always remember to Beware the Depths.

games.name: Brigandine Abyss
games.summary: The king of Solginat is dead, and a new would-be emperor stands over the corpse. Confront the dark in one of six different storylines as you manage resources, rally your monsters, and stand against the empire

games.name: Curse of the Countess
games.summary: Descend a gothic clocktower dreamscape to escape the curse of time. A short, atmospheric puzzle game that gently blends Sokoban mechanics, bullet-hell traversal, and dark mystery.

games.name: Electio
games.summary: Five live rounds, a blank, and a choice. Electio is a short narrative horror game where death carries permanent consequences.

games.name: Fell & Sell
games.summary: Slay. Loot. Sell. Survive! Dive into a first-person blend of hack'n'slash roguelike and shop management. Plunder deadly dungeons for loot, escape with your life, craft, and stock your shelves. Then risk it all once more for profit!

games.name: Find My Frogs: Branches
games.summary: Find My Frogs: Branches is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a hand-drawn village nestled high in the branches of an ancient tree. Explore charming corners, discover tiny secrets, and help Uncle Froger find his missing hat.

games.name: Flyra: FPV Drone Simulator
games.summary: Flyra is a high-speed FPV drone simulator with Racing, Freestyle, and Survival challenges. Test your reflexes, explore unique environments, and fly a range of drones with realistic physics. Discover the thrill of flying free.

games.name: Folk Emerging
games.summary: Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with in-depth characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the wilderness, hunt megafauna, outsmart competitors in trade & autobattler combat. Discover fire, agriculture, politics... and survive to tell the tale.

games.name: Fractured Worlds
games.summary: Fractured Worlds is a dark fantasy action RPG set in the shattered remnants of a ruined reality. Master weighty, precision-based combat, explore diverse realms, and face challenging bosses alone or together with other players of the realm

games.name: Goblins Can Conquer
games.summary: From a small pack of goblins to a mighty horde: conquer the lands turn by turn! Strategize your expansion, build your village, and collect powerful spells to empower your army. Recruit new goblins and crush your foes: the age of the goblin has begun!

games.name: Luminous Jigsaw Puzzles
games.summary:
Step away from the noise of the world and enter the enchanting realms of Luminous Ages. This isn't just a puzzle game; it’s a journey through a vibrant multiverse brought to life by the breathtaking, hand-illustrated gallery of renowned fantasy creator Anthony Christou.

Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere of magic and myth. Whether you are piecing together a majestic dragon or a celestial horoscope, you’ll find a serene sanctuary designed to spark wonder. From the first piece to the final click, experience the satisfying glow of vibrant colours and hidden details emerging under your fingertips.

games.name: Make My Sandwich
games.summary: Make My Sandwich is a cute puzzle game about assembling sandwiches by hand. Read the order cards and drag ingredients onto the board, stacking them carefully layer by layer. Consider your guests' diets and tastes, pick the perfect drink, and follow all order requirements to clear the level!

games.name: Money Trails
games.summary: Become a billionaire as you venture out in your limousine. Decide what to buy and build to grow your endless procedurally generated island. Add up your money, incrementally increase your passive income and receive random alerts on your Personal Digital Assistant while you travel.

games.name: Pumpkin Woods
games.summary: Collect magical ingredients and build your cozy witch home while exploring the wonderful sights and secrets of these mysterious lands. Beware though, danger might be lurking deep in these woods...

games.name: SCP: The Beginning
games.summary: A first-person survival horror game set inside a collapsing containment facility. Explore restricted sectors, read unreliable reports, and survive hostile entities where following procedures can be just as deadly as breaking them.

games.name: Slay the Berserker
games.summary: Slay The Berserker: A solo developer's 3D hack and slash dark fantasy game with 2000's retro style. Find your path with stylish platforming movements as you slay enemies in half. Face challenging bosses across diverse biomes in your quest to Slay The Berserker.

games.name: Slime Slayer: Endless Loot
games.summary: Click to aim, reap souls, enjoy pop-bubble hack-and-slash. An incremental ARPG focused on looting and build crafting. Build unique setups from 20+ classes and 100+ core talents. Change combat rules with hundreds of uniques and Gemword system.

games.name: Sniper Camouflage Orange Spy Warrior I Buried Two Bodies in the Garden and the Police Haven't Figured Out Yet That They're Missing Because They Were a Lonely Old Couple Who Had No Relatives Simulator 2026
games.summary: Sniper simulator game with sponge bob graphics

games.name: States of Power
games.summary: Lead your nation in this strategy wargame set during WWII. Build up the economy, command unit divisions and dominate the world, online or in singleplayer! Create custom and alternate history scenarios, simulate them or play as one of the nations.

games.name: The Grand Slamboree
games.summary:
The Grand Slamboree is a 2D Platform-Fighter, where every hit is lethal for intense, fast-paced rounds. With simplified movesets, anyone can join in the brawl, while leaving plenty for dedicated players to master!

Bash, blast and chomp your way to victory in this tournament of creatures, weirdos and not-quite-heroes.

games.name: Thumps & Blows
games.summary: Chaos and fun are guaranteed in this fighting game, where a quirky cast of stickmen battle each other using ridiculous techniques in fast-paced fights with easy-to-learn yet unexpectedly deep mechanics.

games.name: Top Check
games.summary: Collect cards, build decks, and battle fierce opponents in Top Check, a roguelike deckbuilder and online collectable card game inspired by the classic game of chess. With many unique pieces and abilities, only the best strategists will emerge victorious. Do you have what it takes to reach the top?

games.name: Water You Doing?
games.summary: Your ride is dead, and rough waters lie ahead! Survive aboard a musty boat in a totally chaotic co-op. Collect scrap, patch up leaks, swap your catch for cold brews, and use harpoons to break the laws of physics!

games.name: 9mm Roulette
games.summary: Step into a chaotic bar where every turn is a deadly gamble. Spin the revolver, smash tables, dodge bullets, and turn bar items into weapons. With destructible environments, ragdoll physics, and dark humor, it’s all about luck, strategy, and surviving the madness.

games.name: Aggelos 2
games.summary: With the gods of light about to lose the great battle against the gods of darkness, you must master two powerful forms. Dive into a challenging Metroidvania set across contrasting worlds filled with secrets, puzzles, and intense 2D combat in this action-packed sequel

games.name: Animal Falling
games.summary: Animal falling is a multiplayer party game featuring cartoon animals in ball form, engaging players in a platform race filled with strategic obstacles and traps to hinder opponents. Unleash your mischief, obstruct rivals, and navigate the chaotic hilarity to victory in this wild, furry showdown!

games.name: AstroScaper
games.summary: A minimalist puzzle city-builder where every placement counts. Build colonies on asteroids using strategic proximity-based mechanics and minimal resource management. Relax in freebuild mode or chase high scores in challenge mode – all against a serene cosmic backdrop.

games.name: Bard’s Fault
games.summary: Bard’s Fault is a co-op Action Roguelike where you and your friends fight back-to-back against relentless swarms. Craft new builds, sync your abilities, and break the timeline in this multiplayer bullet heaven. Death is just the beginning, go back to the past and unravel a time-travel mystery.

games.name: Bloodbath
games.summary: Bloodbath is a suspense and investigation game with elements of horror, in which you take on the role of an operator responsible for controlling an android.

games.name: BreakEven: Idle
games.summary:
BreakEven is an idle action RPG for those players who enjoy the cycle - kill, loot, power-up, and destroy even harder.

The battle is automatically happening while you are making all the right decisions regarding the equipment selection, skill building, and overall strategy.

The game plays like an action RPG but values your time just like an idle game does.

The complexity is always ready when you need it but never interferes with you otherwise.

games.name: Bump Guardian
games.summary: Bump Guardian is a casual deck-building defense game about protecting a growing life. Build your deck, repel incoming threats, and progress through the stages of pregnancy.

games.name: Chou Shin Jikuu Geimu Neptune: Unlimited
games.summary:
Hyperdimension Neptunia!
The latest installment in the numbered series!

The Gamindustri world is facing an impending doom.
With the addition of a new goddess,
Eleven of them will face the giant meteorite together.
A hopeful adventure woven by goddesses
Now, the grand curtain rises.

games.name: Cocoro
games.summary: "Please make me human." A visual novel about a robot longing to become "human" in a world torn apart by rampaging AI. An unforgettable summer unfolds between a boy who has nowhere to call home and a humanoid girl who dreams of marriage...

games.name: Condemned: Nightfall
games.summary: A survival horror PvE and PvP set in a Noir Futuristic NYC! Team up with up to two others, or go in alone, and search creature-filled semi open-world map for arcane clues that lead you to a lucrative Bounty. Featuring permadeath consequences, only the best hunters will make it out alive..

games.name: Cyber Breaker
games.summary: Welcome to the 'Breaker System'. Fight back against the system through a game of cards and free humanity from its systematic embrace as BREAKER. Combine the use of skill cards and powerful artefacts alongside tactical thinking to best the system and break through the advancing array of robots.

games.name: Dave the Diver
games.summary: Dave the Diver is an action-adventure and management simulation game developed by Mintrocket. In the game, players control Dave, who spends his days diving into underwater environments to catch fish and gather resources, and his nights managing a sushi restaurant. The gameplay combines real-time underwater exploration and combat with restaurant management mechanics.

games.name: Fenrir
games.summary: The Nine Worlds are crumbling. Fenrir is free. Build your warrior from hundreds of items, master a deep build system, and fight your way through Midgard to Asgard — before the beast devours everything.

games.name: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread
games.summary: An interdimensional, time-traveling, action-platforming adventure game featuring everyone's favorite shark.

games.name: Ghostly Simulator: Your Neighboring Ghost Story Collection
games.summary: Welcome to an immersive horror fiction reading simulator. Every tale within is rooted in the chinese mundane, familiar moments we all live through —like the annual Spring Festival Gala You can shut down the simulator at any time. But remember: reality is always far more horrifying than any story.

games.name: Giraffe Raising Game: Reach for the sky
Glow Box
games.summary: A 60-minute adventure where all you do is glow.

games.name: Golftacular!
games.summary: Mini-golf turned upside down! Abuse wild items on a variety of challenging golf tours. Shoot, fly, explode, and whatever else you can to get in the hole! It’s golf… barely.

games.name: Hyperdimension Neptunia Unlimited
games.summary: Hyperdimension Neptunia ∞ (Unlimited) is an upcoming entry in the series where the world faces an apocalyptic loop triggered by a mysterious “meteorite.” As reality repeatedly resets, Neptune awakens alone in a white void and gains the power to “retry” fate itself. Alongside new allies, she must endure countless defeats, uncover the truth behind the cycle, and challenge the ultimate ending to save the world by venturing into a new spacetime.

games.name: Just Keep Fishing
games.summary: A short incremental game about catching a lot fish.

games.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Baekje Military Museum
games.summary: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

games.name: Late Order
games.summary: Night shifts at a cursed 24/7 diner. Every night — new rules and unsettling events. Fulfill orders, don't annoy the bizarre monster in the mascot's body, and maybe you'll have a chance to survive until dawn.

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.summary: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler 2000, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

games.name: Magic Chess
games.summary: Magic Chess, inspired by Chess and Chinese Chess, breaks free from traditional boundaries by introducing brand-new pieces and items, resulting in over 1,000,000 possible combinations. The game supports Single Player, Custom Matches, Local Multiplayer, and Online Random Matchmaking.

games.name: Magnetail
games.summary: Think Like a Genius, Solve Like an Inventor

games.name: Metahustle One
games.summary: MetaHustle One is a fast-paced, frantic FPS with horror elements. Fight through hordes of wicked horned foxes and other corrupted familiars of the «Great Meta-Druid» to escape a glitchy simulation before it turns into a surreal nightmare.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots - Master Collection Version
games.summary:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.

Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.

The game takes place five years after the Big Shell incident in Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty, in a world where war has become a business.

To stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising, Solid Snake throws himself into his final battle.

The battle against Liquid and the Patriots draws to a close, and the mysteries woven throughout the series are now revealed!

games.name: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version
games.summary:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.

Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you avoid combat and complete missions while hiding.

The game take place 10 years after Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater.

Amidst the swirling conspiracies behind the East-West Cold War, Snake confronts them while leading a private military force.

This is the story of how one soldier, “Snake”, becomes “Big Boss”.

games.name: Mind Diver
games.summary: Restore a broken mind to solve a twisted case. Investigate a couple's most intimate moments and piece together the events of a fateful night. Pick what to investigate, deduce awful truths, and solve a dark mystery. But most of all, Mind Diver: find the lost love. Before it's too late.

games.name: Mining and Dwarves
games.summary: An incremental game where you mine rocks, gather ore, and recruit dwarves. Play actively for maximum gains, or idle and let the dwarves do the work.

games.name: Monst
games.summary: Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring humans on Earth with various transformations, fighting against human armed forces, and annihilating the world.

games.name: Night Rolls Cozy Store
games.summary: Run a cozy late-night store. Prep fresh sushi and rolls, stock the shelves, and serve customers until dawn. A chill store management game where every night shift is yours to own.

games.name: Orb Breaker
games.summary: An incremental bullet hell about shooting orbs at enemies, collecting resources, and becoming powerful!

games.name: Peter The Stash Hunter
games.summary: A business sim + looting + strategy hybrid. Outbid rival hunters at storage auctions, ransack what you win, then run the shop that bankrolls Peter's search for his missing grandfather. Sabotage cards, Dutch vs English bidding, harpoon chases. Every box could hide a secret.

games.name: Plasma Dome
games.summary: Plasma Dome is a tactical tower defense with roguelite progression and no predefined paths. Defend your city from an aerial assault of geometric entities from another dimension.

games.name: Question Roulette
games.summary: Prove your wits and composure in this ultimate fast-paced trivia challenge where knowledge, speed, and strategic risk-taking determine victory.

games.name: Research Story
games.summary: Set out to discover and record plants and creatures for the Violet Archive. Grow crops, tame animals, and build the perfect farm! Forge friendships along the way as you begin your life as a researcher!

games.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
games.summary: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Entertainment. Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, it follows Sophia, a young plunderer, as she travels to Minotaur’s Island and searches for answers about her past. The game is described as an original story set in the A Plague Tale universe, featuring combat, puzzles, and mythological elements tied to the series’ wider history.

games.name: RGB Switcher: Color Roguelike
games.summary: RGB Switcher: Color Roguelike is a fast-paced action-puzzle roguelike set in a dying black-and-white world. Players control a customizable geometric Painter and must master the RGB spectrum by manipulating Red, Green, and Blue switches. Through mixing colors and utilizing hundreds of ability combinations, players restore corrupted grid-based arenas while surviving dynamic, real-time combat encounters.

games.name: Rutrum
games.summary: Rutrum is a physics roguelike about dropping gems, popping rocks, and unlocking chests. Build a deck of gems, inscribe them with runes, merge them together to cause damage, touch them to acquire loot from enemies. DROP, POP, UNLOCK!

games.name: Shrimp Game: Overkrill
games.summary: Become a pilot of a SHRIMP - Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platform. Krill your friends, explore areas for loot and customize your SHRIMP!

games.name: Star Wars Zero Company
games.summary: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in Star Wars Zero Company, a single-player turn-based tactics game.

games.name: Super Real Mahjong Venus Returns
games.summary: The legendary strip mahjong game is back with the latest VR technology! Play two-player mahjong against Shoko, Mizuki, Aya, and Akira, and each time you win, they'll take off a piece of clothing. Experience zero-distance stripping!

games.name: Tearscape
games.summary:
Discover a Gothic world in this 2D top-down action-adventure, blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and pixel art inspired by Game Boy Color classics. Fight monstrous foes, unlock new abilities, and explore a non-linear map filled with hidden secrets and dangerous challenges.

Master precise combat, where every strike and dodge matters. Strategically manage your stamina by carefully considering each move as you face off against grotesque enemies. You have a limited number of healing flasks—use them wisely and plan your moments to recover carefully. Upgrade your character's stats to remain effective and competitive in combat.

Discover powerful items hidden in the dungeons that enhance both combat and exploration. Unlock new abilities to defeat enemies more effectively and access hidden paths, uncovering deeper secrets within the world.

Uncover hidden dungeons throughout Tearscape's dark, interconnected world. Each dungeon holds unique challenges, powerful items, and deadly enemies, pushing your combat and exploration skills to the limit.

Face off against challenging bosses—massive, grotesque creatures born from dark experiments. Each encounter demands precise timing, strategy, and mastery of your abilities to emerge victorious.

Explore the vast, interconnected map filled with branching paths, hidden shortcuts, and secret areas. The non-linear design encourages exploration, rewarding you with powerful items and new abilities.

Encounter a diverse cast of NPCs, some offering guidance, others seeking your help, and a few with their own hidden agendas. Every interaction adds depth to the story.

games.name: The Blood Mage II
games.summary: The Blood Mage 2 is a turn-based Puzzle/Dungeon Crawler RPG hybrid. You play as a blood mage, so your health doubles as mana pool. Fight against different creatures and explore the environments to reach your goal!

games.name: The Magical Girl Childhood Friend Lives Next Door
games.summary: A story-driven romance visual novel where your choices shape relationships, uncover secrets, and lead to multiple endings with your childhood friend.

games.name: The Old Flesh of Nuraga
games.summary: Search among the sands of Nuraga to unearth what's driving your grandpa mad. The Ancient Times are seeping out. Will you succumb to them?

games.name: Thoughtless
games.summary: A dark sci-fi psychological Visual Novel where your choices shape who you are. The world has ended and it's been dominated by mysterious aliens who roam the city. Despite that, you only think of what you've lost. Will you be able to rebuild your relationships? Or even... the world itself?

games.name: Tiny Misery
games.summary: A sick mother and her young son move into the home of a lonely old woman. A tragic story inspired by the dark puppet animations of the 80s and 90s.

games.name: U Tsu Tsu Tsu
games.summary: Roam a quiet late-night city in this chill point-and-click adventure. Click anything that catches your eye, check your phone, and reply to viewer comments only if you feel like it. Take your time and enjoy a slow, unhurried night—free from anyone's expectations.

games.name: Who Haunts the Haunters?
games.summary: "Who’s real when the air starts to rot? Who Haunts The Haunters? is an Eastern horror social deduction game. Don't just watch for movement; listen for the whispers and watch the candles flicker. Purify the manor before the intruders’ greed consumes every last spirit."

games.name: A Little Age
games.summary: Build and expand a network of settlements, each with its own little economy. Manage the flow of resources between them at your own pace, and watch a civilization emerge in this minimalist settlement builder.

games.name: Alice's Gaze
games.summary: This is an eerie clicker idle game with light puzzles and idle combat. Alice wakes in darkness, trapped in a strange mansion, seeking escape. The Cat God's altar drops gold, Rabbitfolk gather carrots, and dungeon monsters block the way... Can you accompany Alice to the final truth?

games.name: Allumeria
games.summary: Explore a vast and hazardous cave network and uncover mountains of loot. Build a town and trade with NPCs using advanced building and lighting tools. Fight bosses and raid dungeons to unlock abilities. Play with your friends, and build, fight, thrive, in the fully destructible world of Allumeria!

games.name: BattleGroupVR2
games.summary: BattleGroupVR2 is a virtual reality real-time space strategy where you explore the galaxy and lead a fleet of powerful warships from the bridge of your flagship. Explore, mine, trade, hunt. Grow your fleet, upgrade your ships, train your captains, and battle the enemy from the captain's chair.

games.name: Can I Take Your Order
games.summary: You and your friends play as part time waiters in different restaurants. Use your bare hands to deliver food, taze a raging cowboy who just shot someone and dispose of the body before it starts to stink. Keep your customers happy on your own, or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

games.name: Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters
games.summary: The next episode of Tsubasas riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

games.name: Cards of Destiny
games.summary: Cards of Destiny is a VR puzzle game that brings the tabletop experience to a unique interactive environment! Turn your inner child into a god as you draw one-time-use cards that can save or condemn the tiny humans on your desk – and the aliens chasing them. Adapt to different levels and situations as your randomized deck, ticking clock and looming alien threats all keep you on your feet!

games.name: Cats and Seek: Zoo
games.summary: Let’s roam the zoo, meet the animals, and spot those sneaky cats hiding among them.

games.name: Chiqing Meimei Shaxue de Xiongkong Riji
Chronicles of Childhood
games.summary: A story-rich, platform, side-scroller in the coming of age genre. Travel around the Fantasy World of "Chronicles of Childhood", with your slingshot at hand. Fight and avoid imaginative creations, to finish all the levels and discover what does it really mean to grow up.

games.name: Custom Romance City 3D3
games.summary: Custom Romance City 3D3 is set to be a new entry in the studio’s “Custom” lineage of games, continuing from the Custom Maid 3D2 and Custom Order Maid 3D2 series. Just like in the previous entries, the player will be able to fully customize their dream girlfriend, but this time, they have the whole open world of Romance City to take her on dates and explore their relationship. Of course, the players will first have to skillfully romance the girl, but once they do, the “paradise city created to liberate people from common sense and reason” will be all theirs.

games.name: Cyber Cleaner Simulator
games.summary: Vacuum space junk, polish derelict ships, and clear alien worlds of debris as you upgrade your high-tech cleaning gear.

games.name: Dictocracy
games.summary: Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough

games.name: Dirtnap
games.summary: Dig, fly and fight through fully destructible maps in multiple game modes. Every character has its own unique ability, every biome its own hazards, and the weapon arsenal runs from machine guns to banana bombs to airstrikes. Play with friends, strangers, bots, or all of them.

games.name: Divinum
games.summary: Divinum is an action-adventure that blends stylish, expressive combat with rewarding exploration. Master devastating combos and craft unique builds to fight back mysterious invaders and uncover your island’s hidden truth.

games.name: Drown in Yesterday's Sea
games.summary: Xiamen,Fujian Province,2024. Gu Mengzhi, a 19-year-old student at Xiamen University, encounters a "sea spirit" named Coral—who hails from the ocean—and the two quickly become close.However, just as their bond deepens, an uninvited guest known as "The Stranger" arrives and disrupts everything.

games.name: Elden Ring
games.summary:
Elden Ring is an action RPG developed by FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment, released in February 2022. Directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki, with world-building contributions from novelist George R. R. Martin, the game features an expansive open world called the Lands Between. Players assume the role of a customisable character known as the Tarnished, who must explore this world, battle formidable enemies, and seek to restore the Elden Ring to become the Elden Lord.

The game builds on the challenging gameplay mechanics familiar from the Dark Souls series but introduces a more open-ended structure with vast exploration, dynamic weather, and a day-night cycle. It offers deep lore, complex characters, and an interconnected world filled with secrets, dungeons, and powerful bosses.

games.name: Fracture Point
games.summary: After years in prison, you return to a dark megacity ruled by a ruthless corporation. The only way forward is up—through countless floors of a heavily guarded skyscraper—to reach the corporation's leader and take your revenge.

games.name: Healer
games.summary: Heal your party as you defeat the leaders of the demon lord army. Find your unique playstyle by combining upgrades. As you die, you will learn the patterns and mechanics. Maybe one day you won't have to come back to life to save the world!

games.name: Inferno Protocol
games.summary: Trapped in a deadly labyrinth, you and 5 friends must scavenge, craft, and survive. Harvest monster parts for gear, inject experimental syringes to gain unique skills, and navigate trap-filled corridors. In this 6-player horror survival, you must evolve to escape.

games.name: Jonah Lomu Rugby Challenge 4 Remastered
games.summary:
One of rugby gaming’s greatest experiences is back! Re-released and remastered in tribute to the legendary Jonah Lomu.
Enhanced in stunning 4K with massively upgraded visuals, improved lighting and smooth 60 FPS gameplay on modern hardware. Jonah Lomu Rugby Challenge 4 Remastered brings the thrills, spills and intensity of rugby to a new generation. No licensed teams, just fast, hard-hitting rugby and pure sporting fun.

games.name: Kesu-Ji
games.summary: Kesu-Ji is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics. (Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode) You can aim for high scores on the online leaderboards in each mode and earn rewards. Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

games.name: King in the Mountain
games.summary: A calm strategic incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall between expeditions. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

games.name: Malignant Survivors II
games.summary: Enter a world consumed by nightmares, ancient ruins, forbidden magic, and mountains of loot. Battle relentless enemy hordes, grow stronger with every run, and uncover the dark secrets of a forgotten land.

games.name: NBA 2K27
games.summary: The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.

games.name: O.B.O.L
games.summary: Play a high stake game of head or tails against a mysterious opponent, trapped under the ocean in a claustrophobic, eldritch, Lovecraftian horror atmosphere, all while slowly losing your sanity.

games.name: Oshikake Oku-sama to, Kimi no Uso
games.summary:
Haruse Chiaki, the owner of a struggling used bookstore named "Kotatsu-do," was facing the impending closure of his shop amid despair.

Before him appeared a mysterious beautiful girl, Shinohara Ren.
Ren offered to help rebuild the bookstore, but in exchange, she demanded that Chiaki "marry" her.

Pushed by Ren, who said she needed to understand the bonds of family, Chiaki reluctantly accepted a contract marriage despite his confusion.

And so began an unusual newlywed life with Ren, who aimed for a "perfect family."

Though bewildered by Ren, who often defied common sense, Chiaki gradually found himself drawn to her.

games.name: Pesky Orcs!
games.summary: In "Pesky Orcs!" you take part in medieval fantasy battles between ancient foes: Orcs and humans. Dive into a unique mix of Autobattler, RTS and Roguelike in real retro pixelart fashion!

games.name: Pro Soccer Manager 27
games.summary: Become the manager of a football team and take full control of your club. Manage scouting, training, facilities, and squad development. Choose your philosophy: focus on coaching and tactics, or invest in developing the next generation of stars. Success depends on your decisions.

games.name: Project: Station
games.summary: A 4-player co-op sci-fi horror game where you stealth through unstable research stations, scavenge vital resources, complete high-risk contracts, and extract before the facility overwhelms your team.

games.name: Reconquista
games.summary: A fast-paced dungeon boomer shooter with melee combat, magic, and seed-based generated levels.

games.name: Russian Survivors
games.summary: Fight versus unlimited hordes of lizards and italian brainrot animals in post-soviet environment.

games.name: Saga of Yurina
games.summary: A 2D action platformer of graceful duels and perfect parries under the falling sakura.

games.name: Sincognito
games.summary: Sincognito, is a 5-15 players SOCIAL DEDUCTION, horror, stealth game in which players, split between two distinct teams - Humans & Sins - must use communication with proximity voice chat, teamwork to complete tasks, skills for combat, betrayal, and ultimately mind games to defeat the opposite team.

games.name: Skye's Repose
games.summary:
Skye's Repose is a chill Exploration Farming Sim inspired by Myst and Stardew Valley where you gather materials, seeds, and magical elementals from across the land and use them to rebuild, solve puzzles, and unlock new areas to explore.
In your exploration, you'll meet the mages who arrived and escaped from Skye before you ever arrived. And while they'll try to help you, they are deeply broken themselves and in need of restoration and hope. Can you really bring light to others from so far away?

games.name: Starweaver Express: Per Aspera Ad Astra
games.summary: "Starweaver Express " is a unique visual novel that blends poetic storytelling with dreamlike visuals. As the mysterious transfer student Tsubaki Ueshima, you'll step into a cloistered academy and follow the paths of girls searching for starlight, love, and meaning.

games.name: Streets of Miami VR
games.summary: Streets of Miami VR puts you in the middle of 1980s Miami—sun, sweat, and crime. Whether first-person in full VR or third-person classic view, you’ll work your way up from nothing, navigating the Vice strip as a new immigrant trying to survive in a city run by dealers and corruption.

games.name: Teaching Simulator: Elite Class
games.summary: Jump into the world of teaching with Teaching Simulator: Elite Class. Help your students learn, improve, and graduate from primary school. Decorate your classroom to make learning more fun and exciting. Bring in new students, support your team, and keep your principal happy. Every choice you make affects your classroom, your school, and everyone around you.

games.name: The Abandoned House in Yeongdeok
games.summary: She was sent to the abandoned house in Yeongdeok as part of a viewer punishment challenge. But the joke ended the moment the door slammed shut.

games.name: The Escape From Dungeon Keep
games.summary: A classic text RPG: type commands to explore, fight turn-based battles, manage inventory, upgrade gear, and finish side quests. Chase multiple endings, New Game+ content, achievements, and moddable Workshop maps.

games.name: The Last of RAM
games.summary: A fast-paced parkour FPS where movement is survival. Break into secure facilities, fight through enemies, and keep moving or die trying.

games.name: The Mask of Agnosia
games.summary: The Mask of Agnosia is a surreal 3D narrative RPG. Navigate and map a shifting network of waterways to recover a boat keeper’s memories. Solve matching puzzles to reveal a fallen kingdom, confront specters of time, and collect sacred masks to rebuild an ancient tower before the light fades.

games.name: The Too-Cute Girl Who Moved in Next Door
games.summary: A 3D romance simulation game with point-and-click exploration and interaction with the heroine. The story branches into a pure romance route or a revenge route, leading to multiple endings.

games.name: Too Many Balls
games.summary: Too Many Balls is a satisfying incremental clean-up simulator. Start small with basic pickup tools and a tiny basket. Collect golf balls, basketballs, tennis balls, ping-pong balls, and more. Drop them off, earn money, and reinvest every run into faster tools, bigger hauls, and better upgrades.

games.name: Tower Lab
games.summary: Roguelite tower defense where enemies can’t be killed, knock them off with physics instead! Build devastating contraptions that push, pull, and launch enemies. Unlock towers, discover broken synergies, and dominate through creative combinations.

games.name: Undying One
games.summary: Undying One is a tactical action RPG where every defeated enemy can be claimed for your army. Unlock new spells, raise the dead, command your forces, and endure ever-growing waves of power.

games.name: Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow
games.summary:
Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow is a fantasy visual novel game with a colorful cast of playable characters, each with their own unique mechanics, and all of whom are necessary in solving this mystery. But be careful, as your choices will determine whether their stories end in ruin or victory.

Interrogate your own player characters in this six-chapter murder mystery! Your decisions determine how many clues are uncovered for the final player character, the detective. Explore each stage of grief: Chapter 1 stars Orven as he navigates the shocking deaths of his dream and his hero.

games.name: Kinetiks
games.summary:
Kinetiks is a futuristic competitive arena sport game combining fast-paced action, tactical teamwork and physics-based gameplay.
Players compete in intense matches where movement, precision and strategy are essential. Control the energy disc, outmaneuver opponents and use teamwork to dominate the arena.
Designed as an esports-oriented experience, Kinetiks focuses on skill-based competition, dynamic gameplay and memorable team battles.

games.name: Push and Pull
games.summary: The Push and Pull is a co-op only puzzle platformer about playing as two dualistic bunnies.

games.name: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
games.summary: Hoosegow — a dark comedy about life behind bars. A random convict, a random charge, a random sentence. One goal: survive at any cost. Every decision opens new paths — or leads to death.

games.name: Breathedge 2
games.summary: Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

games.name: Deadline Savior
games.summary: This idle RPG adventure is based on the "Pomodoro Technique." Complete focused work sessions to advance your character's exploration. To reclaim the Goddess's Hourglass and restore peace, the hero must defeat the evil dragon "Procrastination" and its minions. The world’s fate is in your hands!

games.name: Deliria
games.summary: Fight, build, and conquer wonders in a thrilling infinite 3D sandbox. An adventure without cubes! Play solo or with friends in PvP, co-op, or creative mode—backed by 20+ original soundtracks.

games.name: Dong Wu: Odyssey
games.summary: Dong Wu is a challenging RPG about legendary beasts. You will form a 4-person party and fight a battle of succession to claim the throne. In this thousand-year war, your enemy could be the noble or Miasma. Your fate depends on your strategy, luck and courage. Good luck!

games.name: Edge of Evil
games.summary: Edge of Evil is a first-person psychological horror game with a focus on story and exploration. Solve puzzles, meet interesting characters and unwrap and ancient mystery in this game of terror where an ancient seal has been broken upon entering a locked crypt and now the shadows of darkness have been unleashed into the mortal world.

games.name: Fantasy Waifu Collector
games.summary: Fantasy Waifu Collector is an exciting game about collecting "Waifu" in order to build an army to build a town and restore the world from decay! Players will recruit many different characters as they explore a fascinating world filled with monsters. Defeat the Demon King to win, right?

games.name: Housekeeper: Anomaly
games.summary: Scavenge abandoned apartments, cut on broken glass, fight anomalies, trade with the merchants, deceive them into buying bad products and most importantly - try to stay alive and care about yourself!

games.name: Lady Death Demonicron
games.summary: Lady Death Demonicron is an all new side-scrolling, sword slicing, magic wielding, 15 level, multiplayer beat-em-up that takes the best aspects of the 1990's arcade classics - all mixed together with a killer 90's industrial-metal soundtrack!

games.name: Legend of Idle
games.summary: In this incremental game, you must rebuild your kingdom! Gather resources, construct numerous buildings, and set out to conquer everything with your army! A game in the style of the SNES!

games.name: Potential Man
games.summary: Potential Man is a role-playing experience where you must navigate the whims and woes of a humble seed. This wacky story features fully hand-drawn visuals, zany characters, and a classic JRPG-styled soundtrack to boot. Are you ready to achieve your true potential?

games.name: Rabbit Simulator
games.summary: An Action-Adventure game. Gameplay consists of mainly bullet-hell and shooting, but also features puzzles and mini-games.

games.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
games.summary: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

games.name: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
