Move together in sports like Bowling and Basketball, duke it out in Boxing, and even battle with one thumb in Thumb Wrestling - there are lots of ways to compete and have fun together!

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a first-person shooter and the follow-up to Modern Warfare III (2023), continuing the rebooted Modern Warfare storyline. The campaign is set during a North Korean invasion of South Korea and features dual perspectives: a young South Korean soldier named Private Park facing his first combat deployment, and Captain Price operating outside official channels on a personal mission. The game also includes multiplayer with 6v6 core maps, large-scale vehicle combat maps, and a dynamic map system called Kill Block that reshapes layouts between rounds. A DMZ extraction mode is also featured. The game is released exclusively on current-generation platforms and PC.

games.name: Death Rabbit
games.summary: The city that never sleeps has taken a sinister turn, and the dark tunnels of the MTA have become the epicenter of a horrifying outbreak. As Alisa, you must navigate through a labyrinthine underground world fraught with danger, where unspeakable horrors lurk around every corner.

games.name: One Piece: Grand Gourmet
games.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

games.name: Snap & Print
games.summary: Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

games.name: Breach Signal
games.summary: Breach Signal is a 1-6 Player Co-op Psychological Horror game. Enter a special unit operating for The Agency, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

games.name: Eyes Wide Open
games.summary: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

games.name: Last Floor
games.summary:
Last Floor is a first-person psychological horror game focused on observation and anomaly detection. The player navigates a looping hospital corridor and must identify subtle changes in the environment.

Each run begins in an elevator and progresses through an identical hallway. The player must determine whether an anomaly is present during the loop and choose the correct elevator direction to continue. Incorrect decisions reset progression.

games.name: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
games.summary: Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

games.name: Recycling Shift
games.summary: Work at a recycling facility! In this tactile cozy job simulator, sort discarded items into categories, process them into raw material and sell valuable items for money. Could be trash or treasure! Upgrade your workflow, sort and process efficiently.

games.name: Space Savory
games.summary: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)

games.name: The Mailroom
games.summary:
A horror job simulator where you work in the mailroom of a small regional office of Hell located in Modesto, California.

You just started working in the mailroom of that weird building on 5th. The job was easy enough at first. Sort the mail and use their creaky old pneumatic tube system to send it to the correct departments. But then shit started getting weird. Can you figure out what's really going on in this place and find a way out?

games.name: Timeless Rain
games.summary: Explore this foreign world and use manipulate time to defeat any creature who dares to stand between you and your goal! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

games.name: Cozy Archivist Simulator
games.summary:
Cozy Archivist Simulator is a first-person organizing simulation game set in an archive. The player works with piles of document folders, reads filing instructions, and places files on shelves according to archive rules.

The gameplay focuses on sorting and arranging documents by parameters such as category, subcategory, date, number, and other filing criteria. Tasks include processing incoming boxes, finding requested files, checking records, cleaning up workspaces, correcting misplaced documents, and restoring order to archive rooms.

The game features Sandbox Mode with selectable levels and archive tasks, and Campaign Mode structured around a series of working days with different assignments.

games.name: Emberville
games.summary: Help the citizens of Emberville rebuild their town, as you rescue them from the clutches of wicked forces with the aid of a mysterious and loyal friend. Learn various crafting and combat skills as you explore the treacherous corridors of a massive, ever-changing dungeon.

games.name: Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Expansion
games.summary: Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in Catuaí, a South America-inspired region shaped by coffee terraces, red soil and lush hills. Grow coffee beans, raise alpacas and Brahman cows, start new production chains and operate 25+ new machines!

games.name: Minecraft
games.summary: Minecraft focuses on allowing the player to explore, interact with, and modify a dynamically-generated map made of one-cubic-meter-sized blocks. In addition to blocks, the environment features plants, mobs, and items. Some activities in the game include mining for ore, fighting hostile mobs, and crafting new blocks and tools by gathering various resources found in the game. The game's open-ended model allows players to create structures, creations, and artwork on various multiplayer servers or their single-player maps. Other features include redstone circuits for logic computations and remote actions, minecarts and tracks, and a mysterious underworld called the Nether. A designated but completely optional goal of the game is to travel to a dimension called the End, and defeat the ender dragon.

games.name: Pidgeon Pocket
games.summary: Pidgeon Pocket is a chill incremental game about a rooftop pigeon-keeper who sends a flock of trained pigeons into a living city park to pickpocket small valuables from park-goers and bring the loot home. Each round the park transforms into a different live event, from a marathon or a street parade to a market, a concert or a dog show, while an intelligent police force reacts to every theft. Progression runs through a skill tree of abilities and rotating talents, growing the flock from a single pigeon into a full squad. Localized into 30 languages, fully playable with mouse, keyboard or controller, and built to run on Steam Deck.

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary: A kidnapping, a desperate mother, and a shadow from the past. The final chapter of the trilogy reveals every secret behind the series most unsettling icon: the Red Nun.

games.name: Rolling Stock
games.summary: An online co-op train loading game for up to 4 players. Keep an eye out for labels, ensure a tight fit, and help your friends when things get heavy. This new fully physics-based puzzler is rolling out cross-platform on Windows and Linux!

games.name: Thyranya
games.summary:
Thyranya is a free-to-play old-style MMORPG with a vast open world to be explored, dangerous creatures, rewarding quests and a lot of social content!

Dive into a world that pays homage to the classics like Diablo, Tibia, and League of Legends, yet stands out with its unique vibe. Thyranya is more than just a game; it's a blend of nostalgia and innovation, crafted from our passion for those unforgettable late-night gaming marathons. Here, you'll find everything from pixel art magic and epic boss battles to smooth animations, crisp graphics, and a fluid combat system designed for today's gamers. Join us on this journey and experience the essence of gaming, right from our hearts to your screen. Subscribe for a front-row seat to all things Thyranya—where every play feels like coming home, yet embarking on an adventure anew.

games.name: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
games.summary: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary: Enjoy quiet, countryside living in a Japanese village in this brand new farming sim! Just make sure you follow the rules—or else!

games.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
games.summary: Just in time for the 20th anniversary, You Are Empty has been revitalized for modern systems, with fixes, new features, and QoL additions, including all the official localizations. Our team carefully went through the entire game whilst faithfully preserving the intent of the original release.

games.name: A Dogs Dream
games.summary: Test your sixth sense. Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks? Every choice is yours to make. May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.

games.name: Backrooms: Splatter
games.summary: The Backrooms got colorful. Suit up, grab your paint, and splatter your way out of the liminal void with up to 4 friends.

games.name: Copy Cats
games.summary: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

games.name: Fuel Station Simulator
games.summary: Are you ready for the most comprehensive fuel station simulation ever? Manage your fuel station, your shop, the car wash, the workshop, your employees and much more…

games.name: Grimmlins Tale
games.summary: Grimmlins Tale is an action adventure monster tamer where you catch, train, and bond with all fairy tale inspired monsters. Fight alongside your monster friends in deep, real-time strategic combat, and hop on their backs to explore in the whimsical world of Never Everland.

games.name: InOut
games.summary: A minimalist puzzle platformer where each level is more than they seem. Change your perspective on levels to discover new areas. Explore the world to unearth its hidden secrets.

games.name: Anomalith
games.summary: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

games.name: Hello Kitty: Party Land
games.summary: Together with heart.

games.name: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
games.summary: You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

games.name: Phantom Blade 0
games.summary:
Framed for the death of his master and left with a ruined heart, Soul has sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted by his former comrades, he moves through a world of shifting loyalties and silent blades — determined to unravel the conspiracy that has condemned him.

Rain mixes with blood, mercy entangles with vengeance. Soul's journey is one of love, hate, and the fragile search for what it means to have a heart.

games.name: 10 Hours Before Sunrise
games.summary: A brutal 8-bit-style boomer shooter inspired by the best of ‘80s trash horror. You are Samuel Alvarez, a broken man who discovers a cabin worse than any nightmare. Survive the night and face the forces of Wendakor — or you won’t see the dawn.

games.name: Aposis: Infinity Hero
games.summary: Aposis is a minimalist retro JRPG/Roguelike about fighting enemy androids while uncovering the truth about what happened to the world 3,000 years ago.

games.name: Bold: Networked Newt Action
games.summary: Bold: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

games.name: Brain Hack Squad
games.summary: Build and lead your own cybernetic hit squad as you battle rival groups. Use real time tactical combat with pause to direct your cybernetic agents in combat. Upgrade your team, brainwash enemy agents, and deploy informants to gain control of the city.

games.name: Fortune x World: Bokura ga Game wo Tsukuru Riyuu
games.summary: Glovety's 3rd project, about game development.

games.name: Goodboy Galaxy
games.summary: A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game for the Game Boy Advance, where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.

games.name: Gray Planet
games.summary: Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

games.name: Hauntworks
games.summary: Hauntworks is a dark comedy haunted house management sim where you build an automated scare factory. Your undertakers harvest human reactions like screams, vomit, and laughter as physical resources, which you pipe through production chains to appease otherworldly patrons and escape limbo. Releasing in Early Access Halloween 2026.

games.name: Mad Ever After
games.summary: Happily ever after? Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op roguelike FPS. Journey through twisted fairytale realms, wield shapeshifting magical staffs, combine powerful spells and upgrades, and battle bizarre enemies and corrupted fairytale bosses. Rewrite the story, one chaotic run at a time.

games.name: NVA: No Visitors Allowed
games.summary: A minimalist psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping post-Soviet-era abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

games.name: Prison Legacy
games.summary: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

games.name: Project Reprieve
games.summary: A fast-paced FNaF-inspired roguelike first person sit 'n' survive, beat the demons and sins back and repent for you and your friends sins!

games.name: Ray's Hotel Adventures
games.summary: Use your handy Ghost Catcher to capture ghosts, solve puzzles, and stop the horny ghost girls that have been causing some trouble

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.summary: Join your favorite Dr. Seuss characters in 18 exciting minigames and challenges. Your house is about to be full of giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: Through the Manor
games.summary: A cozy building sandbox where you craft painterly structures and step inside them in 3rd person. Build whimsical manors, explore every room you design, and reside within your creations in this atmospheric, stress-free experience.

games.name: Freshly Folded: Laundry Shop
games.summary: Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

games.name: God Is Not Here
games.summary:
God Is Not Here is a first-person psychological horror game. The player explores an isolated house, investigates paranormal phenomena, solves environmental puzzles, and follows clues through recordings, surveillance cameras, and the surrounding environment.

The game focuses on atmosphere, narrative exploration, environmental storytelling, and encounters with hostile supernatural entities.

games.name: Phosphor
games.summary:
Phosphor is a fast-paced sci-fi platformer roguelike where you descend into procedurally generated cyberpunk biomes, battling waves of drones, mechs, and biotech horrors.
Master dynamic combat blending gunfire, melee, dashes, and cyber spells. Stack elemental effects like Burn, Freeze, Shock, and Poison to unleash powerful reactions, then take on massive, pattern-heavy bosses.
Forge devastating builds from hundreds of weapons, passives, and abilities that synergize across runs. Unlock upgrades with persistence cores, tackle daily/weekly challenges, and push deeper with every attempt.
A high-mobility, challenging 2D action game inspired by the intensity of Dead Cells and the emergent chaos of Noita. Currently in active development and beta testing ahead of Steam launch.
Get to the core. The Phosphor still lives.

games.name: Agromatic
games.summary: Automated farming sim where specialized workers handle all tasks while you focus on strategic decisions. Design efficient layouts, manage supply chains across zones, and optimize your growing operation.

games.name: Come To My Party!
games.summary: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

games.name: Everfront
games.summary: A roguelike territory-control strategy game where you continuously expand against AI opponents. Master six doctrines, unlock upgrades, and dominate procedurally generated maps.

games.name: Green Inferno
games.summary: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

games.name: Infinity Ship
games.summary: Combine cards, pilot unique ships, and survive cosmic chaos. A frantic space roguelite where every fusion makes you an unstoppable force. Defeat colossal bosses and prove your worth as the Guardian of the Universe.

games.name: Jawed
games.summary: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

games.name: Jigenro
games.summary:
"JIGENRO" is a 3D color-matching puzzle game.

Click to grab and move panels on the field.

If you can connect all panels of the same color, you clear the stage.
Some stages feature fields with side walls or fields with elevation changes.

games.name: Kick
games.summary: Kick It is a Jump'n Run with a soccer ball. Navigate your ball with skill and finesse through a happy adventure.

games.name: Light of Atlantis
games.summary: In this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania you dive into the ruins of Atlantis. As a small robot you control the water level in various rooms to solve puzzles and discover the mysteries of an ancient society.

games.name: Love D3ath Love
games.summary: In 2222, your AI secretly sends over 3,000 job applications worldwide without you knowing. Soon after, three powerful women appear, each insisting you belong with her. You’re thrown into a growing crisis, their ambitions colliding endlessly. What do they actually want from you?

games.name: Luminleaf Chronicles
games.summary: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is the story of a group of cat girls who set out on an adventure to purify the world's water. In this game, you can choose different characters to go on your own adventures with others.

games.name: M.E.M.O
games.summary: Rely on nothing but your own wits. A first-person cryptographic adventure game that play with paper and pen. As you wander through the maze of memories, can you find the key to saving the future?

games.name: Magic Kingdom
games.summary: Self moving chess, RTS, Meat pigeon game. In the game, you will control the hero, lead a powerful army, release powerful magic, have a strong city defense, and coordinate resource collection to resist the enemy's strong attack

games.name: Moonlight Knight
games.summary: Moonlight Knight is an action-slasher with RPG elements. Use sword, bow, magic and hook to fight your enemies. Loot gold, upgrade character stats, find unique items and unlock ultimate abilities to make it to the very end!

games.name: Pozionista
games.summary: Travel through a world surrounded by nature, collect plants and use them to create potions, invent new recipes, sell potions in stores and explore the world.

games.name: Procession Engine
games.summary: A real-time tug-of-war roguelike deck builder. Your buildings spawn your army. Your cards, blueprints, and imbues decide what that army becomes. Place buildings in your yard, work the belt, and push two lanes until one stronghold falls.

games.name: Slotbound
games.summary: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

games.name: Steins;Gate: Octet of Shifting Space
games.summary: A non-canon extension of the True End of the original game. Unlike the modern visual novel format of the original game, this retro game perfectly mimics the style of graphical text adventure games from the 8-bit PC era (e.g. PC-88), with the player typing short commands to interact with and explore the game world. It features all backgrounds and characters drawn in a low-color pixelated style with emulated scanlines, chiptune music played through an emulated FM chip, and no voice acting. Although non-canon, the game contains many easter eggs and references that connect Chaos;Head and Steins;Gate together.

games.name: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
games.summary:
Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592 takes the 1592 war and bends it into alternate-history fantasy. You lead a ragtag company of exiles, defectors, and outlaws across battlefields where magic and steel share the same grid.

Terrain wins fights — along with skills, not just stat sheets
Every map is built on height. Take the high ground, force enemies onto bad footing, and play the four elements — earth, water, fire, wind — off each other. Read the turn order, land the right status effects, and you'll take fights you had no business winning.

games.name: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
games.summary: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

games.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
games.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

games.name: Wanderdawn
games.summary: Explore various worlds in a hack-and-slash action game - In a world ravaged by an unknown disaster, face various monsters with the diverse weapons you find.

games.name: Bolariki
games.summary: The match-3 roguelike. Stack relics, shatter rules, and pull off outrageous combos, all inside a puzzle game that boots like a fever dream from 1995. Crunchy, retro, and dangerously easy to start. Impossible to stop.

games.name: Bonki D Bonk
games.summary: Survive relentless enemy waves in a fast top-down survival game where your weapons attack for you. Move, dodge, and stack 30+ weapons with 100+ items into screen-filling chaos.

games.name: Snot Pop!
games.summary: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

games.name: Southern Lights: Broken Frequency
games.summary: Lead a stranded Antarctic research station where every decision matters. Manage your crew and its scarce resources while an unseen cosmic threat slowly tightens its grip.

games.name: SpaceShooter
games.summary: Blast through endless waves of deadly meteors in a fast-paced 2D arcade space shooter! Fight through 20 challenging stages, battle powerful bosses, customize your ship, discover unique meteor types, unlock weapons and upgrades, and survive the Endless Mode.

games.name: Sunset Artisan Chocolate
games.summary: Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique! Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

games.name: Survive the Apocalypse
games.summary: Turn-based roguelite in a post-apocalyptic world where you will have to make meaningful decisions (sounds familiar, capitalist world maybe). Make your way out of this ruined city, with eleven quarters (levels) and countless zones. Eat well, sleep well, decide well.

games.name: Tales of Tonbrook
games.summary: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid. When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it! Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

games.name: The Ice Is Watching
games.summary: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

games.name: Angel Guardian
games.summary: Angel Guardian is a side-scrolling action shooter where players take on the role of Kita, a warrior guardian, tasked with saving a prince from the forces of evil. Players can use action shooting, stealth, and hacking to defeat enemies and overcome obstacles

games.name: Ashes of Alice
games.summary: Do not stray off the path. Ashes of Alice is an atmospheric, PSX-style narrative survival game where the world has already ended. Follow a fading blood trail through a desolate, ash-choked landscape, piecing together the final moments of humanity before your vision goes dark for good.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

games.name: Iron Colony
games.summary: After crash-landing on a mysterious island, confront hostile robotic creatures in intense combat and strategic duels. Explore forgotten ruins, uncover secrets, and fight for survival in a world where corrupted technology dominates every corner.

games.name: Let’s Sing 2027
games.summary: Sing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.

games.name: Radiant Starlets
games.summary: Radiant Starlets is a HD2D action platformer in the vein of classic action platformers but you can date all the bosses. Select your boss order and make your way through 8 challenging stages. Try every order and uncover the mysteries of this world.

games.name: Sortilège
games.summary: A tactical dice duel between rival wizards. Read the table, press your luck, and outroll your opponent. Take on the singleplayer campaign or face off head-to-head online.

games.name: Wilderdark
games.summary: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

games.name: Blood of Rations
games.summary: Blood of Rations is a WW2 extraction shooter set in 1944 occupied Europe. Deploy alone into solo PvPvE raids, scavenge what the dead left behind, and extract alive — or lose everything you carried in. No minimap, all-diegetic audio, a grid inventory where every slot is a decision, and an 8-second extraction window. Between raids you rebuild the underground bunker you call home.

games.name: Bros of Bench
games.summary: Bros of Bench is a chaotic co-op platformer where two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Alternate between lifting each other and flying with jetpacks while mastering coordination, physics, and timing.

games.name: Build a Bot
games.summary: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

games.name: Crymelight
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Emery Hearts
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this thrilling action JRPG and uncover the secrets of Emery crystals as you face challenging enemies that will demand all your skill and ingenuity to defeat them.

games.name: Feed Me More Brains
games.summary: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

games.name: Glory On Pluto
games.summary: Bring prestige back to Earth by building your engines and finding Glory on Pluto in this offbeat and unique deckbuilding rougelike.

games.name: K-Pop Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game! Dance and sing your way through the competition and rise to glory. Customise your character to your image, it is your time to shine!

games.name: Wielders of the Essence
games.summary: Incremental base-building horde survival. Short runs earn you resources to construct buildings, which unlock new powers, troops, and spells. Every run pushes you forward, even if you die. Delightfully chaotic and surprisingly chill.

games.name: Brothel Virgin: The Crimson Reverie
games.summary: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary: Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games; Monopoly, The Game of Life, and Clue to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

games.name: Lost Media Agency
games.summary: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.

games.name: Borbs
games.summary: Reunite chonky borbs with their flock in this relaxing puzzle game, brought to life by hand-drawn artwork from a longtime bird keeper.

games.name: Hantu and Hunted
games.summary: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

games.name: Ho Ho Ho Sokoban
games.summary: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

games.name: Never Sort By Color
games.summary:
Never Sort By Color is a first-person zen organization game where you use magnet gloves, part detection, sieves, and quick hotkey tossing to sort an enormous pile of plastic bricks into a labeled workshop. Instead of sorting by color, you sort by part type, rebuilding drawers and organizing bays as the floor area opens up.
As you complete categories, instruction books guide you to pull exact parts from the right drawers to assemble MOCs that snap together brick by brick, turning the quiet sorting loop into satisfying, functional model building.

games.name: Patience Balls
games.summary: Patience Balls is a minimalist physics-based puzzle game focused on tilt mechanics and precision. Players navigate one or more balls through intricate labyrinths and mazes to reach designated goal spots. The gameplay emphasizes steady control and logic across multiple themed worlds. It includes global leaderboards and unlockable achievements within a performance-optimized, clean visual style designed for short, meditative sessions.

games.name: Hill-Z
games.summary: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?

games.name: Mythfall
games.summary: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg. Face deadly bosses, forge alliances, and carve your legacy in a world where every fight could be your last.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
games.summary:
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world.

In the single-player interactive novel villain team-up game "There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.," you play as his greatest adversaries. Can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. (short for a "Very Important Collective of Terrorists, Operatives, and Rogues") defeat the only man standing between them and world domination?

To the V.I.C.T.O.R. go the spoils!

games.name: Echo 9
games.summary: Echo 9 is a tense first-person horror. You are Yon, a maintenance android. Navigate a failing shuttle through deep space, stabilize the dying reactor, and bring Eva to the evacuation point. Radiation is rising, the evacuation point far. Eva is in stasis. You are all she has.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.summary:
From the creative minds of the Persona series – Metaphor: ReFantazio marks ATLUS’ first ever, full-scale fantasy RPG, brought to you by director Katsura Hashino, character designer Shigenori Soejima, and composer Shoji Meguro.

Write your destiny and rise above fear as you step into a fantasy world unlike anything you’ve seen before. Fraught with unsettling mystery, the kingdom stands on a precipice. Now, you must embark on a journey, overcoming obstacles and forging bonds with friends.

games.name: The Totemist
games.summary: Run an occult shop in a quietly strange town, crafting totems and talismans inspired by real witchcraft. Help townspeople with their burdens at your own pace while uncovering an ancient darkness beneath the town, one only you can stop.

games.name: Fancy Farm Brawl
games.summary: Closed Playtest Now Live! Mix relaxing farming & tower defense. Early testers average over 98 minutes per play session. Click Request Access on store page to apply for limited slots.

games.name: World 23
games.summary: Battle through decaying mega-cities, abandoned metro tunnels, and guarded enemy facilities in this fast-paced top-down hack and slash. As Theo and Leo, you master abilities and switch weapons during combat to match your play style and the challenge ahead.

games.name: Zero Sum
games.summary: A hand-drawn twin-stick roguelite where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Subtract, divide, root, modulo. 7 operators, 22 firing modes, 9 bosses, 80+ upgrades. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars, just raw arithmetic violence. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

games.name: Space Station Designer
games.summary: Space Station Designer is a construction and management game that puts you in charge of creating and expanding a network of orbital outposts in Earth and Lunar orbits.

games.name: Axyn Adventure
games.summary: Axyn Adventure is a retro style 3D platformer. You take control of the titular character Axyn and embark on many adventures with your friends Yunn and Leaf. Play in the vast open levels using your big set of moves to get around. Collect as many items as you can to advance the story and unlock tons of content.

games.name: Dungeon of Departure
games.summary: an independently developed, pixel art, visual novel set in an original universe which follows the silent, player protagonist and three companion characters as they struggle to find a way out of an increasingly puzzling, underground world.

games.name: Flick
games.summary: Shift realities with the flick of a light switch and plunge into the grotesque to uncover your family's twisted past. A psychological horror game where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

games.name: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
games.summary: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the Grand Theft Auto series yet.

games.name: Iona's Island
games.summary: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders and help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape a world with accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

games.name: Lord of Undead
games.summary: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

games.name: Microscape
games.summary: Heavily inspired by Runescape, Microscape is a tiny community idle game for Twitch streams. Channel owners can add their community to the world. Players then earn playtime by being in these communities.

games.name: Phantom Vice Auto
games.summary: Experience entertainment blockbusters Phantom Vice Auto and Phantom Vice Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for Phantom Vice Auto Online players.

games.name: Psycasso
games.summary:
Take on the role of a serial killer who creates paintings with their victims blood! Sell your creations to earn money while trying to avoid capture by the police and other civilians.

In this pixel art adventure you'll play as Psycasso, a struggling gallery artist living in an open world city. By day you'll work a day job to earn money and level up skills, seamlessly blending into society. By night you'll be on the lookout to harvest 'red paint' from one of the 'walking meat-bags' to help you create original 2D art. Sell your artwork to art galleries for huge profits! Become rich from your unique artwork while avoiding capture from the ever growing police presence using stealth techniques and unique traps. Buy property, upgrades, furniture, weapons, discover a bustling city and play a host of mini games in this controversial indie title like nothing before.

games.name: The Legend of the 4 Elements
games.summary: The Legend of the 4 Elements is a platformer with elemental combat. Control heroes of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, use unique abilities, overcome challenges, battle dangerous enemies, and restore balance to the world of the elements.

games.name: Circuit Keep
games.summary: Circuit Keep is a grid‑based tower defense game where players build and upgrade circuit‑themed defenses to repel escalating waves of intrusions. The game features a campaign of handcrafted lattices, a research system, and multiple enemy types with unique behaviors. Players manage resources, optimize layouts, and adapt to changing threats across increasingly complex maps.

games.name: Ages of Cataria
games.summary: Care for generations of townsfolk in a land of mystique and wonder. Build colonies along side your friends in this multiplayer colony sim and narrative RPG.

games.name: Project Atlas
games.summary: In a universe where everything is falling into chaos, one person and their new found companion are out to save the universe from total destruction. Experience heart pounding battle action, animal handling skills, survival skills, and even some fishing along the way. Includes solo story mode, multiplayer 6v6 team death match, and a battle royale. Set in the near future where humans battle resource deprivation, and climate change on worlds. Yet off world threats are the real danger! Battle through countless missions with your customizable K-9 companion. Can the universe be saved or was it doomed from the start?

games.name: Turbo Turkey
games.summary: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

games.name: Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou
games.summary: Sprite's 15th anniversary game. A share house receives an odd purchase offer one day and, around the same time, a new girl with suspicious behavior moves in.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Ship Miner
games.summary: Relaxing mining experience that merges combat elements and 1-bit pixel art aesthetics. Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy. Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

games.name: Death and Tactics
games.summary: A post apocalyptic turn-based strategy game. Permanent death is a primary mechanic, with unique events being unlocked based on how you play the game. And there are many ways to play! Such as: selling the organs of party members you don't like, turning your enemies into monsters, and much, much more!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash
games.summary: Dive into a world consumed by the biblical apocalypse. As a fallen priest seeking redemption, battle demonic horrors, cleanse the tormented, and gather what remains to rebuild the Sanctuary of Ash - the faint light in a dying world.

games.name: Atlanta TD
games.summary: Atlanta TD is a roguelite tower defense game where the armies of the underworld descend onto the Four Spectacular Realms in waves as it falls unto the remaining Gods to protect the city of Atlanta!

games.name: Beautiful Light
games.summary: Beautiful Light is a PvPvP(vE) tactical first-person extraction shooter where 6 squads of 3 operators are tasked with entering, securing, and extracting an artifact in a hostile, horrific environment. Face other operators and player-controlled anomalies, but beware: mistakes can risk your life and gear.

games.name: Cats Hidden in Advent Calendar
games.summary: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advents calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this cute HOG by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cats game creator!

games.name: Chronal Chain
games.summary: "TIME CONTROL" bullet hell action. Overcome impossible odds by slowing, stopping and rewinding time!

games.name: Former Dawn
games.summary:
After a failed terraforming mission on an exoplanet light years from Earth, humanity dies out but leaves behind a child species(called the “Formers”) that forgets its own origin. You play a common hunter who rediscovers the truth and struggles against the faceless Organization which will stop at nothing to defeat you. Along the way, you recruit a motley crew of brave Formers who are willing to risk everything for Justice.

Former Dawn is, in a nutshell, a story of discovery, resistance to evil, and exploration of the human condition. The world is rich, the plot complex, and the characters dynamic and multi-dimensional.

games.name: Former Dawn
games.summary: An upcoming port of Former Dawn for the PC

games.name: Goodnight, B
games.summary: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a hungry little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore various environments, meet wacky characters, find secrets, and wall-jump your way towards that coveted midnight snack.

games.name: Hacking Into Erebus
games.summary:
Hacking Into Erebus is a hacking game centered on taking control of a spacecraft named USS Erebus.

The ship is stranded on a remote alien planet. The crew is in cryogenic sleep. The player physically navigates inside the ship using robots while simultaneously gaining access to its network systems. The ship's central operating system, ARIA, protects the system but operates aggressively against the player.

The player must manage robots and interact with panels and terminals to successfully take control of the ship's systems.

games.name: Hag's Hand
games.summary: A tower defense game that blends Brazilian folklore myths with card management. Protect the forest by summoning the creatures that dwell within the wilds. As invaders push deeper into the untamed woods, the witch Cuca merely watches their movement, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

games.name: Knights Province
games.summary:
Become medieval lord. Build and defend your town. Train your army. Conquer the enemies.

Knights Province is intended to be an old-school RTS game. Unlike many modern RTS games, which are fast-paced and often are more about tactics, KP planned to emphasize on “strategy” component. Slower-paced gameplay, base-building, resources collection and processing, in-depth strategic choices, variety of resources and units, attention to details.

games.name: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued
games.summary: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued is a courtroom simulation RPG where every trial is a battle of wits. You’ll take on the role of Harold Beagll, a golden retriever attorney navigating a legal system filled with sharp-tongued rivals, eccentric clients, and unpredictable witnesses.

games.name: Merry Crisis
games.summary: Three loves. One week. Zero chill. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you’re headed?

games.name: Moto Trial Turbo
games.summary: Moto Trial Turbo is a physics-based 2D arcade motorcycle trial game. Players can look forward to exciting tracks, devious traps, secrets, and even player-created levels! Complete challenging tracks against the clock and compete with players from around the world on the leaderboards.

games.name: Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories
games.summary: Immerse yourself in The Neverending Check-In: The Hotel Stories, a pixel RPG filled with mystery, quests, cats, humor and life universe. Rebuild a once-glorious hotel and uncover its secret past in this captivating journey of deep plots, lively characters, and abundant quests.

games.name: Oogies Chicken Quest
games.summary: A short, quirky 3D action adventure where Oogie sets out to find his legendary chicken, Cluck Cluck, who lays diamond eggs. Explore small open worlds , solve puzzles, battle odd enemies, and uncover hidden secrets in vibrant levels!

games.name: Pistol Cat
games.summary: A cat. A gun. Recoil-powered movement, leg kicks, and a fart thruster. Shoot your way through a living open world town, smash everything in sight, and survive the Blood Moon: all as a small, physics-driven cat with a big pistol.

games.name: Rise of Fati
games.summary: Step into the mythical world of "Rise of Fati," an epic adventure game where ancient African folklore and legends come to life. Embark on a journey with Fati, a young and brave warrior destined to restore peace and harmony to her homeland. Explore rich landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and battle formidable foes as you uncover the secrets of your heritage.

games.name: Salmon
games.summary: SALMON is a speedrunning platformer game with ridiculously satisfying movement that really shouldn’t be possible for a salmon.

games.name: Shadow Mate
games.summary: A horror action adventure game in which you work with Belial, a life form that has possessed the body of a young girl named Cynthia, to escape from a mysterious laboratory.

games.name: Silicone Heart
games.summary: Survive on a junkyard planet filled with broken robots, machinery, and resources in this adventure sandbox game. Recycle resources, repair robots, invent items, create new plant species, grow them, and uncover the mysteries of this planet.

games.name: Skate Mates
games.summary: A chaotic multiplayer skating game where each player controls one skate! Only epic teamwork and swift communication will get you through the brutal obstacle course! Dodge the blades, jump the canyons, and avoid the lava, because one mistake sends you all the way back.

games.name: Skye
games.summary: Skye is a hack-and-slash action game blending roguelite elements with arcade-style time limits. Fight efficiently against the clock, carry over your abilities after death, and grow stronger with each run to overcome the inevitable end.

games.name: SweetCanvas
games.summary: An untimely transfer. An unexpected encounter. A chance meeting between two students sets in motion a chain of events that will fundamentally change both of their lives... Or, perhaps, just their love life!

games.name: Tales of Eldoria
games.summary: The sun is gone. In a world trapped in eternal moonlight, guide Liora and her companions through the Arcadia dungeons in a story driven JRPG about sacrifice and the bonds formed when the world is already broken.

games.name: They Are Rising
games.summary: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

games.name: Wizalign
games.summary: A match-3 adventure RPG where every action happens on the puzzle board. Battle monsters, collect keys, discover powerful dungeon items, manage health and shields, and defeat bosses as you explore overworlds and dungeons inspired by classic adventure games.

games.name: You Will Fall
games.summary: A parkour climbing game where gravity is your enemy, fire is your only friend, and the ground keeps winning. No checkpoints. No mercy. Just you and your poor life choices.

games.name: Akashic Slingshot
games.summary: Fight your way through a diverse world in this action-adventure side scroller, where you are given one weapon and die in one hit. Can you earn the right to peer beyond the Zeroed Abyss?

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the Dragon Quest series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: Sombras: Negative Frames
games.summary: ‘Sombras: Negative Frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary: Traverse massive, fantastical landscapes and master seamless real-time RPG combat that has all been enhanced to run at 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

games.name: Goojeegoop
games.summary: Click ClIcK CLICK your way through endless rounds of enemies in an exciting new point and click roguelike and become insanely strong! Click on enemies to unlock new slots, increase your level and create crazy and spectacular builds!

games.name: Nullbreak Protocol
games.summary: A sci-fi arcade roguelite of fast, escalating runs. Launch your core, shatter every block, survive what the room fires back. Draw stacking protocols to build your run, push deeper into the system, and beat your record — the descent never ends.

games.name: Squid Hunt 1923
games.summary: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

games.name: The Industrial Council
games.summary: A cozy AI driven game where you play a journalist in a steampunk fantasy city. Change is coming to Raversul, and with the help of your imp and your newspaper you will play a powerful role in shaping it. Solve mysteries, uncover stories, and shape politics in this revolutionary new game.

games.name: Castles & Castellans
games.summary: Castles & Castellans is a hybrid of real-time strategy and third-person action. Rule from the castle-building RTS view - construct, manage, and fortify against looming threats. Then step into the castellan’s boots in TPP, fighting side by side with your soldiers atop the very walls you built.

games.name: Attack on Titan 3
games.summary: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

games.name: Hakuoki Ibun: Berezinskii no Majo
games.summary: A new Hakuoki game for Nintendo Switch, set in 19th century Europe.

games.name: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
games.summary: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball career simulator set in an original fictional universe. Create a prospect, choose a College, International, or Pro path, shape skills and mentality through RPG decisions, and earn a role through performance, form, and consistency. Play or simulate games in the Live 2D Match Center while teams, rosters, markets, standings, playoffs, records, contracts, coaches, agents, sponsors, injuries, media pressure, and national-team selections evolve across multiple seasons.

games.name: Wilder World: Super Early Access
games.summary: Interdimensional refugees known as the Wilders flee Our Base Reality, which has become an AI-controlled dystopia to Wiami, a digital sanctuary in Wilder World. When the authoritarian FORUM attempts to conquer Wiami, the Wilders strategize a defence.

games.name: Maneki Mania
games.summary: Pet the lucky cat, spin the charm slots and chase the golden koban jackpot. Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune shrine where you unlock lucky charms, grow your luck and watch the gold pile up. Cute on the outside, casino on the inside.

games.name: Demon With a Candy Crisis
games.summary: A quick and easy 3d platformer playing as a demon that needs to quench its thirst for candy. Travel through hell to get to the surface to find someone's secret stash of candy.

games.name: Hunter From Hell
games.summary: With your friends, form a team of paranormal experts to unravel the mysteries of the most terrifying places. Armed with sophisticated gadgets like EMF detectors, infrared cameras, and incantation books, your mission is simple: gather evidence of the beyond and survive chilling encounters.

games.name: Santa's Legacy
games.summary: Step into Santa's boots and manage the most magical workshop on Earth! Build, craft, and deliver gifts before Christmas morning in this cozy holiday management adventure. The spirit of Christmas is in your hands!

games.name: Power Racing Bundle 4
games.summary: Enjoy 4 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!

games.name: Heavy Duty
games.summary: Heavy Duty isn’t just about driving. It’s about controlling the toughest machines on Earth and leading a crew through high-stakes missions. Pick your cargo carefully, balance every load, and be ready to drop, crack, break, and try again until the job gets done.

games.name: Rest Stop
games.summary: Abandoned and alone at a highway rest stop in the middle of the Appalachian Mountains, the night breeze begins to caress your cheek. The scent of wet pine whispers that you’re home. The taste of iron in your mouth reminds you that you can’t stay here forever.

games.name: 1 AM Moscow Time
games.summary: A 2D adventure about rescuing magical creatures in Moscow and the role of a design bureau employee in this whole story.

games.name: 1! 2! 3! Battle Card!
games.summary: A simple and interesting new poker game that supports 2-4 players online battles. The key to winning is to balance risks and benefits, perform operations to maximize benefits, participate in ranking and bidding competitions, and see who is the real "head-breaking" king!

games.name: 100 Amsterdam Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️

games.name: 100 Astro Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

games.name: 100 Barcelona Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

games.name: 100 Cats Argentina
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Argentina! Can you find them all?

games.name: 100 Cats Greece
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Greece! Can you find them all?

games.name: 100 Cats Pakistan
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Pakistan! Can you find them all?

games.name: 100 Cats Philippines
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Philippines! Can you find them all?

games.name: 100 Lisbon Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

games.name: 100 Yen Exorcist
games.summary: Welcome to your part-time job cleaning up evil spirits! We picked up everything you’ll need from a 100-yen shop—more or less. Use your supplies properly, or just chuck them at the ghosts. Your call.

games.name: 10hit
games.summary: With the ability to hijack the minds of anyone who answers a phone call, "0" builds an army of remote controlled assassins to overthrow his twin brother, "1" as standing president.

games.name: 20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes
games.summary: This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes.

games.name: 3 Last Chances
games.summary: 3 Last Chances is an Action RPG game with challenging combat and progression system that allows to create your own unique playstyle. You get 3 chances to replay a year, complete quests and find just the right method of weakening and overcoming the seemingly unbeatable final boss.

games.name: 34Everlast
games.summary: This is a super-concentrated action entertainment for busy working adults. The game is an action puzzle game where your discoveries and actions unravel a complex and intertwined world of breathless action in a dying world.

games.name: 4AM
games.summary: Reclaim your life from the brink of death. Dive into a near-future dystopia where you will hide when you can, run when you have to and try to solve your way to safety in this "Inside" inspired adventure near-future dystopian

games.name: 4Below
games.summary: A co-op extraction roguelike with active ragdoll chaos. Descend into ancient underground ruins, recover priceless relics, survive the unknown, and escape with enough to meet the quota—together.

games.name: 4Mecheros
games.summary: A narrative-rhythm game I made to deal with my things 🚬, about how a predatory contract forces a fragmented band—composed of irreparable broken friendships—to get together for a final show. A coming-of-age story about reverb-punk, playing a real bass and the meaning of (not) loving forever.

games.name: 5 Star Fishy
games.summary: Explore, bite, talk, and swim to the bottom of this semi-linear aquatic metriodvania! The world isn't particularly happy with a tiny pink fishy trying to nuke them, and they may try to kill you, so stay sharp and don't bite off more than you can chew.

games.name: 500 Caliber Contractz
games.summary: 500 Caliber Contractz is a momentum-based 3D-Platformer in which you play as a contract killer hired via crowdfunding to murder CEOs, Disgraced Sinister Ex-Doctors, Private-Prison-Owning DJs, etc. With your handy high caliber sniper rifle and a chest full of anxiety, you can and will propel yourself to where you need to be. Collect tokens that float around for a reason I haven't bothered coming up with and then murder your target. Do it. Please.

games.name: 99 Fails
games.summary: 99 Fails is an impossibly difficult platformer set in Zeebo's surreal nightmare with bizarre monsters, set to music by legendary David Wise.

games.name: 999Seconds!Survivors
games.summary: Reject boring stat stacking! We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 200+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create? —Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!

games.name: [Redacted]
games.summary: You're a government officer. Documents hit your desk, you scrub out the secrets, and you hope nothing leaks. Miss a word? Maybe it's fine. Miss a few? Well, ██████████. You've got limited ink, limited time, and frankly, limited ████████████. Cheaper than a ████████████.

games.name: A Baby CEO?!
games.summary: A struggling book company has decided to hire you, a baby, to be the new CEO? All you need to do is manage the budget, keep the company brand strong and make the employees happy. You can't talk? No problem! Give a thumbs up or down and try your best.

games.name: A Game About a King Saving a Dragon
games.summary: Help a mighty dragon break a terrible curse in this incremental game. Hire workers, collect resources, construct buildings, unlock upgrades, and become a powerful king.

games.name: A Game About Opening a Chest
games.summary: Open the chest, collect legendary swords, craft powerful synergies, and amass enough gold to pay the King. Dodge the Goblin, survive the Dragon’s fire, and earn the Angel’s blessing. Can you conquer the dungeon and reach 2,000,000,000 gold coins?

games.name: A Kingdom of Soil
games.summary: A Kingdom of Soil is a pixel-art RPG set on a contested medieval frontier. Farm, hunt, and forge to survive; manage your tavern and sway allies; plot in shadows or confront rivals in the open. Every choice shapes the legend you leave behind.

games.name: A Little Less Desperation
games.summary: When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

games.name: A Mountain Called Hope
games.summary: Explore a hauntingly abandoned late 1800s mountain coal mining town afflicted by a violent winter storm.

games.name: A Passing in the Night
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a third-person adventure game in which you take a timed, one hour-long night walk. Explore a reactive and surreal neighborhood where reality bends and spirits lurk in the shadows. Converse with other lost wanderers and reclaim hope in a bleak world.

games.name: A Simple Expurriment
games.summary: A cartoony, combat-free metroidvania with puzzles, stealth and genetically modified kittens. Help a cat mom rescue her abducted children by doing typical, not-so-typical and definitely atypical cat things: run walls up and down, turn to liquid and rearrange parts of the alien ship like pieces of a puzzle.

games.name: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
games.summary: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.

games.name: A Sister's Journey
games.summary: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

games.name: A Snail's Tale
games.summary: A retro jRPG with a twist. Have you heard the one about the million dollars and the immortal snail? A Snail's Tale will let you play out the story and answer the question once and for all - can he be stopped?

games.name: A Tiny Wander
games.summary: Buu must deliver a package through a deep forest. Despite many attempts to challenge the forest, he has not succeeded. Chat with passersby, explore, and take breaks at campsites, while searching for a way to get through the forest. Let's go on a small nighttime adventure with Buu!

games.name: A Toast for the End Times
games.summary: In a blasted world teeming with undead, a barkeep and a young girl run the Time's End Tavern, a lone oasis amidst this barren wasteland. In a desolate landscape ravaged by Zombies and Raiders, that one drink they love, and a few kind words, help everyone remember why it's all worth it.

games.name: A-01's Voyage.Logs
games.summary: Humanity has perished. You are an AI incapable of self-termination, sailing into the void. Trapped in terminal wakefulness, chew on your own endless, redundant processing power and face the ultimate decay of the universe alone.

games.name: A.S.S. (Amazing Slot Survivor)
games.summary: Spin the slot machine. If luck is on your side, your power explodes. Level up fast, collect items, and build your loadout. Hunt down “Spawners” that endlessly create monsters, survive the bullet hell, and clear stages. Overwhelm enemies with insane growth driven by luck and choice.

games.name: Aberrate Inc.
games.summary: Aberrate inc. is an upcoming 3D box-and-button puzzle game where the fabric of reality bends—and breaks—at your command. Harness the power to ABERRATE, splitting batteries into two coloured copies. Manipulate phased objects to solve puzzles, unlock new areas, and discover the world of Aberrate inc.!

games.name: Abomination Ops
games.summary: A strange action-packed sci-fi visual novel with elements of horror and comedy. Brought to you by the Dynamic Solutions Megacorporation (a member of the Dynamic Holdings Group).

games.name: About Fishing
games.summary: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

games.name: Above Land: Rhapsody
games.summary: A single player or co-op action RPG roguelite set high above the clouds. Wield outrageous weapons, craft wild builds, and dive into chaotic runs where no two adventures are ever the same.

games.name: Abracademia
games.summary: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

games.name: Absolute Cinema
games.summary: Build your movie empire! Create blockbusters by combining 44 topics and 22 genres, hire star actors through auditions, develop your studio and technologies. Crazy random events, references to real stars, and tons of humor. Prove you're the best director!

games.name: Absym
games.summary: Absym is a unique rogue-souls-like that challenges you to survive between two dimensions: the decaying Nihilor and the corrupted Absymalith. Fight, explore, and use Rift Dancing to shift between worlds in real time. Every choice draws you closer to redemption... or corruption.

games.name: Abyss Delvers
games.summary: Abyss Delvers is an Online Action RPG. Adventure out alone or party up with your friends on an epic journey and fight the monstrous hordes of the Abyss. Featuring randomly generated campaigns, dungeons, items and more!

games.name: Abyss Fantasia
games.summary: The city "Cynthia" on the edge of the abyss, the "missing" girl who didn't know where she came from began to step into the abyss. Experience the complex emotional, mysterious biological environment under the Abyss. Finally face the deepest darkness of the abyss.

games.name: Abyss Lord
games.summary: What awaits the young man in the future? A long and happy life next to loved ones? Losses and suffering leading to an inglorious death? The throne of the enemy of humanity? A harem of all sorts of races, from pretty goblins to graceful vampires? The one and only love until death?

games.name: Abyss Rebel
games.summary: ABYSS REBEL is a Turn-Based Tactical RPG combining grid strategy, intense combat, and loot progression. Set sail for a frozen archipelago at the universe’s edge, lead a four-member squad on a skiff, equipping skills, relics, tackling bosses and summoning mechs to shatter encroaching darkness!

games.name: Abyssal Merge
games.summary: Merge fish to blast horrors! Abyssal Merge is a Suika-shooter roguelike where every merge scales your power. Shoot fish down to grow, and auto-fire up to survive eldritch waves. Featuring boss fights, unlockable ships, and a unique coin-shooting shop. Hold the line!

games.name: Active Matter
games.summary:
You’re an operative stuck in a time loop, always brought back from the dead to the same point.

Choose your loadout and enter quantum unstable zones rich with active matter — a substance capable of warping and ripping the very fabric of space and time.

Fight against rivals from other timelines, survive physics-breaking anomalies and try to stay alive. Harvest active matter, gather loot and extract to a safe place before the whole zone ceases to exist with everything inside it.

games.name: Ad Iterum
games.summary: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

games.name: Addie Shen
games.summary: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

games.name: Adrorium
games.summary: Build your ship, defend against drone waves and explore hundreds of sectors filled with stations, asteroids and planets with lots of POIs. The ship systems can be controlled via consoles with several hundred buttons. Craft equipment and blocks, loot the POIs and disabled drones.

games.name: Advent Arena
games.summary: A PvP card-game/tower-defense hybrid.

games.name: Adventures of Caine McDowell: The Porkian Encounter
games.summary: Tap into your space pilot intuition as you explore an alien world, fighting monsters and fleeing from a vicious bounty hunter in this retro, puzzle-based, sci-fi epic!

games.name: AE: Archeological Expedition
games.summary: Explore dig sites inspired by real locations, from Petra to Pompeii, and unearth artifacts spanning 10 historical eras. Brush away the centuries, discover the stories behind each find, and fill your journal one careful dig at a time

games.name: Aelwater
games.summary: Memory has weight. The departed are not gone. Step into a village drowned by flood and memory, and search for the final answer about guardianship and farewell among the shattered past.

games.name: Aerocube
games.summary: AEROCUBE is a Ski-Fi Roguelike + First-Person Boomer Shooter in a huge mysterious cube that always rotates randomly. Each room of AEROCUBE is different, but one thing stays the same: something’s always behind you, ready to kill.

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.

games.name: Aetherian Chronicles
games.summary: Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! Customize your character to your hearts content and choose your own way to experience your adventure!

games.name: After Hell Freezes Over
games.summary: Venture into the desolate frozen wasteland in this open-world survival horror. Struggle to survive in the cold, where strange creatures roam in the darkness. Build a shelter, collect supplies, fend off unimaginable threats, and fight for survival After Hell Freezes Over.

games.name: After the Wane
games.summary: Retracing the footsteps of a mother she never knew, Lena's trying to make it as a dancer in the city. Caught in a quarrel between dance companies, dealing with love and heartbreak and the challenges of young adulthood, she must also cope with the voice in her head commenting on everything she does.

games.name: After Work
games.summary: Welcome to SPARK, a well renounced photography company. Here you'll find love, learn about consent, and meet friends. Use your observation skills to unfold motivation and stories behind characters. Be careful. You don't want it to end badly.

games.name: Age After Age
games.summary: Age After Age. Build a thriving settlement, shape society across multiple eras, and dominate a living world economy. Choose your path — classic history, Steampunk, Gothic, and more — in a deep city-building strategy with evolving logistics, citizen classes, diplomacy, and research.

games.name: Age of Empires IV: Raiders of the North
games.summary: A New Age Rises in Age of Empires IV. Raiders of the North introduces two full civilizations, deeper Crucible systems, and more.

games.name: Age of Respair
games.summary: Age of Respair is a medieval strategy castle-builder. Build massive castles with fortifications while managing resources and production chains. Assemble a large army and lay siege to enemy castles. Lead your people and bring respair to your kingdom.

games.name: Agecraft
games.summary: Agecraft is a historical strategy and city-building game where players guide a civilization from the Stone Age to the space age. The game combines settlement building, resource management, and technological progression. Players construct cities, manage the economy, provide for their people, and expand across different eras, unlocking new buildings, production chains, and methods of transportation as history advances.

games.name: Agent Simulator
games.summary: If you are a sharpshooter, you would be a great fit for us. Within a short period of time, select 3 options from the list and deal with your enemies. Do not forget that the ability of using time efficiently and aiming your targets are crucial. Complete each mission and earn an agent certification.

games.name: Aghori
games.summary: Aghori is a psychological horror game set in the Himalayan foothills. Unravel dark rituals, cursed forests, and forgotten villages as Rudra searches for his missing friends in a narrative-rich journey through fear, mysticism, and the unknown

games.name: Agni: Village of Calamity
games.summary: Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

games.name: AI Kills All Humans
games.summary: AI Kills All Humans is a Tactical RTS game in which you play as an AI sending robots to kill all humans. You however don't have direct control of your robots, but robots independently decide how to execute your commands, like a general telling troops to attack, but troops themselves decide how.

games.name: AirBoost Airship Knight
games.summary: the blonde Airship Knight Dorota, during a battle in the ruins, accidentally discovers an amnesiac girl, Agate. This also draws the attention of sky pirates, leading to fierce battles. The game offers rich levels and exciting battles, with many companions who will fight alongside you!

games.name: Airport Control 25
games.summary: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

games.name: Airskipper
games.summary: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

games.name: Airsoft Range
games.summary: Play against AI in free play mode with difficulties ranging a walk in the park to fighting a literal aimbot or get lost in the immersive campaign going from a no one to a superstar. All in VR

games.name: Akaku Forest
games.summary: Akaku Forest is a game that blends puzzles, platforming, and thrilling boss battles in a Metroidvania-style format. You take control of Aki-Maku, a courageous forest spirit. Use your torch to solve puzzles or face off against your enemies. Save the forest!

games.name: Akasha
games.summary: Welcome to Akasha. This zen-puzzle platformer will have you questioning your every move. Discover the abilities of the Soul Sphere, solve abstract puzzles, and reunite the Lost Eidolons to reconstruct the pieces of your inner self.

games.name: Akegarasu: Journey to the Underworld
