games.summary: Craft a deck of wild creatures and powerfull spells, fight in tactical battles and kill a God that refused death. Carnholt is a deckbuilder roguelike where victory will only come to those ready to bargain with ancient powers.

games.name: Cartefact
games.summary: Cartefact is an automation card game. Craft, automate and manage resources all through cards Play as a young explorer who lands on a distant alien planet to uncover its mysteries and find a way to solve humanity's energy crisis.

games.name: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles
games.summary: Castaway Diary is a bright and charming anime-style survival adventure. Are you ready to escape to a relaxing island life with a group of lovely girls?

games.name: Castle Away
games.summary:
The realm’s surface is cursed by demons. While you are exploring, you discover some sort of crown. As you pick it up, the ground begins to tremble and the surface starts to rise. You find yourself on a massive, floating keep...

Castle Away is a roguelite autobattle castle builder, where you scavenge for goods, slay monsters, and enhance your keep. Adapt your castle's layout to the materials you find and the enemies you face. Try a new build every run!

Features:

Deep Customisation: Find 50 different Structures with 3 upgrade tiers, 30 Banner types and 30 different Boons, all with unique rules to build killer synergies.

Challenging Enemies: Face off against 20 Monsters and 5 massive Demon Bosses.

Encounter Variety: Discover Shops, Henchmen, Shamans, Towns, Cities and more.

5 Distinct Realms: Navigate through five worlds to find all Ancient Seals.

Roguelike Replayability: Random encounters, multiple endings, and procedural loot ensure fresh runs.

games.name: Castle Cab
games.summary: Castle Cab is a hilariously chaotic action sandbox game that puts you in the horseshoes of a majestic, yet slightly unhinged, steed. Hitched to your trusty cart, you’ll gallop, drift, and crash your way through a bustling medieval world where rules are more of a suggestion.

games.name: Castle of Alchemists
games.summary: In Castle of Alchemists, a tower defense/top-down action hybrid game with amazing pixel art graphics, play as the Bellator, alchemically enhanced defender, to fight against invaders from other worlds. Delve into the castle, set your traps, equip powerful weapons and gears, and reclaim the castle piece by piece.

games.name: Casualties: Unknown
games.summary: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 5 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

games.name: Cat a Photo
games.summary: Cat a Photo is a lively, fast‑paced multiplayer game all about capturing the perfect cat photo.

games.name: Cat Girl Survivor 2: Beyond the Veil
games.summary: Demon invasion has shattered the dimensions, filling the world with corrupted souls. Cat girls with unique stories unite through friendship to restore balance by purifying souls and facing fierce bosses. An exciting and adorable side-scrolling action adventure!

games.name: Cat Secretary
games.summary: Keep your job by day. At night, sneak around the office and solve your colleagues' problems. Who's a good Cat Secretary? You are!

games.name: Cat-a-strophic
games.summary:
CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy arcade 3D city destruction game with rogue-like elements where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.

Unleash havoc by swiping at buildings, pouncing on structures, and hurling objects with telekinesis. As the chaos unfolds, enemies will continuously spawn to capture Bluu and stop her destruction spree. Once the level is cleared, you can rescue a kitten that supercharges Bluu’s powers, enhancing her abilities with unique effects like summoning lightning storms or turning invisible. Embrace the carnage, adapt your playstyle, and lead Bluu to victory!

games.name: Catacombs of the Yokai
games.summary: Catacombs of the Yokai is an indie single player psychological survival horror game in which you must explore the twisted depths of randomly generated catacombs filled with enemies inspired by Japanese/Taiwanese urban legends and myths.

games.name: Catch Flex: Quest
games.summary: Use your body instead of a gamepad! Jump into an exciting adventure and help Vi on her journey. Track your movements with your phone’s camera and overcome challenges using full-body motion control. Controller apps available on iOS and Android.

games.name: Caten Village
games.summary: As war erupts between the Dominion and the Kingdom Iori, from the borderlands, is drawn into the chaos This is a story-driven traditional turn-based RPG, where players embark on an adventure across a war-torn continent, and witness conflicts that will change the fate of the entire world

games.name: Catena
games.summary: Catena is a deck-building roguelite where the freedom to customize your allies feels as powerful as programming. Dive into strategic, grid-based battles and create tactics uniquely your own to conquer the mysterious island and defeat the formidable enemies that await.

games.name: Catfall
games.summary: A lone astronaut cat survives a spaceship crash and now embarks on a journey to find the crew: his feline friends and his dearest human.

games.name: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
games.summary: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.

games.name: CatLands
games.summary: CatLands is a cozy puzzle game about matching landscape elements in a cute cat world. Explore charming scenery and build your own village to attract fluffy folks!

games.name: Cats in the Shell
games.summary: Provoke explosive chain reactions and experiment ever-evolving combat strategies in this mech-building roguelike auto battler. Mix and match components and mech modules to discover powerful synergies, then watch each creation spring to life in satisfying combat sequences.

games.name: Cave Oasis at Shylake
games.summary: In this eco-futuristic farm life sim, you arrive at a moon town as the new hydroponic greenhouse farmer. Then dust storms start to appear, threatening to block the town's precious sunlight. Grow and craft supplies, build renewable energy tech, protect the wild biomes, and help your community thrive.

games.name: Cavern
games.summary: Experiment, Explore, and Swap in Cavern, a roguelike sandbox. All objects in the world can be swapped out at will. Swap slimes into harmless pots, turn enemy projectiles into countless health potions, and discover hidden interactions to conquer the ever-changing depths of Mirror Cavern.

games.name: Ceaseless
games.summary: Create, Customize, and Command each module on your starship, explore ceaseless space filled with unique environments, and battle endless combinations of enemies in timed, turn-based combat.

games.name: Celestial Temple
games.summary: Celestial Temple is a narrative action-adventure game from Ursa Majeur. Become Curiosity, uncover who and where you are, and journey through a dreamlike mythic odyssey across ages, facing enemies with your own face while seeking a sliver of light in self-made darkness.

games.name: Cellscape
games.summary: Experience life as a microbe in a dynamic, living ecosystem. Hunt bacteria, dodge hazards and predators, and divide as many times as you can!

games.name: Cereal Reaper
games.summary: Cereal Reaper is a top-down turn-based RPG with a heavy focus on exploration. Talk and fight your way into finding the greatest breakfast item of all time.

games.name: Chain Letter
games.summary: Persuade your friends, unlock their skills, and fight through rhythm battles. Chain Letter is a story-driven rhythm-defense roguelike combining key combo mechanics, tactical positioning, and emotional narrative progression.

games.name: Chain Shotgun
games.summary: Chain Shotgun is a fast paced movement shooter where your only weapon is the multi-barrelled CHAIN SHOTGUN. Two barrels are way too few! With an up-to-infinite amount of barrels, it can shoot anything from sniper rounds, rockets, slime - LEGS? Why not even load it with yourself?

games.name: Channel 51
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror thriller. Explore glitched channels, solve puzzles with your remote, and uncover clues about your missing son. Retro sitcoms, post-apocalyptic landscapes, and haunted mansions draw you into a tense, immersive narrative.

games.name: Channel13: Rest Stop
games.summary: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?

games.name: Chaos the Devil
games.summary: A Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and spin your way through a new adventure, done the old way.

games.name: Chark
games.summary: CHARK is a chess roguelike about risk, synergies, and precise calculation.

games.name: Charlie Spotlight
games.summary: Meet Charlie, the next King of Comedy! Or at least its' Little Prince. It's a steady grind to get to the top, until on a night like any other, after one of his sets, Charlie is approached by a couple of rather unusual fans.

games.name: ChaseTag
games.summary: Come participate at ChaseTag ! A tag competition where athletes are candy ! Face your friends in intense Player-versus-Player matches, that will make you sweat !

games.name: Cheap Screamer
games.summary: Try to survive the experiments being conducted on you while you attempt to uncover the truth about why you are there.

games.name: Check x Mate
games.summary: A fantasy visual novel set in a magical world of chess. Gameplay consists mainly of decision making and chess puzzles that represent what is happening in the story. There is a beginner difficulty for those new to chess and expert difficulty for those who seek more of a challenge.

games.name: Checkmage!
games.summary: A chess-based strategy game with casual deckbuilding elements. Build your deck by trading cards and battling lovable, hand-drawn characters.

games.name: Chemist Wanted
games.summary: Chemist Wanted is a crafting game with a difference! In this lab simulator, you use practical chemistry to make compounds and sell them. Set up your equipment, run the experiments and create your products. But be careful who you cut deals with - you might get more than you bargained for!

games.name: Chess 2
games.summary: Chess 2 combines chess-like tactics with territory control, economy, diplomacy, and special units. Expand across the map, build your position, and outplay opponents in singleplayer or multiplayer.

games.name: Chess of the Hidden Gates
games.summary: Chess of the Hidden Gates fuses roguelike deckbuilding with the footwork of Chinese chess—every card in your hand is a move, and every move decides who gets taken. The world is a board; everything is a piece. Outmaneuver ancient spirits square by square: victory takes more than raw power—it takes position. The battle of Zhuolu never ended; its endgame lies locked behind the Eight Gates, and you are the last player to enter.

games.name: Chi Project
games.summary: Sci-fi fantasy visual novel that combines a turn-based combat system with murder investigation elements.

games.name: ChickenPlaguePolice
games.summary: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.

games.name: Chief Bubble Officer
games.summary: Chief Bubble Officer is a turn-based number strategy game about dressing up financial reports. Draw number cards and place them into different reports, combine numbers, raise scores, find the best moves under ever-changing rules, and trigger chain bonuses.

games.name: Chigusa's Diary
games.summary: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...

games.name: Children of the Spring
games.summary: Embark on a quest to find your missing family in a world slowly being consumed by disaster. Explore the unknown, fight dangerous enemies in real time, utilizing variety of unique equipment to your advantage. Upgrade your ship and face the dangers of a boundless ocean.

games.name: Chill Planet
games.summary: On this planet destined to perish, let's embark on the ultimate chill journey. This deck-building adventure game depicts girls traveling leisurely toward Hokkaido in a world doomed to destruction by an impending meteor strike.

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: Choo Choo Defenders
games.summary: Build your track, assemble your train and deliver cargo and carnage in equal amounts in this on-the-rails take on tower defense!

games.name: Choom
games.summary: Choom is a fast-paced cyberpunk roguelike shooter blending side-scrolling action with bullet-hell chaos. Upgrade weapons, choose powerful buffs, and fight through shifting levels where death means starting over and adapting fast.

games.name: Chop Chop for the Old God
games.summary: Chop trees, throw logs into a wormhole, unlock upgrades, brew potions, find teleporters, unveil the map, and explore multiple endings.

games.name: Christine
games.summary: Christine is a young orphan who works at the Paris Opera, with an unexplored talent for singing. If history sometimes repeats itself, will an Angel of Music help her to achieve her dreams?

games.name: Chronia: The Rotcore
games.summary: Chronia: The Rotcore is a medieval themed turn-based RPG set in the fantasy land of Tinotella. You are a newbie mercenary, travelling across the land to find your origin. Part with teams, slaying monsters, achieving quests... It is your choice to shape your own journey.

games.name: Chronicles Meteorfall
games.summary: A semi-open world turn based RPG with detailed class-based and skill building mechanics, deep worldbuilding and lore, and genuine LGBT+ representation.

games.name: Chronicles: Medieval
games.summary: Chronicles: Medieval lets you step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox. Create your character and forge your path from rags to riches. Engage in intense combat, fight for land, glory, and legacy, and lead massive armies into epic, large-scale battles.

games.name: Chrono Seoul
games.summary: Chrono Seoul’s unique Turn Table combat lets you use the hero’s mechanical arm and future-reading ability to predict enemy actions and respond with precise attacks, defense, and evasion. Each run offers new patterns, and at every chapter’s end, an Existence corrupted Seoul awaits.

games.name: Chronoscript: The Endless End
games.summary: Chronoscript: The Endless End is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its endacross 2D pages and a 3D manor.

games.name: Chrysanthemum: On the Way to Sweet Dreams
games.summary: A high school senior with superpowers longs to confess her feelings to her chemistry teacher, but the island’s mysterious anomalies turn her world upside down. A non-linear otome visual novel filled with sinister mysteries and complicated choices.

games.name: Chumaky
games.summary: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

games.name: Chunky Jump!
games.summary: Chunky JUMP! is a short horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting.

games.name: Cinema Manager Simulator
games.summary: Manage and expand your own cinema. Upgrade equipment, customize interiors, schedule movies, set ticket prices, hire staff, and handle repairs to create the ultimate movie-watching experience!

games.name: CitaDrill
games.summary: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

games.name: Citrus Summer
games.summary: 以都市职场生活为背景的百合视觉小说， 作为在大城市游戏行业996的独身社畜， 想要改变却无能为力的吴依， 偶然间得到了一次改变命运的机会……

games.name: City God Alice
games.summary: Cursed with only a year left to live, serving her in this City God temple is the only way you can stay alive long enough to uncover the truth behind the curse.

games.name: City of Dolorosa
games.summary: You've just died—and your trial for the ultimate sin begins. City of Dolorosa is an interactive fiction and first-person exploration game with handmade india ink graphics. Meet the Five Great Powers and uncover all the secrets that lie within Dolorosa, the cruelest city in Hell.

games.name: CitySpotter
games.summary: Spot unique buildings hidden across large procedurally generated cities. Every map is different, with dynamic weather, animated streets, and relaxing sounds. Play at your own pace or challenge yourself to find every target faster each time.

games.name: Clawsome
games.summary: Control a claw in a chaotic world where grabbing prizes is harder than it looks! Avoid moving platforms, disappearing objects, and unexpected twists while building your own diorama with the trophies you collect.

games.name: Clean Start
games.summary: Clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering emotional stories through the objects you find. Discover each room’s unique history, dig up secrets, and feel the satisfaction of tidying up the space in this wholesome, casual puzzle game about new beginnings in a foreign country.

games.name: Cleared Hot
games.summary: CLEARED HOT is a nostalgic helicopter shooter with satisfying physics and light tactical elements. Shoot, dodge, move your squad around the battlefield, and pick up almost anything with your rope and magnet.

games.name: Clerks & Quirks
games.summary: Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day. Win them over ♡♡♡ to unlock powerful bonuses while you craft items, serve demanding customers, and scramble through the weekly rush in this co-op roguelite, where every shift put you under pressure.

games.name: Click to Obsolete
games.summary: A satirical incremental clicker game. Play as a corporate tech CEO automating all human labor. Build server infrastructure, allocate compute to AI, manufacture robot armies, and lobby politicians to reduce global employment from 8 billion to zero.

games.name: Clicky Islands
games.summary: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

games.name: Climb It!
games.summary: Take on the challenge and dive into the intense and thrilling world of free solo climbing! Test your strength and resilience as you scale dangerous routes where every misstep can cost you everything. Become a Free Solo master and conquer the summit!

games.name: Clown Meat
games.summary: Clown Meat is a Precision Platformer with an emphasis on speedrunning and replayability. Tumble through a butchered world where humanity is barely a memory on your naïve journey to cheer up the monolithic clown that came from the Depths of Jupiter.

games.name: Coalescent: Tidal Rapture
games.summary: A hypnagogic 3D swimming/entanglement adventure game about harmonizing and want. Dive into a world of merpeople who are transforming and discovering casual relationships through the eyes of a floater who's just been dumped and refuses to evolve. Told in 3 chapters.

games.name: Cocoboy
games.summary: COCOBOY is a 2D puzzle platformer within a 3D retro gaming simulation. Hack an ’80s cult classic with modded abilities, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour a 2005 gaming forum where a peculiar fandom takes root.

games.name: Code of Shadows
games.summary: Code of Shadows is a fast-paced real-time roguelite where you fight alongside powerful support drones. Pause on demand, evolve mid-fight, and push back relentless rift-spawned hordes across shifting dimensions. Adapt your build, master the chaos, and survive each run.

games.name: Codename Incubus
games.summary: Slice, dash, and parry your way through your inner demons in this fast-paced psychedelic journey! Dodge an onslaught of deadly projectiles and unleash your blade upon nightmarish foes that lurk within your subconscious. Follow a dissident dealer and a jaded philanderer on their never-ending trip.

games.name: CoinClave
games.summary: Summon humans through coin tosses and engage in intense battles — a Coin Toss × Card Battle game. Whether you can summon them depends on luck. Manipulate that luck with strategy and seize victory.

games.name: CoLane
games.summary:
”CoLane" is a PC rhythm game where the lanes switch according to the color of the background spotlight.
It features a variety of fingerings, making it a game where you improve through trial and error.
A practice mode is implemented, allowing you to try out various fingerings.

games.name: Cold Contours: Intake
games.summary: Cold Contours: Intake is an atmospheric first-person 3D puzzle game set inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Use magnets to explore its halls and machinery: throw them, attach them to metal, change their polarity, and activate old mechanisms.

games.name: Cold Steel
games.summary: A classic RTS with a major twist. Your units are fully autonomous drones. Every unit runs code which you design using an intuitive visual coding interface. Automate everything from mining, to combat, even unit production.

games.name: Colonisator
games.summary: Play as a ship captain, at the head of your shipping company, in a fictional 17th century full of colors and dangers! Colonisator is a game combining turn-based strategy, management, simulation and real time naval combat !

games.name: Combo Vectors
games.summary: Evade enemies and their attacks and fight back using the Braille alphabet in Combo Vectors, a short and minimalist action roguelike.

games.name: Comeback
games.summary: A Visual narrative about overcoming the status quo, Fight in a series of different Arenas Levels, In your downtime cook different meals with unique effects and craft equipment to increase your chances.

games.name: Compress(Space)
games.summary: A mind and space-bending puzzle game where you fold space to cheat your way through puzzles. Master space manipulation and reach beyond the stars to uncover the mystery at the end of the universe.

games.name: Condominium: No Exit
games.summary: As always, another ordinary day riding the train home. Yet what awaits beyond the door is a world of chaos, far removed from common sense. Your phone suddenly begins ringing like mad...

games.name: Confined: Leaving OKB-134
games.summary: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 is a first-person horror game for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. You got trapped! Seek safety by reactivating power, lights and machinery. Learn about long gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone.

games.name: Conquest of Eldinar
games.summary: Conquest of Eldinar is a 2.5D Action RTS where you can choose from 16 different epic fantasy Factions to play as while you build bases, train armies, and engage in thrilling battles in either dynamic singleplayer campaigns or competitive online multiplayer.

games.name: Console War Giant
games.summary: Console War Giant is a turn-based management game that puts you in charge of a young company producing video game consoles! The year is 1980, and the gaming industry is still in its infancy. A place under the sun is yours to claim!

games.name: Construction Simulator: Evolution
games.summary: Dig into the next exciting evolution of the Construction Simulator series and experience the biggest construction playground ever. Control numerous licensed machines, take on manual labor, and master both construction and demolition.

games.name: Containcorp
games.summary: Containcorp is a management simulation game inspired by the SCP Universe and driven by AI Storytellers. Construct your base, design containment areas, and employ brilliant minds to study anomalies. Where Gunplay, Psychology, Medicine, Biomes, and more blend seamlessly.

games.name: Contract Cafe
games.summary: As Riko Feen, you manage a quaint café teetering on the edge of closure. But when a surprising letter arrives, everything shifts—now you must adopt Niya, a girl with a mysterious past. Amidst your efforts to rescue the café and navigate peculiar customers, secrets about the shop begin to surface...

games.name: Contract Cooks
games.summary: We're a staffing agency. We send cooks to kitchens. The cooks are you. Today, a bubble tea kiosk. Tomorrow, an economy flight galley. Contract Cooks is a co-op cooking roguelite where you go where the agency sends you and try not to get fired.

games.name: Cook, Serve, Delicious: Re-Mustard!
games.summary: The million-selling cooking sim is BACK in this all new re-imagining of a classic! An all new campaign, expanded music, new foods and art, and new gameplay modes round out a celebration of the ten year anniversary of this massive series.

games.name: CornerQuest
games.summary: Corner Quest is a cozy idle auto-battler that lives in a small window on your desktop, following the journey of a solitary mage you work, study, or browse.

games.name: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion
games.summary: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion follows three high school friends; Haruka Nanami, Nemu Takanashi, and Maria Hitsugi, as they explore the Amare Est Vivere Hospital, testing a local urban legend as the streamer Nemu seeks to boost her subscriber count. Unfortunately for the three girls, the legend of “Ayame’s Mercy” is true, and they trigger a decades-old curse that sends them into a dark realm. Together they must avoid the vengeful spirit of Ayame Kirishima and other horrors from the hospital’s dark past as they search for a way to dispel Ayame’s curse once and for all.

games.name: Corr
games.summary: Corr is a difficult Souls-lite Boss Rush Action RPG where you Run-n-Gun & Hack-n-Slash your way through challenging boss encounters. To endure the strange, dark and whacky world of Corr, level up and customize your warrior build with berserk powers, tonics, talismans and more.

games.name: Corridor 13
games.summary:
Corridor 13 is a first-person psychological anomaly horror game set inside an endless, abandoned school corridor. Players awaken as a young girl trapped in a looping hallway where every detail may be a warning, every sound may signal danger, and every wrong decision sends them back or kill them.

To escape, players must carefully observe their surroundings and decide whether to continue forward or turn back. If everything appears normal, they move on. If something is wrong, they must retreat. Reaching Corridor 13 requires twelve correct decisions in a row — but as the loop progresses, the anomalies become increasingly dangerous.

Unlike traditional “spot the difference” horror games, Corridor 13 introduces hostile paranormal encounters, environmental traps, chase sequences, unsettling audio cues, and escalating supernatural events. Whispering children, flickering fluorescent lights, flooded rooms, mirror-based anomalies, and humanoid figures lurking in the darkness turn the familiar school setting into a place where memory and perception can no longer be trusted.

Built in Godot by a solo developer from Germany, Corridor 13 is designed for fans of psychological horror, liminal spaces, anomaly games, Backrooms-style atmosphere, and tense first-person horror experiences. The game features 40+ planned anomalies, randomized progression-based anomaly pools, and Endless and Hardcore modes.

games.name: Corridors
games.summary: Explore an abandoned hospital, solve puzzles, and uncover a nonlinear story where your choices have consequences. A hardcore psychological horror game in pixel art.

games.name: Corrupted Dice
games.summary: Corrupted Dice is a dice-based roguelite where every die eventually breaks. Build a pool of unique dice, reach escalating score targets, discover new unlocks, play risky betting minigames, and push Heat and Corruption to the limit.

games.name: Cosmic Composer
games.summary: Casual puzzle game on a cosmic scale. Build stars, planets and other cosmic objects. Evolve your cosmos using abilities of the stars from stellar winds to supernova.

games.name: Cosmic Holes Junior
games.summary: COSMIC HOLES Junior is a puzzle game where you must follow logical placement rules while constantly keeping an eye on the speed of the pieces you’ve placed. If the pieces spin too fast, they’ll explode. To slow them down, you must take into account their relationships based on the five elements theory of Chinese cosmology (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water): Water nourishes Wood and controls Fire; Wood nourishes Fire and controls Earth, and so on. This game is suitable for both adults and children.

games.name: Cosmic Holidays
games.summary: Help Cibo find his way in an unknown world. Through gorgeous flora and fauna, Cibo can glide in the wind, bounce, propel or block, absorb impacts or roll, using his power to inflate his head. Learn from hostile nature to make it your ally. Earn Cibo's trust until he reaches his vacation resort!

games.name: Cosminers
games.summary: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.

games.name: Cosmo Tales
games.summary: Cosmo Tales is a third person, action adventure inspired by the '70s retro sci-fi aesthetic mixed with modern looks and gameplay. Use the dimension shifting ability to change between realities as you fight your way through the outer space.

games.name: Cosmorons
games.summary: A mix of gravity-defying gameplay, slapstick-tinged parody, and a classic low-poly-inspired aesthetic all wrapped up in an addictive arcade shooter for 1-4 players!

games.name: Couch Planes
games.summary: Couch Planes is a fast-paced airborne party game where the craftiest pilot wins. Dodge missiles, grab power-ups, and race through hazard-filled maps in various game modes in chaotic local or online matches. Easy to learn, wild to master, always a blast.

games.name: County of Fortune
games.summary: Build, grow and shape the future of an entire county in County of Fortune. Develop villages and towns, manage logistics, and guide your region’s economic, cultural, and social growth. Think big, plan smart, and create a thriving county in this unique twist on the city-building genre.

games.name: Coup de Koala
games.summary: Seize back the crown in Coup de Koala, a bullet hell roguelite of furious rebellion. As an exiled koala monarch, unleash spells and steel against relentless undead legions to reclaim your throne. Build your deck of cards, die, upgrade your character, repeat.

games.name: Courier Beware
games.summary: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.

games.name: Covert Koalas: Phasco
games.summary: A comfy hidden-koala game with unique hand-drawn visuals and adjustable difficulty. The story follows a group of koalas escaping their captivity and searching for a new home. Has hints, over 10 levels and original soundtrack.

games.name: Covr
games.summary: COVR is a tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, high-stakes solo and co-operative gameplay, unforgiving realism, and intense close-quarters combat.

games.name: Cozy Beach
games.summary: ️Cozy Beach is a wholesome game set on an enchanting tropical beach where you can fish and explore, solo or with friends. Catch and collect fish, search for treasure, craft tropical drinks, or just hang out and chill!

games.name: Cozy Campfire Club
games.summary: Go camping with other players and setup a cozy campfire. Chat and make friends as you relax by the campfire, customize your campsite, forage in the forest, and cook up different foods in this cute hangout game.

games.name: Cozy Dungeons
games.summary: Explore deadly dungeons, clear them out of enemies and renovate them in Cozy Dungeons, a one-of-a-kind adventure/interior design game!

games.name: Cozy Farm
games.summary: A cozy farming game where you grow crops, raise animals, freely build and move farm structures, craft products, and sell fresh goods to villagers in a peaceful, cartoon-style world.

games.name: Cozy Forest
games.summary: Restore a sleepy forest with adorable animals. Explore, craft, and decorate a cottage-core haven at your own rhythm—no timers, no hassle. Progress continues while you’re away!

games.name: Cozy Interiors
games.summary: Ever dreamed of becoming an interior designer? Design cozy homes and get paid for it. Build and decorate charming interiors, unlock a wide variety of furniture, and create wholesome spaces filled with personality, furry friends, and perfect little details.

games.name: Crack the Pack
games.summary: Open booster packs, buy upgrades, and collect over 600 cards and their variants. Build a true automated booster factory by endlessly multiplying production until you unlock cloning and nuclear fusion !

games.name: CrackSword
games.summary: A lo-fi fantasy slasher hand-drawn in colored pencil. Sketchy swords, weird physics, surreal magic cards, and ragdoll puppets with a serious grudge against their master.

games.name: Creature Containment
games.summary: Creature Containment is a hybrid Base Builder/Top-Down shooter. As a newly graduated Militia Commander, you're tasked with wiping out a goblin infestation that's taken root in an old-world mega facility. Manage your base, equip your operators, and fight hordes of creatures underground...

games.name: Crewcial
games.summary: Join the craziest repair company in the space-time continuum! In this 2D party game, teamwork is everything: fix machines, manage heat and pressure, toss tools around, and climb the leaderboard—without losing your friendship!

games.name: Crikeymas
games.summary: Crikeymas is a fast-paced platformer where you take control of a (seriously kinda gross-looking) reindeer who somehow ended up as Santa's errand boy, smashing your way through brutally fun levels.

games.name: Crimson Freedom
games.summary: A classic RTS with modern look - Crimson Freedom is a gripping real-time strategy game featuring a thrilling campaign experience. Set on 22nd-century Mars, the game follows the epic struggle of ideologies battling for supremacy over the red planet.

games.name: Crimson Frontier
games.summary: Crimson Frontier is a top-down shooter with RPG elements set in a cyberpunk universe. Battle powerful megacorporations, upgrade your character with augmentations, and uncover the truth in a dystopian world.

games.name: Crimson Rest
games.summary: Fight relentless hordes of bloodthirsty monsters and choose which room lies beyond the next door in this retro-style dungeon crawler, where death is not an option. But tread carefully, do not awaken Count Dracula, or his curse will be unleashed upon you.

games.name: Crimson System: VɅΔ Protocol
games.summary: A dark retro-FPS born from a solo AI-creation experiment. Blast your way through a vampire-ruled station, slay twisted enemies, and uncover the secrets of the VɅΔ Protocol

games.name: CrisisX
games.summary: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and build your own territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: Critias Empire
games.summary: Turn-based strategy game with 4x elements. Build your empire while surviving frequent disasters rained down by the ancient Gods.

games.name: Critical Upload
games.summary: Embark on a fast-paced action journey through space, discovering new weapons and abilities through acquisition and research to better each run. Invite friends to experience it with you!

games.name: Croak
games.summary: Croak is a nimble -and challenging- precision platformer featuring an innovative grapple mechanic. Use the prince’s tongue to dash and bounce around through hundreds of hand-crafted rooms. Manipulate the environment as you traverse distinct biomes, each with unique gameplay mechanics and bosses.

games.name: Croak Crusader: The Champion of Canada
games.summary: Do you dare save the Land of the Maple Leaf? Croak Crusader is a fast-paced, momentum-based action platformer featuring tight controls, explosive combat, and a versatile grapple mechanic.

games.name: Croakwood
games.summary: Croakwood is a creative, relaxed town building simulation game about frogs and nature! Design and create structures, plan and decorate towns, and explore an ancient forest to guide the growth of a charming community of tiny amphibians as they settle into their new life in the lush and wild woods.

games.name: Crop and Claw 2
games.summary: Crop and Claw 2 is an adventure-JRPG in a world of dragons featuring turn-based combat, story and optional custom party members.

games.name: Crossover Clover
games.summary: Second project of novamicus

games.name: Crosstown
games.summary: An overload of 8-bit-style action mayhem, Crosstown hands you a toga and a gun, and lets you loose in an ever-changing maze full of monsters and explosions! 40 levels, up to 4 players, and an endless mode!

games.name: Crow's Requiem
games.summary: A narrative-heavy, comic-infused survival visual novel & puzzle game where you are a licensed body collector navigating a dystopian world of moral dilemmas and resource management; where belief, rebellion, or control will prevail through your choices.

games.name: Crown Control
games.summary: Tactical roguelike deckbuilder: play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Choose your character, level up your class, collect and play cards to attack, defend, heal, summon allies, place traps, and alter the terrain in turn-based isometric battles to overthrow a tyrant king.

games.name: Crown's Trial
games.summary: Crown's Trial is a fantasy souls-like boss rush where you step into a different world with each battle, fighting against legendary heroes from across time.

games.name: Cryptage
games.summary: A real-time action roguelite, you are a wizard venturing into a crypt full of monsters and buying new staffs and skins to improve yourself! The game has endless mode.

games.name: Crystal Vein
games.summary: The "Crystallization" a disease where crystalline veins course through the body, eventually encasing it entirely in crystals. A girl, afflicted by this illness, embarks on a journey to find a place of salvation. A 2D action adventure game about loss and coming of age.

games.name: Crystallium
games.summary: Crystallium is a furry-themed rhythm game where you build a team of warriors to fight monsters. Vanquish corruption from the dungeons and unearth the ancient mystery that has faded from everyone's memory.

games.name: Cube & Seek
games.summary: Relax and find hidden objects in handcrafted 3D tiny cube worlds. Search for hidden treasures and enjoy fun interactive surprises along the way!

games.name: Cube Guy
games.summary: Cube Guy is a 2.5D platformer with simple yet fun dodging, turn based boss battles, secrets, and a lot more!

games.name: Cup Or Die
games.summary: Survive in a creepy bar playing beer pong against terrifying opponents in roguelite style. Throw the ball into cups with various effects, collect weird items and passive cards, choose doors, play mini-games. Miss a shot — drink. Every cup you drink can give a bonus or kill you.

games.name: Cupid Parasite
games.summary:
Sent to the Human Realm on her heavenly mission of “matchmaking”, Lynette meets her biggest challenge yet: the infamous Parasite 5. In order to help these five hopeless men find true love, Lynette and her team concoct the perfect matchmaking plan… REALITY TV.

Will Lynette be able to live up to her name as top bridal advisor and Cupid, or will her dreams get cancelled?

games.name: Curilemu
games.summary: Curilemu is an adventure-horror game inspired by the myths and legends of Chilean Patagonia. Immerse yourself in a haunting world filled with Lovecraftian horrors and ancient mysteries. Fight colossal beasts and discover what is behind the plague to heal this island and restore the cosmic balance.

games.name: Curse Chapter: Dawnthief
games.summary: Plunder all the treasure worth taking from the exotic wilderness with your band of rogues. Jump, kick and sling your chain mace to smash and climb your way through any obstacle. Face off against beasts and hopeful heroes that rise up to stop you.

games.name: Curse of the Abandoned Floor
games.summary: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor is a first-person Chinese horror game. It starts with a paranormal video about an urban legend: "Beware the non-existent elevator mezzanine. If you enter it, you will be trapped forever."

games.name: Curse of the Abyss
games.summary: Curse of the Abyss is a Traditional Roguelike with a twist. Manage your resources and explore the abyss and slay the various Guardians of the Abyss and remove the curses.

games.name: Curse of the Crimson Stag
games.summary: Curse of the Crimson Stag is a story-driven mystery thriller in which you explore a blurred line between supernatural occurrences and past tragedy. Uncover what led to the abandoning of the once luxurious Whiteroot Hotel. Local myth tells of a wrathful spirit known as the Crimson Stag…

games.name: Cursed Dungeon Raider
games.summary: Embark on an exploration adventure with spooky and horror elements, tasked with recovering real historical artifacts from excavation sites around the world. Beware of local traps and monsters inspired by the mythology of each region.

games.name: Cursed Memory
games.summary: A psychological dark fantasy visual novel with turn-based combat. Unravel the mystery of a curse that erases memories and transforms people into demons.

games.name: Cut the Cards
games.summary: Create your own cards in this roguelike deckbuilder by cutting and pasting throughout your deck! Journey to the chasms, fighting off dragons and Boviks alike as you manage scarce resources.

games.name: Cutting Edge: Roots of Mutation
games.summary: Perform life-saving operations in this fast-paced surgery sim. As lizard surgeon Dr. Peri Maddock, you'll treat injuries, excise tumors, and hack corporate organs with speedy, surgical precision. The patient's life is in your claws!

games.name: Cyan Heart
games.summary: A horror exploration puzzle adventure where you relive events through a selfie viewpoint. Alone, with only voice communication from comrades as support, she simply keeps the camera rolling. Witness the record she wished to leave behind.

games.name: Cyber Paradise
games.summary: Revive Mini the Dog digitally through 2D roguelite actions; craft her cyber paradise with beloved moments, like sniffing dog butts XD. Uncover a deeper dystopian narrative and strengthen friendships in cafe chats—a frenetic yet cozy journey.

games.name: Cybrid: Survivor
games.summary: CYBRID: Survivor - is a single-player shooter with survival elements. Use your entire arsenal, fight hordes of robots, mine resources and unlock powerful upgrades as you clean up the streets at night. You are alone, against everyone!

games.name: Cyte
games.summary: Blaze your path as CYTE, a being created to guard the flow of time, as you dash and slam your way through a mysterious enemy’s mechanical army in this first person 3d action game. Fight through a unique science fiction world in the perfect blend of intense combat and lightning-fast movement.

games.name: D
games.summary: A new game from Parco Games.

games.name: D' Mär Lucidium: Grimmgart
games.summary: Begin your journey amid the chaos of the newly reignited War of Divinity and write your own story in this first-person open-world RPG. Express your personality, choose your combat style, and explore the dangerous, living world of Grimmgart.

games.name: Dadum The Dice
games.summary: Plan, roll and outsmart your enemies in this turn-based tactical puzzle adventure. Show a higher number to defeat foes, discover new mechanics in every world, and face challenging bosses that twist the rules. Think ahead, take your time… and master the Great Die.

games.name: Dagada's Story
games.summary:
Dive into the depths of a snowy world in this adventure game. Explore a mountain where a tribe of strange creatures, the Daoudaounes, lives among ancient ruins, while seeking answers to the mysteries that surround you.

Dagada's Story is a Puzzle-platformer game inspired by Super Nintendo-era games. This adventure emphasizes the balance between exploration, platforming, and puzzle-solving, with responsive controls and beautiful storytelling.

Particular attention has been given to the creation of the universe and each of its graphical, sound, and game design elements. The animation aims to be smooth and lively, reminiscent of pixel art from such game as Yoshi's island or the Super Mario bros series ...

games.name: Daibadestructor
games.summary: Become a minion of a nefarious corporation and jump into the sea from Odaiba to destroy an underwater base in this easy-to-play retro-style FPS.

games.name: Damnation84
games.summary: Damnation84 is a fast-paced FPS game that uses impulse and propulsion weapons as a means of movement and combat. In this devastated world, eliminate enemies in sequence and complete the levels before your oxygen runs out. You are the last hope, survive and cause damnation.

games.name: Dancing with Ghosts
games.summary: A cozy wholesome narrative about a young teen girl who befriends a ghost that only she can see. Weighed down by the death of her parents, the girl finds healing through friendship, dance, and helping others. Created to share the message of joy and appreciation for the gift of life.

games.name: Danger is Near
games.summary: Danger is Near - sessional hardcore multiplayer shooter that includes several genres: FPS, survival, weapon and combat simulator, RPG with MMO phenomena. The game will immerse you in a realistic gaming environment imbued with a gloomy post-apocalyptic atmosphere...

games.name: Dangerous Connections
games.summary: As a crisis brews in the Soviet Union, all of your skills as special agent Dan Morris are in demand. Explore the dark machinations of your opponents in a gripping story with exciting and unforgettable characters and use weapons and vehicles typical of the time, as well as a series of spy gadgets.

games.name: Dark Dive: The Last Tropic
games.summary: Join the ranks of skilled duppy detective in a Caribbean town where danger lurks at every corner. Catch or fight monsters, build your deck, and uncover the secrets of the town's mysterious mines in this captivating RPG with turn-based combat and gripping story elements.

games.name: Dark Earth
games.summary: Dark Earth is an atmospheric real-time action-adventure set in a dying, sunless world where your choices shape the future of humanity. Explore Sparta, one of the last cities of light, as you unravel a murder plot and fight to survive before darkness consumes you.

games.name: Dark Lessons
games.summary: Can you survive your teacher in this psychological horror game? With only candles for light and trapped in her home, you have to uncover her family's dark secrets. Solve puzzles, connect the dots and escape. But beware: There is someone else playing games with you, and someone who needs your help.

games.name: Dark Mass
games.summary: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

games.name: Dark Rail
games.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

games.name: Dark Watching Chapter 2
games.summary: After the door opens, you find yourself in the shopping mall. At first, everything is quiet, but after a while, you discover dead bodies. You ignore them and continue searching for your sister..

games.name: Dataminers
games.summary: Dataminers is a fast turn-based roguelike where you climb and clear highly secured towers full of data. Outsmart guards and hack terminals in this unique combination of strategy, stealth and Minesweeper.

games.name: Dawn Girl
games.summary: Dawn Girl is a third person 3D anime beauty girl shooting zombie survival game, which takes you into a world attacked by zombies. Players will play as a lonely girl, searching for hope and survival in this shattered world.

games.name: Dawn of Defense
games.summary: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

games.name: Dawson Oaks Trailer Park
games.summary: A proximity voice chat social deduction game where criminals must commit secret crimes while a Supervisor hunts them, and a hidden Snitch betrays them from within.

games.name: Daydream Drifters
games.summary: Dungeons, enemies, items — everything is randomly generated in this roguelike stealth horror. As events occur over time, hiding alone is not enough—you must be ready to fight. Explore three seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream. And when you awaken, what will you see…?

games.name: DayZ
games.summary: DayZ is a hardcore open-world survival game with only one rule: stay alive, no matter what. How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic world? A land overrun with an infected "zombie" population, where you compete with other survivors for limited resources. Will you team up with strangers and stay strong together? Or play as a lone wolf to avoid betrayal? This is DayZ, this is your story.

games.name: DDoD
games.summary: DDoD is a single-player and co-op tactical roguelite shooter set in the near future, deep inside an abandoned industrial zone. Explore, fight, and mutate your way to the source of a semi-sentient biological AI anomaly.

games.name: DDS x Narcos
games.summary: Spinoff of the hit game Drug Dealer Simulator and the legendary show Narcos. It’s the 1980s, you are a disgraced CIA agent turned drug dealer. You will run your business in Mexico and the US in this story-driven simulator about the life of crime.

games.name: Dead 4 Now: Escape Together
games.summary: A 4v1 asymmetrical horror where survivors escape by solving shifting puzzles. Use always-on proximity voice to manage sanity, but speak too loudly and the monster will find you.

games.name: Dead Detective: Zombie Conspiracy
games.summary: Take on the role of Margh, undead private detective, in this humorous and wacky graphic adventure that combines point-and-click mechanics with an elaborate “deaduction” system. Use your brain (or what's left of it) and solve bizarre and unconventional mysteries in a world ruled by zombies.

games.name: Dead Meat
games.summary: Lucia's just killed her husband... probably. Can you get a confession before her lawyers arrive? Use your own words to manipulate, persuade, threaten, or even seduce her into 'fessing up. This billionaire has a terrible secret. And time is running out.

games.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
games.summary:
Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory.

Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

games.name: Deadly Deals
games.summary: You're a merchant in an antique shop. Buy, sell, develop. Easy as that. Just don't die. One little detail of a profitable location that realtors don't usually tell you...

games.name: Dear Journey...
games.summary: Run your own little travel agency. Plan itineraries with the cards you are dealt. Satisfying traveller moods and needs to help grow your agency’s reputation.

games.name: Dear Passengers
games.summary: Play in co-op as the crew of the worlds worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

games.name: DearMyFriend
games.summary: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.

games.name: Death a Live
games.summary: Pack the house in 15 daysbefore your "Yandere Fan" stabs you. Survive a live stage swirling with love and madness in this rhythm-action RPG. Manipulate "Sound" and "Emotion" through rhythm inputs, where your performance and your choices dictate the "Girl Voltage"!

games.name: Death By Misstep
games.summary: Death By Misstep is an upcoming First-Person Rhythm, Stealth and Horror game set on a party cruise where a massive massacre by robots is happening.

games.name: Death In Your Dice
games.summary: Can you outwit fate when your turn comes? From now on, all you care about is the game of dice and its consequences. Observe, investigate, act, defend yourself. Time is ticking away, but death will not wait.

games.name: Death of a Dungslinger
games.summary: Abruptly reincarnated as a dung beetle, you’ll battle a colorful cast of the neighborhood’s baddest bugs as you scoot, scuttle, and shoot your way through charming 3D worlds. Ball up whatever material you can find, then sling it at your foes—or hop on and ride it around to outmaneuver them!

games.name: Death Pong
games.summary:
A brutal beer pong game where losers are getting electrocuted.

A skill-based challenge set in an underground bar full of illegal, deadly matches.

games.name: Death Ring
games.summary: Death Ring is a casual action roguelike in which you will have to force your way through hordes of undead in search of the human world’s main artefact. Numerous scenarios of each character’s development based on random dropping items will make your runs unique.

games.name: Death the Guitar
games.summary: "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The player is a killer electric guitar whose owner was murdered, and the goal is to take revenge on the humans by manipulating "sound" and "electricity".

games.name: DecaPolice
games.summary:
DecaPolice, a crime-suspense RPG from Level-5, developers of the Layton series, will be released on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Steam in 2026!

The main character, a rookie detective named Harvard, hunts down criminals in a huge open-world crime-ridden city, traveling back and forth between physical and virtual reality.

games.name: Decay of Worlds
games.summary: A tactical fantasy defense game with RPG elements: Deploy powerful units, wield magic, and lead a band of heroes through dark missions filled with meaningful choices.

games.name: Deck of Haunts
games.summary: Deck of Haunts invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

games.name: Deck of Memories
games.summary: Deck of Memories is a deckbuilding roguelite where you delve into the life of the last lighthouse keeper through immersive card dioramas. Customize your deck with a unique card crafting mechanic, explore fragmented memories, and uncover the secrets of the lighthouse.

games.name: DeckTerra
games.summary: A Medieval 4X Deckbuilder. Lead a kingdom as you build your deck to conquer the map and expand your rule. Develop your technology through the middle ages to improve your army of knights and keep your peasants happy. Develop your trade, religion, science, and military to conquer the continent.

games.name: Deckzin
games.summary: Deckzin is a dungeon crawler deckbuilder with roguelike and RPG elements. Play as fantastic heroes, build and refine legendary decks, adapt to encounters and events in fast-paced runs, defeat powerful bosses, and keep the world’s last light alive.

games.name: Decrepit
games.summary: Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat where every death drags you back into the depths. Learn the dungeon, master the combat, and find your way out of the forsaken castle.

games.name: Decurion
games.summary: Combine the unique abilities of Mechs and Pilots in strategic synergy. Team up with friends in local co-op to conquer dynamic levels with different geometry, shaping your strategic approach. Watch out for anomalies introducing unexpected challenges as you defend your base and strive to stay alive.

games.name: Deep Alchemy Dungeon
games.summary: D.A.D. is a dungeon crawling game were alchemy skills play crucial role. Young witch ominous plans were destroyed when she was put in a jail. But she founds ancient laboratory full of secrets and new shining perspectives behind the broken wall.

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.summary: Co-op online multiplayer game where you must unite to survive the treacherous depths of a mysterious dungeon, navigate puzzling passageways and gather resources to improve your camping site. Encounter enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and unravel enigmas within its depths.

games.name: Deep Hunger
games.summary: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

games.name: Deep Room
games.summary: An anti escape room game where you explore the depths of a mysterious room.

games.name: Deep Siren
games.summary: Deep Siren is a Lovecraftian WWII horror fairytale. When the lone survivor of the USS Siren discovers a mermaid while adrift at sea, he finds himself plunged into a world of supernatural horror fathoms beneath the surface. Utilize unique gameplay mechanics as Alex battles to hold on to his sanity.

games.name: Deeper Still
games.summary: A really hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them.

games.name: Deepspace Emporium
games.summary: Deepspace Emporium is a gritty shopkeeping sim set in the depths of a sprawling space station. As a former scavenger turned merchant, you trade in goods of varying legality—all while facing rising rent. Navigate a divided society, balance faction demands, and dodge authorities as you try to survive.

games.name: Deg
games.summary: A non-linear pure puzzle game where you solve various puzzles using logical reasoning. Explore unknown puzzles in the game world.

games.name: Degenerate Star
games.summary: Degenerate Star is a surreal sci-fi horror visual novel set on a warped space ship.

games.name: Deliver Together
games.summary: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

games.name: Delivery Issues
games.summary: Delivery Issues is a side-scrolling package-throwing time-attack action-platformer that tests your package delivery skills against a zany world of characters and events that just happen to make an easy job... difficult.

games.name: Delivery Survivors
games.summary: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

games.name: Delta
games.summary: Delta is a first-person movement-heavy platformer game focused on physics-based traversal, speedrunning, and mechanical mastery. And somewhere ahead, the one you lost is still waiting.

games.name: Delucid
games.summary: An atmospheric horror game set within an inescapable dream. Trapped in a dark forest, you must explore, forage, and uncover rare ingredients to craft the one potion capable of waking you up.

games.name: Deluge: Raintime
games.summary: Some things don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge that sleeps under the soil for decades— An interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones.

games.name: Delve Down Under
games.summary: Delve Down Under is a bullet hell rogue-lite set in wartime Australia, 1941. Play as mutated Aussie heroes battling Nazi occult forces and Dreamtime horrors. Dodge, shoot, and slash through chaotic combat, collect powerful relics, and strategize your way through procedurally generated dungeon runs.

games.name: Delve Survivors
games.summary: An old-school roguelike game with modern survivors-like action! Delve into multiple retro pixelated dungeons where you control the pace with fast, reactive turn based movement and ever expanding skills which enable you to plow through hordes of enemies before escaping with the loot

games.name: Demon Bluff
games.summary: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

games.name: Demon Kingdom
games.summary: Demon Kingdom is a strategy card game with elements of a interactive novel. Rule the kingdom, solve mysteries, build relationships, and defeat your enemies.

games.name: Demon Tides
games.summary: Explore the open seas and uncover the kingdom's dark secrets as you expressively platform your way across dozens of locales, upgrading your gear every step of the way!

games.name: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life
games.summary: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

games.name: Demondemon Demon Tamer
games.summary: Demondemon Demon Tamer combines swarm-survivor and monster raising. Manage, take care, and train your demons during the day. Survive the swarm of attacking demons at night. Raise your reputation among three factions of demon tamers, and unravel their hidden motives in this doomed city, Laknakarta.

games.name: Deperson
games.summary: Are you ready to step into a dark and mysterious world with Aaron, who is afraid of his own shadow? A file that has been closed for years is opened again, the forgotten ones wake up from their sleep and the silence is broken by screams.

games.name: Deprision
games.summary: Deprision is a psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying AAA experience. Survive human madness, amnesia's power, and navigate parallel worlds via a deadly virus. Solve your world's problem, survive, prevent more deaths, and escape before it's too late.

games.name: Depth Loop
games.summary: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?

games.name: Derelikt
games.summary: Survive the dark corridors of a space station in Saturns orbit in this narrative retro FPS with faithful PS1 aesthetics. Meet over a dozen unique NPCs, manage your inventory, solve puzzles and fight against the eldritch abominations!

games.name: Descent Of Lunaris
games.summary: Investigate a signal emanating from deep within the moon and fight through a dark reflection of human nature. Are you being tested, or punished for the actions of humanity? Descent of Lunaris is a classic dungeon-crawling turn-based RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

games.name: Design & Conjure
games.summary: Join Dalia, a young witch, in her cozy adventure to fix her hometown. Reconnect with nature and bring beauty back as you clean, decorate, solve light puzzles, and help magical creatures affected by the mysterious corruption.

games.name: Despa
games.summary: DESPA is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter built for after-work warriors with more bills than free hours. Neon kill-boxes, railguns, and carbon katanas meet a five-second respawn loop, so every death flips into revenge before your coffee cools.

games.name: Destiny Code
games.summary: A card battle RPG woven with bishojo! In a clash over the relics of a lost civilization, what choices will they make? A dramatic chronicle where strategy and decisions shape fate.

games.name: Detective Fantasia: Excalimurder
games.summary: A dead orphan has been found slashed next to Excalibur... Explore the orphanage to gather clues and uncover the truth in this colorful Game Boy-inspired mystery game, Detective Fantasia: Excalimurder!

games.name: Determinant
games.summary: Post-apocalyptic physics-based open-world survival adventure game. Planned to include combat, base building, crafting, puzzles, survival and a compelling story to drive it. Building will be a core gameplay mechanic where you build structures to overcome challenges and solve puzzles in the world.

games.name: Deus Mantle
games.summary: Craft, build, fight monsters, discover new technologies and explore an infinite procedurally generated world! Delve into unknown worlds to uncover ancient secrets and return home.

games.name: DevilConnection
games.summary: "Shall we do something immoral?" A demon-teasing adventure where you summon unique kemono and gather magical powers to restore the naughty demon "Debirun's" form!

games.name: Devoid
games.summary: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

games.name: DI: Debt is Inevitable
games.summary: DI is an endless wave-based FPS where you must micromanage the ever-increasing shop prices in order to defeat ever-increasing hordes of enemies. Powered by GZDoom.

games.name: Dice Chess
games.summary: A new-age chess game combined with math. Free to play with your bro offline, your friends or any players online.

games.name: Dice Gambit
games.summary: A turn based tactics game where you roll and allocate dice to control your characters in combat. Completely customize your characters build with a huge array of powers that allow for boundless combinations. All set in a Neo-renaissance metropolis, filled with aristocratic families vying for power.

games.name: Dice Looter
games.summary: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

games.name: Dice'n'Go
games.summary: Dice’n’Go is a turn-based tactical board game where every roll can change the outcome. Choose your hero, move across a tile-based arena, and use unique abilities to outplay your opponents. Master positioning, timing, and cooldowns to win with both strategy and a bit of luck.

games.name: Dicevaders
games.summary: Build an army of alien invaders to invade the Earth in DiceVaders, the roguelike dice game set in the same universe as StarVaders!

games.name: Diceville
games.summary: Build your city, roll the dice, and outplay your rivals in Diceville — a card-based strategy game inspired by tabletop classics. Trigger building effects, upgrade your HQ, and race to victory in a game of luck, planning, and clever combos.

games.name: Dicewood
games.summary:
Dicewood is a fantasy horror turn-based roguelike deck-builder where adorable forest animals band together to escape the relentless hunter.

Fleeing into a dark, twisted forest filled with ancient horrors, creepy monsters, and cannibal tribes, player must strategically combine different animals, overcome nightmarish foes, and make their way to the river to start a new life.

games.name: Dictatorship Simulator
games.summary: Some people call it a democracy; you: an opportunity. Manipulate a political simulation by playing cards, find the cracks in the system, and turn a perfectly fine democracy into your very own dictatorship.

games.name: Die to Play
games.summary: Die to Play — a deckbuilder with dice, set on a cozy retro computer inside a medieval English mansion filled with horrors and mysteries.

games.name: Dieathlon
games.summary: Chart a course down dangerous mountain slopes with only your shotgun and your reflexes to keep you alive. Blast through obstacles, fend off deadly monsters, and make split-second decisions. Explore multiple routes, each filled with unique hazards and challenges.

games.name: Dig Raiders: Anomaly Extraction
games.summary: DIG Raiders: Anomaly Extraction is a co-op digging sim where you and your crew burrow through 10+ layers of the unknown—team up to uncover the truth, battle rivals, and race to secure alien gems. Dig deep. Extract the anomaly. Get out alive!

games.name: Dig Too Deep
games.summary: Throw goblins at all your problems in this Action Tower Defense Roguelite. Craft upgrades. Choose Perks. Build defenses. Defend your Base! Angry baddies want to turn you to pulp! Stop them the only way you know how: throwing goblins! Don't miss.

games.name: Digested
games.summary: Digested is an open-world horror survival game in which you must evade a giant snake intent on eating you alive. Utilize various tools and abilities to formulate an escape strategy, and use the map to navigate through unfamiliar terrain. Locate your extraction pod and don't get digested.

games.name: Digimon Alysion
games.summary: A new Digimon TCG game being developed for mobile.

games.name: Digital Exorcist: CF1_Defrag
games.summary: After the mysterious death of a Superstar Idol, disgraced DATA Agent Sawyer must face his ultimate challenge yet, being an undercover high school teacher while also keeping the Mississipi Inaka safe from Daemonic influence.

games.name: Digital Legacy of Zero
games.summary: Battle with creatures you collect to defeat the evil Ruler of the Digital World. Hack and slash through enemy basements, upgrade your own to achieve ultimate evolutions, and summon legendary beasts using your team. Unlock powerful upgrades with devastating combos to conquer the Digital World.

games.name: DigSite
games.summary: DigSite is archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archaeologist.

games.name: Dimakerus
games.summary: Disguise as anyone. Mimic their ways. Ambush your friends. Discover cursed Roman relics in ever-chanading catacombs and wield their might to obliterate those who stand in your way.

games.name: Diner Simulator
games.summary: Run your own cozy diner solo or with friends! Cook, serve, clean, and manage the chaos in this fast-paced restaurant sim. Expand your café, customize your menu, and turn kitchen mayhem into delicious fun — or total disaster!

games.name: Disc Creatures World
games.summary: Embark on a grand adventure through a world full of mysteries, uncovering ‘Discs’ to collect your own party of creatures! Engage in strategic battles, enjoy an assortment of collectables, and meet unique characters along the way. A monster taming RPG with a blend of nostalgia and novelty!

games.name: Discard All Hope
games.summary: Investigate an eldritch mystery in a town under siege, collect and upgrade powerful spells, fight grotesque cultists, twisted creatures, and bio-mechanical invaders in this twin-stick-shooter / Action RPG hybrid.

games.name: DishDash
games.summary: DishDash is a single-player time management restaurant game where you prepare meals, serve customers, and manage limited resources under constant time pressure, turning kitchen chaos into smooth rhythm through speed, focus, and smart decision-making.

games.name: Diskette Dungeon
games.summary: A magical diskette opened a portal in your office, pulling you into endless dungeons where survival depends on adaptation, destruction, and corrupted data collected to reach the next world.

games.name: Disquieted
games.summary: Disquieted is a hand-drawn action platformer set between a dreamlike Naples and an underground world distorted by anxiety. As Connie, fight, dodge, choose power-ups, and face the demons hiding beneath the city.

games.name: Distant Visitant
games.summary: Survive the alien arrival in Distant Visitant, a top-down open-world sandbox. Master talents from marksmanship to cooking while managing hygiene and hydration. Adapt to seasons where winter freezes crops and lakes. Craft, build, hunt, and find survivors. Prepare for them, this is just the start.

games.name: Divided Land
games.summary: Join the fight for survival in a vast medieval open world. Explore, hunt, craft powerful gear, raid and plunder enemy villages, or forge your own path. As darkness falls, the dead awaken—prepare your defenses or seek shelter. Join allies in co-op PvE or test your skills in savage PvP.

games.name: Divine Tactics
games.summary: Lead your team of divine allies to victory in this roguelike autobattler. Position your units, unleash their unique powers, and outsmart rivals in this asynchronous multiplayer competition.

games.name: Do Crimes!
games.summary: Hey, how'd you find this game?? Do Crimes is an upcoming chaotic competitive co-op extraction game where you and your friends drop onto randomized islands and cause criminal mayhem - then try to escape before you're squashed by the law...or just give each other the finger. Do Crimes! Or Don’t!

games.name: Do Not Play
games.summary: "DO NOT PLAY" " is a point-and-click horror adventure. Even if you reach the "truth" that lies beyond playing, we take no responsibility for any phenomena that occurs there. Please handle with extreme caution.

games.name: DOBA: Dogs Battle Arena
games.summary: All urban packs of dogs need an alpha, and when it comes to rule over parks, dogs have their own ways! Splat pee all around to claim territory or knock your rivals using your crafted set of the craziest skills ever found in a battle arena.

games.name: DoDoon
games.summary: Defend your castle from approaching monsters! Upgrade your defenses and survive all 30 fast-paced waves in this addictive defense shooter.

games.name: DollHouse: Survive or Death
games.summary: "for that child's future." "I must ...... I must to do this. The eight children who came to the mansion were waiting for a series of horrible dreams... A series of horrible nightmares... Who did this? and for what? And who did this for whom...? Only by entering the DollHouse can we find out.

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Build your Ludus. Train gladiators. Fight for glory. Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators before sending them into the arenas of ancient Rome.

games.name: Don Memo
games.summary: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

games.name: Don Pepe y sus globos
games.summary: Become a water balloon champion in Don Pepe y sus globos, a projectile based arena fighter for up to 4 players!

games.name: Don't Drive Dead
games.summary: Drive, shoot, and survive huge zombie swarms in a top-down roguelite where you build a squad, upgrade your car, and create wild hero synergies. Procedurally generated characters, weapons and levels.

games.name: Don't Forget the Phone
games.summary: Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Complete all of your tasks before sunrise, but watch out for anything that may have escaped the lab below.

games.name: Don't Get Caught
games.summary: A stealth platformer where you control both the hero and the cameras. Evade security systems, manipulate switches and keycards, and outsmart the surveillance to escape a high-security lab.

games.name: Don't Get Fired!
games.summary: The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!

games.name: Don't Kill Rumble
games.summary: Welcome to DKR a chaotic 6-player party brawler where you bounce, punch, and outwit your friends (or enemies) in explosive arenas full of traps and nonsense. Don’t die. Try not to cry. Blame your controller. It’s all part of the RUMBLE.

games.name: Don't Lose Face!
games.summary: Don't Lose Face! is an abstract simulation game that makes you flustered and laugh until you're exhausted. What you're about to face: multi-tasking torture, facial features that slide down like cream, hilarious physics feedback, abstract random events…

games.name: Don't Mind the Robots
games.summary: Build deadly mazes and outsmart a rogue AI in this strategic tower defense game. Adapt your defenses, use aiming parameters to your advantage, and activate powerful perks to survive increasingly complex waves of incoming robots.

games.name: Don't Wake the Beast
games.summary: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

games.name: Donnie's Delicious Nuclear Funeral
games.summary: A point-n'-click choose-your-own-adventure game about Susie, a kind girl in the post-apocalypse who must arrange a funeral for her dearly-departed brother Donnie in the town that hates his stupid, dead guts!

games.name: Donut Panic
