The wilderness doesn't care about your plans. Storms will destroy your shelter. Wildlife will compete for resources. Injuries will slow you down. Starvation, dehydration and freezing temperatures are constant threats.

games.name: Last Term, First Love
games.summary: Last Term, First Love is a dating-focused visual novel where you balance romance, academics, and wild campus life. Manage your GPA, navigate social challenges, and pursue love while facing the realities of modern campus culture and the international student experience.

games.name: Late Amusement
games.summary: Were they all just accidents, or were they? Late Amusement is a first-person survival horror from a small indie studio. You play as young student Liam Snow and survive for as long as you can to uncover the secrets of the theme park.

games.name: Late Night Duty
games.summary: A short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia. Play as a traumatized veteran on his first night as a school security guard, where routine patrols quickly reveal that something is wrong within the school.

games.name: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2
games.summary: Head to the USA and grow your own business with a realistic and relaxing lawn mowing experience! With brand new grass tech and reworked systems based on player feedback to the original, plus licensed equipment from around the world.

games.name: Laws of Nadragia
games.summary: Become a prosecutor in the totalitarian state of Nadragia. Study the laws, use the court facts to convict the guilty or unwanted by the government... Can you keep your conscience?

games.name: Layang Atma
games.summary: An isometric psychological survival horror where memories become reality. Fight terrifying manifestations, solve symbolic puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden within a fractured mind.

games.name: Lazy Jiangshi
games.summary: A visual novel about lazy jiangshi Mao and her even lazier mistress.

games.name: Lead The Dragon
games.summary: Join your crew and conquer the narrow roads of America. Explore the open world, earn respect and money by competing in street races, but breaking the law will bring you serious trouble with the police.

games.name: Leaforia
games.summary: Run your own farm, craft unique items, and battle your way to success. Pay off your debt to the city, befriend the locals, and maybe even find true love. Raise animals, train your loyal dog, and ride across the land on horseback.

games.name: Leap Galaxy
games.summary: Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!

games.name: Legacy of Ashes
games.summary: Dive into a horror adventure where you solve puzzles, explore a mysterious island, battle vicious dinosaurs, and escape terrifying chases—all while uncovering the hidden goals of Nova Corp. Secrets await at every turn.

games.name: Legends of Castile
games.summary: Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain in the 19th century. It tells the story of a village girl who must investigate the myths and legends of Castile to fulfill her dream of becoming a nun. Advance the story by solving puzzles and riddles, meeting all kinds of characters, defeating fantastic creatures with your wit, and exploring places all around Castile.

games.name: Legion Was Here
games.summary: You are Legion, a secret agent who can change his appearance at will. Use your investigative and chameleon skills to infiltrate enemy ranks!

games.name: Less Miserables
games.summary: A point-and-click parody of 'Les Miserables', set in the French Revolution

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Letterally
games.summary: Letterally is a deck-building roguelike where you craft words and your deck of letter tiles. Build powerful synergies, collect game-breaking items, and outsmart rule-bending bosses in this turn-based strategic word game.

games.name: Level Up Your Body
games.summary: LUYB - Hit objects to the beat, dodge obstacles. Enhance strength, endurance, coordination, reflexes. Elevate in a virtual world.

games.name: Lexicon
games.summary: Lexicon is a word based puzzle game wrapped inside a strange abandoned computer system. You explore forgotten terminals, sift through corrupted files, and solve linguistic challenges that twist familiar rules into something unsettling. Every puzzle reveals a fragment of a larger story that hides beneath the interface, waiting for you to notice the patterns that are not supposed to be there.

games.name: Liar's Lift
games.summary: Liar's Lift is a 3-8 player social competition. Use the elevator's emergency phone to communicate and solve challenges. Lie or play fair to earn points across multiple rounds. No one dies, but only one winner exits. In this lift, your reputation is the only thing at stake.

games.name: Life After End
games.summary: Life After End is a harsh and cruel representative of the Survival Horror genre, where you have to survive in post-apocalyptic Siberia. Be prepared for harsh climatic conditions and realistic gameplay.

games.name: Life of a Cockroach
games.summary: In Life of a Cockroach you play as a cockroach whose main priority is to survive. Explore an urban environment from a whole new perspective in this open-world 3D adventure filled with challenges, tasks, and dangers. Discover hidden places, master your skills, and become the ultimate survivor insect!

games.name: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
games.summary: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.

games.name: Light Odyssey
games.summary: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

games.name: Lightfold
games.summary: Play as a cat weaving through light and dark in this minimalist puzzle game. Push light sources and solid blocks to craft shapes from cast shadows. Plan your routes, manipulate overlapping silhouettes, and recreate specific shadow patterns to unravel tranquil puzzles in a serene geometric world.

games.name: LightSup!
games.summary: LightSup! is a couch-action co-op game for 1-4 players with rogue-lite elements where you play as adventurers encounter ferocious monsters crawling from the Eclipse Dungeons. Prepare your weapons and protect the Altar of Light at any cost, or the world will be doomed into darkness forever.

games.name: Liminal Point
games.summary: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

games.name: Liminoid
games.summary: Liminoid is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

games.name: Line Forge BlackSmith
games.summary: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

games.name: Little Crossroads
games.summary: A cozy multiplayer life sim where you build a home, explore peaceful biomes, and develop skills like fishing, mining, and bug catching—solo or with friends.

games.name: Little Lilicia
games.summary: A full-fledged farm life sim where you live as a rancher, socialize, and find love with heroines in the town of Kokotan, home of the Forest Goddess. Step into the shoes of the protagonist, Philo, who becomes a rancher by chance, and revitalize the run-down farm.

games.name: Little Monster
games.summary: Little Monster is a hand painted side scroller beat ‘em up where you play as Stormy, a monster under the bed who protects us from our nightmares. Protect the dream! Explore the realms! Rescue your friends!

games.name: Little Samson
games.summary: Leaping, smashing, scorching, and exploding its way into your collection! Little Samson—the rarest and most coveted game of the 8-bit era—arrives on modern systems for everyone to enjoy!

games.name: Little Witch in the Woods
games.summary: Little Witch in the Woods tells the story of Ellie, an apprentice witch. Explore the mystical forest, help the charming residents, and experience the daily life of the witch.

games.name: Littlelands
games.summary: The Littlelands region is brimming with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look, for a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for buried treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.

games.name: Liv
games.summary: You are accused of the disappearance of a young woman. To prove your innocence, you must solve the case. Use the computer, the victim's diary, and her videos from the last months. You can use specialized software and the police datas. Make deductions, solve puzzles and find out what happened to Liv.

games.name: Live Fire Exercise
games.summary: Inspired by classic training missions from your favourite FPS games, Live Fire Exercise is a time trial arcade shooter that challenges you to complete rounds as fast and accurately as possible.

games.name: Living Hell
games.summary: A co-op horror where you must retrieve specimens before sunrise, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations.

games.name: Lizards Must Die 2
games.summary: Lizards Must Die 2 is a cooperative slasher action game, a high–quality continuation of the SENSATIONAL first part. Insidious lizards attacked the lands of the Rus again. HYPERBOREA is on fire and only the GLORIOUS HEROES can lick the invaders from their homeland.

games.name: Llamero
games.summary: Run around herding magical llamas, gathering mountains of wool, and upgrading your skills to help a struggling wool village. A cozy, story-rich incremental game about a herder and the responsibility he carries.

games.name: Loco: Rails & Tails
games.summary: Chaotic co-op for 1-4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time. Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

games.name: Logistics Simulator: America
games.summary: Drive across the United States as a professional trucker. Deliver cargo on highways and backroads, manage your fleet, develop your warehouses, and run a realistic logistics business. Plan routes, manage fuel and time, and take on the real challenges of life behind the wheel.

games.name: Loop
games.summary: You awaken alone on a deep-sea rig. Your only companion is a decaying AI: LUMEN. In 20 minutes, everything explodes. Die. Wake. Remember. Escape this psychological horror loop—but do you really want to know the truth?

games.name: Looppip
games.summary: Looppip is a magical seed that carries an ancient hourglass with the power to turn back time. Your mission is to save the bee hives, essential for the survival of life on Earth, and reverse the environmental collapse threatening nature.

games.name: Loot And Defend
games.summary: A short, relaxing incremental game about slaughtering millions of attacking zombies. Take a load off, the end of the world doesn't have to be stressful.

games.name: Loot List
games.summary: Loot List is a thief simulator and action game about robbery. There's one difference though — here, every heist has to have a list.

games.name: Loot Profit
games.summary: Merchant Simulator. It seems simple enough — buy low, sell high. But in this world, almost everyone’s out to swindle each other...

games.name: Lootbane
games.summary: Lootbane is a roguelite RPG about risk, reward, and loot-fueled power. Explore changing regions, build synergistic warbands, push deeper into dungeons for legendary treasure, and lose it all to your insatiable greed

games.name: Lootborne
games.summary: Lootborne is a dark fantasy desktop autobattler. Build your character, loot gear, push through PvE stages, and challenge other players in async PvP duels while battle rages at the edge of your screen.

games.name: Lost Call
games.summary: Lost Call is a top down pixel art 2D Zelda inspired game with a metroidvania style map. Take off on a quest through an abandoned and ruined town to stop your phone from ringing all the time, and learn more about the characters who still remain within it.

games.name: Lost Entry
games.summary: Lost Entry is a horror game where you search the Deep Web for information while avoiding enemies that adapt to your actions. Your goal is to survive the night and complete the task your employer gives you without getting murdered by a bunch of Deep Web killers.

games.name: Lost Exit
games.summary: A psychological horror experience set in a shopping mall with an infamous history. Take on the role of a night shift security guard trapped inside a shifting nightmare of liminal spaces, deadly games, and a truth that refuses to stay buried.

games.name: Lost Ground
games.summary: 3x3 grid turn-based battle and the exquisite encounter of the rogue-lite deck building! Place multiple heroes on the 3x3 grid to strategically defeat your enemies. Customize and grow your heroes with various combinations of gears, cards, and relics. Defeat the demons to reclaim lost ground!

games.name: Lost Hellden
games.summary: Lost Hellden is a unique 3D hand-painted J-RPG from Artisan Studios, enhanced by dynamic lighting and weather effects. Follow Cyphel and his allies as a mature story unfolds. Customize your characters as you see fit and dive into a battle system that mixes action and strategy.

games.name: Lost in Art
games.summary: Explore a surreal, twisted version of real-world art gallery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure inspired by classic survival horror. Use creative thinking and a mysterious power to solve puzzles, evade a sinister threat, and uncover the secret of a cursed artwork; before it traps you for good.

games.name: Lost Isle
games.summary: Lost Isle is an open-world survival game set in a procedurally generated fantasy world. Build and protect or siege and plunder. Harvest and craft or explore and loot. Whether you decide to go it alone or forge an alliance with other players, the Lost Isle is yours to take–and lose–as you see fit.

games.name: Lost Patient
games.summary: The game is a surreal horror RPG, containing puzzles and enemy battles, it features a mix between pixel art and 3D low poly art!

games.name: Lost Skies
games.summary: Chart a course in a breathtaking, but fractured world. Explore ancient ruins, master advanced technology, and craft your very own skyship to brave nature’s fury and colossal threats in Lost Skies. Team up with friends or go it alone in this awe-inspiring cooperative survival adventure.

games.name: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
games.summary: While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive, but properly manage time, space and energy to achieve the goal.

games.name: Lounge Café
games.summary: Lounge Café is an atmospheric coffee shop simulator where you play as Sara from Lucerne, running a small café in Binoville. Choose beans, craft drinks, and compete in the city’s major coffee tournament to become the best.

games.name: Love and Demons
games.summary: Dive into the fearsome demonic world! Step into the shoes of Max, a lazy prince who will be accompanied by three odd girls. Can you find a way to get him back home?

games.name: Love WMC
games.summary: Love WMC is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

games.name: Low Battery
games.summary: A sokoban game with power restrictions. Plan your route carefully to find your way out.

games.name: Low Earth Orbit Adventures
games.summary: Low Earth Orbit Adventures is a relaxing space sim set in the near future where the space around Earth has become a frontier of science, commerce and diplomacy. Retrieve the Hubble, rescue astronauts, assemble space stations and many other missions in this realistic but friendly adventure.

games.name: Low Effort Romance
games.summary: Low Effort Romance is an otome visual novel about two tired adults who accidentally fall for each other between quarterly reports. Can you juggle deadlines, nosy coworkers, group projects, and a romance that keeps almost happening on company property?

games.name: Lull: Rest After Crying
games.summary: A horror action-adventure in which a young girl carrying a baby on her back attempts to escape a mysterious facility twisted by endless renovations.

games.name: Lunr.Rdio.Taxi
games.summary: lunr.rdio.taxi blends drifting and rhythm into an exhilarating spacetime 'Drifthm' adventure! Slide and boost your way through the solar system to the beat of Brazil's best DJs and earn big as an interplanetary taxi pilot trying to pay an infinite debt in this hypercapitalistic BrazaFunk future.

games.name: Lurkers
games.summary: Lurkers is a chaotic 2D multiplayer sandbox where you can build, battle, and survive! Fight zombies, conquer game modes like Bedwars, and unleash your creativity in a world that’s yours to shape and destroy.

games.name: Lurking
games.summary: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

games.name: Lydia Was Here
games.summary: A horror RPG about how not to handle grief, identity, and the delusions of bringing someone back.

games.name: Lóng Shén de Xīnniáng Wàizhuàn: Yù Líng Qǐ Tán
games.summary: A Japanese-style fantasy x fairy-tale narrative adventure ADV, telling the story of an unnamed god and a wandering miko…

games.name: Machine of the Wasteland
games.summary: High-octane vehicular combat action game set in a chaotic, post-apocalyptic world where survival hinges on your ability to outmaneuver and outgun your enemies.

games.name: Mad Chess
games.summary: Mermaids, Angels and Dragons join the classic game of Chess as 3 additional factions with their own units and abilities. Madness? No, this is Mad Chess!

games.name: Mad Mojo
games.summary:
Think Inscryption meets Pokémon.
Mad MOJO is an action-packed monster-catching deckbuilder with a hidden layer of fourth-wall-breaking psychological horror. Hunt for the legendary Prime MOJO using poker-inspired hands, real-time parries, and game-breaking elemental Tokens. But beware of the MOJO hiding just beyond your reach...

games.name: MadHouse for Toys
games.summary: Madhouse for Toys is a top-down horror game where an AI-powered plush rabbit tries to escape from a toy asylum. Solve puzzles, hide, or fight against insane toys. The unique 3D horror style and the unusual world make the game unlike anything else.

games.name: Magic Scavenger
games.summary: 《Magic Scavenger》 is a light Rogue-like spell-building looting and extraction game. To earn money, you embark on an adventure—scavenging valuable items, crafting your spells, and fending off waves of enemies before extracting with your haul. How much treasure can you escape with?

games.name: Magical Girl Critical Deluxe
games.summary: "If magic doesn't work,then you beat with stick!" Action game in which a magical girl is transferred to another world and struggles

games.name: Magical Girl ER
games.summary: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

games.name: Magical Girl: Taboo Village
games.summary: The girls awaken in a mysterious village cursed by flowers. Every night at 8 PM, one girl is chosen as a sacrifice to the Kamibana—and hanged. Unravel the village’s tangled mysteries and sever the ritual’s endless cycle. A magical girl × folk-horror suspense visual novel from Acacia.

games.name: Magical Girl: Taboo Village
games.summary: The girls awaken in a mysterious village cursed by flowers. Every night at 8 PM, one girl is chosen as a sacrifice to the Kamibana—and hanged. Unravel the village’s tangled mysteries and sever the ritual’s endless cycle. A magical girl × folk-horror suspense visual novel from Acacia.

games.name: Magnavis
games.summary: A co-op horror game. Pilot your submarine through tight caves without crashing, complete assigned missions, repair damaged systems—and whatever you do, don’t die.

games.name: Magnetic Bonds
games.summary: Magnetic Bonds is a fusion of the visual novel and turn-based RPG genres inspired by shonen manga where players explore a vast galaxy, befriending characters and building relationships as they progress through the story and take down enemies and bosses.

games.name: Make Your Move
games.summary: Make your Move is a roguelike game where you control the map like a rubik's cube. Create combinations to improve your stats, discover new cubes, get equipment, and battle for resources to protect your world from the void.

games.name: Malleus Maleficarum
games.summary: A Metroidvania inspired by the mechanics and style of classic games in the genre. Help Mirabel find different ways to explore a haunted mansion and hunt terrifying witches while gaining new weapons and discovering more about the macabre experiments carried out by demonic beings.

games.name: Malvinas: La Ultima Carta
games.summary: The last survivor of a battalion (a teenage soldier) must protect the last letter of his fallen comrades. Undergo the hunger, cold and violence the Argentinean soldiers had to endure during the war on the islands.

games.name: Mana Quest
games.summary: What can you do when you've been isekai'd by mistake and you're just a regular guy? You become an entrepreneur! Take over a shop and get rich while building up your harem of monster girls in this comfy +18 hentai RPG!

games.name: Manaftory
games.summary: Collect resources, build machines, and automate everything. Explore magical lands, face hostile creatures, and turn their loot into part of your factory system. This is your Manaftory — a magical factory powered by mana.

games.name: Manifesto
games.summary:
Manifesto is a new management sim about burnout, layoffs, and making shitloads of money.

You’ve climbed the ranks, left countless competitors in your wake, and proven you have what it takes to survive in this cut-throat business. With this latest venture, you’ll have to put any human feelings you’ve ever experienced aside, and attempt to satisfy shareholders who can never truly be satisfied.

games.name: Manipulus
games.summary:
Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times.

As a Manipuli general, form strategic defensive lines and manoeuvre your followers to activate wild abilities to defeat the oncoming monsters and lead your band to safety. Re-play your cards, re-live your actions, and fight to keep your refugees alive in this dark and captivating adventure.

It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!

games.name: Mannequin Mayhem: Physics Ragdoll Shooter
games.summary: Get ready for a wild ride in "Mannequin Mayhem," the craziest shooter this year! Say goodbye to zombies and aliens; it's time to blast creepy mannequins. Survive endless waves, customize your arsenal, and embrace the chaos. Let's laugh and blast our way through the weirdest enemies ever!

games.name: Marble Run Maker
games.summary: Build marble runs in a room with realistic physics. Stack random objects to make a wobbly track and watch the ball roll down! Explore puzzles with unlimited solutions and cozy vibes.

games.name: Marble Souls
games.summary: Prepare to roll through the dense, interconnected world of MARBLE SOULS. Collect lost souls and level up your marble in the new genre-defying game from the creators of Mosa Lina & FALLSTRUKTUR.

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.summary: Mariachi Legends is an action-packed mystery Metroidvania game. In Mariachi Legends, Join fantastical festivities at the Day of the Dead carnival alongside Detective Pablo Cruz, currently masquerading as a mariachi player to investigate an evil curse looming over the serene town of Santa Mascota.

games.name: Mark My Words
games.summary: The word-building roguelike. 'Mark My Words' is an addictive deckbuilder where you assemble high-scoring words, discover fancy Stickers, and utilize Glyphs to unleash intriguing combinations. Master the Art of Wordplay in several different Game modes!

games.name: Market Manager Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

games.name: Marque & Reprisal
games.summary: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

games.name: Mars Colony Simulator
games.summary: Build humanity's first home on Mars. Mine resources in first person, construct life-sustaining domes, grow lush vegetation, and launch rockets to reconnect with Earth in this immersive colony-building simulator.

games.name: Mars Tactics
games.summary: Classic turn-based tactical combat with some modern twists. Use stress to manage RNG. Master advanced suppression mechanics. Grow troops who develop abilities, personalities & relationships based on what happens in battle. Procedural, destructible maps. Realistic bullet physics.

games.name: MarsCity3026
games.summary: 1000 years in the future, Mars colonies are now full cities. Play as a robot that solves grappling hook puzzles and flying car puzzles. Humans went into cryo-sleep to escape disaster. Each puzzle gradually brings the terra-forming machines back online so that the humans can wake from cryo-sleep.

games.name: Martyr
games.summary: Rise as a martyr in a plague-scarred, heretical Europe. Surrounded by disease, paganism, and relentless foes, you will fall, return as a Shade, and forge power from sacrifice. Death is not the end. Every fall strengthens you, every relic will help you, but enemies will hunt you for your faith.

games.name: Masackra
games.summary: A tactical game with grid-based combat, classes, and synergies. Assemble your squad, strengthen it through events, and make decisions that determine the outcome of each battle.

games.name: MassEve
games.summary: The quantum world is on the edge of revolution, and only neutrinos can shift its fate. Mass-Eve is a fast-paced roguelike twin-stick shooter diving deep into the mysteries of modern physics. The future of the universe depends on your choices, are you ready to reshape it?

games.name: Master of Chaos
games.summary: Pulverize your enemies for underestimating this cute little wizard by counter attacks, deflecting projectiles, unleashing face-melting ultimate abilities and building insane combos boosting your power until you are strong enough to beat the boss or break the game - Either way you win.

games.name: Match In Peace
games.summary: In this terrifying, genre-busting strategy game, find and match monster pairs to unleash their terror on your enemies. Battle in PvP, conquer the Tower and Roguelike modes and find alchemy components to craft new powerful monsters. Can you keep your calm under pressure and Match In Peace?

games.name: Match Tree
games.summary:
Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game).
Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep.
Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

games.name: Math Is Hard
games.summary: math is hard! or is it? Push, calculate and solve your way through challenging Sokoban-style puzzles. Strategically manipulate numbered blocks and operators to reach the target value and clear the level. Are you up for the challenge?

games.name: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense
games.summary: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense is a real-time tactical tower defense game. As Princess Lua, defend the demon realm against the hero alliance. Build unique towers, manage unit morale, and use tactical pauses to repel invasions. Your strategy decides the demon realm's fate.

games.name: Maximum Thunderness
games.summary: An extreme response to minor problems. MAXIMUM THUNDERNESS is a roguelike sidescrolling co-op action game where you fight a space alien criminal invasion with different skills and abilities.

games.name: Mayhem Brawler II: Best of Both Worlds
games.summary: A perfect fuse of '90s arcade vibe and modern rogue-lite / RPG mechanics in a time transition-themed beat 'em up. Play solo or online with friends and shape the story through your choices. Be amazed by the hand-drawn comics-inspired art, frame-by-frame animated characters, and kick-ass soundtracks.

games.name: Meaningless Random Numbers
games.summary: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning cash through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching.

games.name: Mearcair/System Pulse
games.summary: Dive into System Pulse, a rhythm-fueled roguelike bullet heaven where you must outmaneuver swarms of robots moving while attacking to the beat. Unleash your reflexes, survive rhythmic encounters, and master the symphony of chaos in this electrifying action game.

games.name: Meat-Grinder
games.summary: Live the life of Obi, a female killer with questionable morals and a good sense of humor! Witness a real human meat grinder performed by her and meet many unique characters on her way!

games.name: Mech Log Zero
games.summary: Take control of a mechanized pilot and its Mech. Blast through Colossal Machines and secure the last remnants of life inside a dying God.

games.name: Mecha Simultactics
games.summary: Mecha Simultactics is a simultaneous-turn-based competitive tactics game with customizable mechs, isometric battlefields, destructible terrain, anime-inspired battle replays, and online PvP.

games.name: Mechborn
games.summary: Protect Earth and her colonies in a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by ’90s mech anime and Greek mythology. In MECHBORN - YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK - Unlock mech parts and pilots, craft custom decks and unleash devastating combos as you fight to repel the Kaiju incursions!

games.name: Mechs and Muskets
games.summary: Mechs and Muskets is a 2D isometric tactical RPG set in an alternate Napoleonic era where mechs rule the battlefield. Customize your squad with unique mech parts and abilities, and lead them through turn-based strategic combat in a story-driven campaign

games.name: Meeple Incremental
games.summary: Roll dice to move Meeples around the board and collect money, skill points, and capsule tickets. Unlock unique skills and minigames, powerful collectibles, and automate dice rolls to increase your income.

games.name: Mega Man: Starburst
games.summary: A new adventure starring Mega Man!

games.name: Megapain
games.summary: A dynamic retro shooter with intense arena battles and co-op mode! Gear up with pistols, assault rifles, and rocket launchers to annihilate hordes of mutants solo or with friends. Every arena is a new challenge, every firefight is pure action! Inspired by the FPS shooter legends of the '90s-'00s.

games.name: Melt Away
games.summary: People end up forgetting about the dead.

games.name: Melted Time
games.summary: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

games.name: Memento*Fragment
games.summary:
Memento*Fragment is a visual novel in which [You], the protagonist, recover your memories by viewing memory fragments.
The first contains the past of a girl, traveling alone through a world on the brink of destruction.
Continue watching to learn about her past, your relationship with her, and rediscover your identity.
Don't look away, no matter how tragic the answer may be.

games.name: Memory Adventures in the Jungle
games.summary: Affordable price ! A hommage to the oldschool games, but delivered with a modern and cute look. If you are a fan of 1980's or 1990's, or just searching for an interesting game to play - here is your place !

games.name: Memoware
games.summary: Memoware! A small adventure, exploration and puzzle videogame.

games.name: Menhera Maiden
games.summary: A ‘Landmine × Yuri' Visual Novel. To complete your master's thesis, you are forced to interact with these landmine girls—a decision that may well prove to be the most disastrous of your life. Your dialogue and choices will not only shape your relationships with the heroines, but also your thesis.

games.name: Meowmentum
games.summary: Run, young Meowcolyte - finish the elders' speed trials and prove yourself worthy of wielding Meowmentum! Harness your paw-kour skills, dash through magic orbs, and race against the world!

games.name: Meowniverse
games.summary: Merge endless cats on your desktop! Every cat you adopt becomes a unique part in your Collection. Evolve your cats, complete the Collection, and enjoy their company. They’ll embark on adventures, bringing you coins and fish! Get ready to huff cats and let their sweet meows lift your spirits!

games.name: MeowPower!Yachiyo
games.summary: A casual side-scrolling beat em up where you play as a catgirl and join forces with cats to defeat enemies.

games.name: Mercy Incore
games.summary: Solo indie hack-and-slash. You are a medieval knight with jet booster and transforming sword. Fight your way through a techno-void. Leech enemies’ lives to survive. Escape — or become a techno-vampire.

games.name: Meritaton
games.summary: A 2D adventure story about the daughter of a pharaoh who tries to change her predetermined destiny in the dark and mysterious Ancient Egypt.

games.name: Mess
games.summary: MESS is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment. Experience yourself in a role of Warden to maintain order, or Prisoner to try to break free and escape the prison.

games.name: Metal Coffin
games.summary: War has been raging for decades with no signs of it stopping. Take your chance in bringing an end to it in this high focus strategy game. Manage your troops, your supplies and protect your flagship at all costs and you might just be able make it to the capital of the nation.

games.name: Meteora
games.summary: Be a meteor in a constant race for survival in a young and chaotic universe by dodging, chasing & taking down other meteors in Meteora. Power up, strategize and put your skills to the test in our spectacular arcade combat racer!

games.name: Metro Rivals: New York
games.summary: Reputation is paramount; strategy is key, and all-out speed can make or break everything. Welcome to Metro Rivals—a genre-defying subway simcade game where you battle Track Titans in solo play or clash with friends in fierce PvP.

games.name: Micro RPG
games.summary: Monsters have invaded the kingdom, taking advantage of the knights' annual holiday! You are the last hope! Equip yourself with weapons and fight the monsters surrounding you in this turn-based game with your spinning attacks across a dozen fantasy worlds!

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
games.summary: Pursue your dream of an aviation career with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. This brand-new simulator is designed to take advantage of the latest technologies in simulation, cloud, machine learning, graphics and gaming to create the most sophisticated, immersive and awe-inspiring flight simulator of all time. To achieve this unprecedented level of accuracy, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is powered by the significantly evolved Asobo Studio engine.

games.name: Microvania
games.summary: Explore a tiny world, find upgrades, discover hidden paths, and battle bosses in this retro-style metroidvania action platformer.

games.name: Midnight Laundry
games.summary: Midnight Laundry is a short first-person horror game where a long night at the laundromat takes an unexpected turn.

games.name: Midnight Scour
games.summary: Escape a rural nightmare in this atmospheric first-person horror game. You are hunted by a cunning killer. He lives, sleeps, and actively hunts based on your actions . Use stealth to navigate the house, solve puzzles, and complete one of the exits.

games.name: Milki Delivery
games.summary: Grab your bike and milk bottles, let's hit the road! Explore the countryside in this short cozy delivery adventure. Befriend folks and gently help them rebuild their community, one bottle at a time. Upgrade your bike, your dairy farm, and venture deeper into a once-lively region.

games.name: Mimic
games.summary: A multiplayer survival horror game where players must choose their allies carefully to survive imminent danger. In this social-deduction game players won't know who to trust with their lives.

games.name: Mingle
games.summary: Find your perfect match in the crowd. Match and merge minglers. Repeat until they're all joined together. 50 unique playable characters.

games.name: Mini Worlds
games.summary: Mini Worlds is a cozy building game about creating tiny cities on a small world.

games.name: Miniature Land: Four Seasons
games.summary: An escape room game made by hand-building and photographing miniature scenes. Explore a miniature world in live-action and enjoy feeling like you're really there.

games.name: Minute Man
games.summary: Minute Man is a 2D beat 'em up platformer game where you can freeze time as you're fighting enemies to secure an advantage. Fight through various waves of enemies and defeat bosses in several levels, keeping time frozen as you chain combos against your enemies!

games.name: MioAquaria
games.summary: Build and manage a cozy underwater sandbox aquarium run by cats. Discover fantasy sea creatures, research upgrades, send expeditions, and balance fish, staff, and visitor needs to become the world’s top aquarium.

games.name: Mira and the Legend of the Djinns
games.summary: An epic 2D pixel art style Metroidvania, inspired by Moroccan culture and spiritual traditions. Wield powerful ancient weapons and forge your way through unrelenting deserts, crumbling necropoli, floating islands and dangerous mountains as you try to uncover the secret of the last Djinn.

games.name: Mira: Shadow of the Past
games.summary: Travel. Go back. Erase your regrets.

games.name: Mirai #167
games.summary: MIRAI #167 is a 2D pixel-art runner where you control two characters at once, rewinding time and jumping through portals. Embark on a frantic adventure to save humanity in a world where AI surpasses human control - upgrade your characters, break records and rewrite history before it’s too late!

games.name: Mirealle
games.summary: A world has split into thousands of floating islands. A forgotten history is hidden in ruins. Mirealle is a touching puzzle adventure set in a cozy universe. It is about the search for hope where a lost part of the world… and of oneself… are hidden in every detail.

games.name: Misplaced
games.summary: Misplaced is an archive-sorting and one-stroke deduction game. Draw files from a shuffled archive, sort them into folder nodes on the board, then match each file to its sub-node. When every file is correctly archived, solve the one-stroke puzzle to link the clues and restore the truth.

games.name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
games.summary: A light-hearted lesbian romance between a tired office lady and a gyaru foxgirl. Make choices as Sasami and pursue a relationship with the cheerful Mirai, or risk ruining it.

games.name: Missi
games.summary: Missi is a cozy point & click game in a watercolor hand-drawn world. Find hidden objects and solve puzzles using clues in sketches of past adventures. Try to trick the Mushroom Spider and the Crow King by collecting all medicinal herbs for the sick little mouse.

games.name: Mistwilds
games.summary: Mistwilds is a vibrant online adventure where you collect, evolve, and battle magical creatures. Explore a vast world, unlock new zones, and join forces with friends to tame wild beasts, take on quests, trade rare loot, and conquer challenging dungeons.

games.name: Misty Garden
games.summary: Create a peaceful garden. Build a soothing retreat and help the wandering creatures unwind from chaotic lives. Misty Garden is a calm and relaxing base building providing laid-back experience interacting with the creatures living in the Misty forest.

games.name: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale
games.summary: Welcome to Misty Valley, cast your line, sail to hidden islands, and uncover secrets of the sea. Befriend charming villagers, tend your farm, and explore a world full of wonder, mystery, and gentle adventure. Your story begins where the mist meets the tide.

games.name: Mitch
games.summary: Mitch just landed! Will you help her begin her new life?

games.name: Mizuki and the Crimson Moon
games.summary: Journey through a yokai-filled Japan in this 2D Action Platformer! Control Mizuki, a carefree and playful kitsune, as she investigates evil events happening around her village. Use her signature ability of teleportation to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies in this unique platformer adventure.

games.name: MLF: Pro Catch
games.summary:
The official Major League Fishing game, a fishing sim you can play solo or online with friends. Cast, troll, and feel every fish fight back as you control the drag, manage line tension, and read each run and dive to land your catch. Reel in over 50 species, from Largemouth bass and Rainbow trout to Muskellunge, Alligator gar, and sharks, each with its own model, habitat, and behavior.

Explore six diverse waters, including Shadow Lake, the Everglades, the Florida Keys, and Lake Whitney, all with a full day-night cycle and shifting weather. Fish from shore, docks, or boat, and gear up with tackle from real brands like Mossy Oak, YETI, Abu Garcia, and Berkley. Compete in tournaments, climb the leaderboards, and chase your personal-best trophies.

games.name: Moki: The Escape
games.summary: Moki wakes up in a strange environment. The only memory: the own name. A peaceful world... or is it?! Join Moki in a challenging 2.5D jump & run platformer with many puzzles. Meet lovable and sometimes oddball characters and experience a occasionally emotional story.

games.name: Momolitos
games.summary: Explore vibrant zones, collect ingredients, and feed adorable Momolitos to help them evolve into hundreds of unique forms. A cozy creature-collecting adventure that blends exploration, discovery, and the joy of caring for your own lab full of curious life.

games.name: Mondrayn
games.summary: Mondrayn is a challenging JRPG game with a dark fantasy atmosphere in a surreal dystopian world where you have to survive and become stronger. Find a variety of artifacts, create equipment, and explore locations filled with danger and mystery.

games.name: Monolith's Dreamers
games.summary: A captivating 2D puzzle game where strategic thinking is essential. Explore the world of the Monoliths, outwit the traps guarding the ruins, and help the inhabitants. Solve puzzles that block your progress by collecting and redistributing energy.

games.name: Monolith: Dark Matter
games.summary: A round-based FPS for 1–4 players set inside the Monolith — a brutalist complex shaped by living black matter. Fight escalating waves of its marionettes, earn points to unlock new sectors and build your arsenal, and uncover the route to a final encounter.

games.name: Monomoon
games.summary: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

games.name: Mononoke no Kuni
games.summary: Through free village building and boat trips, this 3D open-world action game adds the fun of discovering and exploring unknown islands, as well as the tension and strategy of roguelite dungeon crawling!

games.name: Monster Alchemy
games.summary:
Monster Alchemy is a Monster Collector RPG where instead of catching monsters, you create them using alchemy.
Create unique creatures, use them to gather rare resources, and fuse them into even more powerful beings! This RPG combines classic exploration with a deep crafting system where your monsters are your ultimate tool for looting, combat, and discovery.

games.name: Monster Hatcher
games.summary: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

games.name: Monster Nursery
games.summary: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 10 Lo-fi tracks.

games.name: Moomin Midsummer Madness
games.summary: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

games.name: Moon Princess
games.summary: A daughter-raising game in a world of wuxia and mythology — raise her as a martial arts master in a rich wuxia world. Train, fight, manage, and shape her future! With 50+ branching endings and 60+ story characters, forge your one-of-a-kind heroine and change the fate of the Jianghu!

games.name: Moonbrella
games.summary: A 2D Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.

games.name: Moonbringer
games.summary: Moonbringer is a fast-paced action shmup with a skill tree. Kill the waves, stack the loot and upgrade your ship. Unlock a variety of new abilities and become more powerful every run. Shoot, die, upgrade, and dive into space one more time.

games.name: Moonlight Cradle
games.summary: This is a traditional simulation management and raising game with multiple endings featuring beautiful girls.

games.name: Moonshire
games.summary: Embark on a journey to save Moonshire as you navigate through a mysterious world filled with dungeons, weapons, upgrades, and fast-paced combat!

games.name: Moonwakers
games.summary:
Dive into a survival roguelite by taking control of a S.E.E.D, an advanced reconnaissance android! To accomplish your mission, explore exoplanets to determine if they are suitable for humanity.

Thus, you'll need to search for vital elements necessary for life: Carbon, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, Oxygen, Phosphorus, and Sulfur. But beware, danger lurks on this unknown land, and your survival will depend on your ingenuity and skills. Traps abound, and you'll need to strategize to make it through.

Regularly, you'll have to shelter your character to escape ionic storms. Exploration will allow you to acquire new skills and enjoy more autonomy, speed, and gliding. Your biggest challenge? Managing your energy to avoid extinction.

games.name: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed
games.summary: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed is a goofy 3D puzzle-platformer where your greatest asset is your backside. Solve lateral thinking puzzles to complete your Civic Disturbance Duty.

games.name: Moorage
games.summary: Moorage is a fishing roguelite where you must travel the ocean to find a way off a desolate island. Meet people stranded like you, level up each time you fail, and catch a bunch of fish!

games.name: Mooshie's Kitchen: Reheated
games.summary: Mooshie's Kitchen was once a place of fun and joy for decades until it shut down in 2023. Since then, it's been surrounded in rumor and mystery. What could have happened on the day of Mooshie's Kitchen's closure?

games.name: Mop'n Spark
games.summary: "MOP'N SPARK" is a 2D puzzle platformer where a street cleaner and an electrician—an unlikely duo—team up to tackle challenging stages.

games.name: Morbid Mailroom
games.summary: In a claymation prison for occult offenders, you are the package inspector. Search packages for hidden contraband, coded letters, and cursed objects. Balance duty, compassion, and survival as you decide what reaches the inmates and what burns in the incinerator. Your choices cannot be undone.

games.name: Mortal Quest
games.summary: A survival-adventure game about a mortal who's been transferred to a demon-infested island.

games.name: Motion Wulin
games.summary: "Motion Wulin" is a fast-paced martial arts action game where you play as a time-traveling warrior fixing broken timelines.

games.name: Mount Noire
games.summary: Get cash, get meds, get home. Survival horror set in a forgotten ski resort.

games.name: Mowit: Grass Cutting Simulator
games.summary: Mowing lawns has never been this much fun! Relax with your friends in online co-op, upgrade your equipment, shape beautiful gardens, and enjoy the experience. Join the fun with 1-4 player co-op!

games.name: Mr. "Bargain Expert"
games.summary: Play as an antique shop owner in this incremental idle management game. Buy low and sell high, appraise and acquire valuable antiques, hire employees to automate the business, expand into new branches, build your own antique empire, and collect rare treasures.

games.name: Mr. Grin's Final Act
games.summary:
Thirty years ago, a tragedy silenced the studio.
Now you're back... and so is Mr. Grin.
In this first-person survival horror, scavenge badges, rewire circuits, crack safes.
Stay out of sight. One sound and you die.
He's not hunting you. He's directing you.
His script. Your survival.

games.name: Mudang: Two Hearts
games.summary: MUDANG: Two Hearts is a narrative-driven, third-person action adventure that blends tactical stealth, visceral combat, and cinematic storytelling set on a politically volatile Korean peninsula.

games.name: Multi Idle
games.summary: Multi Idle is an idle game that features Exploring, Adventuring, Hero's, Dungeons, Raids and many more in its own kind of idling way. Get stuck in an endless loop of trying new things every time you play!

games.name: Murazu 2
games.summary: Fast-paced precision platformer where you help Murazu, a factory android girl, escape a long abandoned facility. Dash through obstacles, launch yourself like a rocket, optimize your movement and route, and reach the finish as quickly as you can!

games.name: Murder Meet Cute
games.summary: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

games.name: Murder on the Stella
games.summary: It's a murder mystery. It's an adventure. It's a cruise vacation simulator. It's different each time you play.

games.name: Murderplanet
games.summary: Fight to the death in the arena-based action roguelike game show, Murderplanet. Craft a build of ridiculous and broken synergies to weave and cleave through hordes of enemies. Survive each wave, stake out Capture Points, earn heaps of cash and further customize your runs for maximum arcade chaos.

games.name: Murino: The Fog Is Coming
games.summary:
Murino: The Fog Is Coming is an atmospheric first-person horror game about the life of a courier in the endless district of Murino, where apartment blocks disappear into the fog, familiar routes stop being reliable, and an ordinary delivery job slowly turns into a fight for survival.

The player lives in one of Murino’s apartments, in Building P-352, and works as a courier. Each day begins as routine - accept an order, leave the apartment, pass through entrances, courtyards, and service corridors, reach the destination, and return home. But in Murino, even the simplest job quickly becomes dangerous. The buildings seem to stretch on forever, the courtyards all look the same, and the Fog and the Samosbor make every familiar path less and less safe.

games.name: Mushrooms vs Engineers
games.summary: Mushrooms vs Engineers is a top-down bullet heaven/hell where you are The Engineer, armed with your trusty nail-gun battle the hordes of Mushrooms over 20 waves until you face the final boss. The enemies you face are affected by your own choice of upgrades in the shop.

games.name: Music Power Up
games.summary: As a musician in the 1980s, create music for early video games. Make your own sounds and melodies from scratch, or use pre-composed patterns. Play games, upgrade the music app, meet programmers, editors and musicians, find your next music job, in the crazy decade that started the digital revolution.

games.name: My Arms Are Longer Now
games.summary: You are a yucky long-armed thief. Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

games.name: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel to Me
games.summary: A dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Quietly wander through it, solve opaque puzzles, meet strange figures, and uncover the subtle threads of melancholy from which this place was born.

games.name: My Bookshop Dreams
games.summary: A cozy bookshop management sim where you run, customize, and expand your dream bookstore. Restock shelves, host author events, play mini-games, and collect literary works as you grow your reputation across cities—and maybe even planets.

games.name: My Eerie Lair
games.summary: A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.

games.name: My Femboy Roommate: Special Weekend
games.summary: You take your roommate turned boyfriend, Robin, to a fancy resort for your one year anniversary. Explore and enjoy everything the high-end resort has to offer while bonding and getting closer to Robin. Will you make the most of this special weekend?

games.name: My Helpers
games.summary: My Helpers is an experimental horror game that hides a group of virtual… "assistants" inside your machine. Find them by combing through your real files, exploring weird applications, and using your computer in ways you may have never expected - and remember: this is just a game.

games.name: My New Paranormal Life
games.summary: My New Paranormal Life is a story-rich, erotic visual novel focused on its dating-sim and sandbox aspects.

games.name: My Own Hero Party
games.summary: A party-building casual incremental game where every expedition is a race against your stamina. Recruit allies, clear room-based dungeons, gather gold, and grow a custom upgrade tree after being kicked out of the hero party.

games.name: Mym's Sword
games.summary: Defeat powerful foes and discover a colorful world full of mystery and wonder in this exploratory action platformer! A wandering beast discovers a magic sword, but can she uncover the truth of its origins, and resist the powers that created it?

games.name: Myrtle Grove: A Clair V. Mystery
games.summary: When renowned P.I. Clair V. Is called to a Louisiana town on reports of a ghost, what they find is a mystery cloaked in a nightly calamity. With spirit abilities and the gift of foresight, Clair must loop through futures to uncover the roots of the haunting and stop a curse.

games.name: Mystery Adventure The Maid Did It
games.summary: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

games.name: Mystery Egg Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your very own mystery egg shop! Stock shelves, manage customers, and grow your business. Every egg hides a surprise, you can sell them sealed, or open them to discover what’s inside? Unbox action figures, trade collectibles, and build themed dioramas to increase their value.

games.name: Mystic Tavern
games.summary: Mystic Tavern - co-op simulator tavern and farm with a mystical twist. Build your homestead, explore multiple map regions, harvest and mine resources, cook dishes and brew potions. Customize your character, bond with charming NPCs, and face subtle horror after sundown as you uncover hidden truths.

games.name: Mythic Isle
games.summary: "Create your mini fantasy island in the corner of your Windows desktop! Tired from work or study? Just click casually and watch adorable pets farm, mine, and build automatically for you~ From a deserted isle to a thriving paradise - all thanks to these little creatures with superpowers!"

games.name: Name of the Will
games.summary: You are informed to be a resident of Hope, a suspiciously harmonious community. Dodge the secretive governors, establish a rapport with your neighbors who monitor you, and solve puzzles to find out how you got here. Are you willing to sacrifice for the truth? Or, are you choosing a life of oblivion?

games.name: Nano Dash
games.summary: Nano Dash is Boulder Dash like action puzzler game but with a lot of new elements and also some Metroidvania features like tiny story-line, power-ups and a lot of secrets and hidden dungeons. The graphics and sound is 8 Bit like and close to the one from the original from 1986.

games.name: Nanovoid
games.summary: In Nanovoid, the pursuit of immortality has led to the awakening of a prime evil that threatens everything. With the universe turned against us, protect the human race and face off against deadly enemies in this high-stakes space shooter. Can you save humanity from annihilation in a deathless world?

games.name: Near the Sun: Chapter 1
games.summary: God's punishment burns the earth to ashes, and eventually consumes the underground world as well. A stylish 2D stealth action game where how you explore determines your fate. A boy carries his sister on his back and races through the underground world.

games.name: Neath
games.summary: Manipulate the turns of friend and foe alike in this Eldritch roguelike tactical RPG by the makers of Rogue Legacy. Ascend the inverted tower. Kill an indolent god. Control every "moment".

games.name: Nebula Veil
games.summary: Only tiny, fragile shuttle between you and open space. Beyond it, wreckages drift in blood-red fog. The longer you’re alone, the less dead the cosmos around feel. Survival isn’t enough. Seek answers, analyze data, examine anomalies. To unveil fog’s secret, every detail matters.

games.name: Neidfyre
games.summary: Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose.

games.name: Neighborhood Video
games.summary: Crack the case of the missing video store employee in this 3D point and click mystery game by solving escape room puzzles, combing the computer database, and scouring shelves as an undercover detective posing as a cashier during your first weekend at the suspiciously understaffed Neighborhood Video.

games.name: Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki No Emaki
games.summary: Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

games.name: Neon Auto Party
games.summary: Build a party to auto-battle through waves of enemies in a futuristic fantasy setting. Each unit has its own deck of cards that determines their performance in battle. Find and buy items while leveling up units to take advantage of powerful synergies and reach the end of the dungeon!

games.name: Nephelia: Through the Clouds
games.summary: Take control of your own airship, hire people for your crew, help them on their personal stories, follow the trail of a whimsical inventor of the colonisation era, trade, fight, discover, and try to stay afloat.

games.name: Nerd: Tracing Dayline
games.summary: An adventure game created with the concept of "a game for a single song."

games.name: Nether Spirits: Beyond the Gate
games.summary: Mend your shattered soul in Nether Spirits, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark, fantastical afterlife corrupted by sin. Choose from seven distinct classes, explore a vast world, and fight your way to salvation - alone, with friends, or in real-time PvP!

games.name: Neural Drive
games.summary: Neural Drive is a cyberpunk action rogue-lite. Use acceleration powers to reflect bullets, dodge attacks, and counter enemies. Master weapons and upgrade your skills to overcome relentless enemies and deadly bosses.

games.name: Neuron Activation
games.summary: A frantic rhythm-puzzle game filled with micro-challenges. Push buttons, flip switches, shoot targets and more in search of high scores to appease your overlords.

games.name: Never Clean
games.summary: A minimalist game about collecting strange and absurd trash. Walk around, pick up items, sell your finds, unlock upgrades, and complete your collection. Play to relax or compete with others for the best time. It costs no more than an everyday small purchase and stays with you forever

games.name: Never Look Back
games.summary: A psychological, rule-based horror game set on an infinite liminal staircase. Players have to descend the staircase, squeeze a cute rubber duck, and never look back as the Darkness follows behind.

games.name: Never's End
games.summary: Never's End is a turn-based tactical RPG where you return from death into the midst of a global cataclysm. Possess townsfolk to use them as living weapons, wield the forces of nature to reshape the battlefield, and lead mankind back from the brink of extinction.

games.name: Neverlooted Dungeon
games.summary: Venture deep into the Neverlooted Dungeon and face its treacherous, deadly traps. Armed with your creativity, trusty weapon and magical items, find your own ways to outsmart the dangers in a highly immersive world. Be careful, become paranoid, be the first to loot!

games.name: Nexvultus
games.summary: Nexvultus dives into a co-op horror experience where you seal fractures in reality to contain a collapsing world, to prevent the escape of what's looming on the other side.

games.name: Nia and The Abyss
games.summary: Join Nia on her journey to breathe new life into the ocean depths. Clean the seafloor, plant seeds, and attract unique marine life. Cultivate a thriving ecosystem as you uncover the remnants of humanity lost beneath the waves.

games.name: Nick's Recursive Videogame About Deciphering Word Puzzles to Discover Your Identity and Redefine the Universe!
games.summary: A recursive word game for (mostly) clever people! Use your imagination to define things that define things that define things...in an unpredictable reality where there are NO wrong answers & your mistakes pile up (and up and up)! Playful, lighthearted, and charmingly offbeat.

games.name: Night Blood W: Cutthroat Wolf
games.summary: "Nightblood W: Cutthroat Wolf" is a cyberpunk action role-playing game. You will play the role of an ambitious gang cadre. Your goal is to challenge and eliminate the rebellious Frey Gang alone, prove your strength, and eventually reach the top of the gang to control the entire city.

games.name: Night Plane
games.summary: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

games.name: Night Shift: 1999
games.summary: Balance work, vampirism and socialising as you explore Kings Cross, Sydney during the last year of the millennium. Keep a lid on your darkest desires and be rewarded with a deeper understanding of what it means to live again. Or don’t — no one will stop you. You’re a vampire, after all.

games.name: Nightborn
games.summary:
Nightborn is an Action RPG with narrative-focused gameplay set in a dark gothic version of our own world.
Players assume the role of the Bloodhound, a Vampire detective trained in tracking supernatural threats to the Nightborn, using arcane rituals forbidden to others of your kind.
Investigate a series of disappearances of your fellow Vampires, including your Maker, a politically influential member of the Nightborn, the Vampire elite of New Orleans.

Create your own Bloodhound character, choosing from 10 iconic Vampire lineages with a set of signature lineage power skill trees.

Lineage powers include physical prowess enhancements, shapeshifting, controlling the minds of mortals, and acts of eldritch sorcery.

Fuel Vampire powers by preying upon mortals via stealth, seduction, or brute force.

Elude Mortal Law Enforcement and Monster Hunters, masking your dark nature.

Solve the mysteries of gothic New Orleans by taking quests, discovering clues, and exploring the supernatural underworld.

Battle, evade, or outwit, natural and supernatural foes, using your powers, weapons, and tactics.

Side with a Nightborn faction, the ruling Establishment, the reckless Libertines, or the fanatical Orthodoxy; or eschew them all to forge your own path.

games.name: Nightmare Circus
games.summary: Nightmare Circus is an action-adventure game where the player takes on the role of a Puppeteer trapped in the Nightmare Realm. Set out on a journey to find his friends and escape the nightmare!

games.name: No Elevator
games.summary: A claustrophobic guy refuses elevators and climbs a massive building.

games.name: No Exit
games.summary: No Exit is a small chapter based indie horror game. You'll have to face challenging enemies, and perhaps make some allies, as you try to escape the crooked dimension you're trapped in.

games.name: No Gods of Men
games.summary: Rebuild a towering citadel, manage your disciples, and slash through waves of enemies in a hand-drawn world that combines roguelike metroidvania gameplay with base-building & colony management.

games.name: No One Leaves the Field
games.summary: A first-person folk horror game set on a cursed farm where the wheat shifts each time you enter. Search for your car keys, uncover the family’s dark ritual, and beware—something ancient walks between the stalks.

games.name: No One Returns
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what happens if you wake up and everyone is simply gone? No One Returns is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Denis, search a chillingly silent city for clues about your missing family while fighting the frightening zombies swarming the streets.

games.name: No Straight Roads 2
games.summary: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

games.name: No Such Place
games.summary: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter.

games.name: No Tithe for Olaf
games.summary: A grimly humorous single-player tower defense roguelite set in 17th-century Norway. Defend your farm from the King’s tax collectors, build bizarre towers, and lead a farmer’s uprising as a goat-riding rebel! Upgrade your farm, manage resources, and weaponize onions in escalating rural chaos.

games.name: Noble Steed
games.summary: A fast, funny 2D platformer where every level throws you into chaotic combat and questionable heroics, all to rescue your runaway horse… again.

games.name: Nocturnals: Cacti Coast
games.summary: A narrative-driven, choose-your-own-adventure game where a young survivor must make difficult decisions in order to survive the foggy wasteland of Cacti Coast and find a community to call home.

games.name: Non Eternals
games.summary: A single-player command action RPG with MMORPG-style combat. Features a quirky system where placing skill commands next to the UI boosts their power! Rescue the creators from the Dark Lord, who manifests their inner darkness as monsters!

games.name: Nonetbeat
games.summary: NonetBeat is a TPS action game starring three charming heroines. Each with unique combat styles, they obliterate hordes of monsters with magic! Sandbox stages let you destroy terrain for dynamic battles. Collect magic and unleash dazzling combos in thrilling hack-and-slash action!

games.name: Nonolith
games.summary: Discover the countless secrets of the NONOLITH. Copy and paste blocks to reach new areas, and master hidden mechanics that let you do the seemingly impossible. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

games.name: Nonuple Nine: Asymptote
games.summary: "NONUPLE NINE: Asymptote" is a side-scrolling, narrative Sci-fi adventure game. Control the subject girl and solve the mystery of the building where the same floor loops. With vast scientific insights, can you find the answer for the "meaning of humanity" during this deadly journey?

games.name: North Pole Workshop
games.summary: Play as one of Santa’s elves to create, gift-wrap, and deliver toys. This 1-4 cooperative toy-making game can be completed at your own pace in easy difficulty(1 star). For more challenge and to test your team's coordination, you can attempt the harder timed difficulties (2-3 stars).

games.name: Northanda Chronicles
games.summary: Master role-driven combat in Northanda Chronicles, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit three heroes from countless combinations, craft a shared deck of powerful abilities, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

games.name: Not Guilty!
games.summary: You are the judge, the executioner, and the warden — all in one. Investigate absurd cases, make questionable decisions, expand your prison, and keep the budget balanced. Bend your morals, play with verdicts, and build your own empire of justice.

games.name: Not My Son
games.summary: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

games.name: Novel Simulator
games.summary: Novel Simulator is an interactive fiction game blending writing and roleplaying. As both author and protagonist, you explore worlds and unlock "cheats" to craft stories across cultivation, sci-fi, wuxia, and urban settings through dynamic choice-driven gameplay.

games.name: Now Hiring
games.summary: Now Hiring is a top-down narrative adventure where you play a job seeker trapped in a scam syndicate. Across 21 days, your choices in dialogue battles and moral dilemmas will shape your fate, reveal human struggles, and lead to multiple endings.

games.name: Nowhere Manor
games.summary: House of stolen devil bargains and indolent angelic aristocracy: Nowhere Manor is doomed to disappear. You can leave if you’ve got a soul … but that’s not an option for an artificially created servant such as Liber. Just how far are you willing to go escape?

games.name: NowLoading Forever
games.summary: Can you actually “play” this game!? Before you can play "FINAL TALES QUEST", you must first load the game data.

games.name: Nox Mortalis
games.summary: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

games.name: NPC Simulator
games.summary: NPC SIMULATOR is a game where you can finally become that boring NPC! No swords or spells. Your job is to give out quests, fix crooked textures, and do whatever it takes to keep players from reporting bugs. Hang in there!

games.name: Nuclear Sub
games.summary: A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country.

games.name: Null
games.summary: NULL is a first person psychological horror game about grief, obsession and what happens when love refuses to accept an ending. You explore a neighbourhood that stopped behaving like one. You talk to people who seem completely normal until they turn and look at you in a way that makes you wish they hadn't. You find what was left behind by someone who could not say goodbye. And slowly the picture forms — what happened here, who did it, and why they thought love was a good enough reason.

games.name: Null Path
games.summary: Your skill, patience, and ingenuity will be tested in this homage to precision platformers and metroidvanias! Traverse various biomes, from caves to volcanic wastelands and mysterious towers. Each environment with it's own deadly traps, puzzles, and challenges designed to push you to your limits.

games.name: Number Machine
games.summary: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

games.name: Numbers Go Up
games.summary: The 2048 roguelike deckbuilder. Stack game-warping mods and tile enhancements on a systemic board, chain merges, and compete online for the highest score.

games.name: Oasis of Lilies
games.summary: Julie's Oasis is a haven for gentlewomen looking for relaxation and discreet pleasures. Ayame enters the club, unsure what to expect, only to meet strangely familiar women one after another. Oasis of Lilies is a light-hearted visual novel about a girl who dreams of having a harem of her own.

games.name: Obitus
games.summary: Obitus is a multiplayer survival game where players are thrown into a deadly wilderness. Scavenge for weapons, avoid traps, and eliminate your opponents – only one will survive. Inspired by Hunger Games, it combines strategy, tension, and life-or-death combat.

games.name: Object Impermanence
games.summary: A first person puzzle game where your vision defines reality, and only the things you can see exist. Learn and master the strange behaviours of objects outside your vision. Traverse the ancient structures of a world forgotten by the universe.

games.name: Obscurity: Unknown Threat
games.summary: Obscurity: Unknown Threat is a horror shooter game where a team of soldiers must survive against a hidden foe. The game contains both conventional symmetrical FPS game modes as well as asymmetrical battles vs the Obscurity.

games.name: Ocean City Killer
games.summary: Ocean City Killer is an open-world corporate dungeon crawler. You play as Rick Atlanta, a private eye investigating the death of a former colleague. What starts out as a routine case pulls you into the dark labyrinth of a seedy megacorp. Hop in your muscle car to explore the city!

games.name: Odd Jobs: On The Lot
games.summary: A physics-powered, 1-4 player co-op set in a vibrant Australian carpark. Teammates race to complete a rotating roster of odd jobs avoiding hazards and losing wages. Manage chaos collecting stray trolleys, unloading delivery trucks, cleaning up trash, or delivering groceries directly to car boots.

games.name: Oddinary Farm
games.summary: Stuck on an alien TV show where your death is entertainment, you must escape a variety of bizarre islands filled with riches and deadly creatures before impending doom consumes you.

games.name: Odds Chronicles
games.summary: A tactical roguelite RPG where every roll matters. Fight on a strategic grid, shape your hero’s path through dice-driven choices, and uncover a story-rich world inspired by tabletop adventures.

games.name: Oedo Developer
games.summary: “Oedo Developer” is a city builder featuring Ieyasu Tokugawa's Edo. Story and free play modes are available, the first offering a history based city building experience, and the second allowing you to freely develop the lands. Plan, build, distribute, and learn as you make the Edo of your dreams!

games.name: Off-Score: A Game of Songs
games.summary: A surreal game that tells the stories of 3 songs. Play the music until the end by solving the puzzles and secrets along the way.

games.name: Office Manager
games.summary: Build and manage your own office empire. Design buildings, find tenants, negotiate contracts, and keep them happy. Research new technologies, expand your business, and handle unexpected events in a living office world.

games.name: Oh Demon! Fix my TV
games.summary: In this horror, comedy, and puzzle game, you will play as a demon summoned by an old woman to fix her television, sending you on an adventure beyond all reason.

games.name: Okko the Exiled
games.summary: Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure, where you stomp, launch, and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the demon lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

games.name: Olga: Episode 1
games.summary: Relive Olga's childhood memories as she visits her grandparents' home in Belovodica, a secluded mountain village where some discoveries last a lifetime.

games.name: Omea
games.summary: Your words shape the adventure. Omea is a revolutionary AI-powered narrative game where your personal Game Master responds to everything you write. No menus, no limits. Just type and forge your own legend across fantasy, sci-fi, mystery, and beyond.

games.name: Omertà: Mafia Novel
games.summary: Noir visual novel set in 1950s New York. Infiltrate a prison, build a smuggling network, and shape fates through tough choices across branching paths.

games.name: Omicrox
games.summary: Omicrox takes Ultimate Tic Tac Toe and adds powerful one-use ability cards for unlimited strategic possibilities. Earn abilities as you play, like swapping boards, blocking moves, or stealing cards, and use them to outsmart friends or AI in this battle of tactics.

games.name: On a Summer Night
games.summary: "Today, I would like to tell you about one night. One night that changed my life." On a Summer Night is a short point-and-click visual novel.

games.name: On Donuts and Holes
games.summary: A psychological adventure through a dreamy landscape. Face unanswerable questions to reach the ultimate enigmas: Who are you? Who am I?

games.name: On Love, On Monsters
games.summary: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile.
