Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

games.name: On the Rocks
games.summary: Run a bar in a toxic wasteland - scavenge the wasteland, brew what you find, serve who you must. In a world gone to ruin, the last bar standing is yours to run.

games.name: One Coin Museum
games.summary: Explore, collect, and curate your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, sail across vast oceans to uncover treasures with your claw. Display them to attract visitors, and grow your reputation. Upgrade your boat to travel farther and discover the world’s hidden wonders.

games.name: One Last Push
games.summary: Survive the horrors of WW1 in this intense PvE survival shooter. Scavenge supplies, earn your regiment’s respect, and fight for reinforcements before you become another name lost in the mud.

games.name: One Last Sacrifice
games.summary: PvP Autobattler meets character progression. Draft your board from a rotating shop. Build a semi-persistent deck and refine it through crafting. Discover powerful synergies. Outwit your opponents in sync or async duels and ascend the Arenas of Naskarr. A card battler without pay-to-win mechanics.

games.name: One More Dig!
games.summary: Grab your equipments and dive deep! One More Dig is a pirate-themed mining adventure. Master your stamina, unearth cursed treasures, and upgrade your gear with dubloons. The greatest haul is always just one more dig away—how deep will you go before the tide turns?

games.name: One Song, One Life
games.summary: “One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.

games.name: One With the Unicycleverse
games.summary: A precision platformer where you maneuver and weave your unicycle through hundreds of dastardly obstacles across dozens of levels and side modes. Upon mastering the controls; the game becomes a meditative experience and you will discover what it means to be ‘One with the Unicycleverse.’

games.name: Onii-chan Continue!: Secret Love With Yuri
games.summary: Yuri lives with her big brother, Hayato. Though she looks like a model student in public, in reality she likes to laze around at home and play video games. Though they sometimes argue, she loves her big brother. As Hayato accepts another game challenge from Yuri, so begins his trouble-filled days...

games.name: Oniria
games.summary: Oniria is a first-person psychological horror game with a retro aesthetic. Explore the village by solving puzzles and evading the strange presence that haunts it. Experience Angy's present in 3D, and uncover her hidden memories in 2D.

games.name: Only Tactics
games.summary: You lead a tactical group in a series of turn-based battles with other groups. A limited number of actions and rules create an infinite number of tactical combinations. The levels are balanced so that the one who finds the right tactics wins. Get ready, that will not be easy

games.name: Oomi's Nook
games.summary: Oomi’s Nook is a relaxing and heartwarming sticker decor game. Decorate a cozy little room with hand-drawn style stickers according to the drawing or unleash your creativity! Follow the lighthearted everyday life of the adorable Oomi family and watch them live leisurely in the world you create!

games.name: Oops Unit
games.summary: Oops Unit is an online co-op game where up to 6 players team up as a bomb squad. Solve puzzles, gather resources, and push through deadly traps and enemies to reach and defuse every bomb. Extract, buy new gear, and repeat—or die trying, because anything, even your friends, can sabotage the mission.

games.name: Operation Eventide
games.summary: Adelle, a former magical girl, wakes up in a robotic body. Still picking up the pieces after her untimely demise, she seeks the truth of her new life. Experience as this 'love song' resounds in the rift of magic and logic in this nostalgic, thrilling yuri sci-fi visual novel.

games.name: Operation Purge
games.summary: Operation Purge is a story-driven sci-fi survival game set on Titan, Saturn’s mysterious moon. Explore the terrain, manage limited resources, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the surface. Will you survive long enough to find the truth?

games.name: Ophelia´s Paradise
games.summary: Mystical Horde-Survivor. You are the hero who defends paradise against hordes of adversaries. On your journey, you will unleash legendary powers in a mystical world and discover unique items.

games.name: Opona
games.summary: The reality TV show Popworld is a one-way ticket to pop stardom, and Mia and Noah came here to win! Fight your way through turn-based dance battles (and a whole lot of drama) in this hand-drawn idol adventure game.

games.name: Orba
games.summary: ORBA is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art action game where you race a fragile Orb up a deadly tower. Dash through shifting floors, use powerful Lucky Charms to outpace destruction, and push your limits before the Orb shatters.

games.name: Orbfall
games.summary: Orbfall - Reclaim the Planet is an upcoming action-packed sci-fi adventure currently in beta development. It is set in a shattered world devastated by the impact of mysterious orbital objects, players explore dangerous environments, gather resources, battle hostile alien factions, and fight to reclaim the planet from chaos. Featuring detailed base building, team-based PvE combat across multiple maps, and a dark atmospheric setting, Orbfall delivers an immersive blend of survival, exploration, and intense futuristic warfare as humanity struggles to rebuild its future. (Still in development though)

games.name: Orblins
games.summary: Orblins is a Marble-Matching Roguelike inspired by classic marble shooters like Zuma and Luxor. Create game-breaking builds with endless marbles and upgrades to defeat a host of Orblins and bosses. Choose from a large cast of characters or create your own custom class to personalize your run.

games.name: Orbrix
games.summary: Orbrix is an incremental idle breakout game. Break endless layers of bricks, purchase powerful upgrades, and unlock visual themes. Play actively or as idle as you want. Create a swarm of upgraded bullets to defeat your enemies. Can you grind your way to level 1000 to escape the Orbrix prison?

games.name: Orc Warchief: Strategy City Builder
games.summary: Become an Orc warchief and fight for survival of your race. Rebuild your village and train your warriors. Gather resources and craft your weapons. Raise your warbanner and gather The Horde.

games.name: Order of Renewal
games.summary: Order of Renewal is a multiplayer fantasy indie RPG game with co-op and PvP. Detailed combat system with realistic swordsmanship, physical interaction, unusual, and fresh mechanics will require tactics and skill in every battle.

games.name: Order of the Sinking Star
games.summary: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a narrative adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

games.name: Order: The New Dawn
games.summary: Order: The New Dawn is a colony sim with space adventure. As a legendary captain from the United Stellar, build a base on the desert planet New Terra and face the perils of the Wastespace—how will you shape the destiny of the stars?

games.name: Oremus
games.summary: This text adventure, beautifully illustrated in pixel art, invites you to explore a medieval abbey filled with secrets. You take full control by entering commands directly on your keyboard through a flexible command parser, allowing for free and immersive interaction.

games.name: Orium
games.summary: Aboard your ship, exterminate the enemies of profit, exploit planets and expand the corporation’s commercial empire across the stars. Orium is a roguelite infused with streamlined 4X elements.

games.name: Orson, P.I.: Midnight at the Grand Hotel
games.summary: Twelve guests at a Chicago hotel plot to steal millions in jewels. Stop them before midnight strikes.

games.name: OS95 Plus!
games.summary: OS95 Plus! is the newest first person puzzle adventure game from Gev Creates. You're stuck in a mysterious facility and are forced to indefinitely partake in software testing. You must navigate rooms and solve puzzles to escape and uncover the truth behind the experiment.

games.name: Our Life: Now & Forever
games.summary: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

games.name: Out and About
games.summary: You've come to help your Granny after a terrible storm destroyed her cottage and wreaked havoc in her idyllic coastal town. Can you find a way of restoring her home and uniting the townsfolk? Connect with nature by foraging, gardening, and cooking, then try out your new skills in the real world!

games.name: Outscratched
games.summary: The scratchcard roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble a unique selection of scratchcards, blessed charms, and magical stickers. Discover endless exciting combos to beat the odds against a diabolical lottery.

games.name: Over the Hill
games.summary: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Over the Radio
games.summary: Local co-op game about flying a plane. One player is the pilot, the other the navigator. The pilot has no map. The navigator guides the pilot using only words. Work together to reach your goal in a remixable national park map.

games.name: Overbooked
games.summary: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

games.name: Overhours
games.summary: From building makeshift traps, to defending her new friends from danger and taking back precious time. Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a dystopian media agency that steals time. One employee, together with an unexpected ghostly partner, is trying to retrieve it all.

games.name: Overserved: Food Fighters!
games.summary: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

games.name: Owl Force
games.summary: Lead the legendary Owl Force and your wingmates on an epic journey defending the galaxy against the nefarious Darktail Order. Take on missions, upgrade your ship, and engage in heart-pounding battles to uncover the hidden secrets of the universe.

games.name: Owlet's Embrace
games.summary:
An owlet afraid of flight sets off to explore a vibrant mysterious world and rediscover itself. On this heartwarming adventure, you'll confront the owlet's deepest fears as only the greatest challenges can lead to the most profound growth.

Owlet's Embrace is an action exploration platformer, blending fast paced grappling hook manouvers with combat and emotional discovery.

games.name: Paccarat
games.summary: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

games.name: Pachinko Life
games.summary: A pachinko roguelike where every run is a life. every country, class, and choice changes how the board plays.

games.name: PACS: Post Apocalypse Courier Service
games.summary: Can you build delivery vehicles to survive the post apocalypse? Go it alone or with up to 4 friends as you navigate treacherous environments, make deliveries, customise vehicles, scavenge for parts, and grow your delivery business!

games.name: Paddle Cats
games.summary: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

games.name: Paddle Legends
games.summary: A chaotic roguelite twist on classic retro arcade-style gameplay. Unlock paddles, grab upgrades, and new ball powers as you battle through dynamic levels, obstacles, and bosses across three campaigns and an endless mode.

games.name: Paddle Momentum
games.summary: A 1v1 arcade game where you rally the ball back and forth while building momentum. Earn points, unlock upgrades, and grow stronger over time. Between matches, care for and play with your mole—the better you treat it, the more it will help you during matches.

games.name: Pakku Pony
games.summary: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

games.name: Panema
games.summary: Build. Roll. Bend Luck. A dice-builder roguelike of blessings, curses, and Yahtzee.

games.name: Panic in Puzzle World
games.summary: Panic in Puzzle World is an action-packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Play as Tide and breathe fire, slash with your claws, bounce on bad guys and glide with your wings to put a stop to the robot menace taking over the land, block by block!

games.name: Panline
games.summary: Welcome to post-scarcity! But you’re not on the list. Deliver to make a living off-grid while Panline, the abundance engine that keeps the city endlessly supplied, begins to change. Earn currency, favors, kit upgrades and work the runner scene to unlock new contacts and fixers.

games.name: PanzenTD
games.summary: A charming tower defense game where heroic panda warriors defend their homeland against waves of destructive robots. Build towers, deploy unique heroes, and outsmart your enemies across stylized jungle battlefields.

games.name: Papa Needs a Headshot
games.summary: Papa Needs a Headshot is a brutal western-steampunk FPS soaked in kin blood. Rip through flesh and bend the battlefield with your cursed metal arm. Use every bullet wisely to slaughter freaks and abominations on your warpath. Keep enduring only to put a bullet in the skull of the man who made you.

games.name: Paper Play VR
games.summary: Experience creative minigames as the world's biggest paper playground unfolds right in front of your eyes! We have crazy games, difficult challenges and a heartwarming story for you and your friends, so come and join the party!

games.name: Paper.Void
games.summary:
Navigate an infinite monochrome dimension where many mysteries are yet to be discovered. You are merely a paper plane, flying through space as you collect VOID Cubes which further distort the world around you...

The VOID may be infinite, but as you progress further, it becomes increasingly challenging to navigate as you leave behind a permanent deadly trail of light. Your sense of scale, gravity, and depth do not exist here.

When reality reaches its END, can you survive your own self-made labyrinth? Or will your journey lead to an inevitable PAPER CUT...

games.name: Papy Panic
games.summary: Papy Panic is an indie driving game where players control quirky vehicles, navigating through chaotic environments with physics-based jumps and obstacles. It includes a standard single-player experience and a dedicated interactive Twitch Mode designed for live streamers.

games.name: Pararecords
games.summary: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

games.name: Parasite Mutant
games.summary: Parasite Mutant is a science-fiction horror RPG set in the distant future. Psionic agent Nova was sent on a mission to an abandoned and secluded island city filled with horrifying creatures, not knowing that what happened on the island will completely change her fate.

games.name: Party Pop Bubblyz
games.summary:
Jump into the Ultimate Penguin Party!
Break the ice and have fun at the Park! Join the 20-player party to be the star!
Explosive Fun in Just 10 Minutes

games.name: Pastry Pile Up
games.summary: Drop and merge pastries to create bigger, more delicious treats! Serve your sweet creations to adorable cat customers to earn coins. Use your coins to fully customize your cozy bakery, and compete on the global leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

games.name: Path for the Seeker
games.summary: Path For The Seeker is a detective adventure in which a young nun investigates the disappearance of a famous inventor in a city on the border of two worlds.

games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.summary: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG created by Grinding Gear Games. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading. Path of Exile 2 is a free-to-play online multiplayer game with co-op for up to six players.

games.name: Path of Glory
games.summary: Path of Glory is a deck-building, roguelite game, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Offering endless replayability, unlockable characters with unique tree skills and card deck's. Fight all beast on your path to become a Hero.

games.name: Paver Simulator
games.summary: Did you ever dream to become a paving artist? Perform tasks, during which the most important thing is creativity and precision. According to your design you lay different types of paving stones, so you earn money and raise the level of your reputation. Test your skills in the Paver Simulator

games.name: Paws and Leaves: A Last Tale
games.summary: Life flashes before your eyes when you die. Help Me Fox by finding his memories beyond life and experiencing a touching, cute, and scary tale.

games.name: Payday: Aces High
games.summary: Mask up as one of The Aces, an elite group of heisters with access to bleeding-edge tech, black-market toys, and weapons no sane dealer would list. Framed by business titan Warren Jupiter and thrown in jail, the time has come for you to hit him where it hurts: banks, museums—hell, even his so-called “untouchable” penthouse.

games.name: Peace Dice
games.summary: The post-apocalypse. When some are trying to survive in a new world, others join the detective agency "Peace Dice", which searches for evidence of mutants. Go on a raid and don't come back empty-handed!

games.name: Pebbles Quest
games.summary: The Princess has been kidnapped by evildoers! It is now Pebbles Quest to breach the Castle, face a gauntlet of traps and trials, all to rescue his one true love.

games.name: Pelican Post
games.summary:
Pelican Post is a cozy narrative game about delivering mail to a town of unique characters and helping to regain a lost sense of community.

You play as Pepper, a young pelican who recently moved to Port Pleasant to take a job as the town's mailman. Through your job, you'll get to interact with and get to know the townsfolk and help them out.

"Small acts of kindness" is pretty much in the job description.

games.name: Penguin Colony
games.summary: Narrative adventure game based on H.P Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness. Swim, Slide and Explore open ended levels as multiple penguin types with different abilities and challenges.

games.name: People of Mine
games.summary: A psychological horror where you play as a former agent hunting a cult—only to uncover a disturbing truth about your identity, memories, and the monsters you thought you were fighting.

games.name: Permafrost
games.summary: Embark on a brutal journey of survival in a perpetual winter. Hunt and gather resources for building and utilize deep survival mechanics to craft your way through a harsh, unforgiving landscape. Forge alliances or dominate the remnants of humanity in this chilling open world saga.

games.name: Permanent: Hope & Vacuum
games.summary: Psychological horror, puzzles, platforming, adventure, dungeons, action, intrigue and a touching story are all terms that should be used to try to define the essence of «Permanent: Hope & Vacuum».

games.name: Pest Protocol
games.summary: The swarm is infinite—your hands aren't. Pest Protocol is a short, satisfying incremental game. Start by clicking to eradicate pests, then rapidly deploy autonomous systems to clear the screen for you. Build, upgrade, and scale your extermination empire. Automate the eradication.

games.name: Petal Runner
games.summary: Hop on your bike and join Cali & Kira as they explore the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and train to become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a wholesome slice-of-life story about growing up and letting go.

games.name: Petrichor
games.summary: Petrichor is a JRPG about a space cub going on a quest to find the perfect houseplant. Make friends, defeat monsters, help people, save the stars and maybe get his plant. Maybe.

games.name: Phantasma Hotel
games.summary: A cursed hotel that kills you, revives you in the bathroom, and rolls the dice on your fate with every step, every fight, and every terrible choice you make.

games.name: Phase Zero
games.summary: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Two survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and escape the town in this classic survival horror. Can you make it till dawn?

games.name: Phasmophobia
games.summary: Phasmophobia is a cooperative horror investigation game played from a first-person perspective, supporting one to four players. Players take on the role of ghost hunters who must identify the type of ghost haunting a designated location by gathering evidence using various paranormal investigation equipment. The game features speech recognition, allowing ghosts and certain equipment to respond to words spoken by players. As investigators spend time at the site, their sanity decreases, eventually triggering hunts during which the ghost actively pursues and can kill players. The game includes multiple location types of varying size, twenty-nine ghost types each with unique behaviors and evidence, and a progression system where players earn money to unlock and upgrade equipment. Virtual reality is optionally supported.

games.name: PhotoLoop
games.summary: PhotoLoop is a casual game about editing photos using an outdated editing software that only has the lasso tool. Make sure to make your edits clean and concise, or you might not be able to pay your rent due in five days!

games.name: Piano at 5 am Encore
games.summary: The paid, complete version of Piano at 5 a.m.. It includes additional episodes that depict the characters' pasts and narrated voiceover.

games.name: Pico Drift
games.summary: Explore the city as your ultimate drifting arena. Dodge traffic, outsmart the cops, and challenge your friends. Experience official campaign tracks and game modes, or create your own playgrounds. This is your world - drive it your way

games.name: Pikku Adventure
games.summary: A challenging puzzle adventure about learning an alien language. Explore a strange world and meet its cute inhabitants. Decipher the language and earn their trust. With every word learned, you will uncover more secrets. Can you solve the mystery of this world and decide the fate of the Pikku?

games.name: Pileus Bad Trip
games.summary: Put yourself in the role of a surviving village mushroom and try to fix what happened while you were asleep!

games.name: Pill After Pill
games.summary: You’re a pill-dependent driver with paranoid schizophrenia, forced to escort a skeletal mafia boss across hostile territory. Your real enemy isn’t the gang chasing you — it’s the fear slowly consuming your mind. Drive, Shoot, Take Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after...

games.name: Pinbleton Park
games.summary: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

games.name: Ping Profit: Internet Tycoon
games.summary: Launch your hosting company straight from your parent's basement! Buy servers, solve problems, and grow your profits as you climb from startup to tech titan. Keep customers online, boost your reputation, and build the ultimate hosting empire in Ping Profit!

games.name: Pingbert's Snow Ride
games.summary: Slide, soar, and deliver! Join Pingbert, the upbeat penguin mail carrier, in Pingbert’s Snow Ride—a fast-paced, platformer where you'll slide down snowy slopes to deliver mail at high speed!

games.name: PinKeep
games.summary: PinKeep is a pinball deckbuilding roguelite – use the ball and flippers to collect resources and defeat your enemies! Place buildings from your deck on the playfield to defend your Keep. Create powerful synergies to eradicate the hordes of attacking Knights!

games.name: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
games.summary: PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package. Choose your faction, amass an army from thousands of "willing" participants, and lead them to greatness! (or agonizing defeat)

games.name: Pistonica
games.summary: Pistonica invites you into a calm, open world where steam and machines meet. In this first-person steam automation game, you build and automate a refined factory, explore an island, research tech, and trade goods - all because of a strange radio signal.

games.name: Pith
games.summary: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

games.name: Pizzapocalypse 2
games.summary: A 3D platformer with a pizza moveset that's accessible & engaging to all skill levels! Explore different countries, and put a stop to the evil corporation ruining Pizza!

games.name: Plant Game
games.summary: Run-based plant survival and growth game about learning the world through imperfect senses. Grow leaves, roots, and resilience, unlock biological “sensors” as UI progression, and earn your reveal when you bloom or die.

games.name: Plantverk: Perfectly Plantastic Plant Simulator
games.summary: Create your perfect little Greenhouse with fantastic plants, fun decorations and more in this cozy idle game! Throw your harvests around and cause havoc, and then use the vacuum to clean up your mess (for profit of course). Use your well-earned money to buy decorations, unlock new plants and pots.

games.name: Play Rough
games.summary: Play Rough is a roleplaying game set in the surreal, post-apocalyptic wasteland of what was once California. It's a place where humans live side-by-side with living cartoons, twisted abominations of ink and flesh, and... Clowns...?

games.name: Playable Alpha
games.summary: Surviving a post-catastrophic event, your mission is to survive. In this VR First Person Looter Shooter, you will get weapons, gear, upgrade it and have fun blasting them aliens to shreds.

games.name: Please Fix the Mess
games.summary: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

games.name: Plinkidle
games.summary: Falling balls, rare buffs, and steady upgrades unlock colorful, cozy stages and immersive environments.

games.name: Plucked
games.summary: A top-down bullet-hell roguelite about a small, heavily armed duck. Pick a weapon, survive the waves, and merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower while the pond does its best to pluck you. Quack responsibly.

games.name: Plush Party
games.summary: Get ready to challenge family and friends in PLUSH PARTY, the ultimate party game for all ages! Customize your cat, escape the claw, and be the last plushie standing!

games.name: Plush Rangers
games.summary: Survive waves of wacky mutated constructs to defeat powerful bosses with your team of Plushie friends in this quirky chaotic Survivors-like. Earn merit badges to unlock new Plushies, relics, items, and upgrades.

games.name: Plush Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your own cozy plushie shop in this management simulation game. Buy, price, and sell adorable plush toys, stationery, and mystery blind boxes!

games.name: Pocket Wheels
games.summary: Pocket Wheels isn't just a racing game, it's an objective-based 3D platformer. Take a seat in various toy cars with special abilities and explore a house full of themed rooms filled with collectibles, objectives and race tracks!

games.name: Poem Ex Machina
games.summary: Anime style, Ride X Fight, fast paced game.

games.name: Point in Time
games.summary: Use time travel to cooperate with your past self and conquer seemingly impossible puzzles. Can you craft the perfect timeline without altering history? Design your own escape.

games.name: Pokor
games.summary: Pokor is a story-driven roguelike tactical turn-based card RPG. Players take on the role of Heart, commanding a deck of playing card soldiers to engage in turn-based battles against enemies as they venture deeper into a vast, pale, and ever-changing palace to uncover the truth and the true self.

games.name: Polaria
games.summary: Polarium is a relaxing idle game set in the serene world of Antarctica. Discover peaceful marine life, learn about polar ecosystems, and find comfort in nature. Inspired by real research, the game blends healing gameplay with subtle messages on climate and biodiversity.

games.name: Polda 8
games.summary: It´s the eight entry in the point and click adventure series Polda and the final game with Pankrác as the main character. Just like previous entries is this one focused on puzzles and crazy humor, however this time there are also action minigames and three controlable characters.

games.name: Pollinate or Die
games.summary: Pollinate or Die is a fast-paced action roguelite set in the hazardous wastelands left behind by humanity. As one of the last surviving bumblebees, you alone can revive Earth's flora. Fight through swarms of enemies as you search for flowers to pollinate and bring life back to the planet.

games.name: Poly Beats
games.summary: Poly Beats is a 5K rhythm game that never misses to have the very best features, and interesting gimmicks.

games.name: Polyaris
games.summary: Polyaris is a single-player, first-person survival skiing game set in a post-nuclear, procedurally generated Arctic world. Survive the cold, ski through icy wastelands, find essential resources, fight enemies, and uncover the mystery of why you are the last one alive.

games.name: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure
games.summary: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a hint of nostalgia! Play as Ponchyo the platypus and journey through a variety of vibrant worlds. Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home.

games.name: Poodle Kick
games.summary: The world’s most accurate poodle-kicking simulator. Made for horrible people like you.

games.name: Pool of Madness
games.summary: A retro-styled Lovecraftian pool game with roguelite elements. Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

games.name: Poolside Vigil
games.summary: Based on a true story. Navigate through ever-changing pools where the path can never be memorized. Solve puzzles with physics-based interactions and survive the entity on your trail. Experience the grim consequences of phone addiction. Can you solve the mystery of that fateful day?

games.name: PooPig
games.summary: Shoot, dodge, and chase your acorns in this absurd, cartoon-style Bullethell filled with humor and visual gags.

games.name: Port Valley
games.summary: Port Valley is a (not so) classic Point & Click game where a certain choice changes everything. Witness 3 points of view of the same story and find out what's really going on during Port Valley's Election Day!

games.name: Portabellows
games.summary: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

games.name: Posse of 3
games.summary: Posse of Three is an RPG Maker game that takes place in a wild west setting with heavy fantasy elements! You will play as 3 main characters. Sammy a young settler, Ahiga a native man, and Fennic a wild fawn. Expect traditional turn based rpg combat with a gripping wild west story.

games.name: Postal 2 Redux
games.summary: A ground‑up overhaul of 2003’s infamous open‑world shooter. Part modernization, part love‑letter, POSTAL 2 Redux will hoist every original asset out of the creaking Unreal 1.5 engine and slam it into today’s Unity—delivering the same familiar week in the POSTAL Dude’s life with a merciless glow‑up and a bucket of new toys.

games.name: Potat
games.summary: Potat is a quirky, physics-based 3D adventure where you play as a sentient potato trying to escape a house before you get cooked alive. Roll, flip, and flop your way through a bizarre home filled with deadly traps, chaotic layouts, and unexpected obstacles.

games.name: Potata: Foxy Tale
games.summary: Potata: Foxy Tale is a fairy tale themed platformer adventure game in a beautiful world of dark forests. Your goal is to restore the balance and assemble the fragments of the Woodland Spirit.

games.name: Potion in Motion
games.summary: Brew potions, cast spells, and master alchemy in a fast-paced potion shop where magic and language intertwine. Experiment with weird ingredients, and manage quirky customers while avoiding failures! Every potion is a puzzle, but will you perfect your craft or turn your shop into a disaster zone?

games.name: Potion Punch Rivals
games.summary: Potion Punch Rivals puts your shopkeeping, potion punching skills to the test. Race against your rival to see who can take orders first, prep fastest, and serve best.

games.name: Power Line Rider
games.summary: Power Line Rider is an Action-Packed Endless Runner with retro 8-bit inspired graphics & sounds! Dodge Birds, Squirrels, Monkeys and Fight Bosses as you race across a post-apocalyptic world where the fastest means of travel is riding on old Power Lines!

games.name: President Simulator
games.summary: Become President of the USA: sign absurd decrees and balance your policies to avoid being called a "sellout." Communicate to gain popularity, manage interviews, and face press conferences. Everything falling apart? Press the red button.

games.name: Price for Freedom: Gold and Sand
games.summary: Gold and Sand is a CRPG with turn based tactical combat, with limb based targeting and bleeding and maiming mechanics. Several mini games such as cooking, fishing, and others.

games.name: Primal Survival
games.summary: A realistic prehistoric survival game where you play as Homo habilis or Homo erectus. Craft primitive tools, build shelter, hunt massive beasts, and survive the harsh forces of nature in a vast multiplayer world.

games.name: Prison Fury
games.summary: Prison Fury is a 2 player co-op puzzle platformer game. Pair up across mirrored prison stages to solve interdependent puzzles—door sequences, platform chains, patterns, levers and more. Runs are intense and can take 16–45 minutes.

games.name: Probably Stolen
games.summary: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

games.name: Problem Solver Club
games.summary: Solve school problems, face problematic girls

games.name: Professional Ship Simulator
games.summary: Take the helm in this realistic, large-scale maritime simulation. Command your fleet from agile rescue vessels to massive LNG tankers and perform precise maneuvers in challenging conditions. Navigate a living open world where weather, traffic, and every wave shape your career

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary:
Professor Layton and the New World of Steam depicts the world one year after the events of "Professor Layton and the Unwound Future".

Due to a mysterious incident in Steam Bison, a new adventure for Layton and Luke begins!

games.name: Progress98
games.summary: A retro incremental idle desktop companion all about making progress on the side and at your own pace.

games.name: Project Accipiter
games.summary: "We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But uoohhh~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!" Join Squad Accipiter in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

games.name: Project Blood Sword
games.summary: You are a lone ex-mercenary, turned Demigod, the embodiment of wrath – an unstoppable force seeking revenge on a cult that has enslaved humanity, draining the blood of thousands each day with the means to resurrect the god of hatred.

games.name: Project Damascus
games.summary: A first person adventure platformer, focused on exploration with time based mechanics and puzzle elements. Enter the ruins of the Kingdom of Pharygia. Swiftly traverse its dillapidated, intricate infrastructure to delve further into the depths of iniquity, in order to cast light on hidden truths.

games.name: Project Evilbane
games.summary: Project Evilbane is a dynamic and action-packed strategy-based experience that you can tackle solo or with friends. Switch freely between ranged and melee weapons, and customize your skills for every situation to create your own unique warrior. Your choices and teamwork will determine your victory!

games.name: Project Horizon
games.summary: Project Horizon is a 1-4 player co-op first-person spaceship simulator where the entire crew needs to work together to carefully maintain the nuclear reactor, take up arms against enemy ships, and repair every leak and faulty electrical panel to survive.

games.name: Project Kepler: Delivery Included!
games.summary: Project Kepler: Delivery Included! is a roguelike base-defense game where players control a lone cyborg stranded on a hostile planet. The objective is to survive waves of evolving alien creatures while managing resources, constructing automated defenses, and deploying drones for combat and support. Key features include procedurally generated runs, upgradeable drones and turrets, automation systems, daily randomized upgrades, and an ultimate fail-safe: an orbital strike to eradicate the planet.

games.name: Project Obscure
games.summary: Solve the physics-based puzzles in a steampunk atmosphere "Enlighten" dark mysteries of an old facility. Delve into a unique experience and KEEP YOUR LIGHT ON.

games.name: Project ReMind
games.summary: "Welcome to the end. My end" Manipulate machinery, open secret passages and bypass computers to remember your life, from your first discovery to your own death bed. In this first-person narrative puzzle game investigate a mysterious presence looking for the answer that haunted you since THAT day.

games.name: Project Roy
games.summary: Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where you play as a rogue AI that survives by hijacking enemy robots. Combine abilities, adapt mid combat, and fight your way through a sci-fi facility to escape and defeat a powerful experimental war machine.

games.name: Project Sara
games.summary: A man who has lost his wife and seeks to escape loneliness and grief begins working as a firewatch in a forest. He meets a girl named Sarah and encounters strange occurrences while uncovering deep family secrets. He learns that not every voice is human and not every farewell signifies an end.

games.name: Project TurboBlast
games.summary: Drift, boost, and spin around corners at BLASTING SPEEDS in this stylish Singleplayer + Multiplayer Arcade Racing game, Blending the familiar drifting of Kart racers and tight responsive handling of classic Anti-Gravity racing games. With a focus on being easy to pick up but difficult to master.

games.name: Project; Virai: Doomer's Life Escape
games.summary: Help a doomer girl make her VTuber persona popular and escape her depressive routine. If you can.

games.name: Prolegomena to a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
games.summary: This is a fully voiced multi-ending adventure game that progresses by repeating a limited 3-minute dialogue time. Interactions primarily occur through an interface called "choices".

games.name: Protagonist Complex One
games.summary: Enter a world of mystery, danger, and lightning-fast action in PROTAGONIST COMPLEX one, a pulse-pounding action game that blends the intensity of razor-sharp combat with eerie atmosphere.

games.name: Protect the Pit
games.summary: A short incremental clicker game that blends the strategy of tower defense with the depth of sprawling upgrade trees. Build your own winding mazes to repel the oncoming hordes!

games.name: Protocol Bound
games.summary: Bound is a psychological thriller where you search through private conversations, hidden files, and recordings on devices that aren't your own. Manipulate others, uncover dark secrets, and shape the outcome through the choices you make.

games.name: Protocol Paradox
games.summary: Protocol Paradox is a fast-paced roguelike shooter blending twin-stick combat, anomaly-based weapons and branching lore. Survive procedural sectors, customize builds with weapons and passives, face concept-driven bosses, and replay for new revelations.

games.name: PSI
games.summary: A movement-based climbing game where you ascend on a suicide mission to save an amphibian cargo cult.

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Psycho-Sleuth
games.summary: Psycho-Sleuth is a psychological mystery where cognitive disorders twist the logic of murder. 13 afflicted participants — each bound by strange rules like “no lying,” “no left side,” or “no faces” — are trapped in a deadly game where the sickness spreads and truth itself becomes unreliable.

games.name: Psychotic Bathtub
games.summary: Have a psychotic episode in your bathtub. Argue with a rubber duck, flood your bathroom and drown dad. Find your very own ending – or all of them.

games.name: Pubes
games.summary: A 3D action game where you control a strand of body hair and move around a 3D room! Use the unique fluffy floating and sticking abilities of body hair to safely reach your destination!

games.name: Puffin Parcel Post
games.summary: Puffin Parcel Post is a charming roguelite strategy game where players build and manage postal networks using adorable puffin workers. The game combines base-building mechanics with logistics optimization and strategic placement of buildings. Each playthrough offers fresh challenges through unlockable perks and upgrades that change how you approach building your postal empire. Players construct delivery routes, manage resources, and watch their cute puffin team waddle and zip across the map delivering parcels.

games.name: Pufflings: Journey Through a Fantasy World
PulseWave
games.summary: Every weapon fires to the beat you create. Mix guns, modifiers, and upgrades to build deadly combinations in this rhythm-shooter roguelike.

games.name: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
games.summary: Jump, dash, and brawl your way through beautifully animated 2D platforming levels, then shift perspectives into dynamic top-down 3D street zones to gather rare ingredients in chaotic, GTA2 - style street battles! Every fight feeds your menu. Every level is a recipe for madness.

games.name: Pursuit of Mercantile Power
games.summary: Pursuit of Mercantile Power is a single-player economic sim with light RPG. No money spawns—money only moves. Control the village’s cash flow, use proposals and loans, buy shares, and take over enterprises to seize GuYuan’s commercial order.

games.name: Puzkin: Magnetic Odyssey
games.summary: PUZKIN: Magnetic Odyssey invites players to explore a vibrant, magical world where magnetic energy sustains the balance of nature and creatures called Puzzies. Players, embodying chosen children, are transported to this mysterious realm to restore its harmony through epic adventures, collaborative construction, and immersive quests.

games.name: QiuQiu Town
games.summary: You have come to this new world, where you will start a new life, have many options, run the farm, scale up, and become a great agriculturist. Or run a store and become a business mogul. Or ordinary life every day, if you were given the chance to do it again, what would you choose?

games.name: Quadremor
games.summary: A first person shooter where you take a role of one of the last human mercenaries, who has to take his revenge for annihilation of humanity. A deep dive into a dark and unforgiving realm, which will stay in your consciousness for ages.

games.name: Quality Assurance
games.summary: Participate in chaotic testing sessions with up to eight players where you'll work together to solve a wide variety of randomized tasks while navigating hindering conditions. Prove to your creators that you're not just functional — you're exceptional.

games.name: Quest & Rest: Inn Simulator
games.summary: Run a cozy fantasy inn where adventurers rest, restock, and head off to glory. Assign quests, serve buff-granting ales, sell magical gear, and manage your guests—then watch their stories unfold from the comfort of your inn.

games.name: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale - Chapter 0+1
games.summary: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale is a choice-driven visual novel. From his present perspective, Ivan uses VR and a brain‑computer interface AI to revisit memories. Inside the simulation, he influences his past self to make different choices—and the AI instantly simulates new life paths.

games.name: Questing
games.summary: An oddball, subversive fantasy adventure game inspired by 16-bit classics like Chrono Trigger and A Link to the Past

games.name: Quiet
games.summary:
Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting the homeowner.

Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

games.name: Rabanaz
games.summary: A chip-based deckbuilder full of clever tricks to secure your victory. Tinker with your chips, slot in modification tubes, and reshape the scoring to craft your ideal strategy. Can you outwit the Rabanaz machine?

games.name: Rabauken: Spirit Resort
games.summary: Build a spirit resort. Research. Expand. Idle. Crowd-control spirits. Repeat. An automation game designed to be played on the side.

games.name: RabbitHole Island: Turn-based Vtuber Battles
games.summary: Turn-based battles against powerful vtubers. Free to Play!

games.name: RadCity: a post-apocalyptic adventure
games.summary: Scavenge for food and escape a dead city in a broken, post apocalyptic world. Gather enough food for 40 days and prepare for a train journey to a place of refuge. Featuring a top-down perspective and a finely crafted 3D world.

games.name: Radical Zomboarding
games.summary: Radical Zomboarding is a roguelike snowboarding game that's all about shredding powder and shooting zombies. Do tricks, buy perks, and soak the slopes with blood!

games.name: Raev: Kingdom on the Distant Shores
games.summary: Build an empire, founding its villages and cities. Every kingdom started with a single bonfire, and RAEV allows you to create your own thriving civilization across a sprawling continent. Craft interwoven cityscapes, inspire your people, and build a kingdom to forge your path to greatness.

games.name: Raiders 1941
games.summary: Raiders 1941 is a fast-paced, vertical scrolling shoot ‘em up that blends exciting retro action of arcade classics, with modern gameplay up to 120hz refresh rate.

games.name: Raiders Rise
games.summary: Raiders Rise is a multiplayer action-strategy game where two teams must cooperate and compete to collect crystals. Survive alien threats, outmaneuver rivals, and choose help or betray? In this chaotic battleground, teamwork is key… until it isn’t.

games.name: Railway End
games.summary: This is a spot-the-difference game with a railway theme. By comparing photos, find the anomalies in the scene to guide the protagonist to the end of the railway. There is no text in the game.

games.name: Rain98
games.summary: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

games.name: Ramen://Protocol
games.summary:
Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder.

Players aim to complete 10 days of business operations while upgrading their skills and toppings.

games.name: Ravelle: Last Draw
games.summary: What starts as casual matches in a humble café becomes a shared effort to protect a place that matters. Ravelle is a free-to-play turn-based strategy card game with visual novel elements, blending tactical card battles and personal character stories.

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.summary: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods, playable solo or in online co-op.

games.name: Re:cord Noah: Fractal of Oblivion
games.summary: An upcoming otome game being developed for global release in 2026 for the Nintendo Switch. It is a collaboration between AmuLit and Soyogi Fractal, a vocal synth project made by Yuki Kaji.

games.name: Re:Curse
games.summary: A time-travel mystery visual novel about found-family, connections, and hope in dark times.

games.name: Re:Ver Project - Tokyo
games.summary: Co-developed by Toei Animation and indie developer Nestopi, is a survival suspense adventure game set in modern Tokyo depicted in pixel art. Yukinori Amane whos falsely accused of a crime, uses his survival skills to evade the police and uncover the real culprit.

games.name: Realindustry
games.summary: Realindustry is a hyper-realistic industrial automation simulator that blends deep strategy with authentic scientific principles, challenging players to build and optimize complex production chains using 231 real-world materials and 352 precise chemical recipes. Developed by AssemblyPrime, the game features a unique "mystery" theme where your industrial expansion is monitored by an unknown entity, adding narrative tension to the core loop of resource management and technological progression. Across multiple technological tiers, players must master genuine chemical engineering and metallurgy to transform basic elements into advanced products, offering an unrivaled level of technical depth for fans of the automation genre on Windows and macOS.

games.name: Realms at War
games.summary: Realms at War is a turn-based strategy game inspired by chess, where fantasy factions clash in PvP and PvE battles. Equip your forces, adapt to rogue-like challenges, and conquer diverse realms filled with ever-changing foes and environments.

games.name: Rebirth of Arcadia
games.summary: Rebirth of Arcadia is a turn-based tactics game with roguelike elements and contemplative story. Experience the journey of two groups of people working together to escape from the Abyss. Explore, defeat monsters, wield and modify the power of runestones to uncover the secrets of the Abyss.

games.name: Rebirth TD
games.summary: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.

games.name: Recital of the Heart
games.summary: An adventure game with a focus on story and exploration. Experiment with wide range of weapons, abilities, and modifications as you delve deep into a world pure imagination. Solve conflict and mysteries with your partner Kand by your side. Heed his wise words, or throw caution (and him) to the wind!

games.name: Recurrence
games.summary: "Something is broken... and it keeps repeating."A classic survival horror set in a cyberpunk world corrupted by a strange signal. Solve puzzles, face terrifying creatures, and try to escape a nightmare that seems endless

games.name: Recursor
games.summary: An action roguelite inspired by platform fighters

games.name: Red Echoes: Berlin
games.summary: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

games.name: Red Howl
games.summary: Social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. 3 factions clash: use your unique powers and unmask them before the Blood Moon turns against you, or be devoured.

games.name: Red Moon Kingdom
games.summary: When a group of outcasts is sent to retrieve a wondrous artifact, a fatal mistake brings chaos upon the world. Explore, solve puzzles and card battle your way through a unique medieval fantasy setting full of magic with 3 controllable characters and in stunning 4K hand-drawn visuals.

games.name: Red Rebellion
games.summary: A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town set in a historically accurate medieval England.

games.name: Red Rising
games.summary: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

games.name: Red Rust Pioneers
games.summary:
Your story begins stranded in the unforgiving wilderness of the Wild West.

Your one goal: to survive.

Endure scorching days and freezing nights as you battle hunger, thirst, and the elements. Forage for food, hunt wildlife, and fish to stay alive. Scavenge the land to gather vital resources and craft the tools and weapons you’ll need to stand a chance in this brutal but breathtaking frontier.

Can you master the elements and withstand blistering heat, violent rainstorms and freezing cold winters?

Should you beat the odds and live, alone or with up to three friends, you’ll find yourself in a gorgeous, rugged, vibrant land. Will you be able to not only survive, but thrive?

Build and grow your camp your way with easy to use base building mechanics. Fish in the lakes and rivers, or hunt in the atmospheric woodlands and open prairies. Farm and harvest a variety of crops to establish a self-sufficient camp. Adventure high into the mountains to mine resources, and craft better weapons and tools.

Explore a beautifully realized, open world, fictionalized Wild West frontier and become the first to discover the untamed wilderness of Red Rust Valley.

If you can overcome the threat of extreme hunger, brutal weather conditions and lethal wildlife you may just live to appreciate it.

games.name: Red Snow
games.summary: Experience the ultimate fusion of snowboarding and combat in RED SNOW! Navigate perilous slopes, battle enemy forces, and execute stunning tricks to earn cash in this epic board-n-sword adventure.

games.name: Redhowl
games.summary: Social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. 3 factions clash: use your unique powers, unmask them or be devoured before the Blood Moon turns against you.

games.name: Reels of the Damned
games.summary: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

games.name: Reggie, His Cousin, Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World
games.summary: Control the direction of gravity as you run, jump and explore in an outrageous time-traveling adventure as Reggie, an unlikely hero from the 16,000th century on a mission to save science and ultimately the entire universe!

games.name: Rekindled
games.summary: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.

games.name: Relentless Dark
games.summary: I'm just a dude who got bored and wanted to make a fun but scary coop zombie game. If I can do it you can too! It's always been my dream to develop and release a game one day - even if it sells just one copy  Thanks again for all of the amazing feedback so far! Can't wait to play this with you all

games.name: Remnants of Sin: Deck & Puzzle
games.summary: This is a roguelike deckbuilder where cards become tiles. Place shape-based cards onto the board, clear rows and columns, and turn every decision into damage, defense, or special effects. Fight through creatures of the underworld, refine your deck and relics, and see how far your strategy can go.

games.name: Remote Control
games.summary: Remote-control human proxies to explore a derelict spaceship. Type your commands, manage risk and decide how disposable a life really is.

games.name: Reng Azure Requiem
games.summary: Face the soul guardians in your quest for the 7 master keys in this pixel art Action RPG. Evolve your abilities and rely on the help of your protector raven to explore and fulfill this purpose in the grim world of Tartarius.

games.name: Rentcthulhu
games.summary: A dark fairytale deckbuilder where you serve Ancient Gods. Reconstruct shattered stories using card suits and racial synergies. Stack high scores to complete Oracle challenges in this twisted roguelike adventure. Can you mend the fragments before the darkness wins?

games.name: Reroll Routine
games.summary: Reroll Routine is a rolling clicker inspired by autobattler-style shop systems. Buy ROUTINES, earn R€COINS, win the ROLLYMPICS and REROLL your life. One of the past champions, Relder, is here to help you achieve it.

games.name: Resequence: The Orchard
games.summary: Resequence: The Orchard is an occult-horror adventure game in which school counselor Saito approaches an inexplicable phenomena through his counseling sessions with students.

games.name: Reshine
games.summary: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

games.name: Residiuum: Tales of Coral
games.summary:
Explore a universe rich in personality and full of mysteries.

After the sun went mad and exploded, all that was left of the world was the Auric Earth. A region divided between the Elite with their suited men and their experiments and technologies with the multi-purpose gas Sig, and the less fortunate who must deal with gangs of criminals of various kinds and a hostile environment full of toxic and poisonous substances.

games.name: Residuum
games.summary: RESIDUUM is a first-person psychological horror game set in a decaying research facility. With only a dwindling flashlight and faulty heartbeat sensor, manage power, seek answers, and escape what hides in the dark.

games.name: Resolute Bay
games.summary: Forelegs are better than two as you journey across mountains, thickets and plains in search of your lost herd. Master Fight, Flight and Freeze responses to fend off foes in snappy, turn-based battles of wits, then take in the scenery and have a good roll before trotting on.

games.name: Resort Island Simulator
games.summary: A world filled with tricksters, pirates, zealots, and treasures. An ocean full of danger and prize. Face dilemmas and encounters. Manage a resort in this wild world and build a thriving business. An Explorer, a Survivor a Resorter or a Trader? Forge your own path to wealth. Make Resort Prosper!

games.name: Restore the Luminous
games.summary:
Restore the Luminous is a free-to-play digital trading card game in which every card is unlocked the moment the game is installed. There are no booster packs, no gacha and no cards for sale; the only purchases planned are cosmetic.

Two players duel one on one with decks of 40 to 60 cards, built from a single card pool shared by every leader, with a limit of three copies of any one card and no colour restrictions on deckbuilding. Cards are paid for with LP, a resource that comes in five colours: red, blue, green, yellow and black. LP grows and fully refreshes every turn, and its colours are set by discarding cards from your own hand, so deciding what to throw away is as much a part of the game as deciding what to play.

Damage is not a life total that ticks down. It moves cards from the top of the defending player's deck into a damage zone, and a card with a Turnover ability fires that ability for free as it lands there. A player loses when their damage zone fills up. On turns 4 and 7 both leaders evolve at the same time, each drawing an extra card and unlocking the next stage of their own ability.

All four leaders draw from the same card pool, but each has a different innate ability and a different set of numbers: a different opening hand size, a different number of unit slots and a different number of counter slots. The same deck therefore plays differently depending on which leader is holding it.

The game includes solo matches against AI, online 1v1 matchmaking, private friend matches by room ID, and community-run round-robin and bracket tournaments.

games.name: Retro Rail Go!
games.summary: Drive nostalgic Japanese‑style trains through busy city lines and iconic routes. Follow timetables, signals, and station rules to become a master conductor. Choose between relaxed journeys or strict professional challenges in this retro 1990s console‑aesthetic simulator.

games.name: RetroSpace
games.summary: A space station has been swallowed by a black hole, mutants roaming the corridors, and everything seems to have gone mad around you. Be sneaky or blast your way through the station and find a way home, all in a disco-punk atmosphere, as if you were the hero of a 70s B-movie that never existed...

games.name: Retrospect
games.summary: "retrospect" is a novel game consisting of five chapters. Trace the memories of the ghosts and learn about them. That is the only mourning you can do.

games.name: Returnless
games.summary: Eyeball Gun is your weapon. Use it to fight shadow enemies, manipulate time, and escape a city consumed by black fog - no pause, no checkpoints. Progress is saved at the end of a run.

games.name: Revelation of Decay
games.summary: Zombies have taken over our homes! Pick up guns, organize a brave team, and fuck up those monsters! Farm land, scavenge a large apocalyptic world, and fight various of zombies! Modify your weapons, defeat scaring bosses, and finally uncover the truth behind the zombie outbreak and save our home!

games.name: Revenant Maze
games.summary: A first person, action-roguelike that centers around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes intent on defeating you. Only to turn the tides and become the monster yourself.

games.name: RevenBlade
games.summary: RevenBlade is team-based third-person hero shooter with MOBA elements and a focus on melee combat with fast-paced action and mechanical outplays.

games.name: Rewind And Reclaim
games.summary: Rewind and Reclaim is a turn-based adventure inspired by 90's horror movies. Explore different B movie scenarios by creating scenes in which victims outsmart villains. Investigate their terrifying behind the scenes to unfold the story linking them all.

games.name: Rhythm Hotel
games.summary: Rhythm Hotel is open! Grab your camera and capture Einstein’s secret identity! Next door, Socrates is in a heated debate with a stubborn donkey. Don’t panic! It’s our special rhythm challenge — fall behind the beat and you might get kicked into a dimensional rift by the donkey!

games.name: Rich Dad Simulator
games.summary: Run your own chain of markets. Start from a small shop to the biggest business in town. Manage staff, control inventory, set prices, and keep customers happy. Build new locations and expand your retail empire. Can you succeed and become the king of retail?

games.name: Rich Flavors
games.summary: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?

games.name: Rich River
games.summary: Forage the nature for treasures, sell your finds, and use the profits to build a thriving city. Explore, trade, upgrade your tools, and transform the reaches in this cozy clicker life sim.

games.name: Riff Hammer
games.summary: RiffHammer is a rhythm-driven hack-and-slash where you annihilate enemies to crushing metal beats. Wield genre-infused weapons, rage through procedurally generated dungeons or handcrafted scenarios—and import your own music if metal isn’t your thing.

games.name: Rift Fishing
games.summary: Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

games.name: Riftfall
games.summary: HELL DIDN'T CLOSE. IT EVOLVED. A fast, brutal retro indie FPS raised on the 90s classics: a 20-level campaign, 5 heavy weapons with alt-fires, 60+ enemy types, unique boss arenas, AI squadmates, permanent upgrades, skull keys, secrets and an epic soundtrack.

games.name: Rina to Akumu no Kan
games.summary: One day, the unlucky girl "Runa Ichiya" wakes up in a haunted house.

games.name: Ripley Remembered
games.summary: A surreal, story-driven puzzle game set on a train caught in a time loop. Solve narrative-driven puzzles, battle psychic bosses, and uncover the truth about memory, grief, and a girl named Ripley—before the day resets again. Pixel graphics, bullet hells, puzzles, and dialog.

games.name: Rise & Reign
games.summary: Washed ashore on a strange medieval land, its up to you to choose your destiny. Harvest resources, craft weapons, and build your kingdom. Raid other players or work together. Serve the king or take the throne for yourself. This land is harsh, can you survive?

games.name: Rise of Chi
games.summary: When Chi finds her eggs are stolen by sneaky snakes, she is forced to leave everything behind. A brave journey that begins with a personal mission and escalates into something far bigger. Guided by unlikely allies and haunted by self-doubt, Chi must face enemies far greater than she imagined.

games.name: Rise of Sorcery
games.summary: A narrative card-based RPG where every choice shapes your destiny. Master magic by assembling occult whispers, but beware: each spell permeates your body. Manage your magical impregnation or risk the Darkism. Balance your power before magic consumes you.

games.name: Rite of the Dealer
games.summary: Rite of the Dealer is a roguelike multi-deckbuilder where you guide charming rat companions through a peculiar, otherworldly hotel.

games.name: Ritterschlag
games.summary: Ritterschlag is a medieval autobattler: choose from ten classes and defend your hard-earned hop brew for 20 nights against vile rabble. Pick items every night and level attributes to create unique builds with which to smash the bandits' faces in.

games.name: River Drift
games.summary: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

games.name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart
games.summary: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

games.name: Road Kings
games.summary: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

games.name: Road Truckers: New Beginning
games.summary:
Live a trucker’s life in the first trucking sim RPG. Explore villages, cities and wilderness in a fully customizable truck. Get on-foot to eat, sleep, and help people along the way. Your goal: to bring back prosperity in your region. Drive, grow, and inspire!

Experience trucking on a new level: by driving and interacting with the world around you. Make your truck unique by customizing it mechanically and visually, inside and outside. Meet people and decide how to approach them. Enjoy the beautiful scenery in different weather conditions. But most of all, see the change you’re making by supporting the economy.

games.name: RoboFarm
games.summary: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

games.name: Robot Recycler Ryn
games.summary: Build your own custom combat robots, piece by piece! Weld, saw, and shape metal to perfection. Lead your creations into battle as you follow Ryn in Story Mode, or craft freely in Construction Mode.

games.name: Robot Rhapsody
games.summary: A futurist fairytale exploring AI themes, technology, existentialism, and strange transformations in a suffering world. A retro-inspired JRPG presentation of a modernist, character-driven drama.

games.name: RockBeasts
games.summary:
Lead a band of misfits on a roller-coaster ride to stardom in the age of MTV, rock anthems, and bad haircuts. ROCKBEASTS is a story-driven, role-playing management game that puts you in the shoes of a manager of an up-and-coming rock band.

Rock ‘n’ Roll Band Manager: This band has real potential, but they need your help to live up to it. Their tunes can revolutionize the music industry and redefine genres - but what good is a great song if no one hears it? It’s your job to land your clients a record deal and negotiate the terms on their behalf. Will you help them fight for their creative freedom, or sell them out to the industry bigwigs?

Coffee and Cigarettes for Breakfast: Sex, drugs, and rock ’n’ roll can only get you so far. Somebody has to make sure the band is in shape to play the next gig. This is where you come in. Make sure they eat a half-decent meal every now and again, fix their gear, get them to rehearse… Hope you like herding cats!

Don’t Stop Me Now: It’s your job to book the venue, finalize the setlist and ensure the gig goes according to the plan. Each successful performance is a step toward fame and glory. Sure, that “club” was just a grimy basement, and the audience barely outnumbered the band - but even rock legends have to start somewhere, right?

games.name: Rogualik
games.summary: Rogualik is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where you uncover dark, scary secrets of a surrealistic sweet-filled world. Use ridiculous makeshift kitchen weapons, upgrade your croissant with "Mise en place" assets and defeat all the crumbs that stand in your way!

games.name: Rogue Drone
games.summary:
Rogue Drone is a top-down sci-fi strategy game that blends tower defense, base building, and resource management into a single survival loop.

Gather resources and expand your outpost during the day, then defend it against escalating waves of hostile drones at night. Build and optimize your base layout, manage energy distribution, and deploy defensive systems to withstand increasingly dangerous attacks.

Harvest crystal resources, refine them into higher tiers, and unlock new technologies to strengthen your defenses. Every decision shapes your long-term survival as enemy waves grow in complexity and intensity.

With a focus on planning, automation, and deterministic combat, Rogue Drone challenges players to design efficient systems that can survive without direct control when the night begins.

games.name: Rogue Mech
games.summary: Pilot your trusty Phoenix in this isometric, post-apocalyptic mecha survival game with base building elements. Trade, plant, hack, dig, talk and fight your way through the wastelands. If you survive, you might be able to restore a little green to this ash-ridden world.

games.name: Roguebound Pirates
games.summary: Loot, upgrade & dominate! In this action roguelike, your inventory IS your ship. Combine weapons to become absurdly powerful, search for epic treasures, and claim your place as a pirate legend!

games.name: Rootbound
games.summary: A physics-based action adventure about a plantling’s quest to save its home from a mysterious blight. Equipped with your sentient backpack, you venture into a broken world. Meet lost souls, solve ancient puzzles, fight dangerous monsters, and uncover the secrets of a long-forgotten civilization.

games.name: Rostov
games.summary: You've been kidnapped and need to escape a serial killer. In this first-person horror game, you're constantly being hunted and never know when he'll find you. Grab anything you find along the way and try to survive.

games.name: Rot Together
games.summary: A first-person co-op horror game for up to four players set in a medieval world. Explore a procedurally generated map and fight a mysterious cult. Brew potions, kill monsters, chat with your friends. Survival is not guaranteed!

games.name: Rotted: A Brain Rot Simulator
games.summary: Humanity is trapped in an infinite scroll. Your mission: Break the loop and escape the rogue AI controlling your mind. Stack wild powerups and survive the digital prison in this retro PS1-inspired survival roguelite. Shut down the network... or rot.

games.name: Rotten Chamber
games.summary: Rotten Chamber is a single-player social deduction puzzle game. The player faces a circular council of city officials, each with a unique role and identity. Some officials are corrupt and disguising themselves as honest civil servants. Through reading role-based testimony and applying logic, the player must identify and arrest the corrupt officials without wrongfully accusing the Mayor, whose arrest immediately ends the case. The game features 45 hand-designed levels across 3 acts, an endless mode, custom seeds and 15 unique roles with distinct mechanical and narrative identities.

games.name: Rotten Survivor
games.summary: Rotten Survivor is the ULTIMATE 2D top-down horde survivor game! Fight massive hordes of bizarre enemies! Upgrade your equipment, create crazy combinations between all of the different weapons and modifiers and become an unstoppable force!

games.name: Rottenroots
games.summary: Rottenroots is a branching narrative role-playing game set in a dystopian world where conformity means survival. Guide Salem through moral dilemmas, time-pressured choices, and dynamic character interactions. Your decisions shape his personality, relationships, and fate in this gripping story.

games.name: Roughly Crafted
games.summary: Roughly Crafted is a craftsman simulator where you slap together monster bits and odd materials into one-of-a-kind weapons. Run your own shop: experiment with designs, bargain with adventurers, and grow your collection of crafting parts. Remember: the right tool can save a hero’s quest!

games.name: Royal Verdict
games.summary: A medieval court simulation where every verdict matters. Hear cases, uncover lies, and balance the King, the People, and the Church as your reputation shapes the fate of the kingdom.

games.name: RPG Chess
games.summary: A turn-based RPG, except it's also chess! Instead of capturing, your pieces engage in thrilling 1v1 battles where they can level up and unlock powerful abilities. Shape your team as you progress through the single-player campaign or challenge others in online matches!

games.name: Rudravati: Curse of Bhankilla
games.summary: A first-person supernatural horror inspired by the legends of Bhangarh Fort. Explore India’s most haunted place, uncover your brother’s disappearance, and survive the ancient curse that still haunts the ruins.

games.name: Ruin and Rebirth
games.summary: Ruin and Rebirth is a fantasy open-world factory building game with creature taming and breeding. In this playable creation myth, bring life back to a surreal, shattered, post-divine apocalyptic world where the gods have died.

games.name: Rules of Alchemy
games.summary: Defy fate as you blast your way through a procedural open world, in this spell combo roguelike with thousands of items and hundreds of spells.

games.name: Runa in Nightmare House
games.summary: One day, the unlucky girl "Runa Ichiya" wakes up in a haunted house.

games.name: Runback
games.summary: Runback is a platform fighter where losing is far from the end, with every round giving you power ups to choose from! With over 200 custom cards, every game is a unique experience.

games.name: Rune Fencer Illyia
games.summary: Rune Fencer Illyia is an intense, atmospheric action-platformer with a heavy focus on exploration and combat. Traverse an enormous and dangerous world, meet strange allies, and outfight your numerous foes with fast-paced swordplay and stolen runic magic.

games.name: Runic Tower
games.summary: Stand as the last guardian of the god-bound Runic Tower in a groundbreaking 3rd-person roguelike tower defense experience. Command evolving powers, confront relentless invading factions, and utilize strategic planning to overcome your foes!

games.name: RunMan Turbo
games.summary: The indie legend returns, now in a 2D platformer where you speedrun randomly generated levels. Bounce, slide, jump, and run fast as heck. Easy to play and challenging to master, with an awesome soundtrack and a style that will make you go, "Oh snap!"

games.name: Rural Cat Trails
games.summary: Explore Nanoha Town, in the Japanese countryside, during the cherry blossom season as a cat. Use unique cat actions like Wall Jump, Dig, Paw Swat and Wiggle Butt Dash to make your way to Sakurana Shrine, a place of memories with your late Grandpa.

games.name: Russian Village Business
games.summary: Become a young entrepreneur who arrives in the Russian countryside and opens a village shop. Buy and sell goods, upgrade your store, and make this village great again - just like in the good old days!

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

games.name: Safo and The Moon Warriors
