games.summary: In a world where the sun no longer rises, Prince Safo must rescue his sister from Argus, a mysterious one-eyed monster. Joined by diverse companions, this adventure RPG features beautiful illustrations and a novel-like story as players uncover secrets in this sunless world.

games.name: Sails
games.summary: Plunder, craft and live the pirate’s life. This is a multiplayer pirate survival game where you mine, craft, trade and plunder to survive. Form alliances with other players to strengthen your crew and wage war on your enemies. Fight to keep what’s yours before others take it.

games.name: Saintless
games.summary: Explore the halls of the underground cult of The Open Hand. Experience the test rooms setup for your initiation in this psychological horror exploration game. Never forget....they are always watching.

games.name: Sakimori
games.summary: "Sakimori, find and purify the Cursed Objects disrupting the boundary." Explore shunned ruins and observe invisible threats. With Tsukino Saku, a spirit sentinel, survive where Utsushiyo (living) and Kakuriyo (spirit) intersect. Purify Cursed Objects in this Japanese survival horror action.

games.name: Sakura Arms: Radiant Duels
games.summary: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponents tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides selections.

games.name: Samurai Bringer: Rampage
games.summary: Samurai Bringer: Rampage is a deck-building auto battler where you strategically form your squad by arranging samurai units and combining weapons and abilities to suit your tactics. Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!

games.name: Sanctuaries
games.summary: The conquistadors just landed and they are coming for your treasure! You must protect your Sanctuaries against this new threat. Take arms, lay down traps, improve your empire and lead your Heroes into battle to repel the invaders!

games.name: Sangra
games.summary: Classic survival horror with a modern feel. Solve puzzles, search for items, manage your inventory, and pray you'll return to the safe room alive in this decaying twisted facility consumed by a mysterious metallic corruption.

games.name: Santa's Burnout
games.summary: Santa has officially quit. The kids are too spoiled, and the magic is gone. This year, the Toy Factory has been converted into a strip mine. Click rocks, crush hope, and manage a cynical coal mining operation in this dark industrial idle game. Your goal? Ensure everyone gets coal for Christmas.

games.name: Sarco
games.summary: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

games.name: Sato
games.summary: Manipulate space and time in this planetary puzzle-platformer. Learn the rules to unravel more of the world and the secrets within. Do you remember? 183 15.

games.name: Save My Human
games.summary: This is the story about a little girl who is taken to an evil world inside a video game, and her dog embarks on an adventure to save her. The dog will not be alone, he will encounter other pets who are also searching for their owners.

games.name: Saveseeker
games.summary:
Saveseeker is a turn-based RPG adventure that follows a tenacious time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

Play as Emmer Edette, a cheerful and carefree child who discovers she inherited her famous father's ability to 'save' moments in time at specific points worldwide. Alongside her grumpy dragon toy sidekick, Tippleton, she embarks on a journey to overwrite all of the world’s save points (“Save Stops”) and confront her father, a once-great Hero using his power for nefarious means.

Explore six vibrant lands, recruit the Hero’s former foes, and save the world from an untimely end!

games.name: Saw: Genesis
games.summary: A century before Jigsaw, survival demanded sacrifice. Experience the thrilling world of SAW first-hand in a new 3v1 multi-player horror game where three Accused must work together to escape a maze of traps, while one Judge orchestrates their rehabilitation.

games.name: Sayagatari: Promise of the Cursed Blade
games.summary: "My love for you began with that kiss." Ex-Kendo practitioner Kanemori Tōya, comes across Saya who seals demonic blades. Saving him from his murderous impulse curse is a kiss from Saya!? The two begin living together, battling with demonic blade in hand. Break the curse with a kiss from this beauty!

games.name: Sayonara Wild Hearts
games.summary: Sayonara Wild Hearts is a euphoric music video dream about being awesome, riding motorcycles, skateboarding, dance battling, shooting lasers, wielding swords, and breaking hearts at 200 mph.

games.name: Scarlet Skips
games.summary: Jump jump jump as much as you can in this silly 1-button Rogue-Like about skipping rope! Power up your jump ropes to help Scarlet jump higher, survive longer, and reach absurdly high scores! boing boing boing boing boing boing boing boing

games.name: Scattered
games.summary: Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of hidden kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home.

games.name: SchoolBoy OutDoors
games.summary: You’re a schoolboy who ran away from home to hang out — but this is only the beginning! Summer, friends, backyard mischief… and mysteries hiding something much darker. Explore the streets, avoid adults, and uncover a secret you were better off not knowing.

games.name: Schoolgirl vs. Fishman
games.summary: Schoolgirls × Mermen × Sewers! A "drenched" horror adventure! Solve mysteries to find an exit, and decide: will you run or fight? Your choices branch the story. Can they escape this nightmare safely...?

games.name: Scicry
games.summary: A first-person sci-fi action-horror. After a catastrophic event, the station’s crew has mutated, turning its corridors into a deadly labyrinth. Explore the station, scavenge resources, and fight monsters to survive.

games.name: Scopecreep
games.summary: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

games.name: Scorched Sun
games.summary: Scorched Sun is a short experience that combines top down survival horror with turn based combat. As a new initiate, delve into the depths of a monastery of the Scorched Sun order and discover the secrets within.

games.name: Scorched Warfare
games.summary: This is a strategy action game set in a fictional fantasy world. You play as a warmaster, commanding troops in battles. Use the roguelike system to customize your gameplay style: will you be a one-man army, standing against thousands, or a mastermind tactician controlling the battlefield?

games.name: SCP RP
games.summary: A multiplayer SCP roleplay experience where a living facility is powered by programmable-driven characters, dynamic events, and player choice.

games.name: SCP: Darkwater
games.summary: A psychological horror game inspired by SCP-1128. As a young woman trapped in a surreal loop, explore your bathroom and submerge yourself in the bathtub to enter a terrifying ocean dimension inhabited by a colossal entity lurking in the depths.

games.name: Scramble Knights Online
games.summary: Welcome to Scramble Knights Online! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracotta! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training.

games.name: Scraps of the Machine
games.summary: FPS Mech Action! Pilot a mass of steel through a single player campaign set in a desolate landscape. Target enemy armor or weapons to wear them down piece by piece, find upgrades to improve your mech or change its loadout, and survive in a world of rust and decay. Discover, Destroy, Scavenge.

games.name: Scrybe
games.summary: SCRYBE is an incremental game with multiple playstyles. Battle cities for hidden resources, unlock secrets and gear, and progress at your own pace. There’s no right way to play — choose your path and enjoy the journey!

games.name: Scumbag Streamer
games.summary: Scumbag Streamer is a story RPG game where you play as a streamer. Interact with NPCs and the environment to get as much money and viewers as possible! Your choices will determine the type of streamer you are and the audience you get.

games.name: Seasonal Lockdown
games.summary: An anxiety inducing survival game where you must balance removing anomalies while keeping unstable robotics under control. You are an undercover agent discovering the dark secrets an establishment owner is hiding from the government.

games.name: Secret Files: Tunguska - Remastered
games.summary: The award-winning adventure classic returns as a remaster with modernized visuals and updated technology. Join Nina and Max on a globe-spanning investigation filled with puzzles, conspiracies, and danger - and uncover the secret of Tunguska that changes everything!

games.name: Secret of Havendor
games.summary: Survive the shadows of your past. Forge your path in a world where blood and targets are currency. Will you cling to your humanity or become the monster they see?

games.name: Sectron
games.summary: Sci-fi turn-based strategy on procedurally generated planetoids. Expand your base, deploy and upgrade units, negotiate alliances, and conquer each unique world. Simple rules, deep tactics. Easy to learn, hard to master.

games.name: Seed
games.summary: SEED is a 24/7 persistent society simulator MMO where your characters live, work, and die even while you’re offline. Collaborate with thousands of players in a single-shard world to build economies, interact with and manage your Seedlings, and shape the laws of a new planet.

games.name: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey
games.summary: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey is a role-playing card game set in the Seekers Alliance universe. Venture into the mysterious Sovereign's Island with a diverse cast of Heroes, strengthening your decks through battles and encounters; confront powerful foes and uncover the Island's hidden secrets.

games.name: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits
games.summary: Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about Mika, a young girl searching for her lost cat, Seina. Her journey leads her into a peaceful, hand-painted world filled with cute animal spirits, ancient shrines, and quiet magic.

games.name: Sekira
games.summary: Dark forces are penetrating our world! Help the humble priestess Anachel crush the heads of the Dark Lord and all his minions!

games.name: Send In The Vampires
games.summary: Maniacs have taken over the asylum. Restore order with your fists in the ultimate gothic arcade beat em up. Supports up to 4 players in couch coop/remote play.

games.name: Sender Unknown
games.summary: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

games.name: Senior Survival Club
games.summary: In a zombie apocalypse, a grandmother takes a chainsaw to find her grandson. Defeat slow, persistent zombies, collect gear, and strengthen with exercise. Advance through ever-stronger hordes, reclaiming youthful power in this survival action game.

games.name: Separator
games.summary: Separator is a short nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, inspired by modern occultism and beliefs surrounding mysticism.

games.name: Sepium
games.summary: Investigate and localize abnormal activities in this 1-4 players survival horror game. Find your way to various locations where something odd is happening, while trying hard to keep your crew alive.

games.name: Sepulchron
games.summary: An atmospheric puzzle-horror game where you have 72 in-game hours to escape with your life. Solve challenging puzzles that require logical deduction during the day, survive assaults from hostile ghosts at night, and uncover the mystery behind Astor Manor.

games.name: Serenity
games.summary: A zen gliding and exploration game with procedurally generated music

games.name: Serial World
games.summary: "SerialWorld" is a comedic yet serious RPG. Whether you've played deck-building games before or not, everyone can enjoy this adventurous tale. Embark on a journey into the mysterious world to solve the city's disturbances!

games.name: SeverSoul Xookeeper
games.summary: Keep the entities fed, pacified and contained every night within a dark decaying facility. Can you survive each shift in this intense point & click horror?

games.name: Shadow & Steel
games.summary: Shadow & Steel is a top-down hack-and-slash arena shooter set in a fantasy world. Battle hordes of undead, demons, and living nightmares designed to push your combat skills to the limit. Strike up close with your blade and weave arcane spells from a distance.

games.name: Shadow Dwellers: Deliverance
games.summary: Deliver, or take it back. An observation-based horror game where you process packages while watching for subtle irregularities in the same apartment building. No correct answers are given. What remains are your decisions—and the recorded “variations.”

games.name: Shadow Hills Manor
games.summary: Shadow Hills Manor is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and looting. Break into the manor left behind by greed and decay. Search for valuables, but the more you take, the angrier the manor becomes. Your choice of greed shapes how the manor reacts.

games.name: Shadow of the Moonlight
games.summary: A dark fantasy visual novel set in a medieval world. You are the privileged son of a wealthy family, seeking revenge, even if it means becoming an outlaw. Will you dare to face your weakness and strength? How far will you go to find your true enemy? Uncover your roots' secrets. Survive… if you can.

games.name: Shadow of the Road
games.summary: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

games.name: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a grim survival horror game where you investigate the secrets of an ancient monastery, solve intricate puzzles, and face terrifying nightmares that haunt its shadowy halls. Hunt the Haunt.

games.name: Shadows of Midnight: They Watch Me Sleep
games.summary: The game is a narrative-driven horror experience inspired by the Silent Hill and Fears to Fathom franchises. Live through two terrifying stories: a man’s summer getaway turns into a nightmare at a shady hotel, and a child grows up knowing something watches from the forest—always waiting.

games.name: Shadows of the Deepforge
games.summary: An assassin weaving through ruin, striking fast and vanishing faster. The halls test your cunning, the darkness tests your nerve. Torchlight betrays, silence protects, and every shadow is both a hiding place and a threat.

games.name: Shadows of the Werewolf
games.summary: Shadows of the Werewolf is a cinematic, third-person action-adventure game that places players in a suspenseful, horror-filled world. The story unfolds across various locations, including a suburban home and a mysterious forest retreat, where an innocent couple faces a relentless werewolf and other monstrous creatures. Players will engage in tense exploration, object interaction, and combat, using stealth and strategy to hide, fight, and escape from supernatural threats. The game blends elements of classic horror films and survival horror games, offering a narrative-driven, single-player experience filled with fear, suspense, and the challenge of survival under the full moon.

games.name: Shadowstone
games.summary: Shadowstone is a 1-4 player tactics game where players must master strategic positioning and powerful hero synergies to survive against the unrelenting horrors of the Sunderlands.

games.name: Shape Sender Deluxe
games.summary: Solve physics puzzles with magnets, springs, portals, fans, and more while your new best friend Sendy helps you along the way! But maybe keep an eye on him, he's been acting a little … strange, lately.

games.name: Shardbreakers
games.summary: Reclaim and synergize raw Shards to craft your own Magic in this fast-paced bullet-hell action roguelike. Unlock new heroes, unleash chaos, and conquer hand-crafted realms swallowed by darkness.

games.name: Shardpunk 2
games.summary: The Empire may have fallen, but humanity continues the fight. Shardpunk 2 puts you in command of a human outpost in this potent mix of turn-based tactical strategy, RPG, survival and resource management as you gather your team, scavenge for resources and prepare for a new, evolving threat.

games.name: Shatterfarms
games.summary: Farm. Forage. Fight. Shatterfarms is a first-person farmcore roguelike where you'll scavenge and fight through the calamity, while cultivating a mysterious farm to survive and grow stronger. Creatures are untamed, magic unstable, and horrors unimaginable. Welcome to Shatterfarms.

games.name: Shelf-Employed
games.summary: Shelf-Employed is a first-person organization game set inside a chaotic magical warehouse. Sort thousands of packages, master useful spells, and upgrade your workflow as you turn towering piles of boxes into perfectly ordered shelves.

games.name: Shell as Hard as Steel
games.summary: A horror game about an elevator repair technician who, as he ascends, discovers what became of those who never made it back down.

games.name: Shenmue III Enhanced
games.summary: Step back into the world of Shenmue III with the Enhanced Edition, the latest release of Yu Suzuki's legendary adventure series. Faithful to its roots yet enriched with modern improvements, this enhanced version offers the most polished and accessible way to experience Ryo Hazuki's journey.

games.name: Sherpa's Caravan
games.summary: Explore a cozy open world as a sherpa driver in your van! Deliver cargo, cook food, craft gear, and explore mountains, lakes, and hidden trails. Sail in boats and kayaks, dive underwater. Meet old friends and upgrade your van! A camping atmosphere and next-gen graphics.

games.name: Shibuya Sushi Master
games.summary: Cyberpunk sushi master adventure

games.name: Shine On, My Little Sun
games.summary: When the Sun fell, darkness covered the world. In the snowy wasteland, the town of Svargo thrived under its faint light. But the Sun did not go out. The small Sun sleeps atop a grim lighthouse. What happens when the Sun awakens, seeking a few days of simple childhood?

games.name: Ship Happens
games.summary: You and your best mates have embarked upon a noble, but extremely dangerous mission. Spacecrafts throughout the galaxy are calling for help - can your crew take the controls and guide them to safety away from ravenous, ever-expanding black holes?

games.name: Shop Crush
games.summary: Run a mysterious thrift shop in a story-rich Visual Novel. Meet eccentric customers, uncover hidden illusions, and unveil the sinister secret of your shop.

games.name: Short Short Fictions
games.summary: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

games.name: Shothop
games.summary: Shothop is a violent retro boomer-shooter blending fast-paced movement mechanics with brutal combat. Utilize movement mechanics, cleanse the robot invasion, and restore the portal defense network. Reboot the grid. Survive the shift.

games.name: Show Quiz
games.summary: Show Quiz is a dynamic quiz game that tests your knowledge and reflexes! Chain together questions, climb levels and improve your rank to impress Jack Pot, your supercharged presenter.Over 5000 questions await you in this game!

games.name: Showa American Story
games.summary: Showa American Story is a brand new RPG and an enthusiastic love letter to the 80s' pop culture that features a strong taste of B-Movies. Follow Choko's journey of truth and revenge across North America as she grows stronger.

games.name: Shrine of Haunts
games.summary: In the summer of 1990, you return to the secluded mountain village of Iwao as your grandfather falls critically ill. The village shrine is said to seal the yokai "Tsuchigumo." As the "Mushi Okuri Festival" nears, its ritual flames may awaken a thousand-year-old curse…

games.name: Shrine Protectors
games.summary: A casual arrow shooter meets rogue-lite strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, and unlock powerful upgrades and passive spells. Combine precision shooting with tactical army management in this relentless bullet hell.

games.name: Shroomwood
games.summary: Top-down bullet hell with challenging roguelike progression. Unlock and upgrade your town as you fight through procedural levels.

games.name: Shuffle Farm
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where farming meets the arcane. Build powerful synergies, master production chains, explore uncharted lands, and face formidable challenges - all with the help of a mysterious god. Or just chill and plant some crops... you can do that too!

games.name: Shy Cats Hidden Tracks Collection
games.summary: A musical hidden object game where you search the streets of 9 CITIES for singing kittens from a choir and money bags to hire and assemble a cat band. As orchestra conductor, you'll be able to configure the musicians as you wish, creating your own music and choir melodies. Find them all!

games.name: Sigils of Nightfall
games.summary: Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines dungeon crawling with elements of the award-winning RPG, Mörk Borg. Embark on a dark journey, improve your character, and survive at all costs — or be consumed by the horrors lurking in the darkness.

games.name: Sign It
games.summary: Monteririo, a city steeped in violence and vice, welcomes a young examining magistrate. An appointment from the Crown has effectively exiled you to this southern outpost, a thousand leagues from home. Tell me—is there truly a way back to the North for you?

games.name: Sign: Broken Kether
games.summary: Sign is a visual novel series that blends fantasy, urban life, and adventure. The story follows Lyra, a high school girl who encounters Cygnus, a witch from another world. Together, they embark on a journey to reclaim the witch’s lost powers.

games.name: Signal Hill
games.summary: Signal Hill is a psychological multiplayer horror game blending exploration, teamwork, and survival. Decode signals, uncover the truth, and face what’s waiting in the dark.

games.name: Silence of Elven Mage Rin
games.summary: A puzzle game featuring a beautiful elven sorceress.

games.name: Silent Road
games.summary: Drive through Japan’s suicide ring in your night-shift taxi. Pick up strange passengers, fulfill their unsettling requests and follow the silent road as their stories make each ride darker than the last.

games.name: Sin: Reloaded
games.summary: Nightdive Studios and 3D Realms have joined forces to bring you SiN: Reloaded, a completely remastered experience of the classic 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. SiN was a groundbreaking story driven FPS brimming with memorable characters, horrific enemies and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now in 2020 SiN has been Reloaded!

games.name: Sirin's Feather
games.summary: The Bird of the Dead has taken your beloved. How many times will you have to die to bring her back? Gather companions, uncover their secrets, and shape the story in a world where pagan myths come alive.

games.name: Sisters of Solitude
games.summary: Explore a haunted convent with your EMF detector, tape recorder, and camera. Uncover the fate of four ghostly sisters and the mystery behind the murder they commited. Every room hides a clue, every shadow a warning, and the truth waits for those who dare to seek it.

games.name: Skateboard Knight
games.summary: Hop on a skateboard and casually save the world! Simple controls—just move up or down the lanes. Horizontal movement and attacks are all auto!

games.name: Skatebound
games.summary: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

games.name: Skeleboy
games.summary: Skeleboy is a Breakout-like action Rogue-lite game. Guide Skeleboy through Hell, upgrade his skulls to perfection and save the bones of the dead Princess! Be the Skeleboy you always wanted to be.

games.name: Skill Eater
games.summary: Skill Eater is a roguelite game where you've been turned into a slime with no choice but to steal opponents' skills to grow stronger. Eat your way through the humans and monsters that stand in your way, claim their powers, and aim to defeat the final boss that awaits you.

games.name: Skingdom
games.summary: Create your own ski realm in Skingdom, a ski resort construction and management game! Arrange your resort, draw your slopes and build your lifts, hotels and shops. Take care of your budget, hire staff and invest in upgrades for your ski resort to reach the top of the mountain!

games.name: Skroll
games.summary: Wake up, junkie. Your brain is hungry and only infinite scrolling can satisfy it. Manage dopamine, battery, and sanity in this survival roguelike about digital slavery.

games.name: Skyclimbers
games.summary: Build your kingdom, choose your class, and tame monsters in this Multiplayer City-Building/Open-World Action RPG that takes place in a procedurally generated anime-themed metaverse.

games.name: Skylark 64
games.summary: A 64-bit 3D Collect-a-thon Platformer where you play as A flying squirrel who can glide, run, jump and roll in open non-linear levels collecting Acorns, Soul Leaves and 7 pieces of armor with unique power-ups! You can even play with a friend in Split-Screen Co-op!

games.name: SkyRen
games.summary: Race, climb, and free-run through dynamic cityscapes! Build your character, master movement, compete with players, earn gear, level up, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate free-runner in this anime parkour MMO!

games.name: SkyRig
games.summary: Build floating automated rigs in a volatile gas giant. Extract elements, synthesize compounds, and descend through atmospheric layers in this sci-fi systems-builder focused on chemistry, engineering, and survival.

games.name: Slain 2: The Beast Within
games.summary: A brutal gothic hack-and-slash where steel and savagery collide. As Prince Akran, wield the sentient blade Bathoryn, embrace your werewolf fury, and battle through a dying world. The time for hesitation is over. The quest begins now. Akran’s fate - and the fate of the kingdom - rests in your hands.

games.name: Slam City with Scottie Pippen: Respect Edition
Slash-Out: Fantasy Dueling
games.summary: Slash-Out is a twin-stick sword-fighter against a gauntlet of boss battles. Master both the sword and shield to best fearsome opponents and prove yourself as the hero of the kingdom!

games.name: Slaughterhouse
games.summary: A 90s style point and click game. Blizzard. Stranded. Eight days. Enemies — kill them all.

games.name: Sleep Walk
games.summary: A son attempts to bridge the emotional divide between himself and his father in an attempt to get them both to stop dwelling on the past and create a new path forward together. Sleep Walk is a story about forgiveness and self worth.

games.name: Sligga Trigger
games.summary: Suit up and sling some shells at sadistic, superpowered sci-fi slugs. Snag some secrets, suffer some shrapnel, and shoot the shit out of some Sliggas in this one-of-a-kind twin-stick shooter.

games.name: Slingbox
games.summary: Slingbox is a minimalist, physics-based 2D platformer where precision and momentum are everything. Master your dash and rope mechanics to swing, launch and race through clean abstract levels. Beat the clock, earn medals and chase perfection.

games.name: Slopeside Kings
games.summary:
Slopeside Kings is a multiplayer snowboarding combat racing game.
In Slopeside Kings you shred down the slopes, catch big air, and pull off tricks to build boost then use chaotic items to battle your way to the finish line.

games.name: Sloppy Forgeries
games.summary: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced, two-player local multiplayer painting game. Each player is given a mouse, a blank canvas, and a few simple paint tools. Each round, a famous painting from art history is revealed. Players race to copy the painting as quickly and accurately as possible.

games.name: Slots & Slaughter
games.summary: Spin slots, win gold, buy and upgrade items, then battle bizarre enemies as you build an overpowered item deck in this casual yet tactical roguelike deck-builder.

games.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
games.summary: Stay afloat and navigate challenging waterpark rides against up to 16 online players. Spray water, slide, score, and aim to become the pool's most distinguished duck!

games.name: Small Kingdoms
games.summary: Rule a small fantasy kingdom and conquer your rivals as you build up cities and armies on the world map and command troops on the battlefield. Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and RTS game with small procedurally generated world maps, and campaigns you can complete in a weekend

games.name: Smalland II: Lost Realms
games.summary: The Smallfolk are back with a massively expanded universe in this open-world survival adventure set on a tiny scale! Enjoy up to 10 player co-op where you craft weapons and armor, form companionships with creatures, build encampments, and discover strange new lands.

games.name: Smash Simulator
games.summary: Inherit a failing company and transform it into a destruction empire! Build and manage your own Rage Rooms, let clients smash objects to relieve stress… and turn it all into profit!

games.name: Snack Factory Together
games.summary: Team up with friends to build a successful snack business. Start with a small room and simple machines, then grow into a massive factory.

games.name: Snack Invaders
games.summary: Slipping into a junk food‑induced coma during a late‑night movie marathon, you wake up as an astronaut stranded in a galaxy overrun by living junk food! Play solo or co‑op online with up to 3 friends (4 players max) to battle hordes of junk food and Souls‑like bosses as you fight to escape alive!

games.name: Snake in the Dark
games.summary: Sure, you've played Snake. But could you play it blind? Snake in the Dark is a total re-imagination of the timeless arcade and puzzle game classics like Snake and Sokoban. Fun gameplay you know delivered with more puzzling twisssts than you expect!

games.name: Snap Quest
games.summary: A Photo Collection Adventure Game. Complete your research notebook, solve creature puzzles, earn research grant money. Buy upgrades for your camera, rebuild the town, bond with the locals, and reveal the paranormal mystery of Star Island.

games.name: Snug
games.summary: Snug is a cozy game about packing bags just the way you like. Stack, sort, and squeeze everyday objects into oddly shaped spaces with physics, jiggling, and the satisfaction of fitting things neatly into place.

games.name: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs
games.summary: Sobakistan — the land of dogs, is a darkly satirical narrative immersion in a closed-off totalitarian dog state — where any step could send you to prison.

games.name: Soft(A)ware
games.summary: Soft(A)ware is a surreal puzzle-platformer set inside a vast, hostile system. You awaken in a virtual world that functions as a prison — a place designed to limit, to control, to erase any trace of freedom.

games.name: Software CEO
games.summary: Build your own software empire from scratch. Manage projects, recruit staff, design components, and grow from a garage startup to a tech giant. Create SaaS platforms, sell software, or fulfill contracts. Balance quality, deadlines, and innovation in this relaxing yet deep business simulation game.

games.name: Solar Voltage
games.summary: After a huge solar storm destroyed their ship and left them stranded, help Volt and her crewmates escape the dangerous planet filled with deadly robots and a mysterious AI.

games.name: Solo Leveling: Arise
games.summary: Solo Leveling: Arise is an action RPG based on the South Korean web novel of the same name.

games.name: Sombie
games.summary: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.

games.name: Someone's Inside Me
games.summary: Your teacher Ms. Morbid has trapped you and your classmates on a deadly multiplayer field trip inside a human body! With proximity chat, two teams must scavenge, sabotage, and outwit each other to see who escapes first.

games.name: Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story
games.summary: "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story" is an action-adventure platformer following the story of a failing musician named Sondro, who must seek and recover the wish-granting Mystic Orbs to repay his debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Can he find them before the many rogues of Sunova beat him to the punch?

games.name: Songs of Glimmerwick
games.summary: Become immersed in a musical woodland fantasy world where casting a spell is as easy as playing a song. Attend classes, grow the university garden, make friends with classmates and townsfolk, and explore the island’s many oddities and mysteries in this story-driven witch academy RPG.

games.name: Sonic Valkyria: Kanon
games.summary: "Every time you shoot an enemy, music is born." The heartbeat of rock becomes your aim. An impulse shooting game with anime song rock and lock-on! "Sonic Valkyria: KANON"

games.name: Sonnet
games.summary: Transport a magical flower across scenic lands, encounter strange travelers, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets in this sprawling medieval roadtrip.

games.name: Sottaku
games.summary: Sottaku is a multiplayer video game in which players compete against each other, Geoguessr-style, in order to quickly read or fill in the blanks in cloze or reading sentences, across Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

games.name: Soul Blade
games.summary: "Soul Blade" is a 2D platform action game with classic hand-drawn 2D animations that provide a smooth and immersive visual experience. The combat system is built around the "swordplay" mechanism, delivering intense and exhilarating battles.

games.name: Soul Devourer
games.summary: Soul Devourer is a metroidvania action-platformer with a classic 2D horror style. You'll explore the vast, cursed Sakuradoki High School, master unique abilities, fight twisted monsters and uncover the long-buried secrets concealed under the school.

games.name: Soul Hunter
games.summary: A team of young paranormal researchers ventures into the cursed corners of Japan to prove the existence of the spirit world. Ghosts feed on fear and the sanity of the living, luring you into traps of illusion. Your only defense is a special camera, capable of banishing spirits and unveiling secrets.

games.name: Souls End
games.summary: Souls End is an auto-battler roguelike where you'll draft unstoppable armies, placing units and items in just the right way to create awesome synergies! Cast spells while battles unfold and find relics to further elevate builds. Will you defeat life itself-or will you meet a Souls End?

games.name: Soulscape 2: Fragments of the Present
games.summary: Soulscape 2 is a Turn-based RPG set in the dystopian near future. Featuring an isometric exploration, party-based combat, and a branching dialogue that is shaped by your choices in the game.

games.name: Sound System
games.summary: Sound System is a next-generation rhythm game that brings guitar gaming back, while introducing an entirely new platform built around free music and community-driven gameplay. Shred guitar, sing vocals, and build your own note charts for any tune anytime, unlocking a new era of music gaming.

games.name: Soundscapes
games.summary: Soundscapes is an interactive music sandbox where your songs shape the world around you.

games.name: Soup-of-War
games.summary: You are a clumsy one-armed pirate cook desperately trying to prepare meals for your crew by grabbing, cutting, and throwing ingredients into pots while your ship heaves violently on stormy seas, turning every simple cooking task into a chaotic physics-based struggle against time and your own limitations.

games.name: Souq Boss Simulator
games.summary: Run your own Baqala in a nostalgic 2002 Gulf neighborhood inspired by old Dubai and Riyadh. Stock iconic childhood products, serve familiar faces, complete quests, unlock special items, make deliveries with friends, and use your BB Gun to stop thieves as you build your way to becoming the Souq Boss

games.name: Sova
games.summary: Descend into a surreal sci-fantasy world in this narrative-driven action roguelite, where every run reshapes your story. Sova’s expressive combat meets deeply branching dialogue and world-shifting decisions. Compose your violence, rewrite your past, and bend a crumbling realm to your will.

games.name: Soviet Spooky Tales: Green Eyes
games.summary: Have you ever heard of the damn Green Record? Or maybe the Black Sheet is trying to kill you at night? Have you ever seen a Blue Nail in a pie? The visual novel "Soviet Spooky Tales: Green Eyes" is the first of five planned games in the entourage of Soviet children's horror stories, where everything happens for real. The story tells about a girl named Dasha from 4th grade, who disobeyed her mother and listened to a green record. Together with her, you will face a mysterious and terrible evil, and only you can decide what awaits her in the end ^___^

games.name: Space Cat Solitaire
games.summary:
Space Cat Solitaire is a euphoric and satisfying puzzle card game adventure. With cats.

Stack, organize and pros-purr! Hone your puzzling skills as you create epic combos, beat your high score and find your fortune among the stars! Use your wits & your winnings to unlock customizations, trophies, and elite story-driven missions featuring the eccentric locals of the Whiskerfang Expanse.

games.name: Space Diner Simulator
games.summary: After buying a rundown diner, you need to repair it and bring it to its full glory. Manage, renovate and upgrade the diner to attract more customers, and meet their demands. Bring a piece of home to the edges of space with Earths best recipes.

games.name: Space Scavenger 2
games.summary: Space Scavenger 2 is an Action-Roguelike where you scavenge for modules to build a hodgepodge spaceship. Upgrade and customize your ship on-the-fly to make the best of a terrible situation. Playful and colorful - who said you can't smack aliens with a huge hammer in space?

games.name: Spaceborne Fighters
games.summary: Spaceborne Fighters is a dynamic action platformer featuring arena battles against hordes of enemies. Explore 10 diverse maps, develop your character through skill trees, and craft items to face challenges in the most spectacular way.

games.name: Spaceman's Luck
games.summary: Do you have a Spaceman's Luck? A space strategy game.

games.name: Spaceships and Cellular Automata
games.summary: Spaceships and Cellular Automata is a tower defense game set in space! Place different towers to defend your ship against the waves of aliens. The enemies are simulated based on Conway's Game of Life. Even just one of your bullets is enough to cause a destabilizing chain reaction to destroy them!

games.name: Spark! Photon Blast
games.summary: "SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-" is a sports action game where players face off in a futuristic stadium, rendered with stunningly beautiful photorealistic graphics. Your goal is to score by launching a sphere into your opponent's goal. Enjoy the heart-pounding, high-octane action where every second counts!

games.name: Speak of my sin
games.summary: Speak of My Sin is a word reasoning game - players are supposed to find the truth of the cases, restore the story in a number of interrelated cases and finally detect the identification of “me”, speaking out “my” sin.

games.name: Specters of the Sun
games.summary: Specters of the Sun is a challenging 2D action platformer with action-packed levels. Take on the role of an elusive specter to reclaim your old corpse, now possessed at the heights of your former kingdom.

games.name: Spectral Protocol
games.summary: Spectral Protocol is a psychological horror game where you’re trapped in a mysterious facility. Play solo or in two-player co-op, find hidden buttons, and escape terrifying creatures. Danger is everywhere ! will you survive or become another lost test subject?

games.name: Spectral Report
games.summary: Enter abandoned locations as Spectral Reporters to prove the existence of ghosts. But beware: sanity is fragile, and not everything you see is real. Cooperate with your team, investigate the place, take evidences, and finally prove that ghosts are real.

games.name: Spellcaster University: Gears and Gobelins
games.summary: Dive into an epic new chapter of Spellcaster University's magical world with the "Steam Age" expansion!

games.name: Spider Dynasty
games.summary: This is a completely innovative Metroidvania-like game. There are two ancient trees host two royal families who have maintained an aerial dynasty woven from spider silk for generations. However, unknown evil forces are corrupting the entire silk world…

games.name: Spider Hotel
games.summary: Run, hide, survive in SPIDER HOTEL—an asymmetrical 1v4 chase. Hunt as the wall-crawling Spider or cooperate as the Insects to rescue allies and escape. Traps & abilities decide who gets cocooned.

games.name: Spinbot
games.summary: A roguelite drenched in 00's competitive shooter vibes. In Spinbot, you trade your soul for cheats. Wipe out waves of bots and upgrade your "wordprocessor.exe" with some amazing features.

games.name: Spiriki: Tiny Island
games.summary: Listening to the gentle sound of the waves, take care of three small quirky nature spirits! With their help and some patience, create your own tiny cozy diorama and bring back life to your overgrown island!

games.name: Spirit Crossing
games.summary: Spirit Crossing is a beautiful cooperative life-sim about building friendships and community. Sign up for our Closed Alpha playtest and discover a world where you can connect, escape, and belong.

games.name: Spirit Vendor
games.summary: I built Spirit Vendor as a solo indie dev, and I'm excited to share it with you! In this charming world, you decide how your day unfolds—run your shop, tend your fields, and care for your animals. Explore a lively village, meet unique characters, build friendships, and perhaps even find true love.

games.name: Splash Girls
games.summary: Splash Girls is an exhilarating shooting action game in which you must save girls who have grown gigantic due to a mysterious virus. Players wield a vaccine-firing gun and a massive syringe to stand against the rampaging virus. The only thing that can save these giant girls is your extra-thick injection!? An flashy rescue mission of extraordinary scale and intensity is about to begin.

games.name: Split Brain Samsara
games.summary:
You and your friend are locked in the same body!
In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure!
Communication will be key!

games.name: Spook-A-Boo
games.summary: Spook-A-Boo is a ghost-hunting couch co-op game for up to four players. Team up with friends and family to locate and capture sneaky ghosts hiding in plain sight.

games.name: Spot Zero
games.summary: Gacha ARPG developed by Tarta Games.

games.name: Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster.
games.summary: "Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster." is a psychological horror adventure exploring themes of salvation, dependency, morality, and ruin, featuring multiple endings shaped by your choices.

games.name: Springs, Eternal
games.summary: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

games.name: SpringTale
games.summary: SpringTale is a 2D action platformer indie MMO where you explore the changing seasons in a massive endless world alongside your friends.

games.name: Spyder: Agent 8
games.summary: Save the world as Agent 8, a robot spider superspy! Crawl across walls, ceilings, and floors, and use built-in gadgets to solve fun environmental puzzles in this brand-new, family-friendly adventure from the BAFTA Award-winning studio Sumo Digital.

games.name: Squad Busters
games.summary: Build a vast collection of Supercell characters, each bringing their own special ability to the battle. Wrestle enemies with Brawl Stars' El Primo, or spray bullets with Boom Beach's Heavy. Harvest Trees with Hay Day's Greg, or summon Skeletons with Clash's Witch!

games.name: Squadron 42
games.summary: Take the role of a rookie UEE Navy combat pilot in a cinematic single-player epic adventure set in the Star Citizen universe. Battle in the stars and face-to-face as you seamlessly transition between dogfighting and ground combat. Serve aboard a massive Navy capital ship as your custom character interacts and builds relationships with a living, breathing crew. Cutting-edge performance capture brings unprecedented emotion and life to some of your favorite actors. Powered by StarEngine, Squadron 42 pushes gaming graphics and fidelity to the next level.

games.name: Squid Grid
games.summary: Welcome to Squid Grid! A free puzzle challenge about a squid on a grid. Unique sokoban mechanics, cute art, and hand-crafted levels will give you a puzzle experience you won't forget. Get Squid Griddin'!

games.name: Squishy League
games.summary: Squishy League is a fast paced versus sport game where you control a squishy character that can only move by dashing. Smash the Ball into your opponent’s goal to score points ! Master charged shoots, spins, and wall bounces to outsmart your opponent. Play locally or online in crazy 1v1 matches.

games.name: Stage Tour
games.summary: Stage Tour is a rhythm-action game that blends familiar, accessible note-highway gameplay with exciting modern twists. It’s poised to rekindle the flame of plastic-instrument rhythm gaming with new features and modes, diverse bandmates and instruments, competitive depth, and seasonal events.

games.name: Staged
games.summary: Staged is a co-op first-person physics party game for 1–4 players. Play mischievous goblins, rebuild stage sets from reference photos, haul oversized props through tight backstage spaces, and get every placement right before the curtain rises.

games.name: Star Child
games.summary: Star Child is an explosive new action-adventure set on a sinister alien planet. Fight numerous aliens and formidable bosses, wield powerful explosives and destructive laser weapons, find secrets and unlock new abilities as you progress. Can you survive your dangerous mission?

games.name: Star Life
games.summary:
Sandbox "Zero To Hero" RPG in futuristic setting. Game features deep economic gameplay with realistic economy and full freedom for a player.

While on a planet, range of opportunities is wide, from being employed practically at any building (should there be a vacancy) to owning any non-government building, influencing economy directly. Entire planet economy is based on real buildings present in the game and therefore player can shape it to his liking (if player is rich enough). Player can also choose to be anyone - from local business owner, to criminal or politician (or as it might often be - all at once). Skill development is only possible if player performs tasks which require those skills.

Player can travel from planet to planet and own or rent any spaceship, mining, pirating or simply trading goods between planets. While game has no quests & restrictions, there is a main story present which implies that player need to achieve certain results and actions to meet win condition, which does not stop player from continuing game thereafter.

Choose any path or all at once. Model employee, Business owner, Politician, Merchant, Pirate, Criminal, or just explore game as it feels.

games.name: Star of Games
games.summary: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends.

games.name: Star Squadron
games.summary: Star Squadron is a next-generation space combat simulator delivering unmatched immersion. With seamless transitions, an interactive narrative, and revolutionary voice synthesis that personalizes dialogue to your actions, your choices, and your name, every journey will feel uniquely yours.

games.name: Star Wrath
games.summary: Star Wrath is a multiplayer space extraction-action where you design your own ship and fight other players for resources in intense PvP and PvE battles.

games.name: Starboys
games.summary: Third-person arena shooter where gravity is a weapon. Run on walls, fight on ceilings, and flip mid-air to outplay friends in fast 1v1–4v4 matches (up to 8). Customize your Starboy and build arenas with the in-game editor.

games.name: Starburst Fever Night
games.summary: Enjoy fast-paced match-3 puzzle battles! Quickly move star blocks and aim for chain reactions!

games.name: Starcult. Night: Twisted Age
games.summary:
Starcult. Night: Twisted Age is a dark fantasy visual novel with romance and horror elements, set in a mysterious world on the brink of catastrophe.

Explore the life of Silviya, newly married into the noble House of Nebula. Silviya is an Artist, but in this world such skills reach far beyond pastels and paints. Hoping for a different life, she marries the young head of the House, Hans.

The story begins with the brutal murder of her husband by an unknown monster shortly after their wedding. Silviya calls for a detective to investigate the mysterious crime. But who is the real monster?

Use Silviya’s Emotion Palette to read the true feelings and intentions of friends and enemies, influence their actions, and try to escape countless death endings.

Shape your relationships and their nature, create your own cult, and make meaningful choices leading to multiple endings, including Detective, Hedonist, Mystic, Nihilist, Ascended, and hidden endings waiting to be discovered.

games.name: Starfinder: Afterlight
games.summary:
The first party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well — save the galaxy while you're at it!

In Starfinder: Afterlight, you will assemble a crew of misfits from across the Pact Worlds and become the legends in this single player party-based RPG: find unique companions scattered across the stars, each with their personal stories and dilemmas.

There are no wrong answers: experience a story-driven game where choices matter and nothing is forbidden - everything has consequences. Factions remember your deeds and companions judge your heart in a game with branching storylines which ensure no two adventures are alike.

games.name: Starnded: Gardens of the Rubellite
games.summary: Starnded: Gardens of the Rubellite is a first-person sci-fi survival RPG. Explore an alien planet, gather resources, build your base, and survive a world that's both beautiful and deadly.

games.name: Starship Colony
games.summary: A deep starship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.

games.name: Starting a Village from Zero
games.summary: This is your own village-building story — You are a familiar summoned by Lily, an apprentice witch. In her place, gather materials, construct buildings, and create a thriving village. A new kind of miniscape × survival × roguelite simulation.

games.name: State Z
games.summary: State Z is a post-apocalyptic open-world survival game where you'll have to survive threats from human NPCs, zombies, other players, and your own needs, all within a 64 km² map with 100% exploration. Build your own base, hunt, gather resources, cultivate a farm, maintain vehicles, and trade with communities for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.

games.name: Static Between Stations
games.summary: Static Between Stations is a narrative-driven RPG in the dying city of Patchwater. Explore, negotiate, scavenge, craft or try your best to avoid conflict. In a fight for survival adaptability is your only advantage.

games.name: Static Shift
games.summary: A Lovecraftian, psychological co-op horror where the powers from above are tormenting you and your co-workers, warping reality with anomalies and using any means necessary to stop you from leaving or finding out the truth: Can you do it?

games.name: Station Command
games.summary: A strategy RPG autobattler with branching story set in a far future corporate dystopia

games.name: Steal & Sell Simulator
games.summary: Steal valuable goods at night and sell them for a profit during the day. Start small, grow your business, and take on bigger, riskier jobs as the police close in. Invest in your shop, unlock new opportunities, and build a more efficient operation with every successful theft.

games.name: Stealer
games.summary: Platformer with elements of metroidvania. Begin your adventure as a thief who is immersed in darkness. Use your lantern to explore eerie locations, search for clues, and interact with surrounding objects to uncover secrets and achieve your goals.

games.name: Steampunk Shinobi
games.summary: Steampunk Shinobi is a roguelite action game set in a Steampunk/Medieval Japan-inspired world. Play as a lineage of Shinobi, where each death passes the quest to the next generation. Procedurally generated maps evolve with your actions, making every playthrough unique!

games.name: Steel Maiden
games.summary: Two buttons. Pure, explosive speed. A lightning-fast action roguelite you play with just two buttons. Forge your own combat style with builds that shift every run, and chase that rush of pure dopamine through gorgeous visuals.

games.name: Steel Runner
games.summary: Steel Runner is a VR vehicle crafting sandbox game using physics. Create your own unique vehicle by combining various types of blocks, then ride it to enjoy free exploration, adventure, and combat in an open-world environment. Shape your ideal vehicle and explore this vast world!

games.name: SteelGuard
games.summary: Pilot customizable mechs in an epic battle against hordes of enemiesor dive into intense PvP battles where precision aiming can turn the tide, or let your mech's auto-firing system handle the heat of combat. With rogue-lite elements, each run offers a unique challenge and opportunity for growth.

games.name: Stellar Fixer
games.summary: Step into the grease-stained boots of a debt-ridden Patcher in a gritty industrial space station. Diagnose critical failures, strip panels with your automatic vortex drill, and replace complex components to bring massive ships back to life. Restore power, clear the smoke, and pay off your debt.

games.name: Stellaris: Willpower
games.summary: Shape Minds, Rule the Stars. In a galaxy defined by borders, belief knows no limits. In Stellaris: Willpower, your Ethics evolve into powerful ideologies that can reshape entire civilizations.

games.name: Stellations
games.summary: Stellations is a manic arcade game about careening around mind maps. Pilot yourself through vibrating circuits where each input is tactile, twitchy, delightful. Chase, be chased, escape.

games.name: Step Into the Dark
games.summary: Dive into the grim depths of the underworld, fight with its ferocious inhabitants, and determine your own fate in this classic first-person aRPG with immersive elements, created for fans of the genre.

games.name: Step Theater
games.summary: Welcome to the "step theater". "Step theater" is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

games.name: Stick N' Sheep
games.summary: Join the woolly madness! A chaotic 2 to 8 player party game where an avalanche of crazy minigames awaits you. In a colorful cartoon world, push, betray, and survive to become the smartest… or luckiest sheep!

games.name: Still Stars Echo
games.summary: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

games.name: Still Warm
games.summary: Deep-fry lángos in a Budapest alleyway and serve the regulars from the apartment building across the courtyard while they slowly realize someone is picking them off, one by one.

games.name: Stillwell
games.summary: Minesweeper meets horror. Deterministic grid puzzles with clear rules. Use your lantern, flashlight, and chalk to escape before your oxygen runs out.

games.name: Stip
games.summary: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

games.name: Stop The F
games.summary:
Stop The F is a first-person puzzle. Use a camera capable of capturing objects from reality into subspace and bringing them back.
Use various filters that enhance the camera's performance.

The project aims to recreate and reimagine F-stop, a canceled prequel to Valve’s Portal. While Stop The F draws direct inspiration from it, it is ultimately an original creation by an indie team, crafted with its own vision and identity.

games.name: Stories of Somnia
games.summary: Unravel a story-rich adventure blending a turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics. Use spells to grapple across gaps, uncover hidden routes, and combine abilities with powerful Dreamkin companions to overcome a world consumed by Gloam.

games.name: Storm Settlers
games.summary: A survival citybuilder set in a desert afflicted by relentless sandstorms. Build, farm, research, clear sand and protect your people from the storms. Will you find water or desolation? Will your settlement thrive or be buried in sand?

games.name: Stormforge
games.summary: Stormforge is an open-world survival crafting game for up to 8 players. You are Stormforged, with the ability to brave and harness power from magical storms. Explore, fight, forage, craft, build, and defeat bosses in this epic, fantasy game. Survive the Storms and thrive!

games.name: Stranger Tavern: Brawl
games.summary: Combines auto-chess, cards, and war-chess with PVP. Use 75+ cards and 52 heroes, each with unique skills. Six summoners offer strategic bonuses. Explore 12 synergies and factions with creative tactics like economy or hero devouring. Rise through ranks in PVP with stunning hand-drawn art!

games.name: Stratagem Lost
games.summary: Brave perilous turn-based strategy encounters and uncover dark conspiracies in a broken world. Draft your team of unique characters and have them learn skills from each other.

games.name: Stray Night
games.summary: Experience a puzzle-build roguelite hack-and-slash adventure. As a stray cat in a nightmare, strategically combine puzzle blocks to customize skills and defeat inner trauma. Overcome the walls of loneliness and discover your true identity through fast-paced combat and permanent progression.

games.name: Stray Sheep and Corpse Love
games.summary: The second and last game in the MOONSTONE's Stray Sheep series.

games.name: Strigoi Town
games.summary: Combine your potions and refine your deck to withstand waves of vampires in a Compact Deck-Refiner where every card matters. Draft your starting deck, discover powerful effects by mixing flasks and recruit allies to uncover the dark mystery threatening your home.

games.name: Striker!
games.summary: Striker! is a retro-inspired football-golf game set across 40+ levels. Control your team of Strikers and shoot your ball over a wide range of different courses and mechanics.

games.name: Stronghold 4
games.summary: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

games.name: Stunt Paradise 2
games.summary: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

games.name: Stunted Gravity
games.summary: Stunted Gravity is a hovercraft stunt-driving game set in a neon-dystopian future. Race, jump, and improvise lines across arenas where gravity pulls in any and every direction. Execute stunts, evade hazards, and battle enemy drones as you pilot though the interplanetary Stunted Gravity Circuit.

games.name: Sublustrum
games.summary: Step into the space between subconscious and reality. Explore strange liminal worlds, solve sound-driven puzzles, and unravel the secrets behind the enigmatic device left by a vanished scientist.

games.name: Substrate: Emergence
games.summary: Grow fluorescent cells that create mesmerizing emergent chaos. Simple mechanics hide deep complexity as cells evolve survival strategies through synergistic interactions. Catalogue successful lines and culture them to develop your own unique biology.

games.name: Sucks To Be In The Sticks
games.summary: A teenage vampire getting hooked on blood in a world that traded it for energy. See the absolute worst of what humans do to one another in every drop. It destroys you. You hate it. And yet, crawl back for more. A narrative adventure about a rather short eternity.

games.name: Sugar Sling Showdown
games.summary: Sugar Sling Showdown is a candy-slinging 1-6 players open-world adventure game where you brawl and compete with each other in Crackarena, while protecting and building a sweet society together in ToffeeTown. Your tongue is your ultimate weapon in this chaotic sugary mayhem.

games.name: Suicide Mr. Fury
games.summary: Suicide Mr. Fury is a Meta-Otome adventure that deconstructs the absurdity of falling for someone who doesn’t exist. Navigate branching paths, meta-narratives, and a multiverse of madness with the overbearing CEO, Mr. Fury, between digital delusion and harsh reality.

games.name: Summer Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip
games.summary: As coach of the girls' track team, go on an exciting retreat in the countryside with the three best girls of your team, where you'll help them overcome their struggles and unlock their full potential!

games.name: Summer Delusion: The Girl Only I Can See
games.summary: A tropical-themed visual novel woven with romance and lingering mysteries. I met a friend—but only I can see her. The doctor insists she’s a delusion, yet she claims to be from another realm. Who can I truly trust? My choices will determine everything.

games.name: Summer Road
games.summary: Summer Road is a new RPG based on the concept of playing RPGs more casually. It targets people who are tired of AAA RPGs and want to play in a short time, and want to immerse themselves in nostalgia.

games.name: Summer Sprint
games.summary: Ride your bike across beautiful landscapes. Overcome obstacles. Help Lisa catch up with the thief.

games.name: Sunkissed City
games.summary: Sunkissed City is a life-sim set in an upbeat, sun-kissed seaside metropolis full of funky vibes and quirky characters. Stake out your new life in the city, tending to DIY gardens, learning new skills, and making life-long friends and help bring life back to its once-vibrant streets!

games.name: Sunyata CCG
games.summary: Set in Earth’s magical future, Sunyata is a tactical, action‑packed collectible card game where you command fantastical creature and castle abilities. Ride dragons, summon the undead, and evolve magical beasts in duels that reward creative deckbuilding and adaptive strategy.

games.name: Super Adventure
games.summary: SUPER ADVENTURE is a Shmup turned 2D-Platformer with great emphasis on bullet dodging, expressive boss fights and a wacky story.

games.name: Super Blood Hockey: Rogue Manager
games.summary: A sports game where you don't control the players, instead play as a shady coach and use your deck of dirty tricks to become season champion. A unique hybrid of roguelike deckbuilder, auto-battler, and high action arcade hockey.

games.name: Super Debt
games.summary: Fight against time in Super Debt, the intense and challenging twin-stick bullet-hell dungeon-crawler where everything is tied into one resource... money.

games.name: Super Magic Ball! Home Run Derby
games.summary: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

games.name: Super/Human Identity
games.summary: An RPG/Visual Novel hybrid where your choices affect both your own fate and the fates of your companions. Dynamic relationship system, romances (LGBTQIA+ or straight), and Quick Time Event superhero action.

games.name: SuperWeird
games.summary: Automate highly unstable and unreliable robots using microprograms installed along their paths. Design an automated system that is prepared to handle the challenges of a super weird environment, full of automated hazards left here long before your arrival.

games.name: Surface
games.summary: A linear first person exploration adventure. The game is about exploring detailed and creepy liminal environments without monsters or puzzles, you simply walk and look around.

games.name: Surface Labyrinth Kurumabu
games.summary: Neo-2D Action Puzzle Game !

games.name: Survive: The Alien Tracing
games.summary: A survival game where you uncover the mystery of the alien civilization "The Fallen of Elun". Navigate a dark world, solve complex puzzles, face hostile creatures, and use many weapons to survive while searching for the truth behind your missing son.

games.name: Surviving Deponia
games.summary: Explore, craft, build and fight your way through the harsh landscape of Deponia. Meet allies and make enemies while surviving the perils of the junk planet. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!

games.name: Sushi Loop
games.summary: Sushi Loop is a fast-paced cooking game where keeping order over your restaurant's conveyor belt is essential. Plan your Route, direct dishes along the belt, complete orders, and think quick to stay ahead of the clock. Every second matters. One mistake can break the loop.

games.name: Sushi on Wheels
games.summary: Run your dream sushi truck in Sushi on Wheels! Prep ingredients, customize your truck, and serve handmade sushi to hungry locals. Upgrade your gear, discover new recipes, and build your reputation in this cozy management game set in a charming Japanese town.

games.name: Suspended Animation
games.summary: A sci-fi first person exploration game about a ship in danger, and the evil AI tasked with saving it: you.

games.name: SWAT God
games.summary:
SWAT God is the world's fastest shooter. Unique mouse control gives you limitless speed and precision. Merciless enemies that only get harder. Are you fast enough?

SWAT God can do things that most do not understand and many refuse to believe. Move like lightning. Dispatch whole squads with one burst and vanish before the sound hits their friends. Bolt to the hostage and rush them to safety in a blur. Shoot one enemy and before his friends can turn to look, flank around the entire building in an instant to finish off the rest.

This is a hyper speed top down shooter that aims to remove all speed limits. Mouse control gives you as much speed and precision as you're capable of. Enemies with faster-than-human reactions will hunt you down, surround you, bombard you with grenades and rockets.

games.name: Sweep Squad
games.summary: Sweep Squad is a 1-4 player arcade sweep-em-up where you and your ambiguous rodent friends team up to sweep away the bad guys and hit your quotas. Crank up the earnings with overtime and use various sub-weapons at your disposal to sweep away the competition.

games.name: Sword & Banner
games.summary: Mount & Blade meets Total War with classic RTS controls - brought to life in pixel art. Lead your warband across a living fantasy world, raid settlements, trade goods, and fight large-scale tactical battles with formations, dynamic weather, and an army you build from peasants to knights.

games.name: Swordeye
games.summary: A hardcore MMO slasher with brutal directional combat. Explore massive, persistent PvPvE dungeons where every fight matters. Fight your way to the top, or die trying.

games.name: Synapse Chronicles
games.summary: Synapse Chronicles is a gritty, visceral action-adventure game that blends intense cosmic horror with tactical, physics-driven combat. Unravel a cosmic conspiracy at the center of the universe and explore a bleak world filled with danger, secrets, and tense action around every corner.

games.name: Syncline
games.summary: Syncline is a grid-based puzzle game in which the player rolls a straight line of cubes across a board and lines it up with goal blocks. The line tumbles as a rigid body: it can lie flat or stand on end, climb terrain, and split apart when driven into obstacles — cubes that cannot pass break off and remain on the grid, where a later move can reconnect them. Rotating the camera in 90-degree steps changes the movement directions and decides which cubes are kept when the line splits. Hazard blocks destroy or transform cubes that land on them; nothing is randomized, and every level is verified solvable by the game's own solver and stamped with a par move count. The game features a campaign of themed level packs, a built-in level editor backed by the same solver, and community level sharing through mod.io. Inspired by Bloxorz and Cuboid.

games.name: Syntaxia
games.summary: SYNTAXIA is a dream-dark adventure game that allows you to rewrite reality itself by changing the words that describe it. Use your creativity and intuition to escape. Which path will you choose?

games.name: Syrup 2: Candy Alchemy RPG
games.summary: SYRUP 2: CANDY ALCHEMY RPG is a direct sequel to Syrup and the Ultimate Sweet. As the title implies, the series has evolved into a fully featured RPG! Synthesize candies, battle monsters, and complete quests while discovering more about the world beyond Atelier Sweets!

games.name: System Purge: Hollow Point
games.summary: Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a massive expansion which adds a surreal new campaign, challenging new gamemodes, and more.

games.name: Szkeletal
games.summary:
Szkeletal: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger (also known by its original Polish title: SZKELETAL: Ziemniaczkowy Głód Estrogenowego Drakula) is a 2D top-down action roguelite and bullet heaven game heavily inspired by the gameplay loop of titles like Vampire Survivors. It serves as a satirical parody of the Polish internet, specifically targeting the gaming community, local content creators, and self-proclaimed "ludologists".

Set in a vaguely defined, fictionalized location, loosely inspired by the internet lore of personalities fleeing to Romania. Players take control of the titular "Estrogen Dracul". The core gameplay involves collecting potatoes and automatically attacking hordes of meme-based enemies. Key features include the "Destiny Cards" system, which allows players to manually pick up and throw cards to trigger specific tactical effects, as well as a dynamic weather and day/night cycle that actively modifies visibility during runs.

games.name: Table for None
games.summary: "Table for None" is a pixelated, bite-sized open world, food truck cooking adventure game. Explore diverse regions, discover new recipes, and prepare meals to manage your food truck!

games.name: Tabula
games.summary: A mind-bending, level-based puzzler about overlapping computer windows to create traversable, top-down landscapes. Delve into the heart of an unusual operating system, one folder at a time!

games.name: Tails & Talons
games.summary: Tails & Talons is a roguelite deckbuilder where spell-casting cards and card-matching combos intertwine to create a addicting and strategic experience! Join a colorful cast of furry adventurers, unleash powerful spells, and chain devastating combos as you descend down a mysterious tower..

games.name: Tails of Fate
games.summary: Fulfill this tale, as darkness swarms the fantasy lands of Fauna. Venture epic kingdoms and treacherous dungeons in a 2D action plaformer, with Metroidvania elements in a hand-crafted pixel art world filled with souls-like boss fights, dungeon platforming, and difficult dynamic enemy combat design.

games.name: Taisho Romance Theater
games.summary: This is a dark and diverse romance visual novel set in 1920s Taishō-era Japan, where amnesiac actor Kotori Sakuma is pulled into long-buried secrets after a friend's mysterious death. As he becomes entangled in magic, conspiracy, and haunting blood ties, his search leads him toward a darker truth.

games.name: Take Us North
games.summary:
Take Us North is a narrative adventure survival game that follows the journeys of migrants and asylum seekers on their way to cross the US-Mexico border.

Inspired by real-world stories, Take Us North aims to foster greater awareness and empathy about some of the most crucial global issues of our time.

games.name: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets
games.summary: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets is an indie Action RPG made as a tribute to the Game Boy Advance era of gaming. A spiritual successor to Save me Mr Tako, play in a world where Octopuses were erased from history.

games.name: Tales of Meadows
games.summary: XIII century. Eastern Europe is torn between new beliefs and old rites. Learn about the events that will change Philip - once a kind and naive young man - and turn his path into a story of pain and bitterness.

games.name: Tales of the Death
games.summary: Join a comic adventure in a hand-drawn book with a life of its own. Rearrange the panels of an animated comic to reveal the stories of the world of The Death.

games.name: Tales of Tuscany
games.summary: Tuscany has been obliterated by Thunder Goober for his own entertainment! Play as Lambypoo and adventure through the broken land of Tuscany, either making friends and having them join your team or defeating enemies for their EXP in your efforts to save your cousins and reunite Tuscany.

games.name: Tama In-Between
games.summary: An action-puzzle game where the slime cat "Tama" explores a mysterious, slightly melancholic pixel-art world. Use three unique actions—Absorb to grow, Split to divide, and Swap to switch bodies—to solve puzzles and follow Tama’s hazy, uncertain journey.

games.name: Tamer Town
games.summary: Collect Mokitons in this city management game, where tamers and their monsters unite in battle, evolve and bond together in their unique town. Design neighborhoods, unlock stories and grow a feel-good world where every connection matters.

games.name: Tamitos: Tale of Understanding
games.summary: A story-driven platformer where you experience the world through autistic and neurotypical perspectives. Explore a magical world, rescue Tamitos frog creatures representing emotions, and solve meaningful puzzles that teach empathy, understanding, and the beauty of seeing the world differently.

games.name: Tangles 2
games.summary: On the remote island of Scirine, Majed, a young biology intern, arrives at Al-Bayan Research Center, expecting scientific breakthroughs. But his journey turns into a descent into mystery as he uncovers terrifying truths, where reality blends with illusions, revealing more secrets with every step.

games.name: Tango District
games.summary:
Tango District is a puzzle style cyberpunk city-builder where every move is a balancing act.
Grow your district by buying buildings from powerful corporations, but don’t let them take over as you fight to stay financially afloat.
Shape your city’s identity through smart placement, as buildings adapt to nearby structures, boosting your fame and population in unexpected ways.
Keep citizens on your side by making bold, sometimes outrageous decisions during events, or risk corruption spreading through your streets. In a city where power, money, and reputation collide, every choice defines your future.

games.name: Tank Core
games.summary: "Tank Core" is a 2D top-down shooter game infused with Roguelike elements. Players will collect various random tank components in levels, including turrets, chassis, shells, modules, and cores, to assemble unique tanks that will protect base and defeat all enemies encountered.

games.name: TankRat
games.summary: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

games.name: Tape Man
games.summary: "Tape Man" is a puzzle platformer packed with hidden mechanics for you to discover. Throw your measuring tape to explore a vast maze of puzzles. Your measure tapes work as a platform, an obstacle, and many other things—it's for you to find out!

games.name: Tape Us Out
games.summary: Tape Us Out is an asymmetric, online co-op puzzle game. Players are sucked into a VHS tape and must face challenges of logic, coordination, and communication within the universe of old movies to find their way back to reality.

games.name: Tartaros
games.summary: Jump into a retro-style puzzle adventure that tells the mythical story of Hades and Persephone. Play as Persephone and use magical powers to escape. Encounter mythological creatures, immerse yourself in atmospheric journey and find your way out of the underworld!

games.name: Tarvos Desolation
games.summary: Survive on a hostile moon full of nightmares! Face hordes of monsters, explore mysterious locations, and uncover secrets that may save your life. Will you find a way to escape, or will you be consumed by the darkness of Tarvos?

games.name: Tattered Banners
