games.summary: Lead your mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a living, simulated world shaped by your actions. Raid, bribe, steal, spy, assassinate, lay siege, and more - and watch the consequences ripple through and change a realm at war.

games.name: Tea, Please!
games.summary: Tea, Please! is a short 30-minute game that explores the contrast between the drudgery and noise of office life and the surprising happiness and peace gained through remote work during lockdown.

games.name: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive
games.summary: Your sister's first driving lesson! If you fail to teach her properly as an older brother, your survival cannot be guaranteed. Will you be able to survive safely until the end?

games.name: Tears Apart
games.summary: Tears Apart is a fast-paced, dungeon crawling cction roguelite. Tear through the decay with your dash strikes, commanding a delicate balance of evasion and aggression. Dive into the hollow realm, defeat creatures of void, and tune your combat tempo as you discover powerful and synergistic abilities.

games.name: Teios' Journey
games.summary: Embark on a thrilling adventure through a vibrant world teeming with challenges and mysteries. Traverse diverse landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and engage in epic battles as you unravel the secrets hidden within the land.

games.name: Teknokrat
games.summary:
In the futuristic techno-metropolis of Nu-Vika, you are but a number in the system.

You have been branded as unemployed, and rely on the state to survive. Until you are assigned a temporary position at a cyborg repair workshop, giving you a shot at gaining freedom.

But when strange glitches start happening to your eye implants, you find yourself thrust into a plan far beyond your comprehension, tying your fate to one of three patients in your care.

TEKNOKRAT is a gay, y2k-fuelled sci-fi thriller/romance about the danger of enforced stagnation in the face of unstoppable change.

Explore a city where might makes right, and technology is absolute. Choose a partner in crime, and face the consequences of your actions with them.

games.name: Telluria
games.summary: One Soul. Two Lives. Separated by 1400 Years. Unravel an ancient prophecy in a 3D narrative adventure spanning two different eras where an entire reality is at stake. When they finally find each other, you will decide what survives — and at what cost.

games.name: Tempus Triad
games.summary: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

games.name: Ten Ten
games.summary: Ten Ten is a unique game that combines shooting, puzzles, and bullet-dodging.

games.name: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant
games.summary: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant is a story-driven merchant adventure that will test your sense of strategy and empathy as you make tough decisions for a fox merchant girl aiming to save the life of a loved one.

games.name: Ten Years of Rain
games.summary: Ten Years of Rain is a fantasy adventure Zelda-like with a unique Central Asian inspired setting. Pick up your blade, call your hawk, and prepare to travel the cursed lands. Battle the forces of the Great Khan, explore the secret places of the world, and discover the cause of the long rain...

games.name: Terminal War
games.summary: Terminal War is a grounded, team-based third-person shooter set in a fractured America during the late 1990s. Engage in intense combat across war-torn cities, forgotten towns, and contested territory where every bullet, every strike, and every decision counts.

games.name: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.
games.summary: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, and the explosive power of chemistry. As a skilled alchemist turned freedom fighter, you’ll craft potions for the resistance, engineer devastating bombs, and dismantle tyranny from the shadows.

games.name: Tete
games.summary: A wobbly climbing adventure featuring a clumsy little golem. Can you conquer the hardcore controls and jiggling physics?

games.name: Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life
games.summary: No graphics, No tiles. Just text-RPG adventure! Explore a shifting labyrinth, regain the Ring of Life from the wizard Shingor. Classic roguelike-style messages guide your journey, with narrative scenes evoking the spirit of MUDs and gamebooks. Death is permanent. Every run brings new discoveries.

games.name: That Bomb Game
games.summary: A dangerous bomb game up to 12 players where you'll have to type words fast to save yourself from exploding. Use power-up cards to control the game, only the last player standing wins.

games.name: The Abyss Break
games.summary: Hardcore first-person co-op horror extraction game. Explore the parallel worlds of the Abyss alone or with a team, gather resources, and make life-or-death decisions that will determine your survival.

games.name: The Adventures of Graham
games.summary: A sci-fi retro Metroidvania. Help Brigadier General Graham recover his gear, defeat enemies, and complete his mission.

games.name: The American Dream of Gunther Aims
games.summary: A retro puzzle shooter built around ricochets, where every shot counts. You play as Gunther, a revolver and a family man, in a constrained turn-based system: one action at a time, until it fully resolves.

games.name: The Ashen Oz
games.summary: A fast-paced dark fantasy action roguelite where you chain attacks and parries into fluid, combo-driven combat through a twisted fairytale world.

games.name: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
games.summary:
The Attic is an adventure in which you'll have to solve riddles, puzzles, and repair objects from the ‘80s and ‘90s to unveil the secret your brother and his mysterious friend, Destiny, were hiding.

Hideouts, secret spots, locked chests, mysterious videogame cartridges… A cozy adventure with hints of mystery inspired by escape rooms and the classic point-and-click adventure games.

games.name: The Barkeeper
games.summary: A stylized top-down 3D bartender simulator. Your task is to quickly make cocktails & drinks according to recipes in a given time. Success depends on tactics, space planning and your adaptation speed. Ready for the challenge? Then grab your shaker and shake!

games.name: The Beginner Investor
games.summary: Start from scratch, learn the market, and build your fortune in this accessible stock market tycoon game. Buy, sell, and diversify your way to wealth!

games.name: The Black Bahr
games.summary: The Black Bahr is a sandbox colony simulation RPG blending ocean exploration, crew management, and dynamic faction politics. Freely chart your course as a pirate, merchant, or honorable captain, shaping your destiny across the open seas.

games.name: The Bold Bogey
games.summary: The Bold Bogey is a 3D golf adventure that combines open exploration with satisfying platforming. Explore a vast world filled with dungeons to dive into, bosses to fight, and new ways to upgrade your ball in a golf game unlike any other. Do you have what it takes to become the Boldest Bogey?

games.name: The Boo Croo
games.summary: 4-player cooperative and competitive party game with various minigames where everyone can win... and everyone can lose!

games.name: The Bornless
games.summary:
The Bornless is an FPS action shooter packed with a variety of gameplay modes. Dive into last-man-standing co-op gameplay or try the thrilling demon versus disciple mode, all within a terror-filled world. Players pair up and form teams, conjure demons to aid in combat, and utilize strategic planning and resource management to survive. Whether you choose an aggressive playstyle or prefer a more cautious approach, the choice is yours.

Join or create a Faction and amass various resources to upgrade and enhance your Safehouse or personalize your gear to give a new look to your arsenal as you go to war with other Factions.

You will also experience deep lore and storyline involving all the characters within The Bornless universe, which will be revealed as facts are discovered by players.

games.name: The Bugs Manor
games.summary: The Bugs Manor is a free 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay, focused on direct interactions with the environment. Can you survive your first night in this haunted house and uncover its mysteries?

games.name: The Bunny Graveyard II
games.summary: Help Skye the Bunny find her lost brother Claudio in this action-packed horror adventure with charming pixel graphics. Hop like a bunny and get ready to explore the haunted streets of Carrot Town!

games.name: The Cabbage Effect
games.summary: A cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter on procedurally generated stages that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.

games.name: The Calling
games.summary: The Calling is a team-based PvP shooter where players can assemble a squad of their favorite live-streamers and battle for dominance. Featuring a growing cast of both new and popular streamers (including 2 established Twitch Partners), this game is built by streamers for streamers and their fanbase.

games.name: The Curator
games.summary: The Curator is a gallery-management roguelite about managing your own traveling exhibition. Upgrade your van and constantly re-organize artworks to unleash synergies while satisfying picky visitors. Prepare for special events and curate a collection that pleases everyone, including the Baron Family.

games.name: The Darkness Delivers
games.summary: A haunting horror story set in an isolated abbey. Jeanne, a naïve young nun, struggles to save her lover, the angelic Sister Séraphine, from a wasting disease which has ravaged their home - but what is Jeanne prepared to sacrifice for Séraphine's sake?

games.name: The Day That Wasn't
games.summary: Relive the same day without remembering it. Your choices feed four inner alter egos (Shadow, Mad, Alex, and Bully) — shaping reality, glitches, and one of 16 possible endings. The day repeats. Your mind doesn’t. Or does it?

games.name: The Depths of Despair
games.summary: Get ready to unleash your inner warrior as you battle goblins, demons, orcs, and more in a thrilling souls-like adventure. Your quest is to help an angel named Amelia find her sister, who has been captured by demonic entities.

games.name: The Depths of Duskraven Manor
games.summary: Follow the exploits of five fugitives as they fight their way through the horrors that lurk under Duskraven Manor. With the promises of a clean slate, wealth and freedom from the pasts that haunt them, they fight through unimaginable terror while uncovering a reality-shattering mystery.

games.name: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest
games.summary: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - a standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

games.name: The Diamond Adventures
games.summary: The Diamond Adventures is a multi-genre, single-player adventure game packed with minigames and exploration. DanTDM is taken back through the old eras of his YouTube journey, allying with old friends and facing old foes as he makes his way through the memories into the present day.

games.name: The Door Factory
games.summary: The Door Factory is a first-person horror game where you inspect mysterious doors before they are sent into production. Step inside, observe the environment, spot anomalies, and decide whether each door should be approved or reported.

games.name: The Dowsing
games.summary: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

games.name: The Dropouts
games.summary: Heist your own school to get the exams' answers and discover why so many students have disappeared in Noirmont High. Spooky and nostalgic.

games.name: The Duskbloods
games.summary: An online multiplayer PvPvE game where players vie for supremacy among themselves and against challenging foes. Play as the "Bloodsworn"; a group that has transcended human strength thanks to their special blood, and throw yourself into a violent fray for "First Blood" as the twilight of humanity approaches. The moontears will flow for one and one alone.

games.name: The Endarkenment
games.summary: This is a narrative-based psychological horror game where the apocalypse itself is just the beginning of The Endarkenment. Explore the enigmatic lands of Antarctica and its surrounding areas all while the world ends.

games.name: The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape
games.summary: A dark fantasy style pixel ARPG. Players will travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

games.name: The Everything Building
games.summary: Press up and down, elevator goes brrr! Deliver customers to the correct floor and max your score. Serve many customers including but not limited to surfers, astronauts, cars, ghosts, cheerleaders, horses, and cheerleader horses. 1-2 players! 50 different floors! HORSE MODE included!

games.name: The Final Fragment
games.summary: A coming-of-age visual novel with GxG romance elements set in a Ukrainian arts academy. Nina tries to keep the trouble at bay. But when a mysterious incident occurs at the academy, will she muster the courage to confront the things she's been running away from?

games.name: The Funskin Project
games.summary: A horrifying experience in a strange and timeless universe. Explore, solve puzzles, fight for your survival and try to escape this nightmare.

games.name: The Gambit Lost to Time
games.summary: Become a time-travelling advisor seeking to shape this world towards her ideal future. Choose between one of four kingdoms to support, with the realization that today's friend is an enemy in another timeline. Bring out your best Gambits and lead your troops to victory!

games.name: The Gas Station: Graveyard Shift
games.summary: Congratulations, You've been hired as the new nightshift employee at silver lake gas station. Can you survive the night?

games.name: The Glory Dungeon Raider
games.summary: Enter the depths of a treacherous dungeon in The Glory Dungeon Raider, a fast-paced 2D roguelike where every run is a new challenge! Arm yourself with various weapons, and face off against deadly creatures. Do you have what it takes to survive?

games.name: The Grand Planto Heists
games.summary: The neighborhood will never be the same! Play as a raccoon obsessed with the front gardens of The Grand Planto Heights in this 3D digging adventure, dodging Animal Control with your woodland critter friends and stealing whatever you can scamper away with in your paws & jaws!

games.name: The Granny Detective Society
games.summary: A cozy and quirky detective game where Madeline, a retired little mouse, watches her street and dives into thrilling investigations… until the Granny Detective Society contacts her and she discovers that the whole neighborhood is living a double life… especially the grannies.

games.name: The Great Beyond
games.summary:
Defeat the onslaught of aliens by building your own moon base, placing & upgrading tower defences, managing units, and mining resources!

Colony Sim, Underground, Strategy, Simulation.

games.name: The Great Hatch
games.summary: Lead an army of goblins in a quest to break a giant floating Egg. Build your village and manage hordes of goblins in a chaotic journey to uncover the mysteries of the giant Egg.

games.name: The Guidelines: Hotel Napoli
games.summary: "High pay. Simple tasks. Room and board included." Monitor "anomalies" through hidden CCTV cameras scattered throughout the hotel rooms. You must accurately judge and report whether a situation requires a mere cleaner, the intervention of law enforcement, or... something far beyond.

games.name: The Guiding Spirit
games.summary: Mix and match hundreds of traits, flaws, and skills to design unique heroes with complex personalities and ambitions. Watch them love, hate, help, and hinder each other. Roll the dice and become the Guiding Spirit of your group of misfits in this story-rich fantasy campaign simulator!

games.name: The Hearth and Harbour
games.summary: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

games.name: The House Always Wins
games.summary:
The House Always Wins is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a bizarre multiverse casino where every run is built on clever choices, powerful synergies, and calculated chaos.

Build your deck, battle through strange worlds, and collect relics in the form of playing cards. Each relic has its own unique effect, but the real power lies in the combinations you create. Form classic poker hands like pairs, three of a kind, or full houses to unlock massive bonuses, then experiment to uncover secret combos hidden throughout the game. You are not just building a deck — you are building a winning hand.

games.name: The House Dreams Along With Them
games.summary:
A first person horror puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity. Solve cryptic puzzles with logic and careful observation while dreaming in different rooms of a mysterious house in the woods. Completing a dream-puzzle makes the dream real in the house.

The game is inspired by Myst, Blue Prince, The Witness, The House of Leaves, Twin Peaks Season 3, liminal space games such as Pools and Limscape, anomaly horror games such as The Exit 8 and Cabin Factory as well the metafictional rabbit holes of games such as Fez, Braid, Tunic, and Animal Well.

games.name: The Hydra Experiment
games.summary: Solve puzzles as a mad scientist in this action-adventure RPG.

games.name: The Incentive Program
games.summary: The Incentive Program is a match-3 roguelike about a surreal corporate job that’s hiding something. You’re paid to play, but you won’t win. So rig the odds, exploit the rules, and escape the program.

games.name: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
games.summary: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

games.name: The Inspector
games.summary: The Inspector is a short-form first-person adventure about exploring the human mind. As an Inspector, you have the delicate task of investigating the human mind in search of those elements that will bring our loved ones back to life

games.name: The Internal
games.summary: A time-based action roguelike where you battle twisted simulations of your co-workers and climb the corporate ladder before the clock hits 1700.

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
games.summary: It’s the golden age of game nights with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Play 5 brand-new party games designed to turn your standard bash into a sidesplitting blast. You bring the friends, we’ll bring the fun. Coming this fall to screens near you!

games.name: The Kingdoms of Ædloran
games.summary: The Kingdoms of Ædloran is a 2D top-down pixel RPG. Explore a living open world, encounter strange and fantastic creatures, level up and learn new abilities, battle savage beasts and monstrous foes, delve deep into perilous dungeons, and claim legendary loot.

games.name: The Kingsward
games.summary: Explore an open-world RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.

games.name: The Lab Thing
games.summary: The lab thing is a first-person survival horror game. Explore a mysterious secret lab and play as the only human left alive. Gather all the scientist's notes about the monster, upgrade backpack items, record information and try to escape before you join the body collection of the lab thing!

games.name: The Last Errant
games.summary: The Last Errant is a challenging, turn-based tactical deckbuilder where every move counts. Build your deck, master unique classes and variants, manage your sanity, evolve and mutate your cards, shape your playstyle through meaningful choices, and outthink your enemies on a grid-based battlefield with extreme replayability.

games.name: The Last Keeper
games.summary: Take on the role of a lighthouse keeper on a remote island. Maintain the machinery, use the radio and the map to guide ships into the harbor. Survive and uncover the mysteries of Farpoint Island in a horror experience inspired by Voices of the Void and No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.

games.name: The Last Lunch
games.summary: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

games.name: The Last Mothership
games.summary: A short incremental game about harvesting planets to feed your mothership. Mine, manage resources, grow your fleet, and unlock upgrades to evolve your species. You are the devourer of worlds.

games.name: The Last Opening
games.summary:
Play chess against Death. One move at a time.
Survive the cold, gather what you can, and shape a world where every action echoes on the board.

games.name: The Last Poem
games.summary:
5 years have passed since then.
The sequel to "Christmas Tina" by the original team.
Here and now. A "Chinese" and a "Japanese" meet once more in a non-romantic encounter. At the end of the century, a journey begins—from the first (her) to the last (her)...

games.name: The Last Wizard: A Goblin Detective Mystery
games.summary: Investigate a murder as the first goblin detective in a comedic fantasy world without magic...where a wizard is the prime suspect!

games.name: The Legend of California
games.summary: The Legend of California is an open world, action-survival shooter set on the mythical Island of California during the gold rush era. Explore a vast, untamed frontier and forge your legacy alone or with friends

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: A remake of the 1998 Nintendo 64 title for the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

games.name: The Lewd Knight
games.summary: Help the girl - a superhero in the fight against evil

games.name: The Lightkeeper is Gone
games.summary: A retro-styled horror adventure set in the 1930's on a lone island. Take on the job of keeping the lighthouse while discovering the story of those that came before.

games.name: The Little Crumb
games.summary: The Little Crumb is a cute management sim set in a toy-like world. Bake and serve handcrafted treats, customise your character, befriend quirky wooden locals, and grow your shop into a warm, thriving bakery.

games.name: The Little Land
games.summary: The Little Land is a strategy god-sim where you play as a god worshipped by the Littles. Command the forces of nature, protect them from danger, and watch as they gather resources and expand their village.

games.name: The Lumenites
games.summary: Build a cozy village on your flying turtle. Land on floating islands, recycle, upgrade your village, repeat! There's no combat, or wrong answers - just explore and go from chaos to control as you shape your perfect paradise.

games.name: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
games.summary: Somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago a man wakes up with no memory of who he is, how he got there or what happened to him. A short point-and-click adventuregame about a man overboard survivor.

games.name: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients
games.summary: Party role-playing game. You control a squad of characters moving through an open game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

games.name: The Man Who Walked
games.summary: The Man Who Walked invites you to solve relaxing puzzles by switching between two worlds: in 2D you rearrange the environment, in 3D you explore it. Only by combining both perspectives will you uncover the end of the story.

games.name: The Maze
games.summary: In a pitch dark maze like factory, you must avoid He, secure secret documents, and escape with only a flashlight. If He finds you, He’ll charge from the dark with an axe. Can you survive and escape?

games.name: The Membrane
games.summary: Defend the jungle against The Membrane's vile spawns in this fantasy roguelite survivor. You've signed your life away, now you must fight your way from naked servant to fortified King. Earn wages, craft defenses, and improve your base. Will you survive long enough to slay every putrid boss?

games.name: The Merlies
games.summary: Meet the Merlies, a tiny birds community trying to find harmony in a world where the remains of an ancient civilisation are still visible. Build your village ingeniously, gather your birdies and explore this way-too-big world in this cute post-apocalyptic adventure ! Ready to spread your wings?

games.name: The Midnight Barber
games.summary: A narrative ASMR adventure about a supernatural barbershop in late 70s Barcelona. Trim and style your supernatural clientele, gain their trust, and uncover their darkest secrets.

games.name: The Milgram Experiment
games.summary: A first person narrative game, based on one of the most controversial psychological experiments of all time. Step into the shoes of an unwilling subject faced with the toughest moral choice: who lives and who dies. You alone will decide who to kill and who to spare. Please wishlist!

games.name: The Minesweeper's Tale
games.summary: From the clues, reveal an imaginary map zone by zone in this minesweeper-variant logic game, where each solved region transforms a grid into a work of cartographic art.

games.name: The Mirrion
games.summary: Dive into a harsh open world where every choice can mean the difference between life and death. Explore untamed lands, build shelters, hunt, craft tools, and defend yourself from threats. Nature, weather, and unexpected events will test your will to survive.

games.name: The Mysterious Cat Tower
games.summary: A turn-based J/W/GRPG. Find spells to add to your arsenal, pick impactful talents, tune your attributes, acquire powerful allies, freely reset your build and try something new. Find your own way to play as you experience the harsh life of the strongest pussy in Brazil.

games.name: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley
games.summary: Mind-controlled squirrels! Alien abductions! Monsters in the forest! Are the rumors true - or is it just an elaborate hoax?  Help Maya Harper unravel this comedy point 'n click mystery and escape Doomsday Valley alive.

games.name: The Name of the Night
games.summary: We were completely different, but back then we were both obsessed with the same thing in the same place... “The Name of the Night” is a text-based adventure game that explores the arcade music game culture of 2000 through the story of two girls' delicate emotions.

games.name: The Next Stop
games.summary:
The Next Stop is a narrative adventure about a murder full of contradictions, where the clues don't add up and everything hides something darker. It blends point & click mechanics with the depth of a visual novel, all set in a haunting subway filled with secrets.

Eight people are on board. Eight stories. Eight hidden truths. Each stop on the train reveals a new chapter. Each carriage is a different experience. Every decision you make has consequences.

games.name: The Nobody Woods: Lucy
games.summary: The Nobody Woods: Lucy is an adventure game set in Nobody Woods, a place on the border between life and death. Escape from those who want to take Lucy's life, explore the forest, solve puzzles, and meet new friends.

games.name: The One Who Stands Behind
games.summary: Survive hordes of monsters in a deck builder with a tactical grid while engaging in existential conversations with your avatar.

games.name: The Only Droid
games.summary: Tear enemy robots apart piece by piece in a physics-based action roguelike. Destroy weak points, stack upgrades, and create your unique build as you turn relentless robotic enemy waves into mechanical graveyards.

games.name: The Other Order
games.summary: A surreal tile-based roguelike where you build and reshape tile combinations to attack your enemies.

games.name: The Outer Frame
games.summary: Discover the truth. Bury it better. Decide how before the masses turn on you. A choice-driven mystery where witnesses and evidence are in your hands.

games.name: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
games.summary: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, secure vital sectors, deploy fortifications, and unlock new units and upgrades mid-battle to outmaneuver and crush the alien threat.

games.name: The Plant Shop
games.summary: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.

games.name: The Pope: Power & Sin
games.summary: Take on the role of the Pope, strengthen the authority of the Church State, fight for spiritual and political independence from pagans and the renewal of church structures. The rule of Pope is a torrent of numerous scandals, excesses and signs of moral corruption in the authorities of the Church.

games.name: The Prophecy of Horn
games.summary: Defeat the legions of darkness and kill their ruler, the Demon God Horn. The game tells the story of the feat of three heroes in a dark flexible world in an RPG with an original hybrid turn-based combat system and other well-known game mechanics.

games.name: The Quiet Days of Dorothy
games.summary: During the 2020 lockdown, Dorothy spends her days caring for jars of sourdough starters. By sharing them with others, she builds unexpected connections and discovers small acts of kindness that bring warmth in difficult times.

games.name: The Reflection
games.summary: The Reflection is a ritual-based co-op horror game where players attempt to exorcise a demonic entity while being relentlessly hunted. Investigate cursed locations, perform the correct rituals, stay silent, and work together under pressure — one mistake can mean certain death.

games.name: The Remains
games.summary: The Remains is a multiplayer co-op survival horror game (4 players) where players must make use of stealth to complete objectives and escape enemies and progress through levels to advance their story.

games.name: The Retrospection of Tomorrow
games.summary: In this non-linear, time-travel romance visual novel, you'll date four captivating love interests just like in any ordinary otome game… until they die before your eyes(!). Trapped between memories and delusions, fighting fate itself—can you rewrite their endings? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

games.name: The Rifted Skies
games.summary: The Rifted Skies is an active VR roguelite set in a long-abandoned world. Play as a lone warrior returning home. Parkour and fight to outrun a deadly Rift. Unlock new powers and uncover - can your home ever be saved?

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary: A story-driven, atmospheric thriller with pixel-art graphics and survival-horror elements. Short, intense, and unforgettable.

games.name: The Rusted
games.summary: The world belongs to machines now. Join a loyal robot dog on a journey through a haunting post-apocalyptic world in search of its lost human family. The Rusted is a hand-drawn 2D action-puzzle platformer.

games.name: The Second Reality Room: Unspoken Truths
games.summary: Decode the "Second Reality." Decipher the true feelings behind the words of Visitors you can't fully understand. Talk. Read minds. Translate. An empathy-driven psychological mystery adventure that doesn't turn chuunibyo—an adolescent delusion syndrome—into a joke, but gets to how they really feel.

games.name: The Secret of Weepstone
games.summary: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

games.name: The Shadow Beneath
games.summary: The Shadow Beneath is an action roguelike where you must fulfill an ancient prophecy and rise against the demonic forces that have taken over the world. You will battle relentless waves of enemies, master powerful abilities and reclaim what humanity lost since the Demon Lords reign began - freedom

games.name: The Shadow Syndicate
games.summary: The Shadow Syndicate is a stylized noir stealth-action game set in 1930s Brooklyn. Sneak, fight, and uncover a dark conspiracy using supernatural powers. Explore a vibrant city, play mini-games, and solve mysteries in this thrilling cinematic experience.

games.name: The Spirit Engine DX
games.summary: The Spirit Engine DX is a complete rewrite of the cult classic indie title from 2003 by Mark Pay. Instead of using a traditional turn-based system, an auto battler with real-time pausing is opted to allow players to switch tactics at their own pace without constant menu prompts.

games.name: The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth
games.summary: A new collaboration by Acacia, the developers of Mahou Shoujo no Majo Saiban, and G-MODE. Explore dungeons and face a story of sickly sweetness, alt accounts, and a girl band with issues in The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth.

games.name: The Subminer
games.summary: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

games.name: The Sword Game
games.summary: The Sword Game is a semi-fast paced retro styled 3D platformer, made to mimic shareware games of early 2000's. Your mission is to get the lowest time possible on all levels. You can cheat, find shortcuts, you have all the freedom in the world.

games.name: The Symbiant II
games.summary: The Symbiant II is a BL / Yaoi / Gay visual novel about a man who goes through change he didn't ask for. It's also a tale of ancient secrets, intimate exploration and unlikely romance.

games.name: The Tag-along Obsession
games.summary: The Tag-along Obsession is adapted from the movie "The Tag-along", based on the Urban Legend. It is a first-person horror puzzle adventure game, Players will play Hui-Ting and go into the situation to understand a series of supernatural phenomenon, and immerse themselves in the story, looking for the answers to everything.

games.name: The Tale of Mara & Moa
games.summary: Mara and Moa have made a terrible mistake and now they need to find the Spirits of the Forest to save their village. Explore a world full of secrets with dynamic and fast-paced combat, alternating between the two characters and channeling the powers of the Sun and the Moon.

games.name: The Tavern at the End of the Road
games.summary: A souls-like deckbuilder in first-person 3D where each run is a new life told by a mysterious innkeeper. Journey to the north, Errant, and travel the Road to become Legend. A replayable mystical experience with tactical combat in a world that remembers your choices.

games.name: The Tower Must Fall
games.summary: Build an impossible tower. Defend it against endless sieges. Watch it crumble, then rebuild stronger.

games.name: The Tram
games.summary: Discover tram driving on routes inspired by Eastern and Central Europe of the 2000s. Realistic physics, demanding weather and operating conditions, and a richly detailed city turn every trip into a true driver’s challenge.

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Escape from your own house, in which you have been locked up. But be careful, you will not be alone in your captivity. Immerse yourself in this first-person horror adventure, full of family secrets and betrayals. And find out who and why they locked you up.

games.name: The Void
games.summary: The Void is a wave based survival fps inspired by the movie "The Mist" and spiritual theology. Your objective is to survive by utilizing the scarce resources and fighting through the hordes of creatures.

games.name: The War in Chiapas
games.summary: Control a group of young people who enter the jungle of Chiapas, Mexico, in the eighties, to form a guerrilla whose objective is to create an army to overthrow the government through a new revolution, however, a paramilitary group appears unexpectedly.

games.name: The Way of Ping-pong
games.summary: A roguelike bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

games.name: The Way of Wrath
games.summary: The Way of Wrath is a story-driven turn-based tactical RPG set in an ancient world governed by shamanistic laws. You explore the beautifully handcrafted landscape, rebuild defences of an old fort, take on quests and unite war torn people against the imminent wrath of enemy forces. Will you lead with an iron fist, diplomacy or trickery is up to you, but with every choice you make be prepared to face the consequences.

games.name: The Whims of the Gods
games.summary: The Whims of the Gods is a city-building game where you can play solo or join forces in co-op to shape an ancient civilization, manage people and resources, face divine challenges, and survive under the ever-watchful gaze of the gods.

games.name: The Whispering Bones
games.summary: The Whispering Bones is a roguelike psychological horror where you gamble with a mysterious stranger in the depths of a nebulous wood. Speak to him, unravel his secrets, make bets and win a chance for a better life.

games.name: The Witch and the Hundred Knight Mobile
games.summary: An upcoming mobile game based on The Witch and the Hundred Knight series.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.summary: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

games.name: The Zibbo Show
games.summary: Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

games.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.summary: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

games.name: There’s Something Wrong With the Hero’s Choices
games.summary:
It's supposed to be a simple novel game, but the "choices" are just plain weird!?
A wildly unconventional text adventure game where twists beyond your imagination await!
Guide the hero's party to the Dark Lord by making one bizarre choice after another!

games.name: Thermocline
games.summary: A BLIZZARD RAGES. Lone survivor, you are STRANDED upon a FRIGID CORPSE-PLANET. THEY seek your warmth, sucking Soul from the shadows. AND TONIGHT, THE WIND IS YOUR CLOSEST SEMBLANCE OF A FRIEND.

games.name: Thesis of Love
games.summary: During the endless summer in Chishima, you join a graduate program hoping to become worthy of your crush. Little do you know what awaits... In this otome dating sim, experience campus life with three lab members trapped in toxic relationships. Your choices may lead them to new paths.

games.name: They Come in Fives
games.summary:
A story-rich collectible card game with a dark, horror-tinged atmosphere, set in a world where urban legends turn into devilish contracts.

Play as the Reaper on Lucifer’s payroll. Hand over souls, keep bodies, and build an army to overthrow the boss. Unravel urban legends and fight the hidden world government.

games.name: They're Gonna Get In
games.summary: They're Gonna Get In is an RTS/Roguelite where you play as an advisor to the ruler of a failing kingdom. Your enemy mirrors you. A wall will fall. The only question is whose breaks first.

games.name: They’ll Hang You for That Face
games.summary: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.

games.name: Thieves Guild Master
games.summary: Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.

games.name: Thornetica
games.summary: Thornetica is a strategy rpg and slice of life visual novel that revolves around the university’s theatre club. Engage in classic strategy combat, choose who to cast as each role in the play when these kids jump on stage to perform. Take the time to unwind, bond and play minigames in the backstage!

games.name: Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars
games.summary: Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars is a third-person, fantasy-themed, on-rails shooter for a single player; players take the role of an archer on the back of a dragon AND the dragon itself through short first-person dragon-breath segments.

games.name: Through Hell and Back
games.summary: Through Hell and Back is a timeline based roguelike deckbuilding game. Place your spells on the Timeline to outsmart your enemies. Choose your power ups carefully, trade spells and upgrade the Timeline to unleash devastating combos.

games.name: Throw a Life!
games.summary: "Throw A Life!" is a chaotic party survival game for up to four players! Work together to mine, craft, build, and hunt on a dangerous island. Divide roles to survive efficiently—or embrace the chaos and have fun with friends!

games.name: Thumblemania
games.summary: Thumb up and fight! Thumblemania is an action-packed wrestling game where you smack down your opponents to become the “Strongest Thumb of the Univeeeeerse”!

games.name: Tidewake
games.summary: Enter the uncharted seas of TideWake in this single player naval roguelite. Explore uncharted oceans and defend your vessel from dangerous foes. Collect and customize your ship with powerful parts and mystical trinkets to become the most powerful pirate in history! Sink into chaos. Rise a legend.

games.name: Tidy Tidy
games.summary: A casual healing organizing game. No complex controls—just click and drag to logically sort and arrange items across scenes, turning clutter into order. With no time limits, savor the relaxation and healing of tidying up.

games.name: Tidy Up History
games.summary: Tidy Up History is a cozy cleaning sim where you inherit a chaotic museum. Tidy messy rooms, unlock new abilities, and find hidden keys to open new wings. Uncover historical knowledge to properly identify and showcase artifacts, returning the museum to its former glory.

games.name: Tile Tale
games.summary: Tile Tale is a 2D strategy sandbox blending clicker gathering, automation, and exploration. In a misty grid world, craft items, build factories, and keep conveyor belts moving. Defeat enemies and uncover the truth. What awaits at the end? Discover the world, one tile at a time!

games.name: Tileburg
games.summary: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

games.name: Tiles of War
games.summary:
Tiles of War is a turn-based tactics game where players fight for control of a map by capturing territories and defeating enemy units. Each tile on the map can be captured to become part of your territories, and more territories means more money, and more money means better troops to fight your enemies with.

With 18 different commanders of 3 different factions, each faction with their own campaign, you will face challenging battles in a variety of scenarios. And if that's not enough, and you want to prove the world, you are the best, then the competitive multiplayer mode, with an elo ranking system awaits you.

games.name: Time Jump
games.summary:
A casual 3rd person action-adventure

Play as William Roger in this 3rd person comedy adventure. It's 1994. You're late for school! No sleep. No Breakfast. You "accidentally" activate your professors “Camera” and get sucked into the past.

Lost and alone in this strange place with your wits and no knowledge of where to go next, uncover the many mysteries of why you are here and at all costs, find your way back home before time runs out.

games.name: Time to Die
games.summary: Time To Die is a strategic roguelike dice-builder. Choose your heroes to fight relentless enemies in turn-based combat where time is your enemy.

games.name: Timeless Heart VR
games.summary: Timeless heart VR is an action VR roguelike game, As the second work of Timeless Stories series, this work further simplifies and enriches the unique sword skill system of the series. Advancing in the unknown labyrinth with Lycanea, and break through this blockade from fate!

games.name: Tinker's Ascent
games.summary: Jump to new heights in Tinkers Ascent, a 3D platformer adventure game. Collect, craft, and rebuild in this world of floating islands. The biggest thing to remember: don't look down... or maybe just don't fall down.

games.name: Tiny Eden
games.summary: Tiny Eden is a peaceful first-person farming sim in the heart of a futuristic city. Turn your small apartment into a thriving smart garden. Grow plants, cook meals, sell your harvest, and expand your urban farm - from a single windowsill all the way to a rooftop paradise.

games.name: Tiny Flock
games.summary: From the creators of Human Fall Flat – Tiny Flock, a cosy, physics-based VR puzzle game for all ages. Help guide your adorable wayward sheep through beautiful hand-crafted diorama puzzles using the environment around you to get them to safety!

games.name: Tiny Fortress
games.summary: A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

games.name: Tiny House Finds
games.summary: Search inside and around cozy 3D houses, floor by floor, in a relaxing 3D hidden object game full of tiny details.

games.name: Tiny Shop
games.summary: Leave the hustle and bustle behind and bring your dream of a cozy little shop to life! Create, decorate, and watch visitors fall in love. Let your imagination run wild and craft a beautiful, inviting space they'll want to return to again and again.

games.name: Tiny Tree Talk
games.summary: Find a new sense of belonging on TinyTreeTalk – a wholesome old-school bonsai forum. Decorate miniature scenes, grow & shape bonsai trees, and bring people's diorama requests to life as you grow your reputation, unlock new props, and embark on a chill and vibey journey across mid-2000s Japan.

games.name: To Be Connected
games.summary: To Be Connected is a relaxing, minimalist strategy game where you shape the land, connect your sites, and maintain a balanced, harmonious landscape. Build a world that expands forever, or craft real-country layouts by shaping land and connecting important locations.

games.name: To Kill a God
games.summary: An immersive action roguelite experience with a groundbreaking skill system that allows you to craft your own skill tree. unlock the true potential of your character, delivering an ever-evolving experience.

games.name: To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora
games.summary: Delve into the captivating realm of Faenora in our upcoming real-time strategy RPG game, To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora. Drawing inspiration from timeless classics like Final Fantasy Tactics and Ogre Battle, we're modernizing the elements that made these games unforgettable.

games.name: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith
games.summary: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith is a medieval forge management sim. Craft unique weapons, satisfy demanding customers, or take risky deals for profit. Rebuild a crumbling forge with two struggling blacksmiths.

games.name: Tokens
games.summary: A deckbuilder roguelike that flips the rules with double-sided tokens. Line them up to trigger powerful Harmonies, forge synergies with Arcanes and Effigies, and face Mister Mirage’s exciting challenges.

games.name: Tokyo Ramen Drifter
games.summary: A driving roguelite inspired by Japan's 90s street racing scene. Deliver ramen, upgrade your car, and challenge rivals on mountain roads across Japan.

games.name: Tom the Postgirl
games.summary: Take a ride with Tom through her village and discover a great deal—perhaps too much—about the locals. Her approach, although controversial, is highly effective: intense and obsessive stalking.

games.name: TomaDo!
games.summary: TomaDO! is a fast, quirky multiplayer platformer where tomato heroes race through floating obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and respawn at checkpoints. Jump, dash, and explore golf and other modes to reach the finish first.

games.name: Tome Improvement
games.summary: A co-op dungeon crawler where you and your friends name the spells. Catch critters, combine them in your staff, and hope your friends remember which spell is "DIVORCE BEAM" when you are surrounded by skeletons.

games.name: ToMyX
games.summary: ToMyX is a narrative arcade action game that blends Visual Novel storytelling with fast-paced action, puzzles and emotional confrontations. Inspired by the developer's real past relationships, players must survive a surreal TV game show where memories become gameplay and every chapter ends with a Final Judgment.

games.name: Too Deep To Quit
games.summary: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

games.name: Torizon Telecom
games.summary: Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text. “Telecom”—a world where everything is text. “Telecom”... But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

games.name: Total World Liberation
games.summary: Open World Survival Automation Crafting Building Turn-Based game, yup that's a huge mix of genres and it works!

games.name: Touhou Dream Duel
games.summary: Battle your way through Gensokyo in this fan-work inspired by classic Touhou Project fighting games.

games.name: Touhou Sousenkyou: Land of Oracular Zeitgeist
games.summary:
An extraordinary new entry to the world of Touhou shmup fangames is arriving in 2026!

With the sudden announcement of a "popularity contest" occuring in the Human Village, a variety of maidens—from familiar faces like Reimu Hakurei and Marisa Kirisame to completely new and original characters never seen before—set off to win the contest by battling it out.

But lurking in the shadows behind the curtains of this "popularity royale" lies a mastermind attempting to fix the matches...

A Phantasmagoria-styled versus game, sure to draw in allies, spectators, and even fairies!

games.name: Tower Deckfense
games.summary: Tower Deckfense is an exciting blend of tower defense and deck building. Build your deck strategically, upgrade your towers, and equip them with powerful modifiers to discover the best combinations and devastate your enemies.

games.name: Tower of Tears
games.summary: A 3D Survival-Horror Metroidvania in a vast, interconnected tower ruled by cryptic systems, strange residents and esoteric mysteries...

games.name: Tower Tactics 2
games.summary: The fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock unique trinkets, and deploy enhanced towers to overcome relentless waves of enemies and new strategic challenges.

games.name: Towerlings
games.summary: Watch autonomous adventurers climb a 100-floor tower while you guide their fate through strategic intervention. No direct control — only decisions. Choose when to summon, strengthen, or protect, and decide whether to build an army or raise a few elite heroes.

games.name: Townseek
games.summary:
Townseek is a relaxing exploration-trading game where you embark on a journey across the world of Explora and discover the lost legacy of Sir Reginald Sharkingston! Discover exotic landmarks, trade with faraway towns, fish, mine, and farm as you complete your journal and make a name for yourself!

The whole world is your sea now, so be sure to see all that it has to offer!

games.name: Toxic Crusaders
games.summary: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

games.name: Toxoplasma
games.summary: You are trapped on an abandoned space station, developing a bio-weapon that makes the infected hallucinate demonic entities. Spot any anomalous signs of infection before they kill you, complete your research, and unmask the conspiracy that brought you here.

games.name: Toymaker: Threads of Joy
games.summary: Toymaker is a toy-crafting and store management simulator set in the 1910s Spain. Meet unique customers and colorful locals in a bustling city, and discover a magical story based on a folk legend. Follow two different mythic paths, and change the future of your hometown!

games.name: Trade Anchor
games.summary: Amidst powerful alien empires, you are among the first humans in this corner of the procedurally generated galaxy. Trade and explore. With no combat, your success hinges on mastering complex alien economies and navigating intricate politics. Can you carve out a place for humanity in the cosmos?

games.name: Trade Tales
games.summary: A cozy farming simulation meets entrepreneurial adventures. Create your legacy, Immerse yourself in a world of creativity, social interactions, and unexpected twists. Shape your story, build your own brand, and discover the joy of life in "Trade Tales." Your adventure begins now

games.name: TrailRail
games.summary: Your path taken is the key. "TrailRail" is a physics-based action puzzle game where the trajectory of your movement becomes a tangible object. Control the girl and aim to escape from the mysterious research facility.

games.name: Train Goes Right
games.summary: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

games.name: Train Set Code
games.summary: Build a train set layout where everything runs on its own. Automate points and signals to direct the trains and keep them moving. Get creative and design a huge network that carries a fleet of trains.

games.name: Train World Driver
games.summary: Take the Driver’s Seat in Train World Driver! Control iconic locomotives from steam engines, diesel beasts, and modern high-speed marvels in this casual, fun game. Complete missions, deliver passengers or cargo and explore stunning environments.

games.name: Trainwatch
games.summary: Meet Troy, the new Gatekeeper. His job is simple - close the gates at a desolate railway crossing for one month. This is his last chance to earn back his wife's trust. To prove he can stay sober. To become a better man. Join him at the Tower in the middle of nowhere. Help Troy fix his life.

games.name: Transport Fever 3
games.summary: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

games.name: Trapped on the FlipSide
games.summary: In this Puzzle Platformer, follow the narrative of three explorers, kidnapped by a mechanical megastructure. Play as their assistant spherical robot in an effort to save them from this brutal place. By powering up the system, area by area, the secretive past and dark truth may make itself known.

games.name: Trash Day
games.summary: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen shopping cart, and work together to get back home. Live your best raccoon life.

games.name: Trash Wars
games.summary: A 3D hybrid tower defense game! Defend against trash, send trash. Manage resources, build turrets, automate defenses, and survive against pollution.

games.name: Travelling Light
games.summary: Travelling Light is a narrative game about four friends, Lars, Leah, Samson, and Ivy, caught in the turbulence of their early thirties. Inspired by real events, this experience lets you step into each perspective as love, friendship, and heartbreak collide.

games.name: Treasure Islands
games.summary: Help Nick and Pippa find a selection of new artefacts and exhibits for the Grand Museum in an exciting adventure across a number of islands, each with their own quirks, characters and strange events!

games.name: Treasure Rush: Phantom Infiltration
games.summary:
After you save your friends from the Tower Cave, things in Chairwood don’t calm down at all. People start going missing, whole houses turning quiet overnight, and nobody knows what’s going on. Every clue you follow keeps pointing back to Phantom Corp. They’re acting like nothing’s happening, but everyone knows they’re involved.

So now it’s up to you and your friends to go inside their facility, figure out what they’re doing, and stop it before the whole town ends up gone.

games.name: TreasureTails
games.summary: A cozy, relaxing and casual adventure game where you play as a curious cat searching for treasures. Explore peaceful landscapes, follow treasure maps and solve clues to find and unearth many hidden wonders and mysteries.

games.name: Trees Hate You
games.summary: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

games.name: Trial By Magic
games.summary: There comes a time for every spell caster when they must face the TRIAL BY MAGIC. Those who overcome the challenge are forever known as Wizards, a title carried with pride. Those who fail are branded Wimps, forever shamed. So the question to you, spell caster, is: ARE YOU A WIZARD OR A WIMP?

games.name: Triarchy
games.summary: Sail your ship, explore islands, fight monsters, choose your abilities, and craft legendary gear to hunt for deadly bosses. Play Triarchy your way! Activate Boss Challenge Modes or enable Assists to suit your playstyle. Open-world, Co-op, Action Adventure (1-3 Players)

games.name: Trick Eight
games.summary: On a remote village shrouded in bloody tradition, a centuries-old ritual endures. You are a detective with unique skills, yet branded as a traitor. Will you surrender your limbs to ascend like an immortal? Or risk everything at the edge of science and plunge into the abyss of truth?

games.name: Trickshotterz
games.summary: SCORE IN THE TOP OF THE CUP. Pick abilities, grab wild powerups, and pull off absurd trickshots that hit harder the crazier they are. Play with up to 4 players locally, online, or hop into public matchmaking.

games.name: Trifoil
games.summary: Trifoil is a minimalist, cerebral line drawing puzzle game, that explores how lines can interact with themselves. It has multiple puzzle mechanics, secrets to discover and mysteries to solve.

games.name: Trigonometric Equations
games.summary: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

games.name: Trip Movie /Mosaic: Shounen Alice Satsujin Jiken
Trivia Murder Party 3
games.summary: Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp to put you through a sinister new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

games.name: Trizna
games.summary: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.

games.name: Tropico 7
games.summary: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

games.name: Trouble in Potion High
games.summary: Something has gone very wrong in Potion High. As an outside specialist for "hopeless cases," you must fight your way through corridors overrun by interdimensional creatures. Restore order using potions and your own pocket laboratory. Can you contain this chaos?

games.name: Trucker 2056
games.summary: Trucker 2056 is a narrative trading RPG featuring a point-and-click driven plot and card-based combat. Heavily inspired by late 80s and early 90s classics by Origin and MicroProse.

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: True Confession
games.summary:
Dramatic and hardcore pixel art shooter that turns into crossroad of anger, gilt, religion and psychoanalysis

True Confession is a game aimed at fans of action movies 80-00 years (Heat, Training Day, The Wire, The Departured). In visual style resembles POSTAL, Crimsonland, GTA2. So it's oldschool but seasoned with modern mechanics and deep religious and psychological plot.

The game is hardcore, each opponent can pose a fatal threat and gives rise to a healthy sense of rivalry. True Confession is distinguished by its down-to-earthness, the game does not have automatic health regeneration and superpowers, an important distinctive mechanic of the game is "anger".

As the game aims to feel grounded, there are no rocket launchers, flamethrowers, or tanks — this game is about crime in the streets, not the battlefield.

Let's pray/play together!

games.name: True Nightmare: Diner Loop
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you. Can you escape?

games.name: Trypan
games.summary: TRYPAN - A survival horror experience centered on exploration, resourcefulness, and sheer will to survive. Investigate your father's disappearance in the abandoned town of Stagmon.

games.name: Tsurugihime
games.summary: Tsurugihime is a side-scrolling action RPG. The last battle is in 100 days. It is up to the player to decide how to live until the day. Battle, ikusei, exploration, story, and even sister. "Craft" everything. An RPG that "crafts" fate.

games.name: Tuoni
games.summary: A turn-based roguelite RPG set in a mythic northern wilderness. Explore procedurally generated lands, battle eerie folkloric creatures, and craft powerful builds on your journey to the land of the dead. Experiment with diverse playstyles in a richly tactical, old-school inspired adventure.

games.name: Turbo Loop
games.summary:
Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game built around simple gameplay that is easy to pick up, yet challenging to master. Whether you're chasing perfect lap times or battling head-to-head, every race is about precision, timing, and control.

Take on AI opponents, challenge a friend in local multiplayer, and push your skills across a wide variety of tracks. Unlock new cars, fine-tune their look, and create your own racing circuits with a simple and easy-to-use track editor.

games.name: Turning Manor
games.summary: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to unravel the mysteries of Turning Manor.

games.name: Turok: Origins
games.summary: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.

games.name: Twin Jet Racer
games.summary: Two jets. Two triggers. That’s all you need to swerve, drift, corkscrew, loop or even fly to reach the next checkpoint and top the leaderboard. Master the controls and the physics to progress to the next class of racer and unlock greater challenges. Compete against friends or against the clock.

games.name: Twinkle Seek
games.summary: Go search for sparkles to the ends of the world!

games.name: Two Dollar Suits
games.summary: Two Dollar Suits combines the very best of the Action-Strategy genre into a fast-moving criminal playground, where players thrive in creativity and exploration. Complete intricate levels and create your own paths using skill, ingenuity, and raw power.

games.name: TwwwT: The Witches Who Weave Timelines
games.summary: A 2D action-focused roguelite where you control “witches from history,” battling endless enemies and dense bullet-hell barrages to correct fractured timelines

games.name: Type & Magic
games.summary: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard's castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle's dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don't.

games.name: Type Ride
games.summary: "Type Ride" is a typing-based tower defense game where you summon units by typing. In a world overrun by ink lifeforms, the protagonist—once known as the "Type Rider" for her high-speed typing skills while riding a motorcycle—decides to ride her beloved bike once again to resolve the chaos.

games.name: Typeoids
games.summary:
Typeoids is a fast arcade-style typing game inspired by the classic Asteroids.
Wield your keyboard to protect yourself against the incoming asteroids threatening to crush your ship, and get performance statistics and track the progress in your typing journey.

games.name: Tyrants Must Fall
games.summary: Build your rebel army and lead them to victory over the Tyrant King in this turn-based tactical roguelike. Improve your leader's skills, unlock new units, and hone your battlefield strategy as you march towards your fate as the Hero of Destiny.

games.name: Tyrants Rafting
games.summary: Tyrants Rafting is a chaotic co-op escape game where two players control one rigged boat and race from checkpoint to checkpoint before the timer runs out. Play as infamous dictators on the run, survive deadly rivers, grab pickups, and stumble through a satirical escape full of golden speedboat boosts, pickup-truck shootouts, and friendship-ruining shared controls.

games.name: Ugomeku Note
games.summary: Welcome to the world of UGOMEKU NOTE (“Wriggling Note”). You—gentle, kind, and always wearing a lovely smile—have been chosen as a hero to embark on an adventure full of humor and heart. This is a handcrafted RPG made with RPG Maker MV. All graphics, music, and systems are being created by a solo developer.

games.name: Ultima Chess VR
games.summary: Ultima Chess VR – chess as you've never seen before! Battle on the chessboard in virtual reality, where every piece comes to life and engages in a fantasy duel!

games.name: Ultimate Chaos Gambling Battle
games.summary: Poker, mahjong, hanafuda, blackjack… Welcome to the ultimate “ULTIMATE CHAOS GAMBLING BATTLE” where every form of gambling has been thrown into a chaotic melting pot! Don’t just understand the rules—master the chaos, bet your entire fortune (ALL-IN), and seize victory!

games.name: Ultimate Lemon Basket
games.summary: Ultimate lemon basket is a platformer where you lose if you drop a lemon on the ground. Between you and the goal are ghosts, cows, snipers, acid rain, hopes, dreams and other things AS WELL!!

games.name: Ultra Mushroom
games.summary: Hey! Wanna rise to the top at a festival stall? "Ultra Mushroom" is a high-energy game where you run a mushroom stall at a three-day festival and see how much you can earn. Gather mushrooms in the mountains by day and sell them at night. The key? Rhythmic banter and Ultra Mushrooms that bring joy!

games.name: Umblight
games.summary: Umblight is an Inscryption-like card game adventure where you're trapped in a dark, machine-filled room that changes as you go. Build your deck of shadow and light cards, make new cards by combining them and play mind-bending synergies as you try to defeat your dungeon master!

games.name: UN:Me
games.summary: UN:Me is an adventure game where you guide a girl harboring multiple souls within her body through an unsettling mental labyrinth, engaging in dialogue with each soul while making the harrowing choice of which to keep and which to erase in your escape attempt.

games.name: Unchest
games.summary: A mouse-only management game with a bit of tower defense. Restock goods, trade with customers and craft gear for the nighttime—if the monsters reach your shop, they’ll plunder your hard-earned gold.

games.name: Uncursed
games.summary:
Uncursed is a co-op pirate adventure where you rescue lost souls, loot shiny treasures, items and uncover secrets so dark even your torch might quit. Survive deadly dungeons, face unpredictable weather, and the occasional chaos caused by your crewmates—all while gathering loot to buy a ship, buy cool gear, and maybe splurge on a new hat.

Your crew's goal is to buy and repair a ship to reach more distant waters and shed light on the threatening secret.

Explore the surrounding islands alone or in a team, collect valuable items and the souls attached to them. Every day you can take part in a new adventure in the procedurally generated dungeon, which rewards you with valuable treasures if you survive its terrifying creatures and cunning traps.

games.name: Undefeated: Genesis
games.summary: The ultimate superhero experience. Fly freely and unleash your awesome powers as you battle violent mutants to save an alien planet.

games.name: Under Heaven or Hell
games.summary:
You wake up in Hell with no memory of how you got there, and no clear way out.

To return home, you will have to survive the brutal politics of this realm and forge alliances with two dangerous devils and an enigmatic angel, each with their own secrets, and temptations that may pull you closer.

Will you escape with your soul intact, or will your path become forever tied to those who linger within the flames?

Your choices will shape your fate, and perhaps, the fate of Hell itself.

games.name: Undergone: Before
games.summary: Explore the story of Kale Vortex in a world where nature thrives — until every step begins to change it.

games.name: Underground Business
games.summary: Underground Business is a horror cooking game where you prepare orders for a rural town at a pizzeria kiosk. Take orders, cook pizza, investigate the suspicious pizzeria underground and run for your life in high-intensity chases!

games.name: Underground Security Inc
games.summary: Defend your dungeon against "heroes" in this rogue-lite base defense game. Assign minions, build traps, and mine ores. All in the name of becoming the most profitable dungeon!

games.name: Unearther
games.summary: Journey into different places and environments in search of resources and valuables. Make tools and equipments, survive the dangers and lurking monsters. Craft your way of living and discover the unknown world hidden in plain sight.

games.name: Unfated
games.summary: Unfated is a single-player 3D papercraft Strategy RPG where you play as Jo, a peasant turned revolutionary as she leads a scrappy group of rebels to fight the forces of fate and oppression in a turn-based journey across the land of Antedeluvia, seeking to end a century long conflict.

games.name: Unhost
games.summary: Unhost is an anomaly-detection psychological horror game. You play as a paranormal detective trapped in an abandoned hospital. During each night shift, you must monitor surveillance cameras, detect anomalies, and capture them using a remote-controlled robot. Stay alert - your attention to detail is your only advantage! Collect evidence, explore your surroundings, make contact with ghosts. Survive seven nights of horror and uncover the truth.

games.name: United Heist: Facility Zero
games.summary: Work together in separate locations, each filled with unique puzzles that only your partner can help solve. Every move depends on sharp communication through in-game voice chat. Can you crack the code and escape before time runs out?

games.name: Unmixable Syrup
games.summary: I wolf down a cold, lonely meal. Work's wearing me down, and money's shaky. The syrup I pour into my cold coffee never mixes, no matter how much I stir. So I figure I'll just wander around in my dreams.

games.name: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
games.summary: Be a stone Golem and try to save Nature with the help of an adorable Fox! Reconnect ancient sources of energy in environmental puzzles. Discover secrets from a lost civilization and save animals on an emotional quest in a cozy, colorful world.

games.name: Unravel Trigger: Cold War
games.summary: The sequel to Unravel Trigger: Prelude to War.

games.name: Unreal Engine The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: A fan recreation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time with updated graphics, made using the Unreal Engine.

games.name: Unseasonable Flowering
games.summary: "Unseasonable Flowering" is a first-person horror game set in Japan. After moving to a new home, the young protagonist, Mashiro, is met with eerie residents and inexplicable phenomena. Something "sprouting" everywhere quietly erodes her daily life.

games.name: Unwound
games.summary: Lose yourself in a surreal candyland adventure about transformation and escapism. Descend into a land of weirdos and forgotten memories as you assemble a new you from whatever you find.

games.name: Unyverse
games.summary: Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse delivers an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience for single and co-op players enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.

games.name: Uppercute
games.summary: Uppercute is a 3D action platformer where, with the help of your sister and the use of your runner skills, you’ll dive into people's minds, face challenging opponents and retrieve valuable information to solve the mystery of your brother's disappearance.

games.name: Usual June
games.summary: Hang out, fight monsters, and discover your town’s darkest secrets in Usual June, a third person action game about summer break and the end of the world.

games.name: UvsU: You vs. You
games.summary: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

games.name: V.E.D.A: The Awakening of Souls
games.summary: V.E.D.A is a Soulslike training game with weighty combat and exploration. The protagonist, awakened with no memory, undergoes combat training in a training simulator and uncovers hidden secrets. You too can enter the Soulslike genre. Don't hesitate.

games.name: Valerie
games.summary: Follow Valerie on a charming 2D adventure where you'll jump, slide, bounce and boost your way through dense forests and dreamscapes using her bubble powers.

games.name: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
games.summary: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

games.name: Valley of the Old Masters
games.summary: The World has been in the midst of the winds of change. As a wandering artist, you end up in a mystical valley on your journey. Do you find inspiration for your art there?

games.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths and Ashes
games.summary: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.

games.name: Vampires Die
games.summary: Hired by the "Council" to take out a rogue coven, you must gather your clan and travel through the dark streets, graveyards, and crypts to battle for hierarchy against the deadliest of your own bloodline. Roll the dice in this "chill" turn-based board game, but remember, sometimes even Vampires Die!

games.name: Vanguard Tides
games.summary: Fight in massive-scale battles where armies paint the battlefield in their color. Captured territory affects both your health and your abilities. Level up your vanguard and your army, defend your castles, and survive the shifting tides of battle to claim ultimate victory!

games.name: Vaunted
games.summary: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.

games.name: Ved: Recure
games.summary: Ved: Recure is a fast-paced action roguelite where you play as an adult trapped in the 1000th game you bought but never played. You’ll wield fully customizable buff chains to face off against formidable foes and strategic builds to conquer this 1000th game and make your way back to reality.

games.name: Veil of Madness
games.summary: Veil of Madness is a Lovecraftian Deck Builder game that merges the strategic charm of a deck builder with the immersive experience of a first-person RPG genre. Unravel eldritch secrets, battle insanity, and shape your destiny in this chilling journey.

games.name: Veil of the Damned
games.summary: Beyond the veil of the damned, face danger and treasure. Master your skills to survive the labyrinth.

games.name: Veiled Shadows
games.summary: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

games.name: Veils of the Past
games.summary: A psychological mystery where every clue reshapes reality. Unravel the link between a vanished woman and your missing sister, only to discover four entirely different truths, each revealing a new world, a new enemy, and the price of remembering.

games.name: Veinrider
games.summary: Veinrider is a short incremental game about traversing alien caves and escaping a strange planet.

games.name: Vena
