games.summary: Roguelike deckbuilder meets hex-tile city builder! Build a resource engine to survive the center’s rising demands. Place producers, converters, and combo-rich tiles. Roll dice to shop, pick perks, and chase wildly different builds every run.

games.name: Verdge
games.summary: Verdge is a dynamic speedrun plaformer, where the player can decide which content is generated.

games.name: Verismo
games.summary: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic tragedy set in 1920s Sicily.

games.name: Veriventure
games.summary: Craft intricate levels from a variety of pieces to create traps, puzzles and combat. Play through the story, access online levels, or make and share your own in this 3D dungeon maker.

games.name: Veros Veros Veros
games.summary: Maybe a waitress simulator. Maybe an arcade game where you play as a waitress, but in reality, it doesn’t really matter.

games.name: Versalis
games.summary: A fast-paced, grid-based, card-flipping tactical CCG for up to 4 players! Archetypes and team Dynamics bring powerful abilities to move, defend, swap, or reorient cards. Capture the board and flip your way to victory!

games.name: Veyora
games.summary: Veyora is a medieval open-world RPG with elements of farming, survival, and adventure. In a vast, stylized world, you decide where to live and what to create – whether near a bustling town, in the lonely mountains, or by a peaceful lake. Each location offers its own resources, challenges, and opportunities.

games.name: VHS World '89
games.summary: A cozy first-person sorting sim set in a 1989 video rental store. All 3,360 VHS tapes have spilled across the floor — pick them up, read the covers, and shelve them by genre. No timers, no pressure: just the quiet satisfaction of putting every last cassette back in its place.

games.name: VICCP 2 Core
games.summary: The Very Important Central Control Panel is back. Keeping the mysterious atmosphere and with even more mysteries. Control the omnipotence remote, experiment, and find many endings. Brainstorming in retro sci-fi style / Puzzle / Quest / Point Click.

games.name: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
games.summary: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

games.name: Vignettes: The Dream City
games.summary: Vignettes: The Dream City is a first-person surreal dream-crawler game featuring turn-based combat, knowledge-based gameplay, non-linear exploration, and souls-like progression. Your dreams are haunted by a strange city, and you feel supernaturally drawn to explore it. What will you find within?

games.name: Vikings Dynasty
games.summary: Embrace viking life and earn Valhalla’s blessing. Survive in the harsh norse environments and praise the Gods. Become a Jarl, control every aspect of your village and protect your community at all costs. Build and customize ships and explore the fjords in the unforgiving world of Vikings Dynasty.

games.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
games.summary: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

games.name: Virtueror: The Virtual Conqueror
games.summary: Virtueror is an RTS with 4x and RPG elements. Your mission is to conquer new worlds and to extend your domain over the whole galaxy. Build your base, command your units, gather resources, set up defenses and crush anyone challenging you. Have no mercy and the universe will be yours!

games.name: Vision Quench
games.summary: An online co-op dark fantasy looter shooter set in the underbelly of a consumer goods conglomerate mega dungeon. Within its halls you will fight ancient foes and modern horrors. Can you survive long enough to make it to the top?

games.name: VISK
games.summary: Face your fears in VISK, an open-world online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. Escape from a strange village, uncover the dark secrets of this place and solve puzzles to discover new areas. But beware, deadly creatures are after you and your friend!

games.name: Vitalis
games.summary: Vitalis is a TTRPG-inspired Roguelike and Dungeon Crawler where you try to escape an occult forest. Cast your die to move, fight, and flee. Scale your character, collect items, and weapons. Defeat the boss and leave the forest, or run away and bide your time.

games.name: Vocaless
games.summary: Vocaless is a unique platformer game with rhythm elements, you must perform all of your actions to the beat! Not only that, but everything in the game, from enemies to obstacles, follows the beat of the music.

games.name: Void Diver: Escape From the Abyss
games.summary: Manage 'Balusha' antique shop in an anomalous city. Command 'Divers' into the abyss to recover artifacts from city dungeons. Survive and escape alive in this high-quality pixel art extraction action RPG. Face bizarre threats alone or with friends.

games.name: Void Dungeon
games.summary: Void Dungeon brings you a 2D Action RPG with intense hack & slash combat, deep character options, and unyielding enemies, which you can face solo or with up to 4 friends. Oh, and quirky costumes. Because it’s better to look good when the void consumes you.

games.name: Void Inc
games.summary: You are the Head of Tech at Void Inc., a rapidly growing SaaS startup where every decision creates another problem. Plan your day, survive frantic technical minigames, manage unstable staff and infrastructure, and try to reach the company's targets before stress consumes you.

games.name: Void Protocol
games.summary: Void Protocol is a 3D ​​hardcore puzzle​​ game built on ​​Temporal Imprint​​. In an indie-crafted cyberpunk lab, freeze/rewind objects' states (position, activation, motion) to crack ​​impossible puzzles​​. Manipulate causality—every action sparks solutions or paradoxes.

games.name: Void Raid
games.summary: A cooperative space horror about raiding derelict ships: breach compartments, grab the loot, and make it back to your own vessel before the oxygen runs out — or before something lurking in the dark gets to you.

games.name: Void/Breaker
games.summary: VOID/BREAKER is an Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through environmental destruction/BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK THE SEQUENCE /BREAK FREE

games.name: VoidWalker: Call of Insomnia
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the world of dreams and discover its secrets, enjoying every moment thanks to photorealistic graphics

games.name: Vossarium
games.summary: Escape a twisted facility where reality bends around you. Sneak past The Guardian, use a camera with a reality shifting lens to break the laws of physics, befriend strange entities lurking inside, and uncover the dark truth of Mira Voss's life.

games.name: Voxenvale
games.summary: Voxenvale is a cozy blocky online realm builder where players jump, build, decorate, and visit each other's cubic worlds.

games.name: Voxotron
games.summary: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit. Pilot a spaceship around a spinning cosmic cylinder. No brakes. Thread impossible patterns and find the hyperfocus your brain was built for. Short runs. Instant death. Easy to learn, with insane skill ceiling. Pure flow state.

games.name: Voyage Router
games.summary: Voyage Router is a "navigation-based roguelike" where you explore procedurally generated terrain guided by your map. Adapt your route as the environment and conditions change, and visit as many target points as possible.

games.name: VPetlings
games.summary: Raise your own virtual pet right on your desktop. Choose your favorite, take care of your companion, play together, train for battle, and help them evolve! They will always be there, keeping you company while you work, play, or browse.

games.name: Wanderburg
games.summary: Wanderburg is a minimalist open-world roguelike in an ecosystem of Castles on Wheels. Consume, grow bigger, upgrade your modules, and survive! Unlock new weapons, build your castle, and discover the procedurally generated map!

games.name: Wandering Cat
games.summary: Wandering Cat is a fantasy adventure game for all cat lovers. The game offers an immersive and fun experience, where players can take on the role of a brave and independent cat with a refined palate!

games.name: Wandering Wolf
games.summary: Survival-Action experience in a dead world destroyed by civil war. You have to complete your own story, fighting for survival with monsters and nature.

games.name: Wanderlust
games.summary: A sandbox sci-fi adventure without combat. You have reached your adulthood and in accordance with the Mars Quorum, you are offered a Wanderlust, a period of time where you are given the means to freely explore the galaxy, getting to know the Ruhe societies and also yourself.

games.name: Wanderstate
games.summary: You find yourself alone in a place that feels familiar… but not quite right. Wander aimlessly or with purpose, it won’t matter. Is there an end? Has anyone been here before you? Time feels slow. Or maybe it's frozen. Or maybe… you’re not meant to leave.

games.name: Wanted 3D: Dead or Alive
games.summary: Grab your bandolier and saddle up for Wanted 3D, a GZDoom-powered Spaghetti Western FPS! It's time to settle the score with your former gang and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Are you ready for the wildest showdown the Wild West has to offer?

games.name: Wanting Shock
games.summary: Owari and her 7 friends plan to solve an abandoned mystery, but quickly spirals into something sinister.

games.name: War Trigger
games.summary: Destroy, smash and blast your way to victory! Use advanced weapons and vehicles to dominate the battlefield.

games.name: Warbound
games.summary: A Rogue-like, Tower Defense Auto-Battler. Raise the dead, battle knights and wage war with fleets of advanced futuristic Drones as you battle across the eras in this strategic combat simulator. Upgrade your base, unlock new technology, destroy the enemy before they can level up.

games.name: Ward Off Evil
games.summary: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world. Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle.

games.name: Warfactory
games.summary: Warfactory fuses planet-scale automation with real-time strategy and lite 4X elements. Build sprawling factories, design modular robot armies, and lead thousands of units into battle. Conquer a galaxy with a supply chain — one conveyor belt at a time.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II
games.summary: The galaxy is in peril. Entire worlds are falling. The Imperium needs you. Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine, the greatest of the Emperor's warriors, with Clive Standen (Vikings, Taken) as the iconic Captain Titus. Unleash deadly abilities and an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid hordes. Hold at bay the horrors of the galaxy in epic battles on far-flung planets. Uncover dark secrets and drive back the everlasting night to prove your ultimate loyalty to humanity.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary: Thrust into a universe of relentless war, become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, collect and evolve iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

games.name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
games.summary: 【Village-Building Action RPG】 Saved by a goddess, you arrive in a ruined world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, swap hats to change classes and give villagers their roles. But one night, the Idol Demon King holds a Live next door...and monsters come pouring in!?

games.name: Warp Marked
games.summary: Warp Marked is an incremental space exploration game. Explore a mysterious uncharted dimension, navigate around its dangers, learn its secrets, and return stronger with every launch!

games.name: Watamari Part2: A Fake Marriage?
games.summary: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

games.name: Watch Eye
games.summary: Victoria just wanted to take a shortcut through the usual parking garage in order to get home... she just didn’t expect to find an untold danger there.

games.name: Watch Out For Goblins!
games.summary: Experience the joy of physics based goblins in their natural habitat! Run, jump, kick and flip your way through a delightful physics sandbox! Explore and collect Power Cogs to become Goblin Royalty! There's no saying what might happen, and no stopping the BIG GOBLIN ENERGY!

games.name: Water Me & You
games.summary: Water Me & You is a cozy two-player co-op adventure in which you play as a water droplet or a seed-like creature that can change states, on a quest to regenerate a world left behind by humans.

games.name: Watering The Plant Girl: Roots & Rehydrated
games.summary: An inflation-kink NSFW visual novel where a scientist named Enora experiences the best and worst week of her life with a cute plant girl. Tons of worldbuilding and sexual-yet-wholesome content!

games.name: We Build Below
games.summary: A roguelite, co-op factory builder that is set on an alien planet. You're part of an rag-tag mining team trying to get rich. Meet the daily quota to keep your mining permit and defend against dangerous parasites to stay alive.

games.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
games.summary: You and your partner are taken to a mysterious facility where communication and cooperation are your lifelines. This asymmetrical co-op adventure will have you uncover secrets that will shape the fate of Tomorrow…

games.name: Welcome, [Employee Name]
games.summary:
Welcome, [Employee Name] is a satirical Papers, Please-like game set in a space station control room. You will experience being an employee of a giant corporation (HonkyTonk inc.) that controls everything entering and leaving the space station, sometimes to the detriment of its occupants...
Discover their secrets, help the people trying to make a difference, or not... your choice!

Control and cross-reference: Open manuals, read instructions, compare documents, this is your job!

Multiple story paths: Truck drivers have hearts too, and it seems like the company you work for has some... issues...

Choices have consequences: You have the power to make a difference, or to keep your head low in this big corporation. What choices will you make?

games.name: Well Dweller
games.summary: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer- a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

games.name: Westlanders
games.summary: Forge your legacy in the Westlands. Survive and thrive in a Wild West open world. Alone or with friends, explore, fight, and build from your customizable wagon. Expand into bustling settlements, recruit allies, and forge a network to tame the wilderness and build your legacy.

games.name: What We Bring
games.summary: What We Bring is a cozy puzzle game about the objects that shape a life. Organize, sort, and pack through the years, choosing what items to carry forward. The items you keep shape the character’s future, influencing the path they take in a branching narrative story.

games.name: Whatever It Takes
games.summary: Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG in a dark fantasy setting. As a fallen god, master elemental magic, absorb enemy powers, and engage in tactical duels. Use a harpoon for traversal and shape the Omnisphere’s fate through your choices. Reclaim your throne. Whatever it takes

games.name: Wheelie Bad
games.summary: Pilot a wheelchair together and prove you're the superior driver. In this chaotic game, every single crash is definitely your partner's fault. Adapt as the game constantly introduces and mixes new mechanics. Survive the madness, or drive solo to show you were the carry.

games.name: When I’m Not Drawing
games.summary: In this cozy life-simulation RPG, you play as a young woman who moves to a new city to pursue her dream of becoming an artist. Manage your schedule, balance life and career, explore the city, and meet new friends. Live a fulfilling year on your own, at your own pace.

games.name: When Voices Died
games.summary: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

games.name: Where Dolls Hang
games.summary: Where Dolls Hang is a survival psychological horror game where you investigate a place plagued by strange and unsettling events filled with hanging dolls. Explore dangerous locations, gather evidence, uncover hidden secrets, and use your boat to confront the unknown as you search for answers.

games.name: Where Noble Plans Lie
games.summary: Build-up your territory, your team of advisors, and your reputation as you bring every other noble to ruin at the behest of the Vampire Queen. Make the kingdom yours in the city-builder and turn-based RPG: Where Noble Plans Lie!

games.name: Where the Chips Fall
games.summary: Balatro Meets Blackjack with a Cuphead aesthetic in this casino rogue-lite where you gamble with you abilities. Every chip you bet can turn the tide in your favor, but you could also lose it all in a bad hand. Think you can beat the house?

games.name: Which Sea Is This?
games.summary: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

games.name: Whiplash
games.summary: WHIPLASH is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run.

games.name: Whisk
games.summary: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

games.name: Whiskers and Wizardry
games.summary: Step into the magical paws of an overconfident wizard cat in this action-packed roguelite! Craft unique spells, battle hordes of minions and powerful bosses, cleanse the forest of evil, and rescue your Human Wizard Owner. From the creators of Margoq's Lair, a studio focused on roguelite games.

games.name: Whiskers In The Sand
games.summary: Whiskers In The Sand is a fast-paced survivors-like arena roguelite where battle-ready cats shred through hordes of undead desert monsters. Unlock new cats, collect relics, stack upgrades, and forge ridiculous builds to survive the pharaoh's second reign.

games.name: Whiskers Wonderland
games.summary: Whiskers Wonderland: a game where your pops sent you to find something that was lost in a restaurant, but be warned, Mr Whiskers doesn't like trespassers and you unfortunately are one, so he's after you... You do remember another robot named Dr Mouser. Ready to find what happend to him?

games.name: Whispers of Appalachia
games.summary: An atmospheric horror walking simulator inspired by Appalachian folklore. Explore a hostile forest, survive multiple nights, and avoid the creatures that roam within. No puzzles. No combat. Just you, the forest, and what hunts inside it.

games.name: Whispers of the Tallgrass
games.summary: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

games.name: White Rats
games.summary:
White Rats is a sci-fi survival visual novel set within the cold, decaying corridors of the research station UF-44.
When a group of survivors wakes up with fragmented memories and no clear way out, they must uncover the truth behind the station’s secrets — and the experiments that took place there.

Choices matter: each decision can lead to survival... or something far worse.
Investigate, adapt, and try to keep your mind intact as reality begins to twist.

Will you solve the mystery — or become just another test subject?

games.name: Who Wants To Be King?!
games.summary: The year is 865. Vikings are sailing to avenge Ragnar Lothbrok. Build your city and defend it—alone or with friends.

games.name: Wiblu
games.summary: Wiblu: The Search for the Fire Tea, is a captivating video game with German mythology, following Wiblu's quest to find the legendary Fire Tea to save her sick grandmother.

games.name: Wiffleball Legends
games.summary: Swing for the fences and become a backyard hero! Throw insane curve balls and other crazy wiffleball pitches in this 4v4 wiffleball game! Build your dream team to win a championship in season mode, crush home runs in a home run derby mode and lead your team to the national championship in Story Mode

games.name: Wild Haven
games.summary: Wild Haven is a nature ecosystem builder. You will build the forest and create a thriving ecosystem. Clean up polluted land, strategically place wildlife together, discover more complex plants and animals and rebuild the ecosystem your way!

games.name: Wild Terrain
games.summary: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.

games.name: Wild West Pioneers
games.summary: Follow the American dream and start settling in the frontier with the city-builder Wild West Pioneers. Build and manage your ever-growing villages, establish production chains as well as outposts and build trade routes to support your cities and outposts.

games.name: Wildekin
games.summary: Wildekin is a 3D pixel-art adventure where up to 4 friends can build, explore, survive and thrive—or at least try to before some creature tries to turn you into a light snack!

games.name: Wilderlocke
games.summary: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

games.name: Windwalkers: Below the Storm
games.summary: Lead high-risk surface rescue operations across a storm-scarred Earth. Power your rover, tools, and modular pack with limited energy resources as you recover survivors, salvage critical supplies, and help reclaim the world above.

games.name: Windwoven
games.summary: You inherit forest edge land. Daily, till soil with your hoe grow radishes, rear chicks, bond with oddball neighbors. Spring seeds yield summer gardens; autumn's firelit pumpkins reveal woodland mysteries. Nighttime under trees, fireflies dance like starlit constellations, this is your idyllic life.

games.name: Wing-It
games.summary: Adapt or crash! WING-IT is a 2.5D shooter where your arsenal is a slot machine. Shoot down drones to trigger the Toy Box Gacha and swap weapons on the fly. Fight through Medy's house, survive the bullet hell, and defeat the mechanical monstrosities ruling the house.

games.name: Wingmine
games.summary:
Wingmine is a narrative puzzle game inspired by Minesweeper, entirely based on logic.
Your special unit has been scattered behind enemy lines: analyze the terrain, defuse the mines, and save your team.

games.name: Winter Whiskers
games.summary: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

games.name: Wire Throne
games.summary: Blast your way out of captivity, upgrade your ride, and unleash devastating firepower to take down the Wire Throne! One life, one car in this roguelite top-down looter shooter!

games.name: Wish Of Hers
games.summary:
Wish of Hers is a round-based 2.5D roguelike about surviving in unstable dreams.
Each run is shaped by unlocked abilities, combined aspects, and your decisions.
Experiment, adapt, and break your own builds!

games.name: Wish Upon a Llama
games.summary: Embark on a delightful journey of breeding and raising adorable animals like llamas, bunnies, and capybaras while building meaningful relationships with the residents of Llama Town. What unique animal breeds will you discover and whom among the townsfolk will you befriend? Adventure awaits!

games.name: Witch the Showdown
games.summary: A high-difficulty action game combining parry mechanics and deck-building. Fight your way through and aim to become the champion of the tournament.

games.name: Witchbrook
games.summary: Experience the thrills and pitfalls of school-life in Witchbrook! Discover a spellbinding isometric pixel art world full of charm and intrigue in this richly detailed magical school and town life simulator.

games.name: With Dream
games.summary: This is a story about two doctors who travel back in time to fulfill the last wish of a dying old man.

games.name: Withering State
games.summary: Act as Premier Alexander Sants in a time of stagnation, division, and the falling of walls. Will you steer the brotherly nations of the People's Republic of Sudlivia toward the liberal West, reinforce the crumbling East, or forge a new path? Or even be ousted before becoming the General Secretary?

games.name: Within
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the atmospheric world of a first-person thriller. You will face a cunning criminal. Explore locations, solve puzzles, and try to escape the nightmare. But be careful: you can become not only the hunter but also the prey.

games.name: Wiz Hunter
games.summary: Wiz Hunter is a rogue-lite deckbuilding card game. Embark on a deadly quest to hunt down wizards through strategic, turn-based combat. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

games.name: Woe Reigns Unending
games.summary: Lead a cursed party through a ruined world in this grimdark side-scrolling RPG. Build your team, master tactical combat, and unleash forbidden powers to survive an endless parade of nightmares. Decide what, if anything, is worth salvaging from a world that has been reduced to ashes.

games.name: Wonderfall
games.summary: A third-person adventure game in a dystopian 1920s Paris consumed by Entropy. As buildings crumble into sand, Léon, a young orphan with the ability to manipulate this sand embark on a quest for truth and confront the remains of a city collapsing beneath his feet.

games.name: Wonderland Quest
games.summary: Wonderland Quest is a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.

games.name: Wong
games.summary: Wong is a 2D platformer designed for speedrunning, where you will clear levels, learn their shortcuts, and compete for the best score in a fluid, precise, and perfection-focused gameplay experience.

games.name: Work In Progress
games.summary:
It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout...
Here is your gun, your contract.
Now go fire some people.

games.name: World In The Abyss
games.summary: The aliens have caused the oceans to rise, plunging the world into the abyss. Survive, craft, and explore this mysterious underwater world. Build your base, defend it against relentless waves of enemies, and dive deep to uncover the secret that could stop the alien invasion once and for all!

games.name: World Inverted
games.summary: The sky lies beneath our feet. Above stretches a vast plane. From it hang forests of inverted buildings, linked by narrow corridors and pipes. They stand in silence, like upside-down obelisks pointing toward the eye of the sun. This game reveals an upside-down world through words and unique visuals.

games.name: World of Dogs
games.summary: WORLD OF DOGS is a high-velocity immersive sim where speed isn’t balanced—it’s weaponized. You are the first fully grafted human, stitched together from dead champions, dumped into a collapsing city where every faction is fighting for a future that hates you.

games.name: World Without Time
games.summary: World without Time is an atmospheric adventure about a fire alicorn exploring a ruined world, using magic, and confronting their past self. Experience exploration, flight, light combat, and choices that shape the fate of the protagonist.

games.name: Wrong Treatment
games.summary: Wrong Treatment is a psychological horror survival game where the protagonist's mind becomes the main setting.

games.name: Wǔxíng Yóu
games.summary: A Zen spell game based on the Five Elements Theory.

games.name: Xanniban
games.summary: Evil has been unleashed. Don the Trespasser's suit as you dash across facilities, manage resources, and confine hostile machines to change the fate of humanity. Lure your foes into containment as a grim epidemic festers beneath the surface...

games.name: XenoFeels
games.summary: A space customs simulator. Every day, spaceships from different galaxies fly past your tiny asteroid. Tourists, truckers, travelers... Bad news: There are terrorists among them. If you miss even one, your home planet will explode. Good news: You carry a shotgun!

games.name: Yami Kids
games.summary: Play as "The Yami Twins" and uncover the mystery behind your family's killers. Yami Kids is a tale of tragedy, familial bonds, and revenge. Face off against trainers in "Shadow Duels", and make contracts with Oni to aid you on your quest.

games.name: Yami Mura
games.summary: Emica awakens in her city's train station, compelled to walk through darkness and the anxiety of being stranded in a strange world. She must escape by solving puzzles.

games.name: You Remembered
games.summary: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

games.name: You Sure Wanna Drink This?
games.summary: Dive into a whimsical turn-based RPG where logic meets alchemy! When a mysterious force steals all potion-making knowledge, you’ll master remedies on the fly! Analyze bizarre ingredients, reverse-engineer their effects, and craft tactical potions to outsmart enemies.

games.name: You're Nuts!
games.summary: Escape from a decaying industrial maze where logic is the only way out. Scout for shortcuts, scavenge parts to craft upgrades and make sure to come back to your safety hub each day to protect your cover. A cozy co-op adventure for 1-4 sentient robots. Can you find the key and reach the exit in time?

games.name: Your Forever Friend
games.summary: Your Forever Friend is the solution to never feeling alone again! Play video games, listen to music together, reminisce about buried memories... And there's absolutely nothing wrong with it. NOTHING ! <3

games.name: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
games.summary: Your judgment, Inquisitor Medieval Spain. You serve as an Inquisitor in the shadow of the dreaded Tomás de Torquemada. Cast out demons from the possessed. Burn heretics. Spare the innocent — or condemn them. Every wrong choice will bring you closer to the wrath of the Church… or the fury of the mob.

games.name: Your Painting, Sir
games.summary: Recreate paintings using newspaper cutouts — Analyze the painting, search the newspaper for similar elements, carefully cut them out, and place them on their correct position. Will you fool your boss with your arts and crafts?

games.name: Your World
games.summary: Create beautiful multiplayer worlds, games, simulators, and theme parks with this easy-to-use sandbox title.

games.name: Yuha's Nightmares
games.summary: This is a simulation game about the nightmares that our main character Yuha suffers from. You will explore the surrealistic world that is full of unexpected events. The deeper part of Yuha's consciousness is depicted through the flip side of the 3D world.

games.name: Zaibaly
games.summary: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

games.name: Zaleste
games.summary: Shmup collaboration between Compile Heart and M2.

games.name: Zeizen
games.summary: Ultra-violent point & click set in Shanghai, China.

games.name: ZeroPrompt
games.summary: The internet is dying. You're a verification operator. Filter out AI impostors from humanity's last clean network. Interrogate live LLM agents that think, lie, and bribe in real-time. Use investigation tools to detect deception. Every verdict shapes the internet.

games.name: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
games.summary: "Date" one of four girls on the path to enlightenment. Prom awaits. Will you be led astray by an old crush? The realistic dating-sim that "teaches" through its gameplay. Follow Rayen, a young disillusioned teen as he attempts to romance girls based on e-book tutorials. Will desperation win out in this desire for love, or will knowledge, patience, and logic pave the way to success?

games.name: Zolana: Girl Galactic
games.summary: Saving Planet Earth, one outfit at a time! Zolana must save the planet Earth from having its fashion taken away, by challenging the Uniforian conquerors to a runway competition! Dress to a new theme each round in order to wow the judges and save the day!

games.name: Zombie Craft
games.summary: Zombie Craft is an open-world survival, farming, ranching, factory-building, and trading game inspired by many beloved classics. Explore the continent freely, rebuild villages, and earn your fortune. And whatever you do—prepare for the night. They are coming.

games.name: Zombie Typing
games.summary: Zombie Typing is a tense survival game where every action: moving, looting, reloading, and fighting off the undead, relies on your typing skills. Type fast and stay sharp, because one wrong key could mean the difference between survival and being devoured!

games.name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
games.summary: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

games.name: Zwaard
games.summary: Explore a world where you try to preserve the still existing life forms. Technology has taken over and will try it's best to stop you in your adventure. Whilst those technologies try to stop you they could also be the only reason you're still alive.

games.name: Brave Billiards
games.summary: 《Brave Billiards》is a strategy action game that combines billiards physics, roguelike building, and fantasy monster battles. Aim, charge, and strike to launch the cue ball across the table in combos, defeat monster balls, collect relics and skills, and create your own adventure style.

games.name: Built by Force
games.summary: Merge Titanfall-style gunplay with Satisfactory base-building and Minecraft exploration in a living, randomized world. Transform at will, master a single-resource economy, and join with up to 11 friends to face adaptive AI enemies.

games.name: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol
games.summary: Neo-London remembers nothing. The Dominion made certain of it. You are Cipher Reeve — the man their erasure failed to take - and the buried Signal you've touched carries the memory of everyone they erased. A psychological techno-thriller where truth is contraband and every choice is recorded.

games.name: Crash and Conquer
games.summary: A thrilling, Carmageddon/Twisted metal-inspired roguelite game blending high-octane driving and action with strategic elements.

games.name: CyberQuest
games.summary: Explore CyberQuest, where your decisions define you. Journey from a novice freelancer to a skilled hacker. Choose your path: white hat, black hat, or hacktivist, and embrace the cyber challenge!

games.name: Cytokine Storm
games.summary: Cytokine Storm is a retro survival horror set inside a coma patient's body. Battle parasites, viruses, and a defective immune system to wake yourself up. Explore a surreal biological world where you must use your wits, weapons, and unique costumes to survive grotesque locations and puzzles.

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold
games.summary: Prepare for Evercold, the sixth expansion pack in the ever‑expanding world of Final Fantasy XIV Online.

games.name: Hellcrown
games.summary: You are dead. But your ghostly hand still commands. Hellcrown is a roguelite strategy game where every run unfolds into a chain of random stories, sieges, and consequences.

games.name: Idle Casino Empire
games.summary: An idle casino tycoon where you build the floor, then rig it. Buy the machines, turn casino psychology into upgrades, then play your own blackjack, roulette, and slots in Owner Mode: nudge the reels, peek the deck, mark the cards. Twelve games, eight venues, a prestige loop. The house is you.

games.name: Joint Venture
games.summary: Run the prison commissary from behind the window: match IDs to prisoner numbers, obey the guards' daily rules, and fill orders for profit. Then build a contraband empire in drugs, shivs, and smuggled goods, dodging patrols, cameras, and pat-downs. Serve your time, or smuggle your way out.

games.name: Long Shadow
games.summary: Guide one family across centuries of collapse, evacuation, settlement and interstellar expansion. Preserve memories, establish laws, command crews, inherit ships and face the Afterless as every choice becomes part of history.

games.name: One Billion Ducks
games.summary: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

games.name: Polymorphite
games.summary: Polymorphite is a rhythm-adventure hybrid game that fuses keyboard-and-mouse rhythm dodging gameplay with a deep narrative following three concurrent Tokyo residents as a bizarre serial murder case unravels the fabric of reality; and the question of what it means to be “human” becomes more important than ever before.

games.name: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers
games.summary: A fan-made roguelike action Touhou game. Due to a Kedama incident in Gensokyo, Flandre Scarlet eagerly takes the initiative to resolve it. Or rather, she's actually just causing chaos, definitely not trying to solve anything!

games.name: Wizard 64
games.summary: Destroy incoming enemies as a flying wizard. Collect points to grow stronger. Unlock new weapons and abilities, and use different builds to defeat endless monster hordes.

games.name: Stranded in the Abyss
games.summary: Stranded in the abyss is a shoot-em-up in a unique sci-fi sci-environment where you command a massive squad of ships in an endless war Against an evil rebellion. Shoot command and bomb your way through hundreds of enemy fighters, capital ships, and skirmishes.

games.name: Stranger Than Heaven
games.summary: Stranger Than Heaven is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. The game follows a multi-decade story across five eras and five cities, centered on men searching for a place to belong. It combines close-quarters action with narrative elements, historical urban settings, and activities connected to music and performance.

games.name: Sorrow: Rise of Divinity
games.summary: An open-world action survival game combining fast-paced battle royale, competitive deathmatches, trophy hunting, and intense missions—where strategy and skill determine your fate.

games.name: Cogito: Requiem
games.summary:
Cogito: Requiem is a 2D action game where you dash freely through a harmony of music and sound effects.

The setting: a world where humanity has migrated into the digital realm and vanished, leaving behind only the SI—artificial intelligences who once had humans as their masters. As Cogito, you race through this world where their remnants linger, set on "ending" the SI that have fallen into error.

games.name: Alien Agent X
games.summary: Players can obtain materials and exchange them for corresponding characters, costumes, weapons, actions, etc. Supports body adjustment, taking photos, scene scanning, player chain connection.All multiplayer online. Currently in the early access most Unreal the scene will be changed later.

games.name: A Date with Death 2: Remnants
games.summary: Train, chat, and flirt your way through the Underworld in this romantic story-driven chat simulator. Create your own Grim Reaper, connect with your team through text and video calls, and decide who you are when the past no longer defines you in a sequel to A Date with Death!

games.name: Aftershock
games.summary: Put yourself in the shoes of a combat veteran. Can you handle the hardships that come with a life of solitude?

games.name: Alchemist
games.summary: A magic-focused action battle* RPG where research and alchemy shape your path through combat encounters, puzzles, and challenges across diverse locations.

games.name: Demi and the Fractured Dream
games.summary: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

games.name: Every Wednesday
games.summary: When Hideki steps inside for the first time, he does not yet realize that this is where he will finally stop feeling invisible after a long time. Meet new friends alongside him, uncover their stories, and support them through life’s challenges. They might even help you rewrite your own story …

games.name: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria - Chapter One
games.summary: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria is a 3D metroidvania set in Seoul — a ghost city run by AI after humanity's population collapse. Explore a twisted Seoul and discover new abilities.

games.name: Metro 2039
games.summary:
METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

The year is 2039. For a quarter century, the last survivors of nuclear war have been locked in bitter conflict deep in the Metro tunnels beneath the poisoned city of Moscow.

Now, finally, they have been united by a single leader, a fanatical Spartan known as Hunter. But this is no peace: Hunter’s Novoreich regime rules through propaganda and fear, subjugating the population in the name of a new war for the surface against a dark and terrifying enemy.

In the wilderness beyond the city, the reclusive Stranger is haunted by violent waking nightmares. When the ghosts of his past force him out of exile, he must undertake a harrowing journey into the shattered ruins of Moscow, to the one place he swore he’d never go. The Metro.

Experience the most shocking METRO adventure yet in a powerful single-player story that weaves exploration, survival, combat and stealth across a hauntingly beautiful but deadly world with unparalleled immersion.

Inspired by the worldwide best-selling METRO book trilogy by Dmitry Glukhovsky.

games.name: Shatterswarm
games.summary:
Shatterswarm is a narrative-driven 2D space shooter that combines direct ship combat, fleet command, tower defense, and base building into a strategic colony survival experience. Command Captain Hope's hero ship as you defend Earth's last bastion, The Citadel, against the relentless Voxan Empire.

Take control of your hero ship in intense 2D space combat while simultaneously building and managing a fleet of ships, constructing defensive networks around your citadel, and managing resources to survive wave after wave of alien invaders. Every decision matters as you balance offensive capabilities with defensive structures, all while facing unique enemy types that require different strategies to defeat.

The game features a diverse roster of challenging enemies, each with distinct mechanics: parasites that hack into and take control of your own ships, motherships that spawn smaller vessels, deflectors that fire your projectiles back at you, and robotic enemies that latch onto your ships and tear them apart. Face off against epic multi-phase boss battles against Voxan commanders Gordox, Gudrak, and the dreaded General Mortex.

With its perfect blend of action, strategy, and base building, Shatterswarm offers a unique short game experience where tactical thinking and quick reflexes are both essential for survival. The Citadel's survival depends on your strategy—will you focus on overwhelming firepower, impenetrable defenses, or a balanced approach?

games.name: Vanguard Exiles
games.summary: Vanguard Exiles is a new style of auto-battler designed by legendary game designer, Richard Garfield. Each player pits their Squad against their opponent in an ever-changing environment. Each Squad has its own unique identity and is comprised of Units and Actions, each with traits and abilities that can shape your battle strategy. You are the general, guide your troops to victory!

games.name: Sagas of Lumin
games.summary: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

games.name: Wild Life
games.summary: Become the heroine Maya - strong, beautiful and able to call upon her wings, her tribal heritage - in this gripping Adult Action-RPG. Roam the world from fertile forests to dry and sun-soaked deserts, spread your wings and cut through the skies of a world torn by greed and vanity. Find your own way to ensure your survival and embrace the possibilities of fighting and sex.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

games.name: Wake Up
games.summary:
Wake Up is a thrilling 2D/3D adventure game made by R16studio. Dive into a world full of mystery, puzzles, psychological horror, and tension where every choice matters.
Are you ready to wake up and find the truth or maybe not.

games.name: God of War Laufey
games.summary: God of War: Laufey is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Santa Monica Studio for PlayStation 5. The game follows Laufey, also known as Faye, after she awakens in a strange afterlife realm following her death. To protect Kratos and Atreus, she travels through the Everywhen, an afterlife of the gods where deities from different mythologies compete for power. The game shifts the focus from Kratos to Faye and features sword-based combat, magic, and new supporting characters.

games.name: Fable
games.summary: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

games.name: Persona 4 Revival
games.summary: Who’s on Air? Legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journey to prevent more tragedies while uncovering the truth behind the chaos.

games.name: Yuna and the Spirit Forest
games.summary: A 2D pixel-art metroidvania where you fight using elemental spirits instead of basic attacks. Explore, collect, and solve puzzles in a magical forest.

games.name: Blossoming Yandere
games.summary: You've moved into your first apartment. A girl gazes at you, craving your love. What are you to do when you're the center of someone's world? Make choices, explore your new home, piece together a mystery, and be careful. Your actions and words have consequences.

games.name: Hearts Gone Black
games.summary: Hearts Gone Black is a top-down survival horror game where you scavenge abandoned homes and gather or mine resources in open world, fight infected, manage survivors, build a base, and endure a broken world where weather, hunger, sanity, and moral choices slowly wear you down.

games.name: Join Us
games.summary: Lead a cult and prepare for the end of the world in Join Us, the upcoming co-op, open-world survival experience. Ride bears, build up your perfect base, and prepare for the apocalypse.

games.name: Kiipluu
games.summary:
Kiipluu is a hardcore stealth adventure set in a brutal Neolithic world.

Every encounter is a tense survival puzzle. Study patrol routes, use tall grass, shadows, sound, and terrain to stay hidden. Set traps, strike from ambush, or slip past unseen. Being discovered can quickly become fatal.

When stealth fails, combat is fast, brutal, and unforgiving. Weapons are primitive. Injuries matter. There are no easy victories.

Along the way, Kiipluu is haunted by dreamlike spirit journeys and visions of his father, a legendary hunter whose shadow looms over every choice. Your decisions shape who survives, who is lost, and what kind of person Kiipluu becomes.

This is a story of fear, survival, and growing up in a world that wants you dead.

games.name: Seasons Turning
games.summary: A farming/life sim focused on exploration and immersion. There's no stamina bar and no broken tools. Aside from the genre's norms, it has four puzzle-filled dungeons, secret locations, irrigation, gene splicing, mafia kittens, and one rusty, well-loved bicycle. Save whenever. Play at your own speed.

games.name: The Concrete Sutra #1
games.summary: A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike. The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

games.name: Backrooms: The Savior
games.summary: That's a co-op horror exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. This time, you won’t just hide—grab your weapon and fight back against the entities. Explore classic and original levels, scavenge supplies, rescue survivors, and survive. Ammo is scarce. Noise is deadly. This time, fear goes both ways.

games.name: Altiros
games.summary: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

games.name: Ash and Flame
games.summary: Ash and Flame is an interactive cinematic thriller set in the dark fantasy world of Erwintal. You are Raynar, a war veteran who takes up his sword once more to face an ancient evil. Your choices shape the kingdom’s fate: ashes… or the flame of hope.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Embark on a quest to become the 13th Zodiac in this frantic hack-and-slash roguelike action adventure. Take on a celestial trial of grit, speed and power, and rise stronger after each fall as you upgrade your skills. Your trial awaits!

games.name: Abismo
games.summary: Abismo is a deep-sea co-op horror game set on the abyssal floor of an alien planet. Descend alone or with up to three friends into shifting trenches, recover classified research, and survive the crushing dark while uncovering an analog-horror mystery buried in corrupted VHS tapes.

games.name: Abjure
games.summary: Win by emptying your hand. Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder where the 2 of Spades reigns supreme — draft cards, stack relics, and outplay every opponent in a strategic twist on the Big 2 card game.

games.name: AmaTisMo
games.summary: A visual novel about depression and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind players.

games.name: Anemorie
games.summary: Anemorie is a visually rich, story-driven adventure game that invites players to step into the life of Anna, a young woman on a journey of self-discovery, love, and resilience.

games.name: Armatus
games.summary: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

games.name: Artius: Pure Imagination
games.summary: Artius is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as four unique artists fighting to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction. Dash, swing, and smash your way through vibrant, hand-drawn worlds inspired by art!

games.name: Astral Dive
games.summary: Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

games.name: Azur
games.summary: Azur is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS set on the French island of Belmas. Every time you respawn, complete missions, explore, and survive as long as possible to secure the best gear, with the risk of losing everything.

games.name: Bestiario
games.summary: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

games.name: Between the Shelves
games.summary: A cozy bookshop management game where customers step out of classic literature. Curate your shelves, recommend the perfect book, and unlock new items and mechanics as your shop grows into a living collection of stories.

games.name: Billionaire Life Simulator
games.summary: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

games.name: Bravo, Gaspar!
games.summary: "Survive my sadistic show. An action roguelike where your performance with collectible creatures serves only to feed me. On my stage, the rule is simple: entertain or die!"

games.name: Bug Bounce
games.summary: A co-op action roguelike where you evolve insect heroes, build absurdly powerful loadouts, crush swarms of enemies, and fling your friends through chaotic physics-based combat.

games.name: Cages: Hidden Worlds
games.summary: Cages: Hidden Worlds is an immersive first-person puzzle escape game, where every sound, shadow, and mechanism bring an eerie sense of mystery and impending doom. Solve the workings of complex, original machinery you’ve never seen before and uncover the secrets buried inside them.

games.name: Capitol Diktatoria
games.summary: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

games.name: Clutch
games.summary: Clutch is a cinematic, open-world, action-driving game from the team at Maverick Games - lead by former Forza Horizon Creative Director, Mike Brown, and other senior leads on the franchise.

games.name: Conatus: Forgotten Depths
games.summary: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where every weapon defines a unique playstyle. Explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, craft powerful potions and unravel the mysteries of a world built from everything humanity chose to forget.

games.name: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
games.summary: This is the most chaotic farm in the universe. Combine 150+ crazy items to theorycraft game-breaking builds. Trigger massive, automated chain reactions to skyrocket your yields, poop to win!

games.name: Cyber Demon Protocol
games.summary: An antique computer has granted you the ability to summon cyber demons. Seeking power from demons is like dancing on a tightrope, from Lawful Good to Chaotic Evil, how will you choose? Will you collude with the wealthy, politicians, stars, and artists, or change this decadent society?

games.name: Cyberwars
games.summary: Cyberwars is a turn-based tactics roguelike. You move infantry, vehicles, helicopters, naval units, and aircraft across hand-built maps, capture cities and factories for production, hold airports and ports to control the air and sea, and use terrain and fog of war to break the enemy line.

games.name: Dance of the Butterflies
games.summary: Your twin sister is missing. Under her name, you uncover a deadly system where 50 people compete for a Wish powerful enough to change anything. The price of entry is a piece of yourself, signed away in a contract. Survive. Find her. And try not to lose yourself to the people you meet along the way.

games.name: Danganronpa 2x2
games.summary:
A new killing game begins in the same setting and with the same characters as Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. A brand-new scenario with different victims, culprits, and tricks! Reveal the truth by shooting down contradictions in a Class Trial and uncover the culprit of a murder.

The original scenario from Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, with revamped visuals and presentation for modern consoles, is also included.

games.name: Dark Queen of Samobor
games.summary: Embark on a journey inspired by Slavic mythology and Croatian folklore in this 2.5D action-adventure game inspired by the likes of Song of Iron, Prince of Persia, Inside and Limbo.

games.name: Dead Reckoner
games.summary: Navigate the darkness in Dead Reckoner, a stealth-action submarine game where survival depends on more than firepower alone. Slip through the shadows, elude your enemies, and exploit their weaknesses as a new recruit in a mysterious government initiative that will determine the future of humanity.

games.name: Deadly Rehearsal
games.summary: The rehearsal must be flawless. Every sound, every light timed perfectly. You are one of the best stage manager's after all. Failure is not an option. The play is cursed... and it demands perfection.

games.name: Deepward
games.summary: Choose 3 heroes from a roster of six, each with distinct weapons, abilities, and playstyles. Build the right squad, switch between heroes on the fly, and fight relentless horrors in this fast-paced horror FPS roguelite set in the 1920s. Descend beneath a god-forsaken place where death is permanent.

games.name: Deus Exia
games.summary: “Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.” Embark on a colorful 2D pixel action adventure in Deus Exia! Slash, parry and combo though four distinct lands. Collect cards and skills to craft powerful builds — then overcome deadly enemies and bosses.

games.name: Dithered
games.summary: Dithered invites you to a realm forsaken by the clock—a surreal nightmare where you must platform through the jagged shards of a protagonist's trauma. Guided by two bickering birds and hunted by a ticking horror, you must fight your way through a glitching reality…

games.name: Fear Tall Grass
games.summary: Dark creature-collecting roguelite where humanity enslaves their old gods. Command evolving monsters on the board of Humanity’s final crusade.

games.name: Fossil Quest
games.summary: Fossil Quest is a cozy fossil‑digging life sim where you travel to dig sites, excavate bones, and assemble exhibits to build your own dinosaur museum. Upgrade tools, decorate your home, and curate displays before opening the museum to visitors in a relaxed, collectible‑focused experience.

games.name: Foxfire
games.summary: A top-down sci-fi survivors-like with space physics and a devastating arsenal of evolving weaponry. Customize your ship and tear through alien swarms as routine recon missions descend into bullet hellscapes.

games.name: Ghost Justice
games.summary: Lead elite operatives against ruthless cartels in a brutal narco conflict. Coordinate multiple tactical teams, plan ambushes, gather intelligence, and eliminate high-value targets through stealth-driven turn-based combat.

games.name: Gods Play Dice
games.summary: A dice themed roguelike where every roll matters, and your journey will be lead by faith.. Luck isn't on your side, it is the game. Throw dice. Adapt. Survive, and most importantly believe in your dices.

games.name: Haparoot
games.summary: Step into a dream world. Become the sole source of light in the darkness and Explore an authentic handcrafted landscape in third-person. Solve layered environmental puzzles, discuss some familiar issues and uncover secrets shaping the journey toward balance.

games.name: Haunted Cleaner
games.summary: Haunted Cleaner is a relaxing, light puzzle and narrative game about tidying up and decorating the homes of the deceased. Play as a psychic cleaner, uncover the stories left behind and help lingering ghosts find peace. Remember, every place tells a story, you just need to listen.

games.name: Heaven Crawler
games.summary: Heaven Crawler is an atmospheric, isometric action roguelite dungeon crawler with RPG elements. Explore The Womb, a forgotten, man-made tower that reaches the heavens. Collect powerful items and strengthen your character on an epic journey to the top. And remember: Bring her back!

games.name: Hellsplit: Labyrinth
games.summary: A rogue-like VR action RPG with brutal, physics-driven medieval combat. Collect seven crystal shards across procedural dungeons. You get one life. No second chances.

games.name: Hypnagogia: Broken Dreams
games.summary: A protector submerged, a mirror shattered, and a dreamscape left severed. Unravel a new, surreal dream mystery as you platform, solve puzzles, meet unique characters, and much more in this first-person exploration prequel to Hypnagogia: Boundless Dreams.

games.name: Hyve
games.summary:
The First and Only 2v2 Digital Card Game
Combine cards with your teammate in real-time to create powerful synergies and defeat your opponents in fast-paced 2v2 matches.

games.name: I Want to Play the Villain!
games.summary: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

games.name: Ignitement
games.summary: As a fire shaman, descend into a meditative battle against your inner demons. Wield explosive fire magic in a rogue-lite inferno. Burn through hordes, gather coins, unlock upgrades, and master the flame.

games.name: Incyanspace
games.summary: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

games.name: Infamous Keepers
games.summary: Defend your dungeon AND your job! Tower Defense meets Roguelite in Infamous Keepers. Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up towers and deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

games.name: Inquisitor Shepherd
games.summary: Become Shepherd, an inquisitor sent to a suspicious village. Unveil the secrets of a world filled with fear, and make an inevitable choice. In this visual novel mystery, your decisions change the world. Can you survive the desperate horror?

games.name: Just Another Guild Day
games.summary: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

games.name: Knightstones
games.summary: Deploy your armies on a war table in this tactical roguelike! Plan your formations, trigger tons of chain reactions, and invest your rewards to rebuild your fallen Order. Be ready… or perish in the final battle.

games.name: Lords of the Fallen II
games.summary: Lords of the Fallen 2, the highly anticipated sequel to the game released in 2023, is set to arrive in 2026. The team at Hexworks aims to create a sequel incorporating more commercial elements, particularly in visual design, to attract a broader audience of players.

games.name: M.A.Y.A
games.summary: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.

games.name: Manafinder II
games.summary: Mankind has ended, yet the world moved on. Take the role of Rey in this turn-based RPG and fight ferocious beasts and other existential threats alongside a disparate cast of allies as you seek a new purpose in a world that no longer welcomes you.

games.name: Moonlight Pale
games.summary: Juliette follows the ghost of her dead cat into a nightmare where she has to fight and solve puzzles through eerily familiar corridors as she tries to survive and help the rest of the girls trapped inside. Discover the sins buried under St. Birgitta's Female Seminary.

games.name: Most Scuffed Golf
games.summary: Build the course, then break it. Most Scuffed Golf is mini-golf for 1–4 couch players: each one places a tile in the hole layout, then everyone shoots through the chaos you all built together. Ramps, curves, bridges — and a hole that's always somehow still reachable.

games.name: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
games.summary: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

games.name: Nine Rounds Rapid
games.summary: A fast paced, super stylized, roguelike, twin stick shooter. Nine levels of designed, hand painted and procedurally generated, punchy and punky fast mayhem in a uniquely stunning attitude filled world.

games.name: Obake Nante Kowakunai JK vs. Gakkou Meikyuu
games.summary: Curious about horror but bad with scary things? This is a not-so-scary horror game made by a developer who feels the same way, created for players who want to enjoy horror without being truly frightened. A pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure with puzzles and light action elements.

games.name: Omnivael: Chronicles of the realm
games.summary: Dive into Omnivael's enchanting world on PC! Master magic, embark on quests, and explore diverse realms. Uncover mysteries today!

games.name: Out of Words
games.summary: Find your lost voices in a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend, via online cross-platform or couch co-op, explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands — where everything you see is crafted by hand.

games.name: Pair at Sea
games.summary: Manage your own pirate crew and sail across the sea. Take care of the ship morale, drag your sailors from one room to another and raid other ships as you navigate the seas.

games.name: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on Borrowed Dime
games.summary: An action roguelike deckbuilder with a twist: build your deck out of coins! Fight your way through this hellish train to the driver’s cabin, all while the eyes of a snarky demon are observing you. Although it is thrilled to decide your fate by mere coin flips, you were the one to take its job offer.

games.name: Phase Nexus
games.summary: Phase Nexus is an upcoming fast-paced 2D action-platformer starring speedster Cyanser and teleporter Raviel (once again not playable yet). Think of a fever fusion between Sonic (without the loops), Viewitful Joe, Sparkster/Rocket Knight and Luminous Avenger iX/White Steel X. In terms of mechanics and movement from those games, they blend well surprisingly.

games.name: Phi: The Broken Strings
games.summary:
Phi: The Broken Strings is a 3D puzzle platformer that takes you on an emotional journey through four levels, each reflecting a key life experience—Happiness, Sadness, Fear, and Anger.
The game is in the prototype stage.

With over 25 unique puzzles, 12+ immersive events, and dynamic NPC interactions, the game blends exploration, storytelling, and platforming into a 4-8 hour experience.

Perfect for fans of Little Nightmares, Inside, Limbo, and Bramble: The Mountain King.

games.name: Pineview Drive: Rising Storm
games.summary: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

games.name: Plagueborn
games.summary: Plagueborn is a 2D action roguelike where you and your allies battle through plague-ridden dungeons. Explore procedurally generated floors, master a wide arsenal of weapons, forge unique builds, and cut down relentless hordes of darkness.

games.name: PlanetBase 2
games.summary: Colonize the Solar System. Manage a base of near-future humans trying to survive on Mars, The Moon and the satellites of Jupiter and Saturn. Grow food, mine resources, manufacture goods and face all the challenges these remote worlds will throw at you.

games.name: Project Mix
games.summary: Project Mix is a VR anime cyberpunk bartending visual novel. What will you do when you've lost everything you once had?

games.name: Quantum Quartz
games.summary: Steampunk pixel-art precision platformer where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles!

games.name: Rebel Roar
games.summary: Rebel Roar is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in an animal cyberpunk universe. Lead a group of rebel animals, in a revolution against an evil Sapien Corporation. Combine decks to create your perfect warrior: from ninja cat to hacker possum.

games.name: Ruin: Beast City
games.summary: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

games.name: Seasons of Books and Keys
games.summary: After class, small problems drift into the library—harmless at first glance, yet hiding secrets and lies. You see the clues, hear every voice, and turn the page yourself as each case unravels. A bittersweet mystery adventure that blends the experience of reading with the feeling of watching a drama.

games.name: Shadows of Chroma Tower
games.summary: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

games.name: Shutter Story
games.summary: Your friend is convinced his house is haunted. Examine his family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

games.name: Simulacro
games.summary: In this first-person philosophical journey, Poísis, an enthusiastic art student, explores a mysterious island in Greece. As she solves the local puzzles, she uncovers traces of its ancient inhabitants, leading her to question her own reality.

games.name: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
games.summary: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

games.name: Spreadsheets & Dungeons
games.summary: A grid-based turn-based roguelike where you manage a party across a dungeon which is a spreadsheet. Explore each dungeon, level up your heroes, build synergies, scale absurd stats, and survive escalating dungeon pressure through tactical positioning and resource management.

games.name: Stars of Icarus
games.summary: Assemble your crew and take to the stars in a team-based PvP dogfight. Enter the forgotten arenas of space, master your ship's loadout and strategize with the rest of your ragtag squadron. Victory or death, together.

games.name: Starship Bloopers
games.summary: Starship Bloopers is a chaotic co-op space survival game where one wrong move can doom the mission. Play with 2 to 6 crewmates as you traverse space, gather resources, survive disasters, battle aliens and each other's incompetence before the sun goes supernova. Can you keep your SHIP together?

games.name: Steel Core
games.summary: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

games.name: Super Cucumber
games.summary: Super Cucumber is a 16-bit inspired action-adventure game filled with tight platforming, unlockable abilities and plenty of secrets to discover. Traverse more than six towers and overcome dozens of levels, fight your way past devious bosses and become the greatest Aardvark Superhero in the world!

games.name: The Detectorist Guild
games.summary: Explore a quintessential British village collecting artefacts and studying local history. Solve a dark mystery that draws in you and your family. Complete quests for villagers who have a habit of losing their treasured possessions. Donate, trade and sell your ‘finds’ to build impressive collections.

games.name: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore, hide, and evade entities with unique behaviors while using your real phone to detect and exorcise nearby threats, as you uncover what happened to your missing sister.

games.name: The Quiet After
games.summary: The Quiet After is a narrative visual novel where players guide Ava, a survivor navigating a quiet but dangerous world shaped by memory, trauma, and choice. Every decision branches the story, influences Ava’s inner voice, and determines how you survive in the aftermath. The game blends choice-driven storytelling, psychological horror, and atmospheric art to create an emotional narrative experience focused on healing, survival, and the consequences of the past.

games.name: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
games.summary: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

games.name: Town of Tinysville
games.summary: Town of Tinysville is a deck building roguelike set on tiny maps with huge stakes. Strategically place buildings, grow your deck, and master powerful synergies. Enhance your run using unique chance cards, landmarks, and powerful laws that permanently affect your town.

games.name: Twisted Grove
games.summary: A non-violent Roguelike Deckbuilder about befriending critters in a magical forest. Assemble unique decks, pet/compliment/smooch your way into the heart of corrupted flora and fauna, and dismantle the capitalist systems tearing down the Grove.

games.name: Void Hunters
games.summary: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

games.name: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears
games.summary: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-rich, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games like Star Control, Solar Winds, and Lightspeed. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat; build out modular, upgradable ships; and explore a galaxy torn by war.

games.name: Wild Wild Eden
games.summary: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

games.name: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
games.summary: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

games.name: Zeroth
games.summary: Zeroth is a run-based action platformer with mechanical depth and interplay inspired by traditional Roguelikes. Learn the rules of Zeroth through hilarious deaths and guide your heroes as they seek to escape the 0th circle of Haell.

games.name: Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump
games.summary:
Interested in boxing, fitness and bodybuilding?
Do you dream of becoming the coolest boxer and knocking out your opponents in packs?
Do you want to be the most powerful in the gym?
Download the game and let's get started!
Here is a game that can make your fingers tremble with tension, performing the next approach!

games.name: Matchward
games.summary: Tower defense empowered by match 3 puzzle strategy. Level up and unlock potentially game-breaking upgrades. Design your own levels and share them.

games.name: Sokogeek
games.summary: Sokogeek is a block-pushing logic game with electrifying mechanics. Help Flux, a robot vacuum cleaner, escape each level by building the energy circuit that powers the exit. The complexity of the puzzles will test your spatial awareness, abstract thinking, and analytical skills to their limits.

games.name: Shadow Rush
games.summary: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. Can you beat the speed of darkness?

games.name: Indie Hoverboard Racing
games.summary: An advenure racing game featuring colourful open worlds and racing on hoverboards. Single player and for all ages.

games.name: Rogues & Fate
games.summary: A fast-paced two-hero inventory management roguelike. Assemble your inventory and crush bizarre creatures. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to defeat the Fate King in this RPG auto battler.

games.name: Paid in Blood
